tei:div.tei:p: — ru ritrī—sderiri ci rkoriri sde—sdeci rirī—rīririri dze tshoritsāsderī ri — — —snye ༄ ri ririci ritrī —mo sabakan chos mi ྾sa mdzang/ mo7 ༄ ra / d+ngha ( //r+sha kar sa' ri/ rigs rtse phro khang // /༄zhu / ni shu — dze+e ru —rī rki — rī ci ci 7sna rī wabyewaja— d+ngha — ci —r+ṣatsā— — rte chi6 —tsho ca trerīstak+ṣurtse trezi / bye ji zhe ༄ wa ji 3 ci

thoganya rjo/) )rdo+o snye/snem+murdze tsā rīsnyene )ji rī 〉rdzosdadza tre ‘snyo jitrī pho ‘ spre rdza tsāsnyolko'oza sprekyi/ po )/skyostijo trebasta (rke ji snyetswasngo ( 7thug tsā/ pho 31lku jusnyedhege rdzo ḍo bhe

rje1rmā'ermirmā'eshīm5'eskusgrosnasgyurmā'elīzakul+līnu zhin〉47//shuṭ+wābishāsinasushobhanāladaragralhubadz+rasatwaspyunāka ༄༄//skyab thodig rngo rngesem / cwami ngo hrū dpal lngane bla ma dam pa yī shesabalhan l+līmamugyul+līzaṅgāmaku'ismyul+līrmābluspurtswa/snyi'imashrī.ā6spirgornyenashār+sānatodī5shrīlhadraspyasbopuli sgru+o na re da5la bzarnga poshā rnam pa zhe 'ar pa mdo tsham brnod pa l+līri'irmā'isgyuchu 5'imuru'imu'isnyoldeskunimasngatresughunāmasngihaṃracisma//dka ldan bstsan pa'i mdzas rgyanazhas/ bya ba bzhuhā/

7sdeslo+oḥramanyamasdu ṭ+wāṃṭī dībyi lci dz+waX ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃtweṭ+wāṃXṭ+wāṃX bloṭ+wāṃ shā/ ca/r+sā srud+kungaban+yani 5 lta5n+d+ra shāpre༄/lidze ༷ / rmelhayithe(mye /zakhrisno'i m+mesngamashīlha'i cho—rīrinan//ni/prapāritadz+nyān+d+raskedz+wayasurumāya//༄༅slo/rab 'ibyams rgyal ba'alwa pos phyu ma'agar/ /rmol+līrngen rdol+līl+līrmom/ khyegloljadīpashāsan+ya3 trīyan+ḍi rti/r+pāsnyan pu'isgronaswe tso smrag 'an pa ya/ /

———ring ———4 ———— rtswa()lotshonayoṭ+wāṃblurnodamasañcā/ dzo nu//zlo paṅgi ladī sa shin+ti lapy-i+o brdosnosna/nātha///kyai/skyi l+līnaglirnorwaglu/sgro rngarmel+lī l+līzhisnraṭ+wāṃnamā+oridīdz+rajurā hripābya/ (spum ldan rdo rja 'dzanapa' zhabs la nudud/ /

1 ——na dpre skrun gaskaska brazhagartse de yang mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ de'i gong rim mi sna snga rabs pa du ma zhig gis spyi tshogs la shugs rkyen thebs pa'i phyag rjes bzhag pa sogs kyi thad la zhib 'jug gi dgos mkhor bstun/ thengs 'dir nga tshos gong ma chan lung mchog gis/ tā kau shri hu thog thu'i lung las kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar 〈〈dge ldan bsta/na pa'i mdzes rgyan〉〉zhes bya ba par du bskrun pa yin la/dpe ni sngar byang gi dgon chen bzhi'i ya gyal dgon lung byams pa gling du —shing par bzhugs shing dpe grangs kyang mi nyung bar nges mod/ rim gyis rkyen sna tshos/sa kyis deng sa nga dpe yang je dkon du gyur pa dang / lhag par/ dpe 'dir dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i stod tsam nas chin rgyal rabs dang / bod kyi 'brel ba'i thad la zhib 'jug rin thang ldan pa zhi rna bkod 'dug pa so gas la dmigs nas par skrun byas pa lags/gcig sgrig stangs thad ma phyi'i shing par ma la pota gnyis byas 'dug mod/ so sor kha mi 'khyar ba dang rnam thar dkyus gcig tu gzigs bde ba'i ched nga tshos glegs bam gcig tu byas/ gzhung le'u nyer lngar bgos nga khadirazhal bshusabs te skabs7na 'tshol bde ba'iphyiradapedeb la ni rig bzhi mo lha rdo 9 dir+ṣosde dāka/da byo/ dka/khe chaka kru lko/da/

2 daspaskrunagasalabashad/ da ———gnyis/ dbyu 'i/ kyi le'u rnams mthong sla ba'i ched yig 'bru che bar bsgrigs/gsum/ par gzhi 'di'i ma phyi ni stod cha dgon lung shing par ma dang / smad cha pe cin shing par ma yin la/ ma phyir yig nor yin nges re zung mchis pa dag par bcos pa las/ dogs gzhir gyur rigs de mur bzhag pa bcas shing par ma ji bzhin du dpar skrun byas pa yin/bzhi/ rnam thar gyi mjug tu rje de nyid kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag kyang bkod yod/lnga/ par skrun gyi sbyor dngos kun la/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang dang smon lam rgya mtsho lags kyis rgyab skyor rogs ram shugs chen gnang bar bsam pa rtse gcig pas bka' drin che che zhu ba lags/ /zhes kan su'u zhing chen grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gna' dpe legs sgrig gzhung sgrub ci khang gis/

1getshumā pu tho natshanas sbyor nador busdurga/ —/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar〈〈khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bsten pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba〉〉'di nyid matswad pa bo ni/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi ṭā ma'i zhal snga nas kyi sde yin la/ 'di ba'i sku thog dang po ni thu'u nga/kwan blo bzang rab brtan zhu ba/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi/ dadzaku slob ma do sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan mkhan de nyid yin/ de'i sprul sku rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho ba gong ma khāng zhi dang / yung ṭi nga rnam gnyis kyis yun ring bkur gzos rgya cher mdzad pa de nyid do/ /de'i sprul sku rje tha'u bakha/na ra therin po che chos kyi nyi ma ni/ lang gru'u phyo0/sa gtogs dpa' ris phun tshogs lung bar grags pa der pra sti'i rigs su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul (1737)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug par gdan sar bkod/bde sku ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho las dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ dmar — gtsang dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin las yi ge bslabs/ me yos lor sum pa mkhan chen las rab tu byung / chos grwar zhugs te thugs rig 'gran zla med pas bslab sbyangs kyis rtser son/ sa sbrul la lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa las dge tshul balhabs/ bcu dgu ba shing phag la dbus su

da 2 rtsomapabo tshamasarngu+o//ramadorabaca da/ —phebs te 'bras sgo mang chos/ grwar zhugs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po dge rgan du bsten cing blang dor ci gsung bka(re bzhin bsgrubs/lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rje dang / kun mkhyen sku 'phreng gnyis pa rje 'jigs med dbang po gnyis rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung zhing /mkhas grub dam pa sum cu lhag nga sten/ nyer gsum par zhwa lu mkhan por phebs/ nyer lnga bar mdo sma da du phebs te dgon lung gi khrir bzhugs/lug lor rgyal sa pe cin du phebs/ lcang skya rin po che sku na bgres pas rje de nyid dang / gong ma chan lung gi bka' bzhin bstan bgro'i don la sman pa'i legs mdzad kyi 'phrin las nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun khyab par mdzad/spyir mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / rig pa'i gnas thams cad thugs su chud pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ gong ma chan lung mchog gis jing zi'u chan zhi thu'u bkwan hu thog thu zhes rnam dag bslab ldan bsam gtan gyi slob dpon 'phags pa chen po zhes bsngags pa'i lung las kyis gzengs bstod/ dgung lo re drug pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu khyi (1802)lor gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa bsdu bar mdzad/ rnam thar rgyas pa nges 'dod pa dag gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i〈〈rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po〉〉pota gnyis bzhugs pa la gzigs par zhu'o/ /zhes smon lam rgya mtshos/

sha ngang zla —— ༷11 dkar chagamachod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba ( 1 )sngon gyi skyeṭashrī rabs 'ga' zhig gi rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ ( 7 )le'u dang po/ sku bltams pa'i tshul/ (47)le'u sa/nyis rdo4/ chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi bla saung du mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par pakaud pa'i tshul/ (52〉le'u gsum pa/ dbang phyogs tsi na'i yul grur zhabs kyi pad+mo bskyod de 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i tshul/ (74)le'u bzhi ba/ gzhung lugs chen mo rnams thos bsam gyis gtan la phab cing zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du gsan pa'i tshul/ ji (93)le'u lnga ba/ sku na phra mo'i gnas skabs nyid nas mkhas grub chen po'i rnam thar bdag gir mdzad cing / 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos tā kau shri'i lung las phul te chab srid chen po'i bla mar bkur ba'i tshul/ (127 )

ristod 2 dkarachagale'u drug pa/ gong ma chen po'i gser gyi lung bzhin khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gangs ri'i ljongs su gdan drangs te pho brang chen po po ta la'i mi 'jigs seng se/'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod par mdzad pa'i tshul/ — (1 51)le'u bdun pa/ rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mo yab sras las mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mthar phyin pa gsan cing / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por mnga' brnyes pa'i tshul/ (176)le'u brgyad pa/ gnam bskos sa'i tshangs pa chen po'i lung gis rgyal khab chen po'i dge 'dun rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya legs par slob pa'i tham ka bla mar mnga' gsol zhing / bstan 'gyur rin po che hor gyi skad du bsgyur pa dang / chos sde chen po dga' ldan byin chags gling btsugs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i tshul/ (205)le'u dgu ba/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang phan tshun snyan tshig rna ba'i bcud len gyi sgo nas chos kyi dga' ston spel ba sogs mdzad pa thor bu 'ga' zhig sde tshan du byas pa'i tshul/ (225)le'u bcu ba/ grub mtha'i rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan zhes gyo ba sngon med legs bshad kyi dga' ston

dkar chag 3gsar bas bstan pa rin po cher phyag rjes dang skal ldan gdul bya yongs la nam yang nyams pa med pa'i chos kyi skyes bzang bo stsol bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ (262)le'u bcu gcig pa/ gnam bskos mi yi bdag po 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i thugs kyi bum bzang zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis gtams par mdzad pa'i tshul/ (284)le'u bcu gnyis pa/ gdan sa chen po dgon lung byams pa gling du zhabs kyi pad+mo bskyod de mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i tshul/ (303)le'u bcu gsum pa/ rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang mang du bzheras shing dge 'dun gyi sde gsar ba btsugs pa dang /yul phyogs du ma'i rgud pa bsal te dge mtshan rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul/ (332kyile'u bcu bzhi ba/ gangs can gyi ljongs su zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod de chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i tshul/ (370〉le'u bco lnga ba/ bod yul dbus su phebs pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo gangs can mgon po rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid yid bzhin nor bu 'khrul med ngos 'dzin mdzad pa'i tshul/ (41 5〉

da 8———bhe————da — dkorachag le'u bcu drug pa/ byang kyogs bstan pa'i sgron me rnge btsun trem ripa'i mchog sprul rin po cher rab byung gi tshul khrims stso la bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ — — (437〉le'u bcu bdun pa/ mdo smad kyi ljongs su byon nas gdan sa chen po byams pa gling gi chos kyi khrir mnga' bsgyur te pyi tsad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i tshul/ (460)le'u bco brgyad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs par mdzad pa'i tshul/ — —— (483)le'u bcu dgu ba/ thugs sras skyes chen dam pa 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor ba sogs kyi tshul/ (525)le'u nyi shu ba/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs mdzad pa thor bu ba 'ga' zhig sde tshan du bgyis pa'i tshul/ — (549’le'u nyer gcig pa/ mchod yon zung 'brel gyi thus/sa 2skyed smon lam gyi mthusnga paṇa chen thams cad ma/khyen pa gse ra bye/ rgyal khab tu gdan drangs te rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston spel bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ (571)le'u nyer sanyis pa/ gnam bskos mi'i rje bo 'jam dbyanges gong ma chen pos bla ma dadza pa dgung lo bducha/ cur phebs

———— dkar mun /rgapa'i dga' ston pyi gnang skyes rgya cher stsal ba sogs kyi tshul/ (597)le'u nyer gsum pa/ zhing 'di'i gdulabya rdzospyo nas mdzad pa tha ma ba༅stan pa'i tshul/ — — skyiskyi — (612〉le'u nyer bzhi ba/ mnal snyo 'od gsal gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las tshad ma'i lam rim gsasaba'i tshul / —sko — skyi — (633)le'u nyer lnga ba/ rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshu la/ (655)rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ — — (752)zur mikod/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag —d+kuskyi (783)zhu ba po'i t+pa/tam/ — — — skyi sto — — (804〉

1nachod brarnod dad smyo mā pur dmā bucazha da/ sangag rgya0sa kun las sngar sangs rgyas kyang sadwas kyās sras kyi rnam pa 'dzin/ /srid pan+d+ra skye ba yongs su zad kyang srid pa1 skye ba'i tshul yang ston/ /sesduzlo dz+waṅge 'ga' yang gzigs pa medaX spyang sesngus can+t+ra don la rtag gzhol ba/ /phru byā zla med 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis spu byā mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /dbang gzhu'i lding khang dbus na chu skyes gdan steng chags pa'i nyams kyis tsog pur bzhugs/ /mnyen lcugs sor mos bskul ba'i rgyud stong dbyangs kyis snyan tshig mi zad 'dod pa 'jo/ /mtshar sdug lang tsho'e dpal la rgyal ba rnams kyang rjes chags spyan gyis rtag tu gzigs/ /— byangs can ngang ba'i bu mo bdag snying pad mtshor dus kun dgyes pas rtsen par mdzod/ /dzi shes me long gtsang mar shes bya'i ri mo mtha' dag rdzogs par bkra/ /༷legs bshad gru char g.yo bas bshad sgrub bkaun paḍi chu gter rgyas par mdzad/ /'phrin las nyi zla'i sgro1 mes 'jig rten rgud pa'i mun pa kun sel ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma rig/sa brgya'i khyab bdag ro/ra palti kau bye rgyal gyur cig /mi shigs rlung gi rnam 'phrul rdoX rjeḍi mu ni rnam pa med kyang mtshan dpe'i rnam pa yongs su rdzogs/ /gzhomaX med a yi rang gdangs kau dz+rī'i gsud ni rgyun mi 'chad kyang 'byung dang 'jug pa'i rtsol ba bral/ /rtog med bde chen ye shes do

2 mtshod brjod dngartsomaparadamabaca'ab/ ——twe'i sbyigs ni spros dang bral yang shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun la khyab/ /ngo mtshar yon tan phung po khyab bdag rdo rje'i sems khyod bdas/ snyi nga 'dab brgya'i ze'u 'brur rtag tu bzhugs/ /sgrib bral chos sku'i nam mkhar masden bzang nyi zla zung gis rtsen pas dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gsal bar mdzad/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro la nye ring mi mnga' bu ltar bgī bas rtag tu gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub la gzhol/ /yid srubs sde bcas gtan du 'joms pa'i nusngu pa yongs rdzogs dpag bsam shing ltar skye rgu'i re skong 'phrin las mnga'/ /gang gi yon tan sa dang rgya mtsho'i rdul grangs ji bzhinaX dpagaX par dka' zhing ba rjod pa'i yul las rab tu 'das/ /chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha' ji tsam pa/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs kyang de tsam ste/ /ji tsam las dang 2ོna mongs sems can mtha'/ /gang gi 'phrin las mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /'di na ka lan ta ka'i gshogs rlabs rtsal gyis nam mkha'i pha mtha' 'tshol ba'i ngal pa lhur len dang / /byis pa 'ga' yis gting zab chu gter chen po a za'i tshig gus bcus te zad par re ba bzhin/ /rgyal sras thos sgrog bse ru'i tshogs kyi blo gros ra ba las 'gong bla ma'i yon tan lhun po ni/ /'ching ba kun ldan tshur mthong bdag 'dra'i blo gros chung ngu'i kheb kyi mig bur ji ltar tshud par nus/ /'on kyang mya ngam thang du skom pa yis// /gdungs pa'i skye bos chu klung rnyed pa na/ /rdzogs par btung ma nus kyang cha tsam zhig /spyad pa yis kyang gdung ba sel bar 'gyur/ / de bzhi na dge ba'i bshes kyi yon tan gyi/ /cha shas tsam zhig gtad+dha/ du ba sdo da pas

da mchod brjod dang ma par dam bca' ba 3kyang / /skal bzang snying la 'dod pa kun 'jo zhing / /bsod nams phung po mtha' yas sdud pa nyid/ /de phyir bdag gi tshe rabs gzhan du yang / /ma dad rnyog pa bral ba'i yid kyi rdzing / /bla ma'i yon tan 'dab brgya'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /dge mtshan nam yang nyams par ma gyur ces/ /rang don la gus bser bus yang dang yang / /‘yid kyi ma la ya tshal bskyod pa las/ /skal bzang snying la sim pa mchog ster ba'i/ /rtogs brjod bsung zhim 'thul ba khegs ma gyur/ /'di na gser 'od glog phreng do shal can/ /sprin sngon mdzes mas dbyar rnga brdungs pa na/ /rma/ bya gzhon nu nags kyi lding khang du/ /rab dga'i zlos gar ci yang rtse ba bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po'i kun bzang spyod pa'i gtam/ /snyan 'arebs ngag gis dal buca/ gleng ba la/ /gzur gnas tshogs rnams dga' ba'i 'dzum dang grwa cas / /rna ba blags te rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /ji skad du/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi skyes pa'i rabs las/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin brnya na par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur// zhes dam pa'i rnam par thar pa la brten nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnam dpyod can dag gis skyes bu dam pa rnams go 'phang ca/thon por gshegs nga 'i lam gang yin pa me+es nas phyin ci ma log pa'i kru ma la 'jug pa dang / dkon mchog skron me'i gzungs las/ dad pa sdon 'gro

pyi 4 mchod brjod dngartsom paradam bca'ab/ zhe ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs tshogs tham sa cad kyi rtsa ba dad pa sngar ma skyes pa skye zhing / skyes zin gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang / chos dang mthun pa'i mdzad spyod bzang po rnams la rjes su yi rangs pas rang nyid dam rma 'i rjes su slob par byed pa sogs kyi dgos pa khyad par can du ma 'grub cing / sardzu ṭa'i rgyud las/ gang phyir phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams pas/ /slob dpon ba spu'i khung gcig mchog /de phyir slob dpon mchod byed pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas gzigs/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud du ma las phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mechod pa las rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che bar gsungs pa'i rigs pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan brjod pa las kyang / bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam gyi bsngags pa brjod pa bsod nams che bar 'grub pas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rjes/ gang dag rgya mtsho'i gos can rdul snyed kyi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rmad byung ngo —mtshar gtam/ /srid mtha'i bar du dbyangs su bsgrags pa bas 'di

mchod brjod dngartsom paradam bca'ab/ da 5 wan mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /yon tan rtogs pa brjod pa'i cha shas tsam/ /brjod pa'ang bsod nams bla na med do zhes/ /slu med dam pa'i gtam gyis yiṅka drangs nas/ bdag gi yid ni tshul 'dir zhugs par gyur/ rīces gsungs so/ /rgyu mtshan de bas na bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren mchog dam pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dri ma med pa dang ldan pa/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son te rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa la sa'i steng na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i smra ba'i khyu mchog chen po/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs kyi gdugs dkar po rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi khyon kun khyab par 'degs pa la thugs rje dang snying stobs phul du byung ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel ba la rnam dpyod thogs pa med pa'i nges pa don gyi shing rta chen po/ nor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la stobs kyiri 'khor los sgyur ba'i gnam bskos gong ma chen po la sogs pa'i 'dzam gling dregs ldan mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bus gang gi zhabs stegs kyi pad+ma mngon par mchod pa'i lha mi'i gtsug rgyan dam pa/ gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka'i lung gis bkwan ting phu'u shan bkwang tshi tā kau shri ste bod kyi skad du byams brtses kun gyi spyi bo nas dbang —bskur ba'i kun mkhyen chen po zhes pa'i mtshan dang lung las kyis mngon

ri—skre mchod brjod dang rtso ma par dam bca' —paramyotho ba 4gas dang dkyil 'khor kun bi khyab ba—ga don bi slango dwa / / tsho ri dpa〉 cha ni ri mo sku ni skuri mtshan nas smo ri/ te yongs rdzogs bsta/na pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes bsta na pa'i sgron me zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar po sa gsuk+ta ༷ ༷ 0ri tsho ༷1de/ /)steX /// ྅:mi /skyerdon rnam— par g.ya ba — —da — rnam par thar pa rgya ma lta bu las skra sa blangs pa'i thigs pa tsam zhig rang gzhan gyi dad pa'i gsos su brjod rma ra wa// // — — ri rī lte pha

7ngaci sngon sgyi skyes rabus 'ga' zhig gi rtogs brarnod cha gas tsan buzhad pu/ bder gshegs grong du bgrod par chas rnams la/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog gshegs pa'i lam 'di zhes/ /drang por gsal bar stom/ pa'i sa mkhan ni/ /rmad byung dam pa'i rnam par thar pa yin/ /de phyir rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan rang dang / /'phags bod mkhas grub du ma'i rnam thar gyi/ /rin chen phreng ba tshar du dngar ba yis/ /thub bstan gser gyi mchod sdong mdzes par byas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar nyin byed kyis/ /ring nas btang ba snyigs ma'i mtshan dus 'dir/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nor 'bru chud gzon pa'i/ /byi ba rkun po'i rnam thar 'dzin pa mang / /gang zhig 'di na cher rlom du ma'i lo rgyuṭa srin bu'i rjes kyis sa gzhi bkang na yang / /stabs legs dbang gis srid mtha' tsam du legs spyad yi ge'i gzugs su grub pa nyi tshe las/ /phal cher srid pa'i rdul khrod gyi nar 'khyams pa'i spyod tshul gya gyu'i ri mo 'ba' zhig ste/ /glegs bam che yang bon po'i rnga bzhin gzugs yor tsam las snying pos stong pa des ci bya/ /tshangs sras dpal mos lho phyogs chu gter yongs spangs gang gi blo mtsho'i dbus na bder rol pa'i/ /ngang tshul dge ba phyogs kyi mdza' bor rtog par byed la spro ba rab rgyas gom 'gros can/ /nyams

dka8ge sngon sdi—lhas rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha tshogatshom bshad ——pa/ med bsod nams 'dzum dkar rnam par bkra ba'i mdzese sge ga tshig phri nga do shal skyes thogs pa'i/ /dam pa'i spyod tshul ston pa'i legs bshad marjog 'di 'gro la dge legs thog ma'i pho nya yin/ /a ho snyigs ma ba tshware khron pa nas/ /phan bde'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar ba yi4/ /rnam thar 'dod rgu stsol ba'i nor rnyed pa/ chos kyi rdo rje kho bo skal ba bzang / /kwa ye rnam grol don gnyer na chung dag /gdol gtam 'gron bu'i do shal ring dor nas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gzi 'od stong 'bar ba'i/ /dam pa'i rtogs brjod nor bu'i gtsug rgyan longs/ /de ltar thog mar dgos 'brel cung zad brjod nas da ni rnam par thar pa dngos gzhi bshad pa la 'jug par bya ste 'di la riganyis/ sngon gyi skyes pa'i rabs mdo tsam brjod pa dang / sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa rgyas par brjod pa'o/dang po la yang gnyis te/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs kyi tshig zin la thon pa bcu bzhi dang / der mi gsal yang tshad ma'i lung las dngos su thos pa gsum gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'o/ /dang po/ ni/ ji skad du phal bo che'i mdo las/ byang chub rgya mtsho rab brnyes gyur nas kyang / /sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgya mtsho ston mdzad cing / /mi 'grib—spyod pa rgya mtsho dus kun ston/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ / —zhes— rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin te bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis ma dag pa'i zhing

da wa sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ byed wadu sems can gyi don du sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa sna tshogs pa nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du ston par mdzad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas nici/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ yongs su ma dag zhing rnan sa su/ /srid pa ji sred gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs/ der myo/ zad sems can gang la sa/nga 'dul gyi thabs la mkhas pas/ mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dang / rgyal blon 'bangs gsum/ khyim pa pho mo/ tha na bya dang ri dwags yan chad kyi sems ldan dang gru zam gnas mal zas gos sa chu me rlung sogaru'isemyo/sa med kyi bem po'i rnam pa ci rigs pas/ gdul bya mtha' dag ga nas skabs/ dang mthar thug gi phan bde la 'god par mdzad de/ sdong po bte/da pa'i mdo las/ de dag kun tu 'tsho ba'i chos 'dzin cing / /bla na ji spro da dang bla na med rnams dang / /ral pa ring dang gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag gi yang slob dpon 'byung ba yin/ /de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur/ /sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa 'phyin shing dang / /lnga ma zhol 'khyams pa rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ /zhes ngaske/phungs pa ltar ro/ /de lta bas na bdag nyid chen po 'ji lta bu'i sku'e s+t+ya sa pa'i rabs kyi grangs dang go rim 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes tshung mthong ge skye bo su/sa kyang kha tshon bcad nas smra bar mi nus so/ /'o na ji nyerwa no ’rngo‘ 1 da rma ra bya zhe na/ rnam 'grel las/ gnas rga/sum par ni

— wa 10 stonagyiskyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad dzo / 'phos pa na/ /lung 'dren pa ni mkhas pa'i lugs/ zhes gzhal bya'i gnas shin tu lkog gyur rnams lung tshad ma la brten dgos 4ra gsungs pas na/ gnas 'di nyid kyang dus gsum gyi shes bya thams cad la lkong/ tu ma gyur pa'i spyan mnga' ba paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dbang pos mdzad pa'i rje bla ma macog gi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs su ji ltar stsal pa'i gsung tshad ma nyid la brten nas brjod par bya la/ de yang 'khrungs rabs rnak+ka sa kyi to+o0/sa brjod rgyas par mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po dkon ca/chog 'jigs me da dbang pos mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar dad pa'i ljon shing las shes par bya zhing / 'dir ni don bsdu tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyica/ bsnyad pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /don dam chos kyi ro la rtag nol pa'i/ /mi shigs dag pa rdo —rje —snying po'i dpyid/ /kun rdzob cir shāng r+shachar ba'i mig 'phrul ni/ /shādi na sgyu ma'i rol pa bzhin du snang / /'on kyang chags ldan dgu tshigs gzhon nu yis/ /nyi zla'i nu ma rgyas pa sdo bsangs ma'i/ /mgul bar 'khyud pa'i ngal ba bsten pa bzhin/ /bdag 'dras tshul de smra ba bzhad gad gnas/ /de lta na yang bus pa chung ngu yis/ /gzhan gyi rjes su bzlos pa'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /tshad ma'i lung la brten nas smra ba'i sgo/ /phye bas cung zad gleng ba'i skabs 'di rnyed/ /ye shīs spyan gyis bden gnyis chos kun gzigs/ /'phrin las bzang posaX ba—k+tan pa'i snying po spel/ /legs bshad sgron mes thar lam gsal mdzad pa/ ༷/thams cad mkhyen dngoswā pā ldi n+tu badz+raX/ ༷ /khyod ni

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad dze+e/ 1’stug po bkaud pa'i zhing khams su/ /sar gnas dpa' bo rgya mtsho'e 'khor kyi dbus/ /rang don mthar thug chos kyi sku brnyes kyang / /thugs rje'i dbang gis zhi la mi gzhol bar/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams su/ /gdul bya'i mos pa'i rdzing bu tha dad par/ /gang la gang 'tsham rta gis rol pa bzhin/ /'gog med srid mtha'i bar du ston par mdzad/ 1 /thub dbang chos sprin bzang pos 'jig rten 'dir/ /theg gsum dbyar rnga dal gyis bzhad pa yis/ /rnam grol mngal khur bskrun pa'i gtsug phud can/ nyon mongs dgra sde bcom pa ts+tshaju zhes/ /mkha' la rgyu skar khrod na pa sangs dang / /sa la rkang 'thung khrod na tsan dan bzhin/ /thub pa'i slob ma'i daX zi na khams sa/sum gyi/ /kun byi+or 'dul ba'i dpa' bo mchog tu gyur/ 3 /shākyā bgīs gnye0na e/sa grag3 shrī ded dpon gyis/ 'dus pa'i man ngag gser gyi gru sbyar nas/ /grub pa'i go 'phang rin chen gling son ces/ /grags pa'i ba dan 'phagagā 'ipa'i yul na bsgyengs/ /klu sgrub chos kyi mdun sa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ gyel sras pad dkar 'di yi rnam par thar/ /tshig gi cha shashāzi sdi yang zla tshes bzhin/ /mkhas mang bde 'byung gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ kā /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur pa/ /grub mchog gdengs can dbang po dbe+en zhes/ /grags pa rab snyan gser gyi rnga bo che/ /khor yug ri bogle r+shar du lhang lha nga brdud+ku+o / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyi ma'i 'od/ mo /'thungs pas lang tsho rgyus pa'i pad dkar de/ /'chi med grub ༷༷ dge sar so 'phreng ni/ /mthar byed grang reg dgra la 'phya bzhin rgod/ 4 /

— 12 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa /thub bstan drod kyis btang ba'i bho ṭa'i yul/ /ma rungs kla klo'i kha ba rgyun chags par/ /mdo dang rgyud sde nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brgya/ /ka ba dpāl b.ram̐gs khyung sdon skyes kyis drangs/ /dam chos rin chen sgrorno rme tshar da ngar nas/ /bod yul rgud pa'i mun pa nyer bcom pa'i/ /bka' ༷4/ sdong bo ljongs 'di'i blo ldan la/ /gser gyi ri bo ji bzhin khur du lci/ ྾ /mdo sgyu sems sde'i man ngag la brten nas/ /kun bzang gnyug ma'i rang zhal mngon sum gzigs/ /snang srid rten 'brel kun la mnga' brnyes pa/ /go+o phywag pa zhes grags pa'i 'brug sgra ldir/ /zur rigs sa/dung gi rnyog braṅge ñjingaX bu'i nang / /gsang bdag sprul pa'i zla snang tshokrudi shar tshe/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyurakha gardzan pa'i ku mu da/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'dab ma lhug par bzhad/ a+yo /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /zhal bzang zla ba'i 'dzum 'od 'thungs pa las/ /dge legs ku mud rgyas pa'i dpal yon can/ /si si ri bar grags pa'i ma ṇi pa/ /gang gis rkun nor ltar sbas yon tan driX/ ༷/r+ghaṃrgos pa'i rlung gis phyogs kun khyer ba na/ /'di ni 'phags pa gos )kasdo 'chang ba zhes/ /kun gyis bstod bsngags me tog phring bas mchod/ 7 /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'bras bzang g.yur za'i dpag bsam shing / /rdo tre+e steng gerwa mtshan gsol glang thang pū/ /khe rgyal bde dge thams cad net+t+waṃn la ba tang / /pham gyoje sdig sdu ga thams cad rang gis len/ /tshul 'dis rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzod pa kun/ /khyed kyi rnam thar

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'gaX kyi/sa brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 13yin par da gdod khums/ 8 /'od gsal 'khon gyi sa/dung rigre/sa shar ri'i rtser/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo smra ba'i zla ba 'dzeganu// /sa/ngas ri'i mdangs kyis phyogs kun dkar ba'i ljongs/ /phanapabade'i 'od kyinu/ lhag par dkar bar byas/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas rgya bod hor gsum kun/ /dbang du bsdus te bu ram shing pa'i bstan/ /'khor lo gsud+ngha 4 gyis phyogs mthar rgyas/ mdzad pas/ /chos rgyal 'pha rngo //sa par grags pa don dang mthun/ deng /'chad rtsod rtsom parla 'ojo zer rnobum jeg gis/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs pad+mo kha phye ste/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsiri da rngo/'a sto na stsol mdzad pa/ /bla ma dam pa bsdod nasdus kyāl mardzun zhes/ /gangs can ljongs kyi mkhas grub mtha' dag gi /gtsug na zhabs kyi pad+mo ngal bso zhing / /rab dkar gragasta ༷ mu tig do shal gyis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin pa skal bzang byas/ 10 /tsho gas gnyis shar ri'i ba gam la 'dzegs pa'i/ /rgyal sras zla ba mdzad bzang 'od dkar can/ /bsta/na 'dzin lha chen ral pa'i rgyan gcig bu/ /de ni byamag chen ltos rdi zhes su grags/ /gang gi gsang gsum bkod pa'i rnam 'phruzlo gyiXs/ /'dzam gling sa chen skyong ba dbang bsdus te/ /shar phyogs 'jib/ rten dad pa'i khang bzang rtser/ /blo bzang ring lugs rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzod/ /rlabs chen 'phrin las nyal 'gro gangaru/ can gyi/ /'dzin ma 'i rgyun du 'khyil ’ba 'du sa sde'i mtsho/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub rlaX da phreng g.yo ba gang / /mkhas grub gdengs can bye ba'i rol gnas gyur/ 11 /sde snod chu gter 'jing na rnam par rol/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod

14 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs bsdod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ da dgebadag gir 'dzin/ /lung rigs sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka stong ldan pa/ /rte btsun chos k+shi rgyal mcha na nā gen+d+ra/ /gang gi legs bshad char checha/ do r+shal spyos/ ༷ / blo rbozang n+ning lugs rgya mtsho'i dpal rgyas te/ /bshad sgrub rlabs phreng 'bum phrag 'phyur ba la/ /bgrang yas blo gsal ngang mo 'phur lding rtsen/ /mkhyen bzang baiḍūr chu 'dzin ba gam las/ /rgya chen lung gi gru char dang bcas te/ /dgag sgrub rigs pa'i gnam ༷sngigs stong phabs pas/ /rgol ngan log rtog brag ri thal bar brlags/ 1kra /drang srong dzo hus gaṅgā hub gcig gis/ /'thungs la mtshar ci dpal 'byor lhun grub rjes/ /sa dge phyag rdzogs grub mtha'i klung chen bzhi/༷ /cije charno rnarmi dpyod zhal du drangs 'di rmad/ /gangs can mablo/na po phyag na pabh+yo/sa kyang / /ris/sa kyi bdag por bzung na ljongs 'di yi/ /mkhas grub gzhan dag spyi bo'i cod paṇa gyis/ /gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo cis mi bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi pha rol son/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i bang mdzod bdag gir mdzad/ /mthu ldan srung swāXd tshogs rnams bran du ba kol/ /khyod ni zla bral rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ 13 /phun tshogs nags ཿོla 'khrigs pa'i mdo smad ljongs/ /grwags pa 'od zer brang 'gro'i snying po 'khrungs/ /rnam dag khrims mye dri bsum̐ng ṣ+pem spo yis/ /blo ldan yid kyi brtan pa dbang med 'phrog /e ma kun las dman pa'i sa bzung nas/ /kun gyi spyi bos bkurno ba'i gnas thob cing / /mi bsrun skye bo'i smod tshig dug mda' yang / /bsngags brjod me tog sil mar gyur 'di rmad/ bum nang mar me bzhin du yon tan

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod chashasatsamabashadapa/ 1byo dgetshogs/ /nang du sbas kyang spyod tshul bdud rtsi'i rdzing / /chos brgyad rus sbal ༷༷1sa kyis ma rnyog pa/ /gang gi rnam thar pad+ma'i sbubs bzhin gtsang / 14/thub bstan mkha' la blo bzad sdos ldan zhes/ /skal bzang kurdo'i gnyen gcig shar ba yis/ /ṭ+wāṃge dragaṅge 'oṭ+wāṃ kyis sa kun snang byas zhes/ /grags pa'i yi ge 'og min bar du so nga / /rgyal bstan nyal 'gro snyigs ma 'i than chen gyis/ /gdungs pas chu thigs go 'phang 'dzin phyogs pa/ /'di yi gsang gsum sprin sngon las 'ongs pa'i /'phrin las char gyis bskyangs pas rgyas par gyur/ /gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par legs 'doms pa'i/ /khyod kyi legs bshad pad+ma'i phreng ba ni/ /dus 'dir skal bzang bung ba mtha' dag la/ /rnam grol sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rmad byung skyes rabs brucu bzhis nyer mtshon pa'i/ /sna tshogs sgyupha'aphrul bkod pa 'byarmos hūṃs skyos/ /'gro 'dul 'phrin las dus las mi yol ba/ /'dren mchog bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o//gnyis pa 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs las dngos su mi 'byung yang tsha da ma'i lung la sa thos pa'i skyes rasdus gsutrī shu gyi rtogs bangod mdo tsam gleng bar bya ba ni/ de yang rje bla ma 'di nyid skyes bu dam pa mang po zhig gis bla chen daswongs p+ta n+d+rab gagal gyi sku'i skye bar gsungs te/ bla chen tan haṃ| tu barmyegs ṅgeshās rehūṃ rang mang po la chos gsungs pas de rnams kyis dad pa thob ste/ ma re+ongs pa'i dus su mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir chos sde che chung du mar gtsus/ lag krong la kaser thog 0/yu thog 'ge la/ nga/ge

nga wa16 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsamatshoshad pa /ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan byed cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i dus su bstan pa la bya ba byed par smon lam btab/the'u rang gcig ci byas kyang dad pa ma thob par de lta bu'i dus su rgyakhapre phran zhig tu skyes nas gtsug 'a/ga khang rnams bsreg cing bshigs/ dge 'dun rnams si skrad/ dam pa du ma bkrong ba sogs bstan la 0/nod 9 byed pa'i lo ga pa'i t+thayo/ lam btab/ bla chen gyis de lta bu'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig tu gyur nas rgyal phran des bstan pa bsnubs pa slar yang gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam rgya chen po mdzad do/ /dus phyis rgya'i dmag dpon nyen gung gis mdo smad kyi dgon sde rnams bshigs pa rje bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mchu+o'i bka' drin las 3gong ma chen pos slan+d+ra ya nga gso bar mdzad na'ang / da lta'i bar thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa rgya chen pos yun ring du bskyangs te chos srid sa/nyis char nar+sha/ nu gro dha'i ljo na pa ngazhin du rgyas par byed pa po ni rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid yin paṭan na/ log pa'i smon lam 'debs mkhan ni nyen gung dang /ga(nan rnams des bkṛngs pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig dang bla chen ni rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid yin no zhes phyogs 'di'i bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du gyur pa'i dam pa —māng po zhig zhal mthun par gleng ba thos so/ /rgyu mtshan de bas na bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal ni bla ma dam pari sku'i skye ba snga ma zhig tu gdon mi za baṭa/ de'i rnam thar mdo tsam bshad na/ bla chen 'di sku snga kyapu 'bro rnya ga snang /khri4/ sum rje bya bar 'khrungs nanu/ chos ldan gyi rgyal po'i nga 7/'a slo+o/ rma dzad/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i smo/na 'a ma rgya chen po

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 17btab nas rang lo so lnga ba lcags phag gi lo sku tshe 'phos pa/ chu pho byi ba'i lo tsong kha bde khams su bon po bza' mi gnyis kyi bur sku'i skye ba bzhes/pha mas mu zu gsal 'bar zhes bon ming btags/ sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis chos la dad nas sku nar son pa na lkog tu no na 'jam dpal bya ba las bzlas lung blangs/ khang rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba zhig la sems bskyed zhus/ skyi rgyal ba'i gtsug tor la dbu tshad dang / nam dga' ldan byang chub la yo ga gsan dus de'i tshe na bod du rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pas/dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa na bzhugs pa dmar ban shākya nu che// g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal dang gsum gyis karma sha tam tsu/sa/sa 'dul ba'i dpe cha dgos pa rnams bsnams nas nyin par yib cing mtshan mo lam bcad de bros nas mnga' ris su slebs kyang / der bzhugs ma nus pas byang lam brgyud de hor gyi yul du byon/ der dge bsnyen shākya shes rab la brten te re zhig bzhugs kyang skad rigs ma gcig pas bstan par bya ba byed ma nus pas/ mdo smad lho'i be ri tsha mtsho ngos nas tshur byon te/ rma lung gi lo rdo rje brag /an chung gnam rdzong / tan tis/ shel gyi yang dgon rnams su bsgom zhing bzhugs/ de'i dus su tacha/ tig gi ri la phyugs ma 'tsho ba rnams kyis brag phug zhig na khong gsum bzhugs pa mthong nas/ dgong kha grong du mi rnams la gleng ba/ mu zu gsal 'bar gyis thos nas/ sang nyin blta bar phyin pas slob dpon gsupa mthong /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas thar ba yi/ /bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i sdug

18 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha rtus tsam bshad pa/bsngal zhi byed pa'i/ bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dang por bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar bya/ /zhes dgongs nas rab tu 'byung bar shusol ba btab pas/ 'dul ba'i po ti gtad nas 'di la ltos dang dad na rab tu 'byung ngo gsung / bltas pa na dad pa lhag par skyes te mchi ma byung nas rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ gtsang gis mkhan po byas/ g.yos slob dpon byas te rab byung dang dge tshul du bsgrubs te/ mkhan slob kyi ming sbyar nas mtshan la dge ba rab gsal zhes btags pa phyis su thugs rab che bas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal zhes grags so/ /de nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi 'ong gsungs pa la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes glang dar ma bsad pas bod du bzhugs ma nus par bros nas glong thang du phebs yod pa'i drung du phyin te zhus pame/ ngas rgyal bo sdig can bsad pas kha skong mi 'ong / 'on kyang ngas btsal gyis gsung ste/ rgya'i dge slong ko pang dang gyi ban bya ba gnyis btsal te btang / de nas sngar gyi mkhan slob kyis mkhan po dang las slob byaṭa// dmar gyis gsang ston/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis kyis kha skong byas te bla chenas bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /de nas bla chen byang phyogs su cang in rtse mkhar mi nyag gha'i yul du byon te go rong seng ge grags la 'dul ba gsan pas/ lung sde bzhi bstan bcos dang bcas pa gnang nas/ bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshe gas pa'i bstan pa tshul bzhin du gsal bar gyis shig kho bo ni rgas pas yun ring du mi 'tsho gsung skad/ dbus gtsang du sngar rgyal po glung dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas rab byung ba med par byas pa'i

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i dzās/ shrī brjod cha shasatsam bshad pa/ 1ni— ge—dbang gis sdom pa blang yul ma rnyed pa la/ mdo smad du mkha rin pa mi rdzo/sum dang bla chen rnams bzhugs pa thos nas/ sdom pa len par klu mes tshul khrims shes rab sogs gtsang dbus kyi mi bcu slebs/ gtsang la bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas nga rgas nas mkhan po mi 'khyongs rngachi sa bla chen po la zhus shig gsungs pa bzhin zhus par/ bla chen gyis nged bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mkhan po mi btub gsungs pa la/ gtsang gis dmigs gsal la rung gsungs nas bla chen pos mkhan po dang / gtsang dang g.yos las slob dang gsang ston/ dmar dang ha shang gis kha skong byas te mi bcu bo bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /de nas bla chen gyi zhal nas/lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring rkos mkhas pas gnas gzhi zungs zhes sogs kyi bslab bya'ang gsung / de nas klu me sa kyis krum ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba nyan cing bsdad/ gzhan rnams bod du thegs/ phyi lo klu mes kyang bod du chas te/ phe bas khar bla chen la mchod gnas zhig zhu sa par bon zhwa 'ob zhu sa ser gyis kha bsgyur ba gsol 'phro zhig gnang nas 'di gyon la nga rjes su dran par gyis gsung / mi bcu bo bod du 'dzom ste/ so sos gnas gzhi dang gtsug lag khang bzung rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa spel te bstan pa dar bar byas so/ /de lta na bstan pa phyi da t+na zhes grags pa'i thog ma ni bla chen po las byung ba yin pas bka' drin 'di ni gangs can pa rnams kyis nam du yang gzhal bar nus pa ma din no/ /bar skabs shig shar phyogs su lha rtse bhig tig ces bya ba/

20 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/sdon gyi lha rten mang du bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyi gnas zhig tu kwa 'od mchog grags pa dang mjal nas/ shes rireb kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bum tika la sogs nga/ dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'a sogs pa mngon pa'i theg pa chen po lo bcu gnyis su gsang/ nas/ mtshan mo'i rmang lam na glang bo che gcig la bcibs nas nor bu rin po che phyag tu bsnams nas/ tshong 'dus kun tu 'gyu zhing byon pa la mi rnams kun na re/ btsun pa khyod kyi nor bu bzang ste/ da ltar re shig nyo ba ya nga rmad/ rin yang mi therga/ zer ro/ /de nas mnal sad nas bsam pas/ bstan pa rin chen sgrom phye ste/ /yon tan mchog gi nor byin yang / /mi rnams don du mi gnyer bas/ /re shig nags su gnas par bya/ /snyam du dgongs pa'i skabs su/ ri tan tig dang nye ba na the'u rang spun dgu zhes bya ba mi ma yin stobs dang ldan pa de rnams bla chen po mthong ba dang dad pa skyes te/bdag cag gi sa phyogs gang dang gang na dgon pa chen po dngos grub brnyes pa mang du byung / rtsa ba dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rnyed sla ba der 'byon par ci gnang / bdag cag gis kyang khyed kyi grogs dang dge bsnyen du yang bgyi'o zhes zhu bas/ gnang nas tan tig tu byon no/ /de nas gnas der dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen ngo dang / chos skyong la gtor ma rgya chen po la sogs pa mang du mdzad nas/ bstan pa bsrung ba skyob pa'i spyan snga ru/ /thugs dam bzhes pa rgyal sras dpa' rna rma sa dag 'jig rten skyong ba rdzu 'phruk+ṣ-ir stobs ldan pa/ /skyob la gus rnams bdag la stong grogs mdzod/ /

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 21ces gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des cig char 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya ba dge ba'i phyogs ci yang mi byed pa'i log rtog can mang bas/ de dag dgag pa'i ched du lha khang dang mchod rten dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ tshon rtsi yang yul der byung / bzo yang rang nyid kyis mdzad nas 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson par mdzad do/ /de ltar dam pa'i spyod pa de lta bus dad pa skyes nas/ sba gor ye shes g.yung drung zhes bya ba de 'khor mang bo dang bcas nas tan tig tu byon pa dang / bla chen pos dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams0brjod pas/ rang nyid kyi spyod lam de lta bus gnong zhing 'gyod nas tshul bzhin du rab tu byung / de'i rjes su par gnas brtan grags pa zhes bya ba rab tu byung ste/ sba par gnyis so/ /de bzhin du ja pa grags pa dang cog chen shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis te/ja cog gnyis so/ /de bzhin du bzhad dpal gyi sdo rje zhes bya ba dang srags rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis te/ bzhad sgags gnyi sa so/ /'al ba rdo rje dbang phyug dang bsnubs lab shi dpal gyi dbang phyug gnyis te/ 'al bsnubs gnyis so/ /zong mchog chos skyong dang 'tshur shes rab mchog gnyis te/ zong 'tshur gnyis so/ /de ltar bla chen slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i dben pa'i gnas yid du 'ong ba der sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas shing chosaspyakyi dga' bde la gzhol ba na/ mtshan mo'i dus zhig lha'i dbang bo brgya byin la so gas pa 'dod khamangasmu kyi lha du ma bla chen la chosaḍā nyan par 'ongs pas/ lha'i k+ṣ-i+oni+od pyi ri ga yu sna

22 sdon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad dzi/de dag gsal bar byas pa 'khor rnams kyis kyang mthong ngo / /lha rnams kyis mchod pa byas shing bla chen gyis de dag chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdza da pa na lha rnams kyis/ btsun pa khyod ni bzang na mi ma yin gyi 'khor 'di dag ni ngan no/ /zhes zer nas song / phyi nyid+ngha 'khor rnams kyis mdang ya mtshan pa'i snang ba 'di lta bu mthong bas bla chen po nyid nges par sprul pa zhig lags sam zhus pas/ sprul pa ma yin gyi/ bdag ni theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i sbyor ba'i lam ba snang ba thob pa la zhugs pa'i ban+de dge ba gsal yin zhes gsung / yang skabs gzhan du/ dang po bud med sgog 'tshong ma/ /bar du stag sna khri sum rje/ /da lta mu zu dge ba gsal/ /zhe 8 she bya ba'i skyes rabs kyang gsungs so/ /mkhasashrī pa mi gsum ni re zhig gi bar tan tig tu bzhugs nas sku tshe'i smad du dmar dang sa/tsang gnyis tsong chu chen po'i 'gram gyi ri brag dmar po zhig la khang bu brkos te bzhugs pas ri de la dmar gtsang brag zhes grags shing deng sang der chags pa'i grong pa'i ming la yang dmar gtsang zhes 'bod do/ /g.yo da 3/ 'byung de dang thag mi ring ba zhig tu bzhugs pas lung ba de la g.yo dge lung ba zhes grags pa deng sang zur chags pas dbyi dge lung pa zer ro/ /mthar gsum ka da lta'i zi ling mkhar yod pa'i gnas 'dir phebs nas sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i gdung la mchod rten bzhengs pa phyis su rgya mkhar gyi nang du tshud pas bsnyen bkur so gas ma byung bas sa 'bu ma tsam du gyur pa dus phyis kyi bar du yod zer ro/ /bla chen kyang spu/ tshere —tram̐d sdo dmar gtsang du byon/ der gtsug la ga ṣa nga dang rtelnga/ rnga/ nga du

rdzidzod+ngha sngon gyicesarabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad ba/ 23bzhengs/ brag la brkos pa'i khang bu zhig tu bzhugs nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ba shing mo phag gi lo mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i che zhal nas/'phags pa thogasdo med dang btsun pa mche ba'i sde gnyisnga kyis rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs pa mi 'dra bar bkral ba de/ kho bos rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po la 'dri dgos te/ slob dpon de gnyis kyang da lta dga' ldan na bzhugs so zhes gsungs shing / yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir da lta 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon yang bskrad de gtong bas/ kho bo byams pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ma byon gyi bar du 'dzam bu'i gling 'di thams cad du skye ba brgyad tsam len dgos zhes kyang gsung / bla chen gyis bstan pa'i me ro gsos tshul phyis su a ti sha la zhus pas/ so so skye bo la de lta bu'i 'phrin las mi 'ong bas/ bla chen sa thob pa cig yin nges gsungs shing / 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mdo mchod bya ba gzigs nas bod kyis 'di lta bu ga la shes/ paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa zhig yin 'dug ces gsung skad/ sku gdung ril po ma nyams pa'i phyi nas 'jim pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa brag phug der bzhugs pa la/ dus phyis brag phug rdib kyang skyon cung zad kyang ma byung /de nas dad ldan rnams kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas da lta der bzhugs so/ /sku brnyan de nyid kyicag skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig la gsung byon pa dang las dag pa 'ga' zhig la mthong snang ya mtshan can byung ba dang / skabs 'ga' zhig tu zhal mdangs nag por gyur pa dang / sku las rdul thon pa lta bu byung skabs dmag 'khrugs sogs mi legs pa dang /zhal mdangs bzang ba'i dus su yul phyogs su bkra shis pa 'byung ba dang /

24 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ yang sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa 'ga' zhig gis phyag mchod sogs byas pas nyer 'tshe las thar ba sogs kyi lo rgyus ches mang zhing / rgyun du'ang zhal ras kyi mdangs mi 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang / thugs ka'i thad du reg na sku byin dang mi 'dra ba'i drod yod pa lta bu dang / na bza' phul ba la skyi chags shing skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku la 'byar 'gro ba dang / dus bzang rnams su tshul khrims kyi dri ngad kyis gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang thams cad khyab pa sogs kyi ya mtshan da lta'i bar du dngos su snang ngo / /kye ma rgyal ngan gla0nga bo yi/ /log smo/na sdig pa'i stobs darwa bas/ /ljongs 'di'i thub bstan pad+ma dkar/ /brlang spyod mche bas rtsad nas phyungs/ /de tshe bstan pa 'ba' zhig ni/ /bde legs rtsa bar gces dgongs pa/ /bla 'di yi bka' drin gyis/ /slar yang rab tu gsal brno mjed/ /tshul de 'jig rten kun la spron pa'i slad/ ༷/dbang zhis phyogs kun snang ba'i 'od bkye zhing / /khengs pa btang ste gang gi drung lhags nas/ /gtsug nor zhabs la gtugs pa'i lha phyag bgyis/ /rgyal bstan yungs 'bru'i tshad du gyur pa ni/ /mi ring dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rnam thar mchog 'dis mkhas rnams yid 'phrog ste/ /gang gi ring bsrel la yang sri zhur brtson/ /gzhan yang bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid/ sgra bsgyur mad pa chos k+to sngo gos kyi sku'i skye ba yang yin te/ rgyu mtshan ci lta bu zhe na/ d+me maX darmi 4 waṃd du lan rjes ma phebs skabs/ nyin cig lha bris pa zhig la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhing bkod 'bri rgyu'i zhal ta gnang

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 25zhing / de dus kho bo yang sku drung du yod pas/ zhing bkod kyi lha gras su mar pa lo ts+tsha cis kyang 'bri bar gyis/ de la rgyu mtshan zhig yod ces gnang ba dngos su thos/ yang nyin gcig kho bo mjal du phyin nas sku drung du phyag 'bul skabs/ rtsed mo'i rnam pas khyod kyis nga la phyag byed pa dad pas yin nam/ mdzes lam gyis yin zhes phebs pa la/ dad pas yin mod zhus par/ khyod dad pa'i mig gis lta shes sam/ /dad pa'i mig gis lta shes na/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /sgra bsgyur mar pa lo ts+tsha de/ /dag pa longs sku'i tshul du bzhug/sa/ /zer ba go ye zhes gsungs/bdag la de tsam las ma gsungs kyang rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang / lha btsun no min han lhun grub dar rgyas dang / ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' sogs la/ nged rang mar pa lo ts+tsha yin srid de gzhan la ye ma lab ces dngos su gsung snang ngo / /des na mar ston gyi rnam thar mdo tsam 'god na 'khrungs yul ni/ lho brag chu khyer gyi gro bo lung dpe gsar du/ yab mar pa dbang phyug 'od zer dang /yum rgya mo bza' mdo sde gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ yul gyi slob dpon zhig las yi ge 'bri klog bslabs pas tshegs med par thugs su chud/mtshan chos kyi blo gros zhes btags/ 'brog mi lo ts+tsha ba'i drung du phral skad kyi lo tsā bslabs/ rgya gar du 'byon par bzhed nas yo byad thams cad gser du bsgyur pas srang bco brgyad tsam byung ba bsnams nas bal bor byon/ lo gsum gyi bar tsha ba goms su bcug /de'i ring la spyi ther ba'i bhong nas gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas rgya

26 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/gar du byon pu la ha ri'i dgon par rje nā ro pa dang mjal dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur nas rgyud brtag gnyis dang / rdo rje gur dang sa/skyo ṭa rnams gsan/ gsang 'dus zhus par nged kyis kyang shes mod/nub du la k+ṣe tra'i dgon pa na pha rgyud kyi bdag po paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes snying po bzhugs pas der song la zhus gsungs pa bzhin phyin nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang dang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzhan yang kri ya dang yo ga phyag len las tshegs dang bcas pa gsan/ tshur byon nas na ro pa la ma hā mā yā zhus pas/ de ji5nga ngas shes na'ang dug myo/tshori gling du ku ku ri pa bzhugs pa de ma rgyud kyi bdag po yin pas khong la zhus gsung /de nas lam bar du dug sbrul dang gcan gzan dang mi ma yin gyi 'jigs pa dang bcas par dka' spyad chen pos lho dug mtsho'i gling du zla ba phyed kyis thon/ dpal zhi ba bzang po dang mjal te sgyu ma chen 5'i dbang dang gdam sa ngag rnams rdzogs par zhus/ phyir phebs nas junā ro pas kyang tshar gcig gnang / de nas mai tre pa dang mjal bar dgongs te dka' spyad srog dang bsdos nas ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon par byon/ mi tri pa'i zhabs la gtugs te phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang do ha'i bshad pa rnams rdzogs par gsan pas sgro 'dogs rnams cig char du chod pas/ rje mnga' bdag chen po'i bka' drin kyis/ /gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs/ /sems stong pa nyid la spar zin byas/ /mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas chod//ces sa/sungs/ gzhan yang dur khrod so sa gling du mkha' 'gro'i bla ma

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad ba/ 27las gdan bzhi dang / sir+gha gling sogs gnas du mar mkha' 'gro dang ku su lu'i bla ma mang po las gdams pa sna tshogs pa gsan/ slar yang nā ro pa'i drung nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / /nā ro'i chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa rnams gsan cing bsgoms pas rtogs pa bzang po 'khrungs/ de ltar rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas bod du byon pa'i lam bar bal bod mtshams kyi grong khyer zhig tu mnal lam du dpal gyi rir byon nas bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang mjal/ phyag rgya chen po'i brda don rnams gsan pa thugs la bzung /lho brag tu phebs nas rngog ston choṭasdo rdor la dgyes pa rdo rje/ mtshur ston dang mar pa mgo legs la gsang 'dus kyi dbang / rim lnga'i dmar khrid/ba rang lwa ba can la ma hā mā yā'i bshad pa rnams gnang zhing so sos gser la sogs pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen po phul/ tshogs 'khor gnang ba'i gral du slob ma rnams kyis zhus ngor mar pa rang gi rnam thar mgur du gsung ba ni 'di ltar ro/ / rje rtsod ldan dus kyi rdo rje 'chang / /dka' ba spyad pa'i skyes bu mchog /kun gyi spyi bor thod bzhin 'khur/ /dpal nā ro'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /nga lho brag mar pa lo ts+tsha 'di/ /lo bcu gnyis lon nas chos dang mjal/ /de sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad par nges/ /dang po yig tshang ka kha bslabs/ /bar du sgra bsgyur lo ts+tsha bslabs/ /tha ma lho bal rgya la phyin/ /lo gsum bal bo'i mthil du bsdad/ /byin rlabs can gyi bal bo la/ /rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi nyan/ /

— 28 sngon gyiskyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus/ /des kyang 'dod pa ma tshim par/ /rgya gar yul du chos la phyin/ /chu mi zan dug gi chu la brgal/ /lus dug sbrul bzhin du shun pa brjes/ /srog chos phyir 'dor phod bsam pa yis/ /gnas ngo mtshar mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa/ /byang phyogs phu la ha rir phyin/ /dngos grub can gyi dgon pa ru/ /sgo srung nā ro paṇa chen la/ /rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor dang / /bsre 'pho 'tshams sbyor gyi gdams ngag thob/ /khyad par gtum mo'i las rgya zhus/ /snyan rgyud kyi don la ngo sprod byas/ /nub du la k+ṣe tra'i dgon pa ru/ /dpal ye shes snying bo'i zhabs la gtugs/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nyan/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi gdams pa thob/ lam rim pa lnga yi don la bslabs/ /lho dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du phyin/ /gdugs nyi ma'i gung la smag tu sros/ /lam da lta gsal ba da lta stor/ /srog yal bar dor nas rje btsun btsal/ /dpal zhi ba bzang po dngos dang mjal/ /ma rgyud ma hā mā yā gnang / /dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs/ /sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams pa thob/ /shar dngos grub kyi chu bo gaṅgā brgal/ /ri rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dgon pa ru/ /rje mnga' bdag bai tre'i zhabs la gtugs/ /rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs thob/ /chos phyag rgya che la rtogs pa bskyangs/ /sems dngos po'i bzhugs tshul gtan la phab/ /gzhi chos nyid don gyi ngo bo mthong / /de 'dzam gling yongs la grags pa yi/ /phyogs bzhi bla ma'i brgyud tshul yin/ /gzhan dur khrod myul ba'i rnal 'byor dang / /shing drung gnas pa'i ku su lu/ /

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ ྅9 —yongs su ma grags 'ga' yod de/ /rdzogs rim kha 'thor mang du zhus/ /ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub thabs dang / /phran tshegs kyi gdams ngag rtsis las 'das/ /lam la kha rag gnyos dang 'grogs/ /nged bal bo'i mthil du slebs pa'i tshe/ /nga lho brag gi mar pa lo ts+tsha dang / /kha rag gnyos kyi lo ts+tsha gnyis/ /lo ts+tsha gang mkhas gang mkhas zer/ /gdams ngag gang che gang che zer/ /yar bal bod mtshams suthon tsa na/ /nor zang zing gi sku bsod khong la skyes/ /yul la stod chos gzhir phyin tsa na/ /sgra bsgyur gyi grags pa mnyam por thob/ /bod dbus gtsang gi mthil du thon tsa na/ /gdams ngag gi snyan pa kho bos thob/ /bla ma grub thob dang mjal lags pas/ /gdams ngag mi che'i dogs ma mchis/ /tha snyad la byang chub mi re bas/ /gzhung bshad pa kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ ces so/ /de nas snyan grags dang sku bsod shin tu rgyas 'khor dang longs spyod mang du 'dus pas bdag med ma khab tu bzhes/ gzhan yang phyag rgya ma brgyad tsam yod de dgyes rdor lha mo dgu dang spyor ba yin gsungs/ dar ma mdo sde sogs sras kyang 'khrungs/ de nas gser mang po dang bcas slar yang rgya gar du phebs/ dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rgyud brtag gnyis/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur dang sardzu ṭa/ rgyal po in+t+ra bo rnyi nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi bshad srol bram ze sa ra ha'i lugs shog dril gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang / gsang 'dus kyi dbang mnyam nyid rnam

30 sngon gyi skyes rabasa'aga'irtogs brjodacha /shasatsam bshad pa/rgyal dang 'grel ba sgron gsal rnams gsan/ mi tri pa la gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang 'grel ba/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud rnams zhus/ gzhan yang sngar gyi bla ma thams cad la mjal zhing chos la dag ther mdzad/ nā ro mi tre'i gtso ba'i bla ma rnams gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par byas/ rgya gar nas snga ma bod du phebs skabs phyag dpe rnams lam bar du chud zos su song bas 'di res dpe cha mang du bsgyur te bris so/ /de ltar rgya gar du lo drug bzhugs nas bod du 'byon khar nā ro pas grong 'jug gi gdams pa sogs snyan rgyud 'ga' zhig len par slar yang rgya gar du lan gcig shog gsung / de nas bod du byon/ mes ston tshon po'i bde mcho ga gi dbang dang gdams pa gnang / rje btsun mi la sogs skal ldan gyi bu slob mang du 'dus/ gser mang du bsgrubs te rgya gar du 'byon par chas pa la/ slob 'khor rnams kyis bshol ci btab rung ma gsan par rgya gar du phebs lam du jo bo rje bod du 'byon pa dang mjal/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gnang ba zhar chos su sa/san/ de nas rgya gar du slebs pas/ nā ro pa mi bzhugs pas/ gshegs khar mar pa yong rgyu yin kyang ma slebs pas 'di sprod gsung rten skal bzhag 'dug pa dge tshul shes rab seng ges sprad byung bas/ bla ma snying la 'dod pas gdung ste bzod glags med pa'i spyan chab mang du shor/ ci la thug kyang bla ma dang mjal dgos dgongs nas/ mi tram̐ pa'i drung du phebs nas zla ba gcig gi bar tshogs mchod dang bcas bla ma dang mjal ba'i gsol ba btab/ de bzhin du zhi ba bzang po/ rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i rgyan ca7 dge tshul shes rab seṅge/ ri ri pa/ ka so

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shaso tsam bshad ba/ 31ri ba rnams kyi drung du'ang zla ba re re la tshogs mchod dang bcas gsol ba btab pas de thams cad kyis bla ma dang mjal ba'i lung bstan stsal/de nas ri sul nags khrod/ grong khyer sogs phyogs thams cad nyul zhing dka' spyad chen pos nā ro pa'i mtshan nas 'bod cing ngu bzhin byon pas sdig spyod kyi rgyal po zhig gis gser 'phrog 'dod pas bzung ste btson la bcug /de las thar nas zla ba brgyad kyi bar du btsal bas mnal lam du mjal/ yang zla ba gnyis kyi bar du btsal bas ma rnyed par shin tu ngal zhing dub pas sgyid lugs pa la nam mkha' nas brtson 'grus skyed cig pa'i sgra byung bas zla ba gsum du btsal bas nā ro pa'i zhabs rjes zhig rnyed pa la dad pa chen pos de'i rdul spyi bor bzhag cing yang btsal bas/ nam mkha' nas rjes rnyed pa tsam la snying po med pa'i sgra gsan/ de nas zla ba bzhi btsal bas ri logs zhig tu rnal 'byor pa gos ser por ri gyon pa zhig mthong ba nā ro pa yin nam min snyam par the tshom byas na don mi 'grub zer gar song med par gshegs/ de nas zla ba lnga'i bar btsal bas zhal mthong yang zhen pa skyes pas de ma thag yal song / yang zla ba drug btsal bas rnyed nas/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul chos zhus pas/ mi ro gcig gi khog pa phye klad pa gsol gyi 'dug pa nas rtsibs mas blangs te gnang nas tho gsungs pa la skyug bro bas de ma thag yal/ yang zla ba drug btsal bas mjal nas ded kyang rjes ma zin/ skabs shig thang chad pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs 'dug pas gsung gleng 'ga' tsam gnang nas yal song / 'di yan nyams snang la mjal ba'o /

32 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod shas tsam bshad ba/de nas kyang dad pa shugs drag pos btsal bas zla ba brgyad song ba na/ ri mun pa can gyi nags su tsardon gyi sdong po'i rtse mor dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par mjal/ bla ma'i sprul par shes nas gsol ba drag /tu btab pas/ da gzod nā ro pa dur khrod kyi chos kyis brgyan pa zhig byon/ pha bu'i mdun na slebs yod gsungs sku mngon sum du bstan pas/ dga' ba che drags khong nas yus pa'i tshig dang bcas mchi ma mang po shor/ zhabs spyi bor blangs pas ma tshim par sku la 'khyud de brgyal/ sangs pa dang gser maṇ+ḍal du bkod de phul/ nā ro pas rdzu 'phrul gyis tshogs rdzas bkug nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/ mar pas chos gnang bar gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te dpon slob gnyis ka phu la ha rir byon/ lam bar du mkha' 'gro ma rnams chos la 'khren pa'i cho 'phrul 'jigs su rung ba byung yang glags ma khel/ de nas mar pas zhus pa bzhin sngar ma gsan pa'i grong 'jug gi gdams pa dang / bde mchos mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi chos skor rnams gnang nas sngar gyi gdams pa rnams phyi'i shun pa lta bu 'di nang gi yang snying lta bu yin pas brgyud pa bcu gsum bar du chig rgyud gyis zhes bka' rgya mdzad/ khyod rgya gar du yong thebs snga ma gnyis la dus la ma babs pas ma ster/ khyad par du chos kyi phyir dka' ba ma spyad na rgyud la phan mi thogs/ ngas kyang te lo pa'i drung du dka' chen bcu gnyis/dka' phran bcu gnyis rnams chos 'di'i phyir du spyad pa yin/ khyod kyis kyang chos kyi phyir lus srog la ma ltos pa'i dka' ba spyad pa'i ched du nga phral du ma 'phrad pa yin gsungs/ de nas chos bkazho gnyan pa dang bar chad

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjodachashasatsamabashadapa/ 33 wakyi rnam pas mar pa rgya tshad kyis snyun nas grong la khade pa byung yang ro nā pa'i byin rlabs kyis snyun las grol/ nā ro pas chos drug rdo rje'i mgur gsung / de nas mi tri pa'i drung du byon nas bde mchog dang dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang zhus/ 'di res rgya gar du lo gsum bzhugs te bod du byon/bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du/ bla ma sen ta pa la chos 'ga' zhig gsan skabs mnal lam du mi tro pa seng ge la chibs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la gsol ba btab pas phyag rgya po brda'i don bstan/ de nas bod du phebs pa'i lam du bu slob rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang de dag la rgya gar du byon tshul gyi mgur mang du gsung / phug ron dang lug gu dang sha ba'i ro sogs la dngos su grong 'jug mdzad nas gdams ngag la yid ches par mdzad/ sras dar ma mdo sde 'bum la gdams ngag mang po dang khyad par grong 'jug gi gdams pa gnang bas/ dar ma rtas brdabs/ nas grong khar phug ron gyi ro la grong 'jug mdzad de rgya gar du bram ze'i bu'i ro la zhugs pa ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po zhes grags so/ /de nas bla ma mar pa nyid kyis gzhung dang gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod kha phye ste bu slob rnams la nyin 'chad cing mtshan bsgom du bcug nas kun thugs dam 'phel ba'i skabs zhig na/ bu chen rnams kyi gdul bya 'phrin las sogs lung ston par bzhed nas so so la rmi lam sgugs su bcug pas/ rje btsun mi la la ka chen bzhi'i rmi lam byung tshul zhus pas thugs mnyes nas rmi lam brda' 'grol gyi mgur gsungs te/ mtshur ston dbang nge / rngog ston chos rdor/ mes ston tshon po/ mi la ras pa dang bzhi

34 sngon gyi skyis rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/'phrin las rgyas par lung bstan/ rngog ston la rgyud kyi bshad pa/ mtshur ston la 'pho ba/ mes ston la 'od gsal/ mi la ras pa la gtum mo'i bka' babs/ khyad par du mi la la slob ma gzhan su la'ang ma gnang ba bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi dbang cha lag dang bcas pa rnams bka' rgyas btab ste gnang / da mdo sde 'bum ni med/ nga'i bka' rgyud kyi pha rabs kyi gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa khyed rnams la gtad pa yin pas 'bungs shig 'gro don 'phel bar yong ngo gsungs/ de ltar sgra bsgyur mar pa de nyid kyis chos kyi phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i dbang du byas na/ snga phyir rgya gar du lan gsum byon pas de dag gi skabs su mar pa rang gi mgur las/ nga bal bo'i lam du zhugs tsa na/ /gcan 'phrang dang chu la thar dus med/ /nags mthug po cig la thon dus med/ /shing sdong po mi ro rengs pa 'dra/ /lam de kun gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsa na/ /bya dgung du 'phur ba gshog pa 'dar/ /zhes dang / nga de nas rgya gar du phyin tsa na/ /mtha' 'khob kyi jag pa shi skyid la/ /srog ci bder thon pa'i re ma mchis/ /gcan gzan gyi ngar skad thos tsa na/ /lus gtsang sar thon pa cung ma bsams/ /sbrul sbal chen gyi kha rlangs mthong ba'i tshe/ /yid brtan par phyin yang gom tshugs 'khyor/ /lam de kun gyi 'jigs pa mthong ba rnams/ /dus da lta dran yang glo snying 'dar/ /chu grags pa can gyi ge ga brgal/ /zhes dang / chos snying nas 'tshol ba'i gdung sems kyis/ /yul rgya gar shar nub chu bzhigamyul/ /thang chen po cig la chod dus med/ /me 'obs kyi thang la phyin

sngorta ༷/ skyes rabs 'gari rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ bye5 no snyam/ /yid chos la ba— mam kyang snying rlung 'phyo/ /nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pas thebs/ /de shi de chad bcu gsum byung / /kha chem/ tshig spu/sukya/ ngazhag sa med/ /dbuko/k+toshaṃ 'gyu ba chad pa lan gsum myong / /dus de kun gyi sdug bsnga/la mthong tsa na/ /sdang dgra'i mig nas mchi ma k+ṣ-ikru chor/ /zhes pa ltar srog dang bsdos pa'i dka' spyad mdzad/spyir paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob dang mkha' 'gro ma ku sā li ci rigs pa'i bla ma brgya rtsa dang / khyad par du brub thob kyi bla ma lnga dang / de'i nang nas kyang 'gran gyi do med nā ro pa dang mi tri pa gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs/gzhung bshad dang gdam sa ngag gas/na rgya che ba'i dbang du byas na/ sgra ka la tsan+d+ras sna drangs nas/ /skadi sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /grogs lo ts+tsha tshogs na nga re brod/ /dgyes rdor gdan bzhis sna drangs nas/ /rgyud 'grel brgya dang sto brgyad shes/ /grogs ston chen tshogs na nga re brod/ /bka‘ra rma ni'i gdams pas sna drangs nas/ /snyan rgyud brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /grogs sgom chen tshogs na nga re brod/ /ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum ni/ /bsre dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa/ /khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ /dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa/ /bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ /rim lnga'i dmar khrid ma gtogs pa/ /rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ /che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ /de thams cad bla ma rje'i drin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gdams ngag de rnams thos rkyang du ma bzhag ཿ/ra bsgon/sa pas thugs

36 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ rgyud la rtogs pa'i yon tan 'khrungs pa'i dbang du byas na/ ngas sos dal dbe+en tshe rtsa rlung bsgom/ /lus sems gcun zhing gcun zhing bsgom/ /'byung ba 'khrugs kyang nyam nga med/ /bogs 'don du shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgom/ /snang ba sdud cing sdud cing bsgom/ /gti mug tu song yang nyam nga med/ /zung 'jug tu shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus bsgom/ /snang ba spro zhing spro zhing bsgom/ /rnam rtog tu song yang nyam nga med/ /sgyu mar shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /'dod yon spyod tshe lha skur bsgom/ /ro bri myang zhing myang zhing bsgom/ /bza' btung du mthong rung nyam nga med/ /tshogs mchod du shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /thabs lam gyi skabs su gzhan lus bsgom/ / bde ba bskyed cing bskyed cing bsgom/ /tha mal du 'dug kyang nyam nga med/ /lhan skyes su shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba bsgom/ /'pho ba sbyong zhing rusgyung zhing bsgom/ /'chi ltas byung yang nyam nga med/ /rdzogs rim du shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /shi ba'i dus su bar do 'dzin/ /bar do sprin dang na bun 'dra/ /chags sdang skyes kyang nyam nga med/ /rang grol du shes pa'i gdengs shig yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skal ldan dang ba 'dren phyir bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i dbang du byas na/ rje mi la sku drung du byon dus/ sku lha sku du ma dang /'byung bzhi dang / cir yang mi snang ba dang / 'ja' tshon dang 'od du snang ba so gas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan/ mar pa mgo legs sogs kyis

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 31sku dgyes pa rdo rje/ bde gsang rdo rje phag mo sogs su k+ṣiṃthong / rgyu mtshan zhus par nga yi dam gyi bskyed rim gsal ba dang / khyed rnams la dag snang shar ba 'dzom pa yin gsung / yang la las sku da lta mthong ba de ma thag ma mthong ba dang / gser sbram 'od 'tsher ba dang / chu 'khyil me 'bar/'ja' dang 'od kyi thig le sogs su mthong nas zhus par/ nga'i 'byung ba lnga'i rtsa thig rlung gsum rnams dwangs mar gyur te rang rgonas su brtan pa dang / khyed rang rnams snang ba dag pa gnyis tshogs kyi mthong snang yin gsung / gzhan yang 'das ma 'ongs thogs med du mkhyen pa/ rtsigs pa sogs la thogs rdugs med par byon pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du mchis shing / yum bdag med ma yang 'od kyi rnam par yab kyi thugs kar thim par grags/ de nas dgung lo gya brgyad pa bya'i lo rta'i zla ba'i bco lnga la ltas ya mtshan pa du ma dang bcas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i dbang du byas na gong du bshad pa ltar yongs grags kyi bu chen bzhi/ las can gyi slob ma bzhi sogs nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu mang du byung ngo / /chos brgyud kyi dbang du byas na rje btsun mi las sgrub rgyud kyi bka' babs bzung ste/ nyi ma lta bu'i slob ma dwags po lha rje dang / zla ba lta bu ras chung pa gnyis kyi/ snga ma las brgyud pa dwags po bka' brgyud ces gangs can gyi ljongs yongs su khyab cing phyag chen dang chos drug gi gdams pa gtso bor dar zhing rgyas/ mes rngag mtshur gsum gyis bshad pa'i bka' gtso bor bzung ste/ brgyud 'dzin rnams la/ gsang bde dgyes rdor gyi dbang bshad gdams pa'i rgyun rgya cher dar bas/ rang re dge ldan pa'i

38 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/gsang 'dus sogs kyi dbang bshad man ngag gi rgyun yang de las 'ongs pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir 'gos lo chen pos/ gangs can gyi rgyud 'dir bshad sgrub gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa ni rje mar pa lho brag pa yin te/ zhes deb ther sngon por gsungs pa ni gzu bo'i gtam du blo ldan rnams shes par gyis shig mar pa'i rnam thar 'dra min mang po zhig 'dug pa las/ 'di dag ni rnal 'byor pa khrag 'thung rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar mthong ba don ldan dang sgo bstun nas bris pa ste rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /deng dus 'di na chos don gnyer ba dag /nyin gcig tsam gyi dka' spyad mi bzod cing / /'u su'i 'dab ma tsam gyi yo byad kyang / /sha las bcad bzhin 'phangs par byed mthong na/ /lus dang srog la mi lta'i dka' spyad dang / /rang nyid dbul la mi sems gtong phod kyis/ / dam chos 'tshol ba'i ngal ba bsten pa 'di/ /ha cang snying stobs tshad las 'das sam snyam/ /e ma sgra bsgyur mar pa lo ts+tsha zhes/ /grags pa lha yul na yang glengs pa des/ /'phags yurmi rmikhaṃsaX grub thugs gsang mdzod brus nas/ /rgyud don gdams pa'i snying nor bod du blangs/ /'on kyang deng dus bstan 'dzin phal mo che/ /chos brgyad bye ma'i mkhar las la g.yengs nas/ /lung rtogs gser gyi sbram bu stor ba la/ /cir yang mi sems byis pa lag stong bzhin/ /de tshe slar yang mar ston gyi/ /dzi shes rang gzugs bla ma rjes/ /bhastan pa'i sgron me sbar pa yis/ /r+shagro rnyi thar lam ston par mdzad// ༷yang sbridag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid/ sku tshe snga mar

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod chashas tsam bshad pa/ 39gtsang skyo na he ru ka'i sku'i skye ba bzhes pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan ci lta bu zhe na/ nyin gcig gzim khang du bu slob 'ga' dang gsung gleng mdzad pa'i lhong zhig la sku rtsed tshul gyis u cu mu chin smon ram pa'i sku skye la/ khyod kyis nga'i 'khrungs rabs sngar yod de la gsar du kha shas 'jug par gyis shigang la bla ma zhig gis gtsang smyon gyi skye ba yin zer te/ nged rang na phra mo'i dus ri brag mthon po nags ljongs yod pa'i lung ba zhig gi bkod pa lam lam 'char ba/ phyis bod du slebs nas gtsang spyon phebs bzhugs mdzad pa'i gnas 'ga' zhig mthong bas de kho na ltar 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / yang kho bos phyis su pe'i cing du mjal skabs/ gsung gleng zhig la ri bo rtse lnga'i rje nyid kyi sgrub khang la e waṃ dga' 'khyil zhes ming 'dogs gnang ba las 'phros te/ gtsang smyon gyi mgur mtsho'i mjug tu e waṃ zer ba zhig yod pa 'dug nged kyis khang ba'i ming la e waṃ btags yod ces gsungs/ 'di dag ni gtsang smyon gyi skye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul ba med pa yin pas rgyu mtshan de dag la dpags na bla ma dam pa nyid gtsang smyon du grags pa dur khrod myul ba'i rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can nyid yin pa gor ma chag go /des na grub thob chen po de nyid kyi rnam thar mdo tsam bshad na 'khrungs yul gtsang nyang stod stag tshal du myang ral pa can dang / nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyi brgyud pa yab sngags 'chang sangs rgyas dpal ldan dang / yum sangs rgyas 'dren gnyis kyi sras su aṅgi ra zhes pa chu pho sbrel la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun gyi dus ma khan chen kun dga' sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung ste sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan

40 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod shas tsam bshad pa/ zhes mtshan gsol/ nges 'byung dang skyo shas che bas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig byed pa'i thugs gtad kyis dgung lo bcu gsum thog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar sgom du 'gro gsum̐ng 'byonapar chas kyang yab yum gyis ma btang bas dgung lo bcu bdun par yul du bzhugs nas yum gyi po ti dgu tshang ma thugs la bzung / bco brgyad dus dngos nyams ci rigs par mkha' 'gro mas tsa rir 'byon par bskul bas/ bros stabs kyis byon nas la thog zur mkhar du a bo chos rje'i rtsar bzhugs/ der sa ra ha'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun sha ra rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge dang mjal/ zhal mthong tsam nas snang ba 'gyur te phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ ri chos skor gsum/ thar gru skor gsum/ nā ro chos drug brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba 'ga'/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ do ha skor gsum dang mdzad drug ro snyom sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phal cher gyi lung gsan/ rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes btags/ phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa'i dmar khrid khyad chos kyi ngo sprod dang bcas pa gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes pas mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa sngar gyi de las 'phar rgyu mi 'dug kyang / rjes thob la bogs dang rtsal mang du thon/ khyad par mtshan mo'i thugs dam 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song / de nas chos drug gi dmar khrid gsan nas bskyangs pas/ zhag bco lnga tsam na mnal lam du/ bla ma'i gsang yum la rol nas 'dren mdzad pas yum mda' 'phen tshad tsam du 'drud thub pa rmis/ sad pa na gsang gnas sbyabs su nub nas zhag

sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad ba/ 41 brgyad kyi bar du ma thon zhing / de nas kyang rgyun du phal cher sbubs su nub pa byung / byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo sgom skabs bde drod rang 'bar du song / rtsa thig rlung la gnad du bsnun pas rtsa phran rnams kyi mdud pa grol nas der thig le dang rlung sems 'dus pas rtsa rlung thig le'i zug dang gzigs snang dang rtags snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de nas kyang gtum mo la rtsal thon nas ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar thim pa'i ske rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa'i klong brdol/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyul ba dang rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ston pa sogs sprul bsgyur sna tshogs dang / dngosacasu yang yul nyi shu dang dur khrod brgyad sogs su phebs pas stor nas mis mi rnyed pa lan du mar byung / rkyen bzang ngan thams cad la nyam nga dang khu 'khrig med par thog rdzis dang ro snyoms kho na mdzad/ de nas bla mas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ lha bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga lhan skyes rnams dang / rdo rje phag mo'i sirnyu ra'i dkyil 'khor du lha mo bco lnga ma/ bdun ma/ lnga ma/ lhan skyes ma rnams dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor du zab mo brda'i dbang bzhi rnams rdzogs par bskur nas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud dang man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / khyad par du bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams mnog chos su gnang nas/ da gzhan du song la brtag gnyis sogs rgyud sde'i slob gnyer mthar phyin gyis/ de nas tshe 'di la phyi mig ma lta/ dman pa'i sa zungs/ hrul bo'i gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thong / ri'i bu gyis/ na

42 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad dzi/ bun gos su gyon/ brtul zhugs kyirtsosbyod pas yul snang lam du khyer/ nyam nga la thog rdzis gyis/ 'jig rten chos brgyad blos thongs la tsa ri tsa gong /la phyi chu bar/ gangs te se dang rdzong drug sogs bka' brgyud kyi gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs la bstan 'akro'i don gyis shig gsungs/ de thugs la bzhag nas rgyud sde'i slob gnyer byed par dpal 'khor chos sder byon nas gur ba grwa tshang la zhugs/ g.yu lung ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i drung nas sa lugs kyi dgyes rdor/ gur rigs bsdus/ rdo rje phur ba sogs kyi dbang rgyud brtag gnyis sdo rje gur/ sardzu ṭa rnams la rgya 'grel dang bod 'grel gyi steng nas bshad pa mtha' chod pa gsan/ gzhan yang slob dpon kun dga' nyi ma/ paṇa chen don grub grags pa sogs la gsang sngags kyi dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa/gar thig dbyangs sogs kyi phyag len mang du gsan no/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin tsa ri la bsgom du 'gro dgongs nas byon/ zur mkhar du drang srong mnyam nyid rdo rje las chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ sku tshe snga ma nas sa lam gyi rtogs pa bgrod zin pas tshe 'dir 'bad rtsol cher ma dgos par grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por mnga' ba nges te dus 'di nas bzung phal cher brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad/ gangs te se/ tsa ri/ la phyi chu bar/ bal yul sogs gnas nges med du byon/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang dgyes rdor sogs yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ cha lugs kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku gcer bu la mi'i g.yang gzhi khrag can gsol/ rgyu rlon gyis ga sha dang gdu bu byas/ mi thod rlon par klad pa

— — sngon gyi skyis rabs 'ga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad pa/ 43dang rgyu ma sogs rtsibs mas dkrugs te gsol/ phal cher he ru po//'i cha byad rus rgyan dang / thod pa/ rkang gling / kha ṭu rnams 'chang zhing dur khrod dang grong gseb nges med du byon nas tha mal gyi blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang smyon zhes grags/ skye bo mi bsrun pa 'ga' zhig gis sku la mtho 'tsham pas mda' ma dung ral gri sogs kyis lan brgya phrag tu bsnun kyang brag la khu tshur bdeg pa dang mtshungs par cung zad kyang mi gnod pa dang / der ma zad me 'bar ba'i nang du bcug ste yun ring bor bsregs pa dang phyag zhabs rnams bcings nas chu chen po la skyur ba dang / gangs kyi seng bar du 'phangs pa sogs byas kyang gnod pa ci yang med pa dang / kla klo 'ga' zhig gis dbu dang phyag zhabs so sor phral sku dum bur bsil nas rgyang ring bor skyur kyang de ma thag sku gzugs snga ma bzhin gyur te bzhad mo mdzad pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan pas grub thob kyi snyan grags phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur/ gzhan yang nad dang gdon gyis nyen pa'i sems can mang bo sdug bsngal las thar par byas pa dang / phan tshun 'thab rtsod kyi g.yul 'gyed pa rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dum par byas pa dang / dur khrod kyi ro langs dang / 'byung bo ma rungs pa du ma btul te dam la btags pa sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang shin tu mang / mdzad pa phyag rjes kyang / bal yul du 'phags pa shing kun gyi zhig gsos dang / grub gnas mang por bka' rgyud kyi sgrub sde btsugs pa dang / snyan brgyud glegs bam du bkod pa po ti bcu gsum la zhus dag gtsang ma dang / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar ljags

44 sngon gyi skyes rabs 'gagli rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshedapo/rtsom mdzad cing / nyams mgur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa par du brkos pa dang / skal ldan du ma la gnang ba'i zhal gdams mgur ma'i skor dang / snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa'i yig cha thor bu sogs bstan rgyun la pan pa'i gsung rtsom yang mang tsam yod pa 'dug snga phyi du mar bka' brgyud kyi chos dang gang zag la rgol pa rtsom pa'i rtog ge ba mang bo yang lung dang rigs pa dang gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas spobs pha rmeg med du bcom/ phyi rol du snang ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa lnga ri grub thob gangs kyi seng ge lta bu'i brtul zhugs la gnas kyang / thugs rgyud byams snying rje'i gzhan dbang kho nar gyur pas/ sems can phongs pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang sdig pa'i las tshabs chen po gsog pa dag gzigs pa dang gsan pa tsam gyis mi bzod pa'i spyan chab 'byin cing de la gtso bor dmigs nas thugs dam gnad du smin pa gnang ba zhig yod la/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang las 'bras la rtsi 'jog che bas dge sdig chungasi nguspyotsam yang khyad du mi gsod cing / slob ma rnams la yang tshul de kho na 'doms par mdzad/ byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas gar bzhugs gar phebs kyi gnas thams cad bkra shis shing khyad par du khrid btab pa'i slob ma la rtogs pa mi skye ba med/ rgan zhugs lo bdun cu brgal ba zhig la khrid gnang nas bskyangs pas phyag chen gyi rtogs pa skyes te nyams 'bul du byung bas chos byed kyi mig ltos la phan pa byung / de'i dbang gis dbus gtsang khams sogs nas slob ma grangs kyis mi chod pa 'dus shing yongs su grags pa'ang thugs sras zhe dgu dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs sras brgyad/ bla

sngon—sdi/skyes ringasa'aga'i rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad ba/ 45chen bla chung drug cu/ rtogs ldan nyer brgyad/ sto na sgom nyi shu/ grub chen brtswa brgyad/ rtogs ldan bdun brgya dang sum cu rtsa bdun/ rnal 'byor ma sring bzhi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ /mthar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa chu mo yos kyi lo ras chung phug tu ya mtshan nga 'i ltas du ma dang bcas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ sku gdung zhugs su phul bas lha sku dang ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa slob ma rnams kyis dad rten du bgos/ bu slob rnams kyis gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /zhib par shes 'dod na thugs sras rgod tshang ras pa rtogs ldan sna tshogs rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyi ma'i snying bo sogs la blta bar bya'o//rim gnyis lam gyi nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs pa/ gtsang smyon grub pa'i dbang phyug gdong lnga bas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i g.yu ral gsig pa'i tshe/ /gzhan snang ri dwags 'jigs pa'i zil gyis mnan/ /ras dkar 'dab gshog can mang 'phur zhing lding / /rgyan drug chas kyis sgeg rnams gar byed pas/ /ljongs 'di bya rgod phung po'i ri bo 'am/ /u rgyan yul zhes lha rnams the tshom gyur/ /la lar mkhas dang 'ga' zhig grub pa'i tshul/ /mtshams sprin gos dang ral pa'i cod peṇa can/ /sna tshogs zol gyis mos ldan phan bde la/ /'god mkhas rje btsun bla mar phyag bgyi 'o/ /drang don sgyu 'phrul rol pa sna tshogs kyis/ /nges don rang rig bla ma ngo sprad nas/ /gtan 'dun lag tu gtod pa'i thabs

mkhas tshul/ /bsams kyin lag pa'i pad+mo snying khar zum//khyab bdag rtso rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan ces bya ba las sngon gyi skyes pa'i rabs 'ga' zhig gi rtogs brjod cha shas tsam bshad zin to/ / //
