41lkezhu dang po/ sku bultamāska puzhi tshulka/gang sku mtshan dpe'i 'od zer stong 'bar nyi ma rgyas pa'i gzi byin gyis ni lha rnoms mog mog por byas skye rgu'i 'dren byed pad+mor ngo mtshar ze 'bru'i phreng ba spel/ /swāng gasngang drug cu'i dbyangs ldan dbyar skyes rnga gsang phyogs kun bzhad pas tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan skyengs byas skal bzang rna ba'i dpag bsam 'dab rtser bdud rtsi'i zegs ma cir yang 'thor/ /gang thugs 'gyur med snying rje'i ros gang spros kun nyer zhi'i chos dbyings rozlo pathe kun gsal sgeg mo'i khengs 'phrog bden gnyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor khyon kun cig char gsal bar gzigs/ /gsang ba gsum ldan rje btsun blu mū rdol pazhi rdo rjesdi zhabs sen 'char ka'i gzi mdangs dregs ldan gdūshe s+t+waṃr hūṃd r+ghaṃng khrodres pa de yis bdag yid pad+mo rtag tu skyongs/ /gang yang 'di na 'jig rten phan bde'i snang ba snyigs ma lnga yi mun pas rim gyis zos/ /lam dang lam min ji bzhin gsal byed 'akro ba'i nyi ma zhing gzhan nub kyi ri bor bzhud/ /ma rig gnyid kyis rab non 'gro rnams las snang rmi lam grong du sdug bsngal btson rar bcings/ /rmongs nga/'i gnyid slong chos kyi rnga chen nyid kyang glegs bam khang bur sgra med gzim par gyur/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i chos tshul kun bzung nas/ /lus can phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya 'byed pa'i/ /rlabs chen

4skye sku bltams pa'i tshul/ smon lam ring nas mdzad pa yi/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog gis zhing 'di bzung / /mi bzad snyigs ma lnga yi mthu rdzogs pas/ /snying stobs che ldan rgyal sras gzhan rnams kyis/ /btangasnyoms bzhag pa'i bstan 'gro'i khur chen po/ /gang gi thugs rje'i khyogs la ci bder blangs/ /khyad par blo bzang —rgyal bstan yid bzhin nor/ /lung dang rigs pas byi dor legs bsgrubs te/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /'dzad med phan bde'i dga' ston char du bsnyil/ /dge legs shel gyi rwa bas yongs skor dbang phyogs 'chi med grong khyer du/ /dregs lda na bye ba'i bzhin ras snod gyur nor bu'i khri 'phang mthon po ru/ /ye shes spyan stong ldan gang bzhugs pas bstan 'dzin legs bris ma lus ne pa/ /nag phyogs lha min g.yul las rgyal ba'i dga' ston nyams pa med par gyur/ /chos sdi rdo rjes mdo smad sman ljongs na/ /gang gi ngo mtshar yon tan rjes drane+e rnos / ༷/lag pad spyi bo'i tshal du nyer zum ste/ /rtogs brjod mgrin pa'i rgyud mang 'di sgrengs so/ /bshes gnyen du ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs gang mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la sa yi steng 'dir 'gran zla dang bral mkhas pa'i rtser son grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por ji gshegs/ /'phrin las bzang pos bstan 'gro'i phan bde blar spel 'dzam gling che rgus zhabs kyi pad+ma gus pas spyi bor mchod/ /'di dag ngo mtshar gtam gyi gleng gzhi nyid de bdag blo'i rtsal gyis ci tsam spobs pa de tsam brjod par bya/ /da ni sa bcad gnyis pa sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam par

sku bltams pa'i tshul/ 49thar pa rgyas par 'god pa la 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la gnyis/ dngos dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de yang rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ mdo smad tsong kha'i byang phyogs kyi sa'i cha/ sngon gyi dus su hor rgyal pos 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang / chos kyi rgyal bo 'phags pa sogs gdan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs pa'i gnas lang gru'u sde bzhi zhes grags pa las/ nub pad+mo'i sde'i sa char gtogs pa'i 'brog gnas/ gtsang zhing dben la yid du 'ong ba/ lha shug gi nags tshal dang rtsi sman me tog sna tshogs pas khyab cing / rgyab ri brag dkar dung ri spun bdun du grags pa dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa'i brag ri ha cang mi che ba bdun tshar du bsgrigs pa/ spang ljongs dang ri brag 'bab chu la sogs pa'i dge mtshan thams cad tshang ba'i phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas lung ba'i dbyibs dang rtags mtshan sogs 'og tu 'byung ba'i lung bstan rnams dang shin tu mthun pa zhig go /rigs rus ni hor yin te/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'khrungs yul mdo smad tsong kha'i phyogs su sngon dus su chi kya dor rta nag po zhes grags pa'i brgyud pa da lta chi kya dpon por 'bod pa de'i 'bangs su gtogs pa'i khyim grangs mi nyung tsam yod pa'i grong sde 'ga' zhig yod pa las/ yab ni sde de ka'i sngags pa zhig yin kyang / gnas 'phos te lang gru'u phyogs su song nas 'brog khyim bzung ba la phyos/sa der sngags pa la tshangs pa zer bas chi kya tshangs pa gu ru bstan 'dzin bya ba/rang bzhin drang zhing dpa' rtsal dang spyol phod pa/ ma ṇi dung phyur so da

50 sku bltams pa'i tshul/zhing / rdo rje 'atram̐gs byed kyi rnal 'byor chag med thugs dam du mdzad pa zhig yin/ yum ni bu skyid bya ba bud med kyi skyon las 'das shing dad pa dang ldan pa dge sbyor la rtag tu brtson pa zhig ste/ yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i gser 'phyang zhes pa me mo bya'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu ḍa ki 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi nyin rje bla ma 'di nyid sku bltams par gyur to/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul sa skya ba/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen ā nan+ta'i/ /zhabs pad nyer bkod dam chos gser sbyangs kyi/ /'khor lo lan grangs stong du bskor ba'i gnas/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi sa yi dge mtshan bcu/ /yongs tshang lang gru'u zhes grags maṇ+ḍi la/ /grong dang grong khyer tshom bus mdzes pa ni/ /mtho ris dga' tshal sa la 'phos 'dra yod/ /der ni spang ljongs gtsang ma'i du kū la'i/ /nyer klubs phu chu'i 'og pags ṭ+wā/na sgra 'byin/ /me tog do shal 'chang ba'i dbyig 'dzin ma/ /phun tshok+to/kushrī 'a/nga tsho'i dpal lon ngoms pa bzhin/ /'khri shing sna tshogs ldem ldem gar byed cing / /bung ba gzhon nu dar dir glu dbyangs len/ /spu sdug 'dab chakas mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung / /bag phebs ri dwags bang rtsal 'gran cing rtse/ /dung ri datso/ra po 'pha gas pa'i nor gyi grangs/ rta/bkra shis dbyangs snyan sgrogs la 'asun pha bzhin/ /lha shug nags kyis phyos/sa mtsharna sa gtibs pa ni/ /byedaphupos gtsang byed rdzas su bkram pa bzhin/ de lta 'i ga4thig ler ni/ /rigs rus cho 'brang mi dman zhing / /yon tan nor bu'i rgyan 'cha ru+o ba'i/ /mi ma chog thabs

sku bltams pa'i tshul/ 51shes 'brel ba las/ /sgyu 'phrul mar mtshungs yum gyi sprin rum nas/ /yid 'ong sprul sku'i nyi gzhon shar ba na/ /skal bzang 'gro ba'i 'dren byed pad+ma ni/ / rngo mtshar ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin par gyur/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsarī/ brjod pa dge ldan bsta/na pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ sku bltams pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ / //

52 zhe'u gahaṃsawā/ tshas sde chen po dgon zhud brun sa pu snid gi glu drad du gi zhaditha/sa ne+ed gezhi khri lka zhazhas nu musno rnamā pun dkod puzhi tshulka/snga phyir rmi ltas dang rtags ya mtshan pa byung tshul ni/ sngar lo mngal na bzhugs skabs yum gyi rmi lam du mo rang gi lus gser du gyur pa lan 'ga' zhig tu rmis pa dang / khog na gser gyi ri gcig yod snyam byung ba rmis/ yab kyi zhang bo rab 'byams pa cig sha ra thal zer ba'i sa char sog po'i sbyin bdag gcig gi nang la sdod skabs dgung gcig rmi lam la/sprul sku'i 'khrungs yul brag dkar zer ba'i lung ba'i lho phyogs na tsha babs gcig gi sa cha na glang mdo zer ba'i lung ba cig yod pa de ka'i thad kyi nam mkha' nas sprin shin tu stug po 'khrigs pa'i nang nas 'brug skad shin tu che ba zhig sgrogs bzhin par/ sprul sku bltams pa'i gnas na brag dkar po mtho zhing mdzes pa cig yod pa de dang nye ba na kha dog sna lnga ba'i 'ja' tshon bcas brag la thim pa dang brag la sgo gcig byung / sgo de nas rje btsun byams pa phebs rgyu red zer bas/ kho rang dang khong gi a khu dge / slong a khu rgad po gcig dang bcas pas dad gus chen pos phyag mchod byed pa cig rmis/ sang nyin de phyogs su nag shu'u bla ma zer ba bsnyung gnas rang la thugs dam shin tu 'grus pa gnang mkhan cig —yod pa de la zhus

la dzis sde jin po dgon ludz+wa du zhabasapadabakodatshul/ 53 wapas/ khong gis rmi lam shin tu legs/ khyed tsho'i brag dkar zer ba'i sa cha de la skyes bu dam pa shin tu grags che ba cig dngos su 'byon pa'am/de 'dra cig gi sprul sku phebs pa'i ltas yin pa 'dra gsungs/ sprul pa'i sku 'khrungs pa'i lo de la bsnyung gnas thugs dam du mdzad mkhan gyi bla ma des nub gcig rmi lam du chi kya tshangs pa'i khyim na seng ge mo gcig gis seng phrug la nu ma bsnun gyin 'dug zer ba cig byung bar/ khong gis seng ge'i nu ma lag mthil du yod zer ba thos pas bden mi bden blta dgos snyam nas song bar seng ge mo de bros nas mi ston pa cig rmis/ sang nyin chi kya tshangs pa zer ba cig yod med mi 'ga' zhig la dris par shes mkhan 'ga' zhig gis mod zer/ der kho sku drung du bos nas khyod la bu 'dra e yod ces dris par kho rang gis bu lo bcu lon pa gcig dang / byis pa zla ba gsum bzhi 'gro ba gcig yod zhus par/ bla mas khyod rang gi bu chung de nga'i rmi ltas la dpag na gang zag rang dga' ba cig min 'dug pas/gtsang spra gang thon thon dang / sku rim la rem rem gyis gsungs nas skol ja sogs kyi gnang sbyin kyang mdzad/ dgung lo gnyis gsum bzhes dus nyin gcig khyim du grwa ba kha shas kyis chos 'don zhig byed skabs/ 'don gyin yod pa'i dpe cha rnams sprul skus phar len tshur len mang po mdzad pa yab kyis lan trīga'i bar bzlog kyang ma gsan pa la yab khros nas phu thung gis brdung bas bshum bzhin du khyim sgo nas phyir thon/ dar cig na bshum 'phro bcad nas nam mkha' la spyan ce re gzigs te/ a ma zhes bos nas nam mkha' na/ rje rin po che/ u rgyan rin po che/ bla ma rin po che

54 tshos na po dgon lung du nasges pad bskud tshul/rnams bzhugs 'dug a phas nga la brdung byung zhes ma la lab pa sku rim 'don mkhan gyi mi tshos thos nas yab la bu chung 'di rang dga' ba zhig min 'dug pas phyin chad de 'dra ma byed ces lab 'dug nyin gcig ngas khyed rnams la dbang skur byed ces/ bum pa zhig yod pa thams cad kyi mgor 'jog cing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dag cing gsal ba thogs med du gsungs pas de na yodwa pa'i ser skya thams cad shin tu ha las shing ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /gang thugs dpal gyi be'u'i grwa gcig tu/ /chos kun rdzogs par chud pa'i lha mchog la/ /mkhyen pa'i gter zhes grags pa de nyid ni/ /byis pa'i zol gyis mdo smad ljongs su byon/ /gangs can grub mtha'i yang rtse dge ldan pa'i/ /ring lugs 'di yis gsal bar bgyid do zhes/ /yab rje 'jam dpal snying bo thugs dgyes te/ /rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum zhal khyod la bstan/ /gang gi sku yi bar chad ngas bsal zhes/ / 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /snang srid zil gnon pad+ma kā ra yis/ /dgyes zhal dngos su bstan nas byin gyis brlabs/ /bdag ni rgyal kun snying rje'i ma ma ste/ /dam chos 'o mas rgyal sras gzhon nu khyod/ bskyang bar bya zhes 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyis khyod drung byon/ /na tshod sgo nga'i spubs rgya ma grol kyang / /dam pa'i rang rtags dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa yis /

——— 5sasdechen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bskud tshul/ bye3 —rgyal sranu/ po / la piṅkar nges rnyed nas/ /skye rgu ya mtshan bsngags pa brjod la brel/ /rje ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan nga 'i sku'i skye bar nges pa rnyed pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo gnyis bzhes skabs nyin gcig nga bla ma lcang skya yin gsungs shing / lho phyogs la phyag mdzub kyis bstan nas pha gir dgon pa chen po yod/ nga der song nas bla ma byed rgyu yin zhes sogs sdon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du byon 'dug cing / de dus yum/ gyis za ma grib can cig zo sa par brten/ sku grib kyi rnam pas sku gzugs thams cad shu bas khyab nas 'o brgyal se ba byung bar/ mabo/na po'i rnal 'byor pa yin pa'i mā bla ma zero ba cis/ la ba rtag pa zhus par/ grib byung ba yin 'dug pas byabaru/ khrus gang mang dang sku rim 'ga' zhig gyis zhes phebs nas yab yum gnyis kyis zhal gzigs ri khrod kyi bla ma 'dan ma chos rje zer ba'i sku zhabs la byabs khrus zhu bar kutrīsi 'gro bar thag bcad pa'i dgung mo de —ge 'dan d+ngha shrī bā ma'i rmi la ma la nyi ma gzas zin 'dug pa la rang gis )ོbu ma/dzad nas ri khrod pa thams cad tshogs nas khrus gsol bgyis pas gza' 'a sa grol nas 'od gsal bo byung ba zhig rmis/ de'i sang nyin bu chung byabs khrus la khyer ji+o4ོnga bar bla pho ca/ mi ltas la dpags na 'di gang zag rang dga' ba min 'dug cing / byabs khrus kyis kyang phan rgyu yin 'dug dgongs nas/ rnam 'joms kyi byabs khrus brgya tshar/ gzhan yang rjes gnang bka' ba sgo sogs mang du bstsal pas bsnyun laca/ grol 'dug cing / de phyin cha7) bla ma des khong rang gi gong bya/ chos nge 'gang chen cig zhung la phebs pa de'i sku skye yin par re nas sku rim so pog/sa kyang gang drags

bhe bye6 chosasde chen po dargon lung du nabs pad bskud tshul/ wad wad mdzad/ mā bla ma la khong rang gi bla ma'i sku skye yin min gyi brtag pa zhus par/ bu chung de lo bzhi thog nas gsal kha nyi ma shar ba 'dra zhig yong / da lta gsal kha mi thub zer ba babs 'dug de rjes skabs zhig zhal gzigs ri khrod kyi bla ma'i rmi lam la chu mdog sngo zhing shin tu dwangs pa zhig bkra shis thang zer ba'i lung ba de khyab nas rim gyis che ru 'gro bar/ khong gi bsam pa la 'di ha cang che ru song na lung ba 'dir mi shong ba 'dug pas/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu drangs dgos snyam lag tu 'khar sil cig thogs 'dug pa'i yu bas brag cig la brgyab nas byams pa gling du song cig byas par/ 'khar sil brgyab pa'i shul du bug pa zhig thon pa'i nang du chu thams cad lho phyogs su lhag med du bshar song ba cig rmis pas/ bla ma dang yab yum tshos chu 'di 'gro ba rnams 'tsho ba'i rten du gyur pa yin pas/ bu chung 'di rang dga' ba cig min 'dug kyang nga rang tsho'i bla ma'i sku skye rang e yin/ byams pa gling zer ba cig nas rtsar gcod mkhan byung 'dug par der 'gro ba 'dra zhes gleng / snga phyi'i lo rgyus de rnamyo/sa rim gyis dgon lung du grwa rigs rnams kyis thos pas/ bla ma de nyid kyi sku'i skye ba phal cher 'di rang yin 'dra snyam pa byung 'dug na'ang / dogs gnas gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang yod 'dug pas thag ma chod pa'i bar skabasra zhig tu/ dgon lung gi slob chung zur ba ri khrod la bzhugs nas thugs dam dge sbyor la shin tu brtson zhing / sku zhabs de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin zer ba zhig gis dgung gcig rmi lam du dgon lung gi rgyab ri'i thad nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer nyi

da wa chosasdechenapo dgon lungadu zhabasapadabakodatshul/ ram̐ 7 —da ma gzhan nga sa khyad par du 'phags pa cig shar 'dug par bltas pas/dkyil 'khor gyi rgya khyon tshon gsum bzhi tsam gyi tshod yin pa la 'od zer gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa rmis nas/ sang nyin khong rang gi zla bo tsho pre/ sprul sku 'khrul med lang cu'u phyogs kyi de ka yin 'dug kyang /'then khyer 'dis ci 'dra rang yong zhes gleng 'dug de yang rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi sku snga ma yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bo de nyid sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas re zhig zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal bar dgongs te/ rta lo zla ba lnga ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin snyun babs lci ba'i tshul bstan skabs/ dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas sogs grwa rigs rnams kyis/ rje bla ma nyid gal te gzhan don du dgongs pa gtad pa dus la babs pa'i bshol du med pa yin tshe/ zhing 'di'i bstan 'gro'i dpal du slar yang sprul pa'i sku 'khrul med zhig myur du phebs dgos tshul gyi zhu ba nan tan du phul bar zhal nas khyed rang tshos dkon mchog la gsol ba thob/ ngas yang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs zhes phebs pas dngos su sprul sku 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes ma gnang yang don la zhal gyis bzhes par ra/dzad do/ /gsung 'di tsam yang blo gros dang ldan pas zhib tu brtags na gnad che bar snang ste/ zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ rang gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /zhes dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ blun po yon ta na khar 'byin cing / mkhas pa yon tan khong du sbed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/rje bla ma nyid skye 'chi la dbang thob pa'i dam pa khyad par can yin pa rnam rdzi

rjo༄kro—bhe—cho da—༄sdo —dgon 'ung du zhabs rīd balko/da tshul da da thar nguni thong ba rnams kyis shes pa ltar yin kyang / de lta bu'i rnam pa mi mdzad par thugs shin tu sgam pa bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes te bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba dkon mchog yin pas/ grwa slob sbyin bdag sogs dad ldan mtha' dag gis rang 'dod spangs te gso/la ba rtse gcig tu btab na/ dkon mchog gi byin rlabs dang thugs rje 'ba' zhig gi mthu 'a sa nyi ma rang shar bzhin du gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'doms par mdzad pa gor ma chag go /de nas lug lo zla ba dang bo'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin mdo smad kyi chos sde chen po dgon lung byaca/sa pa gli d+ku+o gi sru nga ma rten kheg tu spyo/ drangs par rje de nyid kyi sprul sku 'byon mi'o/ kyi 'u/nga ba te༈7/ 'usi par/ sru nga ma nyid kyis kha dar srid zhi bde skyid ma reng ba zhis/ sku/ steng du rtags bkyad ma ser po zhig dang / de'i steng du nyin ngade dko/ra po dri ma med pa rnams brtsegs te zheng dang ring thung snyoms par bsgrigs pa dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas la gnang nas rtog dpyod gyis zhes phebs/ de la thams cad kyis dpyad pas/sprul sku mi ring bar 'byon pa dang / byon pa de nyid kyang sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa dang / /rma dzad 'phri+o/ bzang po la brten nas srid zhi'i bde skyid 'phel nga'i brda' mtshon du dpyad pa phyis su de kho na bzhin du byung 'dug go /chu bzang rin po che blo bzang bsta/na pa'i rgyal mtshan la sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs zhus pa bzhin ljags tsom mdzad skabs/ bkra shis dge mtshan 'o da dkar spro bzhin du/ /thub bstan kyun+da'i dpal du gsal gyur cig /ces gnang ba dasi du sa mtshungs su

chos sde chen po dgon lung du zhab / pasdispratshodā—tshi/ —sdopaṃ da dgon lung gi tshogs dung 'bud pa 'grig pa sa spru la sku nge (pu par 'byon pa'i rten 'bre'/ legs po byung zhes mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ 'di lo bod du paṇa chen thams cad myori//byen pa blo bzang ye shes/ khyo‘ra sras sprul pa'i sku 'jigs med ye shes grags pa/ grub dbang se ma sa dpa' rin po che/ la mo chos skyong chen po/ gnas chung / dga' gdong chos skyong r+hane+ems/ la rje bla ma de nyid kyi sprul sku 'byon min gyi lung zhu bgyis par/ thams cad ca/thun par 'byon pa'i bka' lung gnang bas/ grwa rigs thams cad nas spru la sku 'khrul med zhig 'byon par nges shes 'drongs ska/ 'on kyang yul phyogs gang du 'byon ma nges pa la/ la mo chos skyong ma/sa thul sku/ rang 'dod phyogs su 'byon zhes pa dang / dga' gding choca/ skyong gis rang phyogs su 'byon las che zhes pebs par brten a mdo phyogs su phebs par thams cad kyis thag cho da par gyur/ rma do khar+ya sa kyi phyogs gasgru'adra zhig tu/ phebs pa yang / gnas chung gis/ gnas gzhi de nas brtsis pa'i nyi ma'i byang nub tu rtog pa chug phyi na rim gsal yod gsung ba dang / grub dbang sems dpa' rin po che nas gdan sa'i byang phyogs su 'byon pa'i ngo shar zhes phebs pa la/ gdan sa gang yin gyi dogasa'igacod skyar zhu bgyis par dgon lung yin pa 'dra zhes phebs/ dgon lung chos skyong gis bya lo zla ba dang bo'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin dgon lung ji/ nub byeng gi phyo gas su ca/jub ston gnang nas spru'apre sku 'di phyogs su phebs rgyu yin zhes pa dang / chu bzang rin po che ma/sa sku 'bum choru/ skyor la lung zhu gnang bar lho byang sa/nga rigs shig tu 'khyon pa'i lung bstan gnang / de ltar lung thams cad

da tsho rdo gasdechenapodatsho/na lung du zhabs pad bkod tshul/mthun pa byung bas grwa slob rnams kyis dgon lung gi byang ngam nub byang mtshams gang rigs su sku 'khrungs par thag chod na'ang / des kyang mi chog par da dung sa yul gyi rtags mtshan/ yab yum gyi ming sgra sogs zhib tu the tshoms chod dgos par bsam ste/ mkhas grub po rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la gsung brtag zhus pa'i phyir phebs su sprul sku sa cha phal cher lung ba byang ngos mtho ba/ mgo byang lta'i 'phrang rtags can zhig yod pa thon pa'i nye skor zhig la phebs pa'i ngo shar zhe ri sa gsu reri smu pa dang / zhwa dmar bra snyi dgon gyi srung ma dga' gdong chos skyong nas/ byang yol lho ngogs ltos pa/ rbab brag srin gyi 'tshub cha ston pa/ skam srid kyi chu mig brdal brdol ba/ ming dpal rus sogs la ga da ba na nga zhes pa yod paraci'akhrungs pa'i lung bstan byung / de dag gi don bzhin grwa slob rnams kyis sprul sku'i dogs gnas rtsar bcad pas/ phyogs yas mas su dogs gzhi can kha shas byung 'dug na'ang / /lang gru'u phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa 'di nyid kho na phyogs dang gnas dang yab yum gyi ming sgra sogs gang ci nas lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan dang sgo thams cad nas mthun par ma zad/ yab yum sogs kyi mtshan ltas dang / sprul sku nyid kyi sku'i mdzad spyod/ gsung gi phebs sgo gang la bltas kyang rje bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang po'i yang srid 'khrul ba dang bral ba yin —'dug snyam du thams cad dga' spro dbyar gyi chu bo bzhinabyu'aphel bar gyur to/ /de nas sprul sku ngos 'dzin gyi ched du grwa rigs kha shas 'gro rtsis gyis chu bzang rin po cher brtag pa zhus par/ khong gi brtag pa'i mchod tshe

mis sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bskod tshul/ 61sbar ba dang tshogs dung 'bud pa 'grig pas/ rten 'brelalegs shing brtag pa'ang bzang ba babs pas ngos 'dzin latshogang myur song ba 'thad ces gsungs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas kyang / sa cha sngar lung bstan pa dang mthun phyin brtag pa yang dga' rab byung bas sku chas kyi rigs khyer nas ngos 'dzin byed bcug rjes slar 'phros pa yod pa gyis zhes phebs/ dgon lung chos skyong gis kyang de mthun gyi lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ dgon lung spyi so nas dka' bcu blo bzang bsam 'grub/lcang skya bla brang nas dka' bcu lhun grub rgya mtsho dang dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtsho bcas ngo g.yog rnams kyis/ sku gong ma'i phyag dpe/ phyag 'phreng / thugs dam rten gyi rje'i sku brnyanarnarnams dang / de dag dang dbyibs mtshungs pa'i 'dra min re bcas khyer nas ngos 'dzin mdzad bcug par/ phyag dpe phyag 'phring sku brnyan ngo ma rnams nga'i yin zhes ma nor bar bzhes shing / 'dra mtshungs rnams btang snyoms su 'jog pa mdzad/ grwa ba 'di khrod na ngo mkhyen pa'i rigs yod tshe mgo la phyag 'jog pa mdzod zhus pas thams cad la zhib tu gzigs nas sku gong ma'i gsol dpon lhun grub kyi mgor phyag 'jog pa mdzad/ yang sku snga mas lhun grub la gnang ba'i phyag 'phreng zhig dang / de dang 'dra ba gzhan zhig lhad du phul nas/ 'di gnyis kyi nang nas phring ba ngo mkhyen pa de yab kyi ster skon/ mi mkhyen pa de bdag por sprod ces zhus pas phyag 'phreng de yab kyi ske la bskon cing / cig shos de bdag por sprod pa sogs ngos 'dzin 'khrul med mdzad/ rgyu mtshan de rnams dang bcas slar yang rje 'jam

—— 62 dzisasde chen po dgon luṭ+wāṃ du nabasathipad brkad tshul/ —da wadabyaras bzhad par gsung brtag zhus paso/ — dogs gzhi yod pa thams cad la brtag pa zhib— mo yang yang byas par chi kya tshangs pa gu ru bstan 'dzin gyi bu chung grags pa bsod nams 'di bla ma'i sprul sku 'khrul med yin 'dug pas bdag byas na bzang zhe sa phebs/ dgon lung chos skyong nas kyang sprul sku 'khrul med yin par thag chod pa'i lung bstan gsal bo —phebs/ deng sang gi sku skye bdag byed mkhan phal che bas snga ma de sku 'das phral rang nas rigs rus stobs 'byor dang ldan pa'i khyim du skyes pa'i bu chung re 'bad pas btsal nas rnyed phral rang du lha dang bla ma'i lung tshad ma dang ngos 'dzin 'khrul med sogs gang yang mi dgos par phan tshun nang mthun gyis go sar 'jog gang thub byed pa dang / yang lung bstan sogs phul pa'i lugs su byed pa la las bla ma'i nye gnas dang chos skyong gi sku khog pa zang zi nga gis rngan pa sogs lung bstan rang gi 'dod phyogs dang mthun pa yong ba'i thabs zab mo'i sgo nas rdzun lung thel tshe can re la khungs ske bcol ba sogs 'phyom ma'i zlos gar rnam grangs ji snyed cig bsgyur ba la ltos na/ deng sang gi dus su sprul sku 'khrul bral 'di 'dra lta zhog 'di pa'i don skor la zhib cha nan thar de tsam zhig lhur len pa'i gzur gnas kyi grwa slob de lta bu yang u dusba ra'i me tog las chikyang dkon par mthong ngo / /gzhan yang / deng dus go sa mtho ba'i sprul sku sa/cig gang du 'khrungs sa der gzhan mchog dman mang bo'i skye srid kyang spang la sha mo brdol ba bzhin du dar 'dug pa'i srol zhig mdo dbus thams cad du dar 'dug pa ni/ so skye'i blor mi chud pa'i 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi khyad chos zhig gam/

da chos sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bkod tshul/ 63 yang na snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang rtags rjen par shar ba las ma 'das pa nyid do/ /sngar gyi 'phro ni/ de ltar lung bstan tshad ma dang / ngos 'dzin 'khrul med sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas/ sprul sku ma nor bar ngos zin pas grwa slob rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu stor ba slar yang lag tu son pa lta bu'i dga' ba tshad med pa dang bcas/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che sogs pe'i cing dang sog yul du bzhugs pa'i bla chen rnams dang grwa slob —sbyin bdag thams cad la gnas tshul zhib rgyas phul bas/ thams cad kyis rjes su yi rangs pa'i bsngags brjod dang bcas/ gong ma chen por rgyu mtshan zhu rtsis bgyis par/ de dus sog po'i wang stobs 'byor can zhig la bu chung zhig byung ba rje lcang skya ba'i sprul skur dril bsgrags shing / gong ma'i blon chen phal cher yang wang de la dga' ba'i dbang gis re zhig gi bar/ gong mar zhu rgyu cur gan nas bkag pa la/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che nas mdo kham sdoge su 'khrungs pa'i sprul sku 'di la/ mdo dbus sdi skyes bu dam pa rnams dang / chos skyong tshad ldan rnams kyi lung bstan thams cad mthun cing / sprul sku nyid nas kyang ngos 'dzin thams cad 'khrul med mdzad pa sogs rgyu mtshan phyogs sgor mo thams cad nas rje lcang skya ba'i sprul sku 'khrul med yin cing / gcig shos la de 'dra'i gtan tshigs kyi phyogs tsam yang med pas gal te lugs srol bzhin du khrims ra brgyud nas gong —mar zhu mi 'jug na nged rang dngos kyis gong mar mjal 'phrad skabs ngag lam nas zhu rgyu sku/na/ 'di don la nga rang gi srog yal bar 'dor dgos byung yang rang gi bla ma'i sku'i don ched yin pas 'gyod pa cung zad kyang ge sku

—sdi—64 chosasdechen po dgon lungaduzhabasapadabakodatshul/——ged+ngha—— ༷ge da wamed do zhes cur gan gyi am paṇa rnams la gsung lci ba phebs pas/ khong tshos kyang bya thabs zad nas de 'dra yin tshe gong mar zhus chog pa 'dug zer/ de nas cur gan brgyud gong spe chen por rgyu ma6na zhib rgyas zhus par thugs shin tu dgyes pas myur du skye ba gong ma'i gdan sar spyan drongs la thugs gnyer sogs mdzad chug ces bka' bzang bo gnang / de phral pe'i cing naspodaka' chen shes rab dar rgyas dang dem chi bcas ngo g.yog rnams sprul sku gdan 'dren pa'i ched du yong ba dgon lung du 'byor/lcags byi zla ba drug pa'i nang du 'khrungs yul du phyin te sprul sku rin po cher mjal bas dgyes pa'i rnam pa dpag med mdzad/ tshes gcig gi nyin sbrul gyi dus tshod la byes sgar gyi gzim gur du gdan drangs nas gsol ston gzab rgyas thog dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ de nyin nam mkhaspru shin tu dwangs shing nyi ma'i 'od gsal ba/ char rlung sogs kyis dben pa'i khad shin tu 'jam pa la 'ja' sprin dang 'ja' tshon sna lnga ba du mas lha lam mdzes pa sogs dpon slob thog ma'i mjal phrad kyi rten 'brel ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i khrag /mjal phrad dang ston mo grub zin nas gzim gur gyi phyi rol tu phebs/ gres ma'i nang du bzhugs nas gres spung cig gi steng du ling dkar bo'i phyag phyi gsar ba cig bkab ste gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan yin gsungs nas sku rtsed du ma ga/nang bzhin par/zhal nas sdon gong ma rgyal po zhabs phyir mi lung ba khengs pa tsam dang bcas phebs gi 'dug sngon la rnga brdung ba dang / dung 'bud pa rnams byas nas/ gong ma rgyal bo nang la phebs nas gsol ja bzhes gi 'dugs

— dzis sdi na po dgon lung du zhabs pad bkaud tshul/ 65ces rje gong ma de nyid zhing la phebs pa'i snga lo bdas/ po chen po do lon nor gyi gzim khang du phebs nas gsol ja bzhes pa sob/sa4 kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar gsungs pas/ sku drung na yod pa thams cad kyis rje bla ma de nyid kyi sku'i skye ba 'khrul med du nges shesana'adrongs shing dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba dang mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pa byung 'dug sngon rabs dus kyi rnam thar ri mo kun/ /gzhon nu'i blo gros dri bral me long du/ /shar 'dis mkhas grub sdo ba1nga rtos ldan rje/ /zhi bar mnal ba'i gtam de rdzun du byas/ /rmel sdo 'do mas ༷pa'i gsung snyan dbyar skyes sgras/ /bskul tshe grwa slob yid kyi lha lam jos/sa/ /das/('a dad skyo ba kha dog 'dregrema'i sprin/ /gtibs las mchi ma'i thigs pa char du 'dzag /'di ni sdon gnas dran pa lta zhog gi /tshe 'dir nan gyis bslabs pa'i tshig gsum kyang / /ji bzhin mi tho 5/ gdol ba'i phru gu 'ga'/ /skye srid bzung bar sgrogs la co 'dri nyid/ /de nas zla ba de ka'i tshes gsum gyi nyin dgon lung phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur bar yul phyogs kyi skya ser dregs zhan mtha' dag gis rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgrig pa'i phebs skyel zhus te rim gyis phebs pa'i bshul lam du sang nyin skar ma bzang bas sgom khang la 'gro rgyu yin zhes dben pa la dgyes pa'i thugs kyi bag chags sad pa'i tshul dang / hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi sangs rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen yin pa don gyis gsungs/ de nyin hor gyi dgon pas bsu ba ser 'phreng sogs go/nga rgyas ngos 'du khang du gdan drangs te gzhi len ston mo 'bul ba sogs gzab rgyas zhus pa'i bzhugs grwal nas khri'e g.yas khyogs

66 tshos sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bskud tshul/su ston pa'i sku brnyan 'bag bzo cig la dbu rgyan spon yod pa gzi gas nas lha de'i dbu zhwa nga sa dgos zhes sku rtsed kyi rnam pas gsu/nga bar/de ka'i bla ma zur ba bstam/ skyong zer bas dbu rgyan blangs nas/ phun tshog rismi gzi 'od phyogs bcur rab tu 'phro/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs pacad dang bcas pas phyag tu phul bar thugs mnyes tshor chen pos dbu la bathes stangs sogs kyi sku rtsed ya mtshan pa mdzad pa rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par gyur cing / der 'tshogs kyi skya ser dregs zhan mtha' dag gis ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su 'dzin pa byung / tshes bzhi la chibs gong du a ra pa tsa gsung gdangs mthon pos bzla bzhin phebs pa na skabs zhig mnal phebs pa'i rnam pa gnang bas/ dka' chen shes dar bas chibs pa bskyod nas ma gyogs tsam phebs/ sku zhabs rgyal yag dgon la phebs dgos rgyu yin mod zhus pa la/ nga rang tsho rgyal yag dgon la 'gro rgyu e yin/ 'o na rgyal yag dgon pa'i ming ci zer zhes dri ba gnang byung bas ming sus kyang 4ma shes pas zhu rgyu ma rnyed pa la dag 'a ldan cig zer ba yin pas gsung /de nas rim gyis rgyal yag dgon pa'i chibs bsu ba skya ser mang bo 'byor bas khong rnams la dris pas dgon pa'i ming la dga' ldan bde chen gling yin zer bas thams cad ngo mtshar ba byung / rgyal yag nas bsu ba ser 'phreng sogs rten 'brel gang legs kyis 'du khang gi shā+o sa khri ra ga dan drangs ston mo 'bul ba sogs gzab rgyas zhus/ bzhus/sa khri'i g.yas phyogs su rigs gsum na gon pori sku brnyan bzo de tsam legs rgyu med pa rdzirnamaṭari la gzigs ma/sa 'di dang 'di gang gi sku yin dang phya ga ji 4tshan sogs

— da da wa—/ sde 'in+d+rapo darjo/rjo—/ du—zhabs pad bskud tshul/ 6ṭ+wāṃ'adi da nga 'a di ci yin sogs kyi bka' 'dri zhib par gnang / lan phul tshar ba dang bzo legs po mi 'du ga pe+obs pa dang / logs ris rnams la 'i/ba tu : /zigs nas 'di tsho rgya mis briri 5 pa red gsungs pa sogs thugs rig shi na tu zhib cing lha nyams la mkhas pa don gyis bstan pas thams cad ya ma chan rwari ra gyur/ der gnas skya ser dregs zhan thams cad la mjal kha dang dmi 3pes nga/rtse chari dang a ra pa tsa'i ljags lung gnang nas dad lda na rnaca/sa tshim par mdzad/ tsheṭa/ lnga la zhwa dmar dgon pa'i grwa bsgrigs kyi sari ra chibasdu si rtsi/tshor ṭusku rngohūṃd nga ra 'dan myo/ zhabs drung rin t+pa che'i phyag ma/dzo da rab 'bya tsa sa rngari/ so sa/sa rgyal ji5sa/ dan+t+rabyu/na pa'i grwa rgan gzhon du skya/ dang bcas rdzu se ra ba rgya phrapa/ du rke sdog/ tsha liwasdo5 nga ra du phebs/ skye za zhus/ khong na mas yid prebye / pa ji/ bu+o ma gu nas 'bral mi phong ni pa ltaklo bus phyi+or tsho+oge+og rim gyis zhwa nga/myo/ra dgon pas ca/ ba bsdo smi rwa / gu ri7 4 pa mang bo dang / bzhugre/sa sgar gyi nye 'dabs su gdugs dang ba dan rgyal rma tshan rol mo sogs mchod rdzas du ma thogasdo/ pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag ma/nga bo'i ser 'phreng dang bcas gzim gur du sa/dan drangs/ gzhi len ston mo 'bul ba sogs gzab rgyas zhus rtsi/nga / spya ser thams cad la mjatsho lo kha gnang ba so/sa/sa kyis 'dod pa tshim par mdzod/ tshes drug la ngazhurngakas sgar 'degs pa'i skabs zhwa dam ra dgongu / pa'i bla ma che byechen chos rjes phyas/ 'bul zhus te dgon luri bar du phebs phyekru zhu datse/sdo/ rgyu la don cha 'ga' zhig gi phyir da lam zhabs phyi zhu mi thub pa 'dug cing / gang rtse/ra daspre/3na lung du ma/jal nga nga yo nga 'es niyo / recasdo rngag zhus par/ thugs da byes pa'i ngudomyo4 pa ri shrī ba drori sa dpo na hri na grub

6skye tshos sdi na po dgon lung du na sa pad bskud tshul/la kha btags che ba zhig khyer shog gsungs pa bzhin phul bar chos rjer gnang ste phyag gnyis dbu dang bcas pas byin rlabs mdzad natwa/ da gyes bzhin du dgongs pa gnang bar chos rje dad pa'i spu long g.yos shing /'dren byed nas chu rgyun 'bab pa dang bcas 'bral mi phod pa byung zhing /de nas rim gyis phebs lam du rdor shi dgon pa'i bla ma khri gdan zur grwa skemang dang bcas pas bsu ba ser 'phreng gzhi len ston mo sogs gzab rgyas mdzad/ de nas rgyal rdog dgon gyi bla ma khri gdan zur grwa myo/nga dang bcas pas de ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pa'i bzhugs grwal thog nas dung dkar phyag tu bzhes te 'bud pa'i stangs ka sogs kyi sku rtsed dang / rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rdus shis brjod mdzad par khri gdan zur dang bcas der tshob/sa pa thams cad shin tu dad cing dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs pa byung / de nas jag rung gzhung gi lha sde mi sde skye pho mo skya ser dregs zhan stong phrag du ma 'tshogs te bsu ba ston mo 'bul ba sogs gzab rgyas zhus/ sku zhabs nas kyang thams cad la mjal kha phyag dbang tshem med gnang ba sogs kyis dad gus dang dga' spro'i dpal la bkod/ tshes bdun la dgen lung gi lha sde sngo kho dang dob chang zer ba'i tsho ba gnyis kyis gzhi len ston mo bsu ba sogs gzab rgyasagazhus te thams cad la phyag dbang gnang /༄ de nas brag darka/ra zer ba'i sa char sems nyid sku skye rin po che bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgyu myo5 mi+os dbu mdzad pa'i sems nyid dgon gyi che phra myo/nga posdo/ pebs bsu

chos sde chen po dgon lung du skubs pad bkod tshul/ 69 dang bcas skyes sgar du gdan drangs/ ston mo 'bul ba sogs gzab rgyas zhus/ sems nyid zhabs drung rin po che dang dpon slob thog mar mjal tsam nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa lta bus co/na tu thugs nang gtsang ba'i stangs ka mdzad pa dang / shel ka ra sder ma gang phul bar phud kyi tshul du ka ra rdog po 'ga' blangs nas rang gi bzhes can nang du bzhag de rjes zhabs drung la rdog po kha shas gnang byung bas/ zhabs drung rin po ches 'di ltar mdzad pa ni khong rang bdag bi bla ma yin zhes dngos su ma gsungs kyang / don gyis nga rang gi bla ma'i sprul sku 'khrul med yin pa'i brda' 'a/tshon par mdzad pa yin 'dug ces sa/sungs shing dad mos kyis thal rngo/ sbyor bar mdzad/ mjal kha'i ska bas rab 'byams pa cig la rab 'byarma sa pa zhes bos nas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa sogs kyis/ zhabs drung rin po ches dbu mdzad pa'i der 'tshogs kyi skya ser dregs zhan thams cad kyis ngesagashes/ kyi dad pa'i spu long g.yos shing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gnas su 'dzin pa byung / de nas mchod rten thang gi dgon pa'i bla ma khri gdan zur gyis gartsa ba'i grwa ba rnams dang mchod gzhi'i mgo yod rgam/ mang bcas ser skya mang pos rgyang ring bo nas chibs bsu dang / dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su mchod rdzas thogs pas sna drangs te dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbreng dang bcas gdan drangs/ gzhi len ston mo sogs gang rgyas zhus/ dregs zhan la ma ltos pa'i mjal kha phyag dbang ris med du gnang ba sogs kyis thams cad spro ba'i gnas la bkod/ tshes brgyad la/bzhugs sgar 'degs skabs yum gyis mjal bar/ nga rang tsho dgon lung

ṭī0 tshos sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bkod tshul/la slebs nas khyod rang dang bso/da nams/ tshe ring sgroshāpre ma sogs phral du phyir rang yul du log nged dang yab gnyis dgon lung du re zhig bsdad nas rjes sor rang yu la du 'ong zhes dgung lo bzhi ba gcig lacidapag pa'i mi rgan po'i bslab bya lta bu gnang bas/ sprul sku 'di thugs dkyel che ba zhig yong ba 'dug ces gleng / de nas gan chen dgon pas skya ser r+ṣa nga po'i chibs bsu dang / gdugs rgya'asna mtshan rnga rol sogs ma chod rdzas du ma thogs pas sna drangs pa'i ser 'a phre nga bcas 'du khang nang du bzhugs khri'i khar gdan drangs gaji/ len ston mo 'bul ba sogs gang rgyas zhus pa'i bzhugs gral du rnga dang sbub chol sil snyan dril bu sogs dkrol ba'i sku rtsed gnang bar de kha'i grwa ba rgan pa rnams kyis sku zhabs sku tshe snga mar dbus gtsang nas a mdor phebs phral gan chen la sman chog ba/sar 'dzug mdzad nas/ sku zhabs nyid rang gis nged tshor rnga sil dkrol lugs bslabs pa da res ngos 'dzin mdzad pa nan 'dug ces gleng zhing thams cad la dad pa dang / sprul sku 'khrul med kyi nges shes bskrun par ma dzad/ tshes dgu la phebs lam du char che bas dbu gdugs phab par g.yog bskon te bzung nas 'gyang tsam song ba na zhal nas/ dgon lung gi bsu ba slebs yod pas gdugs 'degs par gyis zhes lan 'ga' po/sungs pa bzhin/ dbu gdugs btespu nas ring bo ma lon pa na/ dpo na slob chu bzang tshang gi phyag mdzod dke' bcu blo gros dar rgyas bcas chibs ba sgo ba mi nyung tsam zhig slebs pas chibs rag pa rnams ya mtshan pa byung / ches bcu la/ —dgon lung nas chibasna bsur phebs pa'i sku skyes chos rje rnams dang dka' sto

chos sde chen po dgon lungadu zhabasapadabakod tshul/ geṭīka waram dge tshul slong brgya phrag mang bos phyag dbang zhus par/ dregs zhan 'bring gsu 3/ la phyag dbang gnang lugs sogs bla chen rgan po lta bu mdzad cing / de nas rim gyis phebs lam du chu phyan cig gzigs par/ ngas khrus cig byed dgos kyang chu 'di la khrus mi byed/ la pha gi'i pha rol na rgyug chu che ba cig yod pas der khrus byed rgyu yin zhes shing rta zer ba'i la rteng nas pha rol na kha li chi zer ba'i chu chen zhig yod pa gsal bor gsungs pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar skyes shing der 'tshogs rnams yid ches kyi gnas su bkod/ de nas rim gyis brtsa/da sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs su phebs pa na/ dge 'dun stong phrag gsum lhag tsam gyis chos gos snam sbyar sogs ngur smrig gi rtags kyis mdzes par klubs shing / gdugs/ dang / rgyal mtshan/ ba dan sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa mang bo dang / dung dkar cha 'bud/ dung chen rgya gling sogs rol cha sna tshogs 'bud dkrol gyis sna drangs te/ gzhan yang me tog dang bdug spos sogs mchod pa'i yo byad mtha' yas pa dang bcas ser 'phreng gi bkod pa shin tu mdzes pas bsus par/ sprul sku rin po che ser 'phreng gi mgor slebs pa dang / thugs gzhan du ci yang mi g.yengs par dge 'dun thams cad la zhib gzigs gnang bzhin par phebs pas/ dge 'dun rnams dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba byung / dgon lung khri ba sku zhabs chu bzang rin po che nas gnang skabs yin 'dug pas khong gi ljags bkod bzhin/ dgon pa rang du sngar phebs kyi bla ma su la 'ang ma mdzad pa'i spyi bla brang / sgar ba che tshad thams cad kyi

7lha chos sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad baspyod tshul/so so'i brang khang gi yang thog nas bkra shis khra ring khra khyil khyil brkyang ba dang / ri rtse dang srang bar rnams su dri zhim po'i shing sna'i dud sprin 'thudze+ezhing / gcug lag khang rnams kyi yang thog dang ba gem ci rigs nas dung chen/ rgya gling / rnga rol sogs rol mo'i khyad par sna tshogs pa 'bud dkrol dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan mthon por bsgrong ba sogs bkur bste bla na med pa dang bcas/ sku gong ma'i gzims khang du gdan drangs/chu bzang rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis skra phud bzhes te/dag dbang chos sdi grags pū bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes —thetshan r+ghaṃsol/༷ rmeng skyi bla brangaX gi gasnyer parnyi kyaje spruzlo sku rirno po r+bha/ chu bzang dpon slob rin po che/ 'dan ma grub chen sprul sku sogs bla ma dang / yab yum gyis gtso ba'i gzhi byes kyi mgron thams cad la dga' ston rgya chen po dang / yab yum sku mched sogs la dngos po'i ster cha bcas gzab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa bgyis so/ /rmad byung mchog gi sprul sku mtshan mo'i mgon/ /dam mi 'i rang rtags 'od dkar ngom bzhin du/ /dran dbang rgyu skar stong gi 'khor dang bcas/ /byams gling kun+da'i dga' tshal skyong bar gshegs/ /de tshe rig grol gnyis ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /grangs med tshar du dngar ba'i ser sbreng gi /bla gos gsar ba'i mdangs kyis sdo bsangaso ma'i/ ḍo /'gram par li khri'i thig le 'god pa bzhin/ /ji ltar 'phags yul badz+ra a sa nar/ /thub pa'i dbang bo'i zhabs sen bkod pa bzhin/ /byams pa gling du 'od 'bar nor bu'i khrir/ /mchog gi sprul sku 'di yi zhubs pad

tshos sde chen po dgon lung du zhabs pad bkod tshul/ ṭ+wāṃ3bkod/ /sdos kyi rgyal bo 'di yis 'dzam gling kun/ /rtos kyi grags pas khyab par mardzod gzigs nas/ /rdosdu kyi spyan dang dz+nyā na shā'i slob dpon gyis/ /rdosdu kyi grags pa zhes pa'i mtshan gsol mdzad/ /ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba yi/ /cha shas rim gyis gang ba bzhin/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i mdzad 'phrin kyang / /nyin bzhin gong du 'phel ba na/ /'di yis las dang skal bar ldan pa yi/ /'akro ba mang zhig thar pa'i khang bzang du/ /'khrid par 'gyur zhes yid srubs sde dang bcas/ /mya ngan khang bur zhugs te shugs ring 'byin/ /dkar bo'i phyogs la mngon dga'i lha klu rnams/ /legs so'i me tog mkha' la 'thor bzhin du/ /dbu 'phang mthon por bteg ste dga' ba'i bzhin/ /cha shas yongs su gang ba'i zla ltar 'dzum/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi bla brang du mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o / / /

///rte441/ mo phro na'u gsumā pu/ dbud khyogaska tsi nazhi gulka glur zhadas gyi puṅgho ngaspod de zhadamā dpy-ings ༈/nga mā bung/ga po chen pos zhasnye na pukun zhaskamā nus gi khyid pu nan-id puzhi tshun/sku gong ma'i thugs dam rten thub pa'i li sku byin can zhika yod pa dgon par spyi 'jog tu 'bul rtsis kyis rten sgam gang gi nang du yod dam zhes sku drung du glengs par/ mchod khang du byon nas rten sgam gcig la phyag ma/dzub btsugs te 'di'i nang du yod ces gsungs pa/ kha phye baṭaṭa sku brnyan rten sgam de na 'dug pas thaca/sa/ cad ngo mtshar bar gyur/ zla ba drug pa'i dbyar chos kyi skabs 'du khang steng du rje gong mas spyi 'jog mdzad—pa'i 'khar rnga brdung ba gzigs nas / pha gi ci yin zhes tshul khrims dar rgyas zer ba la bka'e 'dri gnang bar 'khar rnga yin zhes zhus pas/ 'khar rnga 'di ngas phul ba yin gsungs/ de la dka' bcu ngag dbang lhun grub pas khye/ da kyis zhal rdzun ma gsung zhes sku rtsed zhus par/ rdzun yin na lha dpari / 'di ngas pho brang nas khyer yongs nas dgon par phul ba yin/zhes ngos 'dzim/ gsal bo mdzad/ zla ba bdun pa'i bcu bdun la drag char che na po cig byung bar/ nga pho brang dzor song dus drag char 'di 'dra cig byung nas khas/ ro byas zhesdo4 klo/sungs pa la/ dka' bcu shes dar bas de nas dzo lta ra byatra/ pa yi pho 'e/ṭashaṃ dri ba zhusdo/ par/ drang5 / druzu —cho ci thu ro cha/ ṭadi nged tsho

go phyina'iyulagrur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/ 1byesong na e das/'a/ bsdad na e dga' byas pa yin zhes thog mar pho brang la phebs pa'i bshul lam du drag char chen po cig byung ba thugs kyis dran nas gas/la bo gsung / yang ska thas zhig dgon lung si/ grwa gshag mang bo cig la phyag mdzub kyis bstan nas/ 'di nas 'di'i bar da cha ngo mi shes pa zhig byas 'dug phebs pa dang / sngar bzhugs myong ba'i khang ba gcig la 'di ngas ngo shes/ nga 'di da rgyun ring bsdad pa yin zhes ngos 'dzin gsal bo mdzad/ snga phyir ldo+on gnas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du phebs pa 'di dag ni/ blo gros mi zad par bstan pa'i mdo las/ des sngon gnas rjes su dra na te skye ba brgya yang rjes su dran no/ / zhes sogs sasungs pa dang / phal ngo che las/ de 'di nas kyang rmongs pa med par 'gro'o/ /pha rol tu rmongs pa med par skye'o/ /zhes so gas gzhan don du skye srid 'dziyo/ pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i khyad chocha/ ba/sungs pa rnams gsal bar bsta/napa ste/ deng sa /nga gi mye srid bzung bar khas 'che ba rnams la khyad chos 'a diri phyogs tsam yang yod pa ma mthong ngo / /de nas re zhig gitshobar du sku gong ma'i slob ma a rtse rtsos rjer grags pa rje blo bzang chos 'dzin pa sku drung du bcar bzhugs mdzad cing / gzab ga/shar gyi yi ge 'dri klog sogs phul bas tshegs med par thugs su chud/ chos spyod gsol 'debs kyi rim pa dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ chos skyong rnam sa/ kyi bska nga gso 'i rim pa sogs phral du nyer mkho'i rigs phal cher thugs 'dzin mdzad/ bshar spyang gnang skabs tshig 'dis don 'di lta bu zhig ston pa 'dug dmigs rnam yid la byed tshul

lha6 tsi na'i yul grur 'ibs rte gong ma chin pos bsnyin bkur mthed phul /'di 'dra dgos rgyu yin 'dug ces bla ma chos 'chad pa la goms pa zhig gis 'chad pa bzhin du gsungs pas chos rje sogs dad pa'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'khrug pa byung 'dug sku na phra ba'i dus 'dir nyams dang rmi lam 'dres pa'i snang ba la ko sa la brik+ṣa nas grub chen zhig gis khyed bsrung bar btang ba yin zer a tsa ra gnyis kyis nub re bzhin mel tshe byed pa zhig yod pa dgung lo nar son pa na med song / phyis su brtags na ma gon po dang lha mo gnyis kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa 'dra zhes bdag cag la dngos su gsung / dgung lo bdun gyi thog rje blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang bar —ma'i tshul khrims legs par bzhes/ 'di dus skya bas 'gro'i bslab bya dang dge bsnyen gyi bslab bya rnams zhib tu nges par bgyis te bsrung mtshams las mi 'da' bar bgyis pa yin zhes zhal nas dngos su gsungs pa thos ldetho/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i zhal gyi chu 'dzin las/ /sngon gnas rjes dran gsung gi dbyar skyes sgra/ /yang yang bzhad pas grwa slob mdongs ldasatshogs/ /nges shes brtan po'i mngal gyis sgeg par gyur/ /zhi dul bag yod spyod pa zhim po'i dri/ /skyes rabs mang po'i tsan+dan ljon pa la/ /rtag tu sim pa'i ngad pa sku tshe 'dir/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas ngang gis 'thul bar gyur/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu 'di 'dra mi bsrung na/ /bdag cag srung mar 'bad pa ngo tsha zhes/ /bstan srung gtso bo ma mgon lcam dral gyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu khyod la mel tshe bgyis/ /skye phreng kun tu 'bral med bzung

dzi na'i yul grur phebaṭ+wāṃ te gong ma tshen pos bsnyenabakuradīdzadatshul/ 77 d+ngha ba yi/ /yon tan rin chen rgyan cha ma rnying bzhin/ /dbyangs gsal srad bur brgyus pa'i cho ga'i phreng / /mgul du bzhes pa'i ngal ba 'di ci zhig /deng dus bslabs kyang mi shes blun phrug 'ga'/ /ma bsgabs thugs su chud par khas 'che bas/ /chen po'i go sar 'gying ba 'di dag la/ /co 'dri'i ched du yin par bdag gis 'khums/ /skabs 'dir mtsho sngon gyi dpon po bstan 'dzin ching wang sogs kha shas rang gi mnga' ris la spyod pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu zad pa'i dus la slebs te 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i yan lag bzhi ba'i dpung la dmus long glen pa dbyug pas g.yul 'gyed pa dang mtshungs par/ rgya nag la ngo log rtsis kyis dus zir bslang bas yos kyi lo 'dir jang jun gung nyen ga yo'u dang gung yo'u grung chi gnyis kyis dpung chen bteg nas mtsho sog cham la phabs/ de dus gser khog dgon gyi se chen rab 'byams pa sogs 'phung 'dres brlams pa 'ga' zhig sog po'i dmag rogs la song ba sogs rkyen ngan mang po zhig 'dzom pas/ gtso bor gser khog dgon dang zhar la dgon lung sogs nyes pa yod med kyi dgon sde che chung mang po zhig la gong ma'i bka' chad phog ste/ lo 'dir gser khog dgon dang / shing 'brug lo dgon lung du dmag dpung chen po 'ongs nas dgon gnyis ka shul med du btang / 'di skabs gong ma yung ṭing chen po rgyal sar mnga' bsgyur ba'i lo phyi ma yin cing / rgung ma 'di nyid sngar rgyal sar ma 'khod gong du lcang skya gong ma rje ngag dbyāng blo bzung chosdo ldan las zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan pa dang /rgyarla sridz+wa la ༷dbalnge ba'i rterno 'brel du bzhugs khri khyad mtshar zhig rje bla ma

18 8na'iyulagrur/phebasate gong ma— chen pos bsnyin bkur mdzad tshul/nyid—la phul nas thugs/ smon shugs drag mdzad pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin pa bcas rje gong ma de nyid la thugs dad thun mong ma yin pa yod ṭ+wāṃ 'i dbang gis/ blo bur du thugs dran sad pa lta bus sprul pa'i sku dmage 'khrugs kyi nang du sku la nye zho sogs 'byung dogs kyis thugs ngal chen po 'khrungs te/ de ma thag dmag dpon gnyis la/ bdag gi slob dpon lcang skya kau shri chen po'i sprul sku de phyogs su bzhugs pa sku la nyam nyes cung — zad kyang med par gser gyi rgyal khab chen por myur du gdan 'dren par gyis gsung ba'i bka'i gser yig pe'i cing nas zi ling gi bar du zhag lngas slebs pa'i shin tu mgyogs pa phebs/ 'di dus sprul sku rin po che dgon lung nas nyin lam gnyis tsam gyi sa cha na ri brag rang rong la nags tshal ske shin tu 'thug po bar mtshams med pa 'khrigs shing gcan gzan gtumarme po ma rungs pa du ma rgyu ba/ lamyo/ 'phrang thamyo/sa cad brag chu 'thab pa'i bgrod shin tu dka' ba'i sbas lung 'ga' zhig yod pa der cha zi bya ba'i ri'i rtse mor brag phug kha gnam la lta ba mi rgyus can ma gtogs nga sa rnyed dka' ba zhigacitu gsang stabs kyis gdan drangs/ phyag g.yog pa gnyis tsam bcas nyin mo me btang na du ba thon nas gzhan gyis shes dogs pas/ g.yos skol sogs mtshan kung thun gcig tsam las byed rgyu mi yong ba sogs shin tu 'o brgyal bar bzhugs/ phyag g.yog pa gnyis snen du sems khral kho na byed pa la/ /sprul sku rin po che nas rang re 'di 'dra'i sbed gsang thabs sdug/ po byed dgos pa med/ sa cha gu yangs pa zhig tu phyin nas so/sa bder bsnari pas chog ces yang ya nga gsungs kyang / phyag g.yog pa tshos sku na phra

ji na'i yul grur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyenabakuramadzadatshul/ lhanya /de bas lhus ma things pa'i bab col du bzung nas cha 'jog mi byed par ma zad nye dzakhor du skyo sangs tsam du yang 'byon mi 'jug pa 'i+o gas bsnam ra shin tu dog po bgyis 'dug cang jun gnyis kyis7 gong ma'i bka' slebs phral du dmag mi rnams la lo bco lnga lon pa man chad gsod mi chog pa dang / de rigs gang byung bzung nas cang jun la sprod dgos pa'i dril bsgrags pas/ sprul sku rin po che'i thugs rje'i mthu las g.yul du tshud pa'i bu chung bgrang las 'das pa zhig srog gi 'jigs pa las thar par gyur/ — re zhig cig na cang jun sogs kyis sprul sku rin po che 'ju lag phyogs kyi sbas yul zhig na bzhugs pa cung zad 'phrig tshud pas/ de'i nye 'khor gyi sdo kho dang dob tshang gi 'brog sde rnams dang mchod rten thang dgon pa'i bla ma las sne rnams la sprul sku rin po che de phyogs su yod 'dutha/ pas mi sprod na dmag dpung chen po btegs nas yul phyogs dang dgon sde meg med du gtong rgyu yin tshul gyi rtsar gcod drag po gyis pas phyob/sa de'e se/ra skya thams cad ci bya gtol med la thug — da dung yad+ku+o re zhig gi bar du gsang bsgrum pa'i lugs su bgyis 'dug na'ang rim gyis gcig shes gnyis shes kyis gsang brdol bas bya thabs zad de/ dgon lung spyi ba dang lcang skya bla brang gi nang bzan kha shas sprul sku rin po che gdan 'dre7—/ dzā pre phyin/khong tsho sleb rgyu'i snga nub sprul sku rin po che'i mnal lam du mi ’/ /citha/ gis sang nyin gdan 'dren mkhan slebs yong bas tsham tshom med par phebs na bzang zer ba cig byung / sang zhog zhabs phyi tsho la gsungs par/ 'jam pa sku rim pa na re/ khyed kyi rmi lam ltar na mgo skyel bar song na bzang

bye6 —tsona'iyulagrur rlubs te dong ma chen posabasnyen bkuramadzadahūṃ5 /———ge—'dug ces ma rangs pa'i tshig mang du lab/ sprul sku rin po che nas brag steng zhig tu phebs nas mi 'dra e yong gi bya ra mdzad mi sa/ skabs zhig rgyang ring bo nas rta pa kha shas yong gi yod pa gzigs nas phyag g.yog pa rnams la spran par/ sku rim pa na re/ rmi lam bzhin du mgo len mkhan slebs byung zer zhing sa la 'gyel te ngu 'bod dang brang brdung ba sogs byed pa la/ sprul sku rin po ches/ ma gi tsho'i cha lugs la bltas na dmag mi min pa /'dug rang re'i grwa ba yin pa 'dra gsungs pas khos bltas nas da dung yang yid ma ches/ de nas nang bzan rnams sku drung du slebs nas/gsang mi thub par ma zad da lta ma phebs na/ yul phyogs dgon sde yang gtan brlag tu 'gro ba dang mthar cis kyang phebs dgos pa las 'os mi 'dug tshul zhus par/ sprul sku rin po che nas/ nged rang phyin na rab skyon ci yang med snyam zhing / gal te skyon byung na'ang mi gcig tsam yin pas 'gyod rgyu med/ ma song na nged rang gi don du mi mang po'i srog la gnod cing / mchod rten thang dgon pa yang gtan med du 'gro ba dang / mthar nged kyang mgo mi thon nges pas/ da res phral du 'gro ba rang legs zhes gsungs pas/ phyag g.yog pa rnams dad pa dang skyo ba 'dres mas ja —sun cig gi yun tsam la mchi ma 'don pa las gcam gleng ba sogs kyang ma byung / de nas thamasacad kyis phebs rgyur thag bcad de/ lam 'phrang rnams su phyag g.yog pa nyuganyis gsum tsam gyis re mos rgyab tu khur ba sogs dka' spyad kyis byon/ ri sul cung zad khod yangs pa zhig na dgon lung spyi ba dang / lcang skya bla brang sogs ras gur ngan ngon re phub nas gzhi

dzi na'i yul grur phebs te gongamachenaposabasnyenabakurasdatram̐3—tshu la/ —081 wa bzung yod pa der 'byor nas zhag gnyis gsum tsam ci bder bzhu gas so 3mnga' thang gangs ri dgung du bsnyegs pa la/ /dbang byed sa yi bdag po gdong lnga bar/ /bsod nams dman pa'i gshong bur rgyu ba yi/ /blun po wa skyes 'ga' yis rgol bar brtsams/ /de tshe sa bdag dpung gi rtse mo can/ /drag tu g.yos pas rgol ngan tshang tshing nags/ /bsregs dang lhan cig las kyis nongs pa yi/ /nyes med rtsi shing gelatsho ba gzhan yang bcom/ /bdud dmag bye bas mtshon gyi char phabs kyang / /yid 'od me tog sil mar bsgyur nus pa'i/ /skyes mchog 'di 'dra rkang gnyis dmag dpung la/ /'jigs pas 'bros pa rus sbal spur mtshungs kyang / /gang na spros dang rtsod pa yod pa las/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro bya zhes/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rang gi rjes 'jug la/ /gdams pa stsal pa rjes su sgrub bzhed nas/ /mda' na chu brag 'thab pas gnas sgo bsrungs/ /khor yug nags kyi yol bas mi mngon bsgribs/ /phyogs mtshams gcan gzan gtum po'i mel tshe can/ /ma la ya 'dra'i ri bo'i rtser byon te/ /gnyis pa'i grogs ni grib ma las med cing / /nyi zla'i 'char nub lta las spros gzhan dor/ /nyin mo'i bza' btung spangs pa'i dka' tram̐b kyis/ /mkha' 'gro phug ron rtse ba'i do ra 'grims/ /'di ni skyes rābs du mar sbyang yon la/ /goms pa'i rang gi ngang tshul ngom pa 'am/ /ting 'dzin bder sred nags kyi drang srong la/ /co 'dri byed ces bdag yid 'phyang mo nyug /kye ma 'gro mang srog gi 'khri shing ni/ /

82 tsi na'i ji/la grur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/g.yul gyi spu gris kacod par gzaṭa/ pa 'i /nga / /gang gis cha tsam mthu yis phyir bzlog pa / /'dis kyang mtshungs rngod skyabs su cis mi rtorga/sa/ /sems can ga/tshomyo/na la phan pa'i don 'gyur na/ /spu gris bar med gtams pa'i lam du yang / /pad ma cho myo/thong b.ri ngari+o ba ltar 'jug pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang gyur khyod la skyabaṭashrī su mche/ /de nas dmag sgar du phebs par nye ba na/ lca— ri skya bla brang gi phyag mdzod pa yan nang so zer ba na re/ da ni spru' sku rang dbang med par dmag nang du phebs dgos pa 'dug grwa ba'i khrod na phyag g.yog la 'gro 'dod 'a /khan yod tshe shin tu legs/ gsod sar 'gro ba yin gre/shis dang blang gis 'gro mkhan ma byung na tshag rgyag pa dka'/ nga rang ni 9ོbo ji5 nga rgas pas bla ma gong ma'i rten gsum dang phyag rdzas phran bu yod pa 'di rnams bsrungs nas 'dug pa las/ sprul sku'i rjes la 'gro rgyu min no zhes pags pa sdon po'i wa'i rang— skad bsgrags pa la/ a rtse chos rjes nged rang sprul sku dgung lo bzhi'i dus nas da lta'i bar 'bral med du phyag g.yog bgyis pa yin/ da cha gnad 'gag la thug dus blorngo/ gtong mi phod pas 'chi na mnyam 'chi dang / gson na rma nyam gson min pa med zer/ de bzhin du gzhung bzang snying stobayoche ba'i grwa ba dgu tsam gyis phyag g.yog tu 'gro ba khas blangs/ dpon g.yog bcu gasdog po rim gyi sa / rgya'i dmag sgar yod sar 'byor/‘ /grwa ba dgu bo nang du 4ma btang bar/ a rtse chos rje gcig pu sprul sku rin po che dang bcas yo'u cang jun gyi drung du khrid par+sā / ras gur shin tu che ba zhig gi dbus na khri ca/thon po stag lpags kye gdan bting ba zhig la cang jun

rdzun—'iyulagruraphebs te gong ma chen pos bsten bkur mdzad tshul/ 83kho rang 'jigs rngam che ba'i tshul gyis 'kho da pa'i g.yas g.yon du dpon chen brjid bag can du ma dang mtshon cha sna tshogs zang zing du 'phyar ba gshed ma'i ngang tshul can mang bo phreng tshar du bsgrigs pa rnams kyis ku co sgrogs pa sogs shin tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' b.ri dbus su sprul sku rin po che zhabs pus btsugs/ nas bzhugs su bcug cang jun gyis skad kyi nga ro chen pos/ sprul sku khyed lcang skya hu thog thu'i sku skye yin nam zer ba la/sprul sku rin po ches/ lha dang bla ma tshad ldan rnarma sa kyis bla ma de'i skye ba yin gsungs pas de'i go sar bsdad pa yin ces gsungs pa7la/ 'o na khyod rang gi skye ba sdon ma de la7gong ma chen pos spyan bskyangs bdag rkyen tshad med gnang ba yin pa la/ khyod rang da chagyi gong ma chen por ngo log pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer/ de la sprul sku rin pe ches/ nged rang byis pa lo brgyad zhig la rgyal po chen po la ngo log pa'i dpyad gzhi mi sems yod su zhig gis byed ces mirka/sungs pas/ kho ba dpon po gzhan rnams la ltos nas ngo 'dzum tsam byed cing / khyod ngo log/ pa min na rang gnas su mi sdod par nags /brod datsemyo/ pa bgrod dka' ba'i gnas su 'gro ba ci yin zer ba la/srog mi ga ces durme khan su yang med pas mi gsod mkhan gyi dmag dpung chen po yong gi 'dug zer bas skrag nas bros pa yi'ozhes gsungs par dpon po thams cad bzhad ga/da the5/ ge ba byas/ de ltar nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba cung zad 4 /rngang ged par dregs pas myos pa'i skye bo klan ka 'tshol ba de'i spobase pa bco3shrī patra// kho rang ngo gnong ste g.yog zhig zho brda' sbyar nas//des phyi rore /byethro na ces skro da pa lta bu byed pa bzhin/ ras gur gyi ra ba'i snyi

da 84 dzina'iyul grur rlubs te gong ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/log tu phebs pa na zhabs phyi ba gzhan rnams sa la 'gyel zhing mya ngan gyi cho nge 'debs kyin 'dug pa rnams kyis sprul pa'i sku nyam nyes med par phebs pa mthong nas dga' spro'i shugs kyis phyag zhabs na bza' ci rigs nas 'chang ste re zhig gi bar du phan tshun gtam 'dri ba yang mi dran par lus/de nas bzhugs gnas ras gur zhig tu phebs pa na/ cang jun gyi mi zhig btang nas gsol chas phran bu phul zhing / sang nyin nas dmag sgar 'degs pa dang lhan du zi ling du phebs dgos/ bzhon pa dang chas ka rnams nyin re bzhin sprod pa yin/ dpon chung zhig dang dmag mi kha shas 'bral med du 'gro rgyu yin zer/ sang nyin nas dmag sgar 'degs pa dang lhan du tsha zhag gar babs su mnyam du phebs/ sprul sku rin po cher nyin bzhin chibs rta re byung / phyag g.yog pa rnams la skabs 'ga' zhig tu zhon rta ster kyang de ma thag dmag mi ngan pa sogs kyis 'phrog nas rang rang gi rta sga khur nas 'gro dgos pa dang / gsol chas sogs mdzod nas thon na'ang bar nas gzhan gyis phri ste/ ngan ngon nyung ngu tsam re las ma byung bas dpon g.yog rnams shin tu 'o brgyal ba zhig la zi ling mkhar du 'byor/ 'di yan la/ 7gong ma'i bka' bzang bo phebs yod pa ma shes bas phyag g.yog pa rnams nyin re bzhin de ring skyon ma byung yang sang nyin ci 'dra yong snyam pa dang lhag par zi ling du slebs nas ga 'dra byas yong snyam srems ngel 'ba' zhig gis nyin mtshan 'da' bar gyur/ sprul sku rin po che thugs tshab pa sogs kyi rnam pa cung zad kyang med par ma zad/ rang re rnams zhag kha shas kyi bar sran btsugs na de nas bza' badh+yāng zhim po

da da 6na'iyulagrur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/ byertobaza' ba dang ltad mo ya mtshan can mang bo mthong rgyu yin mod ces phyag g.yog pa rnams la dbugs dbyung ba'i gsung yang yang phebs zhepar phyag g.yog pa phal cher gyis/ sngar sor yang sprul sku'i gang gsung ltar byung song bas da res kyang gsung ris 'di la dpags na skyon med yong ba 'dra zhes dga' dga' ltar byed/ 'ga' zhig gis ya mtshan rang ga 'dra yin kyang ltad mo sngar ma mthong ba zhig mthong dogs 'dug—zer/ zi ling du phebs pa na bzhugs gnas kyi khang ba sogs gang ci'i grwa bsgrig gzab rgyas 'dug pa dang ma 'gyangs par/ 7 gong ma'i bka' bzang bo'i gser yig bsgrags pas thams cad kyi yid la rab dga'i sa thob pa lta bu'i dga' spro dbyar mtsho'i lang tsho la 'gran pa byung /dusdo/ gsum shes bya'i ri mo ji snyed pa/ /rnam 'dren 'di yi mkhyen pa'i me long du/ /gsal bar bkra yang tshur mthong skye bo rnams/ /yid gnyis za ba rmongs pa'i rang mtshang ste/ /bsod nams kyis gtsang zhal gyi pad+ma'i dbus/ /lung bstan bung ba'i dar dir sgrogs pa gang / /ji bzhin mngon sum gyur tshe gzod de dag /yid ches dad pas thal mo sbyor bar byed/ /dpon chen rnams kyis kyang nyin re bzhin gsol ston dang rtsed sna mang bo'i gzigs mo 'bul ba sogs bkur bsti rim 'gro phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs shing / sngar song phyag g.yog pa bcu las med spyang / de nas che phra mang bos phyag g.yog la hab thob kyis je mang dang / sngar gyi ba yan nang so yang slebs nas phyag mdzod kyi go sa bdag byas pa sogs 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mig gis mthong rgyu dang lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod pa zhig

ge— 86 tsi na'i yul grur phebs te bo/nga ca chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/ da wa—gsal bar bstan 'dug mi ring bar sku 'brum bzhes pa la/ dpon po rnams kyis rgya'i sma na pa nyams rgyus yod pa mang bo'i ngag nga1skrur gyis sman dang dpyad 'jam po'i rigs rnams phul zhing / gsol chas 'phrod rten sogs gzab par bgyis/ phyag g.yog rnams kyis sku 'bum sogs grwa tshang re gnyis su zhabs brtan rim 'gro rgya cher bsgrubs pas cher ma 'gyangs par zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba bzhin du snyun las grol bar gyur/ de gong zi ling du slebs kha a rtse chori sro rje nas sprul sku rin po che la/ rgya nga /khar du 'brum dogs che bas nang nub lo gyon ma dang sna tshogs yum gyi gzungs sngags ljags bzlas nan tan mdzad dgos tshul zhus pa la/ bsrung sngags nas bsgra ba'i ngal bas ci byed/ mi tshe rgya yul du gtong dgos gshis da cha lo phra dus 'brum pas thar na sems bde bas mi legs sam zhes phebs shing ljags bzlas sogs ci yang ma mdzad 'dug pa 'byung 'gyur ma ngon sum du gzigs nas thu nga ston pa ra mdzad pa gor ma chag go /sku 'brum la / grol ba'i dga' ston du/ cang jun chen pos gtso mdzad dpon po rna mas kyis nyin kha shas kyi ring rgya'i lugs kyi ston mo dang / khrang zhi'i zer ba'i blos gar gyi gzigs rno/ phul/ de dus rma do smad kyi zi yon ba cu sa/sum gyi nang so 'ga' zhig chad pa'i khrims mun du bcug yod pa/ dmar tshang nang so dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin nas sprul sku rin po cher zhus don bzhin/dga' sto na gyi tshogs grwa la de nyid du cang jun chen po la da swo ngas khrol dngo /sa tshul ngo che na ma dzad par/ cang jun nas gyi gong ma che na por snyan sgro na phur te mi ring bar na nga so rnaspo sa ba tson ra 'a sa thar te rang rang gi —

—— —da / sdiwasaspra—la grur phebs te gong ma chan pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/ skyelhaganas mal bdag negir byas chog pa byung 'dug pa/ mdzad pa'i cha shas phra mo tsam yang 'gro ba'i srog gi bcud len du gyur pa 'phags chen dam pa'i ngang tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /de nas rgyal khab chen por phebs pa la/bzhon khal lam chas sogs gang dgos thams cad mdzod nas byung zhing /lam bar gyi tsha zhag gi grwa bsgrig thams cad rang rang gi sa cha'i dpon po rnams kyi sa bgyis te/ dpon g.yog rnams zhag ma lnga bcus pe'i cing du bde bar phyag phebs/ tham ka bla ma rje thu'u bkwan rin po che nas phyag mdzod ngo g.yog phebs bsur gtong ba gnang zhing / pe'i cing gi grwa rigs sbyin bdag phal cher gyis dngos dang tshab ci rigs pas mngon chung gi tshul gyis bsu ba bgyis/ sprul sku rin po che zi ling nas thon pa'i yi ge 7 gong ma'i snyan du 'byor phral/ 7 gong nas rje thu'u bkwan rin po che la sprul sku rgyal khab tu phebs nas re zhig gi bar du khyed rang gi gam du bzhugs nas lugs swol sog/sa/ bslab rjes nged dang ngo 'phrad gyis zhes phebs/ de don bzhin sprul sku rin po che dpon g.yog rnams thog mar tsan+dan jo bo'i lha khang du phebs nas rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i bla brang du bzhugs/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che dus skabs der pe'i cing gi tham ka bla ma yin cing /7 gong nas spyan bskyangs shin tu che ba sogs lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho na'ang / rje lcang skya gong ma bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i rībla ma yin gshis/sprul sku rin po rje phebs skabs lha khang gi rgya sgo'i nang tsam bar du byon nas bsu ba mdzad cing / nang du phebs nas sprul sku rin po che thog mar khri la baphu po/ka su gso/la te/ phyag 'a bul ba dang bcar thos/ ji 5 /ri myo/jal 'phrad kyi

skyeskye ci na'i yul glur phobs te gong ma chen pos brnyanabakuramadzadatshul/ —tre legs skyes 'bul ba sogs bkur gzos bla lhag mdzad cing / ma bu yu ca ring stor ba ngo 'phrad pa lta bu'i dgyes tshor shin tu che ba byung 'dugamadzod nas gsol phog sogs phral du ma byung bas re zhig gi bar la/ sprul sku rin po cher gsol chas nang ma dang dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi na bza' sna tshogs/ dbu zhwa/ zhabs lham/ bzhugs gdan sogs gang dgos kyi yo byad ma tshang ba med pa dang / phyag g.yog pa rnams la go babs dang bstun pa'i zas gos gnas mal thams cad thu'u bkwan rin po che nas sbyor ba mdzod cing / gyigong ma chen por mjal 'phrad skabs zhe sa byed lugs tha na pus mo 'dzugs lugs/ gom pa 'dor lugs tshun chad lugs srol dang mthun par mdzad tshul nan tan gyis snyan 'debs phul/ skabs zhig gong ma chen po tsardon jo bo mjal bar phebs skabs sprul sku rin po che dang mjal 'dzom mdzad rgyu'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ lha khang gi ra ba'i phyi log tsam du ser 'phreng gi mgor sprul sku rin po che bzhugs nas/ gong ma chen po phengs pa la zhabs pus btsugs te che dpag med kyi sku brnyan li ma zhig dang lha dar dri pral bcas phul par/ gyi gong ma 'do li la bzhugs pa las babs te sprul sku'i phyag nas 'then cing bzhengs ku bcug nang du sprul sku rin po che sngon rwadu phebs gsur bar/ slar yang zhabs pus btsugs tegyigong ma chen po sdon la phebs zhes zhu ba sogs lugs srol la ring nas goms pa zhig gi dpe 'dra mdzad pas/ 7 gong ma rang gi sku pang du bteg nas nang du gdan 'dren zhusasdo te bzhugs khri'i stan gyi khar dbus su sprulkepa sku rin po che bzhugs su gsol/ gyi gosi+o ma rang nyid bzhugs stan gye zur sacig

tso na'i yul grur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyenabakuramadzadatshul/ 89————la bzhugs/ sprul sku rin po che'i phyag nas bzung ste sku gong ma de nyid rjes su dran pas spyan chab bsil zhing re zhig gi bar gsung du0/zhaphya/ phebs mi thub pa lta bu byung / de nas gung nyen ga yo'u sku drung du bos nas/ khyod kyis mtsho sngon po'i sog po thams cad mnga' 'og tu bcug pa la nged de tsam dga' ba chen po med/ nga rang gi bla ma'i sku skye 'khrul med 'a di bzhin gdan drangs nas nged la ngo 'phrad pa la sems dga' ba tshad med pa byung zhes bka' babs/ mi ring bar7gong nas sprul pa'i sku skye ba gong ma'i gdan sa zung gru zir phebs nas khri 'don mdzad rgyu'i tshes grangs sogs rtsis la zhus shig ces thu'u bkwan rin po cher bka' phebs pa bzhin/ gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba zhig zhib rtsis bgyis te zhus pa la/ gong nas phebaru/ nyin lha khang gnyis kyi bar du dge 'dun rnams kyi ser 'phreng bar ma chad du bsgrigs pa dang / rgyal po rang nyid bzhugs pa'i shing rta ser por sprul pa'i sku bzhugs cing / bzhugs stan gser 'brug ma ser po sogs sku gong ma'i lung las ltar phebs rgyu dang / de nas bzung sprul sku rin po che dang phyag g.yog pa rnams la che 'bring chung gsum gyi rik+ka pas mdzod nas gtan 'jags kyi gsol phog sogs gnang rgyu'i bka' lung phebs/ tshes grangs bzang bo'i nyin7 gong ma'i bka' phebs ltar gyi bkur gzos chen po dang bcas sngon kyi dus su/ gong ma yur lo chen pos byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes gdan drangs nas yun ri t+na por bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'dabs chags par/ gyi gor ma yung ṭing rang gis bzhengs pa'i zung gru zi zhes pa'i lha khang rten gsum dge 'dun gyi sde

90 tsi na'i yul grur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/ dang bcas pa rgya khyon yangs shing byin che ba der dge mtshan gyi ltas phum/ sum tshags pa dang bcas byon nas rang nyid kyi sku snga ma yo ngas rdzogs bstan pa'i ma nga' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po ngag dalhang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang po'i chos kyi rgyal srid kyi khri 'phang mthon po la zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod par mdzad do/ /de nas pe'i cing gi bla ma ser mo ba rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya leb/sa par slob pa'i tham ka bla ma jing zi'u chan zhi thu'u bkwan hu thog tu rin po che nas gsung chog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs tshogs 'khor rgyas pa dang / 'bul nod kyang dngul srang brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' cha tshang / bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ ma dzod nang ma'i gos chen ser bo mnab bza'i rgyu pher nges yug dgu dmar po sdon po dkar po ljang khu rnams so so nas yug dgu re/ spu rug dmar ser dang / thig ma 'dres pa dgu tshan gsum/ bzang spos khres lnga bcu tham pa/ bu la han brgya tham pa/ lpags rigs sna tshogs brgya tham pa/ gser srang bcu/ dngul srang dgu brgya dang lnga bcu/ hor dar che ba yug dgu sogs dngos po spam mtho ba phul te bstan srid kyi bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel phul du byung ba bsgrigs par mdzad/ de mtshungs phu'u yin bla ma shes rab rgya mtsho/ ja sag bla ma blo bzang dpal 'byor dang bstan 'dzin chos dar sogs pho brang nang gi bla ma rnams kyis kyang 'byor 'khos kyi 'bul nor phul/ zung gru ziri grwa mang dang / ga'/na yang lha khang so so'i tā bla ma nams dang / pho brat+na nang gi dad ldanagyibyi/ dpon po che phra du mas kyang dad

tsi na'i yul grur phebs te gong ma chen pos bsnyenabakuramadzadatshul/ 91 wa gus kyis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa bgyis so/ /mtshan bzang sa/ser gyi 'khor lo'i ze 'bru can/ /zhabs zung 'dab brgya reg pa'i rdul tshogs kyis/ /mdo smad dge/ ba'i brti sa/nas thamaro / cad du/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i rten bzhag nas/ /gang gi 'phrin las phyogs mthar 'jug pa'i sprin/ /phan bde char gyi snying bo can de yis/ /dbang phyogs skye rgu'i bsod nams lha yi rdzing / /yongs su 'gengs pa'i dus la babs pa na/ /rtag tu gzhan don sems pa'i kyo ba yi/ /dbang gyur rgyal sras dul ba'i khyu mchog de/ /shar phyogs gdul bya'i zhing khams pad+ma'i mtshor/ /gzhan dang mi mnyam snying rje'i 'gros kyis gshigs/ /der ni sa la gnas kyang yon ta na gyis/ /mtho ris grong khyer nyid du brtag bya ba/ /sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag 'du ba'i gnas/ /nor bu'i ba gam bzhad pa'i pho brang du/ /gang gi bsod nam sa daju/nga ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /tshangs pa'i cod paṇa sa la ltung byed pa/ /mi yi rje bo'i bsnyen bkur rgyal mtshan rtser/ /zhabs sen nor bu'i tog gis dpal yon ngoms/ /snyigs ma'i mun pa 'joms la ches dpa' ba/ /sdon med rgyal sras zla ba gzhon nu 'di'i/ /rnam thar 'od 'phreng 'thungs pas char brtas pa'i/ /sa yi bdag po'i yid kyi mtsho gtsang ma/ra —/lhag bsam gser gyi phye mas lus byugs pa'i/ /rmad byung blo gros sa/sa la ba'i ngur ba mo/ /mi 'phrog mos pa'i gshog rlabs sa/yo b.li ma du/ /bstod bsngags mgrin pa'i rdza rnga cir yang brdung / /sgra ldan chu 9ridzin g.yo bas mdongs ma tha' can/ /rab dga' mjus/ ma bkrayi pa'i zlos

da wa92 tsi na'i yul spur phebs te gongo ma chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad tshul/gar bzhin/ /gang sku mthong ba'i mchog dman bar ba yi/ /skye rgu mtha' dab/ kun dga'i 'dzum 'od 'bar/ /de lta'i rab snyan grags pa'i dri bsung gis/ 7/ci yang nga/ sgos pa'i ut+pal ma rnyings ༈ོ legs byas srad pur bstar ba'i do shal gyis/ /mtha' dbus skye bo'i mgrin pa skal bzang byas/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shedrog bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ dbang phyogs tsi na'i yul grur zhabs gyi pad+mo ba skyod de 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // ci

nya3zhi'u dazhi bu/ gzhung zhugs chen rgo rnamārga thos buskamā gyis gtan zha phubu cid zwabu rgyas nu gdamās pu nad du gaskan puzhi tshuzha/ ri 'di dus mdo smad du dgon lung dang gser khog dgon gnyis rgya dmag gis bcom ste/ gtsug lag khang dang grwa gshag rnams mer bsregadage 'dun mang bo bkrong / lhag ma rnams phyogs phyogs su byer te grong yul rnamyo/sa su khyim pa'i zol gyis sbed gsang gang drag gis sdod dgos byung ba la/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po ches thugs khur che bzhes dang / sprul sku rin po che nas kyang zur 'degs mdzad de gyi gong mar zhu mkhas kyi sgo nas/dgom/ lung ba —rnams ri khrod sa/sucha/ dang / gser khog pa rnams phun tshogs lur ba'i ri khrod du bsdad chog pa byung / lo kha shas kyi bar de ltar la/slar yang 7 gong ma chen por thabs mkhas kyi zhu ba dang mdzad sgo gang zab gnang bar brten/ dgon pa gnyis kas sngar gyi rang rang gi gnas gzhi bdag gir byas chog pa byung zhing / gtsub/ lag khang dang grwa khang rnams kyang gyi gong ma'i ma dzod nas gsar bskrun dang / lha sde rnams gyu 'og tu tshud pa phyir ma sprad kyang / de'i tshab tu lo re bzhin mdzod nas phog gtan 'jags su gnang ba bcas zhu don smin rgyas byung / de nas dgung lo bco brgyad la phebs kyi bar du rbahrū/ ngag rtsa cho ka/ gnyis kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa gtso bor byu ci mdzod cing zhar ‘sku/ cho rku rtsaskuka' ci ris/sa kyang gsan par mdzad snang ba la

/de zhathe wa— gzhungalugs la thos bsam dang nadams pa gsan tshul/lo tshigs kyi nges pa sa bon ma byung bas 'bri bar ma spobs pas sdosas gcig tu 'god par bya ste/ de yang slob ma'i tha shal ba bdag gis rje bla ma nyid kyi rnam par thar pa yi ger bkod pa zhig thugs rje gzigs dgos tshul yang yang zhus par gsung las/ deng sang gzhung lugs mang bo la thos bsam rgya chen po byas par rlom pa phal che ba zhig ni/ kho 'di zer na nga 'di zer gyi shag 'gyed pa tsam gtso bor byas te/ mi tshe hril gyis thal phreng nyog po zhig kho na la mgo 'gas 'gas su rtsod pa las/ gzhung lugs chen mo rnams/ kyi go ba dpyis phyin pa 'tshol mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon par snang / de dag la bltas na/ kho bo mtshan nyid kyi grwa sar zhugs nas slob gnyer byed pa ma byung na'ang / shing rta chen po rnams kyi gzhung lugs du ma dang rje yab sras kyi legs bshad rnams la blo gros zhib mo sa thos bas ma byed lugs tshad dang ldan pa/ rje bla mas rang nyid kyi rtogs brjod 'dun legs mar gsungs pa dang cha 'dra ba tsam zhig bgyis pas/da cha gzhung lugs de rnams la go ba phyogs 'gro zhig chags pa'i lugs yin/ 'di kho bo la ltos pa'i rnam thar bzang shos zhig yin snyam pa yod/ de las gzhan song bsdad byas pa thams cad rnam thar du byed na mi thams cad la rnam thar po ti che ba re yong 'gro zhes phebs par/ bdas/ gis 'o na rje gla ma nyid nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs chen mo rnamaso la thos bsam ji ltar mdzad tshul de rnams yi ger bkod pa zhig cis kyang thugs rje gzigs dgos zhus par/ yi ger bkod pa'i dgos pa med khyod de tsam do gal che na ngas ngag lam nas bshad kyi gsungs nas / sku tsha phra mo'i miskenas

gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 95skabs su mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer gtso bor mdzad tshul dang / dus de dang phyis su rgyal dbang dang khri chen gyi zhabs la gtugs nas mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par du rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'khor bo bde mchog gnyis kyi skor la thos bsam gyis bdar sha bcad tshul rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma dang sbyar te zhib rgyas zhig thugs brtse bas 'dom sa par mdzad pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba 'dug na'ang / bdag blo gros dman pas gsung bshad mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin blo la 'dzin thub pa ma byung zhing / dbyibs tsam zhig yid yul du nges par bgyis pa rnams 'dir brjod par bya ste/ de yang thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na yin cing / bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa yang mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rim pas 'jug pa las 'jug tshul gzhan med ci0 / de las thog mar thos pa rgya chen po dgos pa ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thom pa'i mun/ /yang dag thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar/ /lam mi shes na thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ /'jug par 'gyur ba smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /deng dus kyi dam pa'i skye bar khas 'che ba phal mo che ni/ rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung las/ byis pa'i dus nas thos bsam long med par/ /dar gos kyis klubs tshong zong bzhin du 'grem/ /dad gshin dkor kyi zas la bag med spyod/ /gnas brtan dge 'dun phyag

— 96 gaspungalugasal thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/dang bsnyen bkur len/ /lnga bdo'i sku skye rnams la thugs rje gzigs/ /zhes sa/sungs pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ mi shes gdol ba'i phru gu dar zab kyis/ /phang phung mdzes par byas te ṭathon po'i khrir/ /blun po'i 'khor tshogs dbus na 'gyings pa yi/ mo/ba mos thub bstan pad tshal 'joms kyis dogs/ /zhes gang gsungs pa'i ngang tshul las ma 'das na'ang / bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma 'di nyid kyis spyod tshul de lta bu ngan skyugs kyi phung bo ltar gzigs nas sngon byon gyi myo/khas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par sku na phra ba'i gnas skabs 'dir gzhung lugs rgya chen po rnams/ thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de yang thog mar mtshan nyid kyi pu ti lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin cing / rje gong ma 'i zhabs phyir ṭu/na ring bzhugs nas mdo sngags kyi gsan pa rgya po mdzad pa dang mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas rje de nyid kyi thugs la btags pa'i grwa blo+ob thun mong ma yin pa bzang shu dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas sam ngab/ dbang cho sa ldan zhes bya ba lung rigs kyi dbang phyug chen po de nyid dge rgan gyi tshul du bsten nas bsdus tshad kyi rigs lam la thugs sbyangs mdzad pas rtsol ba cher ma dgos par rigs lam shin tu phra ba rnams thugs su chud/ dka' chen nas thog mar rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'jam dicengs zung 'brel gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rlung khrid 'bul bar mdzad cing / de nas bzung thugs nyams7su bzhes par lha'i rnam pa la gsal snang khyad par can thon pas snang ba thams cad rje btsun gyi sku'i

gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdamasapa gsan tshul/ 91da wa rnam par shar te zhabs 'og tu yang rje btsun gyi sku lam lam shar nas thugs la cung zad mi ngade ba lta bu byung / phyis su ྅5nga lo mthon por phebs skabs/ de dus de ltar byung ba bzhin da cha yang skebs 'ga' zhig tu de 'dra'i snango ba 'ong gi 'dug pa rtsa rlung gi nyams shig yin pa 'dra gsungs/ 'di ni nges pa'i don du rje bla ma nyid kyi gzigs ngor tha mal gyi snang ba 'char mi srid pas gang shar mchog gi snang ba las 'os med kyang /thun mong gi snang ngor sku tshe snga ma rnams su snang grag rig gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol bar blta ba'i rnal 'byor la goms pa'i bag chags rtsol med du shar ba gdon mi za'o/ /thos pa'i sgron mes rmongs mun ma bsal na/ /lam dang lam min ji bzhin mi mthong zhes/ /'doms phyir lung rigs smra ba'i bshes gnyen drung / /྅gas lam bdud rtsi'i dga' ston khyod kyis spel/ de tshe mkhyen dpyod gser gye/ ngang ba mo/ /rigs pa'i 'phrul gyi pad+ma stong ngazhad pa'i/ /bsdus gzhung bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu'i 'jug ngogs su/ /nyin bzhin thal 'gyur dbyangs snyan sgrogs pas brel/ /phyi nang snod bcud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'char ba'i gzigs mor ring nas goms pa yi/ /bag chags sad pa'i tshul gyis 'jam dbyangs sku/ /nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigari shaṃ pa'i snang ba shar/ /rnam 'dren khyod dang rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /gartis/ su med kyang gnyis su snang ba dang / /gcig tu zad kyang du mar sto zu/ pa'i 'phrul/ /'di ni sgyu ma las kyang sgyu ma nyid//de nar+sha/ byanashaṃ sa chos dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhud spyi la thos she

98 gzhungalugagagel thosabasamadang gdams pa gsan tshul//bsam mdzod tshul ni/ 'dun legs ma las/ de nyid phyir na mi pham/ chos rje dang / /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyag len la btab ste/ d+ku byams chos lnga'i nang nas dang por mngon rtogs rgyan dang de'i 'grel b.ri rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa slob dpon seng ge bzang bo'i 'grel ba don gsal bcas thugs la byang ba ra bzung ste/ rgya 'grel gzhan thams cad dang /rje bla ma'i legs bshad gser gyi 'phreng ba dang / khyad par du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje bla ma la dngos su stsol bar mdzad pa'i sher phyin gyi man ngag nyama' len gyi rim par bsgrigs pa rnam bshad snying bo rgyan la gzigs rtog gtso bor mdzad cing / mkhas grub du mas mdzad pa'i spyi 〉thal zur ba kol sogs yig cha gang yod la zhib dpyod gnang ba dang /skabs skabs su phung rigs smra ba'i dbang bo dka' chen shes dar ba sogs la dka' ba'i gnas la dogs gcod kyi 'bel gtam kyang yang yang zhib tu mdzad pas ring bo ma pyalon par mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i brjod bya gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes par gyur to/ /byams chos phyi ma rnams las mdo sde rgyan rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho pa las rgyas bshad mdzub khrid tshul gyis zhib tu gsan cing / 'byed gnyis dang rgyud bla ma rnams thogs 'grel dang dar ṭika sogs 'grel ba ci byurigs pa la brten nas tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud par ma dzad de/
