lke lnged wa da ——tshosku —nga lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan 7la/ nyenyezhal nas/ r+yā ngo tshoṭā gaṭ+wāṃg rgyan gyi tshig do na ragari sri pa tsam ngeṭa/ pa la dka' las chen po rang py-id ma dgos kyang / mdo rgyan sbyar te lam gyi rim par bsgrigasdori pa'i go ba dpyis phyin pa rnyed pa la ngal ba cher byas pa yin/mdzan rtorngo /sa rgyan la ltos te byams chos phyi ma rnams la de tsam gyi dka2 las byed ma dgos zhes gsungs/ rgyal yum sbas don rin chen bang mdzod la sa/ /mi phamyo/ r+sha kon gyis nyer blangs nor bu'i tshogs/ /dngos brgyad zang do —spyo/ bdun cu3 phreng ba ru/ /bstar ba'i do shal khyod kyi ma/grin par 'khyud/ /'di na thal 'phreng nyog po tsam zhig la/ /ring du sbyangs pa'i yus kyis cher khengs nas/ /phar phyin shes par rlom pas rigs mthun dbus / /seng ge lta bur 'gying ba mang mchis kyang / /mdo rgyan sbyor tshul dngos shugs bstan don kun/ /'phags seng dgongs pa ji bzhin thu sgo /sa chud de/ /tshogazhung don lam gyi rim par bsgrig mkhas pa/ /deng sang dus na khyod nyid gcig pu tsam/ /'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis zhes yongs su grags pa rnamyo/sa las/ thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung zukru sbyangs pa mdzad tshul yang / mngon pa'i sde snod thams cad kyi brjod bya gnas brgyad du bsdu sa nas ston pa slob dpon dbyig gi gnyen pos mdzad pa'i mdzod rtsa ba dang / thams cad ma khyen pa dge 'dun grub kyiri shrī ma dzad pa'i mdzod ṭika thar lam gsal byed gnyis thugs 'dzin mdzade cing / 'chim gyi mdzod ṭika la gzigs rtog gtso bor mdzad/ rang 'grel sogs rgya 'grel rnams dang bod kyi yig cha phal mo che zhig la zhib dpyod mdzad pas gnas brgyad kyis shes bya gzhi lnga kha che sgo

100 gzhung lugs la thos bsam dngagadamasapa gsan tshul/ ——da ribrag smra ba ltar dang / rang 'grel ltar mdo sde ba'i lugasdoge su 'chad pa'i tshul dang / khyad par du gnas dgu bas gang zag gi bdaka med gtso bor gtan la 'bebs tshul sogs bshad yam tsam ma yin pa'i go ba gting tshugs pa 'khrungs/ 'di dus slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi bstod pa zhig rgyur du zhal 'don mdzad cing / mi zhig gis mon gra ba'i mdzod 'grel dpe rnying zhitra/ kyang 'bul ba byung zhes gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi gzhung mngon pa kun las btus pa dang / sa sde lnga/ sdom rnam gnyis dang bcas pa'i dka' gnad thams cad la zhib dpyod mdzad cing / khyad par du kun btus dang sa sde la yun ring bo'i bar du zhib sbyong mdzad/ kun btus dar ṭika shin tu legs pa 'dug na'ang / phyis su re mda' ba'i 'grel ba phyag tu byung nas gzigs rtogs mdzad pas thugs lhag par drangs te 'grel ba de 2 7yang yang bsngags brjod mdzad/ zhal nas/ theg pa gsum gyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum rgya cher gtan la 'bebs pa la 'phags pa thogs med kyi gzhung 'di lta bu gzhan mi 'dug pas—bstan pa la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug ces yang yang gsungs pa thos/ de ltar thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pas theg pa che chung gi sde snod gong 'og ma lus pa'i don mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang mthun par gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur to//mkhyen dpyod mkhi' lding dbang bo'i gzi brjid kyis/ /chos mngon gdengs can dbang bo skrag pa las/ /shes bya gzhi lnga'i rin chen sna tshogs pa/ /rang spyi3 kha dog lhag ger khyod la bstab/ /theg gsum rin chen

da spu—yo lu tshi laspras— ga/tram̐ — da—t+na ka dad+ngha /tram̐/ rjigizi5//— 101za ma tog gi kha/ /cig char phye nas gzhi yam 'bras bume ner/ /yongs rdzogs khyod kyis bdag gir byas pa la/ /thogs med sku mched thugs khrel ma dzad dam snyam/ /shing rta chen po dpal mgom/ 'phas/twaṭa pa klu sgru ba yab sras kyi gzhung la thos bsam ma dzad tshul ni/ rtogs brjod las/mdo sngags gzhung la ngalabyub mang byas kyang / /zab don nyams su len dang smra ba na/ /gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes pa'i/ /lta ba'i tshul las ring du ma song bar/ /mthong nas lhag par klu sgrub gzhung lugs kyi/ /zab mo 'byed pa'i phra ba'i rigs lam nas/ /yang dag lta ba badren pa'i sa/nad kun la/ /legs par sbyangs te the tshom chod par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la 'debs par mdzad de/ de yang chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po ma byon gong du mkhas grub khyaglu par can re gnyis ma gtogs/ phal che ba zhi ga gis zab mo'i lta ba rang gi nyams su len pa'am gzhan la 'doms par byed pa na/ thos pa ma byas pa rnams lta ci gzhung lugs mang du thos pa rnams kyang rang gi thos pa'i zab mo'i gzhung de dag gi brjod bya las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i blun po'i ngag sgros tsam gyi rjes su 'brang bar byed la/ der ma zad rje bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che la zhugs nas gzhung lugs chen mo rnams la mi tsher thos pa byas par rlom pa 'ga' zhig kyang dbu ma'i gzhung chen po rnams su sa/sungs pa'i rigs pa phra mos bdag med gtan la 'be+ebs tshul rnams phyi'i go rgya gcod pa tsam du sems shing /sems kyi ngo bo gcer mthongs su ngo sprod tshul yin pa skad kyi mdzub khrid chung ngu re tsam la snying bor 'dzin pa pha rjes bus ma zin pa'i rang mtshang

— 102 da dgazhun+d+ratram̐prisalathosabasam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ —ston pa mthong mod/ rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyis ches shin tu rtogs pad dka' ba zab cho/ stong ba nyid rtag chad kyi/ mtha' dang bral ba la nges pa 'dren pa la/ tha snyad tshad mas grub pa dang dngos po kun rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam ya nga med pa gnyis 'gal ba med par gcig gcig gi grogs su 'gro tshul dang / rang bzhin med pa'i chos la 'khor 'das kyi bya byed tshad grub 'jog shes pa'i khyad par rnams ma 'dres par shes dgos shing / de shes pa la klu sgrub yab sros kyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i de rdzon nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam grangs khyad par can rnams la rag las par dgongs nas/ gzhung de dag la deng sang gi rigs pa smra ba rnams kyi slob gnyer byed srol bzhin gzhung tshig khol phyung re tsam la dpe klog dang tshig gi na yam tsam gyi rtsod pa lhur blangs te stong skad kyi mkhas —grags don du gnyer ba lta bu ma yin pa'i thos bsam tshad dang ldan pa mdzad do/ /de yang rtsa ba shes rab dang dbu ma 'jug pa gnyis thugs la bzung nas rgyun tu zhal 'don mdzad cing / rtsa shes 'gel ba burta pa li ta dang / 'jus/ pa'i rang 'grel gnyis tshang ma thugs/ la skyo ra ba dang / rtsa shes ṭika chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed rnams kyi gnad che ba pham cher thugs 'dzin mdzad/ rjes 'brang gi yig cha gang yod la 'di ma gzigs bya ba med cing / de dag las rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gnyis kyi dbu mari yi ga cha la thugs 'gro ba byung bas tshig don dpyis phyin pa thugs la 'dzin pa cho /dzad/ 'jug pa

gzhung lugs 'ad sa ngasam da da kropas pa gzha—tram̐l/ 103zhal 'don mdzad skabs rang gzhan snod bcud sospru/sa phyi nang gi dngos po gang snang 'di mtha' dag rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu las/ dom/ la tshugs thub tu grub pa cur zad kyang mi 'dug snyam pa yang yang thugs la 8 char ba byung /rje thu'u bkwan ri na po che dang / slob dpon shesacidar ba gnyis la zhus par/ nyid sku tshe gong ma rnams su zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba la goms pa'i lag rjes yin 'dug ces dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ 'di dus 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku byin can zhig dbu sngas su bzhugs su gsol nas gso la 'debs rgyun ldan mdzad pas/ nub cig mnal lam du/ rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sku drung du phebs pas/ khong gi phyag tu dbu snas kyi li sku de dang cha 'dra ba'i 'jam 'byangs kyi sku brnyan/ bzhugs khri zur drug pa'i zur re re'i steng du gser gyi pad sdong ngo mtshar ba re re yod pa zhig ba snamyo/sa nas/ bla ma mchog la 'di 'jam dbyangs dngos yin pas gzigs shig gsungs pa bzhin gzigs pa na/ sku brnyan de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing / khri'i zur gyi pad+ma rnams kha 'byed 'dzum byed pa zhig 'dug de nas dpon slob gnyis ka sbra gur zhig gi nang du phebs nas/rje ngag rgyam pas mgon po phyag drug pa dang / seng gdong ma'i thang sku gnyis so so nas ngo sprod lta bu gnang / 'jam dbyangs kyi lder sku khru gang ba zhig gi steng du bla ma'i sku brnyan chung ngu zhig 'dug pa'i bar du/ tshe bsod zhes pa'i yi ge tshar gsum yod pa zhig ston ba gnang ste 'bel gtam mang bo mdzad pa rmis pa'i 'phro la mnal sad pas thugs ngo mtshar bar gyur nas/ sgar yang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la gsol ba shugs drag

da wa104 gagidalugs/lathos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshulanatu 'debs bzhin mnal du so nga ba'i rmi lam du/ rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho phebar+sā nas zhal byang phyogs su gzigs te/ bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa'i mdun du rje bla ma nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ rje ngag rgyam pa'i zhal nas/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba togs pa la bla ma dang yi dmyo/ dbyer med du mos nas gsol ba gdab dgos/ khyed rang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs spyi bor sgoms la rgyun du gsol ba thob cig gsungs nas/ rje bla ma nyid kyi dbu la phyag gis yug yug mang du mdzad pa rmis pa'i mod la mnal sad/ thugs rmis de rnarma sa phyi nyin rang la phyag ris su ba tob ste rje ngadzig/ dbang chos kyi rgya mtshor phul nas/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi nang tshan 'jam dbyang sa gsang skrukrā kyi rjes gnang phral du bka' drin bskyang dgoṭaṭaṃ tshul zhu ba gnang bar/ thugs dgyes pa chen pos rjes gnang kyang stsol ba mdzad 'dug thugs rmis par ma de seng gdong ma'i sgo nas phyir bzlog yang yang gnang dgos pa dang / mgon po srung ma'i gtso bor mdzad na7 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i dbu blar gyur nas/ sku tshe dang bsod nams gong 'phel yong ba'i phyis 'byung gi brda' mtshon du mngon zhing / snga phyi gnyis ni 'og tu 'byung ba bzhin bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ste/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i ltas su gor ma chags so/ /gong gi mnal lam de dag ni phyag bris kyi shog dril ngo ma mthong ba ltar bris pa yin no/ /de nas ring bo ma losgru/ pa ma/ nub cig mnal lam du/ a mdo bla rgan yin zer ba'i a tsa ra zhig rje nyid kyi gzims phugs su khri zhig gi khar — —

gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 1khye5'khod nas pi waṃ zhig brdung gi 'dug pa gsan pas/ de'i sgra las rten 'brel bstod pa'i tshigs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar thon pa zhig rmis/de nas zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin par snang / 'di ni rje bla ma dkon mchog mtshan can la zhal nas dngos su gsungs 'dug cing / rje de nyid kyis gsung chos 'ga' zhig gi skabs su lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas dbu ma'i lta ba thog mar rnyed pa dgung lo bcu gsum dus yin pa 'dug de dus mnal ltas kyang gong gi de 'dra byung ba snang zhes gsungs shing bsngags brjod mjod pa thos so/ /'di ni mgon po klu sgrub dang rje bla ma ngo bo gcig pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis pi waṃ gi dpes nges don zab mo 'doms par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa'o stson pa rmi lam grong khyer na/ /sdon pa smra ba'i slob dpon gyis/ /rdzun pa las kyad rdzun pa'i glus/ /rdzun pa'i chos kyi dwon/ bstarne pas/sgormi rgyu med pagle— don bsgom pas/ /grozlo rgyu med pa'i rmephrang grol nas/thobye rgyu melda pa'i 'bras hūṃb pa'i/ /lha rgyuX med shā'i lha ba rnyed/ ༷/bden pa rātsal rmis rdzun pa mthorji / /rdzun r+sha mthong bas shāden pa rnyed/ /bden rdzun mnyam nyid gzigs mo la/ /mnyam rjes med par yengs 'di rmad/ /'di dus yin nam dbu ma la sprujug pa'i rnam bshad sems bskyed dang bo yan chad zhig ljags rtsom mdzad 'dug pa lung rigs kyi mthar chod cing blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la go ba bde blag tu ster bar byed pa'i legs bshad kyi gter che na por 'dug go /gzhan yang mdo kun

ṭ+wāṃ06 bzhung luglusalasprasabasamadang gdams pa gsan tshul/ — las btus dang / rigs tshokas lhag ma lnga/ bstod tshogs/ bzhi brgya ba rtsa 'grel/ spyod 'jug rtsa 'grel/ bslab pa kun las btusdu/ dbu ma rgyan dang / dbu ma snang ba/ sgom rirma gsum sogs klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung gang yod thams cad la thos bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ zhal nas/ rtsa 'jug gi don la go ba dpyis phyin pa rnyed phyin/ gzhan rnams phal cher de'i yan lag lta bur snang bas ngal ba de tsam mi dgos pa 'dug ces gsungs/ 'di dus drangs nges rnam 'byed legs bshad snying bo tshang ma thugs la bzung zhing dka' ba'i gnas la mkhas pa rnams dang 'bel gtam mang du mdzad pas dbu sems kyi mkhas pa so so'i rigs pa'i 'gros phra zhing phra ba rnams ma 'dres par thugs su chud/ zhal nas/ legs bshad snying bo'i dka' 'grel thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis mdzad pa gnyis kyang shin tu legs trepa snang mod/ da dung yang dka' ba'i gnad dpyis phyin padz+wa rngoshad dgos pa 'ga' zhig yod 'dug pas/ dka' 'grel zhig rtsorna 'du durdu/ gyis legs bshad snying bo'i gzhunge litshig 'ga' zhig la mchan bu btab pa yin kyang skabs zhig nas shog dril rnams bor nas ma rnyed pa la/ dus phyis gzhan zhig gi ngag rtsom gras su bcug 'dug ces gsungs nas bzhad mo mdzad/dbu ma'i skor la thugs gnyer gnang skabs 'dir ha cang thugs brtson che bas mtshan mo yang zhal 'don skabs ma gtogs phal cher dpe gzigs kho na mdzad/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu gcig pur bzhugs dus bzhad mo yun ring gnang bar/ phyag g.yog pa tshos ha cang dpe gzigs la sgrim drags

shazhung lugasal thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 10 ṅgā pas thugs rlung gi na⑫ pa yin 'dra bas cung zad glod tsam mdzad na legs sam zhus par/ de 'dra ma yin rgya gar kha spu can gyi rigs pa 'ga' zhig la ya mtshan skyes nas gad yi+o/ ri+ogor ba yin/ khyed tsho sems mi bde ba mi dgos gsungs/ rten 'brel ngastod pa yang yang zhal 'don mdzad cing dgos pa khyad par can zhig la dgongs nas/ thub pa'i dbang bo dang klu sgrub yab sras/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa rnams kyi sku brnyan re yang bzhengs pa mdzad/'di dag ni rje bla mas/ de tshe ring nas nyams pa'i rtogs dka'i gnas/ /gang gis btsal nas rnyed pa'i rigs pa'i lam/ /'di yi rnad+dha/ 'phrul ci lta bu zhig ces/ /gcig pur gnas kyang dga' ba'i ca co 'chor/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / res 'ga' rgyal la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang / / skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran/ /gzhan tshe dge ba'i bshes la gus pa dang / /mar gyur 'gro la snying nas brtse ba rnams/ /'di dag phan tshun 'gran pa gāzhin du 'phel/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar thugs rgyud la chos kyi ro'i dga' ba lhag par 'phel zhing / bcom ldan 'das la tshad mas drangs pa'i dad pa dang / shing rta chen po rnams kyi sku drin dran pa dang / sems can la bcos min gyi snying rje rnams 'gran pa bzhin 'phel ba shin tu ya mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pa'o//thub dbang gangs kyi ri bo las 'ongs pa'i/ /stong nyid zab mo'i gtam gyi nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /klu sgrub yab sras thugs mtshor bzung ba gang / / khyod kyi rnam dpyod zhal du rdzogs par gsol/ /mtha' brgyad lta ba ngan pa'i rang rong brag /rigs tshul rdo rjes phye mar bsnyil byas te/ /

108 gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/snang stong zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam yangs por/ /rten 'brel sgyu ma'i rol gar cir yang bsgyur/ /de tshe chu gter chen po'i klong / /shugs drag 'bab chus gang ba bzhin/ /gang gi thugs ni spro dga' yi/ rlabs phreng mchog tu g.yo bar gyur/ /rang bzhin med la bya byed bcing grol kun/ /btags tsam 'thad pa dbu ma'i gsang tshig ni/ /rigs smra phal cher ne tso ltar 'don kyang / ji bzhin gzigs shing gsung ba khyod nyid tsam/ /deng dus 'thad dang mi 'thad sgrub pa dag /phal cher 'gro ba bzhi yi dbang gis te/ /khyod ni rton pa bzhi yis drang nges don/ /phye ste nges pa'i don la 'jug par mdzad/ /e ma klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa'i mthil/ /blo bzang rgyal bas gsal bar phye ba'i srol/ /khyod 'ba' zhig gi drin las dus 'dir yang / /skal bzang 'ga' la bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyur/ /slob dpon phyogs glang yab sras kyi gzhung la thos bsam mdzad tshul yang /'dun legs chi la sa/ khyad par tshu rol mthong bas dngos sngo yi/ /de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgo gcig bu/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnas la/ /'bad pa du mas yang dang yang du sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdzad de/ dpal chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba dang rgyal tshab rje'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed tshang ma thugs 'dzin gnang zhing / lha shāka rgyan gsum gyi rnam 'grel gyi 'grel ba dang /bod kyi sa skya'i mkhas pa rnams kyis/ mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel skor mang bo dang / lhag par rigs mdzod la rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang gzigs nas thugs 'phrog tshul rnam thar du gsungs pa sa/ rigs mdzod kyi di pe

gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdamaṭa/ pa kas/na tshul/ 109rtsol bas 'tshol ba gnang ste gzigs rtog zhib tu mdzad/ rnam nges dang rigs thigs dar ṭika gnyis dang / mkhas grub rje'i ṭika chen dang / sde bdun rgyan/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi rigs rgyan sogs rang phyogs kyi yig cha gang yod rnam sa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab kyis rtog dpyod yang dag pa mdzad/ rnam 'grel smon ṭika de dus zhib tu bltas pas sems la phan pa zhig byung zhes phyis su gsungs pa thos/ deng sang tshad ma'i gzhung gi bsdus tshan zur bkol kha shas re la rtags gsal byang bas rnam 'grel shes par rlom pa rnams dang mi 'dra bar rnam 'grel lerinā gnyis pa'i skabs su lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag gtan la phab pa dang / de nyid le'u dang por rigs pa yadzin—dag gis ji lta ra sgrub pa'i tshul dang / le'u gsum par chos kyi bdag med rgyas par gtan la phab pa dang / le'u bzhi par sngar le'u gnyis pa dang gsum par theg pa che chung gi lam gtan la phabe pa rnams rang gis ji ltar rtogs pa bzhin du don de nyid gzhan la bstan nas rjes/ su 'dzin pa'i tshul dang bcas bshad pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin thugs la chud pas dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung 'di nyid thar 'dod rnams kyi mis/ gcig pu lta bur nges pa gting tshugs pa rnyed par gyur to/ / rigs pa'i dbang phyug zhal sgo las skyugs pa'i/ /rnam dag rigs tshul lam gsulho / 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /tshig don brgyad kyi yan lag yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyod thugs gser ldan lto bar rdzogs par 'khyil/ /rtog ge'i chang gis ches cher myos pa yi/ /rnam dpyod gnyis 'thung sna yi 'khri

110 gzhung lugs la thosab—mdang gdams pa napo~Xl/shing rtser/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin 'khor lo g.yo ba des/ /smra ba ngan pa'i dpung tshogs phye mar brlag /tshul gsum rtagatra/ kyi sprin phung las babs pa'i/ /dngos stobs rigasacipa'i thog gis sgro skur brag bshig dang lhan cig rigs lam gru char gyis/ /thar 'dod zhing ba'i tshogs la dga' ston bskrun/ /mchog gnyis su grags pa yon shāka gnyis kyi gzhung la thos bsam mdzad tshul ni/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba tshang ma thugs 'dzin mdzad/ de'i rgya cher 'grel ba chos bshes kyis mdzad pa/ shākya 'od kyi sum brgya ba dang 'od ldan bcas rgya gzhung rnams dang / bod 'grel thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi gleng 'bum dang / 'dul ṭika rin chen 'phreng ba/ 'dul 'dzin gyi bslab bya chen mo/ grwa tshang so so'i 'dul ba'i yig cha gang yod zhib gzigs dang / khyad par du kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba'i 'dul ṭika nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi chig don mtha' dag thugs su chud pa mdzad/ zhal nas/ mtsho 'dul 'di bshad yam tsam ma yin par 'dul ba lam rim gyi nyams len dang sbyar nas bshad 'dug pas/ 'dul ba rtsod par 'khyer ba tsho'i thugs la 'bab min ji ltar yang / lag len du btab nas sems 'dul ba'i thabs su byed mkhan la shin tu phan pa zhig 'dug ces gsungs/ 'dul ba'i skor la phyis su dgung lo mthon por phebs nas kyang gzib/sa rtog rgyun du mdzad cing /'dul gzhung cha tshang la sdum bde ba zhig rgyun du lta rtog byemisdo par mkho ba 'dug gsungs nas snar thang ba nam mkha' shes rab kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul pa'i bstan chos nor bu'i 'phreng ba dge slong ge mya na zhes pa de gzigs dpe

— gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 111ched gnyer du bris te gang phebs su 'bral spangs lta bu mdzad/ yon tan thamyori sa cad kyi gzhi ma sa ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nang mdzod chos 'dul ba la nan tan de lta bu mdzad pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa mchog tu shes par bya'o/ /dgag sgrub gnang gsum rlabs phreng rol pa can/ /'dul lung 'bum sde'i chu gter chen po der/ /bshad sgrub ka/ge — gyi gru yis legs zhugs nas/ rnam grol nor bu ded dpon khyod kyis blangs/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod dam chos 'dul ba nyid/ /gces par dgongs te de yi glegs bam kyang / /chos gos bzhin du 'bral spangs mdzad pa 'di/bstan pa thugs la brnag pa'i rnam thar te/ /rang nyid thub pa'i rjes su zhugs rlom nas/ /de yi bcas pa 'bad pas khyad gsod cing / /gzhan dag tshul der nan gyis sbyong byed pa/ /de dag bder gshegs bstan pa'i chom rkun no/ /kwa ye rang la snying brtse ldan pa dag /bdud kyi dbang gyur log pa'i bshes gnyen gyi/ ngan spyod tha chad rjes su ma 'brangs par/ /dam pa'i rnam thar ji bzhin bslab par 'tshal//de ltar rgyan drug mchog gnyis rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gzhung rnams la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res tshim par ma byas par kun la zhib tu sbyangs pa rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i rnam par thar pa phyag len du thebs pa 'di lta bu bdag cag gi dāpal ldan bla ma 'di nyid tsam ma gtogs/ dus phyis kyi 'gro 'dren du khas 'che ba— rnams dang / thos pa rgya chen po byas par rlom pa rnamasdo/ kyi /krod du re re tsam yang mi snang bas/ tshul 'di ni gzhan gyis bsgruhrū/ du med pa'i rna myosu thar du blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis shes par

112 sa zhungalugaṭa lah+phasabasamadad—sridamasapa gsan tshul/byos shig gzhung chen mo de dag gi khrod nas kyang dbu maldi skor la 'bur du dod pa'i thugs gnyer nan tan mdzad cing / de skor mya 'bel gtam la ya ru+o thugari smo thi/na tu dgyes pa zhis/ yod de/ 'di yang rje bla mas/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur 'di rnams kyi/ /legs bshad kun la snying nas gus mod kyang / /'khor 'das rten 'byung mi bslu'i gtan tshigs kyiru// /mthar 'dzin dmigs gtad thams cad 'jig byed pa/ /zla ba 'a sa 'ongs legs bshad 'od dkar gyis/ /blo mig kun+da'i tshal rab phye ba'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis bstan pa'i lam mthong nas/ /klu sgrub lu sas/ bzang gtso bor mi 'dzin su/ /zhes dang / rten 'brel bstod pa las/ khyod kyis bla med theg pa'i tshul/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /ji bzhin 'gre la bar lung bsta na pa/ /klu sgrub gzhung lugs kun+dari tshalnga/ /dri med 'byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /gsung rab r+bharikha' la thogs med rgyu/ /mthar 'dzin snying gi mun pa sel log smra'i rgyu+o skar zil gnon pa/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i legs bshad kyi/ /'od dkar 'phreng bas gsal byas pa/ /bla ma'i drin gyis mthong ba'i tshe/ /bdag gi yid kyi ngal bso thob/ /ces gsungs pa dang tshul mthun pa'o/ /rnam 'grel la yang thugs lhag par mos pa zhig yod pas/ dge bshes bzang po'i rigs dang chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad skabs/ rnam 'grel gyi do 0/sa dpyod mang du 'ong ba zhig yod cing / po ti gzhan rnams se 'bras dge sa/sum gyi chos grwa'i drin gyis dga' mo 'dug kyang / rnam 'grel gyi da ka/ ri si 'i gnas rnams la deng sang lab gler tsam byed mkhan

da wagazhungalugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gas na tshul/ 113yang dkon pa 'dug ces thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa yang yang mdzad/ 'di yang rje bla ma'i rnatsāri thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ rna ma 'grel gyi rnam bshad rigs mdzod la gzigs rtog mdzad cing / le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi lam gyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i skabs la legs par gzigs pas4 rkyen byas nas/chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs dang rigs pa'i srol la dpag tu med pa'i dad pa shugs drag po mnan pas mi non pa 'khrungs shing / ston der bzhugs kyi ring la rnam 'grel gyi gzhung la gzigs tsam nas dad pa'i spu long g.yos te spyan chab kyi rgyun bcad par mi nus pa rtag tu 'ong ba zhig byung gsung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid do/ /chos gsung ba'i tshe yang rnam 'grel gyi rigs pas sgrub tshul rtsal 'don gyis gsung ba zhig yod cing / dus phyis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mnal 'a ma du rnam 'grel lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i legs bshad kyi skyes kyang stsol bar mdzad snang ste 'og tsu 'god par bya'o/ /dbu tshad kyi gzhung gi yang dag pa'i rigs lam la thugs gtsigs che bar mdzad pa 'di ni shin tu gnad che bar mthong ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen pos/ smra ba'i khyu mchog 'phags pa yab sras dang / /log smra tshar gcod phyogs glang grags pa las/ /legs par 'ongs pa'i rigs lam bdud rtsi'i chus/ /blo mig dri ma yang yang ma bkrus na/ /shin tu zab gnas mthong ba smos ci dgos/ /rags pa'i lungo don la yang dpyad pa na/ /dzi la cher log par rtog pa 'phel 'gyur zhing / /gal te yang dag dam bca' tsam zhig gi /nges pa rnyed kyang sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi / /

114 gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan ṭaḥpa/tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom ma chod phyir/ /'dam la btab pa'i phur ba bzhin 'gyur bas/ /yang dag bag chags brtan pa 'jog mi nus/ /zhes dang / de phyir blo gros phra zhing mdzangs pa dang / /ku sha'i rtse ltar ma gyur de srid du/ /ngoms mi sla bar rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /mkhas pa'i bshes la ba.ā+oṃn te legs par sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gzhung chen mo rnams la thugs sbyangs mdzad pa yang ji skad du/ rig pa dpe cha las bslabs shing / /bla ma'i drung nas ma yin pa/ /'phyon ma'i dud med sbrum ma bzhin/ /tshogs kyi nang na mju+os ma yin/ /zhes pa'i dpe lta bu ma yin par/ deng sang po ti chen po rnams kyi gzhung bshad kyi rgyun phal cher nub 'dug na'ang / /gang yod rnams bshes gnyen mkhas pa rnams las snga phyi ci rigs su zhib tu gsan cing bshad rgyun med pa rnams la klag lung gi rgyun yan chad gsan par mdzad snang ste zhib par so so'i thad kar 'bri bar bya'o/ /gang yang 'di na gzhung tshig khol byung tsam 'ga' kha ton byang ba nyid la sde snod 'dzin par smra/ /nyung ngu'i thal phreng bzlas brjod lhur len gzhan smod tshig gi dug mda' 'phen la smra ba'i seng ger sgrogs/ /thos pa'i snang ba dang bral blun sgom mun pa' mal du gyi nar nyal la grub pa'i dbang bo zer/ mi shes gdol ba'i phru gu dar zab kyis dkris mthon po'i stegs la 'khod nas 'gro ba 'dren par rlom/ /snyiswās ma'i ngang tshul 'phyon ma'i gar 'di la/ /snyiswās ma'i skye bo blun po mgu srid kyang / /daspra pa rnams kyi las su bya ba ni/ /dam pa'i chos la chos bzhin spyod pa ṣ+pen// de ni thos bsam sgom pa'i lam zhugarmo

gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang ba/dmas pa gsan tshul/ sprakru5 wanas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i grong du bgrod pa ste/ /de bas ༷dang por thos pa 'tshol bya zhes / /twe ltar dgongs nas ded dari+o na mkhas pa 'di/ /thos bsam gru chen zhon nas nyin bzhin du/ /gzhu nga lugs rgya mtsho'i khyon kun nyul ba las/ /rnyed par dkak+ṣ-ir zhing rnyed na don che ba'i/ /zab don nor bu grangs med 'dod rgur blangs/ /de tshe bden gnyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgya che zhes grag/'a kyang / /'di yi ma/khyen rab zab yangs rgya ma tsho yis/ /gzhal byaska gnas kun rmika/ rjes chu bzhin byas/ /tshul de ma bzod gshung bzang chu po sto nga / /rang rang brjod don lhung lhung sgrogs bzhin du/ /nyin bzhin gang thugs chu gter la zhugs kyang / dogs pa med par bzung bas skyengs par gyur/ /'di na mkhas par grags pa phal mo ches/ /'bad kyang blo yi spyod yu la ma gyur pa/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i legs bshad dka' gnad kun/ /'di yis lag pa'i mthil gyi rdzas bzhin gzigs/ /phyogs glang chos kyi grags pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /yang dag rigs tshul glog gi dra ba yang / /'di yi yid 'ong zhal gyi chu 'dzin dbus/ /nyams 'gyur stong phrag 'khyugs pa'i gar gyis rtsen/ /mes po'i rna ba brgyad kyis ma thos pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad ma lus 'di yis gsan/ /dbang po'i 'dren byed stong gis ma mthong ba'i/ /zab don dka' gnad ma lus 'di yis gzigs/ /'di ltari yo na tan lcags kyu yis/ /bdag yid gnyise (rathung drangs gyur te/ /che na po ga(nan gyi spyod tshul la/ /gus pa sa/ting nas lhod par gaur/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gcig char 'gangs pa yi/ /mkhyen

da waḥ gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/bzang nyi ma stong phrag 'bar ba'i gzis/ /lkog gyur thun gsum ming gi mthar bskrad pa'i/ /ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol bar phyag bgyi'o// ——de ltar bapo/ ne pod chen po rnams la thos bsam gtso bor mdzad pa'i bar skabs rnams su dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsum la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs yang mang du gsan phar mdzad de/ de yang thog mar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sogs lha/ga pa'i lha du ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po la mnga' brnyes pa rje thu'u bkwan pa ngag dbang chos gyi rgya mtsho'i drung nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum 'dres kyi gdams pas —brgyan pa'i smin byed kyi rim pa rgyas par gsan/ sku che 'di la dbang che na gsan pa'i thog ma 'di yin 'dug pas/ dus phyiṭashrī phran la khyed rang gi skye ba gong ma de nyid ngos cag gas/nga sngagre/sa kyi sgor thog mar 'jus/ mkhan gyi rdo me+e+o slob dpon yin pas bka' drin tri/ na tu che zhes 4ri nga (trī nga gsung /rje thu'u bkwan rin po ches snga mo lcang skya gong ma rje ngarga/ dbang blo/ bzang chos ldan pa'i drung nas 'jigs byed kyi dbang gsan pa'i nub mo rmi ra ma du/gzhal yas khang rngam brjid che ba zhig gi dbus na/ za 'o spre / gi 'bol mang bo brtsegs0 pa'i khri mthon po zhig i/ khar rdo rje 'chang lcang skya ba ba zhugs pa'i phyogasadzegacig tu de 'dra'i khri ga'/na zhig 'dug pa la trar nga nyid bkod nas / bla myo(sa gri gurga/ dar tsho sna | sna lngar mtshan pa li/ga ba/ta da de / 'di re zhig khyed rang gis tshapog/sa gye/sa/ slar ya nga nged la 'phrod pa phyed dgos so

gizhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 111zhes gsungs pa zhig rmis pa da res sprul sku rin po cher rno rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang 'bul dgos pa tsho'adi yin pa 'dug ces gsung / dbang gi mjug tu dpon slob thun mong nas tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig mdzad par/tshogs rdzas pyi nang mchod khol zhing 'phyur ba dang / ga nas 'ongs cha med pa'i shing thog a ru ra'i dbyibs can dri ngad phun sum tshogs shing ro cung zad skyur ba sngar ye mthong sta myong ba 'ga' zhig tshosas rdzas kyi gseb tu byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung / rje bla ma mchog nas dbang thob pa nas bzung dam tshig dang sdom pa gces spras su byed dgos pas sngags byang sems kyi rtsa ltung dang sbom po ngos 'dzin gyi bshad pa zhig 'bul gsungs nas 'brong rtse lha btsun rin chen rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bslab bya gnyis kyi steng nas gsung bshad rgyas pa dang / thun drug gi rnal 'byor gyi khrid bcas gnang nas phyag len la 'debs dgos tshul nan tan du 'doms par mdzad/ zhal nas/ de dus nged ne shin tu phra bas zhib par ma nges kyang gsung bshad rags pa tsam blor nges par bgyis te/ rtsa ltung gis ma gos pa la 'bad pa'i lus/sa su bgyis pa yin zhes dbang chen 'ga' zhig gnang ba'i dus su gsung ba kho bos dngos su thos/ rgyud sde'i gnad mkhyen pa nāms kyis brtag na tshul 'di ni bla slob gunyis ka'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin pa 'dug go/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /spro dang sdud pa'i bdag nyid slob dpon mcho ga /dkyil 'a/spredzar gco bor bzhengs te mgon khyod 'a// /shis brjod rin chen bum pa sa dbang bskur tshe// /sa bcu'i ba

/de moskye gzhurnga lugs la dzis bsam dang gdaskes pa gsano tshul/ dzogam mthon po la 'dzegs pa'i/ /chos kyi sprin chen rgyal sras dpa' bo la/ /mkha' khyab zhing gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho yis/ /'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur gnyis pa bzhin/ /snod bcud dag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /longs spyod gsu ma ldan tshogs kyi dga' ston la/ /phyi nang lha tshogs tshim pa drug ldan du/ /rol pas o ṭi ya na'i khengs pa 'phrog /de tshe rje ki rnams kyi/sa tshogs rdzas su/ /bshams pa'i ngo mtshar 'chi med ljon 'bras la/ /kha dog ro nus 'gran 'dod ma da na/ /bde skyong snod du long long khol zhing 'phyur/ /deng dus bla chen rnams kyis dbang sna tshogs/ /bcos ma'i me tog bzhin du khrom dbus su/ /zong du 'grem yang dam snom bsrung ba nyid/ /gces par 'doms dang de bzhin sgrub pa su/ /kye ma gsang sngags bon ltar gyer ba yi/ /dus ngan 'dam rdzab mnam pa'i khrod 'dir yang / /chos bzhin spyod pa'i bsung zhim cher 'thul ba'i/ /yab sras pad dkar zung cig 'khrungs 'di mtshar/ /dbang khrid de dag gi skabs su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi che ba mang du gsungs pas sprul sku rin po che thugs 'phrog pa lta bur gyur te/ rim gnyi sa kyi khrid dang zhi khro sbrag sgrub kyi khrid bcas gnang dgos tshul zhus paracho rje bla ma thugs dgyes pa'i sgo nas re zhig lam rim gyi khrid dmigs mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'bul gsungs nas thog mar thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i khrid mardor bsdus dang / de nas bskyed rim gyi nyams khrid chos thun lnga tsam dang / rdzogs rim lcang skya gong ma'i gsung 'burma du bzhugs pa'i shin tu mdor pa sdu sa pa de'e steng nas chos thun ga/cig tsam dang / do sde tshig

gizhung lugs la thos bsam datha gdams pa gsad tshul/ 119sbram gyi steng nas zhi khrocosbrag sgrub thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor cha tshang gi khrid bcas 'bul bar mdzed cing / sprul sku rin po che 'di ba sku na phra mo 'di 'dra nas chos kyi srog rtsa nas 'dzin pa zhig 'dug gsungs bsngags brjod chen po mdzad/ snga phyi ma nges kyang rje bla ma 'di nyid las chos bka' gsan pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i ji/sung 'bum phal cher gyi klag lung dang chos tshan 'ga' zhig la mdzub khrid tshul gyis gnad che sar bshad pa'ang gnang / bla ma mchod pa'i khrid/dbu ma'i lta khrid gyi gzab bshad rgyas pa/ spyod 'jug chen mo/ stong nyid bdun cu ba/ mdo sde rgyan gsum la mdzub khrid kyi bshad pa rgyas pa/'jam da byangs chos skor gyi lha rnams dang / phyag rdor gtum khyung / rdor sems/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ rnam rgyal ma/ bde mchog dkar po sogs lha cha/nga po'i rjes gnang gi rim pa dang / jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum bka' rgya ma dang bcas pa/ rigs tshogs/ byams chos/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung / rgyal ba dge rnadun rgya mtsho/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen po/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs dam pa mang po'i gsung thor bu sna tshogs kyi klag lung bcas gsan/ 'di rnams zhal nas dngos su thos pa rnams bkod pa yin gyi/da dung yang chos bka' rnam grangs mang tsam gsan yod 'dug na'ang gsan yig sogs ma /mthong bas 'bri bar ma spobs so/ /mdor na dgung lo bco brgyad kyi bar lhan tu bzhugs nas chori / bka' ci rigs gsan pa dang / dka' ga nas kyi she+ornga /sa gcod 'bel gta5 / mdzad pa sogs chos

120 gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/phyogs dang / 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag che phra gang yod la bka' gros zhu ba sogs lugs gnyis ka'i sgo nas 'brel ba mchog tu che zhing phan tshu na thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi dag snang 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa sa yi mthar/ /'dzin cing spel la smon pa'i mthu grub pa'i/ /dam pa gang dang thugs kyi mdza' ba ni/ /mkha' la mkha' dang chu la chu bzhin 'dres/ /phan tshun sku tshe du mar 'brel ba yi/ /mdza' rga/cugs 'dir yang ngoms par mdzad nga k+ṣ-iradi/ /lhan cig mi gre/nas 'ag la gyi bla chen rnams/ /bya 'ug brtul zhugs 'dzin la 'phya ba bzhin/ /'di dus sprul sku rin po che nas/ rje thu'u bkwan pa rang nyid kyi dngos nyams ci rigs par lhar+ṣa / pa'i lha'i zhal ba/zigs pa so gas kyi rnam thar thun mong ma yin pa rnams shin tu rtogs dka' ba'i brda' tshig gis bcings pa nig yod pa la bda' bkrol ba'i gsung bshad zhig gnang dgos tshul zhus par gzhan la mi gsung ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad na snyan du 'bul zhes gsungs par/ sprul sku rin po che nas de bzhin bgyid pas cis kyang sa/sung 'tshal zhes nan tan mdzad pas brda' tshig ma'i steng nas zhib tu gsung ba gnang 'dug dus phyis nged nas lcang skya thams cad mkhyen nga ra rnam thar de mchan gyis bkrol ba zhig gnang dgos tshul 'phrin yig gi lam nas zhus par/ gzhan la mi smra rgyu byas yod na'ang / khyed rang bla ma de'i yang srid yin gshis smras par nyes pa med 'gro gsungs nasi zhib mchan shog dril mdzad de/ gnang ba kho bos bgyis pa'i rnam thar dpag bar+sā ma ljo na bzang du ngakaud pa bzhin mi phyo/ no/ /dus phyis su lcang skya rdo rje

da wa — gzhungalugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 121'chang gi zhal nas/ rje thu'u bkwan pa de sku yon sbed pa'i tshul gnang yang dka' gnas kyi dogs pa zhus na/ gzhan las khyad par du thon pa'i gsung bshad mdzad pa zhig yod/ rigs tshogs/ bslab spyod/ byams chos la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin zhes pa sngags brjod mdzad pa kho bos thos so/ /dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas kyi drung nas/ la ma rim chen mo'i steng nas mdzub khrid tshul gyis bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / lam rim chur ngu/lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gnyis kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas/ rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa'i yig cha rnams kyi steng nas lam rim phyag chen/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs/ gtum mo'i khrid/'pho khrid/ snying bo don gsum rnams dmar khrid man ngag zhal shes dang bcas pa/ tshe khrid 'chi med dga' ston dang 'ba' ra ba'i che khrid kyi yig cha gnyis kyi steng nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe khrid zhal shes snyan brgyud dang bcas pa/ rje bla ma nas nye bar brgyud pa'i tshe khrid thun mong ma yin pa/bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog ci i pa dang / dril bu lha lnga gnyis kyi dbang / lhag pa'i lha du ma'i rjes ga nang / rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams spusan/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po a rtse chos rje blo bzang chos 'dzin pa'i drung nas/ grub chen dril bu zhabs hūṃgs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa rje gong ma de nyid kyi phyag bzhes man ngag gis brgyan te smin rgyas su gsan/ rje gong ma nas brgyud pa'i bde gsang tsā 'jigs gsum gyi rim gnyis kyi zab khrid gsung sgros zhal la/ dmas dang

12 2 gzhung lugs pa thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/bcas lan mang du gsan cing / khyad par du bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid zhal shes dang sngucas pa 'a na du ma'i bar du gsan pa yin gsungs/ rje gong ma'i gsung zhibum du bzhugs pa'i lam khrid mdor bsdus kyi steng nas dben sa snyan brgyud lugs kyi lam rim dmar khrid thun mong ma yin pa dang / grub chen tshem bu lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid yan lag dang bcas pa gsan par mdzad/ rje blo bzang chos 'dzin pa de nyid tshem bu dmar khrid kyi sgo nas ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis lhag song zhing / gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / khyad par du dril bu lus dkyil la thugs dam gtso bor mdzad pas zhing brje skabs dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su gdan 'dren pa'i rtags mtshan khyad par can mang du byung ba dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs par snang zhes rje bla ma nyid nas lha sa bsam 'grub khang gsar du bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi bka' khrid gnang skabs bdag cag la dngos su gsungs/ bla ma dam pa de rnams las bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sgrol ma nyer gcig smanā bla bder gshegs brgyad/ sme brtsegs/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin gsangaji sgrub/ khyung khra/ khyung nag dzam dkar so/gas lhag pa'i lha du ma'i rjes gnang / dril bu skor gsum gyi rgya gzhung gis mtshon pa'i klag lung gi skor kyang mang bo zhig gsan/ par snang ngo / /skabs 'di dag

blo wa gzhungalugs la thos bsam dang gdams pa gsan tshul/ 123da nga / phyis su yang bla ma dam pa mang po zhig las chos bka' ci rigs gsan pa rnamaṭashaṃ kyi skabs su bla ma rnams la bzhugs khri mthon po bshams pa da nga / rje rang nyid kyis phyag dang sngon du ldang ba sogs bsnyen bkur ba dang / dad cing gus pa'i tshul gyis chos 'chad pa la thugs dang snyan gtod pa sogs tshul da ngasku zhu ri thun pa kho nas gsan par mdzad/ deng sang gdan sa mtho ba dang / 'gro 'dren sprul skur khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig gis chos rgyun len pa yin zer nas rang nyid khri stan mthon por 'gying bag dang bcas pas 'khod nas/ len yul mdun du stan dma' bar bzhag pa la rje boru/ bran las dpya len pa'i tshul gyis mnyan pa dang / yang la las chos mnyan pa'i dus su phyag gsum tsam btsal ba las skabs gzhan du bla ma mthong tshe ldang ba tsam yang mi byed par/ yul de la chos nyan pa gzhan gyis shes na mtshang che ba lta bus gsang ci thub byed pa sogs bla ma'i dam tshig mtha' dag khyad du bsad nas thob lo dang nyan lo'i grangs bsags pa tsam don du gnyer ba dang / gzhan la chos rgyun spel khul byed pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang dam tshig dang sdom pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang grangs bsnyen sogs kyi rnam bzhag ci yang med par dkyile 'khor dang dbang rdzas rnams 'dzom zhing cho ga dpe thog nas klag thub phyin phyogs thams cad du tshong zong 'grim pa bzhin du dbang dang rjes gnang lung sogs ster yul 'bad pas btsal te nor dang brje tshong byed pa dag snang ste/ 'chad nyan gyi gzugs brnyan de lta bu ni rgyal bstan dri mas sbags par byed pa'i bdud kyi las su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dgung lo brgyad pa nas bco brgyud kyi

124 gzhung lugs la thos bsam dngagadamasapa gsanatshul/ — ༄bar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam gsum tshul bzhin du bsten nas sa/tso bor mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / gas nga sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi lam gyi rim pa yang rgya che ba zhig gsan par rna ngad mod/ 'on kyang gsang sngags skor la phyis su rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / khri chen rdo rje 'chang gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs nas rgyud kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi zab gnad mthar thug pa la sgro 'dosas chod pa'i jis pa rnyed cing / de la brten nas mdo sdabakyi/sa kyi gnad mtha' dag la dpyad pa methar phyin pa yin/ pas de'i tshul ni 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /tshul 'di ni rje btsun bla ma nyid kyi gsung gis shes par snang ste/ grub mtha'i rnam bzhag thub bstan lhum po'i mdzis rgyan las/ dang por sems dpa' chen po rje btsun chos rgya mtsho ba dang sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas pa dang rje grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dul 'dzin blo bzang chos/ 'dzin pa sogs kyi bka' drin 'a sa mdo sngags kyi gsung rab du ma la dpyod pa'i sgo mang du rnyed cing / phyis su chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyal srid la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal ba'i dbang bo thams ca da mkhyen pa blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas las dam pa'i choṭashrī kyi bdud rtsire bgo skal blangs pa dang / gzhan yang bshes gnyen dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul snyospyi bo ṭ+wāṃru / blangs /shing mkhas pa rnams dang dka(ra ba'i gnas ‘ra 'a be+ek+ṣ-ir ba'i gtam kyang mang du bgyis pa dang / khyad par du rje rgyal ba gnyiṭa/ pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa pyi nang gi rtetwo/ 'brel rnams chu'e zla ba ltar

gezhung lugs la thos bsam dang gasdoms ba skesan tshul/ 125gzigaru/ shing byang chub kyi/ thugs lhag par 'byongs pa rim r+yānanyis kyi ting 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun dam pa khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i zhal snga nas las dpal mnyam med ri bo dge lugs pa'i 4 /do sngags kyi rdzobashad srol du ma dang khrid chen brgyad sogs legs par thob pa'i bka' drin las rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' du ma dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad rgyas shing blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob po/ zhes so// rmolegs bshad glog gi/ rtse dag 'a dang 'grogs pa'i/ /bshes gnyen zhal gyi chu 'dzin 'dzum pa las/ /nyin bzhin zab rgyas chos char 'jo ba yis/ /gang thugs ye shes mtsho chen rgyas par gyur/ /de tshe bka' bstan gdams pa'i chu bo kun/ /yongs rdzogs rnam dpyod lto ba yangs po ru/ /ba skyil bzod drang srong dza hu gsar ba zhig /tsi na'i yul du byung zhes lha rnams glengs/ /bgrang bya nyung ngu'i yun la mdo sngags kyi/ /chos tshul ma lus thugs su chud pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gsang chos kyi phung bo'e tshad/ /brjod las 'das zhes grags pa rdzun du byas/ /snyigs mari ngang tshu—ri mun pas ma sbags pa'i/ /ga/nga gi mdzad bzang bdud rtsi'e 'od can de/ /phyogs bcuri rgyal ba'i thugs mtshor shar ba'i mod/ /dgyes pa'i kun+da dbang med bzhad par gyur/ /dbu la bshes gnyen nor bu'i cod paṇa mdzes/ /mgrin pa legs bshad mu tig do shal 'chari / /zhabs pad mkhas pa'i gtsug na ngal bso ba/ /mtshungs

med bla ma khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan la sa/ gzhung lugs chen mo rnams thos bsam gyis gtan la phab cing zab rgyas kyi gredams pa mang du gsan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //

tre 127zhezhu lnga bu/ sku na mi lgozhi gnas skabus ltad naska nasas glubu chen paṃzhi namā than bradag gin mān-id cid / zhadamā dbrungaska god mā chen pos tā rka shrizhi zhung lus slulka te chabu sprid chen pozhi glu nan brakun dazhi tshulka/de ltar thugs gnyer mdzad pa'i dus su yang thos rkyang gis chog par mi 'dzin par/ don la yang yang dpyad sgom mdzad pa dang / kha phyir ltas su ma song bar rgyud thog tu bskor te nyams su len tshul gyi gnad la sgro 'dogs gcod pa gtso bor mdzad cing / thos don rnams phral phral du phyag len la 'debs pa dang / spyod 'jug chen mo dang / /rgyan 'jug pa/mdo rtsa/ rnam rtsa rnams res mo dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ /blo sbyong don bdun ma dang / tshigs brgyad ma/ bzang spyod dang smon lam bdun cu ba rnams chag med du zhal 'don mdzad cing don la bshar sgom mdzad pa yin gsungs/ 'di ni 'brom rin po ches/ /rje sangs rgyas bya ba kun mkhyen yin/ /de spangs rtogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin yin/ /nga pha ma'i don du de 'dod pas/ /dus dang por thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gnyis par bsam pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gsum par bsgom pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /kye de yang gcig nyid ma yin te/ /nga thos dus tshe na bsam bsgom bdo/ /

da 12sdod wa sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla ma ra bkur tshul/nga bsam dus tshe na shes bsgom bdo/ /nga bsgom dus tshe na thoṭa/ bsam bdo/ /nga gcig tu ma lus bsdoms byas nas/ /chos lam du khyer nas 'gro shes pas/ /nga bka' gdams phyogs char ma lhung bas/ /don rgya 'bag bzhin du 'phrul shes pa'i/ /legs kun tu rtogs te bka' gdams yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje bla ma rang bi/ sa kyang / de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid bsgom dang nyams len gtso bo yin/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gcig char 'byung bas na/ /tshes/sa med lam gyi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo phal mo ches/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar gcig dril ma mdzad kyang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad pa mdzad bzhin par/ /sa lam rtogs pa phul dung rnyed la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thos bsam sgom gsum ya bral du ma gyur par gcig gcig gi grogs su 'khyer shes pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam par thar pa phyag len du btab pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kyang dgung lo shin tu phra ba'i gnas skabs 'di rang nas bdag gir bzhes pa yin te/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i dus su dad ldan gyi grwa slob sbyin bdag mang bo zhig gis gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid kyi bka' chos dang / lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi bshad pa shin tu rno ba zhig mdzad pas thams cad kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog ste dad pa'i shugs kyis mig nas mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba byung / de nas bzung zhu ba po rnams kyi mos pa bzhin dbang chen gyi rigs ma gtogs gsung chos gang zhus thams cad thogs pa

— sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 129med par gnang nas thams cad yid tshim par mdza rikyi/ rtsod pa yang dgung lo bcu bdu na gyi skabs gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i spobs pa mchog tu dge ba u cu mu chin gu shri bzod pa zhes bya bas nyams sad kyi tshul du rtsa shes kyi rab byed dang po'i sho lo ka kha shas las brtsams pa'i rtsod yig phul ba la/'phags pa yab sras dang rje bla ma'i dgongs pa gung bsgrigs te lung rigs dri ma med pa'i lam las drangs pa'i rtsod lan gnang / de la dgag bzhag gi tshul gyis rtsod yig yang skyar phul pa la/ slar yang rdo rje'i gzeg ma lta bu'i lung rigs kyi tsod lan gyis rgol pa de nyid kyi spobs pa rmeg med du 'joms par mdzad pa rtsod lan gyi yi ge gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa ltar yin no/ /phyis su gu shri de sku mdun du mjal skabs dngos su 'bel gtam gyi bka' mchid rgyas par stsal pas kho yang shin tu dad pas de phyin chad nas rje bla ma nyid kyi slob mar gyur te rga/sung gi bdud rtsi la spyod pa'i skal ba can du gyur pa yin/ legs bshad kyi rtsom pa yang / byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs rnam gsal 'debs tshigs bcad ma zhig mdzad pa ljags rtsom gyi thog ma yin cing / 'di phyis su gsung 'bum gyi dpar —bzhengs skabs dgung lo bcu gcig dus mdzad ces mchan btab 'dug na'ang / 'di nga rang lo dgu ba'i dus brtsams pa yin zhes rje bla ma nyid kyis bdag cag la gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung gnang skabs dngos su gsungs pas/ sku na shin tu phra ba'i gnas skabs su yang brjod don zab cing tshig gi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa deng sang gi 'gro 'dren du khas 'che ba rnams kyis mi tshe hril bor 'bad kyang kha nas thon dka' ba'i legs

130 sku rne phra mo'i dus nas geng ma jin pos bla mar bkur tshul/ bshad gyi dga' ston de lta bu spel ba ni snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'byung bar dka' ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang ngo / /dgung lo bco lnga'i dus rje bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho las gsan pa'i lta khrid la zin bris gnang ba rgya gzhung gi nyams dang ldan pa zhig dang / de nas bzung dgung lo nyi shu'i bar byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul bshad pa theg chen 'jug sgo/ rmad du byung ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba mkhas mang mgrin rgyan/ gzhan yang dad ldan du ma'i zhus ngor/ lha dang bla ma'i gsol 'debs/lha'i sgrub thabs mngon rtogs/ chab shog mgur ma sogs phyogs gcig tu sdom par shog grangs brgya lhag tsam zhig mdzad snang la/ de dag kyang tshig don phun sum tshogs pa blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis mthong na yid 'phrog par byed pa sha stag tu 'dug go /dgung lo bco lnga'i dus shes rlom snying kham can 'ga' zhig gis/ da lta slob gnyer chig dril byed pa las bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs bhār chad kyi rgyu yin pas mi legs zhes kha bdud kyis phye ba'i gtam smra ba gsan nas de dag la 'di skad ces gsungs 'dugasu sti/ bslab gsum yon tan lhag cing brtson dang bcas/ /lung gi gter gyur zab don mngon sum rtogs/ /smra mkhas brtse ldan chos phyir skyong la spangs/ /theg mchog mtshan ldan bshes gnyen rnams la 'dud/ /kyi hud bzod dka'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher/ /bgrang dka'i sdug ngasngapa na kra du ma yis/ /rab gtses mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa /thar pa'i skam sar phyin na ci ma rung / /kye ma lus can kun gyi phan bde'i gzhi/ /cag bsngal ma lus drungs nas 'byin byed pa/ /dge legs mtsha na myo/ sa

—skyenaphramogliduzinasagongamachinango sa/gu marabakur tshul/ 131phyogs kun bkra ba'i thabs/ /'dren pa'i bstan 'di lags par rgyal bas gsungs/ /e ma deng dus thub bstan rin chen 'di/ /bdag 'dra'i blun rmongs rnams kyis 'dzin par rlom/ /rnam dag nges 'byung tsam ya nga bsgom dang bral/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tshe skyo bas dben/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs la ba spu'i rtse mi g.yo/ /bdag dang bdag 'dras/ bstan pa 'dzin spel ba'i/ /tshul 'di rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang / /sngon byon skyes/ chen tshogs kyi bzhad gad gnas/ /rab 'byams gzhung lugs dka' gnad legs rtogs shing / /rnam mang yon tan bzang bos rgyud gtams pa/ /mching bu'i khrod kyi gser bzhin 'gakrā srid kyang / /nas/ phyogs thal bas ga yogs te mi mngon byas/ /de lta ru+osku+o/da kyi bdag blo'i nyim/ byed kyis/ /lung rigs bye ba'i 'od 'phreng spro byas te/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i pad tshal snying bo'i bcud/ /blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs la 'gye3sne nus mod/ /'on kyang deng du ṭ+wāṃ sa mkhas rlom phyopo /sa lhung ba/ /phyogs re'i gzhung la sbyangs pa chung ngu can/ /'ga' yis lham dpe zhwa la 'gebs mthong ba'i/ /tshul 'dis kho bo'ang snying las chung ngur spro/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad lus phra'i gzugs/ /bdag gi blo gros a dar shar gsal por/ /'char ba'i dga' ston ci ya nga myong ba yis/ /gcig pur gnas kyang dga' ba'i ca co 'chor/ /e ma rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba mchog /thabs dang 'brel bar dri med kyi/ /rigs pas smra la bdag mkhas so/ /chu phran chung chung ca co che/ /rgyu mtsho

d+ku 132 sku na phra mo'i dus nas rgong ma jin gles bla mar bkur tshul/ ku co ga la sgrogs/ /de phyir 'di ni ngang tshu/la te/ /sgro btags bdag bstod ga la yin/ /de lta na yang thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho ste/ /kho bo'i blo gros kyis 'khums de las phul gad tsam/ /ring nas goms dang dam pa'i byin rlabs sogs kyi mthus/ /legs par bshad pa 'ga' zhig kyang ni cis mi dmigs/ /de phyir blo gros ldan rnams kyang / /yid rangs dga' zhing 'dzum bzhin du/ /legs bshad blangs te 'chad pa dang / /rtsod dang nyams su bstar bar rigs/ /blo gsal ma lus legs bshad la/ /'jug par bskul ba'i dge ba yis/ /'gro rnams tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /chos gzugs sku gnyis 'thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni kho bo'i legs par bshad pa byung ba dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba thams cad la blo ldan rnams 'jug pa'i phyir du chos kyi grags pas rang lo bco lnga bar sbyar ba dza yardu/ zhes pa stsal/ /thos pa'i me tog rnam grangs mang bzhad kyang / /bsam sgom sbrang rtsi'i bcud dang mi ldan na/ /skalta bzang bung ba'i dga' ston mi 'gyur te/ /ri mor bris pa nyid dang khyad par ci/ /de phyir thos bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /tshul bzhin sgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /sku bzhi mngar ba'i ro la longs spyod pa/ /tshad ldan mkhas grub rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/ /'aXd pa sprin gyi bla re dang / /sdod pa glog gi do shal dang / /rtsosdu pa 'brug gi sgra dbyangs gsum/ /thub bsta/na nam mkhari 0 /dzes rgyan te/ /de lta mod kyang deng dus bstan 'dzin rnams// /dpale 'byor nu/ dang me tog mda' can gyi/ /'ching ba sgrub 'a ri smu 'chad tsod rtso ya pa yis/ /bstan la bya ba byed pa ches

sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 133cher dkon/ /mkha—sa khyod rgya chen gsung rab 'chad la mkhas/ /mkhaspres rlom rgol 'joms lurngo regs rtsod par mkha sa/ /mkhaṃs pa mgu dro'i legs bshad rtsoX/ la maXs/ /mkhuṅge pa'i bya pas thu rbo bstan spel la mkhadze+e/ /ches phra'i na tshod sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas/ /mkhas pa'i rtsal kun rdzogs pa'i mkha' lding khyod/ /bstan 'dzin 'dab ldan yongs kyi rje bo ru/ /thub bstan lhun po'i spo la ngal bso mdzad/ /yang dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus rang nyid la gros 'debs pa'i tshul gyis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams tshe 'di'i snang zhen las blo bzlog ste mdo sngags kyi lam la sgrub pa snying bor byed pa la bskul ba'i zhal gdams 'di lta bu 'i/ga gnang 'dug ste/ /na mo mji shrī ku ma ra ye/ bgrang yas 'gro la rab brtses kun bslangs te/ /byang chub thugs bskyed rlabs chen tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sgrib gnyis dgra bcom sku gsum mngon du mdzad/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba kun la snying nas 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs don zab dang rgya che'i tshul/ /'gro la gsal mdzad klu sgrub thogs med zhabs/ /a ti sha dang blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /rgya bod paṇa grub ji snyed mchis la 'dud/ /sdon bsags stobs ldan las kyi mthu brtas pas/ /'khor ba'i gcong rong zab mo'i spubs tshud de/ /'jigs rung skye rga na 'chi'i dgras gtses pa/ / bdag nyid rang la phan pa'i gros cig 'debs/ /kyai khyod rnyed dka' dal 'byor rten mchog thob/ /rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /yang dag bshes kyis legs par zin gyur na/ /da ni dam pu'i chos la cis —sdi 'bungs/ /kun gyi srog la mnga' bsgyur brtse bral zhing / /skyes

da 134 skunaphra mo'i dus nasagongamachenaposablamar batram̐ratshul/ dgekun don med gso da byed 'chi bdag des/ /rtag tu khyod la glags ni 'tshol byed na/ /bde bar gnyid log khyod la gdengs ci yod/ /dal 'byor rten 'di shin tu rnyed dka' zhing / /yid bzhin nor las lhag pa'i don che bar/ /gsungs na 'di nyid don med chud gzan pa/ /khyod ni nges par bdud kyi zhags pas zin/ /lo zla zhag dang za ma'i pho nyas bsus/ /na rga'i mtshon dang dbyig pa/sa lus la brab/ /'dod sred zhag pas ske bcings ngan song gi /g.yangs su 'dren pa'i ngang tshul ma dran nam/ /yoyi mngal las thon pa'i dus nyid nas/ ca/ska da cig tsasnu/ yang ngal gso'i skabs med par/ /rtag tu 'chi ba nyid phyir rgyug gyur na/ /da dung khyod la khom pa'i skabs mchis sam/ /mi lus 'thob la tshul khrimasangagazhir bzung ste/ /sbyin sogs grogs byas smon lam 'tshams sbyor bar/ /dgos na rgyu 'di khyod kyis nam zhig bsgrub/ /gzhi ma tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs sam ci/ /bsgrub dgos rgyu ni 'ga' yang ma bsgrubs thi/nga / /bya min ngan 'gro'i rgyu la kun tu brtun/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas zin kyang 'chir mi skrag /kyi hud khyod kyi 'gro ba ji 'drar 'gyur/ /phyogaru/ bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dpang btsugs te/ /khas blangs dam tshig sdom pa yal dor nas/ /dam pas smad pa'i las la ci dgar 'jug /khyod snying lcags kyi gong bur gyur tam ci/ /lcags shong me lce 'bar 'dra'i dad zas kyis/ /'tsho zhing dkor sgrib sbyong byed yal bar dor/ /bsod nams ming btags bdud kyi pho nya 'dis/ /khyod kau dmyal ba'i srung mar jinatshudu nges/ /phyogs bcu'i sekais can kun gyi mig rgyung bas/ /sems

sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 135dpar khros pa sdig pa che gsungs shing / /sems dpa' gar gnas brtag par shin tu dka'/ /de phyir myoritho la phrag dog mnyam/ la 'gran/ /darmi sbyo/ la brnyas / par byed pa'i brtul zhugs 'dis/ /ba/ting zab dmyal ba'i me nang bskal ba'i bar/ /bud shing ltar bsreg sdug bsngal cis mi myong / /rang nyid ngan 'gror mi skye'i gdengs med kyang / /'gro ba gzhan gyi yar 'dren byed do lo/ /bdag gzhan phung byed don med 'dun ma 'di/ /da ni myur du spangs na mi legs sam/ /kyi hud dmyal ba'i bud shing khyod nyid la/ /legs nyes 'byed pa'i sems zhig yod gyur na/ /dam pa'i bsngags pa'i spyod tshul bzang bo la/ /rab dkar sems kyis 'di ltar 'jug par rigs/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'i rtsa ba mchog /lam ston bshes gnyen mchog de bsam sbyor gyis/ /tshul bzhin bsten la sgo gsum brtson par gyis/ /rten 'di rnyed dka' don che 'jig par sla/ /'chi bar nges shing nam 'chi nges pa med/ /ngan song bzod dka' de phyir skyabs 'gro dang / /las 'bras blang dor rgyun du sems par gyis/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di yi rgyu/ /las nyon gnyis yin de las nyon mongs gtso/ /de phyir de nyid spong bar byed pa'i thabs/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum po bsten par gyis// /drin ldan ma rnams 'khor ba'i gnas 'di las/ /sgrol phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ /phyin drug bsdu ba bzhi yi nyams len la/ /brtson pa drag pos tshul bzhin slob par gyis/ /khyad par bla med rdo rje theg pa yi/ /'jug sgo dbang blangs

da wa13rngi sku na phra mo'idus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/dam sdo ma le gas bsrungs te/ /sku gsum go 'phang myur du 'thob byed thab sdo// /rim gnyis rnal 'byor spyod la brtson par gyis/ /'di lta'i tshul gyis legs par blo sbyangs na/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon rnam dag thebs 'gyur zhing / /dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan pa ste// /dam pas bsngapo—/ṭari pa'i las ni de yin no/ /rang la gros 'debs man ngag bdud rtsi yi/ /bcud bsdus bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di bgyis pas/ /bdag dang 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du/ /theg chen dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /ces rang la gros 'debs pa man ngag bdud rtsiri thigs pa 'di ni 'di snang gi chos brgyad dang rol rtsed la sgrub pa snying bor byed pa'i ban chung ngag dbang chos grags kyis rang lo bcu bdun pa'i tshe sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /skabs zhig rgyal sras bcu bdun pa sku dbang che bas kho bas zhus don bzhin/ bod nas karma zhwa dmar nag gi bla ma gnyis rgyal khab chen por gdan drangs/ khong gnyis pe'i cing du 'byor nas7 gong ma'i spyan bskyang che ba byung na rang re'i bstan pa la gnod tshab che nges yong rgyur 'dug pa la/ rje thu'u bkwan pa thugs khral shin tu che bas rim gro stobs che ba dang / mngon spyod kyi las 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/ sprul sku rin po che nas kyang dam can chos kyi rgyal po las la bskul zhing gtor ma 'phen pa ngedo gas rga/nang bas bla ma de gnyis lam bar du gshegs/ gnam skos sa'i tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs7 gong ma chen po nas gzigs pa mchog tu dge bas gser dngul gos dar rin po cheri spyad pa khyad du mtshar ba sogs kyi gnang sbyin yang dang yang du mdzad pa dang /

8 na phra mo'idus nas gong ma chen potram̐/za mad—basprer tshul/ 131skabs skabs su rgya'/ po rang gi gco rkage ba'i phud kyang skyel 'jugre/ pa dang /hu thog thu nas rgya k+ṣapre ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog la gzigs to+os/ zhib tu mdzod ces bka' nan yang yang phebs thi/nga / sras bzhi ba da lta'i gong ma bdazhe / po chen po 'di nyid kyang rje bla ma dang lhan du slob gnyer ma dzad 'jug pa gnang / rje bla ma mchog nas rgya so/ga ma na ju rno/po4 kyi skad rigs dang yi ge tham sa cad zhar byung du thugs su tshud pas/ pho brang nang du yang yang gad na drangs nas gong ma chen po dang zhal 'dzom gyi thog chos srid kyi bka' mchid mang du gnang ba sogs bdag rkyen bla na med pa mdzad/ rgyal po 'di nyid hwa shang gi lta ba la mabloka tu dgyes pas skabs du mar tshom chen zhig tu rgyal po rang nyid dbus su bzhus/sa pa'i g.yas phyogs su rje bla ma nyid bzhugs su ga dro shāl zhing / hwa shang ma/khas pa rnams mtha' skor du 'dug bcug nas lta ba'i skor gyi mol mchid dang phan tshun nyams bsdur ba sogs mdzad/ rgyal po rang nyid kyis lta ba ston pa'i yig cha 'i/ga ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i sbyar byang du/ byu rje bla ma nyid kyi mtshan dang hwa shang mkhas pa kha shasashaṃ kye ming smos te/ 'di rnams dang lhan du yun ring bor brtags shing dpyad nas grub don brjed byang gi tshul du sbyar ba yin zhes sa/nang nas yig cha de rgya yul thams cad du 'gremaci par mdzad pas/ da lta rgya nag lho phyogs sogs kyi hwa shang ge sde che ba rnams su rje 'di nyid la ma khas pa chen por grags shing / yul gru tha dad nas lta ba rtsar gcod pa'i hwa shang mang bo dzodaka' spya) kyis ṭī 'di'i drung du yongs nas zhabs la gtugs par byed cing / de dag la thog mar hwa shang gi 'dod tshul ltar dang rim gyis dbu

13skye sku na bra tsā'i dus nas gong ma chon pos bla mar bkur tshul/ ma'i lta ba la 'khrid par mdzad pas nyams rtogs skyes pa'eng mi nyung tsam byung 'dug go /rje bla ma nyid la bdag gis hwa shang nā lta ba ci lta bu zhig yin zhus pas/ sdon 'phags yul nas klu sgrub yab sras kyi rjes 'brang gi paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig rgya yul du byon cing / rgya'i hwa shang 'ga' zhig kyang rgya gar du song nas dbu ma pa'i paṇa grub rnams la gtugs pas lda dag giri rku dbu ma'i lta ba rgya yul du cung zad dar bar byas 'dug kyang myud 'dzin mang du ma 'phel/ rgya skad du tā mo tsu shi bya ba slob dpon bho rnyi dha rmo t+ta ra rgya yul du byon nas lta ba'i rnam bzhag gsungs pa dar che ba 'dug cing / slob dpon de 'ga' zhig gis pha dam pa sangs rgyas yin yang zer la/ gang ltar yang lta ba'i ngo bo bod kyi zhi byed kyi lta ba dang gnad gcig tu 'dug deng sang lta ba'i 'dod tshul dar rgyas che ba ni sems tsam pa'i lta ba dang shin tu mthun par snang / bod du byung ba'i hwa shang ma hā ya na'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan deng sang rgya yuzlo du gcig kyang mi 'dug ces gsung / /des na bod dag gis hwa shang gi lta ba thams cad ma hā ya na'i lta ba dang gcig tu 'khrul nas than mthong ba ltar sdang bar byed pa ni rgyu mtshan ma mthong bar zad do/ /skabs zhig dbyar gyi tsha ba shin tu che ba lagyi gong nas sprul sku rin po che dang rje thu'u bkwan pa rnam gnyis tsha ba'i ring lagyi gong ma'i skyed tshal du bzhugs chog pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin dga' tshal du bzhugs/gyi gong ma'i gso la thab rang nas gsol chas nar ma dang / mnab bza' bzhugs stan snye 'bol bsil yab rnga yab seng gos kyi gur sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad gnang zhing / phyag g.yog pa rnams la'ang

skye na phra mo'i dus nas rgong ma chen thas bla mar bkur tshul/ 13nyagyon pa sogs gnadwa sbyin mdzad/ skyed tshal thugs nyams spro ba gang bzhe da du phebs bzhud bag yangs mdzad chog pa'i bka' gnang / der bzhugs ring la rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i drung nas chos bka' rnam grangs du ma zhig gsan par mdzad cing dka' gnas mang bor dogs dpyod soga' dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston gyis dus 'da' bar gyur/ de dus gsung mgur gnang ba 'di ltar ro/ /oṃ dzade legs su gyur cig /mchog sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon mdzad de/ /chos zab rgyas 'gro la 'doms pa'i slad/ /gos ngur smrig 'jin pa'i tshul bzung ba/ /rje tsong kha pa la snying nas 'dud/ /sems legs bskyed rlabs chen tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sgrib gnyis kyi mun stug rtsad nas bcil/ /skyabs blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /dus kun tu 'dud do thugs rjes zungs/ /rigs kun khyab drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro 4rnams 'dren pa'i phyir/ /sku tha mal rnam pas chos tshul 'doms/ /mngo/na chos kyi rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal zhing rgya che'i mkhyen rab dang / /lung rtogs pa'i yon tan gter du gyur/ /chos zab don bdud rtsir 'dod rgur sbyod/ /rje shes rab dar rgyas zhabs la 'dud/ /dam sdom rnams mig 'bras ltar du bsrung / /lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor zab mor brtson/ /'khrul bral ba'i rtogs pa mchog brnyes pa/ /rje blo bzang chos 'dzin zhabs la 'dud/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /rje khyed rang rnams dang mi 9rebral zhing / /chos zab rgyasi bdud rtsir longs spyad de/ /mchog sangs rgyas

140 sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di snang gi phun tshogs sgyu ma'i gar/ /mi rtag ci nga yid brtan mi rung ba'i/ /ngang tshur la nges shes legs bskyed de/ /dam chos la 'bad par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa yi rang bzhin sdug bsngal la/ /bde ba ru 'dzin pa'i log shes 'di// /myur ba ru 'gags nas bslab pa gsum/ /'bad pa yis bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /drin can gyi ma rgan sems can rnams/ /'khor ba las bsgral te gtan gyi bder/ /'god slad du byang chub sems bskyed de/ /gzhan don la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /smin byed kyi dbang thob dam ju sdom bsrung / /rim gnyis la brtson bcas sku gsum gyi/ /go 'phang mchoka tshe 'dir myur thob nas/ /sems can kun 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par du rab dga' 'thob kyi bar/ /bsod nams du ming btags bdud kyi 'phrul/ /'du 'dzi dang snyan grags bkur sti dang / /skad cig kyang ḍiphrad par ma gyur cig /bla chen gyi skye bar sgro btags nas/ /thos bsam dang sgom pa la g.yel te/ /renge phung dang gzhan phung las la 'jug /go 'phang de 'thob par ma gyur cig /chos med kyang chos par rdzu ba dang / /sgom med kyang sgom par rdzu ba dang / /sdom med kyang btsun par rdzu ba yi/ /rdzu chos de rtag tu spong bar shog /mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la/ /tshig tsam du ma lus thos pa bsags/ /thos don la dri med lung rigs kyis/ /legs dpyad de gtan la 'bebs par shog /'du 'dzi yis dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /gcig pu ru thub gsung mtha' dag la/ /sgom sgrub kyis rang rgyud legs

sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 1'i(wasbyangs te/ /sa lam rnams myur bar bgrod par shog /sa lam gyi rtogs pa mchog thob nas / /dag pa dang ma dag zhing rnams su/ /bgrang yas kyi sprul pas thabs mkhas pas/ /mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba 'dren par shog /'dod don 'di gegs med 'grub 'gyur bar/ /rje khyed rang rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs gzhan na med do bla ma mkhyen/ /ces pa'i 'di ni 'di snang phun tshogs thams cad yid brtan du mi rung ba'i ngang tshul can yin par gsung rab las byung ba rnams la nges shes cung zad skyeṭa/ pas rkyen byas te/ sku skye ngag dbang chos grags kyis rang lo bco brgyad par7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i skyed tshal du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dpyod ldan tshul khrims chos 'phel gyis bgyis ṭ+wāṃ〈 zhes pa'o//rgyal phran bye bas gang la phyag byas pa'i/ /ral pa'i rlung gis bslangs pa'i rdul tshub kyis/ /lha yi rdzing ring mog por byed pa lta'i/ /sa chen skyong ba chos kyi rgyal po che/ /gang gi bsod nams stobs kyis bskrun pa yi/ /skyed mos tshal gyi bsti gnas nyams dga' ba/ /mtho ris skyed tshal sa la 'phos pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa bsam las 'das pa yod/ /gang du be+eḍūr zhun ma'i mtsho/ /yid 'ong gtsang zhing dwangs pa la/ /chu bya'i tshogs dang rgyu skar rnams/ /nyin mtshan res mokhu4 khrus la 'jug /spu sdu ga 'dab chags sna tshogs rnams/ /'phur lding gar gyi rol rtsed dang / /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdungs pa yiṭashaṃ/ /dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs par byed/ /sprang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug rnams/ /pad+ma gser

142 sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/gyi skra can la/ /chags pas lang ling 'khor byed cing / /de yi ngo mtshar dar dir sgrog /skyed tshal mdzes ma'i bzhin ras mi// /tsha bas ma rung 'gyur dogs pas/ /g.yu yi ljon shing 'khrigs pa rnams/ /yal ga'i bsil yab sa/yob par byed/ /ri bo ne tso'i sgro thul can/ /me tog do shal 'chang rnams kyis/ /rang gi bu bzhin ri skyes rnams/ /phang bar nyal la 'khrug mi byed/ /lbu ba dkar po'i stod g.yogs can/ /dal 'gro ma ni dri ba'o/na gyi/ /bu mos gtor ba'i me tog tshogs/ /lhung lhu nga zer zhing 'thu bar byed/ /thang dang ri sul chu ngogs su/ /lo ma gsar ba'i lding khang dang / /nor bu'i pho brang nyams dga' rnams/ /bkod pa'i byad par 'gran pa bzhin/ /'di ni dngos sam 'on te sgyu ma zhes/ /blo ldan yid la dpyang thag 'dzin byed cing / /gang du gom pa 'jog pa'ang sngon bsags kyi/ /bsod nams mthu la ltos pa'i gnas der ni/ /ji ltar kun gsal ra bar nyi zlarmo zung / /'dod dgur rgyu zhing 'od kyis rtsen pa bzhin/ /rin chen khang bzang ma/chog tu yab sras gnyis/ /spyod lam ci bder chos kyi dga' bas rtsen/ /nub cig phyis 'byung ston pa'i mnal ltas bzhi tsam bstud mar byung snang ste/ dang po ni mnal lam du rje bla ma nyid7 gong ma'i pho brang gi gyen theng tsi bya bar byon pa na rje thu'u bkwan pa'ang de na phebs 'dug pa'i zhal nas/ 7 gong nas os rod kyi bu chung zhig gnang byung bas nged rang gsol ras la phyag 'tshal bar 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ bu chung de nged la gnang 'tshal zhus par/ de gsod khrimasajikyis phog pa7 gong nas srog thar mdzad pa yin/ rab byung byed dgos

— da wa skunaphramo'idus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 143pas gzhan la ster mi chog gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ yang mnal la ma du tsan+dan jo bor rje the'u bkwan pa'i drung du phebs pas/ tor ge am pas rje thu'u bkwan par nang rten rnams mjal dgos zhus par/ khong gi zhal nas gzhan thams cad mjal chog jo bo rje'i dbu zhwa ston rgyu min gsungs pa rmis/ gsum pa ni/ yang rje thu'u bkwan pas nged la brel ba zhig yod/nyin re zhig mchod mjal sogs mdzod gsungs byung ba bzhin/ mchod khang du phebs pas/ rten khrod na bla sku tshon do tsam pa gdan khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa zhig la/ sbrul gdug pa can dmar smug sbom zhing ring ba zhig gis gnod sems kyis mjug ma sku brnyan de'i khri rkang rnams la 'khril zhing / lus po bla sku'i g.yas phyogs nas yar 'khril te song nas dbu'i steng tsam du thon pa na/ bla sku'i g.yon rol na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku brnyan tshon do tsam pa zhig 'dug pa des sku stod g.yas phyogs su dkyus nas spyan hrig hrig byed cing / ma he'i zhal gyi shangs bug g.yas pa nas glog dmar zhig 'khyugs pa'i gseb nas dam can chos kyi rgyal po sku tshon phyed tsam zhig rgyang gis thon nas song ste/ sbrul de'i mgo la mtshon zhig rgyab pas sbrul mgo thur du nar gyis 'phyang song ba zhig rmis/ bzhi ba ni/ yang de'i 'phror mnal lam du/ phyag dar khrod na chos po ti chur chung 'ga' zhig 'dug pa las gcig blangs nas gzigs pas kha byang la bka' brgyud gtam gsum gyi chos sna tshang bar bzhugs zhes snang ba kha phye bas// yi ge gshar ma la bar mtshams su sdig pa rwa can dang / ro mgo med dang / yan lag la mig dang kha yod pa so gaṭaṭa yid du mi 'ong ba'i ri mo mang bo yod pa

144 sku na phra mo'idus nas gong ma chin pos bla mar bkur tshul/zhis/ 'dug rje thu'u bkwan rin po cher/ dpe cha 'di su'i yin zhus par/ de bcu bdu na pa'i yin/ khyed kyis shes mod gsungs pa rmis/'di nams phyi nyin phral du phyag bris mdzad nas rje thu'u bkwan par phul ba'i shob/ dril de phyis su wo/ bos mthong zhing / bla ma mchog nas brda' bkrol gnang byung bar/ mi/ lam dang po de/ dus phyis cukyo/ gar ba'i 'khrugs long gis os rod kyi rgyal rgyud stong pa'i ltas dang / gnyis pa rje ngag rgyam pa de nyid byang chub kyi sems rnal ma thugs la mnga' na'ang / yon tan thams cad bum nang gi mar me ltar sbed rma zhig yod pas de mtshon byed dang / gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ gtso bor sngon las dang 'phral rkyen gzhan gyi bas ma sbyor ngan pa'i mthu byad sogs la brten nas/ nged kyi rkang lag dang mig so gas yun ring du na ba dang / 'chi la thug pa'i nad tshab drag po 'ga' byung kyang srog la ma skyon pa 'di ri bo dge lugs nga 'i yi dam srung ma'i byin rlabs yin pa'i brda' mtshon du ma ngon zheṭa/ sa/sungs/ kho bos phyag dar khrod du snang ba de gzhan phyogs pa'i chos rnams snying bo med pas phyag dar gyi rdul khrod du dor zhig bya ba yin nam zhus par/ khyod smyon pa yin 'dug de ltar ze ra ga la 'os gsungs/ skabs shig rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa khri chen blo gros rgya/ mtsho'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma ma khas grub gnyis 'ardzam gyi skyes bu dam pa khyad par can yin par ma zad/ ri sku gong ma rnams su bla slob kyi 'brel ba che ba bcas rgyal khab chen por gdan drangs te dbang khrid man ngag gi rgyun gas/ra par bzhed nas gyi ngo/nga ma chen po ra snyasdu /— 'bu'4 —bgyiṭa/ na'ar / rgyal sras bcu

sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 145bdun pa dbang che baṭag khos g.yo thabs sna tshogs kyis do lon/ nor du yo da pa'i bka' 'gyur ba zer ba dang / gzhung gi mkhan por 'ongs pari no min han ming can zhig bcas rim pas pe'i cing du bor+sā te sprul sku rin po che'i yongs 'dzin du bskos 'dug de ltar byed pa'i gya natsha sna—/ de dus sras bcu bdun pa sku dbang che zhing kho rnying ma la shin tu mos pas rnying chos mang bo rang gis nyan cing gzhan la'ang ston khul byed pa zhi ka yin pa dang /bla ma de gnyis kyang 'phyon ma'i gar stabs bsgyur ba la shin tu ma khas pas/snga ma zhig kho'i drung nas rnying chos 'ga' zhig nyan pa'i lugs ba gyis te /long rnams lta spyod gcig par brten/ de gnyis gang rung ci/ga yongs 'dzin byed bcug na sprul sku rin po che rim gyis grub mtha' rnying ma byed pa zhig yong re yin 'dug rje thu'u bkwan rin po ches gnas tshul de mkhyen nas sprul sku rin po che dang dka' chen shes dar ba so gas la kho gnyis su las kyang chos gsan pa mi 'gab tshul nan tan ma/dzad pa bzhin chos 'brel gyi rigs gtan nas ma gsan kyang / 7 gong rma 'i lung bud pa'i dbang gis bka' 'gyur ba re zhig gi bar pho brang du dbyar gyi tsha ba'i gdung ba la sran btsugs te sdod dgos pa byung 'dug cing / gcig shoṭa/ phral du phyir slog 'dug go /skabs shig gong nas sprul sku rin po che la yongaṅge/ tsho0 dzi na las chos gsan gyin e yod bka' 'dri gnang bar phran gyis zhus pa'i yongs 'dzin da duj-i pho brang du ོ 'byor zhes zhus pas/ thugs cung zad tshom me ba mdzad nas bye/ da kyis zhuṭ+wāṃ na pari bla ma su zer ba zhig yin lge/sungs pa la dga' ldan shrir shā'i sprul skyu yin tshul zhutwa/ par/ 'o na gla ma de pho brang du

146 sku na phramo'idusanas gongam chen+d+rapo gablamarabakur tshul/myur bar bos chog gsungs nas yā min la de lugs kyi bka' babs pas/mi ring bar khri chen sprul sku pe'i cing du 'byor/ gsung chos kyi thog/ ma che dpag med kyi rjes gnang zhig gsan/ dngul srang lnga brgya khri stan rgyab yol sogs nyer dpyad mang du 'bul ba sa/nang / bla ma 'di nyid tshad ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa khyad par can zhig yin 'dug pas/ dus de nas bzung ste rigs kyi cod paṇa du bzhes/ skabs 'di dag tu rgyal sras bcu gnyis pas zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten cing / skabs skabs su 'bul nor rgya chen po 'bul ba dang / phyis su 'gyogs rgyang 'degs mkhan gyi mi bcu drug phul nas de dag gi zas gos thams cad rgyal sras rang gis ster ba sogs khong rang zhal bzhugs kyi ring la 'gyur ba med pa mdzad/ gzhan yang mchod rten dkar po'i bla ma sogs pho brang nang gi dad ldan bla dpon du ma dang / har chin wang yi dam skyabs/ de'i sras wang rat+na sidzhai/ ong nyod pe'i li phun tshogs/ thu med pe'i zi kun dga'i ming can rnams byi sa sbyin bdag gi mthil zhus shing / mdor na tsho zhe dgu /hal kha tsho bdun/ cha har ho sho brgyad/ or du su tsho ba drug sogs kyi bla dpon rnams dang 'byor ba dang ldan pa'i yul mi'i rigs sbyin bdag tu ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ de dag gis dus 'di dang phyis su'ang skabs gzhan dang gzhan duca phorang rang gi dad pas kun nas bslangs te dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas yang dang yang du mchod par byas pa rnams yi ger ngakod na ha cang mang bar 'gyur zhing dgos pangang mi che bas btang snyoms su dazhag go /

sku na phramo'idusanasagong ma chenasprasabla mar bkur tshul/ 141mthon po'i rigs kyi gangs ri las 'ongs shing / /phun tshogs stobs 'byor g.yu ral 'thug po can/ /mi yi seng ge bgrang las 'das pa yis/ /khyod zhabs gser gyi khri 'phang spyi bor bsten/ /ser sna bral ba'i gtong phod shing rta che/ /bdog pa'i nor bas bkang ste nyin bzhin ༄du/ /dad pa khyu mchog stobs kyis drangs pa yis/ /khyod drung rin chen ri bo bzhin du byas/ /phyi ma'i dpal la sred ldan 'di dag gi /dad pa dri med yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin/ /phun tshogs 'byor ba mig skya'i gan mdzod bzhin/ /gtong ba'i lag pa dpag bsam yal ga bzhin/ / 'di dus sras bcu bdun pa grub mtha'i kun slong dang sngar smos pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi don skor sogs la brten nas rgyud 'khrugs pas rje bla ma nyid la ma gus pa'i rnam pa mang du bgyis par/ rje bla ma nyid kyang cung zad thugs khros pa'i tshul gyis/ srod thun zhig la 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo'i bskul ba drag tu mdzad pas/ de nub mnal lam du bud med nag mo shin tu 'jigs shing mi sdug pa'i gzugs can mig ya gcig gyen la lta zhing gcig thur du lta ba zhig gis khyod kyis nga de tsam bskul ba ci yin zer ba la/ rje nyid kyis yus kyi rnam pas nged la dgra bo 'dis 'di ltar sdang bar byed na khyod da lta'i bar gang du ci byed kyin bsdad pa yin zhes 'bar bar mdzad pas/ 'o na 'di la ltos shig zer nas rkang ba sa la brdab pas ri dang bcas pa'i sa gzhi thams cad yom yom chem chem byed pa zhig rmis/ phyi nyin rje blo bzang chos 'dzin pa la zhus pas khong thugs shin tu ma4 dgyes pa'i tshul gyis/ khye da kyi skye ba gong ma de byamyo/sa snying rje mo

148 sku na phra mo'i dus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig la thugs dam byed pa ma gtogs sku tshe de la chos phyong gi bskul lan gcig tsam las gtong ma myong / dgra la chos skyong rbad nas mngon spyod kyi las byed pa la ya mtshan ci yod/ mthar byad ma rbod gtong mkhan zhitha/ yong ba yin mod ces bka' bkyon gyi char phab 'dug gzhan yin na sprul sku rin po che'i myo/tshan ltas shin tu legs pas da ni rang re'i sku dgra mi ring bar 'chi ba thagasna chod zer nas dar 'phyar dung 'bud byed dgos rigs su 'dug kyang / de 'dra mi mdzad pa'i khar nyes pa che shos su brtsi ba 'di ni nges par bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chubarmo kyi/ sems la thugs lhag par 'byongs pa'i rang rtags bzo med du bstan par gdon mi za bas ya mtshabyuspu/ shin tu che bar na/nga ngo / /'dod khams dbang mo 'di nyid kyis 'phrin las mjad pa'i lo rgyus gzhan yang mang ste rim pas 'god par bya'o/ /yang skabs khya/ga dge ba'i badze+es gnyen chen po sa mthar 'phrin las kyi khyab brdal che yang / 7 rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshor shin tu mi dad cing 'phrin las kyi sgo 'gegs par brtson pa zhig yod pa/ nub gcig rje 'di'i mnal lam du dge bshes de nyid 'khor mang po'i dbus su khri mthon po zhig gi khar bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bod pa gos dkar po gyon cing skra bshigs pa ske ras/ gi ba/seb tu mda' kha shas nga cug pa zhig gis bla ma de'i rkang ba nas bzung ste phyi rol tu drud nabe khye ra ba zhig rmis pas/ mi ring bar bla ma des mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid bstan 9/dug pa gnas chung chos skyong gi 'phru lo yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs/ 'di khudra tī ‘ོro rgyus gzhan yang ma nga zhing rgyul ba de nyid la ma

— —/sdu na phra mo'idus nas gong ma chen pos bla mar bkur tshul/ 14nyadad pa dang kha ga/tong ba sogs la nges pa mi 'dug kyang / 'phrin las la gnod par byed mkhan gyi rigs rnams dpal ldan lha mo dang rdo rje dregs ldan gnyis kyiṭasdo nges par tshar gcod pa 'dug ces gsungs/ lo zla sogs kyi gsal kha ma nges kyang / skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu gnam gyi lha7 gong ma bdag po chen pos/ rje btsu na bla ma dam pa nyid la bsngags pa brjod rmo'i gser mibaka' lung dang bcas/ sku gong ma'i dus bzhin bkwan ting phu'u shan si kwang tshi tā 4// shri zhes bod skad du/ byams brtses 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i kun mkhyen bla ma chen po zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gzengs bstod dang / gser srang brgyad cu las grub pa'i tham kabasngags brjod kyi gser yig dang bcas pa stsal te chab srid chen po'i bla mar mnga' gso/la bar mdzad/ da lta kau shri'i mtshan 'di bzhin dang bod du chibs bsgyu ra cha5 dzad nas phyir gyi gong spo 'i rgyal khab tu phebs pa na/ ti shri chen po'i lung 'a sa kyi mngom/ par mtho ba gnang rgyu yin tshul gyi bka 'a bzang po phebs so sda la sa/nas pa'i sems dpa' chen po zhig /sa chen skyong ba'i rgyalapo'i tshu la bzung ba/ /sa yi tshangs pa gong ma yung ṭidza zhes/ /ga gsumagrags pa'i ba dam/ g.yo ba0 des/ /gseXr ldan ljongs 'di'i garnon gyis rnyed dka' ba'i/ /gasder bzang tham ska/ sa/zi 8ོda 'bar ba dang / /gseXr yig 'ja' sa phul nas rnam 'dren khyod/ /gasnrer gyi lung gis chab srid bla mar bsngas/sa / /'dz+wam gling mkhas pa'i sa/tsus/ rgyan 'a rardu ba'i rme gon/ / 'dzaXmyo/ gling skyo nga ba'i rgyas pos bkur ba'i gtam/ /'angoXm

150 sku na phra rmo'i dus nas 5nga ma chin spros bla mar bkur tshul/bu'i gling 'di'i skye rgu'i rna ba la/ /'dzam bu'i gse ra gyi rgyan bzhin mdzes par gyur/ /gang gi stobs 'byor zhagazlo pas nor 'dzin khyon/ /cig char 'ching ba gnam bskos mi yi rjes/ /bsti bstang bgyid na dregs ldan gzhan dag gis/ /zhabs la spyi bos mi 'dud rang dbang ci/ /'phrin las bcu gnyis bdag po'i snang ba yis/ /thub bstan pad+ma'i dga' tshal bzhad pa las/ /phan bde sbrang rtsis lus can rkang drug tshogs// /tshim mdzad bstan 'gro'e mgon la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ma)ོ tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ sku na phra cho/'i gnas skabs nyid nas mkhas grub chen po'i rnam thar bdag gir mdzad cing / 'jam dbyangs7 gong ma chen pos tā kau shri'i lung las phul te chab srid chen po'i bla mar bkur ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //
