sna ——— nga 1//mi1/ lkezhu drug phu/ rgad mā chen pozhi gne+er gyi zhung zhazhin khamās gsumā zhaspro zhazhi māgon po rgyalka dadad jimās cad nakhyen pu gangaska skruzhi sdongs su gdan dradarga te phro brang chen po po ta zhazhi māṃ zhadz+rīgs ged gezhi khri ska zhabraska nu pusmro dkod pun na2da puzhi tshulu/de nas rje bla ma mchog gi thugs dgongs la/ bod dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams su phebs thub pa zhig byung na don shin tu che bar gzigs nas/ phebs 'dun gyi dgongs pa rgyun ldan du mdzad kyang 7 gong ma chen por ga nas tshul zhu ma bde bas/ rje sems dpa' chen po thu'u bkwan rin po cher de don 2 gsung brtag zhu ba gnang bar/ lan chags ga/tor ma 'bum ther btang na bzhed don 'grub ces phebs/ rje rang nyid kyi mnal lam du'ang bla ma shangs chengo paṇa zhwa sne ring dang chos gos gso la ba zhig gis dmigre/sa brtse ma 'bum ther dang / la na chags gtor ma mang du btang na thugs bzhed bde blag tu 'grub ces gsungs pa cig rmis pas rim gro rnams bsgrub pa mdzad cing / khyad par du dmigs brtse ma dang /dge legs yon tan ma dang blo bzang rgyal ba sa sho lo ka bcas so so nas 'bum zer re zhal 'don gnang bas/ nub cig paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes yin zer ba'i bla ma zhig dang mjal ba rmis/ phyis su bod du phebs nas paṇa chen dang mjal bas/ zhal nyams dang sku'i dbyibs so gas thugs rdzi/sa

— 152 gongama'i bka' ba'in rgyal dbang chog po ta la'i khrir bskud tshul/ su byung ba de kho na lta bu 'dug ces gsungs/ de nas ring bo ma lon paragyigong ma chen pos rje 'di nyid lame rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mgar thar nas bod du gdan 'dren pa'i mi snar phebs nas/ dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du rgyal ba yab sras kyi drung du bka' chos sa/san par yun mi thung tsam bzhugs chog pa'i bka' bzang po phebs par/ ring mo zhig nas thugs la brnag rngu'i don khyad par can de da 'grub par 'dug snyam pa'i dgyes tshor bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung snang ngo //rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ba/cig bsdus pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs te de nyid ngur smrig gi /rnam rol bdag gi bla ma de yi thugs/ /rtag tu chos kyi bdud rtsi la chagamo/ pas/ /bka' bstan gzhung lugs chu bo bye ba brgya/ /'thungs pas ma ngoms gang thugs chos kyi mtsho/ /zab yangs gting mtha' dpag par mi nus pa/ /ye shes chen po'i klong nas 'di lta ra dgongs/ /deng dus thub pa gangs kyi ri bo 'a sa 'ongs pa'i mdo sngags chos kyi nyal 'gro kun/ /gcig tu 'khyil ba'i gnas ni gangs ljongs zhes/ /grags dkar phyogs kun gsal ba'i yul de yin/ /ji ltar mkha' la snang byed zung gtso ba'i/ /bgrang yas rgyu skar 'od kyis rtsen pa bzhin/ /ljongs der jo shāka rnam gnyis gtso gyur pa'i/ /ngo mtshar rten mang byin rlabs gzi 'od 'gran/ /lung rigs mgrin pa'i ro rnga brdung ba yi/ /blo gsal ngang mo bye ba'i khyu 'khrigs pa/ /sa chen mdzes rgyan chos sde'i mtsho chen po/ /bshad sgrub rlabs phreng 'phyur ba'ang de na mang / /khyad par k+ṣ-i+oro da dpatso/ med dang spyan ras gzigs/ /ngur

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang skya/chog po ta la'i khrir brkyo/da tshul/ 153smrig sa/ra mdzad rgyal ba yab sras zung / /gser ri'i phreng ba'i dbus na lhun po bzhin/ /ljongs der mkhas grub bye ba'i dbus na brjed/ /'di na gnas skabs tsam gyi dbul sel ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu blar 'dod ded dpon dag /srog dang bsdos te rgya mtsho'i 'jings brkal nas// /rin chen gling du bgrod pa'i ngal bsten na/ /skye ba gtan gyi dbul ba sel byed cing / /byang chub phyogs chos 'dod rgu'i dpal ster ba/ /dkon mchog chos kyi nor bu blang ba'i phyir/ /bdag ni cho sa kyi gling der cis mi bgrod/ /de ltar dgongs nas ris che/da skye rgu'i gnyen/ /de yi zhabs zung 'khor lo'i mtshan bzang gis/ /sa la dge legs pad+ma 'god bzhin du/ /bod yul dbus kyi phyogs su dal gyis gshegs//de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa shing pho stag gi lo gong ma'i bka' bzhin lha sras bcu bdun pa kheng zi chido wang dang lhan du rgyal khab chen po nas chibs bskyod gnang ba la/ thu'u bkwan rin po ches gtso ba'i pe'i cing gi bla ma rnams dang / dpon che chung du mas chibs skyel mdzad/thu'u bkwan rin po ches thugs shin tu skyo ba'i rnam pa mdzad ci ra da ni rang re dpon slob sku tshe 'dir mjal phrad mi yong bas phyi mar mjal ba'i thugs 'dun mdzad dgos zhes gsungs pa de kho na bzhin byung 'dug de nas rim gyis phebs pas mgar thar nas 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pas mgron gnyer nang so blo bzang dkon mchog phebs bsur gnang ba ha lo phan du 'byor/ dar rtse mdor/ rgyal ba'i yab rje dang / sde ba sding chen nas drung 'khor kha shas bcas bsu bar slebs cing gsung shog gnang rten

154 gong ma'i bka' banin rgyal dbang mchog potalarikhrirabano/datshul/ da rnams phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyin mgar thar du sleb rgyu'i thog nagi ra rgya nag lugs kyi rol chas sogs dang / de rjes rta ba'i tshogs tshar du dngar ba'i dbus su7gong ma'i gser yig dang / de rjes lha sras/ mchog sprul rin po che/ am pan ne ge gsum/ khi yā drugadapon chung mang po/ ru mtshon bsgrong ba'i dmag dpung bcas gzi brjid che bar phebs/ rgyang ring tsam nas grwacang gnyis kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i ser sbrengs dang / de nas zhwa lu mkhan po/ ser 'bras kyi dpon slob rnams/ yab rje/ sding chen nas sogs kyis bsus/ gtsug lag khang gi yang thog tu rol cho/ 'bud dkrol sna tshogs pa dang lha bsangs/ dar 'phyar sogs rgyas pa gnang / lcags ri'i phyi rol nas thams cad chibs las bshol te gser yig bkur sti chen po dang bcas rgya sgor slebs pa na/ gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa la/ mkhan chen sdo rje 'chang / sku mdun sngags ram pa sogs kyis zhabs phyi zhus te phebs pa dang mjal 'dzom mdzad/ de nas rgyal dbang rin po che dbus dang / lha sras chen po dang mchog sprul rin po che g.yas g.yon byas nas rim gyis 'du khang chen mor phebs/ gong ma'i gser yig bsgrags thog gnang rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams phul/ lha sras kyis mjal dar rtse sprod dang / sprul sku rin po che nas mjal dar phul te phyag dbang zhus/ gong sa rin po che khrir phebs thogagyigong ma'i mdzod nas gsol ston rgyas pa zhus shing gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ bzhugs grwal grol nas mtshams zhig la snyil skyu rin po che phyag g.yog pa rnams dang bcas7

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 155gong sa rin po che'i sku drung du phebs te thog ma'i mjal 'dzom rten 'brel du dngos 'bul mi nyur tsam dang bcas mjal kha zhus/ yun ring tsam lhan du bzhugs shing / gong sa mchog nas bkur bzos chen po sa dgyes pa'i bka' mchid lhug stsol dang / sprul sku rin po che nas kyang thugs dad lhag par 'phel bas gus pa lhur len mdzad/ 7gong nas rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen ngag dbang mchog ldan pa la rgyal ba'i zhabs 'degs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba'i legs skyes su zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed a chi thu no mon han zhes pa'i cho lo stsal cing gser tham gnang skyes du ma dang bcas yod pa rnams phul nas mjal 'phrad thog gsung gleng zhib rgyas mdzad/ sang nyin 'du khang du rgyal ba'i dbang bo gtso bor bzhugs te/ lha sras dang mchog sprul rin po che/am pan sogs mi sna che chung thams cad la bod lugs kyi gsol ston rgyas pa gnang / 'di lo bod rtsis la zla ba brgyad pa bshol yang / rgya rtsis 'i bshol blo med pas/ lha sras nas rgya rtsis dang bstun dgos tshul zhusasapa ltar lo gsar snga bsnur mdzad pa'i yos lo'i tshes gcig gi nyin rgyal dbang mchog la lo gsar rten 'brel gyi mjal kha zhus shing dbang rjes gnang lung khrid sogs zhus pa'i snyan gsan phul bar dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang la yang 'grel ba bzhi sbrag dang khrid chen brgyad sogs zhu ba'i snyan gsan phul bar/ sprul sku rin po che nyid bod du phebs rgyu yin gshis 'grogs yun ring tsam yong ba 'dug pas/ ngas khyed la mkhas grub rin po che'i dkar chags tho'i yig chung gi dgongs pa bzhin

156 gong mali bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/dge lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags phyogs kyi chos bka' yongs su rdzogs pa zhig byed ces dgyes pa chen sngos zhal bzhes mdzad/ /shar nub rgya bod yul gru'i mtsho chen las/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'khor lo'i lag ldan gsum/ /ring mo zhig nas 'brel ba'i mdza' gcugs kyis/ /mgar thar rdzing bu'i ngogs su lhan cig 'dzom/ /brtse ba'i gter chen gangs rtan 'gro ba'i masgon/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin mkhan chen rdo rte rnortashā / ༷/mkhrin preb dbang phyug rol pa'i rdo rje ste/ /rigs gsum̐m rmegorno po lhan du gdan 'dzom nas/ ༷ /༷chos disdo srid kyi dga' ston yo lang gis/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho ngoms pa la/ /sngo bsangs bu mos nyin mtshan re mos su/ /rab gsal nyi zla'i mig gis lta ba bzhin/ /gyirgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i drung nas/thog mar ma rgyud kyi gtso bo byin rlabs kyi gter tu gyur pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa pū i pa'i lugs lha drug cu re gnyis pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi sta gon dang / de'i nyin phyi mar dngos gzhi'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ 'di nyid7rgyal dbang mchog nas dge 'dun tshogs pa mang bo la dbang chen gnang ba'i thog ma yin 'dug pas/ rje bla ma 'di nyid7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'byed du gyur pa'i rten 'brel rmad du byung bar snang / slar yang rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang bca'adus pa 'phags lugs kyi mi bskyod rdo rje'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du nyin dang por sta gon dang / phyi ma'i nyin dbang dngos gzhi'i rim pa rnam sa smi na rgyas su cu'// snga phyir dbang gsan ma khan kyang /

gi5 skya/'ibaka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 157 mkhan chen dz+wa rje 'char ngag dbang mchog ldan/ mtsha3 nyid zhabs phyi bla ma lnga/ grwa tshang gnyis kyi dge bshes rnams dang bcas mkhas pa'i dbang bo du ma bzhugs shing / rgyal dbang mchog nas kyang dbang gi skabs kyi gsung bshad zab cing rgya che ba/ phyag len phra mo yan chad sla chos su ma song ba'i ngos gtsang ba sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' dag mngon sum lta bur gsal bar mdzad pas rje+o bla ma nyid thugs tshim pa'i phul du gyur par snang / der bzhugs ring la nyin phal mo cher sku mdun du phebs par dam pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng mtha' yas pa stsal pas nyin re bzhin yang chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen 'phel bar gyur/ yang rje bla ma nyid kyis zhus pa bzhin rgyal ba'i ba/sung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lam srol/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad mthar thug byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos ma dzad pa'i khrid yig 'jam dpal zhal lung gi thog nas zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du nyin re bzhin chos thun re ma chag pa gnang / 'di dus thog mtha' bar gyi phyag len rnams rje sgrub khang pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol ltar/ gdams ngag la nges pa bskyed pa'i yan lag gzhung chen mo rnams kyi rgyab rten/ bshad don bde blag tu go ba'i yan lag dbe dang gtan tshigs dam pa gong ma'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan te/ dmigs rim rnams myong thog nas gsungs pas rgyud thog tu 'dril zhing / go ba 'byams klas pa sos/sa mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pari gsung bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang / khrid gzhung gi skyo ra dpon yang sprul sku rin po che rang nas mdzad

158 pongamaḍi—pakatram̐baninargyaladabang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ paragyirgyal ba'i dbang bo thugs dgyes tshor chen po rma dzad/ gyirgyal ba'i dbang bo dbus phyogs su chibs bsgyur nye bas skyes bu chen po'i mar shes kyi mtsharma sa su 'jog pa gnang / gzhan yang sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sprags kyi rjes gnang dang de'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / 7rgyal dbang nyid kyi gsung 'bum nas chos tshan mang tsam gyi ljags lung / sprul sku rin po che dang a chi thu chos rje rnam gnyis la dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo la las bzhi'i lha mos bskor ba'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa bka' drin du stsal/lam khrid gsan skabs rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i gros 'debs gser zhun 'khyil ba zhes bya ba mdzad pa 'di ltar ro// na mo gu ru/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus 'gro 'dren slad/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin zab rgyas chos/ /ma sbas lhug par 'dom sa mdzad skyabs kyi mchog /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen tshogs la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rnyed dka' 'ji ga sla don che'i dal 'byor rten/ /rnyed kyang 'di snang bya bas rtag g.yengs nas/ /don med 'da' zhing gtan bde bsgrub nus kyang / /mi bskrub 'di ko bdud kyis bslus par nges/ /ma rungs 'chi bdag dgra de 'ong nges shing / /nam 'ong cha med 'ong tshe mi 'jigs pa'i/ /gdengs mi 'tshol bar blo bde gnyid log 'dis/ tsho /bstan dang mjal ba don med byas kyis dogs/ /da lta bkres skom phra mo'ang bzod dka' na/ /duḥkhas rtag mnar ngan song ji ltar bzod/ /de las skyob pa'i skyabs cig mi 'tshol ba/ /khyod snying lcags gong las kyang sra bar nges/ /bka' dang bstan bcos du mar

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 159mjal mod kyang / /rang sems rgyud steng nyams su ma blangs pas/ /mi dge bcu spong tsam ya nga mi bsgrub pa/ /kyi hud rig sngags mthu yis rmongs sam ci/ /'jig rten mes po'i dpal yang spu gri yi/ /sor chags sbrang rtsi lta bur legs gsungs na/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor 'di la chags pa yis/ /'khor ba'i gting rdo byed tshul ma rtogs sam/ 1srid rtsa gzhom byed thabs mang ston pa yi/ /gzhung kun thos dang bsams pas legs rtogs kyang / /de don mi bsgrub 'di snang bya bas g.yel/ /khyod la thar ba'i gdengs ni ci zhig yod/ /drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal me 'bar 'obs su/ tshud pa la/ /ji mi snyam pa'i gzhung ngan rgyud rengs po/ /khyod ḍā/sa lhag pa'i ma rungs gzhan na gang/ /theg chen rgyal sras kun gyi thugs dam mthil/ /rin chen sems mchog bskyed la mi 'bad par/ /sngags lam zab mo 'tshol bar brtson pa skad/ /byed pa bstan pa'i gnad rnams stor ba'i rtags/ /pha rol phyin drug bsdu bani nyams bstar tshul/ /tshogs chung tshosgre/sa gnyis bde blag rdzogs pa'i thabs/ /mi bsgrub 'khor pa'i rgyu rga/tso chos brgyad la/ /rab brtson khyod ni sems med nyid du zad/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub byed rdo rje theg /dam sdom legs bsrung rim gnyis rnal 'byor la/ /brtson pa spangs te mnog chung bya bas 'da'/ /khyod ko blo ldan rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs bcud mdo sngags lam gnad kun/ /gsal la 'dril bar blo bzang grags pa yis/ /legs gsungs gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsukha gyis/ /nyin mtshan 'bad pas

160 gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mtshog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/brtson par ma byas na/ /'jigs rung brtse bral gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /gnyen bshes zas nor lus dang phral byas te/ /gcig pur mi 'dod gnas su 'khrid pa'i tshe/ /rab 'gyod sdug bsngal drag pos ma nar gyis dogs/ /de bas da lta nyid nas sngon byon gyi/ /mkhas gru ba myo/ lus gshegs shul lam bzang la/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzhin legs spyongs te/ /nyams su bstar bas dal 'byor don ldan mdzod/ /deng dus gzur gnas blo ldan nyin skar tsam/ /chos bzhin bros 'debs de bas dkon par gda'/ /des na rang sems chos dang zhu gtugs kyis//rnam g.yeng chos brgyad dgra 'di btul na legs/ /thabs shes zung 'brel spyod la brtson na legs/ /bzlas brjod me lce rtag tu sbar na legs/ /nyon mongs bud shing rtsad nas bsregasan legs/ /rim gnyis spyod pas sku gsum bsgrub na legs/ /rang sems chos la bskul ba'i gros 'debs 'di/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis legs par bsdebs/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba spangs te tshe gcig la/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces gros 'debs gser zhun 'khyil ba 'di ni dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sku skye ngag dbang chos grags kyis rang lo bcu dgu bar bod du 'gro ba'i lam bar du mi nyag sgang gi sa'i char/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dus gsuca/ bde gshegs kun gyi rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang bskal bzang rgya myori tsho'i zhabs drung du/ /byang chub lam mirim pa'i khrid kyi bka' drin nod pa'i tshe rang dang grogs gzur gams rnams la phan pa'i slad du sbyar

snang ma'e bka' baX /na rgyal dbangamachogapotala'ikhrirabako— da—tshul /wa— 161ba'i yi ge pa ni tshul khrims chos 'phel gyis bgyis pa na ge legs su gyu ra cig /ces pa'o/ /mgar thar du bzhugs pa dang bod du phebs ju5 'i lam bar sogs su rgyal dbang mchog la bla dpon dang dad ldan ser skya ci rigs kyis zhus ngor lung khrid rjes gnang sogs kyi 'dod chos gang gnang phal cher gsan 'dug kyang zhib par ma nges pas 'dir 'god ma nus so/ /rgyal kun snying rje lha skur shar ba ni/ /spyan ras gzigs te de nyid gangs can gyi/ /'gro ba'i mgon du ngur smrig rnam rol par/ /rgyal dbang mthong ba don ldan zhes su grags/ /mgon de rang gi zag med ye shes nyid/ /rten dang brten par sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gtso bor bzhengs nas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa'i/ /rigs lnga rgyal ba'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /zhing khams kun 'gengs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /seng ge'i khri la rgyal sras khyod bkod nas/ /me tog char phabs shis brjod glu blangs te/ /gsang chen bsta na pari bdag por mnga' gsol mdzag /de tshe khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis / /rgyal ba'i gdung gsob rig 'dzin sras mchog la/ /chos kyi rgyal srid yongs su gtad do zhes/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis zhing khams kun bsgrags pas/ /bdud kyi sde rnams mya ngan khang bur zhugs/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs/ /dus mtha' 'di yang mgon dang bcas so zhes/ /rgyal ba rnams ni dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bzhad//mgar thar du bzhugs dus der7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigs kyi cod paṇa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ngag dbang mchog ldan pa/ rje bla ma

16〉 gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchogepotala'ikhrirabakod/tshu la/ nyid kyi bzhugs sa/shag tu phebs nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde la ma gyi ri dmar khrid semaṣ+kabaskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa nyin bco lnga'i ring smin rgyas su gnang / de nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang thang sag pa gnyis kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid yig gi steng nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dmar khrid dang / gsang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnyis rdzogs par gnang zhing / rim lnga gsal sgron gyi shog ldeb nyis brgya skor gyi bshad pa dang / zhagrel ba bzhi sprags rgyud mchod snga ma dang le'u dang po yan grub pa mdzad nas/ rten 'brel gyi khyad che bas rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad pa'i mjug bod du phebs nas dga' ldan rang du grub pa gnang rgyu dang / 'grel ba'i rgyud mchod phyi ma rje'i gser gdung chen mo'i drung du byed dgos zhes mtshams 'jog pa gnang / nub cig rje bla ma mchog gi mnal lam du/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang paṇa zhwa ser po lde thu nga mnabs pa'i rgya gar paṇa chen gyi cha byad du byon nas/ kho bo sangs rgyas bskyangs yin pa shes sam gsungs pa rmis/ phyi nyin bla ma la mnal lam de 'dra byung tshul zhus par/ zhal nas/ slob ma dad pa can gyis bla ma zog por gtong zer ba yin/ kha rog sdod/ khyod rang la dad pa yod na de kas chog gsungs nas bzhad mo mdzad/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi gzim gshag tu mjal bar phebs pa'i nyin gcig rje sgrub khang pa'i thugs dam 'jigs byed kyi sku thang sogs ston pa mdzad nas/ sprul sku rin po che ched gtad kyis khri mthon po zhig bshams pa la bzhugs su gsol/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa/ drung ba rta

d+ngha — ā+oṃng ḍihūṃljokaḍi— ḍine+e spro——pa dbang mchog ngo/ ta la'ikhrir bskad tshul/dzi 163 phug pa dam chos rgyal mtshan dang rje sgrub khang pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i nang rten du bzhugs pa da gnang nas/ khyed kyis byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas 'gro don gang spyogs dang / rang nyid bde gsang 'jigs gsum la sku tshe hril bor thugs dam byed pa dang / 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags 'a'irtags thon pa zhig cis kyang mdzod/ rje bla ma'i bstan pa dngagyigong sa mchog gi 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'degaru/ gzhan dang mi 'dra ba nges par yong zhes sogs kyi zhal ta 'doms par mdzad/ 'di ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyis/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa rin po che'i bdag por mnga' gsol te/ phyis 'byung gi don rnams lung ston par mdzad pa ste slad nas de kho na bzhin byung ba kun la mngon sum gyi grub pa 'di bzhin no/ /nang du risapu gnyis rtogs pa'i klong brdol yang / /phyi ru 'dul ba'i kun spyod phra zhib kyi/ /mdo sngags 'gal med spyod pa'i sdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag la dbang 'byor mchog gi dpal ldan pa/ /gang gi zhal bzang sprin sdoṅge las 'ongs pa'i/ ༷ /gsang chen bdud rtsi'i char rgyun nyin bzhin du/ /babs pas khyod thugs chu gter rab rgyas te/ /bshad sgrub rlabs kyi phreng bas mdzes par gyur/ /gang thugs shes bya ma lus 'char ba'i snod/ /ye shes me long gtsang mar phyis 'byung gzugs/ /gsal bar bkra rnams lung bstan mdzub tshugs kyis/ /'di dang 'di zhes khyod la ston par mdzad/ /rdzun lung srin bya rgod pas blun po'i yid/ /re dogs rgya ru 'dzud pa der mang yang / /bslu med thog tu 'bab pa tshad ma'i

da waram̐64 gongama'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bskud tshul/ lung / /'di 'dra ston pa u dusmra ra'i spun/ /gong sa rin po che bod du chibs kha bat+ya ra ba'i nyim/ kha shas kyi sngon du mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang hor phyogs su phyag bteg /yos lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi nyinagyigong sa thams cad mkhyen pa dbus phyogs su zhabs kyi pad+mo bskyod pas rje 'a di ba yang lhan cig tu phebs/ nyag chu kha la ma phebarme bar du 'brum nyen gyis dregs zhan su la yang mjal kha ma btang kyang rje nyid nyin ltar gyis sku mdun du phebs shing gsung gleng smar ba byung /'brum nyen 'a sa grol nas li thang thub chen byams pa gling du phebs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ya nga phebs rjes zin nas yab sras gsum ka gdan 'dzom/ de nas bzung lha sar phebs kyi bar zla ba bzhi'i ring la nyin bzhinagyirgyal dbang mchog gi bzhugs shag khad shin tu nye zhing nyi ma yang ring dus yi na pa bcas bzhugs shag nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gis sprul sku rin po cher 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi chos thun rgyas pa re ma chapo pa gnang / chibs rag dang gsol tshigs sogs kyang lhan tu gnang nas gsung 'phros tshul gyis mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad du ma lhug par gsungs pa sogs chos kyi dga' ston kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ mgar thar nas lha sa'i bar thag nye ring ci rigs kyis bla dpon che chung / dgon sgrub sde/ lha sde mi sde ris su ma chad pa/sa7gong sa thams cad mkhyen par phebs bsu( gsol ston/ 'bul nor sogs dang / mjal kha phyag dbang zhu mkhan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa rnams kyis rje bla ma 'di nyid la yang bkur ste rim gro dang da da guri ṭa lhur len pa byung 'dug kyang zhib tu

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchogapotala'ikhrirabakodatshul/ —165 wa brjod na ha cang yig tshogs che bar 'gyur bas ma smos so/ /gi po gnas nang bya ba karma dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs grub thob kyi skyes bu dam pa mang bos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can/ bde mchog gi yul nyer bzhi'i nang tshan ka ma rū par grags pa de'i mdar bzhugs zhag skabs/mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ gnas 'di byin rlabs shin tu che bas rang re dpon slob gnas 'brel zhig mdzad na dgos pa che gsu/ngas pa bzhin/ mkhan chen dang mchog sprul rin po che lhan cig par gnas nang rtedu phebs/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi cho ga dang tshogs 'khor rgyas par mdzad skabs phu mda'i gangs ri rnams las 'ja' sprin0ya mtshan can sna tshogs shar zhing char zim bu 'babs pa dang / gangs ri gtso bo'i zhal gyi thad smug pa 'thibs pa dpyid glu gnang skabs sathong phye ste gangs zhal gsal bar ston pa sogs rten 'brel shin tu bzang ba byung / /'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang tha mal gyi/ /chu bur mi ga la sa 'dzin ltar snang ba/ /ke po zhes grags ga nas glen nyer bzhi yi/ /lto gyal ka ma rū dang gnyis med pa/ /rtse mo gangs dkar shel gyi cod paṇa bcings/ /rked pa 'khri shing nags kyi do shal ma dzis/ /smad du spang ljongs gsar ba'i sham thabs klubs/ /nyin bzhin na bun rked ching bcing bkrol byed/ /der ni gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /sprin bzhin 'du ba gnas nang zhes grags pa/ /gangs kyi seng ge lta bu'i rtogs ldan rnams/ /gnyug ma'i rang zhal lta ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor lhan skyes bde ba cher/ /sdom mdzad he ru ka yi

166 mtha ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'ikhrir bkod tshul/ da wadakyil 'khor lha/ /dgyes skyed tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin gtibs nas/ /rdo rje'i glu yi dbyar rnga brdung ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa dgyes pa'i 'al/ /yab sras zung gi gzigs mor bstan pa la/ /tha mal skye bos smug pa'i g.yogs bsal nas/ /gangs zhal bstan ces ca co sgrog par byed/ /de nas rim gyis phebs pas brag g.yab kyis char nye ba'i shis po la thog bya bar brag g.yab sprul ṇ+ḍaṃsku che tshang dpon g.yog lnga brgya skor chibs bsur phebs/ de skabs brag g.yab dang sa tshigs gzhan zhig dos hos rim gtong ba la ma 'cham par 'khrugs long byung bas/ rje /ra sku ngo g.yog rnams mtsho na cha thogs pa'i dmag chas mdzad 'dug pa dang zhag babs su chang bzhes pa sogs sku spyod rtsing ba la rje 'di ba thugs ma rangs pas gzims gur du phyag g.yog pa rnams la sprul sku'i mdzad pa la skyon 'dogs kyi gsung gleng mang zhig gnang / de nub mnal lam du mi dmar po shin tu che ba bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon cing mdung ring 'dzin pa zhig gis/khyod kyis nga'i bla ma blo ldan shes rab la skur ba zhus pa zer ma das/'a ba'i rnam pa ci yang byed pa zhig rmis/ brag g.yab tu phebs nas sprul pa'i skus khong rang gi bzhugs gnas kyi rten gsum rnams dang / khyad par du gsang phu bse khrab pa'i sku zob zhig 'dug pa do gal chen pos ston par mdzad pas sngar thugs rmis su byung ba de jitsho lta ba bzhin 'dug pas zhal kyal shor ba la thugs 'gyod byung / dngos su zhu na phod kyang gos chen legs pa kha shas rgya nas phebs pa'i skyos ma yin tshul gyis phul te thugs spyis bshaskus pa dang / khong rang gi rnam 'grel zhig ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i

ri gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mtshog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 167dbu tshugs 'dug pa mjug mthar phyin pa grub par mdzad rgyu'i bskul ma yang zhus pa yin zhes rje nyid kyi zhal nas dngos su thos/ 'di las 'phros te skyes bu dmyo/ pa gar yod su yin mi shes pas/ khyed cag rang snang la shar ba gtan tshigs su bkod nas gzhan la zur za skyon 'dogs kyi gtam mang du gtong ba 'di rang nyid 'phung ba'i las yin pas dag snang sbyong ba gal che zhes bdag cag la yang yang nan tan du 'doms par mdzad/brag g.yab sprul sku nas7gong sa rin po cher 'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo'i bshad lung rgyas par zhus pa'ang gsan/ rim gyis/ chab mdor phebs/ zhi bzang sprul sku sogs kyis gus 'dud lhur len mjad/ ri bo cher stag lung sprul sku mjal phrad mdzad cing mnyam med sangs rgyas dbon gyi dus 'khor gyi blos bslang dang dbyibs mtshungs su bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang / rten gyi gtso bo rgya gar rno rje gdan gyi ma hā bo thā la dpe bgyis pa'i thub pa'i snang brnyan sogs rten gsum byin rlabs can mang du bzhugs pa la rten mjal zhib bar gnang / gtsang nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas phebs bsu pa blo bzang yar 'phel la gsung shog gnang ba phyag tu phul/ de nas rim gyis phebs pas dbu ma'i mdor dga' ldan khri ba rgyal mtshan seng ge /rgyal sras sprul sku 'jigs med ye shes grags pa/ grub dbang sems dpa' sprul sku/ 'ol dga' rje drung sprul sku/ rta tshag rje drung sprul sku/ shar rtse kyi+o sa rje/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma las sne/ mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas/ dga' bzhi gung / bka' blon mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal/ thon pa sri chod tshe brtan/ 'asbong rtse

da wa1tram̐8— gongama'ibaka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/nayosogs bod mi che dgu stong phrag brgal bra7gong sa rin po che'i phebs bsur 'byor/ rje bla ma snyed la yang so sos sger mjal dang bod du phebs pa'i thog ma'i legs skyes sogs phul/ 'di dus ser 'bras kyi bla ma dge bshes sku drung du phebs pa rnams la dka' gnad kyi dogs dpyod dang 'bel gtam mang du mdzad pas khengs pa can rnams kyi spobs pa bcom/gzu bor gnas pa rnams sngon ma thos pa'i legs par bshad pa'i bdud sgyu rtsis yid tshim pas/ thamyo/sa cad kyis bod dbus gtsang gi grwa sa chen por slob gnyer la sbyangs pa'i ngal ba ma mdzad par rgyal khab chen por bzhugs nas gzhung chen k+ko rnams kyi dka' ba'i gnad gang la yang thogs pa med ripa'i thugs gnyer 'di lta bu yong pa nges par sku tshe snga ma rnams su paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku'i skye ba mang du bzhes dus kyi yon tan thams cad ma brjed par byon pa yin 'dug ces bstod bsngags 'ba' zhig gri+o ga par gyur/ de dag gi khrod na sgo mang dpon slob chos gras/sa bya ba pu ti thams cad dang khyad par du rnam 'grel la mkhas par grags shing / rang nyid kyang mkhas pa'i khur 'khyer ba zhig yod pa des/ dang po rje nyid dang ma mjal gong du da resagyirgyal ba rin po che'i chibs bsur 'gro dgos 'dug pas lcang skya zhabs drung la sgo mang ba'i la rgya tsam gyis mjal ba zhig mi byed ka meng 'dug gos chen gyi na bza' sogs 'phyor chas legs pa la sa yon tan gyi re ba ci yod zer ba sogs kha mang du btang / rje nyid dang mjal ba'i ja gral du ser 'bras kyi bla ma thams cad 'a dzom pa'i dbu ri smu su/ rje nyid nas sgo mang dpon slob rnam 'grel la mkhas zhes thos pas rang re rnam 'grel laca/

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 16nya brtsams pa'i 'phros pa zhig bgyis na ci 'dra yong phebs par/ chos grags na re/ rnam 'grel la sbyangs pa dga' mo byas khul yin pas sprul pa'i sku nas bka' dri gnang na lan 'bul rgyu lag ma thogs tsam yong 'gro zhes zer/ de la rje bla ma mchog nas lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags kyi skor las brtsamasag te bsgro gleng mdzad par/ dang po lan phyogs re tsam 'bul rgyu rnyed cing /ṅge yang ngar ngar lta bu byed pa la skabs zhig nas ci zer 'di zer med pa dang dngos 'gal la lan gsum tsam bud pas/ bla ma gzhan thams cad kyang bzhad gad theg ge ba dang bcas 'ga' zhig gis rje bla ma mchog gi thugs rig dang rnam dpyod kyi spobs pas yid drangs te thal mo sbyor/ la las bla ma chos grag/sa pyi / ne na 'asnobs rgyu ma byung ba la sun 'byin gyi shag brgyab pas/ chos grags gdong dmar hur re rngul churi thigs pa bla gos kyis dbye bze/na rgun dus kyi khu byug gi ngang tshul la gnas par gyur/de nas kho sngon / ra 'bras spungs su slebab/ nas sgo mang gi chos grwa/re tshogs lab tu/ byang pha gi na dge bshes sngo sang nge ba zhig phebs gi 'dugangs khong grwa sar thugs gnyer ma mdzad pas mtshan nyid kyi bsgro gleng de tsam med 'gro snyam kyang / mis yon tan thams cad nang nas shar ba zhig yin 'dug dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir nged rang sngar rtsod pa pham pa zhig mi dran yang da res sprul sku gzhon nu des nged rang kha grags rgyu med pa bzos song / khyed tsho dge bshes chen po yin zer ba tsho sang gnang mjal skabs thugs rig ma bsgrim na sngo lo 'phyar 'jug pa la tshegs mi 'dug zer ba sogs lab bdug

1ṅgā0 gong ma'i bka' ba'in rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir babo/da tshul/legs/ bshad chab kyis rtag par brlan pa'i ljags/ /gdams ngag 'doms la pad+ma'i 'dab ltar mnyen/ /rgol ba 'jom la spu gri'i so ltar rno/ /'di ni mkhas rnams ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i 'phrul/ /dri med rigs pa'i gad rgyang gcig gis kyang / /sa gsum 'dar byed smra ba'i seng ge khyod/ /yul dbus gangs ri'i ljongs su lhags pa na/ /mkhas rlom wa tshogs smra bcad rdzu la brten/ /de nas rim gyis phebs te/ rwa sgreng pa'i thab bsu'i bzhugs gral du7gong sa rin po che nas/ rje 'di ba dang 'ol dga' rje drung sprul sku rnam gnyis la rten 'brel gyi khyad dbu ma'i lta ba'i skor gyi 'phros gleng mdzod phebs par brten lta ba las brtsams pa'i brgal brtag mang du mdzad par rgyal ba'i dbang po thugs shin tu dgyes/rwa sgrong du phebs ma/sa jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / dbu yon ma che chung gis gtso ba'i rten rnams dang 'brom gyi gzims phug sogaṭari/ 'a tsāng thams cad la zhib mjal mdzad cing / lha khang gi 'gag tu rgya' ba'i dbang bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang lhan cig par spyan 'dren khrus gsog gnas brtan phyag mchod/ smon lam sogs rgyas par mdzad/ jo bo'i sku dbu yon ma che chung sogs rgyal ba'i gzims chung du spyan drangs/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang / je 'di ba rnams lhan du gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod dang tshos/sa 'khor rgyas pa mdzad/7rgyal ba —rin po che rwa sgrong gi chos /phrir phebs nas tshogs yongs la rje 'di pas zhus pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub nor bu'i bang ma dzod kyi lung gnang ba gnas dang gang zag chos gsum ga 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel phun

gingamaṇamobaka'—baninargyaladabang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 1gle1 sum tshogs pa 'grig nyin gcig phyi skor du phebs/ bstan pa'i chu dūn ring mor sku khrus gnang / 'brom gyi sku gdung bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum gyis gtso ba'i bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i sku sa/dung bzhugs pa'i 'bum pa rnams la mjal/ yang dgon dang dgon pa gong du rje'i chos khri dang nang rten 'bum nag ma sogs rten gsum dang / mchod rten brgya rtsa shug pa ming chen sogs mjal/ gnas der rgyal dbang yab sras rje 'di ba rje drung sprul sku rnams lhan cig pas dpal 'alo/ ra lo sdom pa'i sgrub mchod mdzad cing / tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad skabs 'ol das/'a rje drung sprul pa'i skus sems mi 'gyur ma'i mgur dbyangs 'then pas thugs 'khul ba byung / phyir phebs lam du shug gseb nas slong mo ba 'dra ba gos kyi phrag pa phud pa'i phu thung gnyis phrag par bkal ba zhig blo bur du thon byung par/ ( mkhan chen sdo rje 'chang nas rje 'di pa la bal ṭaṃ 'dra yod na byin cig gsungs pas/ phyag g.yog tsho la ṭaṃ ka e yod bka' 'dri gnang ba'i bar der gar song cha med du gyur de res nga rang gi ma byung ba ma gtogs 'brom rin po che yin 'dra zhes rje nyid nas dngos su gsung ba thos shing / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bdag gi sprul pa dam pa cig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /zhes pa nas/ res 'ga' dbul phongs sbrang bo'i gzugs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu yin par sems/mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi pho brang du grags pa'i pha bong rtsar rgyal ba chibs bshol nas bskor ba gnang / rje 'di ba dang phyag g.yog pa rnams dang bcas pas dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dang bde mchog gi shis brjod mdzad

172 gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog bo ta la'i khrir bkod tshul /pas/ nub phyogs kyi bha ga'i dbyibs can gyi brag gi bu ga nas blo bur du chu brdol ba thams cad kyis longs spyod rgyu byung / 7rgyal ba'i dbang bor gnas 'di shin tu ya mtshan pa 'dug pas ming zhig gnang dgos zhus kyang zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa las ming dngos su ma gnang /spruX ba'i gnas mchog dpal gyi rwa sgrong du/ /spruldu pa'i skyes mchog du ma lhan cirga/ 'dzom/ /sdil pa'i glegs bam nyid las gsungs pa bzhin/ /spruX pa'i bkaud pa ngo mtshar dpag yas bstanā/ /gsang chen rdo rje'i glu yis mkha' 'gro ma/ /gasrung ba ye shes rjes chags bskul ba las/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo las 'ongs pa'i/ /gsata rdzas dpa' bo'i tshogs la mchod par stabs/ /'brom rje yab sras khyelda kyi sdonarī byung gi /rnam thar ma lus phyi —rol dngos pos kyang / /las can rnams la ngoms pa 'di lta na/ /oṃn tan sbed pa'i thugs ngal 'dis ci bya/ /de nas sta ga lung pho mdor phebs nas rten mjal sogs zhib par gnang / dngos grub gling khar grub pa'i dbang phyug rje don yod mkhas grub phebs pa dang mjal/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang nas lcang skya sprul sku rin po che 'di ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med pa 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig yin tshul gnang bar/ rje don yod mkhas grub kyis/ 'o de nged kyis yag po shes pa yod/ rje 'di ba'i sku gong ma dang nged cag khri chen blo bzang don yod kyi drung du lan mang du mjal/ khong gis rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa mang rab mdzad pas mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud ma lus pa grol ba'i lag rjes yin pa 'dug gsungs/ rje 'di la khyod kyis sgotso

gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir bkod tshul/ 173sgrub la 'bad pa thon cig thos pas mang po shes mi yong / sgom pas mang po shes yong ba yin ces gsungs/ bla ma mkhas grub pa'i gsung de nges par thugs mad pa 'dug ces phyis su yang yang gsung / 'bum steng du bzhugs zhag gnang skabs mkhan chen sdo rje 'chang nas rje 'di ba la dur khrod klu mo rgyal du 'gro gsung / der phebs nas dur khrod kyi dbus su bzhugs te yab sras gnyis kyis bde mchog gi tshogs 'khor dpyid glu dang bcas pa mdzad cing mkhan chen thugs nyams 'ur ba'i gsung gleng ngo mtshar can mang du gnang / de nas rim gyis phebs pas bod kyi sprul sku dang bla dpon che dgu yod do cog rgyal ba'i phebs bsur byon pa thams ca rke kyis rje 'di ba la'ang gus 'dud lhur len pa mdzad/ kun gzigs lnga ba rgya nas phebs skabs thog mar khyams ra chen mor phebs pa rten 'brel 'phrod lam che ba byung ba bzhin/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo thog mar lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra chen mor phebs nas gser khrir bzhugs phral du/ rje bla ma 'di nyid nas gdan sa chen po 'dir chibs kha bsgyur ba tsa/nga ci'i rten 'brel legs shing / slad du'ang bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par zhabs pad bska la brgyar brtan ngos/ thub bstan spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu dar zhing rgyas pa mdzad dgos tshul gyi zhu ba dang legs 'bul phul/ de nas thub pa'i dbang bo dnges dang khyad par ma mchis pa jo bo shākya mu ne/ rang byon lnga ldan/ rje nga 'gran ma sogs lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang gi steng 9ོnog bar gsum gyi rten rnams la rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang lhan cig tu mjal

174 gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal dbang mchog po ta la'i khrir balko/da tshul/ ba gnang zhing spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ yan lag bdun pa sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa rgyas pa gnang / gzhung nas bzhugs gnas khrom gzigs khang gsar du me ribasgrigs 'dug pas der phebs/ phyi nyin e wam du gsol ston gyi bzhugs gral du phebs/ phur bu lcog nas rje bla ma byams pa'i mtshan can rgyal dbang rin po cher mjal bar phebs pa'i zhar la khrom gzigs khang du rje 'di ba dang mjal phrad mdzad par phebs 'dug na'ang / de dus rgyal ba rin po che dang srid skyong pho lha ba thugs nang ha cang gtsang rgyu med pa dang / rje bla ma byams pa rin po che pho lha pa'i bla mar song ba bcas phan tshun thugs rtogs/ mdzad ris kyis thugs gshin pa rang zhig ma byung ba 'dra/ de nas re zhig gi bar nyin bzhin gsol ston dang mjal phrad zhu mi mang ba sogs kyis thugs brel shin tu che ba byung / tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin rgyal ba'i dbang bo pho brang chen po po ta lar phebs nas tshom chen rnying ba'i gser khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod pa la/ thog mar rje 'di bas mjal dar phul zhing / bkra shis lhun po nas brtan bzhugs dang / gzhung— nas gsol ston rgyas par zhus/ gza' skar bzang bo'i nyin rje bla ma nyid nas rgyu kyon sbyar te rnam rgyal grwa tshang nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas bden tshig brjod pa dang chab gcig par/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos phyag gis gnang ba'i byi ru 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sku brnyan khyad mtshar sogs dang / gser dz+wangul gos dar/spyad pa ngo mtshar ba sna tshogs dang bcas/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan brjod pa sdon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i

gongama'ibaka3bazhinargyaladabang mchog po ta la'i khrir bskud tshul/ 1lhabye ngang tshul la thutrasna/sdosmo skyo ba med par zhabs pad bskal pa rgya makyi+o'i bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos tshul sogs dpe dang gtan tshigs lung rigs du ma'i sgo nas tshig snyan cing 'jebs pa dag cing gsal bas bcos min gyi dad gus shugs drag pos nan tan du gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa la/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo thugs dgyes pa'i sgo nas zhal bzhes kyang bzang po gnang / /ris med bstan 'gro'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /rgyal dbang nam mkha'i nor bu mgon po 'di'i/ /'phrin las rta ljang shing rta la bcibs nas/ /gangs can bsod nams shar ri'i rtse la 'dzegs/ /sdon tshe shākya'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /rmad byung rdzu 'phrul bkod pa mtha' yas pas/ /bu rwam shing 'phel grong du gshegs pa yi/ /ngo mtshar dus mtha' 'dir ya/nga gsal bar gyur/ /thugs ba skyed rdzogs ldan sprin gyi bla re ni/ /bsil lda na khyon kun khyab par bres pa las/ /phan bde mngon par bzhad pa'i me tog char/ /snyoms par babs pas sa 'di skal bzung byas//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ 7gong ma chen po'i gser gyi lung bzhin khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gangs ri'i ljongs su gdan drangs te pho brang chen po po ta la'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo 'god par mdzad pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ / //

176 rluzhu budun pu/ rgyalka dazhad phyag na pun+ni yubu snaska lus mādo sngags pye tshaska tshulka najin k+shin pu gaskan cid / puṇa chen jimās cad mākhyen pu chen po lkas busnyen rdogaska nu sdomā pu zhazhes te blubra busnyan zhongs rdogs nu budag h+phar mānga' burnyes puzhi tshulu/de nas gong sa thams cad mkhyen par rje bla ma nyid kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bdud laso rnam par rgyal ba dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang rje 'di bas gtso ba'i rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/rgyal sras sprul sku sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzhi brgya brgyad cu skor la gnang zhing / sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kar thog ma kun slong 'chos pa nas mjug gi bar la rgyud dang rgya gzhung rje yab sras kyi gsung rab rnam ṭa/ kyi khungs dang bcas pa'i ljags bshad shin tu rgyas pa dang /dka' ba'i gnas rnams la rigs pas mtha' dpyod pa dang / phyag len rnams sla chos su ma song ba'i smin rgyas su stsal pas der tshogs pa thams cad rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i dad pa bcos min skyes/ gyirgyal ba'i dbang bo bod du phebs nas dbang chen thog mar gnang ba 'di'i zhu ba po yang rje bla ma 'di nyid yin 'dug pas gong smos ltar rten 'brel gyi sgo rmad du byung ba 'grig par snang / gzhan nga nga jo bore rnam thar che chung dang

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chem/ mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes tshul/ 177pha cho sa bu chos sogs bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i ljags lung yang gnang / 7rgyal dbang zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi ring sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs skabs su yang sku mdun du phebs gsungaca/ pa bzhin yang yang byon par chos kyi gsung gleng mang ba mdzad cing thugs dam rten gras rgya gar shar li 'khor lo sdome pa'i sku brnyan byin can zhig gnang ste gzhan la ma ster bar thugs dam rten mdzod ces phebs/ sngar mgar thar du byang chub lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi bka' khrid k+ka/ra shes su mtshams 'jog pa mdzad pa'i 'phro rnams gnang rgyu'i dbu btsug sas na mkhan sprul sku che khag rnams dang dge b.ri bshes gnyen mkhas grags can mang bas/ 7rgyal dbang mchog nas dka' ba'i gnad du0ma la dri rmed dang brgal brtag mdzad par/ so sos lan phul ba las grub mchog 'jamacidapal rgya mtsho nas bka' lan gang zhus pa thams cad don la 'byor zhing go rgyu che bas7rgyal ba rin po che yang thugs dgyes pa byung zhes rje bla ma nyid gsung ba thos/ bka' khrid rdzogs pa'i mjug tu gzims chung bka' gdams 'khyil bar thub dbang sta zur ma/ 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra sogs rten khyad par can rnams gdan drangs te mchod sprin rgya chen po blor mi shong ba dang bcas/ thog maragyirgyal ba'i dbang bo nyid nas seca/sa bskyed cho gas len pa sogs mjad rjes seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che/ byang chub seX 4sa dpa' rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskye /da pa'i tshul mdo sde du ma las 'byung ba'i yan lag bsam gyiṭa/ mi khyab ḍa /

178 rgyal dbang yab sras lasachosatshulagasanacing/ paṇa—chen mchogalas bsnyen rdzogs bzhes tshul/rnams/ 'chad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhal lung rgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin sems bskyed cho gas 'bog par mdzad/ rje bla ma mchog gi zhal nas/ 'di dusagyirgyal dbang mchog nas lam khrid skabs kyi gsung bshad gang gnang thams cad shin tu rno zhing lam la nges pa bskyed pa la phul shin tu che ba dang / khyad par du skyes bu chen po'i chos skor la lung rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgrub byed dang bcas myong thog tu 'gril ba'i gsung bshad 'gran zla dang bral ba bkakrā drin bskyang byung bas yid 'khul ba la tshod ma byung zhes phyis su yang yang rga/sung ba thos/ lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi ljags lung yang gnang / snyiṭī stobs rmad byung khyod thugs 'dzin ma la/ /snyi5 brtse'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs dngos kyis/ /snyidwa rje'i sa bon grung bo btab pa las/ /snyidwa rje'i myu gu byang chub sems mchog 'khrungs/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i snye ma smin pa yi/ /ma smad rgyal sras spyod pa'i ston thog gis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i dbul ba kun sel ba'i/ /theg chen chos kyi so nam mthar phyin gyur/ /'di dus7gong sa mchog nas rje bla ma nyid la phyag tham che chung yang ched gnyer bskrun pa bka' drin du stsal/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang sdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs 'khod ljags rtsom zhus pa bzhin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga bde chen snying bo rab tu rgyas pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshorges mchod cho ga dga' ston 'dzum zhal bcas bka' rtsom mdzad nas ljags lung stsa la/ rdzogong sa mchog la mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhis tshul/ 179zla ba gcig lhag tsam 'bul bar mdzad skabs yab sras kyis rje 'di ba la chos gral du bzhugs ces phebs pa ltar bzhugs pas gsung bshad 'byams klas pa dang yab sras gnyis dang chos nyan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams dka' gnas la mol mchid mang du mdzad pa gsan pas thugs la dga' dad skyo gsum khor mo yug du byung gsung / de ltar pe'i cing du bzhugs skabs sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ dade ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab dar rgyas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang chos 'dzin pa rnams las byang —chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid mang du sa/san cing /khyad par mgar thar du bzhugs ṅka bas dang lha sar phebs nas nem 'drenagyirgyal ba'i dbang bo dang mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gnyis kyi drung du lam rim chen mo/ bde lam/ 'jam dpal zhal lung rnams kyi gzhung bshad dang / nyams len dmar khrid lan du mar shin tu gzab rgyas gsan pa dang / dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnam sa dang 'be+el gtam mang du mdzad par brten/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che/ yur+yā shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag zab mo/ dpal lha cig dī paṃ ka ra'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad zla med/ che ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gnad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rirab kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas te/ ṭ+wāṃ sngar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'dzam gli nga rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung chen mo snum sa 95 thos pa rgya mcho lta bu mdzad pa de

180rgyal dbang yab gras las tshos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rjogs bzhes tshu' /‘thams cad 'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len du 'ub kyis 'du ba'i tshul la nges pa gting tshugs pa thugs la 'khrungs te rkastan pa thams cad gru bzhi la r+ya gyis 'khyer shes pa zhes bya ba dang / gzhung lugs ma lus gdams ngag tu shar ba zhes jo bo bka' gdam sa pa rnam sa kyis rgya cher bsngags pa'i nges don gyi mkhas pa'i go 'phang la mnga' 'byor bar gyur/tshul 'di ni rje bla mas rang gi rtogs pa brjod par/ de ltar 'bad pas klu sgrub thogaṭaṭa med las/ rim bzhin brgyud pa'i byang chub lam rim la/ /thun mong min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur pas/ /zab rngo 'e gzhung mchog phar phyin gdams par shar/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub lugs kyi gzhung mchog du ma'i don/ /nyams su len pa'i rim pa legs par mthong / /zhes sogs dang / bla ma dbu ma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig las/ des na gzu bor gnas pa'i sgo nas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis lam 'chu ji/ med cig 'tshol na/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde rtsod med gang dang yang mi 'gal 'i/nga de dag nas zin pa de yang shing rta chen po gcig gi rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas drang nges legs par phye ste mtha' gzhan du drang du mi btub par rigs pas gnod med du 'grub pa zhig med mi rung du snang bas/ ga/sung rob chen po rnams dang de'i dgongs pa 'tshol ba'i rigs pa'i sgo dri ma med pa la rtsis po cher bzung nas rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa sngar mang du byung yang de tsam la chog shes ma byas par bstan pa 'ba' nig la dmi raṭagle pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ yi dam dang bla ma tha mi dad par byas pa la rgyun mi chad du gsol ba gdab pa bsag sbyang gi sgo du ma la 'bad paṭasmu da lta

debang yab sras las snas tshul gsan lhangad/ paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen gas bzhes tshul/ 1skye1gsung rab spyi dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos chen po rnams la khol bton re tsam min pa'i lus longs su rdzogs pa nyams len du 'gro ba'i phyogs su shes pa yod/ tshul de la nges pa bde blag tu ster bar byed pa ni bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing /nang rig pa'i sde snod gsum gyi snying bo bslab pa gsum gyi gnad rnam sa phyin ci ma log par shes nas khas blangs pa tsam la ma bzhag par nyams 'og tu tshud par mdzad pa/ mkhas la grub pa brnyes pa'i dge ba'i bshes ri / nyen rdu mas rjes su pazung ba/ lhag pa'i lha dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems dpa' chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi sa/dmas pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i mchan nyi da dang sngags kyi theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa phyin ci ma log par gtan la phab pa nyid ya mtshan par ma thong nas slob ma bkri ba'i rim pa rnams de kho na'i steng nas byed kyin yod/ gdams ngag de yang gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ma na ngag ma tha' dag lam gyi rim pa gcig tu dril nas ston par snang bas 'chad shes pa dang nyan shes pa gnyis kyis bshad cing nyams su blangs na man ngag chung chung du ma zad gsung rab mtha' dag gi gung 'grig nas yong bar snang /zhes rje bla mas rang gi thos bsam mdzad tshul gsung ba'i rnam par thar pa de nyid phyag len du btab pa ste/ deng sang gi thos bsam pa rnams kyis cha shas tsam yang bsgrun du med pa'i rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung ba'o/ / cigazhung bzang gser gyi bye mas lus bgos/ shing / /thabs shes

’82rgyal dbang yapasras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chenamachogalasabasnyenardzogasatram̐zhes/tshu'i /gshog yangs dkar pyo rab rgyas pa/ /rgyal sras snying stobs ldan pa'i ngang ba de/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dpal la rtag sred pas/ /gangs ri'i mu khyud zlum por 'khril ba'i ljongs/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi chu klung 'bum 'khyil bar/ /mkhas grub gde/ ngas can du ma rtag rol pa'i/ /yul dbus chos kyi rgya mtsho che der gshegs/ /der ni 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo nyid/ /mthon mthing thor cog gser zhun khu ba yis/ /legs byugs lha rdzas na bza' dras drub gos/ /snam phran bdun par bsgyur nas gangs can gyi/ /gdul bya'i mgon du ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam par byon pa rgyal ba'i dbang bo de'i/ /zhabs pad dge legs ge sar rdul phreng can/ /bas/ma sbyor gtsug si/ cod paṇa du /r+shasten nas/ /theg pa gsum gyi gdams ngag 'dus pa'i gter/ /rigs can gagim gyi 'dod pa skong ba'i nor/ /rgyud pa gasprum gyi bla ma'i zhal gyi lung / skyes bu gasdom gyi lam rim rdzogs par sa/san/ /de yi mthu las gzhan gyis gsung rab mtsho/ /brtson pas lan brgyar brgal kyang ca/ rnyed pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs don mthar thug yid bzhin nor/ /mkhas grub ded dpon khyod kyi phyag tu son/ /che ba bzhi zhes kun la rlung ltar du/ /grags kyang rgyud la 'byor ba deng dus su/ /khyod la tshulca 'di rdzibazhin mngon gyur pas/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan dpal la bzhed rgur spyod/ /lhag bsam dbul gyi mdog ldan sa srung zhon/ /gtugs med mkhyen bzang 'dren byed stong phrag bkra/ /mthu stobs zho 'thung rus pa'i mtshon 'chang ba/ /skal bzang lha yi bla mar bdag phyag 'tsha' / /2di

spyol dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan 4nga / paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rjogs bzhis tshul //phri3skabs zhig grogs 'as/'a zhig chos la bskul ba'i ched du thar ba'i sgo 'byed zhes bya'i ma gur ma mdzad pa 'di ltar ro/ /na mo gu ru/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas/ /tshogs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i po/tso/ /mgon drin dran bla mar snyi/nga nas 'dud/ /tshe sdon ma'i las smon bzang po'i mthus/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab la /thos bsam pa'i rnam dpyod phul byung ba'i/ /grogs chos mthun dpyod ldan bdag la gson/ /dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /gzhi tshul khrims rnam dag sna gcig kyang / /bsrung nus na phan yon dpag med 'thob/ /don de phyir sdom gsum bcas mtshams rnams/ /srog bsdos te bsrung ba gnad du che/ /chos gzhung lugs brgya phrag thos gyur kyang / /kha phyir lta'e 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la/ /yid g.yengs pas nyams su ma blangs na/ /dgra gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa'i tshe/ /sems 'gyod pas gdung ba'i rgyu ru zad/ /'khor gnyen bshes bu slob 'dzin skyong rnarma ru ci / /dgra nyon mongs dpung tshogs rgyas pa'i rgyu/ /las dang po pa yis spangs na legs/ /grogs bya dang ri dwags bag phebs rgyu/ /chu klung rgyu/na lhung lhung dal gyis sgrog /gnas rtsi shing nags tshal mdzes pas bape/na/ /yid chas/sa sdang skye ba'i rgyu dang bral/ /gnas de 'dra dam chos 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /de bsten par mdzod cig 〉/la ldan dag /dzon byon pa'i mkhas hū‘ sa rngari kung ya sa kyis/ /chosari zab dgu ma nga du ba/sungs 'ari gas kyang / /rje thub pa'i dbang bo'i gsung rab ku/ ma// / don

1skye4rgyal dbang yab sras las tshos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chon mchog las bsnyin rdzogs banes tshul/ma tshang med par gcig bsdus pa/ /blo mchog dman kun la pham/ pa'i chos/ /lta sgom dang spyod pa ma 'khrul ba/ /khong blo bzang grags pa'i legs par bshad/ /gzhung byang chub lam rim las gzhan gang / /de nyams len mdzod cig skal ldan dag /sngon thog med dus nas bsags pa yi/ /las nyon mongs sgrib pa ches 'thug pas/ /lam rtob/sa pa skye ba'i gegs mang yang / /zhing mchog gyur bla ma dkon mchog la/ /yid gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab nas/ / tshogs gsog dang sgrib sbyong la 'bad na/ /lam rtogs pa bde blag skye ba lags/ /tshul de la 'bungs shig skal ldan dag /chos dase/ sbyor gang dang gang byed kyang / /thabs byang chub sems kyis zin pa dang / /mjug byang chub 'thob phyir rab bsdos na/ /lam theg pa chen por 'gyur lags pas/ /de gnad du zungs shig skal ldan dag /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i lam gyi gnad/ /lus yongs su rdzogs par nyin re bzhin/ /bshar sgom gyis nyams su blangs byas te/ /lam zab mor bag chags 'jog pa dang / /skebs gang babs dmigs par gcig dril ba/ /yid chos la rtag tu 'dris pa dang / /lam phyogs rer mi 'gro'i gnad cig gda'/ /de snying gtam yin no skal ldan dag /rgyud rnam par dag pa las gsu ngas pa'i/ /tshe gcig la sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs/ /pha bla ma'i yi dam thun mong min/ /dpal bde gsang 'jigs gre/sum dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lam rim gnyi sa ma kha' 'gro'i snying khrag la / /rtse gcig tu bag chags 'jog pa sa/nad/ /tshul de yi gzhi ma dam sdom nasdu sa / /mig 'bras/ bu lta ra du

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen ma rnog las bsnyen rdzogaru/ bzhos chul/ 185bsrung ba dang / /sdig sbyong byed rnor sems bsgom bzlanu/ dang / /thun drug gi rnal 'byor la 'bad na/ /mchog sangs rgyas de ya nga thag mi ring / /de snying bor zungs shig skal ldan dag /de mang du bshad pas ci zhig bya/ /don de dag yid la gnad du chongs/ /gnas dben par sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /tshe 'di la btsan sa zin pa gyis/ /yid nyams spro'i glu dbyangs snyan po 'di/ /yid chos la phyogs pa'i chos/ grags kyis/ /yid brtse bas skal ldan khyod la gdams/ /yid ma g.yel 'di don bsgrub la 'bungs/ /tshig sdeb sbyo ra gtso bor ma byas par/ /don snying las gces pa bsdebs pa 'di/ /gaugs gzur gnas chos la bskul phyir sbyar/ /'di'i dge bas mang thos skye bo kun/ /chos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa dang / /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces chos la bskul ba'i glu dbyangs thar pa'i sgo 'byed 'di ni/ 'di snang chos brgyad la nyams len snying bor byed pa'i ban chung ngag dbang chos grags kyis rang lo bcu dgu bar/ chos grogs dam pa mang thos sde snod 'jin pa byang rtse dpon slob rab 'byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ lung rigs smra ba'i dbang phyug nag shod dpon slob dka/'a chen tshul khrims rgya mtsho gnyis la gdams pa'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan dka' bcu ngag dbang chos 'byor gyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ zhes pa'o/ /skabs shig rgyal dbang mchog nas rje bla ma gcig pur do rje nag po che( na po dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang / be'u bum gyi lung sogs gnang skabs 'tshub spyongs che ba byung na'ang thu gas brtse ba chen pos yongs mu

186 rgyal dbang yab sras las/ chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mcho ga la sa bdīn dzos/sa bzhes tshul/rdzogs pa stsal/ sku mdun rang nas rgya lo ba sku na rim gyi thugre/ṭa4 dam rten rnams dang / nang rten byin rlabs can gang yod rnams la na jal kha zhib rgyas kyang sanang / jo bo lo ke shwa ra dang / gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gis gtso ba'i mchod khang rnams su ma chod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te yab sras gnyis char byon nas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i gsol 'debs dang thugs smon rgya chen po gnang / yang rje bla ma nyid nas zhus ngoragyirgyal dbang mchog nas 'dus pa bzhi brgya skor la dge slong ma dpal mo lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcitsā/ pa'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya moḥ dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyis sna dzad pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga rje 'di bas bskul ma mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sku gsumyo5 bang mdzod/ 'jigs byed dang bde mchog ji/ tshogs 'khor/ bde ma/chog gi srung 'khor rgyas pa/ drug cu ba'i spom bzhag gnam lcags thog tshen brag 'bebs sotso/sa kyi klag lung rnams stsal/ bar skabs zhi ga tu gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan nyid zhabs phyi pa lung rigs smra ba'i dbang bo nag shod dpon slob tshul khrims rgya mtsho las rna ma 'grel gyi sa bcad chen mori mdzub khrid kyang sa/san par mdzad/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dga' ldan byang rtse'i khri 'don gnang rgyu dang lhan du 'brog ri/ bo che dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs/ gser gdung tshen mo sogs rten brten pa thams cad la mchod pa rgyas pa dang bcas zhib mjal ma dzad/ ma khan chen rdo rje 'chang nas sngar mgar thar du rton 'brel gyi rgad che bas 'grel ba'i rgyud kya / 4 no phyi ma dge

rgya' dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa che na mchog las bsnyen sgyugs banes tshul/ 187ldan nekaser sa/dung chen mo'i drung du byed dgos gsungs yod pa bzhin/ rje rgyal ba gnyis/ pa'i gser gdung rin po che'i mdun du mchod pa dang tshogs gtor rgya che ༵—/ po bshams/ rgyud mchod rgyas pa 'grel dbang dang bcas gnang zhing rje bla ma mchog nas kyang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dngos zabul sbam che ba phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs nan tan du zhu ba ca/dza/ da par dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes shing bde gsang gi shis brjod rgyas pa mdzad/ rim lnga gaspul sgron gyi bshad pa'i mjug kyang dga' ldan du grub pa gnang zhing / rje bla ma nyi da phyag phyir khrid de mgon khang yi/ chos rgyal kyi sku mdun du phebs/ zhal khebs kyi dar nag phyag si/sa bsal te brkyang bskurtsa/ myo/ dang bskul rgyas pa zhig mdzad pas shin tu zil che zhing chos rgyal gyi sku yang g.yo tshad tshad pa dang drung na gnas pa rnams 'jigs zhum zhum pa'i snang ba byung / phyir lam gas nga sngags mkhar dang / yer ba lha ri/ mtshal gung thang sogs kyi gnas gzigs mdzad/yab sras gnyis lha ldan du phebs nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud kyi bshad pa grub chen nā ro ba'i bzhed srol ma nyams pa/ sgra bsgyur mkhas pa gnyis kyi bshad rgyun gcig tu 'dus pa rje bcun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos rgya cher gtan la phab pa/ dpal ldan srad rgyud kyi bla ma rnam ṭa/ kacig nas gcig tu brgyud de rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ /grub jichen ngag dbang blo gros/ rje krāja ma dbyangs bzhad pa'i rno rje/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ de nyid nas myo/khan chen rang gis gsan pa bzhin rgyud 'grel spa sa don kun gsal gyi steng nas rtsa 'grel sbrags te/ bshad pa'i rgyun yongs

188rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchogalasabasnyenardzogasabazhesasngozi/su rdzogs pa rgyud mchod dang bcas pa/ rje'i rnam bshad kyi steng nas 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud lha mo bzhi'i zhus dang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi bshad lung / bde mchog bskyed rim 'dod 'jo/ rdzogs rim dngos grub snye ma/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig mdor bsdus rnam sa kyi bshad lung /mkhas grub rje'i 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim chen mo kha skong dang bcas pa'i steng nas rgya bod kyi gshed skor mtha' dag gung bsgrigs nga 'i bushad lung rgyas pa/ gsang 'jigs gnyis dang bde mchog skru i pa'i lugs kyi ngakye/da rdzogs kyi dmar khrid zhib rgyas/ yer ba'i dpon slob phun tshoko/sa rgya mtsho'i khrid yig steng nas bde mchog dril bu lus da kyil pyi bskyed rdzo gas kyi nyams khrid smin rgyas/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog bskyed rdzogs kyi zhal shes snyan rgyud bde chen rgya mtsho/'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag blu ti gsang thig gi 'phreng ba/ rgyud pa chos grags bzang po'i yig cha'i steng nas mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i gser chos thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim/ 'phags lugs gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa/zab lam nā ro chos drug rnal 'byor dbang phyug lo i pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis slob dpon ye shes zhabs la dngos su gnang pa'i rdzogs rim dga' bzhi'i rim pa/ grub chen dril bu zhabs lugs kyi/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i rdzogs rim byin rlabs bzhi ldan/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim sbyor pa yan lag drug bcas khrid chen brgyad rtswa

rgyashā dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing / paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes tshul/ 18nyagrags pa dang / dpal ldan srad rgyud pa'i lugs kyi gsadra 'dus rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa/ 'jigs/ byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi rim/bde mchog lku i pa'i rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po/ dril bu pa'i rdzogs rim rim lnga/ dus 'khor sbyor drug nā ro chos drug bcas khrid chen drug tu gras/sa pa lag rjes dang bcas pa/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid yig yid ches gsu ma ldan gyi bshad pa rnams gsan/ de dag las gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i dmar khrid skabs sdon 'gro gnyis dang dben gsum la sbyong zhag 'jog pa dang khrid mchod sogs phyag len rgyas pa mdzad/ gzhan yang grub chen mi tra dzo ka'i thugs bcud snyi nga po di /kā —/ sa/sum gyi khrid/ ba so chos rgyan gyi lta /m+bid steng nas dbu myo 'i lta khrid sob/sa khrid kyi rnam grangs mang bo zhig dang / kun rig gi dbang chen sogs dbang 'ga' zhig gcod nam rma kha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang / dben sa pa'i stan thog gcig ma'i steng nas gcod pyi nya lho 5 sa /khrid zhib rgyas/ skyid shod pa'i yig cha'i steng nas mgodu di chen bcu gsum/ mgon po snying zhugs dang bcas pa'i rjes ga nang / bla mgon dbyer med/ grib sel/ snying zhugs 'pho ba dang bca sa pa'i khrid/ be'u bum nag po'i skor gyi phyag khrid man ngag zhal shes dang bcas pa/ mkhas grub rjes bsgrigs pa'i be'u bum cha tshang gi klag lung / gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong du ma zhig gi jes gnang / dpal lda na smad rgyud pa'i 'dzin chos su gnang bzhin pa'i dwags po nam mkha' grarke//sa kyi 'dus pa'i papye de rdzogs/ rkyospreg chung nyer gcig pa/ rgyal ba blo bzang do 5/ brub kyi bka/ 'a 'burnga// ma/bas hūṃb sangs rgya'i smu ye shes kyi bka'

190 yodabangayab sras lasalhasatshulagasanacing/patram̐ chinamatshagalas bat+tan dze+ogs bzhis tshul/'bu —/ sok+to/sa klag lung mang po zhig kyang gsan par mdzad/ bshad pa dang dmar khrid gsan pa de thams cad kyang blo gsar ba la dge rgan gyis mdzub khrid gtong ba lta bu'i bcas bde sla chos tsam ma yin par thog mtha' bar sa/su/ma gyi phyag len phra rags thams cad rgyud ldan gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin mdzad cing / de yang gang mgyogs mgyogs kyis chos thun re gnyis tsam la rdzogs ci thub byas te khrid rgyun 'di dang 'di thob po zhes pa'i rnam grangs tsam don du gnyer ba'i deng sang gi bla slob thugs brel can rnams kyi 'chad nyan lta bu ma yin par/ zhag grangs mang bo 'i /ga gi ring la mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang nas rgyud dang grub chen gyi gzhung mang bo dang rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras kyi legs par bshad pa thams cad gung bsgrigs pa'i gsung bshad 'byams klas pa la rgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdam sa pa mchog tu zab pa du nems brgyan te thad ka thad ka'i go ba dmigs phyed cing rma tha' chod pa go rim ma 'chol bar ngo sprod pa sogs 'chad tshul shin tu ya mtshan pa dang / rje bla ma mchog ni gtugs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab nam mkha' lta ra zab cing yangs ‘4sdoshaṃ bla mas gsungs pa'i gnad re re tsam la brten nas kyang rgyud don man ngag gi gnad du ma zhig gtan la 'bebs shing mi brjed par 'dzin pa sogs gsan tshul rmad du byung ba dang bcas gsang sngags kyi 'chad nyan tshad dang ldan pa bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i gsos su 'gyur nges pa zhig mdzad do/ /de ltar rje bla ma'i bka' srol thun mong ma yin pa'i sngabs kyi/ 'chad nyan byed tshul sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes tshul/ 191bzang bos yi ger 'god par mdzad pa/ zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i lam bstan pa zhes bya ba dkar chags tho'i yig chung bzhin du/rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'khor lo blde mchog gnyis kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa dang dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag pa legs par gsan pa la brten nas/ rje bla mas/ gang zhig rtogs na myo/tha' dag gsung rab la/ /mi 'jigs spobs pa mchog ster 'dus pa'i lam/ /zhes dang / rtogs brjod las/ thub pa'i legs bshad kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /dpal ldan rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyumene+e/ /de yi nang nas shin tu ches zab pa/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud rgyal la/ /smra ba'i dam pa klu sgrub 'di skad gsungs/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du lam kyi gnad rnams ni/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgya yis btab ste gnas/ /de phyir bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bla ma'i man ngag las ni shes byar gsungs/ /tshul de gnad du bathung nas man ngag gi /mthar thug mdor byas spyod bsdus rnam bzhag sogs/ /'dus pa 'phags pa'i skor gyi phran kun la / /ring du 'dris par byas te rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /sgron ma lta bur gsal bar byed pa la/ /brten nas bshad rgyud chen po lnga dang ni/ /legs par sbyar la 'bad pa chen pos sbyangs/ /sbyangs pas 'dus pa'i rim gnyis spyidang ni/ /khyad par rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i gnad kun rnyed/ /ceṭa/ dang / de yi mar+bhe las bde dgyes dus 'khor sor+sha/sa/ /rgyud sde mang bo'i gnad don gdams par shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dpa' gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams legs par sbyar te

192 rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing / paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs banes /tshul /gcitan la phab pas rgyud don la mi 'chug pa'i gzer thebs te/ de'i mthus gsang 'dus sogs pha rgyud rnams su snang phyogs thabs kyi lam rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa dang / bde dgyes dus 'awaṃ/ ra sogs myo/ rgyud rnams su stong phyogs shes rab kyi lam rtsal du bton nas 'chad nga sa zung 'jug sgrub pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su ro+o nga /sa pa'i gdams ngab / pha ma'i rgyud sde rnams su bzhugs pa dang / der ma zad bya spyod kyi rgyud rnamyo/trashaṃ su'ang lha dang stong ba'i rnal 'byor dang rlung dang bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi dang / rnal 'byor rgyud las lhag pa'i lhari sku sa/sung thugs gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum gcig tu sbyor bar byed pa'i rnal 'byor gsum gyis dngos grub sgrub pa'i sgo gsum gang rung du zhugs nas rang gi lhas ma chog stsal pa la brten nas lam bde blag tu bgrod pa'i tshul gsungs pa'i gnad tha mas cad kyang rnal 'byor bla med kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam dngos dang de'i yan las/ ci rigs su 'du ba dang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud don thams cad nyams len du dri lan ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i dgongs pa ltar rgyud snod rung du byed pa dbang gi skor dang / snod du gyur nas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byed pa dang / dam tshig la gnas nas lam ji ltar nyaduri sa su blang ba dang / nyamasari/ su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed tshuk+ṣ-i pre bzhir bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i tshul la nges pa gting tshu gas pa rnyed nas rgyud sde mtha' yas pa'i gnad don thams cad zung 'jug sgrub pa'i gdams pa'i cimachog tu gzigs par gyur to/ /ji skad du/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing / paṇa chan mchog las ba3 rga rdzogs bzhis tshul/wa193tsong kha pa cherme/ yos / zab gnas mthar thug pa rnams yod pa ni rgyud sde rin po che'i rtsa rgyu— ) rnams yin la de go ba la bla d+ngha 4 dgos pyi /nga bla myo/sa kyang gang byung byung nas bshad pas mi chog gi bshad rgyud rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas chu rgyud bshad shes pa cig dargos par gsungs so/ /de'ibyuphyir man ngage ni rtsa rgyud rnams kyi don bshad rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas phyin ci ma log par bshad de slob ma'i rgyud la go ba bde blag tu skyed pa'i thabs la zer bas zhal las shes lugs kyang de 9ltar du go bar bya'i/ rgyud rnams su/ bri bar phangs nas de dag tu ma bkod par rna khung du rim pa bzhin brgyud pa la mi gzung ngo / /des na man ngag mchog tu gyur pa tsam gyis de la ring du sbyangs nas rgyud sde sogs kyi tshad ldan gyi gzhung la bltas pa na rgyud don du ma zhig la nges pa ster dgos kyi sa/dmas ngag khyer nas rgyud don la dpyad pa na nges pa ci ya nga ster mi nus par snang na blo skyon dang don kye+on gang rung cig byung ba'i rtags so/ /sngags dang mtshan nyid gang gi lugs la yang rta rgyug pa'i sngon du gang du rgyug pa'i rgyug sa ston pa bzhin du dang bor thos bsam gyis ga /nga nyams su len rgyu rnams shes par byas nas de nas de ltar gtan la phab pa'i don nyams su len pa yin mod kyang / snying nas sgrub pa byed 'dod pas sngags kyi gzhung che ba rnams la sbyangs na bzhad gad kyi gnas su lta zhing rgyud sde la mang du sbya ngas pa dang ma sbyangs pa gnyis nyams len la mang nyung ci yang mi 'ong ba'i dus su snang bas thar ba 'dod pa dag gis blo zhib mos legs par brtag par byos shig /ces dang / bshad pa'i rgyud kyis rtsa rgyud bshad pa na/ /rtsa rgyud gdams pa'i mchog tu 'char

1nye4 rgyal dbang yab sras las tshos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chin mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes la/ba dang / /dri med dbang dang dam tshig la gnas nas/ /rim gnyis lam gyis legs par baspod tshul dang / /bgrod las dngos grub mtha' yas 'grub tshul gyis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa ru bgrod tshul rnams/ /rgyud las legs par bstan pa'i tshul shes nas/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la/ /sngags tshul ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /gsang sngags pa zhes zer ba shes par mdzod/ /ces gang gsungs pa ltar dus kyi mtha' 'dir rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par rgyud don gdams par 'char ba'i thos bsam tshad ldan 'di lta bu mdzad pa ni bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di gcig pu tsam du zad kyi/ deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba rnams dang 'gro ba mang bo'i 'dren par rlom pa dag la 'di lta bu rna bas thos pa tsam yang mi snang na lag tu blang ba dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des na rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/ gur gum tshori ske kyis btsos pa'i lwa ba'i zhwas/ /rang rigs bstan pa zin na ches legs kyi/ /pha mes lung dang rtogs pa'i khyad nor tshogs/ /rnam g.yeng rkun por shor ba'i lag stong mang / /ga'i mug goms pa'i dbang brtul ra gan la/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa'i gser sbyangs btso ma zhes/ /mkhas mang tshong 'dus chen po'i sar 'grim tshe/ /mi shes ngan pa'i rang mdog bstan pas nongs/ /zhes 0/sungs pa thugs shin tu mad par snang ngo / /bslab gsum chu gter dbus na rnam rol mang du thos pa'i gdengs ka mdzes/ /gnas lugs gzigs pa'i sa/tsug nor dzad kyis lta ngan sa 'og mun pa sel/ /mdo rgyud man ngag

rgya—dzo dbang yab sras las chos tshul spyaspran cing / nga9tsha/ mchog las bsnyin ljags bzhis tshul/ 1nyalhanor bu'i gter gyirusku ska bzang ku phran 〉 /tha' yas skyong / /blub bstan ma dros bdag po ngag dabhang mchosha ldan zhes grags dge ba'i bathe/sa/ /rdo rte 'dzim/ de'i rnarme dpyosde lde mig githe/ /thu rje'i gsang tshig stor gi ༷sgo bye ma/sa/ /do rte theg pa'e sbas don nor bu3 ts+tshagaṅgi/ /rdo rje'i sras mchoka khyod rlo bsnezhed rgur stsa'// /tshul des rgyud sde rnam bzhi'iX larmi bgrod tshul/ /ku sha'i rtse lta ra ma 'dres legs gzigs shing / /khyad par bla med rgyud kyi zab khyad kun/ /ji bzhin dgongs nas sgrub la gzhol bar mdzad/ /'grel ba mchan bu sa bcad mtha' dpyod rnams/ /ka thor bsgrigs nas ldab ldib klog pa dang / /dbyangs dang phyag rgya cho ga shes tsam gyis/ /'dus pa'i bstan pa bzung bar rlom mang yang / /rgyud dang grub chen dgongs don khong chud nas/ /zab don thang mar khardal te 'chad pa dang / / shādo don gdams par shar ba'i nyams len khyo ri /ṅka / / /dus 'dir nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon/ /tshad ldan rdo rje slob dpon yab sras kyi/ /tshad lhan 'chad nyan 'di yis dutsu mazlo' 'dir/ /tshad ldan gsang sngags bstarni ṅge'i srog bzung zhes/ /༈da ldaspren mkhas rnarmis ṅgistod bsngags brjod la brel/ /'di dus marten cheṅge la yid srubs kyis rgyud brlams pa'i log sgrub mkhan zhig gis gsol zas ngan pa drangs pa de gong nas mkhyen te rje 'di nyid la gsungs 'dug kyang / de skabs mkhyen bzhin du bzhes pa mdzad nas de 'dras skyon mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan rje 'di ba dang rta tshag rje drung rnam gnyis la tso/sung ba de kho na ltar byung 'dug mkhan chen sku mtshams su bzhugs skabs rje 'di ba sku mdun

1nya6 spyol dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chin mchogalasabasnyinarjogasabazhes tshupa/du 'bod pa gnang nas mnal lam gyi zin bris rnams ston pa ma/dzad cing /rgyal ba'i dbang bo da nga mkhan chen rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar phyis 'byung dang bcas pa thugs la btags/ bar skabs zhig 'bras spungs chos sde chen po dang se ra theg chen gling gnyis su phebs/ grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las sne rnams dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur phun sum tsho gas pa zhus shing / rje bla ma nyid nas kyang mang 'gyed sogs gzab rgyas mdzad/ so go/'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gsum rnam sa la mchod mjal zhib tu gnang / /sgo mang grwa tshang nas chos khri'i khar gdan drangs te rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung zhus par/ lung rigs kyi lam las drangs pa'i legs bshad 'gran zla bral ba'i gsung bshad shin tu rgyas pa stsal pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams thugs rang dbang med par 'phrog ste/ 3chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes shi nga 'dus tshogs rnams kyis phyag brukrus pa'i chu la hab thob kyis 'thung ba dang phebs lam du dbu zhwa 'ding ba sogs shin tu gus par mdzad cing mkhas pa'i grags pa gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad du khyab par gyur/ de dus ljags bshad gnang ba yi ger 'arukhod dgos tshul sgo mang dpon slo ba chos grags dang khri ba gung thang pa'i sprul sku gnyis nas bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin/ pe'i cing du phebs nas rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel bshad legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs pa gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa ltar yin pas blo gzu bor gnas shing blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa dag gis legs bshad de nyid mthong na

rgyal go yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing / paṇa chen mcho ga las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes tshul/ 197chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ / gur gum gzhon nu'i tshos kyis kha ba sgyur ba'i/ /zhwa ser mdangs kyis mkha' spro nga gser gyi 'od/ /'dzin byed ngur smrig 'chang ba mkhas pa'i tshog/sa/ /li khri'i chu gter rba rlabs g.yo 'dra'i dbus/ /smra ba zla med khyod zhal gangs ri las/ /zab mo rten 'byung gtam gyi nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /lung rigs lhung lhung dbyangs kyis babs pa yis/ /mkhas mang blo gros 'a dzin ma 'gengs par byas/ / na tshod ches gzhon tsan+dan 'khri shing 'di'i/ /yid 'phrog legs bshad sngon med bsung zhim gyis/ /lang tsho chos kyi ra bar yol ba yi/ /rtog ge rgan po'i shing rnams khengs pa nyams/ /sdug btsir rngul chu 'dzag pa'i 'chad po 'ga'/ /mthon po 'i stegs la 'gyings pa deng mthong tshe/ /mkhyen dpyod ne'u le'i kha nas 'dzad med kyi/ /legs bshad nor bu lhug lhug skyugs khyod dran/ /swo sa kyi zhing du chos sdi rgyal po khyod/ /cho ga kyi khrir bzhugs rdo sa sdi rnga chen shārdung / ༷/rdoṅge sdi du’ t+na bus rdos sngi hūṃl ṅgetshan bsgrongs/ /rdoṅge gi rgyal srid rdos kyiXs bskyangs 'di rmad/ /yang skabs shig bsam yas dang khra 'brug sogs su mchod 'bul du byon pas/ bsam yas kyi gnas srung gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar bo mi'i khog tu brlams pas gus 'dud dang bcas rje bla ma nyid lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi sku'i skye ba yin tshul gyi lung phul/ 'on chos sding du phebs nas rgyal sras sprul sku rin po cher ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang gsan te chos 'brel mdzad/ phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis chos kyi bka' mchid 'phel

198 rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing / paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs banis tshutram̐—/zhing bzhugs ring la rgyal sras rin po che nas bsnyen bku/ ra yang dag pa sa/nang / de nasagyipaṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes las bsnyin rdzod+ku/sa kyi sdom pa nod pa dang mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang du gsan pa 'i ched dzu bkas mngags pa'i chi'i tā zhin/ pi chig chi rnams dang /gzhung nas sde ba sding chen nas bcas dpon g.yog sum brgya brgarka pa dang bcas bkra shis lhun por phebasagyipaṇa chen ma/ḍi0ga nas rgyal rtse rdzong du tshogs gso ga pa blo bzang yar 'phepa ngo g.yog phebs bsur gtong ba gnang zhing / bcu ba'i tshes brgyad la dgon par phebs nyin zur bzhi'i dpon slob rnams dang drung 'khor lnga bcu skor/ grwa tshang gi 'a sa sne/ mi tshan dge rgan/ sku skye rje drung bcas kyi chibs bsu dang bde les/sa khang gsar du thabs bsu dang dar 'phyar dung 'bud sogs kyi bkur gzos mdzad/ byi nyinagyipaṇa chen mchog la mjal kha zhu ba sa/nang bar bka' 'dri mang du phebs shing sku mdun du ja gral dang gsol ston rgyas pa sa/nang /zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin rje bla ma dpon g.yog gsum cil dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nas bzung ste dge tshul gyi bar gyi sdom pa'i bdud rtsi stsal cing mtshan la ye shes bkaun pasdi phyon sdo daphal bzang po zhes gsol bar mdzad/ hūṃgs ༷chen du gshenarna drangaṅge te brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i snyan gsan zhus par de dusagyipaṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dgung lo bdun cu don4 gsum du phebs pa'i sku na smin pa dang khyad par du sku gzugs cung zad gcong pa'i tshul du yod kyang / rje bla ma nyid bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin stabs zhal gyis bzhes te

rgyal dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇachenamachogalasabasnyenardo gamigabanes tshul/ 199tshes bco lnga'i nyin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i da bus su po/dan drangs te seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod/ rje bla ma mchog nas maṇ+ḍal phya ga tu thos/sa te spyir rgyal ba'i sku stan pa dang khyad par du chos kyi rgyal bo tsong ༄/ ra chen po'i bstan pa rin po che'i dpal du zhabs pad bska /pre ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad du bskor ba'i gsol 'debs zhus par dgyes bzhin du zhal bzhes bzang bo mdzad/ de dus dngos 'bul gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gser dngul sdom pa'i srang chig stong / sku'i nyer spyad cha tshang / gu ku sha'i gtor rgyan sogs shel sbyang ngo mtshar can mang ba/ gos dar sogs gtos/ che ba phul zhing / dge 'dun rnams la mang ja dngul zho gsum re'i rtsiṭaṭa kyi 'gyed sna bcas gnang / tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin snang mtha' ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa7paṇa chen thams cad mkhye na pa nyid kyis mkhan po myo/dzad de zur bzhi'i slob dpon nu+o/gas dge 'dun bcu tshogs kyi dbus/ mu gsol bzhi'i las kyi cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum yongs su rdzos/sa pa phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bsta na pa'i snying bo so thar gyi sdom pa'i mchog dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te spong bdun 'khor dang bcaṭari pa'i tshulakhrims kyi bdud rtsis thugs kye bum bzang yongs su gang bas ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gidzinor bu thub pa sangs rgyas bcom lda na 'das kyi rgyal tshab mchog tu mnga' gsol bar gyur to/ /blo chen rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas mdzad bsdung gis/ /so ra rtogs ༷ shes nyi ma dus mtha' 'dir/ /mtshams sprin gos kyis klubs pa'i rol

200 shā95 dbang yab sras las chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog las bsnyen rdzogs bzhis tshul/gar la/ /paṇa chen 'gro ba'i mgon po/ zhes su grags/ /'dul 'dzin mkhan slob ded dpon mchog de dang / /gsol bzhi'i las byi/ gru gzings la brten nas/ 4 /chos 'dul rgya mtsho'i snying bo spong bdun khrims/ /legs tshogs kun 'byung yid bzhin nor de blangs/ /dri med bslab gsum bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /mang thos dar kyi lhab lhub rtser bkod pa'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser basprengs pas/ /dge legs 'dod rgu'i gru char lhug par babs/ /bkras lhun du bzhugs ring paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas gnod sbyin dregs pa phywam sring gi rjes gnang gsan/ de nas bzung ste gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rje lcang skya ho thog thu la lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs par gda'/ zhesagyipaṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis rje gong ma'i rnam thar du gsung 'dug thos bsam gling dpon slob las paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang blo bzang ye shes gnyis kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung sogres gsan/ nyin gcig rje bla ma nyid7paṇa chen rin po che'i sku drung du phebs/ phyag phyi pa rnams phyir gsang nas nang sbyar gyi bslab ston mang zhig zhu ba mdzad par bka' lan zhib rgyas phebs shing7gong ma'i bstan srid dang rje rang gi sku che sogs la lung bsta na mdzad pa rnams phyis su de kho na bzhin pyung 'dug de skabasagyigong ma chen po yung ṭing gnam du gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsan pas/ rje bla ma nyid nas chos bka' mang ngo tshi/sa/ gsan rgyu'i thugs rtsis dang / 7paṇa chen mchog nas kyang rje 'di nyid bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par dgongs nas ci bzhed kyi bka'
