lhal dbang yab sras las lhas tshul gsan cing / paṇa rngon mchog las bsnyen 5gas bzhis tshul/ 201chos thams cad gnang ba'i dgongs pa yod 'dug kyang / rkyen des rje 'di ba blo bur du lha/ sar phebs dgos byung bas/ nyer drugre/ shā+ori+o/ )cha/ sku mdun du ja gral thog rten gsum gyis mtshon pa'i thon chas kyi gnang skyes gzab rgyas dang / bstan 'gro'i dpal du mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mdzad pa bla na med pas spyir yul gru thams cad dang / /khyad par du shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i yu ra kur7gong ma chen po'i bstan srid kyi zhabs 'degs yar rgyas su myo/dzad nas bstan 'gro'i mgon po bla na med par 'gyur pa'i zhal ta zhib rgyas su gnang / bkra shis lhun po nas phebs skyel dang bcas lha sar phyag phebs/ rgyal khab chen por chibs kyi kha lo bskyod par nye ba na/7rgyal dbang myo/chos/ nas rje nyid kyi nang rten gras nas thub dbang gi sku brnyan gyis gtsos li ma lnga sogs sku rten byin can sum cu lhag dang / kun gzigs lnga ba chen kro/'i sku thang rje nyid kyi / phyag nasda ma/ rje rin po che'i gsung 'bum cha tshang / rje nyid kyi dbu lo bubs/ phyag dril/ phyag ḍam sogs dbang chas cha tshang / 'phel gdung sogs byin rten gyi rigs du ma dang / paṇa zhwa sne ring gis gtso ba'i sku'i nyer spyad cha tshang / rin chen ril bu/ gzhan yang spos snam sogs dngos po'i gnang skyes bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / ja sag a chi thu chos rjes gtso bo'i phyag g.yog rnams la'ang so so'i go babs dang bstun pa'i sku brnyan byin rten dang bcas gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang / thugs shin tu brtse bas rjes 'dzin gyi zhal ta rgyas par gnang / de nas pebs khar sku mdun du mjal khar byon pas thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i bslab ston nang bcar mang du gnang zhing phan tshun 'bral mi

202 trel dbang yab sras lapha chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog las bsnyin rjogs bzhes tshul/phod pa byung / rje bla ma mchog nas dus kun rjes su 'dzin pa'i sa/sol 'debs dang skyabs 'jug zhu ba mdzad cing / gong sa mchog nas kyang thugs brtse ba'i spyan ras kyi gzigs pa bla na med pas zhal ta dang srung ba skyabs 'jug sogs rgyas pa bka' drin du stsal/ /rje 'di nyid sku drung nas phyir phebs skabs yun ring bor spyan ras kyis btsa' ba sogs mdzad/mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar phebs par sku tshe gang gi mdzad lugs kyi bslab bya mthar phyin pa stsal/ rje bla ma mchog nas byang chub snying bo'i bar du rjes 'dzin gyi zhu ba phul bar zhal bzhes bzang zhing phyag phreng rje 'di'i dbu la bskon pa phyag gis bzung nas mgon po'i bka' bsgo gnad smin zhig stsal/ de ltar mgar thar dang bod du bo nga/sum gyi bar bzhugs ring la rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhabs pad bsnyen nas mdo sngags kyi chotwasmi tshu ro bsam gyis mi khyab pas thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang / gad+ngha / ri sri khyad par can dang rten gsum byin rlabs can thams cad la mchod 'bul dang byin rlabs zhu ba sogs kyang thugs bzhed dang mthun par grub/ gdan sa chen bo rnams kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la mang 'gyed sogs zang zing dang dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher spel/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams dang 'bel gtam gyis dka' ba'i gnad la sgro 'dogs mang du bcad/ srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams pa'i grags pa bzang bo'i ba dan mthon por bsgrengs/ mdor na ded dpon mkhas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu son pa'am/ tshong dpon chen po yul gzhan du khe spogs grub pa bzhin du thugs bzhed mtha' das/ legs par grub nas slar yang ma hā tsi

spyoge dbangayabasras 4sa chos tshul gsan cing /paṇa chen mchog lamu bsnyin rdzogs bzhes tshu pa / lha03na'i phyogs su zhabs kyi pad+mo bskyod pa la mngon du phyogs so//thub chen rgyal ba'i sras ma/chog bye ba brgya'i/ /pagrod pa gcig pa'i brtul zhugs rmad po che/ /nyams pa med par bdag gir bzhes pa yi/ /snying stobs phul du byung ba'i sems dpa' /khyod/ /ring nas thos bsam sgom pa'i a mṛ tas/ /thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams gyur kyang / /rgyal sras taka tu ngu bzhin dam chos kyis/ /nam yang khyod thugs ngoms par ma gyur rnga/sa/ /rdos sdi 'byung gnas gangs can yul dbus su/ /rtos kyi —rgyal po phyas/ na pad+ma dang / /chos k+shi gter mdzod ngag dbang mchorge ldarno las/ /rdos kyi dzubadud rtsi lus pa d+med par gsol/ /khyad par theg gsum dam chos chu klung kun/ /gang du 'du ba nges gsang bla med mtsho/ /gus rtag brtson pa'i gru yis legs brgal nas/ /zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po rang gir bzhes/ /ngo mtshar gzi byin 'bar ba'i rten rnams ni/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis legs par mchod/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rol mtsho ji snyed pa/ /rgya chen gtong ba'i char gyis ci ji5nga bkang / /zab din sgang rtsi don gnyer rkang drug rnams/ /legs bshad pad dkar dri yis tshim par mdzad/ /mkhas rlom rtog ges dregs pa'i me khyer tshogs/ /lung rigs nyi ma'i 'od kyis mog por byas/ /rgyal ba'i dbang bo'i 'phrin las gser gyi gdugs/ /thabs mkhas mdzad bzang dpung bas dgung du bteg /gangs can mtha' dbus nor 'dzin khyon kun tu/ /phan bde me tog char ba snyoms par phab/ /gang gi kun bzang spyod pa'i me long du/ /rgyal dang rgyal

204 spyal dbang yab sras las ts+tshas tshul gsanacing/paṇachinamachogazizirdaspronarjogasabanes tshutsho/sras mkhas grub thams cad kyi/ /dpag yas mdzad bzang rdzogs par 'char ba yi/ /ngo mtshar phung bo 'di nyid mthong ba'i tshe/ /rang dang 'khor gyi dbus na seng chen bzhin/ /rlom pas 'gyings pa'i bla chen gzhan dag gi /spyod tshul phal cher spre'u'i zlos gar dang / /e raṇ+ḍa yi shing ltar bdag gis mthong / /ji lta ji ltar cher rlom de dag gi/ /snang tshul mtha' dag mngon du gyur pa na/tsho /de lta de ltar dpag yas yon tan gter/ /khyed la dad pa'i chu gter 'phyur bar gyur/ /gang sku mtshan dpe'i me tog rgyas pa'i tshal/ /gang lha/sung 'dzad med chos kyi phung bo'i gter/ /gang thugs shes bya'i rgyu skar bkra ba'i mkha'/ /gsang gsum yon tan sa/ter la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mo yab sras las mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mthar phyin pa gsan cing / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por mnga' brnyes pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //

205 rluzhu burgyud pu// gnamā buskos na/zhi tshangs pu chen rngo zhi zhud ñcā/rgasna rgyalka khabu chen li+o zhi dge zhadun rnamās lka zhugaska gnyis k+shi buslubu bru zhegs pur smrobu puzhi jimā ka glu mān nanga' na/sro lka zhing / bustan zhagyun nin t+pā che ton gyi skad du brasgyun pu dad / chorga sde chen po dgazha ldan py-in chags smring butsugs pu sgogaske zhasnyi d+ngha ni puzhi py-i bu rluzhag po che māldad puzhi tshuzha/de nas 'brug lo gza' skar tshes/ grangs bzang ba'i nyin rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi sku tshab/ sprul sku che khag rnams kyi dngos tshab ci rigs/grwa sa chen po rnam sa kyi mkhan slob las sne thams cad/ lha sar sdod pa'i gong ma'i mi drag am paṇa rnams dang / bod kyi bka' blon sogs mi chen du ma dang bcas pas phebs skyel dang / gzhung sa nas thab bsu bzhugs zhag sogs kyi grwa sgrig dang bcas lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te rim gyis dar mdo bar du bde bar phyag phebs/ khrin du phu nas pe'i cing bar du7gong ma'i mdzod nas gang ci'i grwa sgrig dang sa tshigs so so'i dpon po che chung du mas bsu skyel sogs bkur ste bla na med pa zhus/ lam bar du skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa

rngo206 tham ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sob/ skad du bsgyuXtram̐tram̐sogs/da da la mjal kha phya ga dbang dang don gnyer ba rnamyo/sa/ la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi stsol ngaramadzad pa sogs 'gro don rgya cher ma/dzad 'dug kyang zhib tu ma nges pas 'god par ma nus so/ /zi khron gyi sa'i cha zhang li da zer ba'i ri chen po'i la rtsar bzhugs zhag mdzad pa'i oṃtshan mo mnal lam du mi dmar po shin tu che ba zhig gis ri 'di'i rtse na nga rang gi khyim yod pas der phebs pa zhu zer nas kho rang gis gom pa gcig spos pas ri rtser slebs shing / rje nyid kyang der phebs pas khang bzang lta bas chog mi shes pa ma/nga du 'dug pa'i dbus ma zhig tu bzhugs su gsol te kha zas kyi bye gralhaka mi 'dra ba du mas mchod cing / kho rang gi bu dang chung ma yin zer k+ṣiṃ mang bo zhig gis mjal kha zhus/ sa cha 'di man chad kyi rgya yul thams cad kyi bdag po nged rang yin/ bod nas kyang nga la bza' btung ngoge+o gas ster mkhan mang bo yod/ khyad par gtsang gi bla chen sku bgres pa des nga la bza' btung yang yang ster gyin yod/ deng nas khyed kyi srung ma bgyid/ sang nyin lam du bar chad cung zad yod kyang nged kyis bsal bas chog zer ba zhig byung /sang nyin lam bar du shing nags kyi gseb nas spre'us rdo btang pa phyag g.yog pa tshul khrims dar rgyas kyi mgo la phog pas rma srol cung zad btod pa las skyon cher ma byung / de ni rgya skad du bkwan yun chang zer ba bod du bsgyur na sprin ring rgyal por grags pa de yin pa 'dug theg tse dang thugs rgyud gcig pas rtsang phyogs na bza' btung ster mkhan yod zer ba 7paṇa chen rin po che nas be+eg tse lcam sring bsten par mdzad pas de la zer ba yin 'dug phyis su bod du phebs skabs ri de'i rtsa ba nas gser

tham ka bla mar ga〈la zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 2skyelhaskyems shig ga/tong ba gnang bas ga nas byung cha med pa'i sa/can gzan stag zhig gis largyab bar du skyel ma'i tshu9pre byas pa phyag g.yog pa thams cad kyis mthong 'dug ces rje bla ma nyid kyis dngos su gsung ba thos so/ /rgyal khab chen po pe'i cing du phebs nas gnam gyi lhagyigong ma chen lung gser khrir 'khod pa la mjal 'phrad mdzad pas thugs dgyes pa chen pos bka' pa'adri sogs zhib tu phebs shing / yab rgyal po'i dus bzhin gyi gzigs pa chen pos bskyang ba mdzad/ rje thu'u bkwan pa rang yul du phebs rjes pe'i cing gi bla ma ser mo ba rnams kyi las don gyi tham ka khri chen sprul sku rin po cher gtad 'dug pa/ mi ring bar gong ma chen po'i bkas rje bla ma nyid la gtod pa gnang ste pho brang gi bla grwa rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya legs par slo ba pa'i tham ka bla mar mnga' gsol ba mdzad/ rgyal khab chen por phebs/ nas bod du7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bor snyan dngags kyi zhu 'phrin rmad du byung pa zhig 'bul bar mdzad 'dug pa'i phyi mo stor nas ma rnyed cing / mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang la zhu yig phul ba ni 'di ltar ro/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /ye shes lnga bdag zung 'jug sku brnyes shing / /bgrang yas dpa' bo pya /kha' 'gros mngon mchod pa/ /rje btsun thugs rje can gyi zhabs pad dru nga / /gang gi slob bu'i tha shal zhig /thag ring tsi na'i yul shed nas/ /bra ma'i bka' drin rjes dran nasdo// /gdung ba'i yid kyi mchid 'di gsol/ /sku rgyal ba lnga yi bdag nyi)ོ can/ /gsu nga mdo rgyud zab sa/nad dam chos

208 tham ka blapaḍi gsol ningapastan 'gyur sogasdid du rbasgyur tshul sogs/—da waston/ /thugs bde chen snying rje'i ngang du 'byams/ /rje bla ma sku khams bzang lags sam/ /bka' mdo rgyud mtha' yas dgongs don rnams// /gnas dbe+en par tshu9pre bzhin nyams su bzhes/ /tshul de la skal ldan gdul bya dgod/ /rje thar pa'i sa mkhan bde lags sam/ /chos ka ri ka nas 'dus pa'i bar/ /tshig sna gcig tsam yang ma lus pa/ /dpal zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i thabs su bzhed/ /rje mkhas pa'i dbang phyu—/ bde lags sam/ /lus lha ru bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid tha mal snang zhen rgyu bcaṭa/ sbyangs/ /gsung rig sngags nus pa mthar phyin pa/ /rje rig 'dzin chen po bde lags sam/ /sngags rno rje'i bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rlung zla nyi'i rgyu ba bhu tir thim/ /thugs spros bral bde chen dbyings su zhugs/ /rje grub thob chen po bde lags sam/ /lus sgyu ri 'od gsal dbyings su sbyangs/ /dbyings de las rdo rje'i sku ru bzhengs/ //rgyuko shes sgrib phra mo'ang zad par spangs/ /dpal zung 'jug chen po ba de lags sam/ /sku gcig la sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /gsuri gcig la sna tshogs chos phung sgrogs/ /thugs mkhyen paṭasdo shes bya'i dkyil 'khor sa/ zi sa/sa// /pha rdo rje 'chang chen bde lags sam/ /rgyu las dang skal ba bzang bo'i mthus/ /mgon khyod zhabs bsten ba'i sprang btsun bdag /lam bshul ring bgrod dka' nyam nga ba/ — /rje bla ma'i drin las bde bar bkrod/ /dus da lta rgyal khab chen po ru/ /khongagyigong ma chen po'i brtse gzigs kyis/ /lung las sogs bka' drin mnyam meḥre stsa rwa ri / /tshe 'di snang spros pa'i rgyar tshud kyang / /pha bla na/'i gsung

go wa thamakablamar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 209 ngag zhal gdams don/ /dpal dge ldan bka' rgyud gdams ngag mthil/ /dus nam zhig bsgrub par nu sa snyam pa'i/ /yid smon pas nyin mtshan 'da' bar gnas/ /'tshams zhu/ /pha bla ma rje btsun rin po che/ /tshul 'di la yang gcig snyan gson dang / /sprang bdag gi shes rgyud khye'u chung / /tshe 'di snang chos brgyad gdon gyis zin/ /rgyud rtag 'dzin zhags pas sme nas bcings/ /skye 'chi ba dang na rga'i cha/tshon gyis brabs/ /las dkar min gyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded/ /dgra bdaspu 'dzin gyi gshin rjes mdun nas bsus/ /gnatra/ ngan song gi g.yang du mngon phyogs na/ /pha bla ma yi thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /mgon khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /rgyud blo kha chos la phyogs pa dang / /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam rtsa ba bāshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ / dpal zung 'jug gi bar rnams tshe 'di la/ /dus myur bar skyes nas bstan 'gro'i don/ /rgya chen po bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sprang gus zhabs thugs nas ma bsnyel bar/ /gsung zhal gdams lhug par gnang ba dang / /dus snyigs ma'i ngang tshul ma dgongs par/ /zhabasami 'gyur bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs/ /chos med kyang chos parabatags pa yi/ /sprang rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas/ /pha bla ma'i bkadzodrin dran bzhin du/ /gnas rgyal khab che nas phul barme dge/zhes pa'o/ /snga phyi ma nges kyang skabs 'di dag tu /khri chen sprul sku blo bzang ba༈na pa'i nyi ma las chos bka' gsan pa'i rim pa ni/ 'phags

210 ba kabla mar gsol zhingabastana'agyurasogaskadadusprasgyuratshulasogs/lugs kyi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis ma dang /dpal ldan srad rgyud nas brgyud pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha/ bcu gsum dang dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis kyi dbang chen sogs zur bka' dang / spyi bka' rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan pa bzhin paṇa chen 'jigs med sbas pa'i zhabs kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil chog du ma phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa rdo rje 'phreng ba'igyidabang gi rim pa dang / de'i steng du dar+pān zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i kri ya sa muts+tsha nas bshad pa'i bde legs su byed pa'i dbang gsum bsnan pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang gi rim pa rnams phyag len sogs sla chos su ma song ba'i shin tu rgyas zhing zhib pa dang / mi tra brgya rtsa nas kyang 'ga' zhig gsan par mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs chos skor nas bde mchog dkar po/ khros nag sogs 'ga'i rjes gnang dang /grub rgyal lugs kyi che dbang / seng spu/dong ma dmar mo/ rnam 'joms/tshe rta mgon ba/sum/ ye shes khyung khra'i rjes gnang bkru byangs bsrung gsum dang 'brel ba'i rgyas pa/ de'i chos skor gyi lung / srad rgyud lugs kyi lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum ma'i rjes sa/nang / de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs skor gang yod kyi lung / gong— dkar rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig ltar gyi rwa pod yongs rdzogs/ lho brag bka' 'bum/ bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs klag lung skor du ma/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / stan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ bya bral ba chos skyong rgya mtsho'i sa/cod —ṭa/zhung / khri sprul rang gi sa/sung 'ga' zhig gi lung sogs chos bka' rnam graras mang du gsan 'dug kyang zhib par gsan yig ma mthong bas 'bri bar ma sprobs

tham ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur hu la sogs/ 211so/ /snga mo dgung lo phra dus a mdo ser tshud kyi sman pa mkhas pa nig las sa/so dpyad kyi sko ra lung man ngag lag len dang bcas pa zhib tu gsan 'dug dicing / skabs 'di 'dra cig tu skar rtsis la shin tu mkhas pa rtsis ram pa zhig las baiḍūr dkar po ma bu'i steng nas skar rtsis kyi ri mo yongs su rdzog sa pa dang / spor thang rdel 'grem so gas nag rtsis skor 'ga' zhig kyang zhib gzigs mdzad/ phyis su rta tshag rje drung rin po che'i phu po dpal bzang chos rje bya ba mdo sngags rig sānasathams cad dang khyad par du rtsis rig la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu son pa de las rtsi sa kyi dka' gnad du ma'i sgro 'dogs bcad cing / khong gi drung nas dbyangs 'char dang sgra'i sa ris yongs su rdzogs pa dang sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi dka' ba'i gnad rnams kyang zhib par gsan 'dug skabs shig gong ma chen po'i bka' las/ deng dus sog yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che rgya cher dar zhing / gong ma shing tsu bde skyid rgyal po'i bkas bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog yig tu bsgyur ba spar du sgrub pa mdzad 'dug kyang / bstan 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog yig tu bsgyur ba snga phan med 'dug pas/ lcang skya hu thog thu khyod kyis thugs khur mdzad nas bka'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog rnams hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba ma dzod ces phebs/ rje bla ma mchob/ nas bka' bzhin du thugs khur che bzhes kyis bsgyur ba la nye ba na/ chen po ho ra gyi yulo gru so so 'i skad kyi byings 'dra yang zur cure zad re mi 'dra ba mang zhing / khyarngosne par du chos dzo bskrur ba'i ming brda' 'dogs tshul bkas bcad 'dra ba zhig mi 'dug

212 tham ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyar sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/pas/ lo ts+tsha ba du mas so so ra rang rang gi 'dod pas tha snyad mi mthun pa sna tshogs sbyar tshe thos bsam byed pa rnams kyis rtogs dka' ba sogs nyes pa du ma'i gzhir 'gyur bas/ gsung rab kyi ming brda'i tha snyad 'dogs lugs rags bsdus shig sbyar nas spar du bsgrubs te kun la khyab par byas na legs tshulagyigong ma chen por snyan sgron phul bar dgyes pa chen po sdo/ de ltar gyis shig pa'i bka' stsal/ de nas dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba thog mar gleng sa/zhi dang chos bsgyur tshul gyi bkas bcad/ de nas phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba/ grub ོri tha'i skor/ sngags kyi skor/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ brda' sa/sar rnying skor rnams le tshan du byas te ming gi rnam grangs thams cad bod sog gi skad shanyis shan sbya ra du bgyis pa sdon med pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos gsar rtsom mdzad/ dag yig gi bstan bcos 'di nyid ma byung gong du hor gyi skad du chos bsgyur ba phal che ba ni/ rje bla ma rang nyid kyi gsung las/ skad gnyis gang yang rnam dbye tshul bzhin du/ /sbyangs pa med cing mkhas pa bsten pa'ang med/ /gang dran ming btags rtogs par ches dka' ba'i/ /gzhung rnams bsgyur pas chos min chos ltar 'chos/ /sgyur byed lo ts+tsha rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar gu shrī'i ming can gyi blun po shes rlom can mang bos snang bar gang dran gyi brda' cha— ) spyar ba dang /tshisku/ don log par bsgyur pas rga/sung rab dri bcas su byas pa cher+sā mang ba la/ deng sang gi dus su phal che bas snying khams dor nas bkas ngaca da

dzim ka bla mar gsol zheng bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 213dang mthun par blo gros zhib mos nor 'khrul med par bsgyur ba'i srol ches cher dar ba 'di ni rje bla ma mchog gi mdzad pa'i bstan bcos 'di'i drin du snang bas/ bka' drin 'di gcig pu yang hor sog gi skye bo rnams kyis nam du yang gzhal ba'i mtha' rnyed par dka'o/ /de ltar sngon gyi dus su rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'i sku ring la lo paṇa rnams kyis 'phags yul nas bod du dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i phyag srol dang mtshungs par bkas bcad mdzad de/ rje bla ma nyid dang khri chen sprul sku rin po che rnam gnyis sgyur byed kyi gtso bo dang / gzhan ji5nga gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa/'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo ts+tsha ba mkhas pa mang bo dang bcas pas lcags mo bya lo'i smin drug zla ba'i rgyal phur 'grub pyi+o/ra gyi nyin dbu btsugs chu pho khyi'i lo'i mgo zla'i tshes bco lnga la 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa grub par bgyis te/ gong ma chen por gzigs rtog phul bar dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad cing sgyur byed rnams la gtang rag gi yon sdogs khadag rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ gong ma'i mdzod nas spar du bsgrubs te chen po hor gyi yul gru thams cad la khyab par mdzad pas bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i cha rkyen mchog tu gyur to/ /mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bstod bsngags lhur len pa'i yul du gyur pa ste/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya ma tshos kyang khri chen sprul sku 'i rnamyo/ thar du/ chu khyi lo nas bzung bstan 'gyur sog skad la bsgyur pa dang / bsgyur zin 'a chosdo/ pa dang / zhus chen mdzad pa sogs kun du don yod pa'i legs mdzad kyi bya ba las byi 'khor lo la

214 thacha ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/gzhol bar mdzad/ rme khas grub chen po lcang skya rin po ches zhus chen 'di skor la phan pa'i dag yig gangs can 'dir 'phags pa'i yu' nas chos thog mar bsgyur ba'i skabs chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dgongs pa bstun pa'i rtosgra sbyor bam gnyis dang / bye brag rtogs byed sogs kyi tshul dang mtshungs pa'i legs bshad bka' rtsom gnang ba zhig kyang kho bos casu thong ba dang /snyan pa'i grags pa thos 'dzin gyi bu gar son pas sngar bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'di dge sdig gi blang dor la rmongs pa mun pa'i rum lta bu la rgyakhyopre blon lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin las dam pa'i chos kyi sna/nga bas nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gyur pa dang mtshungs par rgya hor gyi yul gru chen por yang / gong ma rem byon sogs kyi/ bka' drin las chos tshul la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa shin tu mang ba'i thog slar yang gangs can 'di dang 'bo+o ba'i dam chos kyi sgron me ches cher gsal bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za snya/ma gong ma bdag po chen po'i legs mdzad dang / bka/'i rjes su 'brangs nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad mkhan 'di dag la mos pa dang spro ba lhag par 'phel bar gyur to/ /zhes thugs shin tu rangs pa'i gsung gnang 'dug go/shar phyogs 'jig rten yangs par mgon 'di yi/ /ku/na tu bzang bo'i 'phrin las nam langs pas/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi rgud mu ོ/ nu ngas dang lhan/ /thub bstan nyi ma gsar ba'i gzi bajid 'bar/ /'phapos pa'i yul nas bod kyi sman ljongs su/ /dal gyis babs pa'i dze+estan 'choyob /tsang ma'i chab/ /chen po hor kyi yul skad ga/shong bu la/ /drang— pas skal bzang yid kyi/ dri ma bkus/ /bda' chad ri myo+o4ོ rā cho sa/sa ma 'a dre sdo

z-im me/ bladamar gsol zhing bstan 'astsar sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 215nga/ra/ /'char ba'i sngon med legs bshad me long 'di/ /sgyur byed rnam sa la 'jug bde'i kham bzang dang / /thar 'dod gsung rab blta ba'i mig tu gyur/ /thub bstan sa chen snyigs ma lnga yi mtshor/ /bying ba 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rus sbal gyis/ /nyer 'degs 'jug pa bcu pa'i rnam par thar/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir 'byung ba e ma mtshar/ /rta'i lo mkhan nang gdong7gong sa thams cad mkhyen par rje bla ma mchog nas snga mo sku na phra mo'i dus gsar rtsom gnang ba'i dbu ma'i yig cha sems bskyed dang po spyan star zhu rgyu dang bcas snya/na tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu yig cig 'bul bar mdzad 'dug kyang 'dra bshus kyi shog dril stor 'dug cing /de'i lan du7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos dbu ma 'jug pa'i ṭik+ka gsal ba'i me long sogs gzigs dpe dbu ma'i yig cha mang bo skyes su gnang zhing / sku na phra mo'i gnas skabs 'di 'dra nas ma/khyen dpyod ba/zhan dring mi 1rijog pa sa sngon med legs bshad kyi dga' sto tsu —/ kye cher stsal pa la thub/sa shin tu dgyes pa'i bsngags/ brjod kyi bka' lan brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa daṭī'i gzhung lugs las 'byung ba'i rgyan gyis spras pa 'di lta bu gnang 'dug ste/ /rang bzhin kun nas ches yangs me zhal lam / /rnam 'byed dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ /gzhan phan snang ba 'bum gyis sa yi steng / /dag byed nyi ma gnyis pa gang de la/ /dbyangs kyi rgya'/ mo mi zad pa yi ro/ /ca/grin par longs su spyad las smreng ba'i gtam/ /bcu drug yi ge'i 'gyur ba pyi5ga gi 'phreng / /sdebs legs snya/na ba'i nga ro t+nari di gso la te/ /

216 them ka bla tsār gsol 'ing bstan 'argyure sog skade rdu thesgyur tshul sonaso/dkyil 'khor gcig tu gdan bshams seng ge'i khrir/ /phyogs bral rgyal ba'i tshogs pa kun bgros nas/ /rang srid 'chi ba med pa chos kyi lam/ /gsal byed rigs kyi sras su khyod bskrun nas/ /tshogs gnyis rnam par dkar ba 'o ma'i mtsho/ /bsrubs skyes zla ba'i cha shas re re nas/ /gzhan don rdul dkar 'dzag pa'i ga bur sman/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba sel slad sa 'dir babs/ /rmongs chen dug rlangs 'khrigs pa'i klu yi srog /zos pas ngo mtshar mtshan dpe dbyig gi snying / /shes rab 'khor lo'i snang ba gser gyi 'od/ /mdza' bar 'khyud pa'i lang tsho gzhon nu nas/ /don dam 'od chags mu tig 'dzum dkar rlabs/ /khong nas grol ba'i mdo sngags chu gter che/ /mkhyen rab lto ba yangs por dog med du/ /'thungs pa'i gnyis skyes rgyal po a ga staḥ dkar min khyab 'jug rmig pa gtum po yis/ /bsad pa'i klu khrag dmar ba chu gter bzhin/ /babs pas nor 'dzin ma 'di skal dman du/ /bgyis te ches cher snyigs ma'i rtags shar yang / dam pa'i brtul zhugs skabs gsum du lha/ /ma bskul bar yang rang dang mthun pa'i sgra/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grags snyan cho ga yis/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston gsar ba khyod kyi khugs/ 'dzam gling mang bos bkur ba'i rgya'/ khab tu/ /gnam bskos lha yis bsngags pa 'i btso/'a btags bzhin/ /phan bde mngon par bzhad pa'i man+da ra/ /phyogs der char du bsnyil ba'i go skabs nas/ /dbyangs can phang 'gro'i rgyud las nyer drangs glu/ /don bzang legs par bshad pa'i rim/ chen phreng / /sna tshogs bdog pa'i za ma tog gi

ma ka bla mar gsol zhitha bstan 'gyur sog skadadubasgyuratshularngo/0/sa/ paṃ 17 wadabus/ /'khyil ba so na des spro dga' ci yang 'phel/ /'di na legs byas rkang ba nor 'dzin 'og /lkog tu brkyangs ba'i rtsa ba ches phra yang / /chos brgyad shun pa mthug po'i e raṇ+ḍa/ /snying bor re ba'i yal ga ngom bzhin du/ /sku bzhi'i ro mngar rga/yur za blo bzang gi /ring lugs sa hā ka ra 'di mthong tshe/ /thos bsam tsu ta'i 'khri shing stobs phra yang / /brtson pas 'khril te gzhan la dga' blo btang / /don tshig 'gal ba smra rtse gnyis rkyong sbrul/ /gzhan snang 'drid pa'i gya gyu las 'angongari shrī mas/ /kun la lhag bsam drang po'i dgu tshigs kyi/ /snang ba dag pa'i cha tsam dang du blangs/ /srid 'byor rmi lam yul gyi grong khyer du/ /bag phebs mdza' bar ston pa'i so skye phal/ /blo brid srin mo'i grogs ltar bsnyen dka' ba'i/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal klong 'dir mi dgyes kyang / /gzhan phan ri mo snying la bkod pa yi/ /dam bca' rdo bar bris pa ltar gsal bas/ /yi dam go cha sra ba rgyal sras che'i/ /ngang tshul nam yang mi lhod lhur bzhes shig /tha mal rnam rtog ri ltar mkhrigs pa'i stobs/ /bde stong ye shes rdo rje 'phyar tsam gyis/ /dum bur bshig nus gsang gsum lha'i ngo bor/ /ma g.yos bdud kyi g.yul ngo ming du choms/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgras/ /mkhas rlom wa skyes rnam thar bag la zhar/ /'god cing ci mdzad gzhan la sman pa'i dpyid/ /rang gir mdzad nas rtag tu zhabs brtan 'tshal/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i cha rdzogs zla ba'i gzhung / /ngan rtog rnyog pa yongs dwangs chu shel khams/ /rab gsal ā dar+sha sogs sngon med kyi/ /les/sa bshad glegs

da /218 tham ka bla mar gso la zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogaṭā/ ——wad bam skyes bzang snang ba spros/ /de ltar mngon dga' dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /ca/dra na du nyer bos gzhan gsos bu yi glu/ /gzigs rngo /ra bstar ba'i spu sdu sa/ ngom bzhin du/ /phul bas dge mtshan nyi ltar 'bar gyur cig /ces pa dang zur du tshig lhug pa'i bka' 'phrin du gsar rtsom dbu rma 'i yis/ cha de nyid mjug yongs su/ rdzogs pa grub pa mdzad dgos tshul gyi bskul ma'ang gnang 'dug shing pho byi ba'i loXgong ma chen pos rje bla myo/ nyid la bod gangs can gyi ljongs su bstan pa rin po che ci ltar dar tshukhapa / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu ci lta bu byon tshul/ bshad sgrub kyi sde ci 'dra chags tshul rnamyo/sa bka' 'dri zhib tu sa/nang bar/ rje bla ma mchog na8 / so sori lo rgyus rgyas par snyan du phul bar/ bka' las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnasari pa bshad sgrub kyi sde la rag las shing / de ya nga mdo sngags tha snya/da rig gnas thamyo/sa cad la so sor thos bsam byed pa'i slob grwa'i sde chen po byung na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa 'dug phyogs 'dir sdon gyi dus su 'jam mgon sa paṇa dang 'phags pa rin po che sogs kyis 'chad nyan gye lde pacurta/r+shashaṃ 'dug na'ang da lta'i dus su ming tsam du gyur 'dug nged kyi yab mes gong ma rnams/ kyi sku ring la sangs rgyas kyi/ ngastan pa rin ngo/ che'i srol le nga/sa par nga tsugs shing / gong ma bde skyid rgyal po dang lcang skya gor ma yon mchod kyis kya/tsho bdun lha khang du mdo phyorngu/sa kyi 'chad nyan me+e sde pa 'i grwa tshang ngatsugs 'dug na'ang / rgyal khab chen po 'dir 'chad nyan gyi grwa tshang ma btsugs 'a dug pas/ da cha rang re yo na mchod kyis pho brang chen po 'dir ko/tsug lag khang gas ra du

tham ka kra mar gso la /nga bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 219bzhengs te/ mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa la thos bsam byed pa'i grwa tshang khag 'ga' btsugs na bstan pa'i gso sa su che ba yo nga ngam zhes bka' gnang ba la/ rje bla ma mchog nas/ 7gong ma bdag po chen po nyid thugs bskyed gzhan da nga ma 'dra bas bka' phebs bzhin grwa tshang btsugs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs 'dir nyi ma gsal ba bzhin yong ba gzhir /ba cas 'i/nga / phran bus kyang nus pa ci yo da kyis phyag ga—ོ/ / ga bgyid ces gsol bar gong ma chen po thugs shin tu dgyes/ de nas mi ring bar7gong ma chen po'i mdzod nas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi sgo 'phar phye ste/ yab rgyal po wang ba/nang dus kyi bzhugs gnas su dgon sde gsar bskrun gyi las grwa btsugs te/ phyi'i khor lug tu lcags ri shin tu yangs pas bskor ba'i dbus su tshogs chen gyi 'du khang chen mo/ de'i g.ya sa/ phyogs su lha khang / g.yon du ma gon khang / sdom pa 'bog pa'i khang pa/ ga/dugs dkar lha khang / sma/na bla khang / rgya gar lha khang / dge ldan lha khang / chos 'kho ra lha khang / rgya/la chen khang / sgo khang / rnga khang / cung khang / bre phul brtse gas pa'i rta bab sogs shin tu rgya che zhing bkod pa mdzes pa dang / grwa tshang so so 'i 'du khang rung khang bla brang grwa ba so sor khang pa che chung tshang mang dang bcas gshag skor grangs mang zhing rgya che ba rgyu dang bzo bkod phul du byung ba rgyal byed tshal gnyis pa lta bu legs par grub/ gtsug lag khang rnamyo/sa su sku gsu/—nga thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mchod rdzas gang la gang 'cha— / rnarda grangs rtsi/na tu mang ba me ga gi bdud rtsi phyogs

220 tham ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshukha/ ngo gas/gcig tu spungs pa lta bu dang / 'du khang dang bla gra'i spyil bu rnams su tha na phyag ma yan chad kyi nyer mkho'i yo byad gang yang ma cha nga ba med pa mdzod nas bsgrub par mdzad/ chos sde'i mtshan dgo/'a ldan byin chags gling zhes pa gnang zhing / /rje bla ma nyid dang khri chen sprul skusagagatso ba'i dge 'dun du mas rab gnas rgyas pa dgung zhag gsum gyi bar gnang ste/ye shes kyi byin chen po phab/ gong nas kyang rab yon gyi gnang sbyin rgya che ba stsal/ lo de kha'i nang du sog po tsho chen bgi bcu zhe dgu/ kha ba kha tsho ba bdun sogs dang / gzhan yang rgya bod kyi btsun gsar blo rig bzang ba lnga brgya bsdus te mtshan nyid kyi pu ti lnga la slob nga/nyer byed pa'i grwa tshang /rgyud pa grwa tshang / rig gnas sna tshogs kyi grwa tshang / sman pa grwa tshang dang bcas grwa tshang bzhi btsugs te gtsug lag khang so sor mchod thebs dang /dge 'dun rnams la gsol phog zla re bzhin mdzod nas sbyor 'jags mdzad/ grwa tshang so sor bla ma dang dge rgan du 'os pa'i nage bshes bod nas gtong dgos tshul gyi bka' phebs pa bzhin mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi bla mar 'bras spungs ha sdang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos 'phel/ rgyud pa grwa tshang gi bla mar srad rgyud bla ma dkon mchog bstan dar/ rig gnas grwa tshang gi bla mar rmog lcog zhabs drung / gso rig grwa tshang gi bla mar phun tshogs 'dzam gling / blo gsal ba rnams kyi dge rgan du gdan sa chen po gsum dang rgyud stod smad sogs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bco brgyad bcas so sor ngo g.yog dang bcas pa 'byor/ chos sde btsugs nasagyigong ma chen po nyid yang yang phebs nas gzigs rtog gnang zhing / bod nas

ma ka bla mar gsol zhing bltan 'argyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 221 phebs pa'i dge bshes rnams la bgro gleng byed du 'jug pa sa/nang /thugs shin tu dgyes pas slob dpon rnams la so sor gos dar gyon pa sogs kyi gnang sbyin dang / grwa ba rnams la rtse zhwa zla gam dang dngul sogs kyi gsol ras gya nom pa stsal/ rje bla ma mchog la chos sde chen po legs par tshugs pa'i legs skyes kyi gnang cha dang phral yun kun tu dge ba'i bka' bzang bo phebs/ bod nasagyirgyal dbang srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan chen pos/ pe'i cing du chos sde chen po gsar bskrun sogs bstan pa'i sri zhu mdzad pa'i legs sor kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i ljags bkod ltar gyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bris thang gras mtshungs/gtso thang gi rgyab tu bka' rtsom smon tshig can khyad 'phags dang / sku gsung thu—sna/sa rten du ma 'bul rgyu gnang ba rnams7gong ma chen por 'bul skabs/ bdag po chen pos kyang tā la'i bla mas nged la gnang ba'i rten 'dis bsta na pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig ces bden tshig brjod pa gnang ste sku thang nang nas gcig phyag tu bzhes par gtso thang zhal byang can byung bas dgyes tshor bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing /grwa tshang gsar btsugs kyi 'du khang chen mor bkram par mthongs 'khor /khrig gis gang bas rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa la bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad/ rgyal ḍadabang mchog nas rje bla ma 'di nyid la yang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog hor gyi skad du bsgyur pa dang / chos sde chen po btsugs pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs mthar spel ba'i mdzad pa rlarkas che ba la bsngags brjod kye lha/sung shog kun sa/zigs lnga ba chen

da lde22 ———— — rda po zhi mar gasdol zhing bsan 'arter sog skad du bsgyur tshul tshugs/ po'e sku thang byin can dang byin rlabs rten sog/sa phon che ba bskur gnang mdzad/ skabs 'a di 'dra zhig tu rje bla ma 'i mkhyen rab pyi klo ri naṭashe zung lda kyo/ dar dbyangs ngesdo/ pa'i bya dka' ba 'ba' zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la bstod cing bkra shis pa'i snyan tshig du ma remig tu bkod pa'i kun bzang 'khor lo klag chusmra/ ya mchan can/ skad gnyis shan sbyar gyis shis brjo da sogs snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad yid 'phrog pa du mas brgyan pa chos srid dge legs rab rgyas zhes bya ba zhig mdzad nas/ gong ma chen por phul bas gong ma thugs ngo mtshar ba'i bsngags brjod rgya cher gnang zhing /phral mar par du brkos te bla dpon du ma la ya mtshan pa'i gnang skyes su stsol bar mdzad do/ /me stag hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du gong ma'i bkas chos sde gsar bar lha ldan smo na lam gyi srol btsugs/ gong ma bdag po chen po tshogs dbur phebhas thog rje bla ma nyid dang dga' ldan shri re thu sprul sku rnam gnyis la chos kyi bgro gleng dang / dgon pa gsar ba'i grwa skor ba gnyis kyi dam bca' bzhag par dge bshes mang bos bgro gleng btang ste lha ldan smon lam bzhin ming btags kyi srol 'dzugs pa gnang / 7gong ma'i bkas sku mdun de khar rje bla ma mchog nas khri chen sprul skus gtso ba'i bla ma dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la bka' chos thun gcig tsam ba/nang zhing /rje bla maragyigong nas pazhugs gdan snyel 'bol nyer dpyad sna / tshogs kyis mtshon pa'i gnang sbyin rgya che ba dang / bla ma grwa rigs thams cad la babs bstun gyi gsol ras rgya cher stsal/ de ltar 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i gser gyi rgyal khab tu mdo ri

tham ka bla mar gsol zhijig bstana'agrur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/ 223sngagaru/ kye bshad grwa tshen po gsar du 'dzugs par na dzad pa 'di ni rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos/ bstan pa rin chen mchog gis sa khyab pa'am/ /khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ /snyi nga rje chen pos yi da rab bskyod pa yis/ /pham/ bde'i gter de gsal bar bgyid par shog /ces gsungs pa dang mthun par rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyiṭa/ ring mo zhis/ nas rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam mang du mdzad pari —'bras bu dus su smin te/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug gong cha da na po dang mchod yon zung du 'brel ba'i mthu las thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad tshang la ma nor ba zhwa ser cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung ba ste/ tshul 'di ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bsngags pa'i gnas dang /gzur gnas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa mtha' dag dad pa dang spro ba dang rjesasu yi rangs pa'i yul du gyur pa'o//rgyal ba kun kyi sras kyi thu bo khyod/ /lung rtogs 'dod rgu'i 'byor bas mngon ma/tho ba'i/ yongs rdzogs thub bstan chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ste/ /sa la skabs gsum gnas kyi ngo mtshar kun/ /rdzogs par bkod pa shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab/ /rnam thos sras kyi 'byor pa skyeng byed pa'i/ /gser gyi ba gam brtsegs pa'i pho brang na/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi gaul/ /kyāl mtshan rtse mor gang du bkod pa'i sdu/ /sa phyogs rdur ni lha mi'i dbal 'byor kun/༷ /kun tu 'bad med char du 'babs pa bzhin/ /bsod nams bye bas bsnan

224 tham ka bla mar gsol zhing bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur tshul sogs/pa'i zhabs zung mthil/ /mtshan bzang gser gyi 'khor lori 0/zi byin dang / /sa skyong dad pa'i gtsug nor 'bar ba'i 'od/ /sa/cig tu 'dres pa'i dge legs snang ba yis/ /'jig rten bde skyid snang ba kha zas su/ /za ba'i rtsod dus mun pa'i dpung bcom nas/ /nor 'dzin dga' ba'i bzhin ras pad+ma la/ /rdzogs ldan lang tsho'i 'dzum bag gsal bar byas/ /mgon khyod chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud len dang / /mi rje'i bsod nams nyi 'od zung 'asgel gyis/ /bskyangs las phan bde'i dri bsung 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thub bstan 'dab brgya'i tshal chen lhag par bzhad/ /rnam dag bslab gsum gser gyi ze'u 'bru can/ /ngur smrig 'dab ma bzhad pa'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /yongs su bdo bas rgya mtsho'i gos can gyis/ /gur kum me tog stod g.yogs 'dzin par gyur/ /nges pa'i don du zur phud lnga ba dang / /ngo bo gcig kyang drang don gdul bya'i ngor/ /mchod yon nyi zla zung gi rol pa yis/ /chos srid 'od snang 'gyed pa'i 'phrul 'di rmad/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ gnam bskos sa'i tshangs pa chen po'i lung gis rgyal khab chen po'i dge 'dun rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya legs par slob pa'i tharma ka/ bla mar mnga' gsol zhing / bstan 'gyur rin po che hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba dang / chos sde chen po dga' ldan byin chags gling btsugs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //

225rlu'u dgu bu/ rgyalka dazhi dbrad tho dad phun tshun/ snyan tshog rna zhazhi budhud rlun nyu sgo nas chos nu dga' s+t+waṃn spelka bu srogs mādod pu thon zhu zhaga' zhig sde tshan du byus puzhi tshulka/ snga ma gong sa rgyal dbang mchog gi chab shog gnang bar 'jug ṭika sems bskyed dang po gsar rtsom medzad pa de ma/jug yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa gnang dgos tshul phebs pa'i bka' lan du zhu 'phrin tshigs su bcad pa dbyangs can mgrin si ra 'phos pa'i snya/na tshig ngo mtshar can 'bul bar mdzad pa 'di ltar ro/ /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan khengs pa 'phrog byed gser gyi chu skyes rnam rgyas rab mdze sa zhal/ /mthong ba'i mod la lha brgya'i cod paṇa gyis btud nor bu'i rtse dga' la 'grogs pa'i/ /zhabs sen ga bur thigs pa lhung mod srid zhi'i rgud 'phrog phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa yi/ /ma lus mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus gang gi zhabs pad dge legs ge sar rnam bzhad drung / /gtsug dang snying la khyod zhabs rdul phreng gis/ /bkra shis ri mor bkod pas blo gros nor/ /ches cher dbul ba'i gnas su ma gyur des/ /snyan 'jebs zhu 'os 'dab brgya'i phreng 'di spel/ /skye dgu'i legs byas rin chen rdul mang lhun por brtsegs pa'i rtser/ /bsod nams ye shes lhun sdug ne ma par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nas/ /mkhyen brtse'i spyan stong ldan pa

cad mo6 rgyaladabang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/mchod sbyin ngargya ba'i dpal brjid pas/ /mkhas mang mtho ris bu mo mgon dang bcas kyi gzhan gyis min/ /mdzes sku bdud rtsi'i rtsa lag rgyas pas zla ba kun gsal ngogs su bros/ /rnar snyan yid 'phrog rga/sung gis mes po smra bcad bsam gtan zol la bkod/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' yangs pas rgya mtsho'ang rmig rjes chus mtshon zhes/ /snyan pa'i me tog phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'gram pa dag la ring du 'phyang / /thub pa'i gsung rab chos phung ma lus pa'i/ /gnad zab brgya phrag bh+ra ma ra tshogs kyis/ /khyod thugs 'dab brgya'i tshal chen kho na la/ /rol par gyur 'dis mkhas kun khengs pa 'phrog /gang gi ljags kyi pad mtsho'i rdul ni dbyangs can bye ba'i ngang mo yi/ /phang phung zlos gar lta bu snyan dngags mgrin pa'i rdza rnga khrol ba can/ /rgyan mang nyams kyi 'jo sgeg rol pas chos phung dga' ston mngon 'gyed pa/ /mthong bas dge dbang sras bces zhing 'di yongs ‘btang mtho ris skas la 'dzegs/ /de lta'i sa/sung mchog chu skyes mngal gyi dbyangs kyang mu cor gtam gyi gnas dgod pas/ /zla mdzis ma ni 'phrin gyi gzugs su bgyis gang stong phrag nyams 'gyur gyis sgeg cing / /gnang rten rgyan gyis mdzes pa phebs pas khyod sku mtshan dpe'i ri bong mtshan ma can/ /ma bris par yang bdag yid rdzeng bur gsal bas dga' dad skyo rnams 'gran bzhin rgyas/ /gang gi drin gyis 'tsho ba bdag /lus sems gsar 'tshes rab dben cing / /'di snang chos brgyad g.yeng ba'i rgyar/ /tshud pas chos las ring du gol/ /mtshams zhus/slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /rgyal rnams 'gro phan snying stobs go

— ——— — spyo/—dbang — dz+rag da ri rwaru dzi—da—bhare sa/ spe tshulnga sdo+o/gas/ — 2hūṃkau /rmeca na d+ngha ga nga / / tsher rtis/sa lnga/ b.ri dz+nyāḍini/ tshu ra 'di du bzo2) na sa/ /rang ṣ+yono/ bstan la btang snyemyo/ri shrī ri ra ja da gyur paṭa// skye dgu myo/nge|na bra pre gnar+sha/ skabs ‘krānir byur kyang / /mtha' yak+tosmu rgya/la ba'i mdzod nga thi/ na/ /khyod 'ba' zhig gi sa khur ṣ+ṭi 5ngas te/ /'gro ba rnam sa kyi dbugs 'abhi na 'dir/ /bsams kyi/na blo ldan su mi gus/ /sa/dukhyosga bar ches dka'i 'gro la rab brtse bas/ /dka' ba dang blangs khyod tshul 'dir dpags na/ /dag pa'i zhing gzhan dgyes spyod rgyal sras rnams/ /thupo/sa bskyed zhi ba'i ma thasnyer ru gol bar nges/ /dbang bzhi'i rin chen khams las grub/ /rgyud bzhi'i bang rim ska rags can/ /rim gnyis nyi zla'i 'od snang mdzes/ /sngag/sa 'chang lhu3 / po khyod las su/ /bde stong rdo rje 'i rtse brgya rab 'bar bas tha ca/'ge skye khyochi'i 'ching ba rab bcad nas/ /ye shes dza bdag rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /rdo rje 'chang khyod zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /mtha' bral zla ba'i nga /zhung la spyi nga rito‘ ri dhis / /rnam par dpyad la bong ba gser gzigs kyis/ /rdzong/ riye nga ra gyis zhes bka' drin stsal pa nga / /sgrub pa'i mchod par bsams te 'bad rigs kyang / /sdon 'a sa rlung shugs kyis bdas paspukyi/ /g.yeng ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa yis/ /da 'amin grub par ma gyu 5 kyang / /slad nas ci nus bgyis te 'bul/ /khyod zhal myur du mjal tha dang / /gsung gi bdud rtsir spyod pa dang / /ci gsung nyams su len pa la/ /gegs bral 'gyur bar thupos/sasdo rjes gzig/sa/ /bka' mchid snya na 'jebs tasbu ra yi sgra/ /rmongs pa'i yid gaji+o ri+o /sa chad med sgrogs pa dang / /thugs dam basbi/nga 'a/ror rdo rje'i

rgyal dbang mtshag dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul rtso gas/ 22nyapa'i gtam des 'jam dbyangs sa/zhon nu yang / /rnam med bde ba chenapo'i dbyings su bros/ /skyes thob khor yug brtan pa'i ri bo'i ngos/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med rta gdong me/ /'ebar ba'i gzi yis srid dang zhi ba yi/ /rgud tshogs chu gter yongs su za 'am snyam/ /phyi nang rig pa'i gnas kyi chos kun la/ /rnam 'byed gzigs pa yangs pa'i 'dren byed stong / /gsal ba'i brgya byin shākya'i sras bo zhig /shar phyogs nor 'dzin thig ler bsti zhes gleng / /nyams 'gyur stong gis sgeg pa'i sgra ldan ma/ /skyes bzang du k+ta la yis lhab lhub tu/ /brgyan te shis brjod glu gar rol bzhin du/ /mngon par brtsen pas phul byung dga' ba thob/ /legs spyad 'khor lo bcu ba'i shing rta yis/ /drangs pa'i dga' ldan ring lugs bsam 'phel dbang / /rang gi bgo skal spyod pa'i ded dpon zhig /'di na phan bde'i 'dod dgu sbyin par smon/ /dkar min lto 'gro khros pa'i spyi bo na/ /'dug pa'i dbang gi rgyal po ji bzhin du/ /ngan spyod snyigs ma bdo ba'i kha rlangs kyis/ /gtses kyang rang gi ngang tshul ga la 'dor/ /skabs 'gar bzang ba'i spyod pa ltar snang yang / /chos brgyad smyon pa'i gar la yid brtan ci/ /de phyir rang gzhan kun la ches sman pa'i/ /gtan mdun dase/ bas stong 'di ya ma brla/ /'on kyang stobs bcu mnga' ba'i zhal gyi lung / /slu med bden pa'i ri mo snying dbus su/ /bris nas dka' thub spyod pa'i drang srong bzhin/ /chos tshul dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la sbo/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs kun la snying bo'i lcid/ /rnam 'dren mkhyen glu'i srang la ma dmigs kyang / /rmong rtul sgyu mar zhen rnams phyi phyir du/ /

da 3shi0 rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi sa' bi spel tshul—0 0—/ —'ching 'dis thugs la pharnag dka'i khur bzhes la/ /rab 'bar dmyal ba'i grong du sa/zhan gyi phyir/ /mtho ris pad+ma'i tshal ltar mngon dgyes pa'i//'phags chen rang gi ngang tshul ji lta ba/ /gzhan don lhod pa med pa'i yi dmyo/ ngos/ /lus can thams cad sgrol gyi phyag ring zung / /brkyangs te ma 'dris skye bo mang bo la/ /rnam pa kun tu dge ba'i dam chos nor/ /ster ba'i mdzad bzang nam yang mi bskyud 'tshal/ /gdod na riṭa ma skyeri sdo stong ba nyid kyi mkhar/ /snang stong khro bo'i gzugs su mngon bzhengs te/ /khams gsum zas su za ba'i brtul zhugs kyi/ /rnal 'byor dag rnga/'i gzigs mor rtag rol zhu/ /sdug bsngal srin mo /khros pa'i mche ba'i bar/ /nyam thag khrag rgyun 'dzag pa'i lus can la/ /sman par 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed rtsal shugs kyis/ /ci mdzad cang shes byang chub lam du sgyur/ /de ltar 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi glu/ /rab dkar baiḍūr khog pa la chags pha'i/ /gtam 'dis khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /rgud tshogs gru rdzings dum bur zhig gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /de du5 shrī sa/zhu ra yi/ mkhan por 'gro mkhan deng sang bzhin du ham pa su che dang zhu rten gang sa/zab la lta ba ma yin par dge bshes sku yon bzang nges rigs tshag btsub/sa nas gtong ba gnang gi yod 'dug pas/ lo snga phyi gnyis kyi mkhan por byang rtse slob dpon ngag dbang lhun grub pa btang byung bar/ khong pa dge ba'i bshes gnyem/ chen po yin pa dang / snga myo / mgasno thar dang bod du thugs 'dris che ba bcas yang yang sku mdun du phebs nas chos kyi gsung gleng dmar ba byung 'dug dus mtshams zhib mo ma nges kyang skabs 'di 'dra

—da wa rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul (ོsu+ogs/ 231zhig tu go nga ma chesna po rang gi ca5 khyen rab kyi rtsasnyel gyis/ 'a/dz+rar yig sa/sar ba bzo 'a/ te/— ( zeb 'og gi bla dpon phal che ba'i tham ka dang / yā mu na che chung gi rka5 ri— thaspyo4 rnapāri/sa kyi yi ge bsgyur balko/da sa/nang bas/ yab rgyal pos rje bla mar gnang ba'i tā kau shri'i gser tham rnying ba phar bzhes nas/ 'khor yig gsar ba ba7ོ//da pa'i gser tham ched du bskrun pa mong gol cur gan gyi a li ha yiri ma paṇa gtso ba'i mi drag mang bo bkas mngags te zung gru zir rje bla ma mchog la stso la ba mdzad/ yang skabs shig bzhugs stan ser po 'brug mdang gong ma rang gi dbu la 'bub bzhin pa'i gdugs ser po gser 'brug ji/ ri mo can zhig kyang bla ma mchog la gnang nas phan ston du phebs ska sas khyer chog pa'i bka'i gnang ba'ang bstsal te gzengs bstod dpe las 'das pa mdzad 'dug gser ldan khyon la dbang byed mi yi lhas/ /gser spe dog co da paṇa 'dzin pa'i0 mgon po 'di/ /gser ltar bsngags pa'i 'os su nyer gzigs nas/ /gasdor tham gdugs so r+ghaṃs kul nas bsnyen cing bkur/ /byang chub se ma sa dang tshul khrims da ga pa'i myo/thus///bsdigargyusmu pa med par dregs ldan kun 'dud pa/ /'di ko deng duṭasmu cher rlom spur ma 'ga'/ / chonu/ rnga sku rgyad rlung gis bteg dang ma tshungs pa min/ /'di dus bkra shis lhun por 7paṇa chen mchu+og gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dbang bo bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por gdan drangs te gdong lngaspu/ bteg pa'i 'od 'bar nor bu'i khri la mnga' gso/la nga'i rten 'byung du zhu yig dang dngos 'bul gyi legs skyes rgya che zhing spam ma tho ba da nga / 7paṇa chen gong ma'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu rin po che

da 232 0 rgyal dbangamachog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ da wa snying bor bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong chen por mchod pa'i yo byad rgya che ba 'bul rgyu bcas/ gser yig pa tā bla ma blo bzang tshe ring can la bskur ba gnang / /blo bzang ye shes nyi ma 'od po che/ /bde ldan nub ri'i phang bar gzim paX las/ ༷/slar yang gangs can skal bzang kurdo'i gnyen/ /dap+tal ldaspya ༷ shesngu zla snang gsar ba bzung / /de yi ya mtshan bdud rtsi'i thigs pa yis/ /khyod thugs dgyes pa'i chu gter 'phel ba las/ /legs skyes bdog pa'i rlabs phreng 'phyur ba'i rtser/ /bstod bsngags dad pa'i mgrin glu ci yang bsgrags/ bar skabs shig gong ma'i bka' las/ pho brang chen po'i nang du rgya dang hor gyi rgyal rabs nas bzung da lta yan chad —du rim par byung ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams/ /sku rgyu dang lha so so'i ngos 'dzin khungs dag mi dag gi dbye gsal dang go ba bas bsgrig chags mi 'dug pas de rnams gsal bar byas te so sor bod sog gi yi ge shan spyar gyi kha byang yod pa mdzod/ ces phebs pa bzhin rje bla ma nyid kyis gtso mdzad khri sprul sogs pho brang nang gi bla ma drags rigs dang cur gan gyi yig mkhan kha shas kyis rogs ram bgyis te zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar zhib dpyad kyis rgyu mtshan rnams snyan du phul ba dgongs par 'byor bas bdag rkyen kyang che ba mdzad/ ston kha gong ma ri dwags kyi sa nas mtsho bdun dgon par phebs rgyu'i bka' gnang bas/ rje bla ma nyid snga 'gros kyis do lon nor du phebs/ rgyal po phebs skabs bsu ba dang ser spreng byed lugs sogs kyi bslab rto/na mdzad cing / 7gong ma dgon par phebs thog chos kyi 'bol gtam byed dgos pa'i bka' — tre

— lhal dbang mchog dang chos spyi dga' tram̐n spel tshul sos/sa/ 233 waphebs pa bzhin/ rje bla ma nyid dang khri sprul sku rnam gnyis nar bgro gleng dang / yang khri spru ra sku dang ha pre ha rje pa tsun dam pa'i sprul sku gnyis bgro gleng gam/nga du bcug pa gsan/ 7 gong ma tshen por sngon rgyal po gong ma rnams sde 'dir phebs dus kyi 'u gas srol rnying ba bzhin gsol ston dang sku gsung thugs rten/ spos/ snam bu/ rta sogs kyi 'bul nor bteg par sku gsung thugs rten rnams bzhes nas gzhan rnams phyir stsal/ ston mo spyan lam du bstar ba rnams 'di rnams bla mas nged la drangs pa'i ston mo yin zhes dgyeru/ pa'i rnam pas wang so pat+pās mi drags rnams la gso sa ras su stsal/ rje bla mar rin po che'i rigs kyi phreng ba che chung / bzang dgos/ rta brgya sogs dngosdo/ po'i gnarasbyin dang /dgon pa'i bla ma grwa rigs tshang mar gnang sbyin gya nom pa stsal/ gong ma phyir phedhe 5sa nas zhag shas bzhugs ring la sog po'i dpon che chung du ma dang / phyogs nas dad 'dus kyi skya ser gyi khrom chen por mjal kha phyag dbang dang / so/ sori 'dod mos kyis bka' chos kyi rigs kyang mang du gnang / tshur phebs lam du ong nyod wang dang pe'i li har chen wang rnams kyis rang rang gi gnas su gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur rgya cher zhus shing thams cad la 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad nas rim gyis pho brang du phyag phebs/ /srid pa gaṭa/la ba'i me long rnga bong gis/ /srid pa'i rgyu skar go la'i lamyo/ baspod bzhin/ /srid skyong rgyal po'i mchod r+ghaṃnas rten gsum rnams/ /sdid zhi'i gtsug rgyan khyed kyis go rim bsgrigs/ /dpal 'byor gdengs ka/ dad pa'i nor bu yis/ /mdzes pa'i skal bzang klu tshogs

da dzo3/ 4de — gyil dbangamachog dang tshos kyi dga' ston spil tshul sogs/ bso )ོ na3 byi/ /dpal la rol go/sa myori tsho bdun me long du/ /mchod yon nyi zla zung gi snang bas rtsen/ /de tshe skom pas gdungs rnams chu myo/thong bzhi/na/ /khyo/ da zhal myosmi jal la rings pa'i skal ldan mang / /gcig char 'dus pa'i lced kyis nor 'dzin ma/ /ngal bas rngul chu'i nyal 'gro phyogs kun babs/ /gang gi byin rlabs sa bon de dag gi /shes rgyud dad pas gshin pa'i zhing sa la/ /btab las mthong dang ma mthong legs tshogs 'bras/ /phral dang yul du spyod pa'i skal ba thob/ /lo mtshams ma nges kyang skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu rje bla ma nyid grum bu lta bu'i snyun gzhi zhig gis/ phyag zhabs bsnyel zhing / spyan kyang bsnyungs pa'i tshul bstan nas rgyun ring tsam song bar sman pa myo/khas pa nyams bsdur gyis sman dpyad phul ba dang / phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis zhabs brtan rim kro 'bad pas bsgrubs pas kyang ngo skyed cher ma bzhes pas/ gong ma chen po yang thugs khral shin tu che bas rgya'i sman pa mkhas pa kha shas re mos kyis gtong ba gnang —'i/nga / 7rgyal po rang nyid kyang phebs nas gzigs rtog mdzad pa sogs bka' drin tshad med pas bskyangs/ 'di skabs dpal bzang chos rje nas lha mo'i pra 'bebs mdzad par pra rten gyi mthong snang la sku'i nye 'khor du sdom sdig shin tu che ba mang bos bskor nas mtho 'tshams pa'i tshul du 'dug pa/ mi dmyo/ra po gzi brjid can zhig gis ral gri thogs te de rnams yul gzhan du bdas pa'i rnamyo/ nga gsal bar rma thong / de nub bla ma daca/ pa nyid kyi mnal lam du/ mi dmar po zhig gis khye da kyi sku la mtho 'tshams pa'i rbad 'dre rnams ngas braskrad pa yin zer/ khyed rang ga na yod ces dris par/ pho prang che na

rgyal relkeng mchog dang cho sa kyi dga' ston spe'/ tshul sogs/ 23byopo'i mdun gyi rgya/ sgo'i phyi rokhapre gyi g.yas phyogs su sdod kyin yod zer/ phyi nyin phyag g.yog ba rna spo sa ltar btang bas/ che'e/ misnra/ du sabo/sa pa'i rgya sgo'i phyi'i g.yas su bkwan 'o/ ye zhes grags pa sprin ring rgyal podze+e lha khang nang du rgyal po de'i gzugs brnyan sngon gyi dus zhig tu bzhengs nas rgyal rabs mang bo'i bar du d+ngha5 chod ngakur bgyis pa zhizla/ 'dug pas rgyal po des 'phrin las bsgrubs par dgongs te gzab gso'/ sogs mdzad/ phyis su rta tshag rje drung rin po ches bskul myo/ gnang ba bzhin gsol mchod zhig kyang lngags rtsom mdzad 'dug 'di dus phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga dang / ye shes khyung khra'i ljags bsnyen so so'i sngags bye ba lhag tsam 'gro ba gnang / 'a/la nas/ khyung khra'i las tshogs su 'bru 'bum bzlas na steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon dang nad thams cad las thar par gsung 'dug nged kyis bye ba lhag bzlas kyang rkang lag gi nad la phan pa cher ma/ byung / gad6ri sa ngag mi zab pa dang lha la byin rlabs med pa ga la yin te/ las tshos/sa narna pus kyi phan yon bshad tshod bzhin 'byung ba la/ byang chub kyi sem5 ga dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba khyad par can dgoru rgyu yin 'dug pas nged la de ma byung bas lan pa 'dug gsungs pa rje bla ma nyid lta bu la byang chub kyi sems dang lta ba rnam dag med pa ga la yin kyang bdag cag lta bu rgyu med kyi 'bras bu re ba'i ham pa cam/ rnams la brda' ston pa'i phebs sgo stsa la par gdon mi za'o/ /'di skabs dang phyis su'ang sku snyun bzhes tshul gnang dus rnams su chos sde chen po dgon lung nas dge 'dun tshogs yongs kyis zhabs brtan rim gro bsgrubs pa rnams gnad du 'gro ba byung snang ste/ rje nyid

236 rgyal dbang mtshag dang chos kyi dga' ston cel tshul sogs/kyi zhal nas/ nged rang shin tu bro 'tshal ba'i skabs rtsi/ga rmi lam du/dgon lung pas zhabs brtan 'bul ba yinazer bzhugs stan deng rgyab yol gyi ngos la tshe dpag med kyi snying bo gser gyi lañca'i yi ge mang bo yod pa zhig phul byung ba rmis/ de dus dgon lung tshogs chen du nged kyi rim gror tshe gzungs mang du gsungs pa yin 'dug dge 'dun tshogs pas rim gro nga/spub na gzhan las byin rlabs che ba 'ong bar snang zhes kho bo la dngos su gsungs byung / de dus sku snyun gyi rnam pa la mtshon pa'i nyams mgur 'di lta bu zhig kyang gnang 'dug ste/na mo gu ru/ dpal mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / /mgon phul byung zhabs dang 'brom ston rje/ /skyabs kun 'dus blo bzang grags pa'i dpal// /dus kun tu 'dud do brtse bas skyongs/ /rigs kun khyab drug pa sdo je 'chang / /tshul tha mal rnam pas 'gro ba 'dren/ /rje drin can bla ma yab sras rnams/ /'bangs bdag gi spyi bor 'bral pe da bzhugs/ /las dkar nag 'dres ma'i rlung bo ches/ /ches rab snyigs lnga bdo'i mthar bdas pa/ /mi chos med chos par btags pa bdag /yid skyo shas kyi nyams rtogs glu ru len/ /ma rigs drug 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /gnas 'khor ba'i rang mtshang rdzun po che/ /dpal thub bstan 'grib pa'i ngang tshul gsum/ /'di bsam kyin skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /sdon byon pa'i mkhas grub bgrang yas pas/ /bshad sgrub pas thub bstan 'dzin spel gyis/ /yongs skye dgu'i phan bde'i gsos sman mdzad/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing du gzhol bar gyur/ /dus da lta bdag dang bdag

rgyal dbang mchog dang chosatram̐—da ga tshaspu/ —zidzhal lo sa/ —tsho1 wa'adra yis/ /ngastan 'gro ba'i sman pa bskru ba la re/ /las ngan pa'i 'damyo/ rdzab rab 'khyi—sdo nang / /skye na rga 'chi ba'i sgre 'o ga byed/ /nad nyon mongs dug gsum sdug bsnga la gzir/ /gzhan mi da pa'i tshir+sha/ me da'i dri ngan sgreg /nyes ltung ba'i 'phyen dang rtug pa 'cho ra/ /choṭa/ brgyad kyi phol mig rdol ba las/ /phung sbyor gyi bya byed rnag khrag 'dzag /bdud las kyi bsod nams za zi yi/ /dug ngan la sman du rlom bzhin sbyod/ /pha bla ma'i ngo sprad gdams ngag sman/ /blo mchu rtser 'gos pa tshun chad spug /gzhan phan gyi dkar gsum myong 'dod kyang / /snyigs dusi kyi/ ngang tshul nad ngan 'a / /gnod dogs kyis/ 'dod lha'i sman pas bkag ji rang drags 'a ṭa/ ngan gyis mnar tshul la/ /ji drags na bstan pa'i 'grib lugs la/ /ji drags na skye dgu'i sdug lugs la/ /mi rtag gi ngang tshul rma ngon gyur kyang / /rtag 'dzin gyi phyi bshol ches cher 'phel/ /srid pa yi bslu brid ma tshare rig kyang / /bder 'dzin gyi 'ching ba ches cher dam/ /rigs drug ku/ na drin can mar gyur cing / /sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul shes ngazhin du/ /byams pa dang snying rje skyer mi btub/ /snang grag kun rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe/ /rang tshugs/ kyi tho yor 'gyel bzhin du/ /bdag 'dzin gyi 'ching ba da dung dam/ /tshe ri / cig la sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /pha bla ma'i gdams ngag zab rno rnams/ /nyams len gyi go skabs ring du brakrā / /rang nyid kyi ngang tshul 'dir gyur kyang / /gzhan dag gi yar 'drekā—/ yen no lo// kye hud dang kye hud kye kye hud/ /'bangs tha shal nga'i smyo tshig bla brdol 'dir/ /pha bla ma kun thugs rjes e gzigs na/ /dus da lta rgyal khams

238 rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul tsu/gas/phal rno cher/ /chos bzang bo mi brin zog po brin/ /gaṭā/ma bden pa mi n-i rdzun pa rno/ /las dkar po mi 'grub nag po 'grub/ /nga 'i tso tshit+pa/ la nyan mkharngu—/ gzhan na gang / /skyabs bla ma dang mchog gsum kho na la/ /sems drang bos gsol 'debs glu ru blangs/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ོ/ bar do gsum/ /skyabs re sa gzhan na yod re skan/ /skyabs mdzod la l+yo na pa tha shal ba/ /mi nga yi sgo gsum bya ba rnams/ /bstan 'gro ba la smam/ par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyid sdug dang legs nyes ci byung yang / /nyams/ len gyi grogaru/ su 'char ba dang / /'bangs ltos bcas kyi bsam do7/ ma 'u ra pa/ /byang chub kyi rgyu ru 'gyur byin rlobs/ /deng duṭa/ kyi skye bo'i byed lug/sa dang / /smyon pa nga'i sems kyi 'khyer so gnyis/ /don mthun gyi re ba mi 'dug pas/ /khyed cag las skyabs gzhan med nges/ na/ /thugs rje yiri shrī sa/ this/sa pa cis kyang mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni chos pa'i gra se dang mi gral ngo/ ) ri rga kar ma chud pa'i btsun gzugaru/ mye+osbyo/ pa lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje zheṭa/ bya bas/ lus bro nad kyis gzir skabs su/ gang dran byung rgya la du ca le co ler snras pa mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'o/ nges pa'i don du nyes kun drungs phyung ba/ /khyod sku snyun gyis sa/dungs pa srid min yang / /tha mal snang ngor mtshan dpe'i zla shesmu ni/ /nye zho'i chu 'dzin sgrib g.yoro/sa 'dzin par gyur/ /'on kyang 'dzam/ gling skye rgu'i les/sa byas kyi/ /mgyogs 'gro'i nus pa brtul bar ma gyur mthus/ /gzugs sku kun gsal mdzes mas mi ri nga par/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin lang tsho ngom/ /de nas rim gyis/ phyag zhabs kyi snyun rnams dwangs skyed byung na'ang /

spyol dbang mchog dang tshos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 23nyaspyakyi) gyi snyun gzhi la re zhig gi bar du skyed ma rgyung bas nyin gcig gong ma chen po dang mjal phrad skabs 7gong nas hu thog thu'i spyaṇa pyi snyung gzhi 'di la thabs ci byas na phan zhes phebs pa la/ rje bla ma rma chog nas sems can gyi srog bskyabs na phan par 'gyur ram zhes zhus par/ gong ma chen po thugs 'ur stabs kyis/ bkra shis khā la khyod rang mgyogs par rgyug la/ngas da nang khrims kyis phog pa'i mi nag can gcig gsod rgyu byas yo da pa bsad ma tshar na srog thar par gyis shig ces bka' phebs/ de ma thag bkra shis khā pho brang gi phyi sgor thon nas rang gi zhon rta btsal bas ma rnyed pas g.yog po zhig gi rta zhon nas ci myur gyis mi gsod sar song bas rgya dpon rgan po zhig gsod sa der khrid nas khrims kyi lugs srol la ga so da khar khrims yig bsgrags te/ 7gong ma la pya/ga gsum byed dgos pa'i phyag gnyis pa btsal dus la slebs shing / gshed mas kyang ral gri gde ngas nas brdeg la khad byed kyin 'dug par/ rgyang ring bo nas ṣ+pe bheng rme 'i bka' yod pas ma gsod cig ceṭa/ skad chen po rgyag bzhin gam du slebs/khyod 7gong ca/'i bkas srog gi chad pa las thar pa yi na no zhes bsgrags kyang mis/ hrig hrig byed pa las gzhan ci yang smra mi shes pa 'dug pa la / thabs kyis dran pa rnyed par byas te bka' bsgrags pas gzod gu/ 4 tsharwa/ nges par gyur pas/ ngu zhing cho nge 'debs pa dang bcas rje bla ma 'di nyid pyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /dpon po de rje 'di pa la mchog tu dad pa ji/ga yin pa la blo bur du khrims kyis phog ste rje bla 6/ra rgyu mtsha 4—/ dang racakuṭa skyabs 'angu ga zhu nga sdosmi mas kyang long ye med par gsod ṭaprer /drid

lngosgoyi— trel sridi nga ga—3—nga 3sa kyi dag ston+d+ra—tsho— tshu rngi zi/dzi/—— pas thabs gzhan ma rnyed par rje bla ma nyid la yid kyis gāsol 'debs shugs drag bgyis rnga 'i na zhes kho rang rje bla ma'i drung du 'onges nas smre sngags dang ngacas zhu zhing phyag thod pa bud bud du btsal bar byas 'dugarje bla ma 'i zhal nas nged la sems can gzhan skyob pa'i nus pa cung zad kyang med na'ang / kho rang gi tshe'i 'phen pa ma zad pa dang / dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byas pa'i mthu yin pa 'dug ces gsung / /shin tu spyi sa/rdzu5'i khrims kyi ra ba ru/ /lta bar bzod dka' nyajigs ru'i+o gshed ma yis/ /gces pa'i tshe srog cari tshon cha'i so rnon pos/ /gcod par nye ba'i nyacage thag rma gon med la/ /gang gi thugs rje'i nyi 'od reg pa'i mod/ /dus kyi chad pa'i mudz+wa/ pa nyer sangs nas/ /'tsho ba'i pad+mar rnam shes rkar drus/ pas/ /bde skyid rtsi bcud ci dgar spyod par gyur/ /bod kyi srid phyo re pho lha ba bso da nams stobs rgyas spyir bstan pa ngastan 'dzin dang bcas pa la gus mchod lhur len pa dang dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa so0/sa lu gas ga nyis char nas bsngags pa ra 'os pa zhig yin 'dug kyang /legs pa'i karmas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad skyon gyi gong bur mthong ba bzhin du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par gting nas mi dad cing log sgrub mang du bgyis shing / rje bla ma 'di nyid rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las phyogs kun tu rgyas par mdzad pa'i thugs kyi sras gcig pu yin pa'i dbang gis dngos su ci yang ma nus kyang / lkog nas bla ma ka thog pa sogs ngan sngags mkhan mang bor mthu gtad kyi rigs mang du byed bcuka par snang ste snga ma zhigle/ rje bla ma nyid sku khams cung zad

rgyal dbangamachog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 241bsnyel zhing 'tshub ltas kyang che ba zhig byung skabs mnal lam du rje bla ma rang nyid mkhar dzong zhig gi yang thog na ngazhugs 'dug par/ pho lha bas dmag dpon byas te bod dmag mang boru/ rdzong gi mtha' skor nas me mda' char bzhin du 'bebs pas rdzong tsho mi thub pa 'dra ba la rdzong zhol ma/sa bud rgya med 'jigs su rung ba ral gri 'phyar zhing dre'u la zhon pa zhig blo bur du thon nas pho lha ba dpung bcas bye'u khras ded pa bzhin thag ring bo zhig tu bskrad pa'i rnam pa gsal bar byung ba dang / 'di skabs rje bla ma nyid kyi phyag g.yog pa rmi lam gsal zhing thog tu khel pa zhig yod pa de'i rmi lam du/ bod nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas btang ba yin zer ba'i bud med gos sdon po gyon pa dre'u la zhon pa sga'i snga shal du pho lha ba'i mgo yin nam snyan pa'i mi mgo rlon pa khrag tsar re ba 'phyang ba zhig rje bla ma mchog la mjal phrad byed par 'ong zer ba zhig rmis/ mi ring bar bod nas pho lha ba dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i gtam byung bas sngar gyi rmi lam mis pa'i tshes grangs pho lha ba gshegs nyin dang 'grig byung ba dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mos rgyal ba yab sras kyi sku dgra bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i ltas su gor ma chag go /gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag /mthu gtad khu tshur bsnun pas gzhig re ba/ /phye ma leb bzhin rang nyid dmyal me'i nang / /mcho nga la datsa' ba'i snying stobs ngom pa nyid/ /tshul de sh+laum bzod rgyal yum dbyangs can ma/ /khros pa'i gar gyis snying rje'i mtshon rnon pos/ /byad ma'i mgo bo las ngan 'ching ba dang / /lhan cig bcad nas snyems pas yul spyun nyul/ /ji 4nga r+sha/ ge sa shig

da 172 rgya rjodarwa—ma ljo/ga dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul—sogs/srod 'a/lor byi/ duzu / camyo/ zhika tu blo bur du gzims khang gi rgyab kyi khang ba mang bo zhig 'a me shor 0/sa thams cad rtab rtab par gyur pa la/ rje bla ma nyid nas dbu/ snga sa su bshams pa'i rten khrod na sku gong ma'i thus/5 shrī dam rten rje bla ma/'i sku brnyan thugs gtsig can zhig yod pa de bzhes te gzims khang gi ra skor du phebs pa na/ phyag g.yos/ pa rnams kyis me la chu 'debs pa sogs thabasdopre ci byas kyang mi phan par me lce thams cad gzims khang gi steng ga yogs nas tshur bskyod kyin 'dug par/ blo bur du 'bros/ mo jo btsun 'dra ba zhig gis bya sgong zhig phyag tu gtad byung bas/ thugs dgongs la sgo nga ltas ngan zlog byed yin dgongs te me nang du bskyur bas de ma thag rlung shugs chen pos me lce phar slog ste gzim sa khang skor la gnod pa cung zad kyang ma byung 'dug jo btsun ma de btsal bas gar song med ci ra /spyir yang pho brang du 'brog btsun ma de 'dra yong don med cing lhab/ par mtshan mo'i dus yin pas phyi rol gyi sgo rim pa mang bo rnams dmag gis bsrung ba dang bcas nang du su yang thar ba med pas 'di ni dpal ldan lha mo'i rnam 'phrul yi na 'dug ces thams cad ngo myo/tshar bar byed pa don la'ang gnas so/ 4 /bar skabaru/ shig 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen nga ra rje bla ma ma cho ga nas phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po sogs yi dam gyi lha/ dang / chos skyong 'ga' zhig gi chos skor sogs deng sang rgyun datshe/na pa rnams slob dpon 'os pa zhig la rtsad gcod mdzad bcug nas rdzong ta bka' drin bskyang dgos tshul zhus pa ngaji/na bde 'byor dpon slob ngag dbang don klub pa la bka' phebs te cho 'a/ rkyun rnams legs par rtsad gco da du 'jug

rgyal dbang mchog dang chonu kyi das/'a nyen kha tshul sogs/ 243pa dang / rgyal dbang nyid nas kyang bka' choṭa/ du d+dha/ zhig gnang ste two/ nga rbe dpon slob pe'i cing du rdzong ta mdzad pa 'byor zhir / snga sor rje bla ma mchog nas zhu ba mdzad pa bzhin thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa spyi dang khyad par du rje btsun dril bu lugs kyi rim pa gnyis kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa brjod byar rma dzad pa'i gsung mgur kyang ngaskur gnang mdzad pa 'di lta ste/ / —dpal rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /sku ga/cig la dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkod pa dza nasari / /rje blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis par 'dud/ /dpyid bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid du/ /yongs shes bya'i 'khor lo kun sdom pa/ /lha he ru ka dpal yab yum dang / /don gnyis/ med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /pha bla ma rje la rag las pas/ /dus 'di nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /skyid sdug gi khag de bla mas mkhyen/ /yul cir snang bla ma'i sku ru bsgo ma/ /sgrar gang grag rje btsun gsung du 'dzer/ /sems dran rtog bde stong gcig tu 'dres/ /lam gcig chog rgyarkas po 'di la re/ /rje bka' drin mnyam med tsong kha pas/ /yongs mdo rgyud gdarna sa par ngo prad pa'i/ /bstan 'di dang mjal ba'i skal bzang ni/ /dus da res tsam zhig yin na yang / /dbugs na bun lta bur yal la nye/ /sro ga ba thag tsam de chad la khad/ /dgra 'chi bdag gshed mas gsod nges par / /da lha chori / snying ngo 'o na pa gces/ /sngon sgo sa/sum sdig/ ra d+ngha da spya/k+ṣiṃkyi pase5 / /dzoprernag dkakrā ba ngan sore sdug bsnga 'a de/ /

244 rgyal dbang mtshog dang chos kyi dga'astonasprelatshulasogs/ da wa bdag lus sems gnyis kyi thog tu 'bab/ /nyam chung gis bzod glags mi gda' bas/ /spra nga 'khos med re ltos bla ma lha/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la snying nas zhu/ /rgyu dkar nag las kyi/ blang dor la/ /da bag yod 'bad pa mdun ma'i rtse/ /dug bdud rtsir 'khrul ba'i btung ba bzhin/ /yul 'dod yon sred zhen 'phung gi rgyu/ /mdang rmi/ lam dga' ba'i rol rtsed dang / /dpal lha mi'i phun tshogs bslu bar mtshungs/ /khams gsum gyi gnas lus gang la yang / /blo thub pa'i bde ba cang ma mchis/ /sdug sna dgu 'dzom pa'i btson ra la/ /zhe blo bder sdod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /sems cang shes kha lo gyen du bsgyur/ /chos bslab pa gsum gyi srab kyis bcings/ /'bad brtson pa drag po'i lcag bzhus nas/ /da thar pa'i lam la dkyus thog gcod/ /bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhungs/ /sdug nyam thag ngang tshul ma bsam na/ /bu don snying gting nas rul bas na/ /rang spyid 'dod blo sna lings kyis bor/ /gzhan phan bde'i thabs dgu snying dbus bcang / /dpal don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas de/ /thabs phyin drug spyod pas bsgrub la 'bad/ /sems cha cho'i 'gyu ba rbad kyis bcad/( /rten dmigs pa gcig la dran pas bzung / /che/gas bying rgod dbang du ma shore bar/ /sgom bde gsal ngang la shes pa gcun/ /chos can gyi snang tshul mtha' yas 'di/ /blo 'khrul bas bzhag pa'i bslu ba can/ /don sdod lugs snying bo btsal ba na/ /dmigs gtad so bral ba'i stor bar 'char/ /yul gang sha ra rang tshugs 'i/ga pas na/ /ming rkyung bu

nga wa rgyal dbang mats+tshag dang chos kyi dga' ston spil tshul sogs/ 245tsam zhig shul du lus/ /don 'di la gzhan dor rten 'brelakyi zhes/ /chos kun gyi 'angog sa de ka tsam/ /dpal 'phags pa yab sras ngazhe da pa'i srol//pha blo bzang grags pas gtan la phab/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba ngo mtshar can/ /lam thun mong de dag sngon sbyangs te/ /zhing 'og min gco bo rdo rje 'chang/ /'dir mi yi gzugs can sprul pa'i skus/ /gnas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bcug /rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi legs bskur nas/ /lus ma bcos rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor che/ /nyams bag phebs dga' ba'i gzhal med na/ /dpyid thig le kha sbyor don gyi lha/ /dpal khrag rathung gtsotshobo yab yum dang / /nang rtsa khams dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs/ /dbyings bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed kyis/ /rgyud tha mal snang zhen kun bcad nas/ /yongs gang shar dag pa'i 'khor lor bsgyur/ /rang gsal stong bde mchog yab yum gyi/ /lus stong ra sgom pa'i nang gi gzhung / /rtsa khyad chos gsum ldan d+dha tī yi/ /snying chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab brgyad dbus/ /thabs shes rab nyi zla kha sbyor nang / /gzhom med kyi thig le hūṃ gi gzugs/ /sems brtan pas kun rtog rgyu ba bcad/ ston mkha' ltar dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char/ /yum nang gi phag mo tsalke lis/ /rtsa stong phrag don gnyis kun+da'i khams/ /dpyid dhū tīr bzhu ba dbab ldog gis/ /sgras brjod du mi nus dga' ba'i/ ster/ /phyi dbang bo'i rlung sems 'gro 'ong bral/ /nang tha malda ba /ti mu ga mun pa sangs/ /lam 'od gsal chosdo sku'i ngo bo dang / /gartid dbye sdu med rna'/ 'byor nyer bskyangs nas/ /spyir 'khrul snarwa— kun nga ra nga dza shes7/ // hū+oṃ//‘ ri/ / drib/ chas/sa lung ṭa byi d+dha/ 'o dza de/ ho ri tshan

246 rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ༈—spu—— spe sha tram̐sha so 1sru—/dpe'i gar rma khan skur bzhengs naṭa// /gang 'tsham pyi+o/ sprul ba ci ya/nga 'dzin/ /snying dwangs ma lnga 'dus thig le las/ /rlung pre thuphe / gnas ldang ba rdo rje gsum / /rang chas kyi gsang sngags bzlas pa yi sa/ /dbye dka' ba ma rig mdud pa grol/ /gzhi pad+mar rab gnas/ rdo rje'i rtse/ /gnad dbu mar chud pa'i rang sems hūṃ/ /bcud bdud rtsilī dwangs ma 'thung 'thungs pas / /g.yo med kyi lhan cig skyes dgas myos/ /gnas dngang bo'i sgo dang 'khor ge+o ngazhir/ /ches phra ba'i rdo rje ṭa5 bon la/ /sems brtan pas 'jig rten gsum snang ba'i/ /phyi yul lnga rtsa/tha' dag mngon sum mthong / /yongs mngon shes drug gi skar khu nga phye/ /lha bgrang yas rnam 'gyur ltad mo mthong / /sa/sung rab byi tshirga/ don kun la dngang / /'chi med kyi dga' cha/ra rtsed 'ango thob/ /yar smin dbu ri5 gnyi sa spa ngas rno rje'i rtser/ /'od nyi zla skar ga/sum thig ler 'khyil/ /rten de k+ṣ-ir rlung sems bcug pa'i mthus/ /sman ga bur thigs pa 'dzad med 'phel/ /yid ting 'dzin mir gyis mdzes pa kun/ /phyogs gcig tu bris pa'i m+bin legs dang / /rigs mtshan ldan pho nya mor 'a grogs pas/ / /rang ci 'dod dga' bde ches cher 'bar/ /sngar 'dris kyi bde chen phyag rgyar bcas/ /de dran pa yis kyang— lhan skyes 'char/ /yid kun khyab chos nyid mdzes ma la/ / rol rol bas lhan skyes ngang du zhu/ /'og surma ma do bde skyong 'khor lo'i dbus/ /mdang da7/ra dmar chos 'byung 'o da du 'che ra / /dbus this/ le sna lnga'i tshom bu la/ /se—ris sade gshepho / rig ridzo/sa lnga ri sdo bor ngaltarteri / /rlung dkar ser bum rngasi lta dushī dbyidas / //7nanu ḍi kyi spi

gyil dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spol tshul sogs/ 247bcings pas tshangs pa'i me/ /a haṃ gi 'bar 'dzag cher g.yos te/ /lam sngon med bde stong smigrod pa rdzogs/ /'od glog gi ༈gas kyu byo+o gas brgyar spros/ /mkha' khyab kyi bde gshegs byin rlabs bkug /sems rigs lnga'i yi ge slar gsos nas/ /nyams gong 'phel bdud rtsi'i gru char phab/ /snod bcud kyi spros pa 'od du yal/ /kun rtog gi rba rlabs nye bar zhi/ /'od gsal gyi dwangs cha ma 'gags pas/ /dus mnyam rjes kun la rgya yis 'debs/ /dpe lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings//snang stong gi ri mo 'ja' ltar bkra/ /thabs bla med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//rten brten pa rdzogs pa'i 'khor ‘yor bzhengs/ /steng mkha' la sprin tshogs dengs pa bzhin/ /lus sgyu ma 'od gsal ngang du thim/ /don lhan cig skyes dngos ye shes mes/ /gdon dngos 'dzin sa bon bcas pa bsregs/ /dpal rdo rje lta bu'i gzugs sku dang / /sems 'od gsal chen po zung 'jug pa/ /ming dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin zhes/ /mchog bsam ske khyab pa'i rim pa las/ /dbyings rig pa rang gsal yid bzhin nor/ /phyi glo bur dri ma kun gyis dag /gzhan blo ngor longs sku he ru ka: ci 'dod kyi sprul pas brtan g.yo khyab/ /yun mi ring snyigs dus tshe thung la/ /thabs dka' ba med par 'dod yon kun/ /nang bde chen grogs su spyod bzhin du/ /mchog sangs rgyas de ltar ster ba'i lam/ /rje sngon byon grub dbang mtha' dag gi /bshul gsang mtha'i rgyud don ma nor ba/ —/tshe 'a di la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /don bde blag nyid du ragrub gyur cig /mchog tshe 'dir myo5 'grub 'chi ba'i

148 rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston thol tshul sogs/ tshe/ /mgon dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bsu ba yis/ /'ja' 'od lnga'i gur dbus mchod sprin bcas/ /gnas mkha' spyod zhing bzang 'khrid par shog /rten reg pa 'dzin pa de nyid la/ /lam lhag ma'i bgrod pa mthar phyin cing / /dus nam yang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi/ /chos tshul bzhin 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i pho brang na/ /mthu ldan gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams/ /ma bu gcig brtse bzhin bdag cag la/ /dus rtag tu g.yel med skyong gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed du gyur pa'i dam pa chen po mdo sngags yongs la mkhyen dpyod gzhan —dring mi 'jog pa'i lcang skya mchog spru la rin po che nas 'a ma rim pa gnyis kyi gnad 'gag yongs su rdzogs shing / /khyad par du grub mchog dril bu ba'i lugs kyi bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs skor cha tshang ba'i mgur mgo sla zhing 'khyer bde ba zhig nyams bzhes gsal 'debs su dgos zhes chab shog gi lam nas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar shākya'i dge slong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /7gong ca/ chen pos chos sde dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan por bod nas sprul sku che ba sku yon bzang ba zhig gdan 'dren rgyu'i phebs sgo stsal par/ rje bla ma mchog nas rta tshag rje drung sprul pa'i sku nyid ba so chol kyi rgyal mtshan nas bzung sku'i skye 'phreng du mar rje bla ma'i ring lugs 'dzin ba'i skyes bu dam pa sha stag tu gyur pa dang / sku tshe 'dir yang lung rtogs yon tan gyi mnga' bdag skyes chen dam pa gzhan 'gran dang bral ba yin tshul snya/na du gsol par brten/ rje drung sprul pa'i sku blo bzang dpalaphran pa mogong myo/'i bkas

rgyal dbasdi sachog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 249pho brang du gdan drangs pa dang zhal 'dzom pas ma bu stor nas yun ring song ba blo bur du 'phrad pa lta bu'i phan tshun thugs dgyes tshor shin tu che ba byung 'dug 'di lo mkhan nang gdong gyirgyal dbang thams cad mkhyehrū/ cing gzigs pa chen por gsar rtsom dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas byi/ glegs bam spyan star zhu rgyu dang bcas gsang ba bla na med pa'i yon tan 'a ru/ brtsam pa'i che brjod/ /zugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debari smu byin rlabs zhu ba dang bcas tshig don zab cing barming ba'i snyan dngags kyi chab shog phul ba 'di ltar ro/ /yid 'ong mchog tu dge ba'i ye shes rdul brtsegs tshogs gnyis gzi 'od lham mer 'bar bas srid zhi'i ngo mtshar phung bo ma lus pa/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i lhun po'i dbang bo 'di ni phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs nyid las gzhan du ci zhig ces/ /'og min gnas kyi mthar thug bar du ngo mtshar gtam gyi rgyal rnga lan cig min par brdungs pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog /dpal ldan phyag na pad+ma gser zhun cod paṇa 'chang bra'i rje bor rol pa gang gi zhabs skyes gser gyi 'dab brgya rnam bzhad drung / /mi phyed dad pa'i gangs kyi ri bo la/ /gang sku'i nyin byed dran pa'i tsha zer gyis/ /reg pa las 'ongs zhu 'phrin bdud ji'i rgyun/ /rnam par sbrengs 'dir spyan zur 'od zhas/sa rkyongs/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i de bzhin nyid dang ro mnyam nyid du zhutre/tra pa'i nam dag ye shes rdo rje'i dngos po ni/ /mtshar sdug gsal la rdzogs pa'i mtshan dpes rnam bkra 'jig rten kun gyi snying la dga' bskyed sgyu ma'i rlo sa gar can / /

/de tsha 9— rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul rtso/gas/zad mi shes pa'i zab rgyas legs bshad gtam gyis 'gro la gtan ngade'i mchod pyin sgo brgya cig car 'byed myo/dzad pa/ /dpal lda na thub pa rnam rdo / kyi yid ni ci yang chags byed khyod ni nges par dang po'i sangs rgyas las gzhan ci/ /'jigs rung sri da pa'i 'brog dgon chen por ma rungs snyigs ma'i ngang tshul srin po khris pa'i bzhad gad ni/ /snying stobs rab tu brtan pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyi dam bcas ri bo 'gas pa bzhin du sgrogs byed pa//tshul 'di dag kyang khyod thugs snying rje'e ku mud phyir zhing bzhad la zla zer baji/na du gnas gyur na/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i khyogs la ma blangs lus can shā lnga ba'i khur ni rnam pa gzhan du ci zhika 5/chis/ /rnam dag rigs pa'i ri sgyu ga phreng rnyo/nga gi rtsed 'jo la 'arngu gas legs bshad chu yi /khur gyi rtsid ldan pa/ /gzhom med yi ge mchos/ gi nam mkha'i glang bo glal ba'i sgra las brkyad khri bzhi stong dbyangs snyan po/ /ci yaja sgrogs pa'i ngo mtshar rol mo 'di yis bdag gi lugs bzang nam mkha' ji srid 'jig rten 'dir/ /nyams pa med pa'i mchog ni nges par sbyin ces ni ma'i gnyen de dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lan brgyar rgod/ /sar gnas dpa' bo stong gi blo gros rwa bar ma chud nges gsang theg pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod che/ /bden gnyis e waṃ dngos po gcig gyur sdo rje'i zab don ji bzhin 'byed pa'i blo gros skal ba ni/ /byang chub rdo rje can dang mnyam pa nyid du rang gir mdzad pa'i gru/ 'i ) byung rnam par thar pa la/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i dkyil 'khor dbang bo rnam par dgyes pas khyod kyi ba spu 'i khung bu nyid du ro la/ /mgon khyod dpakhari stag phun tshogs kun gyi myori/thar so na ga'/ma/ dring mi 'ariyo ga dbang snyog

rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 251 brgyad la mnga' brnyes kyang / /srid pa'i 'dam du la na brgyar bying ba'i srog chagasaphra mo'ang brtse ba'i zhags pasdo/ nam ji /nga ri 'dor bas/ tha chad byis pa'i blo can bdag la'ang brtse bas dbugs 'byirtso bka' 6ri chid lha yi rol mo bsgrags pa ni/ /'di na mngon sum/ spyo da yul ma chog tu gyur 'di kho bo'i rlabs chen bsod nams zong yi/sa bkugs sam snyam/ /snying bo med la snying bor rlom pa yi/ /'khrul ba'i gzhan dbang nyid du gyur pa bdag /khyod drin kho nas lus srog rna dza' gcugs ni/ /ma rungs 'chi bdag phra mas ma phyed bar/ /rab gnag mun pa'i khrod du klog 'gyu bzhin/ /la 'a ra dge ba'i sems pa mngon gyur kyang / /phal cher 'di ning sgyu ma'i bslu brid kyis/ /phyogs slad mgron po lta bur 'thoms shing mchis/ /mtshams kyi zhu gsol/ /bde chen dbyings dang dbyer med thugs rdo rje/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i 'khor lo'i mgon po ru/ /bzhengs khyod 'og min zhing gi gtso bo bzhin/ /'dir ni bskal brgyar bzhugs phyir gsol ba 'debs/ /shākya'i gtso bos grangs ring bsgal pa'i bar//'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i bstan pa'i khur chen dang / /rgyal sras snying stobs chen pos dam bcas pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs spel ba'i rlabs chen khur/ /deng 'dir ma lus khyod nyid gcig pu yis/ /bkur ba'i 'os su tshad rma sa grub lags na/ /rang gi las su bya ba'i gtso bo ni/ /'dor ba dam parno+o tshul dang ga la mthun/ /lhag par brtse bar rigs pa'i nyam thag 'gro/ /'dren la snying las chung ngus gzhol gyur na/ /ma lus zhing gi sras bcas rgyal ba yi sa/ /khyod la mi zad bsngags pa ci yis sgrogs / /
