252 rgyal dbang mchog dngatsho chos kyi dga' ston smrel tshul sogs/ji lta ji ltar 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /mi dge las kyi byerdu pos mnar gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar skyes bu chen po yis/ /thugs rje lhag par g.yo ba ma lags sam/ /'on te khyod las lhag pa'i mgon po sa/zhan/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bsten du yod gyur na/ /de ni thub pa khyod kyis smos shig dang / /nged cag de la bstang du bzung bar bya/ /rgyal ba bye ba'i mdun sa chen po ru/ /ma rungs 'gro rnams bdag gis bsgral bya zhes/ /snying stobs dam bca' lan brgyar bzhes lags na/ /da ni gzhan du bshol du ci zhig yod/ /khyod ni kun bzang spyod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /'jigs 4da sto bas bcu mnga' ba'i rtsal yang rdzogs/ /yid srubs sde bcas rgyal mtshan bsnyil lags na/ /ci zhig khyod la zhum pa'i rkyen du 'gyur/ /khyod kyi brtan gsho'i sprul ba'i zlos gar kun/ /skye dgu'i gsos sman nyid du 'gyur lags mod/ /'on kyang yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i chos kyi tshul/ /'dzin pa'i sgyu 'phrul 'ani ko gzhan las lhag /de slad zhi ba'i lam bzang dang po 'gro 'dir nye bar mtshon pa'i slad/ /mgon khyod sku yi bkod pa mchog 'di nam mkha'i ngo bo gzugs gzhan— du/ /ma gyur de srid rdo rje'i khams su 'di ra ni gzhes par gyur lags na/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chen por bdab/ yi/sa sems kyi gzhan du min/ /de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa'i don chen po brjod pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas sgar yang bdag gi ched gsol ni/ gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsiri cha shas kyis/ /yid la skal ba bzang bor bsgrubs pa bdag /mi ring khyod zhul nya rgyas zla ba ni/ /mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur bar byin sgyis

—lhaladabangamachog dang chos kyi dga'astonaspelatshulasogs/ 25sdod warlobs/ /thub pa'i gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu'i don/ /tshul 0zhin sems pas nyam sa su len pa la/ /mkhas pa dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod mchog thob nas/ / dam pa'i rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di snang phun tshogs g.yo ba glog gi 'od/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba sgyu ma'i srin po ltar//mthong nas gcig tu thar pa don gnyer gyis/ /bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam mthil/ /byams brtse'i kun nas bslangs pa'i rin chen sems/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /snying gi bcud du bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dmu rgod kha blan dka' ba'i sems kyi rta/ /dran shes srab kyis dbang du byas pa las/ /ci 'dod— dge la bkol ba'i las rung gis/ /ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed par byin gyisdo/ rlobs/ /bden gnyis shes bya'i dngos po ma lus r+pā/ /bden par zhen pa'i rang mtshang legs rig nas/ /btags pa tsam gyi rten 'brel sgyu ma la/ /nges shes gting nas 'drongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma dag srid pa las kyi skye 'chi'i rgyun/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yi/ /gsang chen bla na med pa'i lam mchog gi /dga' ston ngoms med spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod zhabs zla ba gsar pa'i dpal yon ni/ /mi shigs snying gi kun+dar rol pa las/ /rgyud don mthar thug zung 'jug ge sar 'phreng / /mi ring mngon sum bzhad par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma dor na bdag gis 'dir ni bgyiri/ pa dang / /bgyi dang bgyid cho'agyur gang lags de dag skam// /chalang da gye— —5 bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur te/ /khyod kyis rjes rabye /bsna kyigamo

da 254 rgyaladabang mchog dngatshasakyidaga'astonaspelasdol 〈gas/su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod rab tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal rnarma par rgod pa gsal ba nyid du mtshon pa'i slad/ /bka' mchid bzang bo'i nor bu'i 'phreng ba bdag gi gtsug na gtsug rgyan bzhin du mchod 'os pa/ / de dang de ni skal ba ji bzhin 'tshams pa chad med yongs su stsol ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis ri mo 'od du 'khyil ba'i ya mtshan dga' ston snying la ci yang sbyin par mdzod/ /ces gso/la ba 'debs rten gos chen rgyan bani skyer kha yug ser po pad+ma tho na thi yug gos gas/ ra 'ja' ris kha thi yug dkar po spu phrug yug lnga/ shel ser gyi me dam cha/ shel ser gye ba6/ṭashaṃ can gcig shel sngo khra'i pag por khebs can cha/ dkar yol sed po'i bges can lnga/ mdzod btags chung ba sum cu/ che legs nga cas zla tshes dge bar/ slo ba bu'i tha shal gus zhabs pas phul / /ges pa'o/ /rgyal dbang mchog nas bkaspru lan du rje bla ma nyid kyi 'chad rtso da rtsom gsu/zho kyi mdzad pa dang bstan 'gro'i pha na bde'i gsos su gyur pa'i choṭashrī srid 'phrin las la gnas tshul bzhin du bsngags shing / rgya la ba'i dbang bo nyid dus ngan snyigs ma'i ngang tshul rjen par shar ba la thugs byung ba'i tshu la dang thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes gsal 'debs kyi zhal gdams dang bcas rna bar snyan cing yid 'khul ba 'di lta bu zhi ga gnang ste//rab dkar gangs kyi ri bo'i ngos chags zla gzhon 'od zer lta bu 'am/ /rnam bkra'i me tog tshar du dngar ba khong nas 'dzum pa'i ge sar bzhin/ /skyes thob dam pa'i dpal la legs/ 'khyud mkha sa sbya ngas yon

rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 255tan snang bas mdzes/ /gzhan phan phyogs su yangs por grol bas kun dga'i bde rdzogs/ gang de la/ /'gro la grib tu bsil ngari yanu/ ga dang /'grogs pa'i 'bel gtam snyan dngags dri bzhon gsar/ /mkhas rnams dgyes pa skong ba'i dpyid kyi sman/ /rnam par 'thul ba'i nges pa 'di na son/ /rnyog bral zla ba dag pa'i dpal khyod las/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya ba sdon med kyi/ /bsil zer dra ba kun tu dgyed pa des/ /kro dang mos/ pa'i chu rlabs gyen du 'phyur/ /bag yod dbyig 'dzi5/ lte ba las thon pa'i/ /khrims gtsang bang rim bzhi ba'i ska rags can/ /nam yang nyes pa'i rnyog rdul cha tsam dang / /mi 'grogs rin chen lhun po khyod du nges/ /nyams myong tshad ma'i klong yangs rgya mtsho che/ /rjes su dpog pa'i rlangs pa mkhar 'khrigs nas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi gru char mi 'dzad pa/ /rab dga'i 'dod pa 'jo zhes gtan 'di snyan/ /rnam dag chos tshur khog las drangs pa'i rgyud/ /thal 'gyur rigs pa'i nyag phran dang sbyar ba'i/ /rtsod ngag 'phong gi slob dpon khyod kyi drung / /chos kyi grags/ pa'i dpal yang snyems nus min/ /gad kyi 'gyur ba rer yang thub bstan tshul/ /ma 'dres du ma 'char ba'i bstan bcos gsar/ /mkhas khyod zhal gyi sgo nas bskrun pa 'dis/ /dpyod ldan yid dbang mi 'phrog go skabs ci/ /gnam bskos lha yi rgyal thabs gdugs dkar khyon/ /yongs la tsha skudung 'phrog pa'i cho ga dang / /lhan cig chosalge kyi rnga yab dkar po'i 'dzum /bsil ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed pa kun tu mtsha ra/ /phyogs bral nam mkha'i khyon 'ari ji srid par/ /dakhyuras kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgrar shar

256 rgyal dbang sdachog dang chos kyi nga 'a ston spel tshul sogs/ trete/ /bsngags 'os khyod kyi ngo mtshar gleng gzhi las/ /brtsams kyang brjod pa'i zad mtha' ga la zhig /'di na zas gtsang sras kyi brtul zhugs pa/ /ngur smrig rlum por bgos pas dbyibs bsgyur te/ /skal mnyam byis pa 'drid pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ / sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor las kyang sgyu ma 'o/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi sman/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bshad dang sgrub 'dod lhag bsam yar tshes pa/ /cung zad ngal gso'i bsti gnas yin na yang / /col chung sems kyi ri dwags res 'ga' zhig /chos lam dogs pa med pa'i sa phyogs su / /'gro bar 'dod kyang chos brgyad zhags pa des/ /dbang med 'jig rten las la kha lo bsgyur/ /sngon chad sems dang 'dres pa'i dam chos gdengs//dbul bo'i khyim gyi nor bu ltar dkon zhing / /'chi bdag dus kyi pho nyas mdun bsus pa'i/ /ngang tshul bsam tshe dal bar mi khom mod/ /gzhan rkyen rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'du byed mtsho/ /res 'ga' dkar dang res 'ga' nag po'i rlabs/ /gcig min du mar gnyer nga'i rnam 'gyur 'dis/ /dal 'byore gru chen stong bar 'jig gam snyam/ /'di na chos gzugs gnyis 'thung phal mo che/ /sred zhen myos tshu'i dug gis yid brlams shing / /rnyed bkur glang mo'i dri tsam nye tram̐r yang / /ngo tsha bor ba'i bang rtsal ci yang 'gran/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed gang tshul min gyi/ /rta ljang shing rtas nub tu rings par drangs/ /prus ngan smag rum cher 'khrigs deng gi tshe/ /dam pa'i grogs kyang u dum wa ra tsam ya tsho bas mdzangs pa'i gral las yar ba'i bya/ /rang dospyo kho na gnyer ba'i

0la dbang mchog dang tsās kyi dga' ston spil tshul sogs/ 251'ug ba'i khyu/ /'khun sgras gangs can sa yi gtos — ska/nga tshe/ /shes ldan su zhig bag phebs dga' bar sems/ / she ltar rang gzhan snang tshul cir bltas kyang / /skal dman snyigs ma'i ma dngas kyis nag po ru//shar ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'drar bdag lta zhig /snying las chung ngu semyog sa kyi ngal 'tshor bde/ /'on kyang nor bzang nor rnams brtan pa'i bu/ /gnyis par zlos pa'i dam pa nyid bzhed ltar/ /lhag par dman pa'i gnas dang dus skabs su/ /yun ring thub bstan sgro na me sbor la smon/ /sdon goms thugs bskyed ri dwags rgyal po'i rgyud/ /mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtsal 'chang ba/ /khyod nyid deng dus blo bzang grags snyan gyi/ /bstan pa gangs ri'i dpal du mngon chas pas/ /legs par brtags shing brtags nas khas blangs pa'i/ /dad+ngha shrī bca' po+o ga gi phyir yang mi 'dor pa/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul lags phyir bstan dang 'gror/ /phan dgongs yi dam pyi pyi༄ gertan por 'tshal/ /'khor 'das kun gyi les/satshogs nus pa rnams/ /'chi med bdud rtsir bkug pa'i bcud phab nas/ /lus srog rdo rje'i chos bdun ngo bo ru/ /bsgrub pa'i snying bo srid mthar mi g.yo gsol/ /dus 'dir bdag rgyud bsod nams ye shes kyi/ /tshogs gnyis rgya chen bsags pas brgyan pa 'am/ /'gro la phan pa'i bgyi ba ci bya zhes/ /yang yang dran pa'i bskul ma dang 'brel bar/ /ring nas goms pa'i nges 'byung byang chub sems/ /bde chen stong ba zung 'jug phyag rgya yis/ /ci mdzad kun la legs par rgyas btab nas/ /bsnyengs bral dam pa'i brtul zhugs nyu/ra bzhes shig /gang gi mtshan yangatrīyid srubs

྅3skye rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogaso/ bdag po'i sde/ /'joms la rdo rje'i ri ltar 'phang mtho ba'i/ /bla ma lha srung r+shabaden mthu dpung sbran te/ /ci bzhed 'bras ldan 'gyur ba'i smon 'dun zhu/ /gnas kyis bskal yang mnyes gshin 'ching ba'i mdud/ /nam yang grol ba med par dam bcings/ nas/ /don bzang gtam gyi ku mu da 'phreng gsar/ /yang yang spel ba'i ngo mtshar 'dir stsol cig /de ltar ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can gyi/ /phang 'gro'i rgyud las nges pa bdun ldan glu/ /sna tshogs bdog pa'i skyes dang chabs jinacig par/ /'azas dkar spungs pa'i chos se che nas phal/ /zhes pa'o/ /lo tshig snga da ra phyi ma nges kyang dus skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu/ rje drung sprul pa'i sku blo bzang dpal ldan pa'i drung nas dbe+en sa nas brgyud pa'i dpa' rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / gdugs dkar lha so lnga'i dbang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang dang bcas/ sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi yig cha'i steng nas mgon po phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs rgyas pa/ tsho mgon po'i be'u bum gyi chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi khrid/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sprag sgrub kyi man ngag rdo rje tshig spram ma'i khrid thun mong ma yin pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe khrid/ dge 'dun grub kyi gsung thor bur bzhugs pa'i yig cha'i steng nas 'bar lugs kyi tshe khrid/ tshar chen gyi yig cha'i steng nas dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gser chos mcho ga sgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba mkha' spyod skor gsum las/ nā ro mkha' sbyod ma'i sirna ra'i byin rlabs zab mo/ /rtsa dbu ma'i chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabarushrī/ /char chen gyi gsur rkajam dbyangs tsho

— rgyal dbang mchog dang chos kyi dga'aston spelatshulasogaso/ —25 —nye——da mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zin bris mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas r+sha/ ru nga chen slob be+eshad lugs kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu sa/cig gi nyams khrid/ tshar chen gyi yig chung rnams kyi steng nas/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/yab yum tsho1/ra spyor dang yum rkyang gi 'pho ba'i khrid/ mkha' spyod skor sa/gle3 ma gyi be'u bum yongs su rdzogs pa'i klag lung dang bcas pa gsan/ mkha' spyod ma'i khrid kyi sdor rnams gsan dus bcas bde sla chos kyi bshad yam tsam ma yin par sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas thog mtha' bar gsum gyi phyag len mtha' dag gsang chen slo/ba bshad 'dzin pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pa yin zhes gsung / /bde 'byor dpon slob ngag dbang don grub pa'i drung nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtsha na pa'i yig chari steng nas bya rgyud de bzhin gsheng—— mi 'i rigs kyi thub pa dam tshig poska/sum baṣ+ka/tshod kyi zur bka'i dbang ཿོna/ 'durlo sa 'dzin gyi yig cha'i steng nas phyag na rno rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang chen zur bka'/ gur mgon lha bcu nga du na ma'i dbang / gnyan mgon stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi ba'i rnam 'gyur bcu drug gi rjes gnang dang / be'u bum yongs rdzogs gyi klag lung rnam gsan/ bram ze mngags gtad kyi rjes gnang gsan dus snod dang mi ldan pa zhig chos gral du byung ba de'i dbang gis yin nam shin tu 'tshub cha che zhing 'jigs zil mi bzod pa lta bu byung zhes gsungs shing / mchod kayog pas gang nas bsgrags mi shes pa'i mi rkang gi gling bu'i sgra lhang lhang ba zhig kyang thos 'dug gsung / /bka' 'gyur khrod nas rgyud 'bum dang

⑨60 rgyal dbang mchog dang tshos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ —gzhan thor bu 'ga' zhig /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid 'pho ba dang bcas gsan par mdzad/ snga mo nas spyod rkyu— rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang gsan par bzhed nas rgyun yod mkhan rtsad bcad kyang ma rnyed pa la/ 'di dus zhabs drung ngag dbang tshul khrims la dbang rgyun bzhugs tshul gsan nas/ khong ba pe'i cing du gdan drangs te rje 'di ba dang rje drung sprul sku rin po che rnam gnyis lhan du 'brom btsun sher 'byung blo gros kyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par gsan/ gzhan yang grub mchog 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzod pa'i yig cha'i steng nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sngags btu ba'i byin rlabs rgyas pa/ phreng ba skor gsum/sgod bsdus sgron me/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mdo bsre sogs lugs mang bo zhig gnu/na cing / mā thi zi'i lha ram pa blo bzang chos 'byor las/drang nges rnam 'byed kyi sems tsam pa yan chad kyi bshad lung dang / chos tshan thor bu kha shas bcas gsan par mdzad do/ /gang sku'i bkod pa dpag yas sprin phung gis/ /dag dang ma dag rab 'byams zhing khams kun/ /skad cig rer yang 'gengs pa'i ngo mtshar la/ /rgyal kun chos kyi dbyings las gzigs mor bzhengs/ /gsung dbyangs yi ge gcig gi rang gdangs las/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung bo'i sgra/ /mkha' khyab zhing du cir yang sgrogs pa la/ /mes pos rna ba brgyad du sprul nas nyan/ /zab yangs thugs gsang sngo dze bsang lha mo yis/ /mkhyen brtse snang byed zung gi rna cha dang / cho //mdo rgyud mi thing phring ba'i kyan ngom par/ /laṅka'i bdag pos mgrino pa bcu yis

rgyal dbang mgyi+o ga dang chos kyi dga' ston spel tshul sogs/ 261bstod/ /'gro 'dul rab 'byams 'phrin las sgyu ma'i gar/ /gsang ba mchog sku/ zles gar khang ba na/ /cir yang bsgyur ba'i ngo mtshar ltad mo la //bltas pas ma ngoms dbang bos mig stong sprul/ ༈/kun rtog spros pa'i chu 'dzin dang bral ba'i/ /rtog med dbyings las mtha' yas sems can gyi/ /ji snyed mos pa'i rdzing bur de snyed du/ /'chur ba'i sgyu 'phrul zla snang 'di ngo mtshar/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rno rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ gyirgyal ba'i dbang po dang phan tshun snyan tshig rna ba'i bcud len gyi sgo nas chos kyi dga' ston spel ba sogs mdzad pa thor bu 'ga' zhig sde tshan du byas pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ / //

262'ezhu zhacu bra/— grubra na ldazhi namā buzhag thrubu bustan n+tu na pozhi na desdo/ rgyun zhes bya bra smro na ged nags dazhad nu datha/zha ston gan/na bus bustan pu nin po chen phyag ne+es dad skalka ldan gdulka bru zhongs lka nam yud nyamās pu ne+ed puzhi chos gī skyes dazwang tho smrolka zhar nadzhad puzhi tshulu/nam mkha'i mtha' klas rgyal ba kun gyis bstod bsngags me tog phreng bas nyin re bzhin/ /gang la mchod pa'i rtson paṃ lhur len rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol gyis bgrang yas rgyal ba'i rlabs chen mdzad bzang ma lus pa/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir rdzogs par ston mdzad bdag gi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po de'i/ /phan bde rin chen bye ma 'dren pa yi/ /mdzad bzang chu klung 'bum phrag nyin bzhin du/ /sride pa'i khyon kun 'gengs par babs pa'i tshad/ /kun mkhyen ye shes kho na'i spyod yul yin/ /'on kyang mkha' la rgyu skar bgrang yas kyang / /zla 'od kho nas kun+da bzhad pa bzhin/ /mtha' yas mdzad bzang kun las rdzu+os ston pa'i/ /gsung gi mdzad pa 'gro la kacig tu sman/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ /thub ngastan rin chen lhun po mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /legs bshad nyi mas grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gling //gsal bar mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar gleng bar bya/ /de nas skabs rtsi/ga dbyar

grubamatha'arnamabanag thubabastanalhunapo'idamadzesargyan rmadzad tshul/ 263gyi duṭat+pā tsha nga/ mi /byo/ tu che baṭasmu pho prang nang du bzhupo/sa / na thugs spro ba mi yong bas rgyal khagu chen pa'i nub phyogs su pho brang dang ha cang thag mi ring ba na zhang shan zer ba bod skad du ri bo spos ngad ldan du 'bod pa'i ri chem/ po/'bab chu dang nags tshal du mas brgyan nga/ 'du 'dzis dben cing spro la bag phebs pa/ sa mtho bas dbyar dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa zhig yod pa der/ gong ma'i bkas dam chos dga' tshal zhes bya ba'i dben dgon yid du 'ong ba zhig gsar bskrun mdzad nas rje bla mar bzhugs gnas su gnang / der bzhugs skabs ji skad du rje nyid kyi gsung las/gang gi zab brling ngamyo/ gnag blo yi rgya mtsho gting mtha' bral bzhin snang ba'i 'jug ngogs su/ mtha' yas legs bshad bye ba'i chu klung rigs lam da2/ ba'i 'dzum pa ci yang rgod bzhin du/ rgyun chad med par 'bab pa'i dga' ba snying la gnas pa de yi kha yi sgo dag las/ dus mtha' 'dir yang lechi —/sa bshad 'od 'phreng bye ba 'gyed pa'i ya mtshan 'di la da ltos shig /ces gang gsungs pa ltar rje bla ma nyid nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pas bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa brnyes su zin kyang / drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor yang gong du brjod zin pa ltar 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur rnams kyi lepyo/khasmu bshad zab cing rgya che ba yod do cog rnams la gus rtag gi brtson pa shugs drag pos thos bsam nyin mtshan khor mo srig tu mjad par brten/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son te mkhas grub kyi snyems

264 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/pas dregs tshopa sus kyang bsgrun du med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang la mnga' brnyes par gyur pas/ ji skad du/ gang zhig bsgrubs kyang 'grub par ma nges grub na'ang gdon mi za bar 'dor dgos pa'i/ /mnog chung phun tshogs don du'ang rmongs pa 'di dag nam yang brtson pa mi 'dor na/ /nges par gtan gyi bde ster thar pa dam pa'i lam ni ma nor bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /rnam dag rigs tshul lan dzargyar smra la'ang mkhas pa dag ni brtson pa ci'i phyir 'dor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la thar pa dam pa'i lam phyin ci ma log pa rnam par dag pa'i rigs tshul dri ma med pa'i sgo nas ston par gyed pa ni mkhas pa dag gi las su bya ba'i gtso bo yin pas/ /don gyi dbang 'di la gzigs nas rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyis da ni bdag gis kyang sngon byon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod pa bla na med cing blo ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs kyi snying la ngo mtshar dga' ba bskyed pa'i skyes kyi rab dang phul du gyur pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel ba skabs su bab bo snyam du nye bar dgongs te/ grub mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan ces bya ba 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu'i snying bo gcig tu 'dril zhing med mi rung ba'i dka' ba'i gnas du ma la sngon med legs bshad kyis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos chen po rmad du byung ba de nyid ljags rtsom bka' drin du stsol pa mdzad/ de yang sems tsam pa yan chad ljags rtsom grub nas mkhyen rab kyi sa/ter chen

spyob mtha2 rngam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan dzad tshul/ 26 5 po lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rin po che'i mdzod 'dzin pa khri chen sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang bo lnga gzigs rtog phul bas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad cig yong ba 'dug pas cis kyang mjugre// grub par gyis zhes dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas dang bcas bskul ma mdzad par rje bla ma mchog nas kyang dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes te yongs su/ rdzogs pa grub par mdzad/ khrichen sprul pa'i sku ren po che nas/ bstan ba co ṭaṭa 'di nged kyi/ sems la shin du phan pa byung bas lung zhig dgos ba/sung nan tan mdzad pa bzhin glag lung kyang 'bul ba gnang /rje btsun bla khya mtsha 7 na nas snga phyir sadul bya'i mos pa dang sgo bstun pa'i gsung rtsom gyi rigs mi nyur cam bka' drin du bstsal 'dug na'ang / grub mtha'i bstan bcos chen po 'di nyad sa/tso pe yin par snang bas bstan bcos mchog de ri che ba cung zad tsam skabs 'dir brjod par bya ste/ de yang deng sang gi dus kyi dmyo pa'i yang srid du khas 'che zhing 'gro ba mang bo'i 'dren par rlom pa phal che ba ni/ chags sdang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi gtam gyi sbyor ba spel ba la ljags kyi dbang bo glog dmar bzhen du 'khyugs par byed byang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad tsod rtsom gsum la 'jub/ pa'i tshe/ ro 'dzin g.yo 'gul cam yang mi mdzad par ber zlam zhal sgrirtere gyi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa rnams ni rtog da pyo da kyi yul du ma gyur la brtsam chos po ti mang po spel bar rlom pa 'ga' zhig byang /lha'i sgrub thabs chang chung dang gsol 'debs chab shog gsol mchod pye/ rigaṭa5 nam grangs mang po tsam las blo ldan dga' ba bskyed pa'i les/ sa — —

266 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzis rgyan mdzad tshulo// bshad kyi yig 'jog 'i/ re tsam yang spel ba mi snang zhing / rigs pa smra bar khas 'che ba'i marngan pa'i nga rgyal ri ltar mtho ba la las bris pa'i rigs gzhung dpe med—khyi rlom pa 'ga' zhig kyang zhib tu brtags tshe rje nyid kyi gsung las/ rang gi rmongs pa'i dri ma'i ngatsog chu nyid/ /dri med gzhung lugs slong phyir sbyor byed pa/ /de dag rnams kyi gtam gyi 'phring ba ni/ /dpyo/da ldan snying gi zug rngu mchog las ci/ /zhes dang / gzhan gyis rigs tshu la bye bas bsnyad gyur kyang / /rang nyid gang la zhen pa de nyid la//rnam par 'thas pa nam yang mi gtong ba/ /dam pa'i lugs su zi 'di bzhad gad gnas/ /la la gzhan gyi rjes su zlos pa la'ang / /shed ma phye ba'i byis pas smra ba bzhin/ /dka' ba bsten kyang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur/ / 'dzin pa 'di dag mchog tu brtse ba'i yul/ /zhes gang gsungs pa las ma 'das par snang ngo / /des na dus kyi mtha' 'di lta bur bsta na pa'i gsos su 'gyur nges pa'i sngon med legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'di 'dra spel bar mdzad pa rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di nyi da tsa'i/ ma gtogs gzhan su zhig mchis/ /bstan bcos chen po 'di nyid du deng sang gi sde snod la spyangs par rlom pa rnams la bskal don du gyur pa'i dka' gnad kyi bshad pa du ma zhig 'dug pa blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis bltas na shes par snang la/ der ma zad mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis ma thon pa'i les/sa bshad gsar ba'i dga' ston mang du stsal 'dug pa kho bo blo gros kyi rtsal shin tu zhan pas zhib tu brjod mi nus kyang phyogs tsam zhig ni 'di lta ste/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyis rdzas yod dang btags yod kyi

— glupamatha'arnam bzhag thupa bstan lhun po'i mdzesargyanamadzadatshul/ 26ba dge khyad par bshad pa'i skabs su/ bsdu ba las gang ci yang rung dhe de 'a sa gzhan pa dag la zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bshad pa'i rdzas yod de/ rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod la byed pa thogs med sku mched dang rje yab sras kyi dgongs pa yin tshul gsungs pa la 'phros nas/ rang sde'i grub mtha' spro ba yin na chos thams cad bdag med par khas len dgos/ de'i don yang chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag med yin dgos/ de yang chos thams cad rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du ma grub pa la byed dgos pa yin zhes bshad pa'i khas len dang / de ltar bshad pa'i yig cha 6 preng mang po yod pa rnams la/ khyed rang rnams kyi lugs la chos/ thams cad re re nas rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du ma grub par rang rgyud pa man chad kyi lugs la 'dod na/ 'jug pa las rang sde'i dngos smra ba rnams kyi/ lugs la rdzas yod de gdags gzhi byas nas de la btags pa'i btags yod 'jog pa ma gtogs/btags yod 'jog mi shes par gsungs pa'i don ji ltar yin pa dang /khyad par rang rgyud pa man chad kyi lugs la chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag med du gtan la 'bebs tshul dang gtan la phabs nas sgom tshul ji ltar yin/ de ltar bsgoms pas nyon mongs spong tshul sos/sa ji ltar yin gsungs nas khas len de dag gi so so'i blo rtse gtad so ji ltar yin pa'i dri ba 'god pa gnang zhing / de rjes rang gi bzhed tshul 'god pa'i skabs su/ /de la gang zag rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin tshul ni nga zhes 'dzin pa'i gzhi'i bdag 'di rang las gzhan phung bo rnams la rag ma las shing ma brten pa'i tshul gyis de dag la dbang sgyur byed lta bu'i rang rkya bar 'dzin

268 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhunapo'imadzesargyanamadzad — tshu—lka/—da dge pa ste/ de la dgongs nas rje yab sras kyis rje khol ltar 'a dzin pa zhes kyang gsungs so/ /des na spyir gdag gzhi phung bo bzung bra la ma brten par sa/nga zag 'dzin mi nus pa yin kyang / bdag tu 'dzin pas rgyud bslad pa rnams kyis ni de ltar mi shes par bdag bzung ba la brten nas phung dza/ 'dzin dgos pa lta bu zhig 'char te/ nga'i gzugs nga'i tshor pa zhes 〈r+sha ka/sa phung bo rnams bdag de'i dbang byar 'dzin pa'i phyir dang /bdag yo da pa la brten nas nga'i phung bo zhes phung bo la nga yi bar 'dogs par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag rdzas su yod pa'i 'dzin tshul ni rang las gzhan pa dag la mi ltos shing / rang las gzhan bdag la mi brten par/ rang gi mtshan nyid 'dogs par byed pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin tshul kho na yin zhing rgyu mtshan de'i phyir gong du drangs pa ltar rje bdag nyid chen pos bsdu ba las bshad pa'i rdzas yod dang skabs 'di'i rdzas yod don gcig par sa/sungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i gang zag rang skya ba 'gog pa la bye mdo sems tsam pa rnams kyis phung bo dang bden pa'i gcig dang du ma dang bral pa'i rtags 'god pa yin no/ /bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus su ni phung bor btags pa tsam las ma gtogs pa'i bdag de yod par sgrub pa'i sgrub byed kyi gtso bo/ /sems can no snyam pa'i blo chos can/ don ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug pa yin te/ blo sdon du ma btang bar dngos po mthong ba na 'jug pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na sdon 'dzin bzhin/ zhes pa 'di nyid 'gog pa'i rigs pa rtsa la du bton nas gtan la 'bebs pa dang / yang de 'dra'i bdag de phung bo la btags pa

spubamatha /rnamabazhag thubabastan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ 269yin nam/ /phung bo k+ṣa sa/nas pa yin nam/ phung bo las gzhan yin nam/ phung bo gtan med yen snya ma du mtha' bzhir spyohe0/sa nas rigs pas 'gog dgos tri/nga / brtag pa de'i nang du rtaspru/ mi rta shād+ku/ gcig tha dad la sogs pa'i mtha' gzhan 'gos/ pa'i rigs pa mang bo zhig 3 da dgos par thogs med dbyig gnyen phyoganu glang chos grags sogs kyi gzhung las 'byung ngo / de ltar brtas/sa pa'i mthar dgag bya bkag shul du bdag ji 'dra zhig lus brtags pa na bdag gam gang zag cig ni nges par yod dgos te/ gzhan du na 'ching krol gyi rnam ba'/spu/ mi 'thad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang phung bo las don gzhan dang rang skya ba'i rdzas su grub pa ni bkag zin pas/ gdon mi za bar phung bo 2 ltos shing phung po la brten nas btags pa'i btas/ṭan yod du 'grub dgos te/ grub tshul de gnyis gang rung 'a/sa mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /des na grub mtha' 'di dag gis gang zag btags yod du 'dod pa'i don ni de ltar yin la/ btags pa tsam gyi tsam sgras kyang phung bo de dag las don gzhan pa'i rdzas yod gcod kyi bden grub dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa so/gas gang yang mi gcod par 'dod do/ /rjes thob kyi chos thams cad bdag med du blta tshul ni/ phung sogs kyi steng du rdzas yod kyi bdag bkag pa la brten nas phung sogs de dag rdzas yod kyi bdag deri longs spyad bya yi na gas/ stongs par 'gyur la/ de lta ra na phung sogs gdag gzhir byas nas/ rdzas yo da kyi bdag yod pa dang / de dag de'i bdag gi bar 'dzin pa khegs par 'gyur bas phung sogs chos tsam du lus par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rang gi phung

— 320 — — — —sdirjitram̐phra rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyasrimadzan+d+ra—tram̐ rjo—/—da wasos/ru ji nye ba de ngazhin du phyi'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten rnams kyang la sa dang nyon mo ngas pa'i dbang gis bskyed cing las dang nyon cho/ngas de dag 'du bya ba po'ibyugang zag rdzas yod kyang med pas de dag kyang des stongs shing chos tsam du lhag mar lus pa dang / de bzhin du dag pa'i zhing dang bcud sogs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i thugs rje dang smon lam gyi nus pa yongs su rdzos/sa pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yang rang skya ba'i rdzas su med pas de dag kyang chos tsam du lus pa dang / 'gog pa dang de nga zhin nyid la be+o gas pa 'thob pa dang mngon du bya ba dang shes par bya ba'i chos rnams kyang 'thob pa po la sorga//sa pa'i gang zag rang skya ba med pas de dag kyang yi+os tsam du 'gyur ro/ /tsam gyi sgras 'thob pa bo dang shes pa bo lgo sogs pa'i sa/nga zag rdzas yod gcod do/ /de ltar na de lta bu'i gang zag rang skya ba med pas de yod par bzung nas bdag gi bde ba bsgrub pa'i ched du chags pa dang sdang pa la sogs pa'i nyes par spyod pa'i tshogs don med pa ra mthong nas de dag las ldog par 'gyur ro/ /don 'di ni rnam 'grel las/ bden pa bzhi la brten pa dang / /bde dang nga dang nga'i zhes sogs/ /yang dag min pa rnam bcu drug /sgro btags nas ni yongs su sred/ /de nyid la ni de 'gal don/ /de nyid rnam pa rjes rtogās can/ /legs bsgoms yang dag lta ba yis/ /sred pa rjes 'brang bcas 'joms byed/ /ces dang / stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don no/ /des na bye mdo gnyis kyi chos thams cad rang rang gi rang skya

grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'imadzis rgyan mdzad tshus+t+ra—/da wa — 2 dzo5da thub pa'i rdzas yomide kyiṭa5 stong bar khas len na/ de thams cad la ca/ nga zag gi bdag med kyi tha snyad bya ci dgos/ de la chos kyi/ bdag med kyi/ tha snyad ci'i phyir btags mi chog /sems tsam pas kyang stong tshul 'di'i sgo nas chos kyi bdag med mi 'jog par/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba sogs phung sogs kho rang gi steng nas stong tshul khyad par pa zhig la chos kyi bdag med du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang shes par 'gyur mod/ gzhan yang chos thams cad kyi steng du rang rang gi rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong bar gtan la 'be+ebs tshu/la gcig tu bral gyi rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i rnam bzhag mngon pa gong 'og sa sde lnga tshad ma sde bdun rtes 'brang dang bcas pa sogs bye mdo sems tsam pa'i gzhung lugs gang nas bshad pa ston cig /der ma zad de ltar 'dod phyin chad 'di dag gi lugs la 'gal ba dang / ma grub pa dang ma nges pa du ma zhig rang lugs su khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di dag ni sngon med cipa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba zhig yin pa phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs na mkhyen par 'gyur ro//gzhan yang sems tsam pa'i lugs la don dam par yod tshul la 'jog tshul gnyis byas nas yongs grub don dam par 'jog tshul la 'phros nas/ legs bshad snying bo las/ lugs 'dis ye shes de rang rig tu bzhed pas ye shes kyang yul du 'gyur ro snyam na/ yul gang la ltos nas de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i yul de la dgongs pas skyon ped do zhes tro/sungs pa 'di'i don la/ yi ga cha rnams su 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye

da 2paṃ2 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhuka—sdosdo— ḍidzes rgyan modzad tshulo/ —shes rang rig yin zer rba dang / mnyam bzhag ye shes rang gi yul chos nyid 'jal tshul la ltos nas so so rang rig pa'i ye r+sha/sa su 'jog pa'i don yin zer ba sogs bshad tshul mi mthun pa mang bo byung ba rnams rje rin po che'i dgongs par ji lta ba bzhin ma song ba gzigs nas/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rang gi bakhyi/da pa 'di ltar gsungs te/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la don dam par 'jog pa la/ 'jog tshul gnyis yod pa'i/ 'jog tshul gnyis pa'i don dam par 'jog pa'i don ni/ zag med kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes la dam par byasnya nas/ de'i yul yin pas na don dam pa zhes bzhag pa na/ zag yed ye shes nyid kyang zag med kyi ye shes nyams su myong ba'i rang rig zag med shes pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir 'jog tshul gnyis pa'i don dam du 'gyur snya ma pa dang / zag med mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi yul la yang / 'jo ga tshul gnyis pa'i don dam du yod pas ma khyab po snyam pa'i dogs pa skye ṅge/ /de skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yang mnyam bzhag ye shes nyams myong gi rang ris/ de yod cing rang yul la gnyis rna nga nub pa'i zag med kyi shes pa yin zhi nga mnyam ba'/ga ye shes dang ngo bo gcig tu yod par bsams pa'o / / )ོli/sa pa de'i la na bshad pa la spyir zag med kyi shes pa gcig gi yul yin pa tsaX 4 gyizhes 'jog tshul gnyis pa'i dbang du byas pa'i don dam —par 'jog na bden mod kyang / 'dir ni de tsam gyis mi 'jog pas skyosamed do/ /'o na ji ltar 'ejog snyam na 'jog tshul gnyis pa'i dngang du byas pari do 'o/ darma du 'jog pa la yul can zag med kyi shes pa de yu'adzi de la don dam dpyod byed kyi tshad ma yin pa dang / yul de zag med kyi/ shes pa

rgyub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ 273des dpyad mthar rnyed pa'i don yin pa ste chos gnyis tshogs zhig dgos so/ / de ni dgag bya rnam par bcad tsam gyi med dgag 'gyur med yongs grub kho na la rung gi yul can zag med kyi shes pa la mi rung ste/ zag med kyi shes pa de myong byed rang rig gis grub pa ni spyir shes pa yin na rang myong byed rdzas gzhan la ma ltos par rang dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'dzin rnam gyis grub dgos pa dang / 'dzin rnam yang kha nang blta kho na yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis zag med shes pa de myong byed rang rig gis gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yin gyi/ rang rig gis zag med shes pa de nyid yul gyi gnas lugs su grub ma grub dpyad pa'i dpyad mthar rnyed pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan des na ye shes de rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug tu 'gyur ba'i skyon med do/ /des na rje thams cad mkhyen pas yul gang la ltos nas de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i yul de la dgongs pas skyon med do/ /zhes pa'i don dpyis phyin par bshad pa yin no zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams gzu bo'i blos brtags na snga ma rnams kyi bshad tshul las go ba che zhing rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs par gting nas so na pa'i legs bshad kye/ skyes chen por snang ngo / /yang sems tsam pas lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags kyis gzugs dang gzugs 'dzin shes rma rdzas ga cik+ṣ-i ga tu bsgrub pa'i skabs su 'asros don dogs slong 'di ltar gnang ste/ ci sems tsam pas gzub/sa rags 'dzin shes pa dang bdag nyid gcig tu 'dod pa'i don ci yin/ lhas sbyin dang mchod sbyin gnyis kyis bum pa lta bu zhig la r+bhane+e mong du bltas pa'i cha balha bya thu na mong ba'i bum pa de lha/ ba po gnyis

274 grub mtha' rnam bzhag zub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mjo da tshul/ka'i mig shes dang rdzas gcig yin nam re re ba'i mig shes dang rdzas gcig yin/ dang po ltar na mig shes gnyis kyang phan tshun rdzas gcig tu 'gyur la/ — phyi myoshaṃ ltar na lhas spyin gyi mig shes dang rdzas gcig tu gyur pa'i bum pa de/ mchod sbyin gyi mig shes dang rdzas tha dad du 'gyur la/ de ltar na de mchod sbyin gyis ma mthong bar 'gyur zhing de bzhin du cig shos la yang mtshungs pas sa/cispu/ si/sa mthong ba cig shos kyis mi mthong na bum pa de blta bya thun mong ba yin pa 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang lhas sbyin gyi rgyud kyi mchortswasbyin gyi the/sa pa rtogs pa'i tshad ma'i gzung byar gyur pa'i mchod sbyin gyi shes pa de tshad ma de dang rdzas gcig yin nam tha dad yin/ dang po ltar na de gnyis rgyud gcig tu thal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na tshad cha/ des de 'jal ba'i tshul de la sems tsam pa rang lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhan rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ de la ni rang gi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i yul rig pa 'bras bur 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pas bsdus pasto'i snod bcud 'di dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa'i tshe rig bya rig byed rdzas/ gcis/ na sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa dang rdzas gcig tu gyur pa'i sdug bden yod par thal bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs nas skyo na de dag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan gyis la na btab tshul kha shas 'god pa rga/nang nas rang nyid kyi bzhed tshul 'di ltar gsungs te/ lhas sbyin dang mchod sbyin gnyis kyis blta bya thun mong ba'i bum pa gcig la bltas pa'i tshe gcig la snang ba'i cha cipre/ rtso/ ri ṭa la mi snang yang / bum pa tsam blta bya r+bhan mong bar

grub mtha' rnam bzhag bub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ — 275'jog pa mi 'gal te/ dper na lhas sbyin dang ma/ cho sne sbyin gnyis kyis sgra mi rtag ces badzo+od pa'i tshe lhas sgyen gyis brjod pari cha de mchod sbyin gyis brjod pa min kyang sgra mi rtag ces pa'i tshig tsam de gnyis/ ka'i thun mong gi brjod par mi 'gal zhing / de gnyis so so nas brjod pa'i tshig de dag las don gzhan du gyur pa'i de gnyis kyi brjod pa thun mong ba'i sgra mi rtag ces pa'i tshig kyang med pa bzhin no/ /des na lhas sbyim/ dang mchod sbyin gnyis dang rang rang gi mig shes nu/ snang nga'i bum pa ni rang rang gi mig shes de dang rdzas gcig mod kyang mig shes gnyis rdzas sa/cig ga la dgos/gzhan rgyud kyi shes pa 'dzin pa'i tshad ma la yang rjes dpag la ni shes pa'i don spyi snang ba yin pas tshad ma dang rdzas tha dad kyi dogs pa mi dgos la/gzhan sem sa shes pa'i mngon shes la yang dngos su sa/sal bar snang ba ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis rang gi sems pha rol gyi shes pa'i rnam pa can du skyes pa nyid yin la/ de ni tshad ma de dang rdzas tha dad ma yin zhing de dngos su snang ba la brten nas pha rol gyi sems ji lta ba bzhin du shes par 'gyur bas de lta bu'i shes pa de tshad ma yin cing shes pa de'i ngo na pha rol gyi sems kyi sgra don dang / pha rol gyi sems gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa'i —ོsnang tshul yang med pas mngon sum yang yin no/ /dmyal ba'i me rtogs pa'i kun mkhyen ye shes kyis dmyal ba'i me gzigaca/ tshul yang dmyal ba pa'i rang gi myo/nga byar gyur pa'i mer snang dang shog bya rig byed rdzas gcig tu gyur pa'i shes pa yul dang bcas pa'i rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes la gsal bar snang 'i/nga de r+ha/ bu'i gzung ba'i rnam pa de yang ku'o/ mkhyen ye

276 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/shes dang bdag nyid gcig pa yin no/ /kun mkhyen ye she sa la de lta bu'i rnam pa 'char ba yang sems can la de lta bu'i snang ba pyi( da pa la ltos da7/sa pa dang / sangs rgyas 'phags pa rang nyid kyis tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i dbang gis gzigs pa kho na yin no/ /ye shes de ni dmyal ba'i me la mngon sum tshad ma yin tshul gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra la/ rgyu mcha na de dag gi phyir kun mkhyen ye shes kyis dmyal ba'i me mngon sum du sa/zis/sa kyang spyir dmyal ba'i me de sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa dang rdzas gcig mi dpo+o/sa so/ /'di dag ni mdo tsam yin gyi da dung 'di dag la brten nas sems tsam pa rang lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam bzhag du ma zhig dang / de la dbu ma ba dag gis 'gal ba brjod tshul thun mong ma yin pa du ma zhig yod cing / shing rta chen po rnams dang rje yab sras kyi gsung rab la brten nas da lta'i gzhung lugs pa dag gi rna bar ma grags pa'i rnam bzhag du ma zhig bshad du yod mod/ /'on kyang ha cang gtam gsar ba mang drags na ra pho dkar po lug khyur mi tshud pa'i dpe ltar rang nyid ston chen gyi gral nas bud kyis dogs pas de tsam las ma spros so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / /de ltar na sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi chos kyi bdag med phra mo rtogs pa'i lta ba rang rgyud la bskyed pa la/ yid shes rtog pa la ltos pa'i rnam rig la 'jug tshul dang / rtog med dbang shes la ltos pa'i rnam rig la 'jug tshul gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po ni ming tshol ba sogs tshol tshul bzhi bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams kyi sdon po gzung ba don gzhan du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa rang mtshan gyis yod

r+sha gib mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ 711pa khegs par 'gyur la/ de khegs pa na sngon po zhen gzhi yin pa snang ba'i sngon 'dzin dbang shes de snang yul la 'khrul bar 'gruka ste/ sngon 'dzin dbang shes la sngon po zhen gzhi yin pa snang ba na rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sngon 'dzin dbang shes de 'khrul bar grub pa na yul sngon po de shes pa dang 'brel med pa'i phyi rol tu grub pa khegs la/ de khegs pa na sngon po de rang 'dzin shes pa'i snang cha tsam du grub cing / de ltar na sngon po sdon 'dzin shes pa las rdzas tha dad yin pa khegs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas rtog med dbang shes la ltos pa'i rnam rig la 'jug pa na paṇa chen chos mchog gis bshad pa lta ra lhan cig dmigs nges gyi rtags kyi don nges pa'i sgo nas/ gzugs sogs rang 'dzin shes pa dang rdzas gcig tu grub pa lta bu'i tshe rang gi mig shes la snang ba'i sdon po de rang 'dzin mig shes dang rdzas gcig tu grub pa yin la de bzhin du gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes sogs kyang rang gang la mngon sum tshad mar song ba'i rang la snang ba'i yul de'i rnam pa dang rdzas gcig tu grub pa yi na no/ /de nu kha cig gzugs dang gzugs 'dzin tshad ma rdza sa gcig tu grub pa yo+os kyi bdag med phra gyi+o/ sgrub pa'i rigs pa yang dag gis bsgrub byar mi 'thad de/ de yin na med dgag yin dges pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma thal rang sogs kyi lugs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir zer pa la/ lugs 'dir bdag med bsgrub pa'i rtags kyi bsgrub bya la med dgag kho na 3dzin dgos pas ma khyab po zhes kho bo cag mgrin pa bsal ma/sa 'chad sdo / /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams/ kyang gaḍū/na

྅18 grub mtha' rnam thezhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzis rgyan mdzad tshul/ —gyis ma thon pa'i legs bshad mchog tu ni nga ngo / /rang rgyud pa'i skabs su gcig tu bral gyi gtan tshigs gcig pu yang / dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel sogs nas bshad pa bzhin tshul gsum gyi rigs pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pas sgrub tshul dang / des rang gzhan gyi grub mthas btags pa'i sgro 'dogs du ma sel ba dang bdag 'dzin kun btags dang lhan skyes kyi gnyen por 'gro ba'i tshul rnams re re nas zhib tu 'chad par mdzad pa 'di lta bu deng dus kyi mkhas rlom su zhig gis smra bar nus/ des na rje bla ma rarnga gis kyang 'di ltar/ de la spyir rang rgyud shar gsum gyi gzhung de dag gangs ri'i ljongs su bstan pa snga dar gyi dus dang / phyi dar la rngog lo chen po yab sras sogs kyi dus su yang 'chad nyan gyi sro/la shin tu dar bar snang zhi nga /de'i stobs kyis rje yab sras kyi dus su yang 'chad nyan gyi srol dar so che bar yed pas snga ma rnams kyis ma thon pa'i rigs pa'i gnad 'gag 'ga' zung ma gtogs rigs pa'i rnam grangs re re nas gzhung dang sbyar nas shin tu rgyas par 'chad par ma mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin par rje'i sa/sung gi zur dang mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma'i stong thun gyis shes so/ /da lta ni gzhung de dag gi thog nas 'chad nyan byed pa'i srol nub pa ltar gyur pas//'grel ba don gsal gyis mngon rtogs rgyan gyi mchod brjo da 'chad pa'i skabs su gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir zhes rngari/'i tshis/ zur gcig byung ba de la mkhas pa snga mas gcig tu bral gyi rnam bzhag cung zad re 'chad rnga4 mdzad nga 'i tshig sgros rnams las 'go mjug tshang ma tshang ci rigs la byang ngari ma ṇi 'dren pa ltar rjes zlos/ pyed pa kho ma/sa po—/cib / tu

grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bltan lhun po'i mardzos rgyan mdzad tshul/ ྅ṭīnya bral gyi gtan tshigs legs par shes pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal brtan par byas te gnas pa las gzhan du rtsa ba'i gzhung dang bstun nas rigs pa rgya bskyed lugs dang go ba 'tshol lugs sogs la blo kha phyogs pa di kon par snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rigs pa de dag gi gnad sheṭa5 pa shin tu gal che zhing legs par shes na gcig tu bral gyi gtan tshigs kho na— bsgoms kyang sgom rgyus phongs pa mi 'dug pas rang sems chos sku'i rang zhal blta bar rlom pa rnams kyis kyang rigs pa 'di tsam re bslabaṭashrī nas lus gnad bsrangs na legs par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams thugs shin tu mad par snang / /yang mkhas grub rjes gcig tu bral gyi gtan tshigs 'di tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags su bzhed pa la/ 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor gyiku / de ltar bzhed pa'i dgongs gzhi bkod nas dogs slongs byas pa la/ rang re'i mkhas pa rnarnga sa kyis 'a rusgro/ btab pa rnams legs ts+tshas pa'i dogs pa sel ba la mi phan par ma zad 'brel med kyi lan du 'gyur tshul dang / rje bla ma nyid kyis/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas de ltar bzhed pa'i dgongs pa zhib tu bkral nas legs ②ོ sa pas phyogs snga'i dgongs pa ma ldongs pa dang / bzhed pa de rje rin po che dang rgyal tshab rje dang slob dpon zhi 'tsho'i dgongs pa yin tshul rgya cher gsungs pa yang snga ma rnams kyis ma sgon pa'i sgrub tshul mchog tu zab par snang //yang deng sang thams cad kyis rang rgyud pa'i lugs la/ rang mngon sum su+o rtorngakis pa ri mdzan sum tshad mas gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis

྅8khye spub mtha' rnam zhag butsā bstan kun thami mdzis rgyan mdzed phu / rtogs par bya ba don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod pa la/ rje 'dis/ de lta na gang zag gi bdag med phra mo mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi bar chad med lam gyis kyang rang yul la chu la chu bzhag ltar gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa las ma 'das pas gang zag gi bdag med don dam bden par khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang lan gyis zlog tu med pa'i thal ba yin par snang / /thal 'gyur ba'i skabs su chos kyi bdag 'gog rma mtha' bzhi skye 'gog dang / gang zag gi bdag 'gog pa rnam bdun gyi rigs pa rnams rtsal du bton nas gsal bar bshad pa dang / rigs pa de rnams kyi gnad dang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'jog tshul gyi gnad rnams ji ltar yin pa dang / de dag tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i rim pa dang / myong ba skye ba'i khyad par gyi spu ris rnams zhib tu shes dgos tshul rnams gsungs pa 'di dag kyang gzhan gyis brgya stong bshad pa las lhag pa'i go ba bskyed pa'i 'chad tshul ngo mtshar bar snang ba kha phyir ltas su ma song bar blo kha nang du phyogs pa'i mkhas pa dag gis dpyad pas shes par 'gyur ro/ /rigs pa'i rgyalnga po rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs zhib tu gsungs nas//rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs kyi don la khyab che chung dang de kho na nyid kyi gting dpog pa la nges pa bskyed lugs mi 'dra ba'i gnad du ma yod tshul dang / ltos grub 'jog tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang / des na zla ba'i bzhed pa'i rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa zhes pa'i rgyu rkyen ni 'dus byas kyi rgyu rkyen sa bon dang chu lud lta bu kho na la mi bya bar shā nido gas byed pyi rtor+sha

rgyu mtha' rnam bzhag bub bltan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ 281pa la'ang bya dgos pa 'di dpal ldan zla ba dang rje bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa khyad par can yin tshul dang / rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs kyis mtha' gnyis lhag ma med par 'gog nus tshul la gtan tshigs dang bsgrub bya nges pa re res kyang mtha' gnyis ka sel tshul dang / thal 'gyur ba'i bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag thams cad kyang rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs 'di'i khong nas slong ba dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad bar du ma zhig la'ang gal che tshul dang / de yang snang phyogs nges pas stong phyogs ngos zin pa dang / stong phyogs rgyu mtshan du song nas snang phyogs la nges pa drangs pa'i go ba mtha' chod pa ma rnyed par shes mi nus shing / de dag kyang 'khor 'das kyi rnam bzhag thams cad btags tsam du grub tshul dang / de la yang ming rkyang btags tsam zhes pa'i rnam bcad yongs gcod kyi don legs par shes pa la rag las tshul sogs mdor na thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba gtan la 'be+ebs pa dang phabs nas rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa'i gnad 'gag gsal zhing 'dril bas mkhas pa'i yid rang dbang cimed par 'phrog pa'i legs bshad gzhan dag gi bshad tshul las khyad par 'phags pa du ma zhig bka' drin du stsal 'dug go /'di dag ni kho bo'i blo gros khab kyi mig bu lta bus dpyad nas rnyed pa'i khya da chos ragar+sā pa sna 'ga' tsam zhig bris pa yin gyi blo gros dang ldan pas zhib tu brtags na da dung yang sdon med pa'i legs bshad du ma zhig ngos zin par 'gyur snyam du sems so/ /'dzem gling rgyan gyi gzhung lugs chu gter las/ /'ongs pa'i zabra

282 grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhunapo'imadzisargyan mdzad tshul/don dbang gi rgyal po kun/ /legs bshad gser gyi nyag thag la bstar pa'i/ /sngon med thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog 'di/ /rgyal kun gsung ge gaṭaci nga ba nor bu'i dpya/ /rdzogs par r+shadren pa'i 'phrul gyi shing rta ste/ /mu stegs 'chal ba'i klad pa 'gems pa yi/ /chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgra tho che yang yin/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub thogs med kyi/ /gzhung bzang chu bo kun 'dus rgya mtsho dang / /gong 'os/ grub mtha'i bzhed srol rgyu skar gzugs/ /rnam bkra kun gsal me long nyid kyang yin/ /rgyal kun dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod nga'i sprin/ /rgyal sras gdengs can rtsen pa'i rol pa'i mtsho/ /nyan rang legs bris nyer 'tsho'i a mṛ ta/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i re skong dpag bas ma shing / /'di ko rje btsun bla ma'i dpal gyi mgrin/ /g.yaṭashrī 'khyil dung gi sgra 'am rgyal kun gyi/ /gsung dbyangs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rol mo zheṭag / /bdag gi blo gros the tshom 'dzin par gyur/ /bka' bstan gzhung ngargya'i dka' gnad cha rdzogs pa'i/ /sngon med legs bshad zla ba gsar ba 'dis/ /nyi tshe'i 'od 'byin bstan bcos rgyu skar kun/ /byis pa 'brid pa'i rnam grangs tsam du byanu / /rgyal ku/na thugs rje'i rang gzugs bla ma rjes/ /rgyal gsung snying bo kun 'dus legs bshad kyis / /rgyal ba'i bstan la ri cho / bskrun pa la/ /rgyal ba srasho bcas dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bzhad/ /ma ngon khyod bslu med tshad ma'i ston pa ste/ /'gro ba'i ma 'dris bshes kyang khyod nyid la/ /blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma'ang /khyod/ /de phyir khyod nyid gcig su 'argo ba'i skyubs/ /phyogs lhang dha rnyu ra yis phi+o /ru rnams kyis/ /ji ba'i/na

da wa grub mtha' rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan mdzad tshul/ 283ma byatsāthong legs bshad gangs ri'i mdangs/ /phyogs tsam spyod yul gyur pa kho bo yi/ /blo gros 'dren byed 'di yang skal bzang snyam/ /de yir+sha pu che rabs gzhan du'ang mgon po 'di'i/ /legs gsung dbyar rngas ne 'i grol mngal bsgrun pa'i/ /rnam dpyod gtsug phud can du 'gyur ba yi/ /dge ba'i sa bon thebs snyam spro ba skyes/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ /grub mtha'i rnam bzhag thub bstan lhun po'i mdzeṭa/ rgyan zhes bya ba sngon med legs bshad kyi dga' ston gsar bas bstan pa rin po cher phyag rjes dang skal ldan gdul bya yongs la nam yang nyams pa med pa'i chos kyi skyes bzang bo stsol par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu ba'o/ / //

284skezhu burgya go/skyeg blo/ gnamā zhaskoska zhi zhi zhadag po zhadamā dbyadarga god mā chen dzazhi thrugaspe nu brumā bramād mābu rgyaspe dmā puzhi chosu nu zhadud myis gtanas pun naded puzhi tshuzha/ rībar skabs shig gyirgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par zhu 'phrin 'dod gsol gyi snyan tshig rmad du byung ba mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i rje bla ma'i bstod pa la dpe glang ba 'di lta bu zhig 'bul bar mdzad de/ /dpal ldan phun tshogs bye ba'i nor bus yongs gtams zab cing rgya che bde ba chen po'i chu gter che/ /bcu phrag stobs dang mi 'jigs bzhi sogs du ma'i yon tan dpe 'das rlabs phreng chal chil rnam par g.yo/ /skye dgu rnam mang duḥkhas gtses la lhag par rab brtses rjes chags dbu ba 'dzum dkar rol ba can/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar chu klung spro dang sdud mdzad rdo rje 'dzin mchog zhabs pad 'dab drung du/ /mgon khyod drin las thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i ro / /myangs las ma smad blo gros lang tsho dar/ /gang des dad pa'i dbyug gus bsnun pa las/ /zhu tshig snyan 'jebs lha yi rnga 'di bsgrag /spros pa'i mtshan ma kun las nges grol dbyings la bde chen in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs kyis dzakhyad pa'i kun gsal chos kyi sku/ /tshon brgya'i dge legs byin pa'i shel bzhin sar sa/nas dpa' bo'i mig gi bdud rtsir gang gyur nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /mkha' la dbang bo'i gzhu dang mtsho

genam bskos 5nga ma jin thar dam 5sa kyi banud rdzi gul tshu / 285las rlabs bzhin mtha' dag snod kyi dbye bas cir yang 'char bzod rmad byung phyi la pa'i sku/ /rgyal kun sku gsum stong dang snying rje gcib/ tu 'dres gyur rol mo 'di ni 'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' e ma rmad/ /'gro 'di'i rgya chen legs spyad shar ri'i rtse mor rlabs chen thugs bskyed mgyogs 'gros shugs kyis dra5sa/ rmad byung mkhyen pa'i zer 'phreng 'gyed pas gzhung brgya'i pad+mo rnam bzhad 'gro blo'i gdung ba bcil/ /thun mtshams bla gso gsar bas rnam mdzes yid skyes snying gi mun pa ma lus cig char 'phrog /zung lnga'i zhabs sen li khri'i rdul phreng dregs ldan ral pa'i rgyan du rol 'di dpag dka'i gnas/ /de phyir rmongs pa'i bran gyur snyis/sa dus kyi/ /gdul dka'i 'gro la mgon po khyod las gzhan/ /skyabs dang dpung gnyen bral ba'i tshul dgongs te/ /rgyal kun mdzad pa'i khur chen khyod kyis bsnams/ /thub gsung legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /mkhyen gter zhal gyi bum pa las/ /skyug pa gsan bsam snyim pa yis/ /lus pa med par gsol ba las/ /rangs shing bde bas khyod thugs gang / /de lta'i bde ba skye dgu kun gyi longs spyod ma gyur pa/ /de yis khyod thugs lhag par gdungs pa'i thugs rje'i ngang tshul 'di/ /mthong bas dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje mgon khyod 'ba' zhig gis/ /bdag gir bzung snyam kho bo'i yid ni the tshom khyogs la brten/ rang don rtsa ltar dgongs pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi zab rgyas dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin pa'i smon 'a ma lus can ma lus pa'i/ /dpung gnyen gyur pa ring nas mdzad pa la gas/ /de slad skye rgu dbugs 'byin cing / /'dod lha'i snying la

2skye6 gnam bakhu+o /sa rgong ma chon por dam chos chi bdud ci gul tshul/'jigs bskyed pa/ //khyod kyi rlabs/ chen spyod pa yis/ /ma bame bas rgyal sras spyod de gang / /'jig rten kun nas mgon po khyod nyid dang /sna /yon tan cha tsam mtshungs pa'ang rnyed dka' nas/ /de rma da bdas/ gis skyabs gcig khyod kyi dper/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba kho na yang yang bsgrin//de tshe chos kun mkhyen pa la/ /rgyal dang khyod dbyer ma mchis kyang / /snying rjes rgyal ba'ang zhum mdzad pa/ /de phyir bdag ni dpe yis dbulata mi ma/nyam mkhyen brtse'i yon tan dpal mnga' bas/ /rnam mang ma khas grubakun gyi ma go bo la/ /zhabs skyes rtul tshogs rnam par 'godacipa ye/ /da pal ldan bla ma khyod la phyag bgyid do/ /dkar nag 'dres ma'i las kye phye da po yis/ /rmongs pa'i mun gtibs phra rgyas tsher mas dkregs/ /'jig lta'i ri bo mtho la brling bas bskor/ /'dzigs rung 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyam thag par/ /chud pa bdag kyang khyod drin las/ /lus sems nyer 'tshes rgyang dben cing / /khyod gsung zab rgyas chos tshul don/ /sgrub la smo/na pas 'da' bzhin gnas/ /mtshams zhus/ thub bstan spyi dang ye nyam med tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs dri med yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /srid rtse'i bar du bsgrong bar gso la ba 'debs/ /chags sdang phrag dog 'gran sems drag po yis/ /rnyed bkur 'thob slad dam chos rin chen nor/ /bza' btung gos la brje ba'i tshong ba mkhan/ /de dag mi dge'i spyod lasalazlog tu gsol/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi dmu rgod 'gro/ /ma rungs gdul dkar gyur pa'i ngang sdol la/ /skyo med rlabs chen spyod pa'i khur bsnams te/ /'gro ba'i

gdam btsābasku godo ma 3na por dam chos kyi bdud rtsi gul tshul/ 281don gnyi — re ba skong bar mdzod/ /bdag kyang khyed zha' myur du mjal ba dang / /khyod gsung sgrub pa snying bor byed pa dang / /gang brtsams las kun mtha' 5/sa 'gro ba la/ /sman pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ bdag dang skye dgu mtha‘ra dag chos tshul thoṭaṭa bsam sgom pa'i grur zhugs nas/ /mkhyen brtse'i skya ba 'dzin mkhas khyod 'dra'i ded dpon mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /shes brtson dad dang lhag bsam dar chen phyar te 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal nas sku gsum nor bu'i gling du phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /slad nas zab gsal rab4 myur cha shas yongs rdzogs mkhyem pa'i dkyil 'khor chu shel dbang bo yis/ /'jam dpal mgrin par zhugs pa'i spobs pas snyan 'jebs zab rgyas don ldan snyan tshig 'od dkar 'phring / /bdag blo'i ku mud tshal snag rmongs pa'i gdung bsal dad dang dga' ba'i snying bo gsal ba'i phyir/ /skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun bzhin spro ba rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /ces zhu yig spyan lam rmin byed mdzod gos mang nug dmar po srid na che ba rgya dril yug mdzod gos ser bo con tan pad ris rgya dril che ba yug mdzod gos dmar po che ba rgyan bzhi yug mdzod gos ser po che ba gser jus rgya dril yug dmar po de mtshungs yug lha rdzas dkar po dri bral dang bcas zla tshes la gus phran gyis phul/ /zhes pa'o/ /de lagyirgyal dbang mchog nas snyigs ma'i dus kyi ngaji tshul dang / dus ngan 'di lta bur snying stobs mchog tu brtan pos bstan 'asdo'i don la gzhol — da3 bsnags ‘/ brjod cing snang stong gnyis tshogs sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams — rwa

288 —gnamabaskos gong ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud gul tshul/bzhes gne la 'de sa dang bcas pa'i bka' lan tshig don phun sum tshogs pa blo gros dang ldan pa'i yid rang dbang med par 'phrog pa 'di lta bu zhig stsal 'dug ste/gzhan phan rmad byung rin chen 'bum gyi sna/ /'dren byed thabs mkhas mdzad bzang chu klung rgyun/ /chad med 'bebs mkhas mchog gi sa mkhan gar/ /sprul sku gdengs can dbang bo gang degal/ /ches dkar lhag bsam chu 'dzin brkyangs pa'i rtser/ /dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur stong gis sgeg pa mo/ /'chi med lus phra'i lag zung nas spros pa'i/ /snyan tshig man+da ra ba'i char 'di 'a'ebs/ /gser mngal dgyes pa'i zhal las ma 'phos shing / /dbyangs can phang 'gro'i rgyud las drangs min yang / /don bzang tshig tu snyan pa'i chab shog glu/ /thos 'dzin rgyan du bkau/da pa'i me tog bzhin/ /dman khams sa bon phra mos skyed bsrings pa'i/ /yon tan e raṇ+ḍa yi ljon shing phon/ /grags skam bser bus bskyod pa'i ngang tshul de/ /ldem ldem mdzes kyang su zhig mtshar du brtsi/ /khyod sdon 'gro ba kun la mdza' gcugs kyi/ /sa bon spyod pa rgya mtsho'i chus bcus las//rgyal sras ma la yar skyes tsardon ljon/ /ngad pa tsam yang phan bde'i 'bras bur smin/ /srid gsum ngang tshul rnyog bral dbang bo'i ngos/ /shar ba'i blo gros 'dren byed rab gsal bar/ /'du byed sdug bsngal ches phra'i rdul tsam gyis/ /zug rngur gyur 'di 'phags pa'i rnam d+nghathar nyid/ /lhag par dug gsum shugs drag 'bar ba'i mes/ /snying la gong bu gcig tu 'khyud pa'i dung / /spres spyod dasgal bar bsdus pa'i ri mo ṣ+ka /gya gyur shar

gin sa rgong ma jin 5ra dam chos kyi dud bul tshul/ 28nyab snyigs dus laṅka'i dpung / /'joms la nges par )pa' ba'i snyi nga stobs phul / /mi shiganā pha lam mchog gi go bgos te/ khaphrin las nem 'gyur stong phrag rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs mkhas rā ma ṇa de khyod du khums/ /dri ldan chu skyes tshar du dngar ba'i tshal/ /ring na gnas kyang ra yig gnyis pa'i khyu/ /dga' bas 'khrigs bzhin gzur gnas blo ldan rnams/ /gang la yid dbang mi 'dud go skabs ci/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mtha' yas nor gyi char/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi myo/chog sbyin rin gsum/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du thob pa'i rten bzang gis/ /'di na skal ba mchog gi rtser son kyang / /lus can phal gyi blo gros dra ba'i sbubs//rmongs byed yid srubs rlung gi 'tshub ma dang / /'grogs pas phan bde'i sems kyi tsardon dri/ /bzang yang rnam par ba skyod 'di 'bras bu dman//phon por ma yin chos lam drang bo'i bshul/ /zhugs na deng dus 'gro ba'i rnam thar dang ci/ /'gal phyir tsu ta'i yul gyi rkang gnyis bzhin/ /rmongs rtul byis pa'i snang ngor brin pa dka'/ /'on kyang rnam 'dren mdo sngags 'o ma'i mtsho/ /thar 'dod 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len du/ /nges nas nyams len nying khu len 'dod tsam/ /'di yang 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs drin/ /slar yang dga' ldan lugs bzang dbang gi rgyal/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rgyud 'tsham gan mdzod grwa/ /yongs su 'geng slad bshad sgrub shing rta ches/ /'dren pa'i brtson pa gzhar yang mi 'dor 'tshal/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs glog gi gar mkhan ltar/ /snang tsam nyid nas mi rtag rang gi mtshang / /rjen par gzigs pa'i spyo shas drag po dang / /kun

2nyakhye gnam bskos rgong ma chin bor dam tshas kyi bdud rdzi phul dzul/dzob sems kyi ri mo mkhan de yis/ /ming tsam bris pa'i snang dang stong ba zung / /dbyer med lta ba mnog gis rgyas btab ste/ /galke/na don grogs kyi 'dod dgu gang yin par/ /'phrog byed dar ma'i brtul zhugs cis mi skyong / /deng dus dkar min ches bdo bdud kyi mda'/ /lhag par 'dzings pas skyod byed rdo rje'i gur/ /lha sngags rnal 'byor nam ya nga mi g.yel zhing / /dkar phyogs bsod nams dpung gi stobs skyed 'tshal/rī /de ltar rab dgas myos pa'i 'bras bu gsar/ /smin las skyes pa'i ka la piṅka'i bya/ /gre 'gyur snyan pa'i sgra brgya sgro gas bzhin du/ /'phur sding gar gyis rol pa'i li khi ta/ /rten gyi spu sdug dang bcas bden pa bzhi'i//chos 'khor gser sbyangs rtsibs stong 'bar ba can/ /bsgyur ba'i dus tshes rmad byung dge ba'i char/ /thub bstan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i gling nas phul/ /zhes pa'o/ /da ni gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma bdag po chen po'i thugs kyi bum bzang dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis 'gengs par mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam bsnyad par bya ste/ /snga mo bod du phebs skabs khri chen rdo rje 'chang gis bka' chos kyi gseng bar zhig la nyid nas 7gong ma bdag po chen por bka' chos 'bul ba shar na/ thog ma rang du skyabs 'gro'i khrid 'bul dgos pa yin zhes ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan stsa la pa thog tu bab ste skabs shig gyigong ma chen po nas gsang stabs kyis bkak+ṣ-ire chos ci rigs gsan rgyu'i snyan gsan phebs pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te/bla ma'i bka' bzhin thog ma rang duji skyabs 'gro'i khrid mdod nga ci sdoshrī tsam bhe

genam bskod/ gotram̐ ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud smyo phul tshutsho/— tshoram̐d du la nas re zhig gi nga ra de nyid thugs/ 'dris mdzad cing / pod yi na gzab gshar 'bri klog da nga dag yig skor snyan 'bul mdzad par 7gong ma zun po nyi nga| nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer med par ma zad/ drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor yang ma/khyen dpyod gzhan dring mi 'jog pas brda' gso la ba tsam gyis tshig don mtha' dag bde blag tu thugs su chud pa'i tshul mdzad/ nyin cig 7gong ma'i zhal nas nged kyi sdoshrī bo da pyi/ mi ge klog chul tshas/sa su chud byung / da ni hu thog thu nyid nas dam pa'i chos nya4 si ṭa/ gu len ngurtesku ston par ṭag dzod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ni shin tu rgya che zhing rna ma grangs mang bas tshis/ don yongs su rdzogs pa las dang ngo ba(smi blor chud dka'/ phyogs re tsam dang nyi tshe tsam bslabs rnga sa sa rngo sne mi 'ong ba 'dug des na gang la bslabs na bstan pa yongs ngo gas/ kyi sa/nad sheri smu tri/nga nyam ṭag su blangs na thams cad der 'du dpaspyi'i sdom lta bu zhig la 4bslab dgos pa 'dug pa la de 'dra'i chos ci lta pu yo da ces bka' 'dri gnang ba la/ rje bla ma mchog nas/ de lta bu'i chos shin tu yod/ mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa gnyis dang de las kyang byang chub lam gyi rim pa bya ba bstan pa thams cad 'gal med dang gsung rab ma lus gdams ngag tu 'char bas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba dang ldan tshul tho re tsam zhigarī zhus pas/ 7gong ma'i thugs la shin tu 'phrod pa byung ste phyag kāthal mo sbyor ba mdzad nas/ de lta na re zhig nged la lam rim ston pa mdzod/ de tshags su chud nas gzod gas nga sngags kyi gdape ṭage pa zhu ba byed ces ga/su/nga / chos slob pa'i na r+sha bhe/ 'bus sdom nyid

da 292 gnam bskos rgong r+shan por dam ‘sa rnyi bdud khyi bul tshul / nas bstan pa'i gnad 'gag dang de la 'jug pa'i rim pa rang stobs kyis mkhyen pa 'di 'dra nges par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbya ngas kyi rnam 'phrul du gdon mi za'o/ /deng dus kyi chos 'tshol ba phal che ba ni/ lha'i sgrub thabs dang las tshogs phran tshegs re lta bus tshim nas bstan pa'i gnad la go ba 'tshol ba'i kun slong tsam yang mi snang bar ma zad/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bur khas 'che ba rnams kyang 'dzin rgyu'i bstan pa ci yin dang thabs gang gis 'dzin pa dang tshul ji lta zus 'dzin par byed dgos tshul la rtog dpyod tsam yang mi 'jug cing / shes bya mtha' dag gtan la phab par rlom pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal ri ltar mtho ba dag kyang chos kyi gnad 'gag gang na yod mi shes pa sha stag 'dug na/ rgyal srid kyi longs spyod shin tu rgya che ba la spyod cing 'du 'dzi dang bral ba'i gnas skabs cung zad kyang med pa 'di 'drar yang lhar dam pa'i chos don du gnyer ba dang / de'i nang nas kyang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad 'tshol ba dang / de 6 ri re nyams len du 'khyer tshul la sgro 'dogs gcod pa 'di 'dra nges par ya mtshan che zhing bsngags pa'i yul du gyur pa ni gzu bo'i blos brtags na shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar gong ma po rang gi dgongs pa bzhin rje bla ma nyid nas kyang bstan pa la rim gyis bkri bar bged nas5 re zhig rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam khrid tshigs bcad ma nyid sdum bde bar darīgongs te/ de nyid tshig don re re nas rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i gsung bshad kyis bkrol te snyan du phul bas mi ring bar lam gyi rim pa la go ba gnan dang mi 'dra ba rnyed pas nyin gcig 7gang ma'i gsung las/

gnam bskos gong ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud ji phul tshal/ 293lam rim gyi go ba de rnams dmigs rnam du 'dril ba'i yig cha nyung 'dus zhig rgyun ra khyer mdzad rgyu dgos gsung bar/ rje gong ma ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa'i lam khrid tshigs bcad ma de nyid phul te dmigs khrid myong thog nas 'gag 'dril ba zhig gsung bar gyigong ma thugs dad gting nas 'khrungs te lam khrid de'i steng nas nyin re bzhin dmigs rnam tshar re skyong rgyu'i dam bca' zhal bzhes mdzad/'dis mtshon nas phyis su lha'i rnal 'byor sogs 'chag med kyi zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams srid skyong gi brel ba ci tsam che yang deng seng bar du lan gcig kyang ma chags pa mdzad 'dug pa ni/ shes rab sdong bo las/ dam pa mang bo khas 'che mi byed la/ /gal te dka' bas khas ni blang gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bur ni/ /shi yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i ngang tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /de nas skabs shig rje tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar mang bo zhig bka' 'dri gnang bar so so'i lan phul zhing / mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par zab mod bu ma'i lta ba ji bzhin dpyis phyin par 'chad pa bod du rje bla ma lta bu ma byung ba'i tshul snyan sgron zhus par brten rje bla ma nas nye bar —brgyud pa'i lta khrid zhig gsan bzhed nan tan lta bu mdzad pas/ rje bla ma nyid nas lta khrid gzab rgyas zhig thugs thog nas 'phul mdzad par/ de nyid yi ger bkod nas 'bul dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba de nyid ljags rtsom mdzad nas sul sa bugs shin tu dgyes par rtser/ gzhan yang gla ma

——tram̐rngiti—— gnam bskos gong ma chem/ por ba chos kyi bdud ci rur nyal/ — dhemachod dz+rari 'i khrid dang 'od dpag med pyi nyal sgom/ sman blari no ga ngasdukwa / pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod pa/ smon lam sogs kyi klag lung bcas snga phyir chos tshan mang tsam zhig phul 'dug shing mo glang gi lo khri chen rno rje 'chang nas rje bla ma nyid la gsung shog zhig gnang ba zla ba bcu pa'i mjug tsam la phyag tu 'phrod pa gzigs pas/ yi ge 'di 'byor dri ri du nyid zhag bdun phrag gnyis tsam sku mtshams la bzhugs nas phyir bzlog gi sngags 'bum phrag zhig 'gro nges mjad na nyid rang seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa sogs bstan srid la phan pa'i rmis ltas bzang ba zhig byung gsungs nas/ phyir bzlog gi phyag dpe yang bskur ba gnang 'dugamatshams la bzhugs rgyu gong mar dgongs pa zhu dgos shing / de skabaru/ gong ma'i zhabs brtan gyi rim kro mdzad pa dang / sku mdun du yang yang phebs dgos pa'i brel 'dzing che skabs yin pus dgongs pa zhu ba mi 'gab pas ci 'dra bya dgos thugs nem nur du gyur pa la/ /blo bur du gong nas sang nyin sku mdun du phepas zhes bos byung ba bzhin phyi nyin mjal phrad du byon par gsung 'phros mang zhig gnang ba'i 'phro la da cha nged cung zad mi khom pa 'dug pas hu thog thu sku mtshams 'dra mdzad na mdzad chog pa 'dug ces zhu ma dgos par tshur bka' phebs byung bas ya mtshan pa dang dga' ba tshad las 'das pa byung zhes gsungs/ 'di ni mkham/ chen rdo rje 'chang dang gyigong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis ka lkog kyur ma ngo na sum du gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan pa gsal bar mdzad pa nyid do/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin bdun gnyis kyi ring sku bcad rgya dam pos phyir bzlog skyigi

gnam basmos gong ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud sul tshul/ 295ljags bzlas 'bum phrag lhag 'a gro nges mdzad/ sku mtshams grol phral du 7gong ma'i mjal khar phebs pas gong ma chen pos gsung ba da ni nged rang gsang sngags kyi chos la 'jug 'dod pas/ sngas/sa byi ljorjug sgo dbang zhig gnang dgos// de yang bla ma nyid kyi thugs dam gyi lha bde mchog gi dbang ga nang dgos zhes phebs pa bzhin rje bla mas kyang 'bul bar zhal gyis bzhes/ cidabang gi yo byad thams cad gong ma rang gis sgrub pa gnang ste/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang sta thon dang bcas pa rgyas par 'bul ba rma dzad/ dbang gnang dus rje bla ma nyid khri mthon po la bzhugs su gco la zhing / gong ma rang nyid stan dma' ba la bzhugs te dbang ma grol bar du zhabs pus btsugs cing thugs dang snyan gtod pa so gas tshul dang mthun pa mdzad/ dbang zhu ba'i thog ma'i phyag rten du gser srang brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal rin po che sna tshogs kyis phra bkod pa phul bas ma tshon dbang gi yon du dngos 'bul kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul 'dug sta gon gyi so shing 'dor skabs so shing gi rtse steng du bstan na rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub 'grub pa sogs rtse gang du ston pa las dpags te dngos grub gang 'grub tshul rnams gsungs nas phyag tu gtad par/ gong nas spyan gyen du gzigs te badz+ra ha sa ha gsung zhing the tshom med par so shing 'dor ba gnang bas so shing maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus nyid du btsugs pa bzhin gyen du 'greng zhing bsdad pas thugs shin tu dgyes par gyur pa dang / rgyal po'i bzhugs gnas dang rje bla ma'i gzims khang gi bar rgyang grag tsam gyis ring ba yod spyang / sta gon gyi nub mo rje bla mas gzims khang du yi ge bdun

296 gnam bskos gong ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud sul tshul/pa gsung ba'i sgra rgyal pos gzims mal nas lhang lhang gsan pa sogs ltas khyad par du 'phags me byung bas/ gong ma chen po sngar nas thugs dad che ba'i steng du 'di nas bzung bla ma dang lha dang chos la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po ldog tu med pa 'khrungs 'dug dbang gsan pa nas bzung rje bla ma nyid sngar nas nged kyi bla ma yin par ma zad da ni rno rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin gsungs nas rigs kyi bdag por bzhes te bla slob kyi dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba mdzad cing / ci gsungs bka' bzhin du sgrub cing mi mnyes pa gtan nas mi mdzad pa dang / de'i mthus gyigong ma rang gi bzhed don rnams kyang lhun gyis grub par snang bas/ khri chen rdo rje 'chang gis seng gi'i khri la bzhugs nas bstan srid la phan pa'i lung bstan gnang ba de kho na bzhin byung 'dug go /de nas rim gyis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab lam rim pa gnyis kyi man ngag yan lag dang bcas pa myong khrid kyi tshul gyis gsan te/ snga dro lam rim dang phyi dro'i dus bde mchog gi rim gnyis kyi thugs dam 'chag med mdzad/ tshes bcu'i dus skabs skabs su dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug bzhes pa dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang lag mchod sogs kyang phyag len du mdzad par gda'/ /chos spyod rnam bcu'i gser ldan dus rtag tu/ /rgyal srid chu gter rnam mang bya ba'i rlabag /'khrugs pa'i klong du mi nub 'degs pa yi/ /brtson 'grus gser gyi rus sbal 'di ngo mtshar/ /nags nang me tog gsar ba rgyas na yang / /bzhad dkar pad mtsho kho nar 'jug pa bzhin/ /dman lam zhi bde sgrub pa'i thabs ldan yang / /snying stobs

— gimum bskos gong ma 3na por dam chos kyi bdud 4 gul tshul/ hūṃ91che 'di theg pa che la zhugs/ /bla ma'i gsung gsang rdo rje'i sde mig gis/ /'khor 'das gnad gsang sgo lcags bkrol ba las/ /snying gi za ma tog tu gdod ma nas/ /sbas pa'i lhan skyes rang nor ngo 'phrod pas/ /gzhan gyis bsten na thar pa'i srog 'chad pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan dug gi phung bo ni/ /tshur chen sngags kyi sbyor ba gtong shes pa/ /'di la grub pa'i bcud len mchog gyur te/ /sdug bsngal ljags khams bde chen dngul chus zos/ /rnam rtog rlung gis 'od gsal me dpung sbar/ /'khor ba'i chab rom myang 'das chu ru zhu/ /grub pa mchog gi sa la yud kyis gshegs/ /rje bla ma nyid nas sngon 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas hor gyi rgyal po hu pi las che chen han la kye rdo rje'i dbang gnang ba chu mo glang gi lo yin/ nged kyis kyang 7gong ma chen por 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang phul ba shing mo glang yin/ gnam lo 'di gnyis khams mi 'dra ba ma gtogs glang gi lor gcig pa yin 'dug ces gsung / 'di ltar gsungs pa rje bla ma nyid 'phags pa rin po che'i sku'i skye bar don gyis zhal gyis bzhes sam snyam zhing / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rje bla ma'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs su'ang 'phags pa rin po che bzhugs pa dang / yang dus phyis 7gong ma chen po'i 'khrungs rabs su hu pi las che chen han kyang yod 'dug pas/ sku skye 'phreng du mar mchod yon gyi tshul gyis bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa gor ma chag go /gong ma chen pos rje bla ma nyid las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshul gzhan yang mang du gsan zhing / dus phyis rje btsun rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi si ཿ ra'i

da wadzi sdo— gnamabaskos rgong ma chon por dam chos kyi bdud rtsi gul tshul /dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo/ gsan skabs/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs su bshad tshod bzhin babs pa'i rtags ya ma tshan pa byung nes rje bla ma'i zhal nas dngos su thos/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa'i myong khrid zhib tu gsan cing / mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gser chos kyi khrid gsan skabs rgyal po rang gi bzhugs stan kyang sdud par mdzad nas sa rjen gyi khar zhabs pus btsugs te dbu rje bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas bka' khrid ma tshar bar du bzhugs pa sogs dad gus blor mi chud pa mdzad/ ja sag bla ma tshul khrims chos 'phel dang sku mdun chos rje bstan pa rin chen gnyis kyis mchod g.yog byas pas dbang gral du bsdad par brten/ gong ma chen pos khong gnyis la nged rnams dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i rdo rje'i spun yin gsungs nas dgyes pa'i bka' 'phebs kyang stsal/yang skabs shig myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang dang / bla mgon dbyer med sogs kyi khrid kha shas kyang gsan nas gtor 'bul sogs 'chag medz+wa mdzad kyin yod 'dug gzhan yaji snying bo don gsum/ tshem bu dmar khrid sogs sngags kyi gdams pa mang bo dang /lhag pa'i lha du ma'i rjes gnang man ngag sogs chos bka' thor bu mang tsam gsan tshod 'dug kyang zhib cha rma nges pas 'a bri bar ma spobs so/ /gang gi legs byas shing rta 'bum phrag gis/ /rdzogs ldan ya mtshan rin chen phung bo kun/ /ring nas sa 'dir rdzogs par 'dren byed pa/ /gnam bskos mi yi bdag po khyen lung zhes/ /sdon bsags bsod nams nor bu'e lte ba nas// /bkram rngazi 'i mdzad bzang stong phrag gser gyi

zha nam b.ro/sa gong ma chen por dam chos kyi bdud rtsi phul tshul/ 299rtsibs/ /dge legs mu khyud zlum pos rab bsdams pa'i/ /mnga' thang 'khor los kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ /de yi gzi baphi/ da brte bar mi bzod nyi ma brgya phrag 'bar ba bakhya/na/ /dpar 'byor longs spyod zad mi she/sa pa rmugs 'dzin dbang bo'i bang mdzod bzhin/ /mthu stobs dpung la sus kyang spo la dka/'a rjakanam lcags ser chen 'bab pa bzhin/ /bka' yi chab 'bangs bgrang las 'das pa rgya ma tsho chen po'i rdul grangs bzhin/ /rgyal po gzhan rnams phal pa'i 'bangs kyis bkur ba'i rgyal po ste/ /'di ni rgyal po rnams kyis bkur ba'i rgyal po'i rgyal po nyid/ /gzhan dag srid 'byor lo 'dab tsam gyis dregs pa'i chu shing ste/ /'di ni chos kyi 'bras bu smin pa'i dpag bsam ljon bzang yin/ /gang gi dbu ni gdugs bzhin mchog gsum nor bu tog tu bkur/ /phyag ni dpag bsam yal ga ji bzhin gtong ba'i 'dod pa 'jo/ /bka' khrims gser gyi gnya' shing bzhin du btsan brjid kun la snyoms/ /e ma 'di yi ngo mtshar ca/tha' skudag srid 'dir brjod nus su/ /mdor na yongs 'du'i ljon pas 'jam mnyen gos/ /klubs te 'dzin mar dal gyis rgyu byed cing / /kun la blang dor ji bzhin 'doms byed na/ /sa chen skyong ba 'di yi rjes su 'gro/ /'di na mnga' thang lag mthil tsam dbang ba/ /'ga' zhig sa yi bdag por rlom zhing sgrogs/ /de yi bsnyen bkur thob pa'i blo chung dag /khengs pas byang khog 'gas pa ltar byed kyang / /gang gi rkang sen no ra buri me long ni/ /dregs ldan bye ba'i bzhin ras dus gcig tu/ /'char ba'i sno/da du gyur pa rtsod dus kyi/ /'khor los bsgyur pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma te / /de

bye00 gnam bskos gong ma chen por dam sa kyi bdud ji gul tshulo/ yi spyi gtsug nor bu'i cod paṇa la/ /gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo ngal bso ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po rol pa'i rdo rje zhes/ /srid zhi kun gyi bla na mtho 'di yin//srid 'byor rdul mang hūṃn spo r+shazhin du mthon por brtsegs kyang snying bo med gzigs nas/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi thugs gsang mdzod las dam chos yid bzhin nor mchog 'tshol byed pa/ /sa yi bdag po'i ngo mtshar mdzad bzang 'di yis deng dus bstan 'dzin phal mo ches/ /rnyed bkur 'ba' zhig snying bor byed pa'i rnam thar dag la co 'dri byas snyam sems/ /de ltar 7gong ma chen pos dam pa'i chos gsan cing nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ rgyal sras gzhan pa 'ga' zhig dang / rgyal po'i sku nye'i wang chen po rnams dang / blon po che chung du ma dang / las tshan med pa'i rgya'i mi drags mang bo dang / der ma zad btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nyug rum pa yan chad kyi khrod du'ang rje bla ma nyid las dbang rjes gnang khrid lung ci rigs nyan nas nyams len byed pa dang / dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs nas srung mkhan shin tu mang ba byung 'dug dus phyis zhig nang blon mi nyung tsam dang / she hwa shang sogs nas gsol ba btab ste man ju'u dang rgya mi mang bo zhig la nyin snga mar skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bog pa mdzad cing / de rjes nyin gnyis kyi ring dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa sta —gon dang bcas pa bka' drin stsal/ rje bla ma nyid nas skad rigs thams cad kyang thugs su chud pas bod skad mi shes pa'i rgya dang man ju'u dang sog po gang la yang chos gang gsung rang rang gi skad kyis gtsang sing nge ba thogāzhwa

gnam bskos gong ma che na por dam chos kyi bdud rtsi phul tshul/ 301med du gsung ba zhig yod pa'i dbang gis/ rgya dang man ju'u chos sgra thos ma myong pa rnams kyang rje bla ma'i gsung la brten nas chos kyi don cung zad re shes nas bla ma dang chos la dad pa brtan po thob pa mang du byung snang /hwa shang du grags pa'i rgya ban smug chas can rgya nag gi yul gru rnams su chos shin tu mang ba yod cing / de dag la sngon gyi dus su rgya gar gyi grub chen a mo snya badz+ra sogs paṇa grub 'ga' zhig phebs nas sngags phyogs kyi dbang khrid man ngag gnang 'dug na'ang bka' shin tu dam drags pas rgya cher ma 'phel par rgyun chad nas ring zhig song 'dug deng sang hwa shang gi sde rnams su 'dul ba dang mdo sde'i bshad pa sogs dga' rab yod kyang /gsang sngags kyi gdams pa'i skor ming tsam yang mi shes pa la/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi drin las hwa shang gi slob dpon che ba 'ga' zhig gis kyang gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang dang gdams pa thob nas nyams len byed pa byung zhing / rim gyis hwa shang gi sde rnams su yang gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba'i mgo tshugs pa lta bu byung snang / der ma zad snga ma hwa shang rnams kyis sngags kyi klog thabs mi shes pas/ dper na na mo a mi to bha la/ la mo o mi tho pho zer ba dang / pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta la/ po zhe bo la mi'i to zer ba dang /ga te ga te la/ kye the kye the zer ba lta bus mtshon sgra ma dag pa dang log pa 'ba' zhig tu bklags pa la rje bla ma mchog gis zhus don bzhin/ 7gong nas hwa shang rnams kyi sngags klog ma dag pa bcos shing phyin chad klog thabs ltar byed dgos pa'i bkas bcad mdzad pa bzhin da cha sngags klog kyang je bzang du 'gro mchis pas/ mtha' khob mun pa'i smag rum du gsang sngags

302 gnam bskos gong ma chen por dam rngo+o sa kyi bdud rtsi phul tshul/bla na medapa'i gyi+o sa kyi snang bas khyab par mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnamyo/ par thar pa'o/ /rgyal kun mes po zur phud lnga pa nyid/ /'dza7/ gling khyon 'dir dge legs sbyin pa'i slad/ /'chi med lding khang nor bu'i the ma skas las/ /mi rje 'khor los bsgyur pa'i zol gyis 'ongs/ /de yi bsod nams zla ba'i ma ma'i ltor/ /rgyal sras dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor sbrum pas/ /mnga' thang sprin gyi pho nyas phyos/sa kun tu/ /dge legs mu tig char du 'grem par gyur/ /de tshe srid pa'i phun tshogs rkang 'thung rtser/ /dam chos gser gyi snye ma g.yur za ba'i/ /rdzogs ldan kun dga'i dga' ston rgyas pa yi/ /'jig rten mya ngan med pa'i dus ston ngoms/ /chos srid 'dab brgya ba dang ku mu ta/ /so sor 'byed pa'i mchod yon nyi zla zung / /thugs bskyed go 'a 'i lam nas dbang phyogs kyi/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams mkha' la mngon 'phags te/ /mi yi bdag po'i dge bcu'i bka' khrims kyis/ /mngon rma tho'i lam du bcug pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mgon 'dis theg gsusmo chos kyi them skas las/ /nges legs khang bzang 'khrid pa'i 'phrul 'di rmad/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rī rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ gnam bskos mi yi bdag po 'jamasnyo dbyangs gong ma chen po'e thugs kyi bum bzang zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis gtams —par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / / /
