—d+ngha 303lbe'u burgya da//haṃska blo / gdan sa chen po dgon zhung py-imās pu skid du zhabus spyi blo tho buskyod de nado smud pye zhasnyan zhasprozhi don rludaska posgyuche na2da puzhi tshuzha/ skabs shig dbyar gyi dus ri bo spos ldan du yun ring tsam bzhugs nas lha du ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad cing / ri de'i sul rnams su sngon gyi dus su 'phags yul nas byon pa'i paṇa grub 'ga' zhig gi bzhugs gnas dang / de dag gis bzhengs pa'i sngags kyi lha sku lder bzo yang mang du yod pa dang / kyai ten hwa shang zer ba'i grub thob zhig byung ba de'i sku yo/dung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yod pa rnams rtsar bcad nas ngos 'dzin ma dzad cing / zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad pas tshar lhong rnams legs par byung / ri'i rtse tsam gyi nags khrod zhig tu gnas sa/zhi rnying ba zhig 'dug pa shin tu rtsub pas cho 'phrul gyi lhong 'jigs 'jigs lta bu mang du byung bas thugs dam la bogs shin tu thon pa byung zhes zhal nas dngos su thos/ de dus thugs shin tu bag phebs pas dge legs su byed pa'i gtam drang srong mngon par dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya nga zu ri/tsho byung lha mo'i rgyud mang gi di byangs las byung ba lta bu'i nyams 'gyur ngo mtsha ra ba'i snyan dngags kyi rgyan dang ldan pa sogs gsung rtsom 'ab/'a zhig mdzad 'duji / cing / dben pa la das/'a ba'i sa/tam chos glu ring mo bya ba'i nyams

304 gdan sa chon po dgon lung du rlubs rte bsan 'gromi rdon mdzad tshul/mgur mdzad pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /na mo gu ru/ /gnañcha spyi gtsug gser gyi sgo yi steng / /tshon ches bkra 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru la/ / bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen bzhugs/ /bu tha shal bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /chos bco brgyad ldan pa'i rdo rje'i lus/ /ches rnyed dka' 'jig sla yid bzhin nor/ /dus da res tsam zhig rnyed pa 'di/ /dgra rnam g.yeng gi kholabor gyur pas skyo/ /nor longs spyod bsag bsrung bya byed gcig /gnyen 'khor g.yog gi ngo bsrung sems 'dzin gnyis/ /gnyid long gtam lus mchor 'du 'dzi gsum/ /dgra 'di gsum gyis gtan bde 'phrog pas skyo/ /skabs lan 'gar thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /chos byed lo cung zad byas na yang / /tshe 'di snang chos brgyad dug dang 'dres/ /tshul 'di la bsams kyin yid re skyo/ /dus ston mjug 'char ka'i me tog ltar/ /yun thung ba'i tshe lhag nges med 'dir/ /zhe rango khrel med pa'i bshul ring rgyarga/sa/ /rgyud tshags su tshud na ci ma rung / /ches snying bo med pa'i bya ba kun/ /'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin rgyang dor te/ /tshe 'di ba'i mi dang mi bstun par/ /gnas dben pa bsten na ci ma rung / /yul spang ljongs ne'u gsing nyams dga' zhing / /dbyibs lhun sdug sa 'dzin khor yug can/ /tshon sna tshogs bkod pa'i me tog bkra/ /skad snyan par sgrogs pa'i 'dab chags lding / /lus spu sdug ri dwags bag phebs rgyu/ /g.yu'i lo 'dab ldem pa'i ljon shing dngar/ /ro brgyad ldan nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzang 'bab/ /yid chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu dang bral/ /gnas dben pa'i skyed tshal nyams dga' bar/ /dpal mnyam med drang srong

gdan sa jin bo dgon lung ru ji sa rte bstan 'gro'i rdon mthod tshul/ 305thub nga/'i gsung / /chos zab rgyas kun gyi bcud bsdus pa/ /pha bla ma'i zhal gdams zab mo'i don/ /lam rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len la/ /rtse gcig tu brtson pas sgrub pa yis/ /dus nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i skal bzang de/ /da ring bor mi thogs myong bar smon/ /phyag skor ba ci lcogs maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod rgyun mi chad/ /byams snying rje byang sems rtag par bsgom/ /'di sgo gsum phyi yi nyams len yin/ /lus sha khrag gi mchod sbyin rgya re che/ /ngag rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos 'chad cing / /sems dbyings rig dbyer med spros dang bral/ /'di sgo gsum nang gi nyams len yin/ /lus lhar bsgoms tha mal snang zhen bcad/ /ngag rdo rje bzlas pas las rlung 'gag /sems lhan skyes bde stong rol pas myos/ /'di sgo gsum gsang ba'i nyams len yin/ /gshis ye nas stongs kyang sna tshogs snang / /dran shes bzhin brtan pos bying rgod 'gog /rkyen gang byung lam 'khyer ro snyoms spyod/ /'di lta sgom spyod pa'i nyams len yin/ /gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi ngo bo rtogs/ /lam thabs shes zung 'brel lta sgom spyod/ /'bras sku po/sum dbyer med go 'phang che/ /'di gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'jog tshul yin/ /tshul de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /srid zhi ba'i mtha' spangs kun bzang spyod//dpal theg pa'i yang rtse 'dir brten na/ /mchog sangs rgyas de yang mi ring nye/ /gros medun ma mi la ma shor bar/ /rang shes rgyud chos la blo gtad nas/ /gnas dbe+en par la ma mchog de 'dra la/ /rtse gcig / gzhol na glo ba dga'/ /a ho la de 'dra'i ngo mtshar rmad/ /'o na

da wa306 gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/la de 'dra'i khe rgyal la/ /kye ma la de 'dras 'di phyir 'tshengs e ma ho de 'dra'i skal bzang la/ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /bu bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'jug rnams/ /tshul 'di la slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /gtam 'di lanu/ byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /ma rigs drug 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /rmongs ma rig 'khrul 'khor rgyun bcad de/ /dpal bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces dben par dga' ba'i gtam rngo+os glu ring mo 'di ni/ rje bla ma rnams kyi bka' 'bangs tha shal lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes ri spos ldan gyi spor thol byung du smra sa pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs skabs shig tu/bod nas byon pa'i dge bshes mang bo dang / chos sde yung he gung gi don ba/nyer ba rnams dang bcas/ skal ba dang ldan pa mang tsam zhig la byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i bshad lung rgyas pa bka' drin stsal pa'i mjug tu se mas bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa'ang mdzad/ 'di skabs dbyar dus phal cher ri bo spos ldan dang mtsho bdun ci rigs su bzhugs pas/ mtsho bdun gyi lha khang ser bor bzhugs skabs shig tu smon lam rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang ye shes bzang bo sogs don gnyer ba mang bo zhig la gsang 'dus 'grel ba bzhi smrags kyi bshad lung yongs su rdzogs pa'ang bka' drin stsa'// /gzhan yang snod ldan gyi gdul bya du ma la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ca 4nga ‘/nga stsol pa mdzad snang na'ang / sa bon ma byung bas re re nas brjod par ma nus so/ /

gdan sa chen po danon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 307rje nyid kyi phyag g.yog pa rgya'i btsun pa zhig rtag par chang la dga' zhing / nad kyis yun ring du mnar te 'chi khar grong gseb tu phyin nas der shi bas/ thams cad kyis kho'i rnam par shes pa ngan so nga du 'gro ba thag dī shā da ces gleng/ rje nyid nas de la dgongs pa'i thus/sa dam spyan dmigs sogs mdzad par nub cig mnal lam du me tog gi tshal yi dadu 'ong ba zhig na me tog brtsegs capa'i khang bzang zhig gi nang du rgya btsun de skyid skyid lta bur 'khod pa la/ gzhan zhig gis 'a di lha'i nga/nas mi tsha/ rgya btsun 'di dkon mchog la dad pa mchog tu brtan pa dang shi nas nyi da kyis sgrib sbyong mdzad pa'i mthus 'dir skyesi pa yin zer/ zhal nas nge—) rang na phra mo'i dus su rmi lam du dmyal ba'i tranas 'gre/'a zhig tu ltad cho/ dī ba'i rnam pas 'gro ba yang yang rmis pa zhig yod/ gzhan gyi yar 'dra'o/ du rlom pa 'ga' zhig dang / che mtho bzang por byed pa 'ga' zhig kyad der pre+obs nas sdug bsngal gyis mnar gyin 'dug ste ming nas smos mi rung ba ( 8duganub cig dmyal khams zhig tu bltar phyin pas rgyal sras bcu bdun pa dang / /ba hwang thas tsi gnyis der 'dug pa la/ dmyal srung lta bu zhig gis rgyal sras bcu bdun pa 'di sngon gyi las 'phro cung zad kyi dbang gis 'dir reb tsam 'ongs pa yin kyang kho bsam pa bzang zhing dkon mchog la dad pa dang lha'i rnal 'byor nyams len la 'bad pa'i mthus mi ring bar 'di las thar bar 'gyur la da lta yang sdug bsngal mtshon tsam las med/gcig she/sa 'di bsam pa ngan pa dang 'chi khar khong khro ci+o bas che ba dang bucas shi ba yin pas re zhig thar pa med cing sdug bsngal kyang shin tu snyi ba

308 gdan sa jin tha dgon lung du zibs te na 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshul/yod ces zer ba zhig mis byung zhes gsungs pa dngos su thos/ nub cig mnal lam du/ hwa shang gzi brjid can zhig khri mthon po zhig gi khar bsnad nas rnga yab g.yob cing phal po che'i bshad pa byed kyi 'dug pa zhig thugs mis su byung / phyi nyin bla ma 'ga' zhig sku drung du yong ba la mnal lam de lta bu byung tshul gsung 'phros gnang gi yod skabs/ gzim khang sgor hwa shang zhig byung nas mjal kha zhu zer/ sku mdun du btang bas lus dbyibs dang skad kyi gdangs sogs mtshan lam du byung ba ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pas khyed rang gang nas 'ong / 'dir dgos pa ci don du gnyer ba yin zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar/ /nged rang lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang thag ’ ba'i sa cha zhig nas rgyal khab 'dir nged kyi slob dpon zhig yod pa mya ngan las 'das par gdung mjal byed du 'ong ba yin zer/ mdo phal bo che 'chad e shes dris par shes zer/ /'o na 'chad pa mdzod gsungs pas/'chad dgos na khri mthon po sta gon gyis/ khyed rnams khri mthon por rmobazhugs pa la nged rang ltan dma' bar bsgrud nas bshad na chos la ma gus par 'gro zer/ der khri mtho ba zhig bshams/ rnga yab cig dgos zer ba bzhin gtad pas/ khri'i khar bldad nas rnga yab g.yob bzhin gzhon nu nor bzang gis dge slong lha chen po las chos kyi rnam grangs thob pa las brtsams te bshad pa mi ring tsam gyed pa spobs pa bzang zhing bshad pa yang zab pa zhig 'dug pa la/ rgyal ba'i sku brnyan zhig dang snam bu legs pa zhig gnang bar snam bu la mig blta ba tsam yang mi byed cing / sku brnyan bīr rgyu phu r+bhang du bcug nas thon song / de nas bzung gar so nga cha

nadan sa chon dza da5na lung du baibs rte ltan 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshul/ 30nyamed du gyur 'dug pa sprul pa'i gang zag zhig yin par nges so yang bar skabs zhig sangs rgyas zla 'od rjes su dran pa'i gzungs ljags bzlas mang du mdzad pas/ mnal lam du nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu che ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba zhig 'dug pa'i nang nas hwa shang zhig gis rgya'i skad kyis ci lang phu sa bkang dri ti'i zhin/ zhes bod skad du bsgyur na byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od snying rjes kun tu khyab pa zhes bya ba skad mthon pos yang yang zer bzhin zla ba'i dkyil nas thon te dal gyis/ nam mkha' nas babs pa thag nyer slebs nas yal song jib zhig thugs rmis su byung gsungs/ gzungs 'di'i phan yon skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed par gsungs snang bas rje bla ma lta bu la byang chub kyi thugs brjed pa'i gnas skabs ga la mchis kyang thun mong gi snang ngor yang de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od kyis sku tshe thams cad du byang chub kyi sems brjed pa med par snying rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can yin bar snang ngo / /'di 'dra'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar can mang bo zhig zhal nas dngos su thos kyang 'ga' zhig da lta dran yul du mi snang zhing re gnyis tsam 'og tu so so'i thad kar 'byung ngo / /spyir skyes thob kyi rmi lam gsal ba'i rigs yod na'ang /'di de dang mi 'dra bar rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon por phebs nas rlung stobs kyis rmi lam 'dzin par mdzad pa yin 'dug pas na dmyal khams tsam du ma zad dag pa'i zhing khams du mar byon nas sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i zhal mjal ba dang / chos gsan pa sogs gsang ba'i gnas ngo

310 gdan sa min po dgon lung du 'ibs rte bstan 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshul/mtshar ba dpag tu med pa zhig kyang yod pa ri /don mi za yang / rje bla ma nyid bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin yon tan sped pa bad/tso bor mdzad pas dngos su zhal nas gsung ba ma thos so /'khrul ba'i bag chags rnyog pa dang bral ba'i/ /gang thugs zab yangs rin chen 'byung gnas ni/ /'od gas la nam mkha'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa la/ /dag snang rgyu skar gzugs brnyan ci yang shar/ /swā dag zhing du swā rung sems can rnams/ /༷sa la spyod pa'i sbus 'bras phra mo dang / —/sadas rgyas zhing du gangs rgyagi/ sras bcas kyi/ /dzi sheg rol pa dze+e shes rūn kyis shaṃzigs/ /garmegs kyang bden par snalnge zherno khyod la rme da/༷ /med bzhirno snang ba'i gajigs mo khyod kyis gzigs/ /gzigs pre'i nges doṅge ji bzhin 'gro la ston/ /ston mchog rmetshungs med khyoṭ+wāṃ la bdag skyabs mchi/ /snga mo ṣ+peg nas chormo sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling nas rje bla ma mdo smad phyogs su gdan 'dren pa'i zhu 'phrin dang mi sna lan kha shas kyi bar du slebs kyang / gong ma chen po'i chos srid kyi las don mdzad rgyu rgya che zhing mang bas dgongs pa zhu ba'i bar skabs ma byung / 'brug gi lo rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i rigs dbon blo bzang dge legs ngo g.yog mi snar ched mngags kyi gdong bla spyi nas nan tan gyi sum̐ 'phrin phul bar da cha gong ma'i las don gyi gseng bar cung zad dod pa'i skabs yin pas thabs/ mkhas kyis dgongs pa zhu lugs bab ltos byas nas lo rjes ma tsam la mdo smad du phebs e thub lta ba yin zhes zhal bzhes mdzad cing ngang phyin pa rnams phyi slob /sa pa rga/ma/— ri / kho ba dgon

gidan michen podagon lung du 'ibs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 311 lung du slebs nas zhal bzhes bzang bo byung ba'i gnas tshul bsgrags shing /spyi sger gyi gsung shog rnams thams cad kyis mjal bas/ mdo smad kyi ljongs su 'khod pa'i bla dpon ser skya mchog dman thams cad ji ltar dbyar dus chu 'dzin gyi phang bar 'brug sgra bzhad pa tsan+dan gyi nags su gnas pa'i gtsug phud can dag gis thos pa dang mtshungs par rab tu dga' ba'i ca co yid kyi brtan pa nyams pa bzhin du sgrog cing / drang srong rig sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa bzhin du gtam 'di 'ba' zhig sgrogs pas dus 'da' bar byed do/ /byams gling 'dus sde'i gsol 'debs dbugs rlung gis/ /gang gi thugs rje'i shing bu bskul ba las/ /dgyes zhal phyogs pa'i zhal bzhes snyan po'i dbyangs/ /mdo smad skye rgu'i rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ /de tshe nags kyi mdongs mtha' can/ /chu 'dzin glal ba'i sgra thos bzhin/ /phyogs de'i skal bzang skye bo rnams/ /rab dga'i ca co sgrogs pas brel/ /de nas rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ mdo smad kyi ljongs 'di chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sku 'khrungs te byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can yin pa dang / bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa grangs las 'das pa sngar byon cing / da lta yang mja du bzhugs pa dang / rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i khrims ldan dge 'dun gyi sde tshogs pa'i chos sde che chung du ma zhig mchis shing / dad pa'i nor gyis rgyud phyugs pa'i skal ldan gyi skye bo'i tshogs kyang shin tu mang ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling nyid rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rtsa ba'i gdan sa yin pa — —

nga wa312 gdan sa chen po danon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/bcas mi ring bar phyogs der zhabs kyi pad+mo bskyod de bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phral dang spreyun du phan pa'i mdzad pa rgya chen po sgrub pa nyid skabs su babs shing don kyang shin tu che bar 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs te/ gong ma chen por rje nyid kyi yum gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs sgrub pa dang yab lo rgas pa dang mjal 'phrad kyi ched du rang yul phyogs su rib tsam phebs chog pa'i gnang ba zhus par dka' dka' zhig la mthar mdo smad du phebs nas zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs chog pa'i dgongs pa khrol/ de dus mdo snad kyi chos sde che chung thams cad la rgya dpon ngan pa rnams dang /de dag gi g.yog 'khor gyi las byed ma rungs pa du mas snyad gtser sna tshogs kyis mnar bar byed skabs yin pas phral du de la phan zhing / gong ma chen po'i bdag rkyen gyi lung gis zin pa'i gras su tshud na mtha' btsan par dgongs te/ gong ma dang dngos mjal gyi skabs shig sku 'bum/dgon lung / btsan po dgon bcas la rgya skad du tsi pen zhes grags pa'i bka'i glegs bu re bka' drin bskyang rgyu thabs mkhas kyis zhus par/ gong nas kyang de 'dra'i dgongs bzhed yod pa dang bcas dgyes bzhin du gnang chog pa'i bka' lung phebs/ de nas sa mo hūṃl gyi lo mdo smad du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar nye ba na/ gong nas lcang skya hu thog thu rang yul gyi dgon par phebs pa la phyag g.yog tu 'di nas mong gol cur gan gyi car gu chi gcig bcas kha shas gtong rgyu yin/ mdo smad kyi dgon chen gsum la bka'i lung gi pen gnang ba lan gru'u zhun phus bskyal te/ hu thog thu de khar 'byor pa dang bstun hu thog thus daspyon pa so so'i lha khang du

gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshul/ 313'jog pa gyis zhes pa'i bka' phebs/ de nas rje btsun bla ma rgyal khab chen po nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te rim gyis do lon nor dang cha har mkhar sngon brgyud or du su dang a lag sha'i sa char phebs lam bar du bla dpon mang bos bsu skyerme dang ston mo 'bul nod bgyis pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs 'bum phrag du ma la mjal kha phyag dbang dang / 'dod chos kyi rigs gang la gang 'dod stsal pa rnams sa bon ma byung bas 'bri bar ma spobs kyang mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel ba ci rigs pas skye bo'i tshogs grangs las 'das pa zhig smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa ni gor ma chag go /rgya sog gi sa mtshams zan yang khrang zer ba'i rgya sgo'i phyi rol tu dgon lung khri ba las thog pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyed tshal mkhan zur sum pa zhabs drung gis gtso ba'i dregs zhan brgya lhag gis phebs bsu gsol ston rgyas pa zhes pas thugs dgyes tshor shin tu che ba mdzad/ zung shan thang du sku'i gcung chu bzang sprul pa'i sku dang / de nas rim gyis stag lung zhabs drung dgon pa mchod gzhi dang bcas pa/'bri gung dgon/ zhwa dmar dgon/ yar lung dgon/ tas thung dgon/ser lung dgon pa rnams rang rang gi mchod gzhi dang bcas pas bsu ston/tas thung gi chu kha nas dgon lung khri zur bde rgu zhabs drung gis gtso ba'i dgon lung gi zhabs drung sku skyes dka' rag mang tsasmu dngaci / bkra shis chos gling / 'brug lung dgon/ ri khrod bsam gtan rtse/ mā yeng /rgyud pa sgang ba bcas stong shag gi bu dgon rnams kyis bsu ston phul/ bya khyung mkhan po/ snya 'bum/ btsan po dgon gye che phra du mas chibs bsu

314 gdan sa chen po da sgo /na lung du phebs te ba ltan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/zhus shīng / grung lang / rnam be'i/ zi ling mkhar rnams kyi rgya dpon che phra mang bo yang chibayobasur 'byor/ mir tshang ge thad kyi tsong chu chen po'i 'gram 'ing grong yi zer ba'i mkhar chung dang nye ba'i sa cha zhig tu/ kho bo cag dang / yab rgan gyis gtso ba'i dgon lung gi rta pa brgya phrag tsam dang bcas pas phebs bsu zhus par/ kho bo cag gang gi skye bar sgro btags pa'i dam pa de nyid rje nyid kyi yongs 'dzin du gyur pas gzigs ma thag chibs bshol ba sogs bkur bzos tshad med pa bka' drin bskyangs/bzhugs zhag gi sar gsol ston dang rta bzang bo sga 'khor bcas phul ba dgyes pas bzhes zhing / kho bo rje nyid kyi g.yas zur du bzhugs khri'i steng du 'dug tu bcug ste thugs brtse bas gsung 'phros rgyun ring tsam mdzad/de dus bdag lo bcu gsum skabs yin pas na phra na'ang / rje bla ma'i zhal ras mjal tsam nas dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba byung bas sngon gyi las 'brel bzang bo yod nges snyam du sems so/ /gser gyi 'khor lo'i mtshan bzang ze 'bru can/ /phyag zung pad+ma byin rlabs ngad 'thul ba/ /de yis spyi bo'i tshal du dpal byin pa'i/ /bdag gi yan lag mchog 'di skal ba bzang / /mtshan dpe'i me tog rgyas pa'i dpag bsam shing / /mthong na mi oṃthun med pa'i sku'i snang bas/ /ya mtsho na byin pa'i 'dren byed zung 'di yang / /ring nas gces par bsrungs pa don bcas gyur/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag res kyang chos phung kun/ /rdzogs par 'doms pa'i ngo mtshar sa/sung snyan po/ /nyan pa'i rna ba 'di la legs snyes su/ /nor bu'i rna rgyan btags kyad

gdan sa chen po dgon lung du pebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ — 315drin bzo chung / /skye mched dbang bo'i me tog bzhad ldan pa'i/ /'byung bzhi'i lus kyi rdzing bu ma rnyog cing / /rnam shes ngang mo gzhan du ma 'phur ba/ /de ring kho nar don dang ldan par gyur/ /sang nyin zi ling du phebs shing / gong ma'i bkas tsi pen skyeli par mngags pa'i lan gru'u zhun phu yang 'byor/ kho bas gong nas rje bla ma nyid la gsol ras su gnang ba'i bzang ja sbag stong phrag cig dang kha btags stong bcas phul ba bzhes/ god ma'i blon chen am paṇa ban+des bsu ston gzab rgyas dang /de mtshungs zi ling gi dpon po thams cad kyis ston mo sogs gzab rgyas phul/ gong ma chen por rang yul du bde bar phebs pa'i gnas tshul dang gsol ras la phyag btsal ba'i zhu yig rta zam brgyud nas phul te zi ling nas chibs bskyo da mdzad/ de nas ji skad du bka' gdams glegs bam las/ lung ba'i dbyibs ni rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /de yi gzhung la 'jug ngogs yod/ /rgyal mtshan gyen la bteg pa 'dra/ /tog la rin chen 'bar ba yod/ /bkra shis sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rtags/ /mdun ri glang chen sga steng na/ /dung kha gyen la bslang ba yod/ /snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab pa'i rtags/ /de yi 'dabs na chu bo yod/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i rtags/ /rgyal mtshan stod la chos grwa 'ong / /zhes dgon pa'i gnas dang / chos rgyal dharma kiti yis/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin par byed/ /ces bstan 'dzin gyi gang zag rnams gsal bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ rgyal dbang bzhi ba yon tan rgya mtshos 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyal ba'i sras po don yod chos kyi rgyu

da 316 gdan sa chen po dgon luja du phebs te bstan 'gro'idon mdzad tshul/ wa mtsho ched gtad kyi rdzong ta mdzad nas phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i chos sde chen po/ mdo smad kyi ljongs 'di'i 'chad nyan kyi da no na pa thams cad kyi thog mar gyur cing mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du ma da lta'i bar du zam ma chad par byon pa/ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dgon klungs byams pa gling du phebs pa'i lam bar du chos sde chen po mchod gzhi dang bcas pas skya bsu rim pa mang bo thab bsu lnga tsam zhus shing / kho bo cag sku skye dka' ram bcas ser skya rta pa sum brgya tsam gyis gdong yon thang zer ba nas chibs bsu skyar ma zhus/ dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su chosdo sde chen po'i dge 'dun byings dang / nye 'khor gyi ri khrod so so'i dge 'dun rnams dang bcas khyon rnam sbyar dang bla gos gyon pa nyis stong lnga brgya tsam gyi ser 'phreng tshar du dngar ba'i mgo mjug bar rnams su gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan spos phor sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa dang / 'bud dkrol gyi rol mo'i bye brag du ma bkod pa mdzes par byas shing 'du khang dang gtsug lag khang rnams kyi ba gam gyi yang thog rnams su mchod rdzas du ma dang rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa 'bud dkrol dang / mdun rgyab kyi ri'i rtse mo rnams su bsangs kyi dud sprin zhim po 'thul zhing / dung dkar 'bud pa sogs yid du 'ong zhing rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod bshams rmad du byung bas phyogs mtshams khyab par byas/ bstanachu srung rdo rje dregs ldan mi'i khog tu brlams pa ru 'dren gyi 'khor dang bcas pas ser 'phreng gi mtha' nas gar 'chams dang bcas lha dar srid du ring ba phul zhing ri legs so'i lung phul/ skye bo'i khrom rdi/na tu che bas gzhi smug ge byed pas

gidan sa chin tha dgon lung du 'ibs rte bstan 'gromi don mdzed tshul/ 311phyag 'tshal ba dang gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'ur 'ur 'don pa dang bcas/ ji ltar sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ma snya ta bzang mo'i mchod pa'i yul du rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas byon pa dang rjes su mthun par/ rje bla ma bstan 'gro'i mgon po nyid sku gser gyi ri bo bzhin gzi mdangs lham me dgyes zhal zla ba rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du 'dzum 'od 'phro ba dang bcas dal gyis phebs te thog mar chos sde chen po'i 'du khang steng gi rab gsal du gdan drangs/ dgon pa spyi nas dkar spro rgyas pa zhus shing /rje bla ma nyid thugs nyams shin tu spro ba dang / gzhir bzhugs kyi bla slob rnams dad gus dang dga' spro 'gran pas nyams dga' zhing bag phebs la gyin che ba dang bcas gsung gleng 'phel ba byung / de nas sku gong ma na rim gyi bzhugs gnas lcang skya bla brang du phebs/ dge mtshan 'bar ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por mi 'jigs seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod/ bla brang nas gzhis byes tshang mar dkar spro'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus so//rgyalka ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rje/ /bya3sa pa byams pas 'gro kun 'drerno pa de'i/༷ /chos mchog chos kyi dga' ston 'gyedz+wa pa'i gnas//da3'a ldan dashā' tshal gnyis rmi byams r+ghaṃng zhes/ /dge mtshan chu bo 'bum phrag 'khyitrī ba'i mtsho/ /mkhas grub gdengs can du ma rol pa'i gnas/ /legs bshad rin chen 'dod rgus gang ba'i gter/ /chos srid rlabs phreng ci yang 'phyur ba der/ /ji ltar dgra bcom bye ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor thub pa'i dbang bo ljongs su gshegs pa'am/ /bgrwang

da 31skye gedanasachin7brgo3lungadusgribasañjasdibastana'agro'i don mdzod tshul/yas rgyu skar dang bcas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ston gnam dag pa'i ngogs su rgyu ba nga zhin/ /skakhapre bzang lha mi'i zhabs 'brang stong phrag dang bcas 'jig rten gsumagyi mgon po zla med 'di/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin 'bar bzhin skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing du lham mer byon par gyur/ /de tshe ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun tshogs/ /mi pham 'khor gyi 'dus pa dang po bzhin/ khyod mdun tshar du dngar bas nor 'dzin ma/ /li khri'i stod g.yog gsar ba gyon pa bzhin/ /zhal bzang blta la rings pa'i skal ldan mang / /kun nas 'dus te gcig tu tshogs pa yis/ /lcid kyis gser lngan rgya mtshor nub dogs pas/ /khyab 'jug rus sbal gzugs kyis 'degs pa bzhin/ /dge legs bdud rtsis myos pa'i lha rnams kyis//sprin gyi gseb nas me tog char 'bebs shing / /rlung gi rgyal mtshan bteg pas mgon khyod la/ /mchod cing skye rgu'i mig la ya mtshan bskrun//byamadze+e pa gling du byams mgon gnyis pa byon/ /daske ba'i yul 'di dasge les/rnyi nor bus baṅkang / /byār 'dod skyes bus tharngo pa'i sa mkhan rnyeshe//'asrig —rten skye 'gro 'jig rten mgon dang 'phrad// sde nas gong ma'i brko' bzhin lan gru'u zhun phu yang slebs/ tshes grangs bzang ba zhig gi nyin bka'i lung gi tsi pen 'du khang chen mo'i rgya mthongs phug mthongs mtshams su bkod cing / gong nas gtsug lag khang gi rten gyi gtso bor 'bul rgyu'i rin po che'i 'phreng ba khyad 'phags zhig gnang ba yang 'bul bar mdzad/ rje bla ma nyid dbus dang / bkas mngags pa'i car gu chi dang zhun phu gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'khod cing / kho bo

gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 319cag gis gtso ba'i bla ma rnams kyis gong ma'i gsol ras la phyag dgu phrug btsal ba rgya'i lugs srol bzhin byas/ de phral zi ling gi dpon po rnams nas rje bla ma/ dpon po gnyis/ nged cag bla ma dang bcas par rgya'i lugs kyi ston mo dang / dgon lung spyi nas kyang de mthun gyi dga' ston rgyas pa byas shing / dpon po rnams nas 'du khang gi mdun du khrang zhi'i zer ba'i zlos/ gar gyi gzigs mo yang phul/ / zhun phu 'di ba tsong du las 'og tu go sa mtho ba zhig yin 'dug pas thog mar rje bla ma mchog la'ang 'gran zla lta bu'i rlom pa byed pa la/ bkas mngags pa'i car go chis lugs srol dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa bsgrags pas dpa' 49ba se che 'egying dor nas rje bla mar gsol ston rgyas pa nyin gsum gyi ring zlos gar gyi gzigs mo/ nyer dpyad khyad mtshar mang bo bcas phul/ gza' tshes bzang bo'i nyin rje bla ma mchog 'du khang chen mor dge 'dun gyi tshogs dbur gdan drangs/ bla ma las thog pa/ spyi pa/ phyag mdzod/ bla brang che khag rnams dang bcas thun mong nas sku gsung thugs rten/ maṇ+ḍal na bza' nyer spyad/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ spos 'phrug gos dar/dngul/ dong tshe sogs rnam grangs stong dang brgyar longs pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas bstan 'gro yongs kyi spyi dpal du rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'i gsol 'debs snying thag pa nas zhus pas dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes shing tshogs pa yongs la phyag dbang bka' drin stsal/ rje bla ma mchog nas dge 'dun la mang 'gyed dang spyi 'jog tu rje bla ma'i gos sku shin tu che zhing spus gtsang ba/ gser

320 gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bsnan 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshul/ srang brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ri gling sogs 'bur du dod pa'i khyad mtshar can/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dngul gyi spar bu'i sdod dang bcas pa/ dngul dkar srang lnga brgya bcas 'jog pa gnang zhing / bla ma rnams dang las sne sogs la gnang sbyin kyang rgya che bstsal/ zhog ja'i skabs shig rje bla ma nyid blo bur du phebs nas rang nyid kyi phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sna tshogs kyi phyag tshwa re thams cad la dad rten du 'gyed par mdzad pa'i phyag tshwa 'ga' zhig gis mar me 'dzin pa'ang byung snang / nyin cig rno bcal chen mor phebs nas tshogs yongs la lam rim chos thun gcig tsam bka' drin stsal pa'i mjug thog tu phyogs nas byon pa'i dge —bshes 'ga' zhig la dam bca' 'jog tu 'jug pa gnang zhing / khri zur rgyal tig lha ram pa blo bzang don grub/ sku 'bum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab bstan 'dzin/ dgon lung nas dge bshes je tshange dka' bgabazang bo 'od zer/ gtsig shu dka' bcu blo bzang dge legs sogs dge bshes che ba rnams dang / phar phyin yan chad kyi rigs pa smra ba mang bos bgro gleng gtong ba yun ring gzigs rtog mdzad/ bgro gleng la gzhung gi dka'adze gnas 'bab tshan che zhing brgal brtag gi rigs pa rno zhing myur bas rje bla ma thugs shin tu dgyes par gyur/ kho bo de dus rang lo bcu gsum skabs yin pas na phra zhing chos grwar ma song bas bgro gleng ji 'dra byung ba —zhib tu ma shes kyang / dam bca' bas byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos nyi shu la rgya 'grel nyer gcig bgrangs pas ma 'grig pa dang / khyim bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan karka ṭa zer ba tsāgs yino zhis khas blangs pa sogs dran pa

dad sa chon po dgon lung du phebs rte bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 321'dug dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po mospu/ kya 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes rtog ge'i dbang bo'i grags pa can de nyid mjal bar phebs shing sku mdun du lan kha shas kyi ring chos kyi 'bel gtacashaṃ zhib mo mdzod/ lan cig dbu ma'i rigs pa phra ba zhig bka' 'dri gnang bar lan 'bul rgyu ma rnyed par dpa' zhum me gdong rdul chu phrom phrom byed pa kho bos kyang mthong /mdzes so sum cu rtsa gsum grong khyer du/ /nye dbang 'khor gyi dbus na brgya byin te/ /mdo smad byams pa gling gi chis sde na/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'khor dbus mgon 'di 'o/ /gling dang gling phran 'dab ma bcu gnyis kyis/ /ri dbang ze 'bru 'dzin pa de srid du/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i khri las mi g.yo ba'i/ /rten 'byung sgo 'phar brgya phrag dus gcig phye/ /dam pa legs bshad skyes kyis dgyes pa tsam/ /phal rnams rin chen gter gyis mgu ba min/ /de phyir blo gsal rnam dpyod pad tshal du/ /rtsod ngag rkang drug sgrog pa dgyes bzhin gsan/ /dgon lung gi 'du khang tshen mo rje bla ma nyid nas 'bug thebs phyag rdzas rgya che ba stsal te gsar 'bug snga ma nas byas zin kyang rab gnas rgyas pa ma 'grub 'dug pa/ 'di res bla spyi nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin rje bla ma nyid rab tu gnas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mdzad cing / chu bzang sprul sku/ sum pa mkhan chen/ kho bo cag khri zur rnams dang gsung chog pa dge 'dun nyi shu dang bcas pas rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs bzhin rgyas pa mdzad/ dgon pa spyi nas rab ston dang dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhud pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku

322 gdan sa chon spre dgon lung du 'ibs rte bstan 'gro'i rdon mdzad tshulo/rin po che mjal bar phebs/ zhal mjal tsam nas phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ khong gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi dmar khrid dang snar thang brgya rtsa'i lha tshogs kyi rjes gnang rnams bka' drin bstsal/ sprul sku rin po che nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus par dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes nas rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma gnang ste dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrub pas spong bdun 'khor dang bcas pa'i khrims kyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams par mdzad cing / mtshan gsar du gnang dgos tshul zhus par dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo zhes pa bstsal//gang gi thugs rje me shel dkyil 'khor las/ /rnam dag cho ga'i 'od bzang nyer spros pas/ /sras kyi thu bo'i thugs kyi skyed tshal du/ /spong bdun khrims kyi pad dkar bzhad mdzad nas/ /dkon mchog rin chen chos kyi gling bzhi la/ /'asdigs medu rnam dpyod 'as+t+waṃr los ༷dbyāng bsgyur ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyalaX por mnga' gsol don mthun mtshan/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i bka' lung khyod kyis bsgrags/ /mayi' la mayi' 'gro'i khrod na 'dab bzang dang / /sdu la ༷sa 'dzin dbus na lhun po bzhin/ji /snyid 'dir srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan khyod kyi drung / /rgyal sras rgyalda ba'i gdung shātshob 'di nyilda 'phags// ༷ dgon lung du bsnyen rdzogs risgrub bya brgya dang bdun cu don gcig dge tshul dang rab byung smyab mi dgu bcu go gsum la dge tshul slong gi sdom

/de ji/danasache/na po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i dan mdzad tshul/ bye33pa ngaka' drin stsal/ phebs lam dang dgon pa gzhan rnams su yang sdom pa zhu mkhan mang du byung 'dug kyang sa bon ma byung bas zhib tu ma nges so/ /nyin du ga sum pa mkhan po sku drung du phebs pa la khyod kyis lha ris 'briṅkashes sam rnga /sung bar/ khong gis snga mo na gzhon skabs ri mo dga' rab 'dri thub pas lha 'ga' zhig bris pa yin kyang / da cha lo mang bor ri mo ma bris pas lha 'bri ba rngo mi thog gam zhus par/ khyed kyis dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs can gyi nyin thang 'i/ga bris nas nged la 'bul dgos/ mdang nged kyi rmi lam du a tsa ra zhig 'ongs nas/ khyed kyis dka' gnas sgro 'dogs ma chod pa zhig yod pa ngas bshad kyi zer nas sdar dogs gnas zhig yod pa bkral nas bshad byung ba rmis gsung bas/ khong gis dgos pa de 'dra mchica/ na thang ka chung ngu zhig lag ris bgyis te 'bul zher+sā zhus pas thugs dgyes pa mdzad/ de nas bram gzugs nyin thang zhig phyag ris nga gyis te phul bas rje nyid nas rab gnas kyang de nyin mdzad de thugs dam rten gnang / kho bo cag gi bla brang du gdan drangs/ dbe tshul gyi sdom pa zhus pa bzhin bka' drin stsal/ dngos 'byor phran bu phul nas sum pa mkhan chen gyis gnas tshul rnams zhus pa'i phyir phebs la/ sprul pa'i sku'i skye ba gong ma de nyid nged rang gsang sngags kyi chos sgo la thog mar 'jug pa'i rdo rje slob dpon yin cing / lugs gnyis char nas bka' drin shin tu che ba yod gsung ba'i 'phro la rje bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho ba de nyid rjes su dran pas spyan chab bsil te bka' lan gyi 'phro gnang ma thub pas der tshos/sa pa thams cad kyang sems shin tu skyo bas myo/chi ma 'don pa la/

324 gdan sa chon po dgon lung du bas te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul /sum pa mkhan chen gyis bzhad mo slong ba'i nyams 'char 'ga' zhig zhus pas bshum 'phro gcod thub tsam byung ste bslab bya'i rim pa mang po zhig bka' stsal/ nged la sku gong ma'i thugs 'brel gyis shin tu thugs brtse ba zhig yod pa'i dbang gis nyin re bzhin sku drung du bsdad pas skabs zhig lag ris la zhib tu gzigs te khyod shes rab che ba 'dug kyang tshe ha cang ring bo e yong/ 'on kyang tshe sgrub sogs bgyis na dga' mo yong 'gro gsung / nyin cig 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po che dang nged gnyis la nang rten gdan drangs yod pa rnams dang khyad par du mnga' ris sprul skus rang gis zhal gzigs ltar phyag ris mdzad pa'i dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor mang can gyi thang ka zhib mjal bka' drin bskyangs shing / bris sku de mgor bzhag nas bka' bsgo gnyer gtad zil che ba zhig kyang mdzad/ yang nyin cig nged rang gcig pu sku mdun du yod skabs khyod la lo 'di nang du 'brum pa nges par yong ba 'dra bas sman 'a di tshags kyis gsung / rgya sman ril bu che ba spra tshil gyi g.yogs can kha shas gnang /de ma thag a cang ngas rdzun lab pa yin no/ /khyod rang phyi rol tu song nas nga la lcang skya rin po ches 'di lo 'brum pa 'ong gsung byung zhes sgrog nyen yod pas de 'dra'i gtam phyogs tsam yang ma smra zhis/ gsung / lo 'di'i rgun kha nged rang 'brum pas na nas thu mo yod skabs 'khrul snang la sngas mgor rje bla ma nyid bzhugs yod pa'i rnam pa byung bas phyi nyin nas bde ru song ba phyis 'byung gzigs pa'i lung bstan 'khrul ba med pa dang rje bla ma'i skyabs 'og nas srog rnyed pa bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis so//

gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 325sngon bsags tshul khrims bzo bos legs bskru na pa'i/ /mngon mtho'i 'tsho ba dngul dkar a dar sha/ /byi dor thabs kyis phral rkyen g.ya' bsal nas/ /gtan bde'i gzugs brnyan ltos zhes nyer gdams shing / /reg pa'i tshor ba bzod par ches dka' ba/ /mi bzad rims nad rdo rje tsher ma'i stobs/ /byin rlabs sreg za 'bar bas nyer bcom ste/ /thugs rje shi gsos bdud rtsis dman bdag bskyangs/ /gtan 'dun lag tu gtad pa'i chos kyi drin/ /lta zhog mi 'jigs skyabs kyi go bskon nas/ /dus kyi chad pa'i g.yul las lan mang du/ /rgyal ba'i bka' drin phung bo'ang gzhal las 'das/ / skabs shig dgon lung gi rgyab ri'i rtse'i nged kyi skye ba gong ma'i mchod rten bzhugs pa'i lha khang du byon/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod sna lnga'i snyan shal bcas 'bul ba gnang zhing yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa mdzad/ chos bzang ri khrod du phebs bzhed 'dug pas ri khrod pa rnams kyis gdan drangs/ nged kyi skye ba gong ma de nyid yun ring bzhugs pa'i khang chung zhig yod par bzhugs gnas bgyis/ khang chung 'dir rje bla ma de nyid kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed dang gnas brtan bcu drug sogs zhal gzigs pa yin 'dug ces sogs rnam thar mang bo zhig gsungs/ ri khrod pa rnamasi la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ljags lung dang skya ser mang bor mjal kha phyag dbang gnang / ri khrod pa rnams kyis 'bul nod gar 'byor phul zhing / rje bla mas mang 'gyed kyi gsol ras dang thub pa'i sku bod li che ba zhig rten skal du stsal/ skabs shig dgon lung gi lu na sbas yul dkar

326 gdan sa chen po dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/po ljongs kyi sgrub sde byang chub gling zhes bya ba yod pa der byon/ rje godzā ma ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i bzhugs gnas su phebs shing / sku na phra mo'i dus rgya'i dus zir skabs skye snga ma'i phyag dpe 'bral spangs zhig yod pa brag gseb zhig tu sbas nas bzhag pa zhib 'tshol dang ri khrod pa rnams la rtsad gcod mdzad kyang ma rnyed pas thugs ngan gyi rnam pa'ang mdzad/ dus phyis nged kyis phyag dpe de ci yin zhus par/ nged kyi skye ba gong r+sha ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan pa dbus gtsang du gsan pa mthar phyin nas bal bod mtshams lta bu ngo mi shes pa'i gnas zhig tu byon nas tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i thugs 'dun gyis lam rim blo sbyong lta khrid kyi skor rnams pod gcig gsang bde 'jigs sa/sum gyi rim gnyis kyi skor rnams pod gcig nyer mkho sna tshogs kyi/ skorangapod gcig ste po ti gsum du bsdus nas yi ge shin tu phra mos rdzong dam pa phyag bris mdzad/ pod gsum po de bsnams nas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang / g.yer gshong sngags ram pa bcas dpon g.yog gsum spyobs zhor la zhwa lu dben sa sogs su da dung dzar ma thob pa'i chos rgyun gang rnyed gsan cing 'byon rtsis kyis drung pa rta phug pa'i sku drung du phebs pas/ drung pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed mdo sngapo/sa yongs rdzogs kyi dge b.lī bshes gnyen rnams rje bla ma'i bstan pa la bya ba byed rgyu bzhag nas mi med kyi lung par rang mgo ci thon byed na/ bstan pa'i bya ba sus byed rgyu yin/ de 'dra mdzad pa gtan nas mi 'thus gsung bka' nan mdzad pas sngar gyi thugs dgongs bshol ba yin 'dug phyis su dgon lung du bla ma rnam gsum zhal 'dzom skabs

gdan sa chen hūṃ dgon lung du phebs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 327 — rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas rang re'i de dus kyi dpe cha 'bum khu tshur phyag tu e yod ces glengs pa'i lo rgyus 'dug de'i khrod nas mdo phyogs kyi po ti nged rang rgya dmag la 'bros skabs khyer ma thub pas brag gseb zhig tu bcug pa yin de rnyed ma byung zhes gsung / ri khrod de'i phug na 'dan ma grub chen gyis gnas sgo phye ba'i brag phug bde mchog gi pho brang du grags pa zhig yod pa der ched gtad kyis phebs/ brag mug de shin tu ring zhing bgrod dka' ba zhig yin kyang nan tan gyis re zhig gi bar du byon nas rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa dang dpyid glu gdangs dang bcas gsung ba mdzad/ ridus phyis nged la bka' phebs pa/ gnas de nges par 'khor lo bde mchog gi gnas khyad par can zhig yin 'dug pas gnas 'brel 'jog pa gal che zhes gsungs/ ri khrod pa rnams la lam khrid chos thun zhig gsung zhing /khong tshos 'khos dpags kyis dngos 'bul dang / rje bla mas kyang mang 'gyed sogs stsal/ phyir phebs skabs lam bar du gnas gzhi dben cing sa bkra legs pa zhig gzigs nas der phebs/ gnas 'dir nged kyi gzims spyil zhig 'bug dgos pas ming la gsang sngags bde chen pho brang zhes 'dogs pa yin gsung / chu mi 'dug pa la gnas de'i thad ka'i srib ngos su chu mig skam shul zhig 'dug pa der rten 'brel zhig mdzad pas chu bzang po thon pa deng sang gi bar du yod/ dgon lung du phebs nas lcang skya bla brang gi mdzod pa la gnas der gzims khang gsar bskrun gyi ljags bkod mdzad pa bzhin mdzod pas khur blang bgyis te phyi lo gzims khang yongs dzogs grub po/ /

byu 328 gdan sa chen po dgon lung— du baibs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/'di na tsha bas gdungs pa'i gnyis 'thung dag /rab bsil pad+ma'i rdzing bu mthong ba bzhin/ /zhi la dgyes pa'i dam pa rnams kyi thugs/ /dben pa'i yon tan lcags kyus dbang med 'dren/ /de phyir tha mal snang zhen rgyang bsringaṭashaṃ pa'i/ /nang gi dben par dgyes dgur rol 'di yang //phyi rol 'du 'dzis dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin la mngon dgyes pas/ /dkar bo ljongs zhes grags rme sbas pa'i yul/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas/ /sngon rabs mkhas grub skyes chen du ma yis/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa der byon nas/ /sa 'dzin mthon po smu+og pa'i stod g.yogs dang / /nags kyi sham thabs me tog do shal can/ /rgyal bo gdan la bzhugs 'dra'i lha zhol gyi/ /ri sul mar gad myu gu bkram pa der/ /brtag bslang sbyang ba'i cho ga sdon 'gro bas/ /sgrub pa'i khang ba yid 'ong nyams dga' ba/ /gaXng sngagus brdu ba ༷chen po'i dga' ston la/ /ci bder rol pa'i phya bradwa bskrun par mdzad/ /dgon lung du chu bzang bla brang / sum pa bla brang / bde dgu bla brang rnams kyis so so'i nang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/ sum pa mkhan pos spyir dgon pa'i chos srid kyi las don thams cad phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa dang / khyad par du da res skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa phebs skabs bya bzhag gang ci'i 'gan khur grwa 'grig cing thugs zin pa byung bas/ er te ni paṇ+ḍi ta mkhan po zhes pa'i gzengs bstod kyi cho lo dang bka' shog brtse gzigs bka' drin bskyangs/ de nas sku 'bumyo/ dang btsan po dgon gnyis

gidan sa chin po dgon lung du d+dhabs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzardu tshul/ 329 su phebs nas7gong nas ga nang ba'i tsi pen so so'i gtsug lag khang du 'jog pa gnang zhing / so so'i tshogs dbur gdan drangs te brtan bzhugs dang chos bka' ci rigs kyi bka' drin zhus shing rje bla ma nyid nas kyang mang 'gyed sogs kyi gnang sbyin rgya cher stsal/ sku 'bum du mi nyag zhabs drung la rong bo grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho nas brgyud pa'i dge ldan phyag chen gyi khrid zhig kyang gsan pa mdzad/ gser khog tu btsan po no min han gyi sprul pa'i sku rab byung mdzad de mtshan la ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes pa stsal/ chu bzang dgon par phebs nas zhag shas bzhugs te gcung sprul sku rin po che dang / yab dar han no yon/ jo lags bsod nams sogs sku nye rnams la chos dang zang zing gi gnang skyes dang / de kari dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed spyi 'jog rgyas pa gnang / slar yang dgon lung du phebs/ de nas pe'i cing phyogs su chibs bskyod nye ba na/dge 'dun gyi rngi+ostis dbur gdan drangs te zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ spyi sger so so nas rang rang gi 'byor 'khos kyi phebs rdzongs kyi dngos po sna tshogs pa phul/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin dgon lung nas chibs bskyod mdzad/ kho bos tsha lam gyi bar du phebs skyel zhus nas phyir log skabs yid shin tu skyo bas 'dren byed nas mchi ma dbang med du shor bar thugs shin tu brtse bas mgo la phyag gis byil byil mdzad cing ma ngu zhig rang re myur du mjal lo gsung / lam zhor la chos sde chen po bya khyung du phebs/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i yongs 'dzin chos rje don grub rin chen gyi sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu snying bor bzhugs

bye30 gedan sa cun po da5na lung du 'ibs rte bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/pa'i mchod rten dang / rje bla mas 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i a ra pa tsa'i sgrub phug rnams mjal zhing / mchod pa rgyas pa dang / bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs nan tan du mdzad/ grubarkya mchog bde khang dpon slob blo bzang rab brtan sogs chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa du mas rje bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor blang / dge 'dun rnams la bka' chos dang mang 'gyed kyi gnang sbyin kyang mdzad cing / chos sde bla spyi thun mong dang so so nas bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzab rgyas phul/ phyir lam mar rtsang zer ba'i grong pa'i rgyab kyi brag phug tu bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sku gdung ril po ma nyams pa'i phyi rol tu sman 'dam gyis g.yogs pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gter chen la mchod 'bul thugs smon rgya chen po gnang / rim gyis snga ma'i phebs lam brgyud nas mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba mang bo'i rgyud la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa bzang bo rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las yol ba med par lhun grub tu spro bzhin rgyal khab chen po pe'i cing du bde bar phyag phebs so/ /'di dus rje bla ma dgung lo so gsum la phebs skabs yin cing / mdo khams su byon pa'i skor 'di rnams rang gi ji ltar nges pa bzhin sgro skur dang bral bar cung zad zhib tu brjod pa yin no/ / dge ldan ring lugs gsar 'od 'ba' zhig gis/ /'khyud pa'i mdo smad gaster ljongs zhes grags par/ /mgon 'di'i zhabs stegs gser gyi pad+ma mchog /nyer bkod phan bde gser gyi char ba phabs/ /

gideno sadamin pon+d+rargon lung du khribs te bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ 33’'asngom 'asngom zhal daspyil sbung ༷nga 'jal ba yi/ /maXng swāng skye rgus bza0nga babhang las 'brel bzhag /snyan snyan legs bshad lhang lhang thos pa yi/ /matres mkhaXs skyes bus byāb sdub 6sa sdon mthong / byu/babyu dngos/ bzhi yi swāng spyong sprin dkrigs te/ /gtong ba'i char ba stsog lhag phabs pa yis //dge 'dun rol mtsho sbying dh+wang 'khyil ba kun/ /dga' ba'i rlabs phreng rtal rtil g.yo bar gyur/ dbyangs nges pa a/ las dang skal bar ldan rnams la/ /yang dag lam bzang mtha' yas pa/ /gsal bar bstan nas thar mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gang / i /'di ni srid pa'i mig gcig nyid/ u /rgud mun drungs phyung dus kun tu/ e /dge legs ster byed bshes gnyen ste/ o /mchod 'os bstod 'os dkon mchog dngos/sgrog —pa'i zung ldan/ dz+rī btsun maXkhas pa maXs btsun dz+rī/ /sdib par swogs khyod gigs par sdib/ /maspyon med skyasdus mchog skyaXbs med mapyon// drun mchog rgal po rgyal mchog dran/ / zhes bye ba ni bar skabs skyo tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ gdan sa chen po dgon klungs byams pa gling du zhabs kyi/ pad+mo bskyod de mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i le'u — ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // —

/11//rdo/ste/rdo/kyi ma zhezhu zhadhu gasnyomā pu/ rgyulka pozhi khabu tu gtsug lkag khang nad du buzhengasu gija dge zhadun k+shi sde gaskan bu btsūgaspe pu dad / guska khyogs du nazhi rgud pu daskalka te dge natshan rgyaska pun nan-id puzhi tshulka/gong ma chen por mjal phrad mdzad par phebs pas gong ma rang nyid —gzims khang gi sgo'i phyi rol tu phebs te sdon la tshur kha btags gnang zhing mtshams 'dri'i bka' phebs pa sogs spyan bskyangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ de nas lo kha shas ring gi rnam par thar pa zhib cha ma nges kyang rags bsdus tsam ni/ skabs shig gong ma chen po'i bka' las/ nged cag man ju'i rgyud pa 'di la pog to han mug tun du bzhugs skabs nas bzung da lta'i bar du dam pa'i chos dar ba yod kyang rab byung byed pa'i srol ma byung 'dug pas/ da cha pho brang chen po'i nub kyi sdo zhol du gtsug lag khang bzhengs te der man ju gsar du rab byung byas pa 'ba'e zhig sdod pa'i grwa tshang zhig btsugs na ci 'dra yong zhes rje bla ma nyid la bka' 'dri phebs par/ rje bla mas/ gong ma pog to han gyi dus nas dge ldagapa dang yon mchod du gyur cing / mug tun du dge 'dun gyi sde dang gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / de rjes rgyal khab chen po 'dir phebs nas kyang yab mes gong ma rnams dang / khyad par du bdag po chen po nyid nas bstan pa 'ba' zhig thugs la dgongs nas gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung —

ge wargyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 333 0thugasu kyi rten bzhengs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa sogs gang ci nas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad cing / da cha sngar ma byung ba'i srol 'di lta bu btod nas chos sde 'dzugs bzhed pa mobastan pa rin po che'i gsos su che ba'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba yin 'dug pas bka' drin mchog tu che zhes zhu ba mdzad pas gyigong ma thugs shin tu dgyes/ de nas bka' bzhin du mdzod nas gtsug lag spa/ nga chen po grwa gshag dang bcas pa chos sde dga' ldan byin chab/sa gling dang cha 'dra ba gsar bskrun mdzad/ rje bla ma mchog nas rab gnas rgyas pa dang / man ju gsar du rab byung byed pa rnams kyi mkhan po mjad nas dge bsnyen dang bar ma'i chu' khrims phog gong ma'i bkas chos sde der tshogs 'don thams cad man ju'i skad kyis 'don dgos pas 'don pa'i skor rnams— man ju'i ska/da du bsgyur ba mjod phebs pa bzhin/ rje bla ma mchog nas rjo cho ga dang cho sa spyod kyi rigs rnam grangs mang bo zhig bsgyur zhing man ju'i skad kyis chos 'don pa la bod kyi dbyangs rta mi 'grig pas gsar du rta dbyangs 'dur ma rnams kyang bzo ba mdzad //rgyal khab chu shel ra ba dkar po'i nang / /dāga' san lug/sa bzang gser gyi mdangs 'dzin cing / /mchog gsum sdin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i bcud chags pa'i/ /'dus sde gur ku/ ma me tog tshal chen bzhad/ /de las mched pa'i rang 'a—dra gnyis pa zhi—ga /nub phyogs dge ba'i gnas su chags pa la/ /man ju'u skad kyis chos dbyangs snya/na sgrogs pa'i/ /rab byung pang 'bung du ma dga' bas rtsen/ /e ma mgon 'di'i 'asprun

334 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi'adunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ wadagelas nyi 'od dang / /mi rje'i bsod nams rlan gsher tshogs pa las/ /dge 'dun sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan phyogs kun tu/ /brtas pa'i dge legs phung bo'i klong 'de rmad/ /rje nyid kyi slob ma lots+tsha ba ngag dbang chos dpal sku yon bzang zhing chos pasgyur ba sogs— la phyag g.yog thugs phan thogs pa bro nad kyis gzir bar zhal gdams 'di mdzad de/ /tsā snyi sir+ghaṃ//rmad byung ge sa —nga mngon bzhad 'dab brgya'i steng / /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyilan rab mdzes sku/ /nyi gzhon bye ba'i 'od kyi dra ba can/ /tshe mtha' yas pas khyod la dge legs stsol/ /mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /shin tu zhi ba'i spyod lam ni/ /ma smad brtan pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /blo ldan khyod la gtam 'di gleng / /phan par dngo/ngas pa'i thugs rje mthar phyin pas/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'dren pa mchog gyur pa/ /drang srong chen po thub pa'i dbang bo yis/ /rang cag rnams la rjes su bstan pa yi/ /gsung rab kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /phra rags bden bzhi'i blang dor ni/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mang zhig las/ /sdon chad khyod kyi thosalags mod/ /de phyir ji ltar thos pa'i don rnams la/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i rigs pas yang dang yang / /nyams su len pa'i rim pa de dang der/ ri /khyod kyis lhag par brtun te bsgrub par mdzad/ /khyad par theg chen lam gyi srog /nyes brgya'i gcong nad 'byin pa'i snan/ /bdag pas gzhan gces rin chen sems/ /goms par bgyid pa gnad du che/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa ma lus pa/ /sems kyi rdo rje gcig pu'i rnam 'gyur te/ /khyab bya khyab byed rang bzhin gcig tu 'dres/ /

la dzi'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs tshul/ 33 byegazung du med snying bden pa'i rang bzhin med/ /rtag pa ma yin bdag tu med/ /bde dang gtsang ba nyid kyang med/ /'on te de ni der shes na/ /gtsang bde rtag bdag dam pa 'thob/ /ji ltar 'o ma la ni mar bzhin du/ /'gro 'di'i khams su nye bar gnas gyur kyang / /lus dang sems kyi gnad la bsnun pa yi/ /man ngag mi shes gang de 'khor bar 'phyan/ /gzhi rgyud sems kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /lam rgyud thabs kyis bskyangs pa las/ /mi 'phrog 'bras bu'i rgyud 'byung ste/ /skal ngan dag la ci cha yod/ /kho bo mkhas grub rim brgyud rigs su skyes/ /gdams pa'i gnad la thos bsam ngal ba bsten/ /rdo rje'i tshig don bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ /'dir ni khyod la phyogs tsam brda' yis bstan//'on kyang sdon las 'dres ma yis/ /nyams myong nang nas ma skyes pas/ /go yul bshad chos tsam zhig tu/ /gdams pa zab mo lus 'di phangs//blo ldan khyod ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab la/ /rtag dang gus par sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /da dung thos bsam sgom par 'bungs shig dang / /re ba'i 'bras bu 'grub par gdon mi za/ /dran dbang khyod da lta khams ma snyoms pa thos pas blo ma bde ba zhig byung mod kyang lha dang bla mar gsol 'debs gnad du khel ba mdzad na rim gyis dwangs par 'gyur ba lags pas slad nas mi 'gyang bar rang re lhan du 'dzoms shing 'bel ba'i gtam bgyid par spro lags/ zhes pa'i yi ge rten dang bcas pa 'di sdom brtson mang du thos pa'i dge slong lo ts+tsha ba ngag dbang chos dpal la mdo rgyud man ngag 'dzin pa'i rigs pa smra ba lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes rgyal khab chen po

— ci ram̐ 3 6 rgyalapo'ikhabatugatsugalag/sangadan+d+ra—dge'adunagyi sdi btsasdos tsalo /na/sa springs/ zhes pa'o/ /yang u rad zhabs dru nga bskal bzang bstan 'dzin gyi/sa rgyal ciba'i gsung rab la thos bsam byed tshul gyi bslab bya zhig zhus pa la 'di gnang ste//na mo gu ru mañju sgo ṣa ya/ dge legs snying du sdug pa'i rin chen sems kyi nor bus ci yang gtams/ /ma smad yid 'ong spyod pa'i rlabs 'phreng 'dzum pa'i tshogs gnyis chu gter las/ /nyer 'ongs kun rtog sprin bral kun bzang lhun grub 'phrin las snang 'bum 'gyed/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang mtshon pa'i mig gcig thub dbang smra ba'i nyi mar 'dud/ /rmongs pa'i dug chus myos pa'i yid kyi glang smyon khyu/ /mi bzad gol ba'i lam du yang yang 'phyan pa las/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa'i lam du 'dren byed pa'i/ /thabs kyi mchog gyur kyo ba rnon po 'dir bshad bya/ /thog med srid par lan brgyar 'phyan pa las/ /stes kyis thob pa'i dal 'byor yid bzhin nor/ /chos bzhin bsgrubs pas don ldan byed pa la/ /snying nas dga' rnams dam pas rangs pa'i gnas/ /lto ba dze+egengs dang gnas mal bde ba tsam/ /snying bor rlom nas ngal brgyas bsgrub pa dag/rten bzang thob kyang blar dor la rmongs pa'i/ /phyugs kyi ngang tshul nyid la gzhol bar zad/ /de phyir bdag nyid legs su 'dod pa rnams/ /nges pa kho nar gtan du bde ba'i thabs/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul zab mo la/ /'jug pa'i gtan gyi 'dun ma ma nor gces/ /'di na 'phral gyi 'tsho ba'i thabs tsam kyang / /gang la re ba'i yul la brtag dgos na/ /gtan bde'i lam du 'khrid pa'i skyabs 'cha' ba'i /

rgyal po'i khab tu gtsuspu lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugasatswal/ 337bshes gnyen bzang bo brtags pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /gang la bshes su bzung ba de nyid la/ /lus dang longs spyod sgrub pa'i mchod pa yis/ /mnyes pa kho na byede la 'bad pa ni/ /bde legs rtsa bar mdo rgyud kun las bsngags/ /blang dang 'dor ba tshu/la bzhin bsgrub pa la/ /ji ltar bsgrub tshu la ji bzhin shes dgos shing / /de la de ston rnam bzhag thos dgos mes/ /rgya chen gzhung la thos pa 'tshol ba gces/ /rigs dang mi rigs rnam par 'byed pa la/ /yang dag rigs tshur+ṣa4 ji bzhin shes dgos pas/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyi rigs lam ston pa'i gzhung / /kun la phyogs rer ma song sbyangs pa gces/ /rigs tshul phyogs re tsam gyis tshim pa dang / /g.yo thabs zol sbyor pha rol 'bebs pa yi/ /sbyor ba kho na slob dang mnyan pa ni/ /phung byed 'chad dang mnyan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /gang la slob pa'i gzhung lugs de nyid kyi/ /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam/ /bskyed dang goms dang grub pa'i 'bras bu'i tshul/ /ston tshul tshig spyi tsam du ma lus par/ /don gyi gnad 'gag so sor phyed pa yis/ /bsam dang bsgom pas lag tu len pa na/ /nam yang gol sar 'chor du med pa yi/ /thabs tshul ston dang mnyan pa dam pa'i tshul/ /snga phyi legs par 'brel ba'i mtshams spyor dang //gzhung gi go ba bskyed pa'i bsdus pa'i don/ /log bshad gol sa spangs pa'i brgal la na dang / /don 'bras ji ltar bsgrub bo dgos pa'i don//yan lag rgyas par bshad pa tshig gi don/ /'di lnga gzhung lugs 'chad pu'i thabs mchog sne/ /rgya gar kha spu can gyi lugs srol yin/ /deg

338 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug la ba/ khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ d+nghapar gzhung don shes la med mi runge / /gnad don bor ba'i sla sar rgyas bshad byed/ /gzhung tshig khol byung tsam la yang yang bzlos/ /tshig gi na yams tsam gyi 'brel ba dang / /'chad dang rtsod pa'i tshu la la bdag ma rangs/ /de phyir gzhung tshig nus pa 'don lugs dang / /de yis lam la nges pa bskyed pa'i tshul/ /gsal la 'dril ba'i go ba ster lugs la/ /snying bor bzung ba'i thos pa gnad du 'gro/ /sngon dus chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa yis/ /lus srog thed la bor ba'i dka' spyad kyis/ /btsal ba'i mdo sngags gzhung dang gdams pa'i tshogs / /phal cher nub cing 'ga' zhig nub la nye/ /'di lta'i ngang tshul mngon du gyur na yang //rgyun ja re tsam chad pa'i rtsiri shrī med par/ /chos kyis lto rgyab 'byid pa lhur len pas/ /thub bstan 'dzin pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad yin/ /de'i phyir thos pa 'tshol ba'i kun slong dang / /thos pa'i baṭasmum sbyor ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ /ma nor tshul bzhin nyams su legs bstar na//thos pa'i phan yon mtha' dag 'byung bar nges/ /gang zhig thub pa'igasung rab dgongs 'grel las/ /tshig gcig tsam yang lhag mar ma lus par/ /kun kyang dang po'i las can gang zag gcig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par 'khrid byed pa'i/ /lam gyi gtso bo yan lag ci rigs par/ /dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'du ba la/ /blo kha nang du phyogs te rigs pa yis/ /yang yang bsams te nges shes rnyed pre nga/nad/ /rin chen gling du chas pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs/ /ngal ba sel phyir ded dpon mkhas pa yis/ /lam du grong khyer yid 'ong sprul pa lhar/ /chung 'asding

morgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag kha dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 339theg pa gsungs par rgyal bas bshad/ k+toga'an don byed la dpa' ba'i sems dpa' yis/ /rigs can gsum gyi sman pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /mkhyen pa gsum byi rnam pa mtha' dag la/ /thos bsam sgom pas nges par slob dgos pa/ /rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /dgongs don snying bor mi pham mgon pos bshad/ /de'i phyer theg pa gsum gyi gsung rab kun/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du/ /de yang mdo dang de yi dgongs 'grel rnams/ /thad ka thad ka'i la.oṃ gyi nyams len du/ /blangs nas rang gi rgyud la sbyo ra shes na/ /mkhas pa mgu ba'i nyams su len tshul yin/ /gzhan du 'dzam gling rgyan gye gzhung lugs la/ /mi tshe hril gyis thos pa bsags gyur kyang / /nyams su len tshe grog po phug rdug tu/ /phyin ltar ma sbyangs gnas su phyir ldog pa'i/ /ngang tshul de yis blo gros ldan pa rnams/ /rangs pa 'thob pa'i gnas skabs ga la mchis/ /de yang thog mtha' bar gyi kun slong rnams/ /phyir lta kho nar song bas lan pa lags/ /sngon byon tshad ldan mkhas grub phal mo ches/ /gsung rab lta zhog bya sgrung tshun tshad kyang / /nyams len grogs su shar ba'i rnam thar gyis/ /go 'phang mthon po brnyes la gzhigs par mdzod/ /de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid bsgom dang nyams len gtso bo yin/ /thos bsam slo/ma gsum cig car 'byung bas na/ /tshegs med lam gyi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i skyes bu phal mo ches/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar gcig dril ma mdzad kyung / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad pa mdzad bzhin par/ /sa lam

da 340 rgyalapo'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ —rtogs pa phul byung brnyes la ltos/ /thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lamangagyi tshul/ /dri med rigs pas legs par nges pa rnams/ /ji ltar rigs par dpyad dang 'jog pa yis/ /yang yang goms par byed la sgom zhes zer/ /bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa ma rnyed par/ /ru sul stong bar dka' thub spyod pa yis/ /mi tshe bskyal kyang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba la/ /gnod pa rdul tsam 'byung ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /nges 'byung lta dang byang chub sems bral na/ /bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang ni bskyod dka' ba'i/ /ting 'dzin brtan po ji tsam yod gyur kyang / /lhag spyod ting 'dzin las ni 'phags mi nus/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa yi/ /khas blangs tshul khrims sngodag pa gzhir jibazung nas/ /ting 'dzin shes rab nyams su blang gyur na/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi ming 'thob lags/ /de dag gzhung lugs chen po mtha' dag la/ /ris su ma chad nyams len byed nus pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ /thos bsam sgom pa byed tshul mdo tsam ste/ /da dung zhib tu rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /blo bzang rgyal pa gnyis pa yab sras kyi/ /dri med gsung rab spyi dang khyad par du/ /lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag rnams la ltos/ /de ltar nyams len gnad du 'gro ba la/ /skyes thob shes rab che ba'i rlom sems dang / /dka' spyad khur du bzod pa'i sdug sra༅/ dang / /thos bsam ngal ba mang ba'i sdug yus tsam/ /kho nas sa chod ci yang mi 'byung bas/ /ma nor lam ston bshes la bsten pa dang / /chos mthun grogs bsten gzhung mang blta rtog byed/ /phyag skor maṇ+ḍal gzungs sngags bzlas

byung rgyalapo'ikhab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs tshul/ 34ṭ+wāṃbarjod sogs/ /lam gyi ma thun rkyen bsod nams tshogs gsog dang / /'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sgo du mar/ /snying nas 'bad pas brtson pa shin tu gces/ /khyad par lha dang bla ma dbyer med la/ /mos gus shugs drag blo sems gcig dril gyis/ /tshig tsam min par gsol ba legs btab na/ /ci byas lam du 'gro ba gdon mi za/ /gal te rang gi blo nus stobs chung zhing / /snyigs dus tshe ni phal cher yun thung bas//rnam mang gzhung la thos dang bsam pa yis/ /bdar sha gcod pa'i spros pas 'jigs gyur ni/ /tshang la ma nor gdams pa'i snying bo mchog /thun spe+ong thun mong min pa'i lam rim rnams/ /gsal la 'dril bar nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i snyan rgyud zab mo rnams//tshul bzhin ston pa'i mtshan ldan bshes gnyen las/ /ma nor legs mnos dben pa 'i ri sul du/ /chos brgyad sgros pa btsan thabs bcad nas su//sgrub pa lhur len byed pa snying gtam yin/ /bgrang yas bskal par gang ji/ mtshan tsam yang / /thos par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa la/ /thos bsam sbom pa'i sbyor ba ci nus kyis/ /bag chags 'thug po 'jog pa gnad du che/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen la/ /tshul bzhin slob pa'i rim pa 'di bshad pas/ /bdag gzhan ma lus skye ba thams cad du/ /rnam dag lam dang 'bral ba med gyur cib/ /ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ji ltar slob pa'i rim pa mdo tsam brjod pa gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying bo zhes bya ba 'di ni skyes pas thob pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing rgyal ba'i gsung rab la snying nas 'jug par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam ge

34lha rgyal 7'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs tshul/dge ba can u rad zhabs drung dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ chosdo smra ba lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lha btsun zhabs drung ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o/ /zhes so / /dus skabs snga phyi ma nges kyang skabs skabs su sku bcad rgya la bzhugs te gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang ye7 shes zhabs lugs gnyis/ snakyai rdor/ 'jigs byed bcu jugasum ma dang dpa' bo gcig pa/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ kun rigs rnam snang mngon byang / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ tshe dpag med lha dgu sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha mang bo'i zlasnyen chen so so/'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ khyad par du 'khor lo bde mchog gi ljags bsnyen lan mang bo mdzad cing lha dbang du byed pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang gnang / rdo rje 'phring ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs bsdus kyi lha gtso bo rnams kyi bsnyen pa rgyas pa rnams kyang gnang 'asprog zhal nas nged kyi dbang rjes gnang thob pa'i lha gang yin dzinesnye'o/ pa re ma byas pa merna ces dngos su gsungs pas ljags bsnyen gcig pu yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa yin 'dug /bder gshegs kun gyi spangs dang rtogs pa'i nor/ /yongs rdzogs thugs gsang dpal ber bsdus pa yi/ /rigasa'adus dkyil 'khor gtso bor mnga' brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis lha gzhan bsnyen cing sgrub ci dgos//'on kyang tha mal shes rgyud zhing sa sa /dngos grub gnyis kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i gegs/ /sdig ltung kha ba bzlas brjod nyi 'od kyis/ /sbya ngas pa gnad du che zhes spyon pa'i ched/ /gang thugs bde stong lha yi lam yangs

lapo'ekhab3 —gtsugalagakhangadang dan 'dunagyisdebatsug—satshul/ 343por/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin dkrigs pa/ /bzlas brjod dbyar rnga bzhad pas nyer bskul te/ /dngos grub gru char 'jo ba'i cho ga bstar/ /rta'i lo bod kyi dpon po tā la'i pā thur du grags pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi snying la lus med bdag po'i mthu zhugs pas tshul min gyi spyod pa sna tshogs pas bod 'bangs thams cad sdug la sbyar zhing / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun bla ma phur bu lcog pa chen po sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams la bsam sbyor ngan pas log sgrub mi bzad pa rtsom pa sogs/ byis pa gri khar rtse ba dang mtshungs pa'i bya spyod byung rgyal sna tshogs byed pa lha sar sdod pa'i gong ma'i am paṇa gnyis kyis khrims la sbyar/ de phral rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' lung bzhin bod 'bangs thams cad bde 'jags su bsdad na srid skyong gi dpon rgyud rgyun 'thud thub tsam yong shas che yang / blo bzang bkra shis/ dpal grong shag pa/ ldeng kha choru/ myori/dzad sogs 'dod lha'i bran du gyur pa 'gas rgyal ba'i dbang bo'i gsung ris su bor te 'khrugs long bslangs shing am paṇa gnyis kyi srog la rgol ba sogs thal cha ngan pa byung bar brten/ gong ma chen po thugs dgongs shin tu tshom pas rje bla ma nyid la bka' gnang ba/'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi bya spyod ngan pa de rnams gcig tu kho rang ngang tshul ngan pa las byung yang / gnyis su nged kyis bdag rkyen ches thal ba'i skyon yin 'dug pas/ deng phyin chad bod kyi mi la dbang spyin mi rung ba 'dus/rilha sar rgya mkhar chen po zhig brtsigs nas bod 'bangs kyi mgo shes pa 'i tsong du zhig dang / dmag dpon thes tu zhig dmag mi /phri phrag dang bcas

344 /de rgyasnaspro'ikhabatugatsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/pa bzhag dpya khral sdud pa dang khrims gcod pa'i dpom/ po to'u brka/na/gri phu/ gri zhan sogs bskos nas/ bod kyi bya ba che chung gang yod rgya dpon kho nas shes pa zhig byed dgos pa 'dug ces phebs/ der rje bla ma mchog gi thugs dgongs la bka' phebs de bzhin mdzad pa shar na bod gangs can gyi bstan srid thams cad lo tog sad kyis khyer ba lta bu 'byung nges pa thugs kyis ma bzod par/ spyir rgyal pos thag bcad nas bka' phebs pa rnams 'ani phral du gyen ldog zhu mi rung nga/ khrims kyi lugs srol yin na'ang / da res bshol 'debs kyi zhu ba phral du mi bgyid ka med 'dug snyam thugs stobs bskyed nas/ de ma thag zhabs pus kyi lhang nga sa la btsugs te/ gong ma bdag po chen po nyid yab mes gong ma rnams nas bstan pa rin po cher gus mchod lhur len par mdzad pa dang / khyad par bdag po chen po nyid bstan pa'i don 'ba' zhig thugs la dgongs pa'i chos rgyal chen po yin cing / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pas/ bka' phebs de bzhin mdzad na bod yul gyi bstan pa shin tu nyams dmas par 'gyur ba gdon mi za bas/ bstan pa rin po che thusas la btags pa zhig bka' drin bskyang ba cis kyang zhu zhes phur blasau ni tshugaso lta bu zhus par re zhig cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa'i 'phro la/ hu thog thus zhus pa de mad par 'dug pas rim gyis gang 'thad byed ces phebs/ mtshams der bod nas rgyal dbang srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan chen pos bod 'bangs bde 'jags kyi mdzad khyab gang drag gnang ba dang / gyigong ma chen por gnas tshul gyi zhu 'phrin thugs la 'thad pa rim pas phul ba rnams

/de rgyalapo'ikhab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs tshul/ 345 la7gong ma thugs dgyes pas/ mi ring bar rje bla ma nyid 7ngo/nga ma'i sku mdun du phebs par bka' las/ bod yul 'di bstan pa'i 'byung khu— —— / yin pa'i dbang gis 'di'i don skor la nged kyis gya tshom ma byas par bsam blo yang yang zhib tu bcang ste khyod la —gros dris pa yin/ nged kyi bsam pa la da cha bod kyi bstan srid thams cad kyi 'gan khur tā la'i bla mar gtad na zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dang chab srid chen por phan sleb che ba 'dra snyam pas de bzhin bgyis pas 'thus pa e 'dug ces phebs par/ rje bla ma mchog nas bka' drin shin tu che zhes zhus pas de ma thag gser gyi bka' lung khrom bsgrags su phabs te bod gangs can gyi chos srid mtha' dag gangs can gyi mgon po rang gi phyag tu gtad pas/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan srid zer ba'i sgra bo che de da dung ma nyams par gnas pa 'di bzhin no/ /'di skor rnams rje bla ma thugs ze po dang ldan pa nyid nas bdag rkapre dngos su gsung ba sgro skur med par bris/ pa yin cing / rje bla ma'i zharkar ji na sasmo/ 'di rnams nged kyis tshe 'di la ltos pa'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dga' mo bgyis pa'i lugs yin ces gsungs/ de dus rgyal po chen por rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis zhu ba de lta bu ma mdzad par bka' phebs snga ma de ga rang la cha bzhag byung song yod na/ bod 'bangs thams cad rgya dpon gdug pa can chos la mi dad cing za 'dod ltog sla me ltar 'bar ba rnams kyi khol bor gyur te/ gzhung sa'i yong 'babs dang 'bangs kyi dpya khral thams cad dmag mi dang dmag rta gso ba'i thebs 'ba' zhig tu song nas/ grwa sa chen po rnams kyi phog jatshu la dang / lha ldan smon lam

da wa346 rgyalapo'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugab tshu sdo/gyi mchod pas mtshon rnamyo/ dashi/ra dge rgyun thak+ka sa cad dung phyis pa bzhin du gyur/ rgyal ba yab sras kyis gtso ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnams la bkur sti dang sri zhu gzugs brnyan tsam du gyu/ra/ khrims lu gas thams cad rgya'i lus/sa srol bzhin bskyangs nas chos /m+bir+yā sa kyi rigs nems sprul gyi ma dud pa bzhin rang zhis/ tu song / phyogs tha dad nas 'du ba'i grwa rgyun dge rgyun thams cad ston mjug gi chu phran bzhin nyag je phrar gyur te deng sang gi dus su bod kyi ljongs de phung shul lta bur yid skyo ning mi thams cad sdug skad khyi'i 'gram pa chags pa bzhin 'don ba zhis/ yong rgyu la/ sku tshe du mar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyo nga spel bar mdzad pa'i smon lam gyi mthu yongs su grub pa'i skyes mchog dam pa 'asni gcig pu'i bka' drin las bod kyi bstan srid lhag med du ma gyur pa 'di banin byung ba blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis shes par gyis shig /dug gsum chang gis ches cher myo sa pa yi/ /sdig pa'i stobs ldan me dpon so gnyis pas/ /bod 'bangs bde spyid me tog bzhad pa'i tshal/ /brlang spyod gya tshom gom pas meg med brdzis/ /rkyen ngan mgyogs 'gro de yi shugs drag pos/ /dase/ legs 'dod rguri 'bras bu g.yur dud pa'i/ /gangs can chos srid dpag bsam ljo na pa che/ /skal ngan gshodo bur 'gyel la phyogs pa na/ /gang zhizla/ 'jig rten rtsod dus mtshan mo yis/ /rgud pa'i mun pa ji ltar gtibs de ngazhin/ /thabs mkhas mjed pa'i 'od snang cher spro ba/ /rgya9ri sras dpa' bo'i dang tshul nyid yi na phyir/ /rgyal dbang 'jig rten gasri treshrī gye ni nga byed

da wa rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dāgatram̐sunad+nghaste sde btsugs tshul/ 347mchog /mgon 'di'i thrugs bskyed skya rengs kyisdo bsu k+to/ te/ /bstan srid shar ri'i tog tu 'dzegs pa yis/ /rdzogs ldan snang ba slar yang gsal bar gyur/ /de tshe /d+ku ba can gyi ljo ngas/ /gza' las grol ba'i zla ba bzhin/ /dge mtshan 'od dkar rgyas pa la/ /ku/ na da'i tshogs kyang rgod pa bzhin/ /thub bstan rin chen sgron ma ni/ /mnal bar phyogs pa slar gso la pas/ /mtho ris lam du skye rgu rnams/ /chos kyi snang bas 'akro bar gyur/ /ne tso ltar ljang yid 'ong spang ljongs me tog bzhad pas ku na nas mdzes / /rlabs phreng g.yo ldan rol mtsho 'di yang chu bya'i phring bas mngon par sgeg /de bzhin phyogs kyi bu mo'i bzhin ras rgud pa'i dri ma dag pa la/ /khyod kyi 'phrin lasdo/ shin tu yid 'ong smug rtsi gsar ba'i thig les mdzes/ /lcags mo lug gi lo gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bor rje bla ma nyid kyi ljags tsospo grub mtha'i bstan bcos thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan spyan 'bebs zhu rgyu dang chabs cig par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 'i/nga zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'i zhu 'phrin snyan ngag gi lam las drangs pa'i tshig don ngo mtshar can zhig 'bul bar mdzad pa 'di bzhin no/ / dge legs rgya chen gser gyi rdul brtsegs rtsig ngos rnam mdzes rmad byung sdom gsum mda' yab brtan brjid dngar/ /gsal snyan chos sgra dril chung mtha' yas legs sgrogs phyogs bral mkhas mang rnamyo/ sad dam chos dga' ston la 'bod cing / 'gro 'di'i gdung sel snang 'bum rab spro rnam rgyul khang bzang dbus na tshogs gnyis sa bsrung bu skyeng rnam sgeg

348 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs dzul/pa/ /ye shes rtse brgyas/ sgrib gnyis dgra bcom kun mkhyen spyan stong rnalobakra sngon med lha dbang zhabs sen drung / /rtag par 'gram chang 'dzag pas rab myos chags ldan glang chen rang sems 'phrog byed gang der ji bzhin du/ /gang gi drin dran yid kyi brtan pa nyams pas gtol bral slar yang der ni 'bad pas rnam phyogs nas/ /gcam bu ma yin don 'brasdo/ n+tu ga pos phyug pa'i snyam 'jebs bstod bsngags yal ga khyon yangs/ a shwaṣ+pe/ /sprul 'dis thub rnarma sa sku yis ljon pa der bzhin khyod brtse'i 'od dmar bdag snying mkha' la mdzes par mdzod/ /rab 'bya dra/ṭa/ rgya mtsho'i rgyal rnams phra rab rdul gyi gzugs su rab 'thor brtsegs pa mi 'jigs bzhi yi bang rim ska rags bcings/ /mkhas grub gdengs can bye ba'i bsti gnas dge legs chu klung 'bum 'khyil go'u tam ring lugs chu gter dbus na mngon par 'phags/ /tshogs gnyis mes po bi shwa karmas lan brgyar brdar ba'i shel khams/ las bskrun mkhyen brtse'i rna cha phyogs kyi 'gram par g.yo/ /srid gsum cher snyigs rgud mun rmad byung mdzad bzang gzi yis drungs phyungs bshes gnyen lhun po'i dbang bo khyod las gzhan na gang / /gru 'dzin bdag dang mkhyen pa'i gter ni gang thugs nyid du brtse dang blo gros zol gyis gnas/ /mdzes dga' mo ni gang gi tshems dkar 'phreng ldan dbus na 'jam mnyen ro myong gzugs kyis 'khyug /chos phung kun kyang rang dbang bral bzhin khyod mgrin nyid las snyan 'jebs dbyangs su lhug lhug 'bab/ /rtse dga' der ni thub chesna drang srong nyid kyang rab chasprenas ngur smrig zol gyis khyod skur 'khyud/ /

la pomi khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi 'dunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ 349 wa de lta'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi rnga bo che/ /srid rtser bskrags pas yid dru bas bye ba brgya/ /mya ngan khang bur brgyal bas snying gas na/ /ci 'di dge zhes su zhig rton par byed/ /gal te rmad byung gtam 'di gzus/sa su grub pa nyid gyur na/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i lto bar chud min rab mdzes sdo bsangs ma'i/ /'gram pa'ang ral bar 'gyur zhes rnam sad ca co skre ga pas na/ /dgu tshigs srad bus kun gsal 'tshem la mes po rgan po da gdod brel/ /mtha' drug 'dab ma dam par zum pa yi/ /r+shad rgyal gnad don sigyi wa ra'i sgo/ /mkhas grub snang byed du mas ma phyed pa/ /khyod gsung 'gram chang zer gyis gsal bar phye/ /thub gsung mdo sngags dka' gnad legs 'byed pa'i/ /ku sha'i rtse ltar rab phra blo gros kun//khyod nyid gcig pus bdag gir mdzad pas na/ /deng dus mkhas par grags rnams blun pa'ang rigs/ /ye nas stong ba'i mdza' mor dam 'khyud pa'i/ /chags chen bde ba'i ro la rtag gzhol yang / /spong bdun rnam par dag pa'i snom sa/sum khrim sa/ /nam yang lhod pa med 'di e ma rmad//g.yengs med thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /ting 'dzin brtan por rtag tu rol mdzad kyang / /bden pas stong bzhin cir ya nga 'char bzod 'phrul/ /ma brtags dbang gzhu'i ri mor po/yengs 'di mtshar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse bas/ /kun la snyo mas pa'i byang sems phul byung yang / /nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i dgra sde ma lus pa'i//mgul ba cig char 'bregs pa'i dgra thabs mkhas/ /dbang bzhi'i sa bon rnam dag da6ri sdo kya / byi/ /drod gsher gyis bskyangs rim gnyis ljon

da 35skye da ram̐l po'i—dishu—tu gatshug lag khadz+wa dngo dge 'dun gyi sde btsunas tshul/pa che/ /sgo brgya'i ti nga 'dzin lo 'dab phyogs bcur g.yo/ /bde stong 'bras bus spa ba khyod las su/ /rgod ma'i me dang haṃ yig 'a/ma ri |sum 'bab//mi phyed mdza' bor 'khyud las lhan skyes kyi/ /sbrang rtsi'e bcud ldan sgyu lus 'dab brgya ba/ /rnam par bkra ba'i 'gal 'du'i phung bo'ang khyod//rdul med rdul du spungs pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ /rtog med chos kun rtog pa bde stong thugs/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i rol mo che mtha' med mtha' klas bskal par lhang nge gsal/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul rol ba yis/ /brtsen bzhin gang gi zhabs rdul cha shas la/ /cod paṇa ma chog tu bsten pa'i tha shal ba/ /bdag yid gtsug phud can gyi dga' ston du/ /tshangs dang dri za'i dbyangs kyang ca co yi/ /gnas su bgyid pa'i bka' 'phrim/ 'brus// yi/ sgra/ /gnang skyes glog 'a/ga rkyong bzhin bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /'di na dga' dad skyo gar ci yang bsgyur/ /las ngan 'dam rdzab rab 'a/khyilam̐ phra rgyas tsher mas gang / /'jig lta'i dra ko/ ris yongs bskor 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon la/ /lhag par chags pa bdag kyang khyod nyid 'ba' zhig mthus/ /lus sems gdungs pa med par khyod drin dran bzhin gnatrasmi / /mtshams zhus/ bgrang yas bska/la par 'gro 'di'i ched du bya dka'i rlabs chen khur bsnams pa'i/ /thugs bskyed mthu chen nus pa ji srid sngo bsangs na chung rdul phran du/ /bsil bar ma gyur de srid 'dor dang nyams nga 'i ngang tshul mngon pa ni/ /ji ltar lha lam dag las 'dab brgya'i tshal chen rgod pa bzhin du mdzod/ /rgyal kun jiḥyig zhun mar sbrum pa las/ /legs 'khrungs blo bzang grags bltan pad

—/de rgya'/ po'i khab tu gtsu / lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 351dkar tshal/ //pyod gsung rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i zer 'phreng gis/ /skal ldan rkang drug gnyen du cher bzhad mdzod/ /gang la gang 'tsham gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gar/ /cir yang ston mdzad sna tshogs rol pa las/ /bdag cag blor 'tsham rdo rje'i sku 'di nyid/ /bskal brgyar mi g.yo rdo rje'i khams su gsol/ /gus zhabs bdag cag ltos bcas ma lus pa/ /deng nas byang chub mchog la reg gi bar/ /mgon po khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /dus nams kun tu brtse bas rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /slad nas kun tu dge ba'i legs bshad zer gyi phreng ba rnam dgod pa'i/ /snyan 'jebs bka' mchin nor bu'i do shal gtan bde'i sim pa myong byed pa/ /lha ga par brtse ba'i phyag ring brkyangs te chad med stsol pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /bdag gi re 'bras don ldan mdzod cig rgyal ba'i dbang bo thugs rje can/ /zhes zhu yig 'degs rtsen mdzod gos skyer kha rgyan bzhi yug sing gos skyer kha rgyan bzhi yug mdzod gos snyug mdog 'brug tshang 'khor ma yug gos chen skyer kha 'brug tshang 'khor ma yug gnyis/ 'jam gos skyer kha yug lha rdzas che legs bcas zla tshes dge bar gus zhabs pas phul/ zhes pa'o/ /rgyal dbang mchog nas bka' lan rje bla ma mchog la don mthun gyi che brjod dang grub mtha'i bstan bcos chen por bsngas/sa pa mdzad cing 'khor ba'i ngang tshu la dang bod 'bangs kyi bde sdug dang bsam pa'i 'khyer so sogs gnas tshul 'ga' zhig las brtsams pa'i bka' lan dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud kyi nga ro la 'gran bzod pa stsal pa ni 'di lta ste11

352 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/bsod nams brgya ba'i zong las nyer bsgrubs sku/ /lang tsho yongs su smin pa'i dbang phyug ji/sa/ /chos kyi srid la mnga' mdzad thub dbang gi /rgyal tshab dam pa'i skyes mchog gang de la/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi dam bca' rdzogs pa'i dbyangs/ /srid par gtogs so cig gi rna ba ru/ /snyan zhing don ldan thams cad gzigs pa bo/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan mchog dbang gi rgyal/ /ma rtogs log rtog dri ma'i cha shas kun//legs par phyis pa'i rang 'od gsal ba can/ /thabs shes zung du sbyar pa'i sug pa na/ /thogs pas mchog ster klu yi dbang phyug khyod/ /zag bcas spros pa'i cha tsam ma dmigs pa'i/ /dag pa don dam ngang du gcig pa'i blos/ dze /kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo ji snyed pa/ /rnad+dha/ par bshis/sa pa'i ngang tshul de yi slad/ /chu nang zla ba'i ri mor yang dag tu//zhen bzhin byis blos nyer btags glo bur gyi/ /nyer 'tshe zhes bya kun tu rtog pa'i gdon/ /de 'dras glags lta'i go skabs ga la zhig /tha mal ngor yang gang sku nyi ma'i gzi/ /sgrib byed chu 'dzin phag tu zha min par//dam pa'i mdzad bzang nyis mun sel ba'i 'od/ /kun tu 'gyed ces gtam 'di yid kyi gsos/ /sa la mngon par rgyu ba'i dregs ldan kun/ /ral bas rmedud pa'i 'jam dbyangs mi yi lhas/ /'dren par bkur ba'i ut+pal dkar po'i phreng / /khyod las gzhan pa su yi rgyan du 'os/ /sdon byon mkhas grub kun gyi legs mdzad sgo/ /yongs la zhugs pa'i sprul ba bye ba brgya/ /bstan snyam skabs gsum dbang bo mig stong gis/ /mngon par dang bas phyogs der blta la brel/ /tshangs sras ma yi phang bar bsten

la po'i khadzo tu gtsuge lag khang dang dalha 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 353'os pa'i/ /yid 'thad snyan tshig 'gyur ba stolat+na gi rgyud/ /skyes bzang nor bu'i khog pa la brten pa/ /nyams med la ka tu son pas rab dga' thob/ /khyad par 'phags yul shing rta che rnams kyis/ /grub mtha'i bzhed srol purmā ri ka'i 'dab/ /ma 'dres so sor phye ba'i legs ngashad gsar/ /mthong ba tsam kyis blo gros bhang ba tshims/ /dpyod ldan yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /mdzad bzang rang gi gnas lugs 'di lta bu/ /mngon sum bstan tshe thub bltan ma lus pa/ /e ma da dung dam pa'i mgon dang bcas/ pa/'di na mchog gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /snying gi pad+mar babs pa'i nye rgyu dang / /gnam bskos lha yi bka' drin la brten nas/ /nyer 'tshes cha/ bslad zo mdog bde bar gnas/ /longs spyod 'bab chu'i rgyun bzhin myu/ra g.yo zhing / /khyim ni chu bos g.yengs pa'i gru rdzing bzhin/ /lus 'di dgun dang nye ba'i me tog dang / /tshe srog chu bur bzhin du 'jig sla zhes/ /las nyon chu bo chen pos rgyun phyogs su/ /khyer ba'i 'khor ba pa rnarma sa rang gi lugs//ston ma'o+o ga bden pa gsung ba'i bka' ji bzhin/ /kye ma 'jig rtem/ 'di na dngos su snang / /khyad par kha ba can yul 'gro ba rnamaji shrī/ /dar dang rgud pa'i rnam 'gyur skad cig ma/ /dbang bo'i gzhu dang chu yi lha ba dang / /glog gi gar stabs las kyang g.yo bar mthong phal cher dam pa'i chos lugs ring btang ste/ /mi bsrun brlang bor spyod pa'i gnas dus 'dir/ /bdag 'dras 'bad kyang gnad+dha/ stong smag rum nas/ /me khyer gzi 'od ngom pa tsam du zad/ /'on kyang thub bltan dri med
