354 rgyal bo'i khab tu gtsag lad khang dang dgi 'dun gyi btsugs tshulo/btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gnad don cung zad myo nga ba'i ro ris med 'gro la sman nga/'i bgo skal du/ /ster ba'i dmyoshrī ngaca 1 yid du 'grogs bzhin mchis/ /gnam bskos rje bo'i bkar btags nyi 'od dang / /mgon khyod chosakyi bdud rtsi'i bcud len gnyis/ /zung du 'brel na lus can bgrang yas kyi/ /bde skyid pad+mo mi bzhad go skabs ci/ /de phyir mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum/ /chad med phreng bar spel ba'i rin rgyan/ /ngo mtshar 'phyang 'phrul ci yang ston bzhin pas/ /dus ring mngon dga'i zlos gar rtsen par gsol/ /sems can /spe na'i don la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /dam bca' rdo rje'i snying bo ltar sra zhing / /bde stong ye shes nges pa don gyi lha'i/ /rnal 'byor khor mor sbyong ba'i brtul zhugs 'tshal/ /de ltar don dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gtam/ /gse ra sbyangs 'khor lo lta bur 'bar ba'i gzis/ /phyogs dus kun tu ngakra shis ster bzhin pa sa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i 'dun sa mdzes gyur ci ga /ces pa'o/ / 7gong ma chen po nas chab srid kyi srung ba tikro bur danongs te pho brang chen po'i rgyab kyi char lha khang sum thog gi nang du 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can dbu stong phyag stong gi sku brnyan shin tu che ba bzhengs par/rje bla ma mchog nas ljags bkod dang grub zin nas rab gnas/ dus chen la bla ma dge 'ardun mang bos mchod 'bul byed rgyu'i cho ga so gas mdzad/ de'i g.yas zur du mchod rten khang bu ngartsegs pa 4 ka dgu yod pa bzhengs pa'i thog brgyad pa grub mtshams su/ narngu sdo mkha' nas me+e lhung bas 'bar te yongs sdo gas zhig pa la de'i shul du tā zhi'i the 'o/ des nga spyo sa/ra lha

ge lhal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi btsugs tshum/— 3lhabyikhang bzhengs par rab ga nas so gas mdzad/ nyin gcigagyigong ma chen po nas bod du bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa ji lta bu byon pa dang / de dag gi mdzad pa'i gtso bo ji 'dra mdzad pa ba ka' 'dri gnang bar/ thams cad zhib tu zhus shing de'i nang nas lo chen rin chen bzang bos mtho lding ra/ser gyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang / der thog rim bzhi yod par rgyud sde ༄khya/'i lha tshos/sa bzhengs shing de rnams kyi da kyil 'khor sgrub pa mdzad tshul zhus par brten/ nged kyi pho brang 'dir ya nga de lta bu byed pa yin gsuras myo/khar nang ma'i g.yas zur du rje bla mas ljas/sa ngakod mdzad nas lha khang gser gyi rgya phibs can thog rim bzhi yo da pa'i nang du rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams bzhengs shing lo dus su rtse thog tu 0/sang 'dus/ de 'og kun rigs/ de 'og rnam snang mngon byang / de 'og tu dam tshig gsum bkod kyi cho ga bla grwa kha shas kyis 'don rgyu btsugs/ dus mtsharma sa ma nges kyang skabs shig zhe nyo ra gyi skyed mo'i tshal gyi nye 'dabs su bod kyi bsam yas la dpe blangs pa'i dbu rtse rigs gsum gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla mchod rten dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang rgya thi/na tu che ba dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang bcas pa gsar bskrun mdzad de/ gong ma chen po dang rje bla ma bcas der byon nas slon lam pyi phyag len rnams mdzad cing co/ga ngo/'i ho sho so so nas grwa rgyun bsdus pa dang phyis su cun gar nas 'ongs pa'i grwa ba rnams kyang der sdod bcug te mdo sngags kyi grwa chang gnyis su byas par/ spyi'i mkhan po dang grwa tshang so so'i bla ma bsko bzhag ri+o gogs sngar smros pa'i dga' ldan byin chags gling dang rna5ni pa

—— bye56 rgya la ba'i tsābatugatsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdi btsugs tshul/ mtshungs pa mdzad/ gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen po nyid kyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thabs su gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa lo star chad med lta bur bzhengs shing / de dag tu dge 'dun kyi sde bzhugs su gsol te/ 'ga' zhig tu mdo sngags rigagoganas kyi slob gnyer/ tre 'ga' zhig tu gsang 'dus/ bde mchoga'ajigs byed/ dus/ 'khor/ tshe dpag med/ kun rigs// rmi na bla/gnas brtan ci ris/sa kyi cho ga 'ga' zhig tu mdo sde gsung sgro ga'aga' zhig tu chos skyo nga rnams kyi bskang gso gtong ba sogs mdor na dbus gtsang gi ljongs su gang yod ci yod thams cad ma tshang ba med pa lta bu 'dzugs pa gnang zhing de thams cad la rje btsun bla ma mchog gi ljags bkod kyis ma khyab pa gcig kyang med/ der ma zad srid skyong gi bya ba byed pa'i yā mun gyi khrod du yang bod kyi slob grwa btsugs te dpon rgyud gzhon pa mang bo der bod chos la slob gnyer byed pa dang / de dag gi khrod nas rig pa bzang grwas 'ga' zhig dbus dang mdo khams su bod chos slob par gtong ba dang / yā mun der chos bsgyur ba dang bod kyi yi ge 'dri ba sogs rgyun ldan byed cing / de rnams kyi mgo shes mkhan rje bla ma mchog dang am paṇa gcig gis byed pa'i srol yang 'dzugs pa mdzad/ /'di dus 7gong ma'i bkas dus kyi 'khor lo dang bde mchos/ gi sa gar mchod gar rnamās cho ga grwar 'dzug rgyur bod nas gar slob mkhan gtong —dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin zhwa lu nas gar gyi slob dpon gnyis gtong ba gnang ba rnams 'byor nas gar gyi skor dang rnam sras drag gtor gyi 'cham

— rgyalapo'ikhab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyisdebatsugasatshul/ 357 da rnams bslab/ de nas rje bla ma'i ljags bkod bzhin zangs 'bag thor tshugs rus rgyan sogs gar chas rnams mdzod nas ngasgrigs te lo ltar sgrub mchod skabs gar dang / dus rim 'ga' zhig la rnam sras kyi 'cham rgyag rgyu ngatsugs/ gzhan yang snga phyi ci rigs su bkra shis lhun po'i 'cham gyi skor dang / sa skya'i gur gyi 'chamyo/ rnam sa kyang 'dzugs pa mdzad do//'phags bod yul gru sngo bsangs mdzes ma'i rgyan/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rgyu skar gzugs/ /chos srid rlabs 'phreng 'phyur ba rgyal po'i khab/ /dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas 'di nang snang / /rin chen sna lnga'i rta babs mthor brtsegs pa/ /'ja' tshon dra bas 'khyud lta'i khang mdzes kyi/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i khyad par bya 'dab la/ /'phyang ba'i gser gyi dril bus dus su sgro ga /btso ma'i gser 'od 'bar ba'i rgya phib kyis/ /nyi ma gnyis pa shar ba'i 'khrul bskyed cing / /glo 'bur sgo dang dra mig dkar khung rnams/ /'tsham par bkod pa dbang bo'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /ba gam 'dab brgya brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas kha nga / /dkon mchog rten gyi ge sar rdul 'khrigs par/ /chos dbyangs snyan sgrog dge 'dun bung ba'i phreng / /'dus te bsod nams sbrang rtsi gso/ga par byed/ /'jig rten ma lus mes pos byas so zhes/ /rig byed pa rnams gtam du sgrogs pa rdzun/ /bden na de yis snod bcud 'byin pa'i tshe//ngo mtshar bkod pa 'di 'dra mi dran ci/ /gtsuka lag khang dang rten gsum dge 'dun sde/ /nor bu'i snying po can gyi rgyal khab ma yi+o/ /'di yi srid skyong gzhan gyi mnga' ris kum// /ba tshwa'i zhi rnga bur bya sa zhes lha rnams

358 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge'adunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ da wa glengs/ /bod nas khri chen rno rje 'chang ngag dbang mchog ldan pa gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa gsan pas thugs ngal shin tu che ba mdzad cing nyin zhag mang bo'i bar du mjal kha ma3mas bcad de/dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'alo/ ra du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i ma chod pa 'bul ba dang / rang nyid kyis dbang bzhes pa sogs mjad cing / thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs cho sa dang mthun pa mang du mdzad/de nas bzung ste lo re bzhin /phri chen rdo rje 'chang gi dus mchod kyi nyin 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor sgrub snga/chod bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa 'chag med gnar / phyis su rje bla ma nyid dang rje drung sprul pa'i klu rin po che rnam gnyis nas/ gong sa rin po cher dngul sra nga stong phrag gcig phul te bskul ma zhus pa bzhi+o/ khri chen de nyid kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs ched dpal ldan mi da rgyud grwa tshang du lo star dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lu hi pa lugs kyi sgrub makyi+o da zhag bdutsha/ tshus/sa rgyun thogs rgyal dbang mchog nas nyin gaspe ma spor gnang bcase / khyo na sgrub mchod nyin bcu gtan 'jags su tshugs pa mdzad/ mkhan che na rdo rje 'chang de nyid zhi bar mnal ba'i dgongs gtad kyis rwa greng du phebs khar/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog la ga sung ji/ tha ma mang bo zhig gnang b.ri mthar/ gong ma chen po'i thugs bskyed shin tu bzang ba dang / rang re'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag rje lcang skya rin po che 'di rnam dpyod 'gran zla dang bral ba bcas deng sang gang ci nagarje nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo brgya lhag par bye/ rgyal 3

rgyal pori khab tu gadzuka lag khang dang daṅge 'dunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ 359da waba'i bsta ma/ pa ya—nga dar/ 'gro ba tshang ma chos mthun bde skyid la spyod pa'i skal bzang mayo+o 0/ shi / dus 'dir kho bo shi na bsam pa rdzo gas/cho yin na'ang bstan pa'i gegs dbang dang / skye ba ngan pa'i byed pa ji 'dra ji/ga yin yang rje lcang skya rin po che 'di phyis su gcong zhing / spyan yang ha cang mi gsal ba yod skad 'di skor yid pham pa 'dug pas 'di la rin po che khyed rang 'ba' zhig nas thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug dang chos srung la 'phrin bcol sogaṭa/ gnang na dga' mo yong 'gro zhes nan tan rtswa zhu ba gnang 'dug go / rīri kun to ka chu 'dzin dhū ti'i mkha' dbyings su/ /thim pa las 'ongs lhan skyes nyin mor byed/ /bde stong 'od zer rtse dga' stong 'dzin pas/grub rigs kun gyi dbus na zla bral ba/ /gang de dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na/ /he ru ka yis mngags pa'i bya ma rtas/ /'ja' dang 'od kyi lam nas spyan drangs te/ /mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i grong du gshegs//de tshe mgon 'di'i thugs kyi me long du/ /gang gi mtshan dpe'i rnam pa gsal bkral bar/ /sku khrus sa/sol ba bzhin du spyan gyi chab/ /mu tig do shal lta bu sbreng ṭaṭa par gyur/ /de lta na yang tshul 'di sgyu ma yi/ /rnam 'phrul tsam du zad kyi don dam par/ /skye 'jig bral ba nam mkha'i ngo bo zhes/ /rang gis rang la gdams ngag 'doms mdzad nas/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'ja' tshon ri mo ltar/ /gang shar bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bya ma sa klas pa'i/ /gsang gsum thugs kyi dpal be'ur bkod pa yi//ngo mtshar ltad mor g.yengs pas thugs ngal bsos/ /sprel gyi lo/ bde

360 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/'byor dpon slob ched mngags kyis bod du gtong ba gnang ste/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog la rnam rgyal grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul zhing / 'bul nod kyang rgya che ba phul/ dgotwa/ pa khyad par can zhig la dgongs nas jo shāka rin po che rnam gnyis la dngul gyi mchod kong che ba re/ dga' ldan sa/serasgrogadung rin po che'i mdun du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs dang dngul gyi mchod kong bcas 'bul ba gnang / bya'i lo/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par rje bla ma mchog nas thugs dam la bogs 'byin pa'i ched du thun mtshams sogs su mgur du bzhes rgyu'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos tshul zhus par/ snyan 'jeb yid 'khul ba'i gsung mgur 'di lta bur stsol bar mdzad/ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /deng mi gzugayosprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /pha 'jam dbyangs bla mar dbyer med pa'i //rje bka' drin can pye khyo/bas la 'dud/ /skyabs kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma de/ /gnas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang / /dbyings zag med ngang du ro gcig pas/ /mchog dman gyi bsam brjod gnas min yang / /dus snyigs ma'i mthar skyes bdag 'dra la/ /khong sangs rgyas gzhan las thugs brtse bar/ /mtha' gol sa spangs pa'i mdo sngags lam/ /rnar lag pa'i mthil du byin bzhin bstan/ /drin de ltar che ba'i bla ma la/ /yid mos gus /drag pos gso'/ 'debs shing / /sems gnas lugs ngo bor mnyam pa nyid/ /don bla ma'i zhal bzang ma yengs ga

rgyal po'i kha tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 36ṭ+wāṃbalta/ /rang gzhan gyi legs tshogs ci 'dod kyang / /tha3ra/ bde bas sgrub nus rten 'di 'dra/ /las don med ngang du mi brer bar/ /chos 'dun ma'i yang rtse sgrub la brtson/ /spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtab/ pas/ /dus skad cig 'gyur 'i/nga so mi thub/ /de 'jig pa'i ngang tshul bsams pa na/ /yid skyo ba bskyed pas sdug bsngal gzhi/ /sgos khu khrag snyigs ma 'dus pa'i lus/ /sgo kun nas mi gtsang dri ma 'bab 'di gces par 'dzin pa'i 'os min yang / /las nyon mongs dbang gis khur du bskur/ /lo zla ba lta zhogs sa 'di tsam/ /'dir sdod kyi gdengs tshad ma rnyed pas/ /bdag 'chi khar phyogs pa'i nyam chung la/ /nor 'khor 'dab rgyas kyang ci zhig byed/ /lar ji tsam mtho bzhi na g.yang sa che/ /rdzas ji tsam 'byor bzhin 'ching ba dam/ /gnyen ji tsam 'dris bzhin tshur la 'khang / /dgra ji tsam btul bzhin mang du 'phel/ /gnas 'di yang re zhika g.yar ba tsam/ /rdzas 'di yang gzhan gyis bcol ba'i nor/ /bder rlom yang myur du 2jig pa dang / /sdug bsngal gyi sna 'dren kho nar zad/ /tshul de phyir 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /yid smon 'os cha tsam mi gda' bas/ /bun long gi snang shas rgyab bskyur nas//sems khur med de rang skyid kyi mchog /rgyud tshul khrims das/ pas phyi nang gtsang / /semasdo4 ting 'dzin ngang du bde zhing rga/sal/ / blo kros kyis shes bya'i gnas kun mthong / /lnga ma de lta ra rnyed pa 'dun ma'i rtse/ /ma rigs drug 'khyams pa'i serna sa/ can rnams/ /bu bdag la snying gi gong bu bzhin/ /thabs du mas gnod pa bsal ba dang / /yongs bde la

362 rgyal po'i khab spyo gtsug labyu khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/sbyar ba'i mtha' ma mchis/ /tshul de ltar drin du che ba rnams/ /rgyud ma rig 'thibs po'i smag gis khyab/ /dgra 'a sa nyon drag pos rgyun du gtses/ /sems sdug bsngal khur 'a sa sa bres dus med/ /rgyu de phyir sems can mthong ba'i tshe/ /mig byams pa'i 'dzum gyis bsu dgos na//gnod sems dang bslu ba'i gya gyu sogs/ /cha tsan/ ya nga mi byed smos ci dgos/ /mgon sa ra gnas dpa' bo che rnams kyi/ /thabs rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying sto bas kozhin/ /dus skad cig tsam yang ma zhum par/ /las gzhan don kho na sgrub la smon/ /bdag gzhan dang snod bcud la sogs pa/ /ming phar btags min pa'i 'char lugs 'di/ /blo 'khrul bas bzhag pa'i snang ba tsam/ /gzhi rtsa ba dpyad na stong sang nge / /dbyingasdo/ gnas tsa gas nam mkha' yangs pa der/ /yid mtshan ma'i gtad so kun zhig pas/ /yul gang shar ngo la bltas pa'i tshe/ /tshugs mi thub sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /sa/zhi bltos/ naṭa/sku grub pas stong bar mthong / /stong bzhin du snang bas rten 'brel go /'di dbu ma ra sa/nas pa'i lta ba ste/ /mtha' rtag chad g.yang la nyam mi nga / /dpal sdo rje can zhabs slob dpon gyis/ /rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi sems la bskur//mchog sku gsum bde ba chen po'i lam/ /gzhi gnyug k+ka 'i ste nga du ngo sprad bzhin/ /blo lhan skyes 'od gsal mchog gi khams/ /lha yi dam gzugs su byang chub nas/ /dus thun dang thun 'tshams rir+sā med par/ /zab gas la gyi rnal 'byor g.yo med dang / /phyi snod kyi spya) nga ba gang shar yang //rang ye shes ngo bo'i gzhal med khang / /nang bcu da kyi/ gang zag 'di

rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 363thams cad/ /lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bkod pad gsal/ /lus tsa khar+sha sa dang/'a bo dpa' mo la/ /zas bdud rtsi tshogs su 'bul ba sogs/ /sngags gsang ba zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /las bya ba ci bgyis 'a ma du bsgyur/ /yid brtan pa 'phrog byed phyag rgya'i gar/ /gnas phyo gas mtshamyo/sa kun tu bun long nge / /nang bde stong zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam/ /rgyun chu bo'i 'gros bzhin bsten 'tshal lo/ /yid nyon mongs tha mal rnam rtog dang / /phyogs lhan cig mi gnas dben pa der/ /rje brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /dus rtag tu dga' mgur spyod pas na/ /las dang bor gyur pa'i gang zag bzhin/ /don bya ba nyung ngu lhur bzhes pa/ /spyir dam pas bsngags 'os ma chog yin kyang //khyed sems dpa' che la mdzes ma yin/ /sngon bstan pa 'dzin par dam bcas bzhin/ /deng lhag par snying stobs go bzhe sa la/ /gre/nan bsdu pa rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyis/ /phan bde legs sgo brgya 'byed 'tshal lo/ /gtam 'di yang dge ldan lugs bzang rgyas/ /mgon bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan/ /ma mkha' mnyam yid can thams cad kyis/ /skyabs byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /skabs 'di 'dra tsam zhig nas byang phyogs cho/sa rod cun gar gyi rgyal po zla ba chi dang / a mor sa na gnyis ma 'cham par brten po+o/nga ma che na pos dpung 'jug mdzad pa'i dus zir gyi mgo brtsams pas/ gong nas bka' phebs pa bzhin rje bla ma dang / dga' ldan shi re thu/ rje drung sprul pa'i sku rnams nas rim gro'i rigs mang du mdzad cing / skabs zhig a mor sa na'i dmag

364 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi 'dun gyi ri batshugs tshul/dar sogs rdzas 'ga' zhig byung bas drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin bla ma rnam gsum nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas/ de nas mi ring bar zla ba chi bzung zhing a mor 5 shrī na stobs zad nas yul gzhan du bros pas/ cun gar dang hos tsi'i yul khams thams cad gyigong ma'i mnga' zhabs su 'dus/ de skabs hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i phu bo dar han chin wang / gong ma'i khrims la phog pas rkyen byas nas hal ha yongs rdzogs ngo log grab byas pa la/ 7gong nas rje bla ma mchog la hal ha'i chings byed par mgyogs bshad kyis phebs dgos tshul gsungs pa bzhin phebs rtsis kyis snga 'gros su/ rje bla ma mchog nas rje btsun dam par de 'dra gnang na gtan nas mi legs tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhib rgyas thon pa'i bka' 'phrin gyi yi ge dang bcas zhabs phyi pa rnam rgyal can nyin mtshan med par mgyogs stsol gyis btang bas/ rje btsun dam pa nas kyang rje bla ma mchorga/ gi bka' rngu/nga bzhin hal ha'i dpon po thams cad la gong ma chen po'i thugs dang 'gal ba mi 'os pa'i bka' phebs par brten hal ha rnams bde 'jags su bsdad/ rje bla ma do lon nor nas zhag /spa shas kyi bar du phebs pas rje btsun dam pa mchog nas bde 'jags mdzad pa'i zhu 'phrin byung ba/ gong mar babs rgyun zhus par de lta na rje bla ma nyid phebs mi dgos pas pho brang du phyir phebs ces pa'i bka' slebs/ de nas pho brang du phebs nasapyagong mar mjal phrad mdzad pas thugs shin tu dgyes pa byung / mi sde shin tu rgya che ba de 'dra ngo log pa'i dus zir byung na lo mang bo'i bar du sems can grangs las

rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 365'das pa sdug bsngal gyi mun par chud pa yong nges pa la gsung 'phrin tsam gyis rang zhir song ba 'dis ni rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid skye dgu rnams la phan bde stsol ba'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid can du nges par byos shig paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar du lan cig bod sog gi dmag 'thab 'dzing byed par sku dngos byon nas so sor gyes par mdzad pa'i gnas tshul gsungs nas 'di nga rang gi tshe 'di la ltos pa'i rnam thar gyi rgetso bo zhig yin gsungs pa la dpagasan 'dzam gling g.yo ba tsam gyi dus 'khrugs rang zhir mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu bod kyi ljongs 'dir sngon byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa su la yang ma byung ba'i rnam par thar pa mchog tu bzung bar rigs so/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal po cun sa/ra zhes/ /dpa' rtsal dregs pas dgra sde'i snying 'dar ba/ /de yi chab srid mkha' la bdud rtsi'i zer/ /'grem pa'i mi yi zla ba mang zhig shar/ /nam zhig bsod nams mar ngor gyur pa na/ /mun pa'i 'khrugs long smag tu 'thib pa'i nang / /gzi brjid cha shas phra ba rgyal po'i gdung / /zla ba'i mi nga can snang du med pa byung / /de yi mnga' thang tho rengs kyi/ /rgyu skar go 'phang 'dzin pa nyid/ /mi rje bcu gnyis bdag po yi/ /dpung gi 'od gzis brdzis pa na/ /khong ba srin bus zos pa'i shing / /shugs drag rlung gis bskyod tsam gyis/ /dka' ba med par 'gyel ba bzhin/ /'di yi srid kyang de bzhin gyur/ /ji ltar me stag chung ngus kyang / /khang khyim 'bar ba'i rkyen byed ltar/ /rkyen ngan chung dus 'khrugs chen ni/ /dus mtha'i

366 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge'adunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ da warlung 'dra ldang bar phyogs/ /'jig rten chu gter 'khrugs byed pa/ /g.yul gyi chu srin ma ka ra/ /srog chags bye ba'i srog za ba'i/ /'jigs rung kha ni gdangs par brtsam/ /de tshe shar phyogs 'jig rten na/ /skye rgu mgrin sdon mtha' dag gi /re ba'i mig 'bur mgon po 'di'i/ /thugs rje'i sprin la gtod par byed/ /mnar med me lce 'bar ba yang //rab bsil pad mtshor bsgyur nas pa/ /dbang bcu ba rnyes pa mgon 'di yi/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa rlabs po ches/ /tshe lo bcu bar ma slebasapar/ /mtshon gyi bskal ba 'jig rten du/ /'byung bar nye me bzlog mdzad nas/ /'gro mang 'chi med gnas la bkod/ /khyod ni skal bzang re sko nga yid bzhin nor/ /'jig rten rgud pa'i mun 'joms 'od stong can/ /phan bde'i gru char 'bebs pa'i sprin bzang ste/ /khyod mtshungs skye rgu'i mgon gzhan yod re skan/ /nyi ma gling bzhi'i mun pa sel la yang yang shar bas mi ngal zhing / /sa chen 'di yang snod bcud 'degs pa'i khur gyir+sā nam yang gdung ba med/ /ga ci ga tu 'gro la brtse ba'i dbang gyur 'di yi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /e ma 'di lta'i mgon gyis yongs bzung 'jig rten 'di yang skal ba bzang / / na/ dgon lung nas 'tshams zhu 'bul bar khri zur bde rgu zhal snga nas ngag dbang dge legs rgya mcho pe'i cing du phebs ska bas kho bo dbus gtsang du slob gnyer la 'gro ba'i 'dun pa che tshul zhus pa'i phyir phebs la /da cha po da du slob gnyer la phebs pa skabs su babs/ deng sang sku skye che kha'i rigs dbus gtsang la 'gro mkhan phal che bas 'bul sdud sogs

rgyal po'i khab tu gtsag lag khang dang dge 'dunagyisdebatsugasatshul/ 361 da thabs sna tshogs kyis 'byor ba gang che byas nas bod du slebs par 'bul ba mang 'gyed sogs gang che 'gran pa dang / de nas ming dang go sa mtho ba zhig e thob 'bad cing che gnyan du ma'i ngo 'dzin dang rgyal srid la kha gtogs zhe gtogs sna tshogs byed pa 'dug ste/ de dag la chos yong ba'i re ba med/ lcang skya gong ma/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gong ma sogs kyis mtshon sngon byon gyi skyes chen dam pa thams cad dang po grwa rkyang lugs kyis dman cha bzung nas tshogs chos grwa 'grims pas mkhas grub chen por gyur te gzhi nas 'phrin las rgyas pa sha stag yin/ nyid kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi rnam thar bzhin grwa rkyang lugs kyis slob gnyer gsha' ma 'i /sa/ yong ba la 'bad dgos/ rgyal ba yab sras kyis mtshon pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la thugs dag snang sbyong ba dang / grwa sa grwa tshang khams tshan mi tshan gyi phyogs res 'then 'khyer la brten nas yul gnyan po la kha smras co ) tshoko/sa byed pa'i skye bo ngan pa'i rjes su mi 'brang ba gal che/ zhes so/gas rtsujid/sa la btags pa'i bslab bya rgyas par gnang 'dug skabs shig gong ma chen po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar phebs pa 'i phyag phyir rje bla ma nyid kyang byon nas gnas gzigs zhib tu mdzad cing 7gong ma'i bkas smon 'a ma gyi tshogs dbur bzhugs nas bsta/ na pa rgyas pa'i thugs sgron sogs rgya cher mdzad/ snga phyir skabs du mar skal ba dang ldan pa mang bo la byang chub lam gyi rim pa/ blo sbyong / lta khrid mi+o/gas dang /gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi darma ra khrid/ dbang chen dang rjes gnang yi/ rigs sogs mdor na zhu ba po rnams kyi mos pa dang

368 rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dgi'adunagyisdebatsugasatshul/—da dge'atsham pa'i bka' chos du ma zhig gnang 'dug pa sa bon ma byung bas zhib tu 'bri bar ma spobs/ ja sag bla ma tshul khrims chos 'phel dang nye gnas dge slong bstan pa༄ rin chen gnyis thugs zin nges kyi phyag g.yog pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ dmar khrid du ma zhig gzab bshad du stsal zhing khong gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor dang bca— / ba/sol ba btab pa bzhin bde mchog lus dkyil gyi rim pa dang po'i dmar khrid dang / gtum mo'i khrid yig bde ba chen po 'i rgya mtsho gnyis kyang ljags rtsom mdzad/ de dus rgyal khab chen por bla ma rnam gsum zhal 'dzom pas phan tshun thugs gcig 'dresdo/ lta bus bka' chos gsan res dang / nyams rtogs kyi brdar sha gcod pa dang /chos kyi 'bel gtam rgyun mi 'chad du gnang zhing / dbus gtsang nas dge bshes tshad ldan mang bo rim par phebs pa rnams la mdo sngags kyi dka' ba'i gnas mang bo'i dogs dpyod mdzad cing chos kyi dga' ston nyin bzhin stsal pas/ bod nas byon pa rnams kyi bdag cag thog mar dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing nas sa'i mtha' 'di lta bur slebs pa la yid pham pa lta bu mchis kyang deng sang ni rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 'di lta bu'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la nyin bzhin longs spyod rgyu byung bas skal ba shin tu bzang ba 'dug snyam sems la dga' ba dpag tu med pa thob par gyur ces zer ba sha stag byung / /gang gi rnam thar phyag rgya bstan tsam gyis/ /dpyod ldan gzur gnas dregs pa'i glang bo rnams/ /lcags kyu'i marngo+o na gyis 'debs la mi ltos par/ /yid dbang 'gugs pa mgon 'di'i khyad chos te/ /snying

rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs tshul/ 369stobs dman la yi ga 'chus pa'i nad/ /pyid byed snyigs ma lnga yi ljan ljin khrod/ /pad mtsho mthong ba'i ngang ba ltar 'jug pa/ /'di yis rgyal sras rnams kyang skyengs par byas/ /mi bsrun skye bo snying gi bud shing la//khong khro'i me lce shugs drag 'bar ba yang / /gang gi byams brtse'i sprin sngon las 'ongs pa'i/ /'jam pa'i gsung gi char bas mod la gzhil//bugs bskyed nor bu'i lte ba las thon pa'i/ /'phrin las rtsibs stong dge legs mu khyud kyis/ /bsdam pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yang / /'di yis phyogs bral mkha' la nyin bzhin bskor/ /tshul des rtsod dus 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan gyi/ /dga' ston la sbyor bka' drin lhun po'i lcid//'degs bzod gser ldan ma 'di skal bzang zhes/ /lha rnams ngo mtshar ca co sgrogs pas brel/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ rgyal po'i khab tu gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs shing dge 'dun gyi sde gsar ba btsugs pa dang / yul phyogs du ma'i rgud pa bsal te dge mtshan rgyas par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //

370'e'u bucu buzhi bu/ gangs can nyu ljongar+sā su zhabras spya pugho+o nan pun zhakod de tshaska kyai 'khon phro rgya chen braskon buzhi tshulka/ skabs shig dgos pa/ khyad par can la dgongs nas paṇa chen thams —cad 'i༈/phyen par bzang gos tshem sgrub kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil thang zhig 'bul rgyu bskur ba/ paṇa chen ma chog nas kyang bkras lhun sngags grwa'i tshe chog sgrub mchod kyi thugs dam rten du sbyor 'jags mdzad 'dug me mo glang gi lo rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po nyid zag med chos kyi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan pa lha sar yod pa'i am pan nas gong ma chen por phral du zhus pas dbo zla'i tshes gsum gyi nyin gong nas rje bla mar bka' bab cing thugs ngal gso ba'i gsung ci rigs kyang gnang de phral du thugs dran stor ba lta bu'i nyams dang rim gyis cung zad sos pa lta bu byung ste/ nyin du ma'i bar du dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thugs dam gyi rim pa mang po dang mi ring bar mchog gi sprul sku phebs pa'i gsol 'debs sogs la nan tan chen po mdzad cing / tsan dan jo bo sogs rten khyad par can rnams la mchod 'bul dang / pe'i cing phyi nang gi dge 'dun rnams la dgongs pa rdzogs pa la dmigs pa'i bsnyen bkur sogs kyang rgya cher myoshaṃ dzad do/ /spyal ba kun gyi thugs rje ba/zugs can bzhin/ /skal bzang gdul

gangs can ljo ngas su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 371bya'i dpal du shar ba ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ngur smrig tshul bzung ba/ /rnam 'dren kalnga bha dra'i mtshan can te/ /gangs can mkha' la nyi tshe'i 'phrin las 'od/ /spro ba'i bstan 'dzin rgyu skar grangs 'das kyang / /yongs rdzogs thub bstan pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /srid pa 'i mig tu gyur pa 'di kho na/ /de lta na yang phyogs lhung ling thog gis//blo mig ches cher bsgribs pa'i skal dman 'gas/ /rgyal dbang nyi ma spangs nas blu na dz+rag gi /me khyer rjes su snang ba tshol phyir rgyug /mgon khyod dri med mkhyen lhan stong phrag ni/ /yid 'ong ut+pal 'dab bzhin sa/sal phye bas/ /yongs 'dzin kun gyi nang na mgon po 'di/ /skyabs gnas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying por gzigs/ /'khrul med rgyal ba'i mdzad pa 'ba' zhig pa'i/ /rnam thar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor thugs kyi mkhar//shar bas mtshan gyi 'od tsam reg pas kyang / /phyag sor kun+da'i 'dab ma thugs kar zum/ /de phyir mgon 'di'i mtshan dpe zla ba'i gzugs//chos dbyings nub ri'i phang bar gzims so zhes/ /yid mi 'ong ba'i gtam gyi 'khyog 'bar gyis/ /khyod thugs chu gter gdung ba 'dzin par gyur/ /de tshe bka' drin rjes su dgongs pa'i rlabs/ /gyen du 'phyur ba mu tig dog pa bzhin/ /mthon mthing 'dren byed lam nas lhung na yang / /thugs gsang ye shes klong nas 'di snyam du/ /snying dbus a wa dhū tī'i pho brang na/ /kun byed rang rig don gyi bla ma rje/ /mchog sa/sum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yongs 'dus pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol pas rtag par bzhugs/ /de ru ma zad mkha' las 'ja' ris lta ra/ /gang

372 ‘ gangs can sngongs su tshos 'alo/ ra rgya ra bskor tshul/shar bla ma'i bkod par 'byams klas pa'i/ /sasang gsum yid kyi rgyan tu 'god shes na/ /snang srid thamase cad bla ma'i rnam nol yin/ /de lta nyid na byis rnams dga' ba'i dngos/ /kun rdzob gzugs sku'i snang ba nub na yang / /rtag tu rang sems 'phrul gyi me long du/ /don dam bla ma'i zhal bzang mjal bas chog /de ltar dgongs nas thugs kyi ngal ba'i khur/ /ring du bor te kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /dbyings las bton te dbyings kyi bla ma la/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin gcig tu 'bul bar mdzad/ /mtshan 'dzin dug r+ṣa/ma cha tsam ma bslad pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /mchod gnas bla ma mchog gi pho brang du/ /sgyu ma'i yo lang bzhin du rgya cher gtibs//de nas ring po ma lon pa na gong ma chen po'i bka' las/ tā la'i bla ma bod kyi bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pu yin pas zhi bar gzhol ba shin tu ma legs kyang bya thabs dang bral bar gyur/ da ni tā la'i bla ma'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'khrul med ngos zin pa gal che bas/ hu thog thu nyid bod du phebs nas sprul sku rtsad bcad nas thag chod pa byed dgos/ hu thog thu nged kyi gam nas thag ring por gtong mi phod kyang / da res bod kyi bstan pa'i do/na gal che bas phebs nas ma 'gyangs par sprul sku thag chod bstun tshur phebs dgos zhes pa'i bka' phebs/ phyag g.yog tu am pan gcig dang / dpon chung kha shas/ gong ma'i bla sman gnyis bcas gtong ba gnang / pe'i cing nas chibs bskyod mdzad rim gyis chab mdor khyon/ bla ma dkon mchog rdo rje bya ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug cig bzhugs

gangs can sngongs su rngos 'khor rgya tsher bskor tshul/ 313pa la/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dbang khrid man ngag rlung gi skor tshang ma dang / mi tra lha drug ri+o sri+o/sa/sa chos bka' mang tsam gsan/bla ma 'di nyid mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thugs dam zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba zhig yin 'dug pas/phan tshun nyams rtogs go bsdur ba sogs chos kyi gsung gleng lhag par 'phel/ phyis su yang zhal nas/ chab mdo bla ma dkon rdor ba de rtogs pa mthon por phebs 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad pa thos so/ /dar rtse mdor/ gzhung nas bka' blon gung paṇ+ḍi ta/ rtse'i mgron gnyer yon tan legs grub bcas chibs bsur slebs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang / kho bo cag chibs bsu bar song ba me gro ru thog gi chab tshan khar mjal bas thugs shin tu dgyes shing gsung gleng mang du stsal/ phebs lam du rgya bod kyi bla dpon ser skya mchog dman mang po dang chos sde che chung du mas skyel bsu/ 'khrab ston 'bul nod/ skye bo'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang por mjal kha phyag dbang bka' chos gnang ba sogs spros pa shin tu che ba byung 'dug kyang zhib tu ma nges/lam bar du 'khod pa'i bla dpon rnams la so so'i go babs dang bstun pa'i gnang cha mdzad cing / der ma zad 'u lag dang ngos skyel mis mtshon rkang khral lag khral 'don mi gang yod la gnang sbyin tshem med mudzad/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes la lha sar phebs skabs/ de mo hu thog thu/ sprul sku che gra/ ser 'bras sogs kyi bla ma las sna rnams dang / rgya am pan gnyis/ bka' blon drung 'khor sogs rtse gzhung gi las tshan pa gang yod

3ṭī4 dathas can ljongs su chos 'khor rgya chor bskor tshul/kyi chibs bsu/ ser 'bras kyi dge 'dun khri phrag tsam gyis ser sbrengs/skye bori tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus pa'i khrom shin tu che zhidā / bro gzhasartsed sna sogs kyis mtshon bod pa lugs kyi bkur gzos dpe bral lta bu dang bcas thog mar khyams ra chen mor phebs/ gzhung nas dkar spro rgyas pa zhus shing jo bo rin po cher phyag 'bul dang thugs smon rgya che ba gnang / de nas bsam 'grub khang gsar du bzhugs gnas/ kyi gra sgrig byas 'dug pa bzhin der phebs/ dgon lung dang btsan po mi tshan kyi/ grwa mang gis mtshon mjal kha zhu mi mang tsam la phyag dbang gnang / sngar so ra rgyal dbang thams cad mkhye/ na pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus rjes/ bod gzhung spyi nas gong ma chen por zhus pa bzhin de mo sprul sku byal tshab tu mnga' gso la na'ang / rgya bod kyi bkur gzo mi che bas sto/na mo so/gas kyi/ skabs bzhugs gral am pan gnyis kyi 'phro la khri chung darna 'a ba zhig la bzhus/sa pa yin pa la/ rje bla casdo mchog nas gong sa tham sa cad ma/khyen spra'i rgyal tshab yin pa dang / bod kyi la rgya la dgongs nas thog yi 'i mjal phrad skabs chibs bshol te ma nyam phyag dang rna jal dar rtse sprod bka' drin bskyangs pas de nas bzung de mo ba dbu 'phang je mthor song / mdzad pa'i cha phra mo 'di tsam yang gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang ba'i ngatre na srid byi ba/so sa sman dam par gyur to/ /mtshar sdug rgyu skar stong shar yang / /nyi ma gzhon nu ma 'ongs pa//de srid nor gyi dbyig 'dzin ma/ /mun pa'i mal nas ldang mi bye da/ /gangs can ljongs su rang rang 'khor gyi dbus/ /kha sgo gas/la ba'i 'od

—d+ngha gangasacanak+to ngas su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 315 ldan bgrang yas kyang / /'gro ba'i nyi ma 'udi nyid ma shar na/ /rgud pa'i smag rum su yis bsal bar nus/ /de phyir bod yuyi bstan 'gro'i pad+ma la/ /rjes chags thugs rje'i bdab/ nyid sgrol byed bshes/ /snying stobs rta ljang shing rta la bcibs nas/ /gzi brjid 'od 'bum lham mer 'phags par gyur/ /bsod namyo/sa bye bas bskrun pa'i zhabs/ /gang dang gang du bkod pa'i sa/ /de dang der ni dge legs kyi/ /me tog gsar ba gsar ba 'khrungs/ /shākya mu ne'i zhabs skyes rdul gtsang rīm//gser gyi char ba 'babs pas shis byas pa/ /gangs can yul gyi badz+ra a sa na/ /lha ldan nor 'dzi na sa yi thig le ru/ /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis phye ba yi/ /zhal bzang gser gyi pad+ma bzhad pa'i 'dzum/ /skal bzang 'dren byed bung bas nyer bsten cing / /legs 'doms sprang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed par mdzad/ /nyes pa'i tshwa sgo can du gzhol ba yi/ /'dun ma'i nyal 'aswo so sor 'bab pa kun/ /legs lam yur ba gcig tu legs drangs nas/ /phan bde'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ /lha sar phebs pa'i phyi nyin pho brang chen po po ta lar byon/ gser gdung sa/sar rnying dang 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra sogs rten gyi gtso bo rnams mjal ba mdzad cing / gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil bar rtse gzhung nas dkar spro phul/ mi ring bar gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po'i nyin tshoms chen gsar bar gdan drangs/ rje bla ma/ phyag mdzod ja sag bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel/ sku mdun dge slong / mgron gnyer bzhi/ gsol

376 gingasacasdi—smongasasu sa'akhor rgya ra bskor tshul/dpon rnams dang / gnyer pa gnyis bcas phyag g.yog che chung thams cad/ bkas mngags pa'i hā tā zhin dang / phyag g.yog tu btang ba'i dpon chung rnams kyis gtso ba'i rgya mi rnams dang / gzhir bzhugs de mo rgyal tshab pa/ spom pan gnyis/ bka' blon bzhi dang bcas pa'i gzhi mgron gdan 'dzoms pa'i bzhugs gral chen po tshogs pa la/ gzhung sa nas gsol ston rgyas pa zhus shing / saṃ kro ta'i skad kyi rgyud las drangs pa'i shis brjod dang gar gyi rtsed sna/ gral 'phros/ dge bshes gnyis kyi bgro gleng bcas rten 'brel phunā sum tshogs pa'i dga' spro'i yan lag rgyas pa spel te/ bsil ldan sā la'i sman ljongs su bde bar phyag phebs pa'i legs 'bul gyi dngos po rgya che zhing spam mtho ba phul/ gtsug lag nor bu'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dga' bzhi gung paṇ+ḍi tas shis brjod kyi bden tshig sngon du 'gro ba'i zhu mchid l+yang rigs kyis brgyan pā dpyod ldan rna ba'i dga' ston du gyur pa zhig snyan du 'bul bar mdzad/ zhu mchid 'bul ba rgyal tshab de mo ba la skabs su babs pa yin kyang / khong ljags mi bde ba sogs kyi dbang gis dga' bzhi gung gi rnam dpyod dang smra brjod rgyal tshab kyi zhal tshab mdzad pa yin 'dug 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang kho bo cag phebs bsur phyin nas mjal skabs bod na bzhugs pa'i bla ma sprul sku dge ba'irke bshes gnyen che ba rnams kyi gnas tshul bka' 'dri zhib tu gnang zhing / khyad par du rje phur bu lcog pa'i rnam par thar pa mang du gleng bar mdzad nas/ nged snga mo bod du yong skabs na gzhon pa dang ngar che bas phur bu lcog dpon slob pa rkyen 'ga' zhig gi dbang gis

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgyachirabaskor tshul/ 377 da gus pa ma bgyis shing / de dus 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje zhal bzhugs pas yang yang mjal phrad byung na'ang / la mo dpon slob nam mkha'i ngag la nyan nas khong la chos zhus pa sogs ma byas pa phyis su bsams pas bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa de nyid rje bla ma'i snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'gran zla dang bral zhing nges par grub pa'i go 'ephang mthon por gshegs pa zhig yin 'dug pas/ khong las chos thos rgyu ma byung ba la 'gyod pa chen po byung / de mtshungs bla ma byams pa yang snyigasnga sa—'i khusbyi nyadir rje bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa la smo/na pa'i mthu grub pa'i skyes mchog khyad par du 'phags pa yin ba la nged nas gus par ma byas pa shin tu ma legs/da cha bla ma 'jam dbyanga.ā+oṃpa zhal mi bzhugs 'dug bla ma byams pa dang mjal nas thugs yid rwagispra 'dreñcha lta bu byed bsam pa yod ba/sungs pa la/rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po ches bka' drin che cis kyang de bzhin mdzad dgos zhes zhu ba ga/nang / bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa'i dngos slob 'gang che ba da lta su 'dra yod bka' 'dri phebs pa la/ nags shod na stag phu sprul sku rin po che bzhugs tshul zhus par khong gi snyan pa nged nas kyang cung zad thos/ khong bod du gdan 'drongs na legs pa/sa zhes phebs/bka' 'dri gnang ba 'di rnams kho bos phur bu lcog tu phyin nas bla ma'i snyan du gasdol bar bzhad mo gnang zhing lcang skya rin— po che thugs mad da res nged rkyeng mi ring bar mjal phyag 'bul bar 'gro rtsis yod gsungs/de nas nyin gcig rje bla ma phur bu spyog pa chen po lha traṭa grastagra lwagrud— kha5 gas5 cu ched gtad kyis rje bla ma nyid la mjal bar phebs/ lcang skya rno

378 gangs can ljongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshu /rje 'chang bzhugs mal nas phral du bzhengs te ra mthil du byon nas phan tshun phyaka 'bul res dang / khri khar stan gcig la bzhugs te phan tshun gnyis kas sngon gyi gnas tshul gsungs shing nongs pa bzod gsol mdzad/dam pa dam pa'i drung na mdzes/ /zer ba bzhin/ chos kyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel zhing slar phan tshun chos bka' sa/san res mdzad rgyu'i gsung 'phros kyang mdzad/ byams pa rin po che sku mdun nas phyir phebs rjes/kho bos nyams mtshar tshul gyis da des byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis zhal 'dzoms nas chos kyi bgro ba yun ring mdzad cing / thugs rgyud kyi mkhyen brtse gnyis kyang gcig tu 'dres pa bka' drin che zhes zhus par bzhad mo mdzad cing / 'dres so/ /legs par 'dres so/ /shin tu 'dres so//khyod phur bu lcog tu brgyugs nas thabs yin no zhes brjod pa la/ bla ma byams pas legs so zhes gsungs ྅ dwo de bzhin du gyur ces mngon par mkhyen pa'i gsung phebs pas kho bo spu ༷7du byed pa byung //thuXb pa'i sras mchog mi pham 'jam dbyangs gnyis/ /s+t+waṃb bsta/na snying bo phyogs mthar spel ba'i slad/ /s+t+waṃb dbang zhal skyin jo bo'i bzhugs gnas su/ /thub gsung chos kyi bgro bar gdan 'dzoms tshe/ /tram̐b pa'i zhal mthong gaspong thos lha rnams kyis/ /thusdu pa byon pa 'i sdon t+t+waṃng rjes dran nas/ /thubyā dbang gnyis pa rje btsun rnam gnyis la/ /s+t+waṃb pa bzhin du mchod cing bka' sgrub gyur/ /de nas mi ring bar gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po'i nyin rje bla ma nyino po ta lar phebs/ srid zhi'i gtsuka rgya na rgyal dbang thamyo sa cad mkhyen

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 379pa bskal bzang rgya ma tsho'e sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu snying por bzhugs pa'i gser gyi mchod sdong chen po'i drung du mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'bul ba nang mdzod sna lnga/ ga se ra dngu/ra khyon srang chen stong phraka gnyis dang sum brgya/ ja sag bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel gyis gtso ba'i phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis kyaja gser dngul gos dar sna tshogs dang yongs 'dzin bde 'byor ma kho/ po ngag dbang do cha/ grub kyisdo/ mchod thebs phon che ba 'bul rgyu bskur ba bcas phul/ rje bla ma nyid gtso bor bzhugs pa la/ rgyal tshab de mo ba/ sku mdun nang ma rnams dang / gsu nga chog pa brgya lhag bcas pas rje bla ma sri da zhi re gtsug rgyan de nyid dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par thugs nyams su bstar/ sgrub mchod kyi mjug tu rje bla ma nyid bzhengs nas spyan mi gsal ba'i tshul mdzad kyin yod gshis/ gser gdung rin po cher phyag gis nom nyug mdzad cing / pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho mi bzhugs pa zhes thugs shin tu skyo ba'i gsung phebs shing / spyan chab sgo re ba dang bcas phyag g.yas pa snyan drung du bkod nas/ snyan pa'i gdangs kyis thugs rje bskul—ba'i gdung dbyangs mgur du bzhes pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra ya/ sku sprul pa'i 'od zer bgrang yas pas /zhing bye ba phrag brgya gsal mdzad pa/ /mgon thugs rje chen po rdo rje 'chang / /pha bska la bzang rgya mtsho yud tsam dgongs/ /gnas pur rgyul bod kyi zhing khamyo/sa 'di/ /chos dge bcu'i khrims kyis skyong mdzad

380 gangs can sngongs su snas 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/pa/ /dpal chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po de/ /pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho ma lags sam/ /dus da lta bsil ldan ljongs 'di na/ /ches— snyigs ma'i ngang tshul bdo ba yis/ /ma 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'grib gyur na/ /rje bla ma'i thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ /dpal mnyam med dī paṃ ka ra yi/ /sras 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes/ /khong bka' gdams kun gyi phyi mo de/ /pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho ma lags sam/ /dus deng sang rgyal bstan dri med 'di/ /khong khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde rnams kyang / /lam 'chal bar spyod pas bslad gyur na/ /pha thugs rje'i spyan gyis/ mi gzigs sam/ /rje bla ma blo bzang grags pa yi/ /sras mchog gyur paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ /rje'i 'phrin las kun gyi byed po de/ /pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho ma lags sam / /da 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs kyang / /snum zad kyi mar me ltar gyur pa/ /bdag blo chung gis kyang mi bzod na/ /pha khyod kyis yal bar 'dor rigs sam/ /dpal sangs rgyas kun gyis ma thul ba'i/ /ches ma rungs snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dren phyir/ /thugs dam bca' brtan po'i go bgos pa/ /pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho ma lags sam/ /deng khyod kyi gdul bya phal mo che/ /mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i ngang tshul 'di/ /pha khyod kyis mkhyen pas gzigs bzhin du/ /lar yal bar 'dor ba cang phod dam/ /ma mkha' 'gro dpa' bo bye ba'i dbus/ /dpal lhun po ltar brjid mgon po khyod/ /thugs zhi ba'i dbyings su ma bzhugs par/ /mchog —sprul sku'i zhal bzang bstan du gsol/ /mgon khyod kyi drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /'bangaspo

gings can tsāngs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 3skye1nyam chung rol pa'i rdo rje bdag /ngag gdung dbyangs nga ros gsol 'debs na/ /pha brtse chen thugs kyis gzigs su gsol/ /mchog sprul sku'i nyin byed myur gsal te/ /bstan 'gro ba'i pad+ma dkar po'i tshal phan bde ba'i ge sar mngon 'dzum pa'i/ /bde skyid kyi dga' ston stsal du gsol/ /dus ring por mi thogs khyod zhal mjal/ /gsung dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ /dpal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po de/ /tshe 'di la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag ltos bcas 'dir tshogs dad ldan rnams/ /dpal byang tshochub mchog la reg gi bar/ /mgon khyod zhabs spyi bos bsten byas te/ /thugs mnyes pa 'ba' zhig sgrub gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /mgur dbyangs de ltar gnang bas der tshogs pa thams cad yid shin tu 'khul ba dang dad pa dang skyo ba 'dres pas mchi ma dbang med du 'chor zhing yid chad chod du 'phyo bas re zhig gi bar du gtam gleng ba'ang mi dran pa lta bu byung snang / rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dpyings su bsdus pa nas bzung dgra lha rdo rje dregs ldan yang khog gzhug mi gnang ba/ 'di res rje bla ma nyid nas gser gdung gi drung du sku phebs gnang nas/ re zhig 'bab ma nyan pa la/ rje bla ma mchog nas bsdigs mo'i tshul gyis dam tshig la bkar ba'i phebs sgo stsal phral khog tu brlams te gser gdung la bltas nas spyan chab bsil/ bla ma mchog nas gser skyems phul te bka' bsgo dam bsgrag zil che ba zhig gnang bas der 'khod pa thams cad 'jigs zhum pa byung zhing / chos skyong nas kyang

3skye2 gangaṭasdo can ljongs su tshas 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/bka' las mi 'da' ba'i g.yar dam phul/ 'di nas bzung ste spyi sger dang lha tshes kyi skabs thar+yā sa cad du sngar rgyun bzhin khog zhugs mdzad pa byung /de nas mi ring ba na gangs ri'i khrod kyi gsang sngags la spyod pa'i 'dus sde rnams kyi khrod na 'gran zla dang bral ba dpal ldan smad rgyud ces grags pa'i rdza rnga phyogs thams cad du khyab par sgrog pa'i grwa tshang gi mkhan po ngag dbang tsha sa grakas/ /bla ma dbu mdzad pa zhwa dmar chos rgya mtsho/ dge bsko sa/ khams tshadi+o so so 'i dge rgan rnams dang bcas pas rgyud pa tshogs yongs la dpal rga/sang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chen bka' drin bskyang dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul bar dgyes bzhin zhal gyis ba'es/ dbang gnang bar nye ba na sku drung du/ nged dang rtse'i sku mdun mkhan po/ mchod dpon chen mo bcas yo da skabs mchod dpon gyis/ dbang gnang rgyur phyag dpe 'dra snyan du klag 'bul dgos sam zhus song bar bzhad mo gnang zhing mi dgos rang re tsho skad cha 'dra gleng gsungs/ kho gnyis thon rjes nged rang gcig pu yod pa la zhal nas mchod dpon de skad zer mod gsang bde 'jigs gsum ngedangakyi lag cha yin pas gsar du dpe klog dgos pa med ces phebs/ de nas dbang gsan mkhan gyi ming tho brgyab pa drug stong lhag byung pas/ rje bla ma mchog nas tshogs pa de tsam la lhan cig tu dbang bskur na gral gyi mtha' na 'khod pa rnams kyis mi thos shing / dbang rdzas 'grem pa yang dka' ba dang / 'du khang du'ang mi chud pa bcas tshan pa gnyis su bcad nas dbang lan gnyis bskur pa las 'os mi 'dus/ phebs pa bzhin tshan gnyis su bgos pashaṃ dang po gsan mkhan/ brag

da gangasacanaljongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 383g.yab sprul sku/ rgyal sras sprul sku/ rje drung sprul sku/ sems dpa' sprul sku/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku/ kho bo cag pi lig thu no min han sogs dam pa'i skye phring 'dzin pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams dang /rgyud smad4 bla ma gnyis/ ser 'bra/sa dge gsum gyi grwa tshang so so'i bla ma gdan zur/ ra stod skyor lung sogs dgon pa gzhan gyi mkhan po'i rigs sogs chos kyi gdan /phri 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma/ rgyud pa tshogasayongs dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang ba tshogs yongs/ chos sde chen po gsum gyis gtso ba'i bshad sgrub kyi sde du ma nas 'dus pa'i thub pa'i brtul zhugs dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i sde sno da 'dzin pa ches mang ba bcas khyon tshogs pa sum stong tsam 'dus pa la ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du nyin snga mar sta gon dang rjes mar dngos gzhi mdzad nas 'phagasadze lugs gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu so gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa smin rgyas su bka' drin stsal/dbang gi gsung bshad dang phyag len shin tu rgyas pas sta gon nyin gung yol tsam nas tshogs pa/ nam gyi sum rngo dang po rdzogs kyi bar dang / dngos gzhi gung ma zin tsam du tshugs pa grol dus nam phyed tsam la slebs 'dugade yang thog ma'i gsu/nga bshad bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs bskyed tshos/sa bsags sangasri rgyas tshul mdo sngags kyi lugs mi 'dra ba mang po dang / de nas chos gsungs tshul spyi dang bye brag tu rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsungs tshul/mdo sngags kyi khyad par/ sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi'i rnam dbye/ so so'i lam bkrod tshul/ 'bras bu ma ngon du byed tshul/ de dag las bla med khyad par

384 gangs can tsāngs su chos 'khor rgya 3ra bskor tshul/du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i nang nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud sde thams cad kyi rgyal po yin tshul/ de nyid 'phags bod du dar tshul rnams dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / chos 'di lta bu dang phrad —pa shin tu dkon pas nyams len dgos tshul/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong 'chos tshul dang bcas pa shin tu zab cing rgya che ba yid 'khul nges pa gnang nas/ dbang dngos gzhi'i dus su phyag len phra mo re yan chad rgyud dang rgya gzhung rje yab sras kyi gzhung gi khungs dang sbyar/ dbang gi ngo bo dang nag pa rnams la dka' ba'i gnas la dwogs dpyod dang grub don gtan la 'bebs pa'i gsung bshad mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa mang po bka' drin stsal/ phyag len kyang sla chos cung zad kyang mi mdzad par tha na dpung skud sum stong lhag la rdor mdud gsum re rje rang gis gnang te sngar nas nyer bsdogs mdzad pa dang / dbang gi dus mig dar me tog nas bzung dbang rdzas thams cad sku dngos kyis phebs nas 'grems pa las mchod g.yog sogs la gtad nas 'grems pa gcig kyang mi mdzad la/ so shing dang me tog 'dor ba yang slob ma gcig kyang ma lus pa la 'dor 'jug pa dang / so shing gi dngos grub dang me tog phog pa'i lha so sor ngo sprod pa dang gsang ming 'dogs pa rnams kyang gcig kyang ma chad pa mdzad/ de dus tshur mthong gi snang ngor spyan mi gsal ba'i tshul dang sku yang gcong ba'i rnarma pas tshogs chen po de tsam la dbang rdzas lan gcig tsam 'grem par phebs pa yang 'o brgyal ba'i tshod yin kyang / bstan pa'i gyun la dgongs pas sku ngal ba khyad du bsad de phyag len phra mo re tshun chad

dngas can sngongs su tshos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 385la zhib cha gnang ba ni/ rang nyid dam pa tshad ldanatsho gyi ngang tshul ngom pa dang / deng sang gi dbang bskur byed par rlom pa'i 'gying bag can dbang chog kha nas ci thon dang dbang rdzas phal cher khris po bzhin bsdams nas mchod g.yog la bskur bar byed pa rnams la co 'dri bar mdzad pa nyid do//de ltar rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma lothug gi bar brgyud pa mi bar khyis ma chod cing / dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyis lhad ma zhugs pa byin rlabs kyi drod dang ma bral ba'i smin byed kyi dbang zab mo rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan du ma'i gzhung gi khungs dang legs par sbyar/ rje bla ma'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa ma nor bar 'dzin pa dpal ldan srad rgyud dang smad rgyud dbe+en sa rgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung sgros kyis zur brgyan/ rgyud don mngon du gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal shes dang phyag len mthong brgyud ma nor bas gzhung bsrangs te shin tu smin rgyas su stsal pas/ mkhyen dpyod rmad du byung ba'i sprin gyi ba gam nas bsgrags pa'i phul du byung ba'i legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga sgras dpyod ldan mkhas pa gtsug phud can rnams dga' ba'i mngal khur ci yang brtas/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char gyis snod ldan slob ma'i rgyud kyi zhing sa ni legs par brlan/ sku bzhi rin po che'i myu gu myur du 'khrungs pa'i sa bon ni brtan par thebs/ dus kyi mthar yang gsang chen bstan pa'i pad tshal phyogs kun tu rgyas pa'i dga' ston ni rgyal cher spel/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhul bzhad cing

3skye6 gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ so so'i zhing nas legs bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi dbu 'phang mthon por gyur te khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa dus kyi mthar yang mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /dbang gi mjug tu dam tshig dang sdom pa gces par bsrung ba dang / sgrub pa la 'bad pa lhur len dgos pa'i bslab bya nan tan du mdzad cing / dpon slob thun mong nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo ba dang gsang ba 'dus pa'i smon lam shis brjod sogs rgyas par mdzad/ 'di dus sta gon gyi bdag bskyed gsung skabs mgul cham gyi rnam pas mgrin pa cung zad mi bde ba'i tshul gyis cho ga sogs shub bur gsung dgos byung ba la/ mchod dpon mkhan pos 'di 'dra yin na dbang gnang rgyu dka' ba 'dra bas zhag kha shas kyi bar 'then pa mdzad na legs sam zhus pas/ de 'dra mi dgos dga' mo yong 'gro zhes phebs/ gsol dzigs kyi skabs phud kyis mgon chos gnyis la gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol mdzad pas mgul ba mi bde ba phral du sangs kyis dwangs nas/ dbang gi sta gon gyi gsung bshad sogs la cung zad kyang mi gnod pa byung bas phyag g.yog pa thams cad ya mtshan cing mos gus lhag par 'phel/ phyi nyin tsam nas chos nyan snga mar ma chud pa'i dge 'dun sum stong lhag tsam la slar yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa nyin gnyis kyi ring snga ma bzhin stsal/ de nas mi ring bar rgyud stod grwa tshang nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du/ sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / dpon slob dge bshes drags rigs/

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 38lha rgyud grwa yongs rdzogs bcas khyon dge 'dun nyis stong lhag tsam la/ grub chen ci/ i pa'i lugs kyi dpapa 'khor lo sdom pa lhasgrudrug ngari rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed zab mo'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa nyin gnyiṭa nyi ring legs par stsal/ 'di skabs kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi che ba dang de nyid bcu bzhi dang sbyar te dbang don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i gsung bshad zab mos mtshon/ thog mtha' bar gsum du mkhas par grags pa gzhan gyis thon par dka' ba'i legs bshad kyi dga' sto na rgya chen po dang / phyag len rnams zhib rgyas su stsal pas rnam dpyod can rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par drangs shing / skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi rgyud khar sku bzhi'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun par mdzad/ )de nas skabs shig rnam par rgyol ba phan bde legs bshad gling pas gdan drangs te tshogs dbur phebs/ tshogs pa dang lhan du yi dam chos skyong gi cho ga nyin gcig gi bar du gsung ba gnang zhing / tshogs yongs la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i ras bris la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bka' drin stsal to/ / 3prerjod 'das sku dang zhing khams 'byams klas pa'i/ /ngo mtshar kun byed lhan skyes rol pa'i gan/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bar bzhengs pa dang po'i mgon/ /'di na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs su snang / /de yi rang snang ye shes gzhal yas khang / /gnyis med gnyis sra snang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /chu zla'i rol pa 'ja' tshon ri mo bzhin/ /skal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir mngon sprul nas/ /'groci rgyud bde gshegs snyi nga po dbang

3skyeskye gangs can sngongs su tshis 'khor rgya chir bskor tshul/ na—4 gi rgyal/— /glo bur dri mas ring nas ches sbags pa/ /rnam dag dbang gi chu bos nyer bkrus te/ /gsang gsum rang 'od 'byin pa'i nus pa bskrun/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom dri ma kun/ /dpyad gsum chu yis dag byas rnam 'byed gdong / /ngom pas legs bshad dpal la sred rnams yid/ /mngon 'dod rgyas pas gzhan la dga' blo dor/ /gang yang 'di na bcos ma'i me tog dang mtshungs ltar snang cho gas byis pa 'brid pa'i sgyu thabs lhur len par/ /blun po'i 'khor gyis rdo rje 'dzin ces bstod pa'i ca co nor skyong mgul ba'i g.yer kha'i sgra bzhin sgrog mang yang /nyes pa kun sbyong sku gsum sa bon shugs drag bskyed cing bsrings pa'i rnam dag dbang bzhi mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi 'dzin mar bskyil mkhas sngon med skal ldan shing rta 'di 'dra u durdza ra las kyang dkon/ /1gro ba kun la stong nyid snying rje'i phyag /zung 'jug dam du 'khyud pa'i ma 'dres bshes/ /khyod las gzhan du rdo rje 9chang ba'i lha//dkyil 'khor gang du btsal kyang su yis rnyed/ /shes bya'i 'khor lo lhan skyes bde ba cher/ /sdom mdzad shrī he ru kaḥkhyod nyid la/ /rdo rje'i stangs stabs gcig gis khro bo kun/ /'jigs par byed pa'i dpa' bo che yang khyod/ /thog ma mtha' bral bsam brjod las 'das kyang / /gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang / /don dam sems sogs sna tshogs mtshan 'chang ba'i/ /khyab bdag nges don bla mar bdag skyabs mchi//phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gdan drangs/ bla ma las sna rnam/sa kyi bsu ba dang

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 389grwa tshang bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs sogs bkur sti bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas phebs nas dga' ldan pho brang du bzhugs/ mchod khang chen mor gdan drangaso te dkar spro rgyas pa dang dngos 'bul phul/ grwa tshang phan tshun gyi dge bshes gnyis kyis tshogs gleng bgyis pa gsan cing tshogs pa la lam rim gyi chos thun gcig dang / dge 'dun lnga stong tsam la mjal kha phyag dbang kanang / de mtshungs dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang /mkhas mang blo gsal gling / bde yang zab yangs 'khyil ba rnams kyi so so 'i chos grwar gdan drangs/ dkar spro zhus shing rigs pa smra ba'i 'bel gtam gyi tshogs gleng dang so so'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ sgo mang du lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum la lung rigs kyi mtha' chod pa'i gzab bshad dang / blo gsal gling du rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma'i bshad lung / bde yang du lta khrid bcas gnang / lta khrid 'di la grub mtha' bzhi ka'i lta ba'i 'dod tshul dang / khyad par du thal 'gyur pa'i lta ba'i rnam bzhag rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa shin tu phra ba rnams zhib tu gsungs pas/ dbu ma'i gzhung lugs la mi tshe ril por sbyangs shing brgal brtags kyis gzhung don gtan la phab pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams yid lhag par drangs te/ legs bshad rmad du byung ba 'di 'dra thos tshe bdag cag gi slob gnyer ni tshig gi na yam tsam la mgo 'khor bar zad kyi/ dka' ba'i gnas 'di lta bu la dpyod pa zhugs pa tsam yang mi 'dug na ji bzhin shes pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bas na rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i

390 gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/rnam par byon pa zhig tu gdon mi za'o/ /zhes bsngags pa bajod ci nga dus re zhig gi bar du grwa tshang so so'i chos grwa sogs su dge bshes chen po rnams tshogs pa na rje bla mas 'doms par mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi gleng brjod 'ba' zhig sgrog par byed do/ /sngags pa grwa tshang gis 'du khang du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang mjal kha zhus shing / 'jam lugs tshe dpag lha lnga'i dze+es su gnang ba bka' drin stsal/ bsam blo khams tshan gyis rgyud khang du dkar spro zhujuni thog kho bo cag dang hal ha dge bshes rgya mtsho gnyis kyis tshogs gleng bgyis par thugs dgyes pa chen po mdzad/ dgon lung mi tshan nas tshoms su shing thorga/ bzhes 'bras sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang mjal kha zhus shing tshoms kyi bar thog tu kho bo sdod pa'i khang chung du phebs/ 'byor 'khos kyi dkar spro dang 'bul nod mtshon tsam phul/ nang gtsang lugs kyi thurga/sa lhod pa mdzad cing bka' blon mdo mkhar ba zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal phyag phyir yod pa la chos kyi bka' mchid mang po zhig gnang / zhabs drung 'di pa 'jig rten gyi mes po lta bu la mdo sngags rig gnas gang la yang mkhyen pa phul du byung ba dang thugs dam dmar ba gang ci nas gang zag phul du byung ba zhig 'dug ces phyis su yang bsngags brjod che ba ma dzad/ ri khrod dge 'phel bas dga' ldan pho brang du mjal kha dang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ljang sngon gyi rjes gnang zhus pa bzhin gnang / grwa sa grwa tshang khams tshan mi tshan so so la mang 'gyed sogs kyi gsol ras gya nom pa stsal te lha sar phyir phebs/ de nas se ra theg chen gling du byon/ spyi sgyer so so'i gsol ston

gangs can ljongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 391'bul nod dang dge 'dun rnams kyi mjal kha sogs 'bras spungs kyi dpe 'dra la/ bka' chos tshogs chen du byang chub lam kyi sgron ma bshad pa zab cing mdor 'dril ba zhig bka' drin stsal/ byes pa grwa tshang gi chos grwar gdan drangs nas lam gtso'i bshad lung dang / smad pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang du rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis kyi yig cha ltar sgrol ma nyer gcig la tshom bu so sor bkod de spyi chings gcig gi steng nas stabs cig tu bskur ba'i rjes gnang dang / sngags pa grwa tshang gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ se ra'i dge 'dun yongs rdzogs kyi steng du 'bras spungs sogs phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i tshogs pa bzhi stong du nye ba la bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnamyo/ par snang mdzad kyi dbang chen smin rgyas su bka' drin stsal to/ /sa yi nyi zla zung zhes grags dkar gyi/ /ba dan srid pa 'di na mngon mtho ba/ /'asdis dkar spuXs 'dra blo gsal bste ba'i gnas/ / ste shing dwa bas bskor ba'i chos kyi sde/ /zla shel ba gam bzhad pa'i khang mig tshogs/ /ston gnam rgyu skar bkra la co 'dri zhing / /norwa 'dzin bu mo'i mun pa'i bla gos ni/ /rgya phibs 'od zer rnon pos 'dral byed pa/ /der ni pad+ma rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du/ /dzire rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug glu len bzhin/ /gzhung lugs bcud kyis blo gros lus brtas pa'i/ /bgrang yas mkhas pa lung rigs dbyangs snyan sgrogs/ /nam zhig rirga/ grol smra ba de dag la/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'e dga' ston 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi rgyal po smra ba'i nyi ma ma/cho ga /mkhas pas bteg pa'i khri la zhabs

392 gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/pad bkod/ /chu 'dzin stug pos n+d+ra char 'jo ba dang / /'odu stong can gyis 'on zer 'gyed pa bzhin/ /legs bshad dka' gnad legs par 'domazlo pa la/ /snyo chen 'di yi blo grormi thogs med pas/ /dorno bzang gser gyi ge sar rnam rgod cing / /sdigs lam bye ba'i dri bzang ngad 'thul ba'i/ /legs bshad pad+ma gsaXr ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs rnams mgron du bos/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i tsan dan nags klong nas/ /rang rang lta ba'i bzhed tshul mngar ba'i dri/ /legs 'doms gsung gi bser bus bkug pa yis/ /mkhas rnams yidra la sim pa'i tshor ba myong / /rtog ge'i lag ldan khengs pa'i myos bum can/ /mtha' dag lung rigs nga ros spa bkong ste/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gragasapa'i rnga bo che/ /brdungs pas 'jig rten thams cad sad par mdzad/ /rgya chen gtong bas phal rnams tshim mdzad cing / /legs bshad skyes kyis mkhas rnams mgu bar mdzad/ /sgrub pa'i mchod dzo/sa rgyal rnams dgyes bskyed pa'i/ /rnam thar 'ari la blo ldan su mi dad//de nas phur bu lcog tu phebs/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa chen po rje byams pa'i mtshan can dang phan tshun gdan 'dzoms/ zhag gcig bzhugs pa'i ring la nyin mtshan 'khyongs par chos kyi bgro ba mdzad/rje byams pa'i myo/tshan can gyis gtso mdzad ri khrod pa rnams dang bcas pas ye shes khyung khri'i rjes gnang byabs khrus dang 'brel ba gsan/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang spyan mi gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad pa yin pa la gsung gleng mdzad pa'i lhong k+ṣi/ga la khyed kyi rten gsum khrod kyi bla macizhwa dmar po can zhig tre

ske gongs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 393'dug pa de gang yin zhes glo bur du bka' 'dri gnang byung bar/ byams pa rin po ches nga'i lha rten khrod du de 'dra med 'gro gsungs nye gnas rab 'byams pa blo bzang dar rgyas la zhib tu btsal 'jug pa gnang bas slob dpon gyi sku zhig thon/ 'di e yin zhus par de ga yin 'dug gsungs/rje phur bu lcog pas/ nga khang ba 'dir rgyun du sdod pas snga phan sku 'dra 'di yod pa ma shes pa la nyid nas 'phral du mkhyen byung ba ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs/ rje phur bu lcog pas bsnyen bkur 'bul nod dang rje lcang skya rin po ches kyang rgya nas phebs skyos tshul gyi dngos po sna tshogs 'bul ba mdzad/ra kha brag dang se ra rtse'i ri khrod rnams su'ang phebs/ se ra rtser mkhas grub rje'i sgrub phug cig yod pa rtsad gcod pa gnang ba la lam dka' tshul zhus par/ skyon med nged rang lam 'di nas 'gro rgyu yin gsungs nas gnas der rgyun du 'khod pa rnams la rgyus med pa'i lam zhig nas byon pas dka' ba med par sgrub phug tu phebs pas thams cad ya mtshan par gyur cing / 'di 'dra'i brag phug tu sdod rgyu byung na skyid pa la zhes dbe+en pa la dgyes pa'i gsung gan nga / de nas lha sar phebs/ thugs 'gol ba zhig gi skabs kho bos rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang man ngag rnams brtse gzigs dgos tshul gsol ba btab par/ de sa lugs kyi man ngag yin pa la khyod kyis don gnyer byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin gsung /rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig yod pa zhib tu zhus pas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas khyod kyi skye ba gong ma de nyid kyang rnal 'byor ma la thugs dam mdzad kyi yod/gsang shin tu dam pas nged rang ma gtogs sus kyang mi shes/ da khyod

3nya4 gangs can ljongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/kyis gzhan sus kyang ma shes pa gyis dang tshes bcu zhig dang 'grig pa byas nas byin rlabs dang de nas khrid kyi skor rnams byed gsungs zhal bzhes mdzad byung bas dbul pos gter rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' spro thob/ mi ring bar tshes bcu zhig gi nyin kho bo cag mi gsum la sirnyu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo smin rgyas dang / de nas nged gcig pur thugs brel gyi gseng bar rnams su bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid/ be'u bum khrod kyi chos tshan kha shas kyi klag lung rnams stsal byung ba byang chub snying po'i bar du bka' drin gzhal dka' ba nyid do/ /yang kho bos gsol ba btab pa bzhin rgyal sras ma/chog sprul rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku/ dge bshes drags rim rags bsdus bcas khyon brgya phrag lhag tsam la bsam 'grub khang gsar gyi kyi+oms chen du byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi dmar khrid/ drung pa rta phug pa nas brgyud pa so sor gyes pa'i khrid rgyun mang po zhig gsan pa rnams gcig tu dril ba'i 'khrid tshul gyis nyin bdun gyi ring la myong khrid kyi tshul gyis stsal/ 'di dus khrid dmigs byings rnams 'gag don dril nas myong ba la bkar ba'i tshul gyis rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa dang / gnad 'gag gal che ba rnams la lung rigs kyis brgyan pa'i gsung bshad gnad phug pas go ba ster phul che zhing /dben sa bka' brgyud kyi zabyā khyad bla ma 'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog tu byanu/ nas mdo sngags zung 'brel du skyong tshul gegs sel zhing bogs 'byin thabs sogs kyi man ngag zhal shes mang po dang bcas bka' drin stsal byung bas/chos nyan gye dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po rnams ni gdams pa 'di thob

404 gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i dkyil tsho'akhor chen po'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa 'brom btsun sher 'byung blo gros kyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par stsal/ bod du rgyun chad nas yun ring song ba'i chos r+ghaṃn gsos pa bdud kyis ma bzod pa lta bus sta gon nyin dbang la tshogs phral du sngar mi grags pa'i rlung 'tshub chen po langs pa'i 'ur sgras gsung bshad mi thos pa'i tshod lta bu byung yang / bgegs gtor phyir thon pa dang dus mnyam du 'jam nyal gyis rang zhir gyur/ spyod rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang las gzhan pa'i dbang —rgyun zur ba mi 'dug cing / rje yab sras nas brgyud pa'i rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang rgyun chad nas dge lugs pa la rgyud sde bzhi ma tshang ba bstan 'dzin du zhal gyis spyo'ache ba rnams kyi mtshang du che ba 'dug rung / phal cher gyis rgyun ja gcig chad pa tsam gyi rtsis kyang mi mdzad pa la/ rje phur bu rtsog pas thugs kyis ma bzod par nan tan gyis zhu ba mdzad par brten rje bla ma mchog nas smin byed kyi dbang bka' drin stsal pa spyod rgyud srog gi chad 'thud du gyur/ der ma zad thun drug gi rnal 'byor ni gangs can gyi gser chos su grags pa rnams kyis cha tsam yang bsgrun du med pa'i rgyal ba dgyes pa'i nyams len rmad du byung bar bsngags shing / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan bar du khrid kyi rgyun bar ma chad du byon pa/ de phyin chad nyag je phrar gyur te da lta khrid rgyun de 'dra yod pa'i gtam tsam yang mi snang la/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rim gnyis kyi sdon 'gros mtshon skabs du mar med mi rung yin pa la rje bla ma nas dpal ldan srad rgyud pa rnams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya jir bskor tshul/ 40bye de rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi bar du byon pa'i bla med lugs kyi rdor sems yab yum gyi rjes gnang yang deng sang bod du rgyun rtsa ba nas chad 'dug ba/ rje bla ma 'di nyid gangs ljongs su byon nas bshad ma thag pa de dag gis mtshon pa'i chos rgyun rtsa ba nas chad pa deng nyag shin tu phra ba mang bo zhig snga phyir gso bar mdzad pa 'di ni chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i blos dpyad na mkhas pa mgu ba'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin par snang mod/ rnam thar bzang po la bzad por shes pa dang ngan pa la ngan par shes pa'i rnam dpyod can deng sang gi dus su nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin ches dkon cing / rgya la re gnyis mchis kyang skye bo rmongs pas 'gro ba dang 'dun pas 'gro ba dang 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang zhe sdang gis 'gro ba rnams kyi khrod du mon spa gro ba'i rdor gcod kyi dper 'gyur pa las 'os ma mchis so/ /rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling pas spyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang gi gsol ba btab ste/ gsan mkhan snga ma dang 'dra ba la po ta la'i tshoms chen du rje bla ma nyid nas/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis 'khor lo chen po'i skur bzhengs nas drag po gsum gyi gdon la sogs pa gdug pa can mtha' dag btul te rtsa rgyud drag po gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud gsungs pa de nyid las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas phyung ste/ grub chen sa wa ri pa la bka' babs pa/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos yi dam gyi gtso bo zhig tu mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa smin rgyas su stsal/ 'dul 'dzin pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la cung zad kha bskang dgos yod

406 da wa gangasacan ljongs su chosa'akhorargyacherabaskoratshul/ pa rnams bskangs te/ 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i lhun po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba phral du ljags rtsom mdzad cing / phyis su lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog sbyin sreg rnams kyang rim pas bka(spru drin bskyangs/ bskyed rdzogs zhig kyang mdzad rgyu'i dgongs gtad che ba yod kyang ma grub 'dug gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po 'di gangs ljongs su gsang bdag gi skor che ba can brgyad tsam byung ba'i nang na rgyal mtshan gyi ༷tog ltar gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ rje rgyal ba gnyis/ pas gsang bde dus 'khor gsum la mchog sgrub pa'i lhag pa'i lha gsum dang / 'jigs byed 'khor chen gnyis la bar chad sel ba'i lha gnyis zhes yi dam du mdzad pa'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can sras kyi thu bo rnams kyis yig cha ci rigs mdzad cing thugs gtsigs che ba zhig yin na'ang / dus phyis lam bzang po 'di'i srol nub par nye ba rje bla ma mchog gis nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa dal ba'i rten la snying po blang bar 'dod pa rnams la bka' drin bla lhag tu che ba snang ngo / /bka' chos bka' drin bskyangs pa 'di rnams dus snga phyi ci rigs su stsal pa yin na'ang / 'dir phar cher phyogs mtshungs su bkod par byas so/ / snyesngon byon ma/khas grub du mas sku srog la/ /ltos pa med par rgya gar 'phags yul nas/ /ljongs 'dir nyer drangs chos rgyun nyal 'gro kun/ /chu thigs go 'phang 'dzin la mngon phyogs tshe/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam mthu grub pa'i/ /bdag gi bla ma chos kyi sprin chen 'dis//'chad nyan gru char rgyun gyis nyer bskyangs pas/ /bshad sgrub lhung lhung

zhangs can sngongs su tshas 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 4khye1sgrogs bzhin 'phel bar gyur/ /skal bzang shes rgyud rus pa bkrus pa'i mod/ /grub mchog mtho ris rtse dga' 'dzin byed pa/ /zab rgyas gdams pa lha chu gtsang ma'i rgyun/ /'di yi mkhyen dpyod ral ba'i klong nas phab/ /grangs med bskal par bya dka'i spyod pa yi/ /gom pa 'degs 'jog ngal bar mi ltos par/ tshe thung yun la thabs mkhas gom d+ku//cig gis/ /sa lam ma lus bgrod pa'i 'phrul kyang bstan/ gang gi zha sa bzang pad+ma tshems dkar gyi/ /ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba rgod pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /zab rgyas legs bshad rtsi bcud mngar bo'i chang / /'thungs pas rab myos skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i dar dir cir yang sgrogs bzhin du/ /ci nus rtsal gyis dad brtson 'dab gshog zung //lam bzang mkha' la bskyod pa'i gar byed pas/ /thub bstan skyed tshal yongs su 'gedus par gyur/ /bstun pa'i gnyen 'dis 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis/ /bkaun la dgyes rgur rol ba 'di mthong tshe/ /bstaXn la bya ba ci yang mi nus pa'i/ /bkaun 'dzin 'di dag ma ning lta bur sems/ /mkhyen nga 'i ye shesda dkyil 'khor rgyas pa las/ /thub bstan sa chen kun nas snang byed pa'i/ /legs bshad 'od kyi sgron sdo 'bum shāgyed pa/ /rgyal ba'i gdung ༷dzāzab khyod la phyag bgyi'o/ / skabs shig dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs bzhed kyis lha sa nas chibs bsgyur gnang / am pan ha ching nga bka' blon thon pa/mchod dpon sde drug mkhan po bcas dang / kho bo yang zhabs/ phyir phyin/mtshal dang gung thang gi rten mjal mdzad cing der bzhugs zhag gam/nga /

40skye gings can sngongs su ‘sa 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul /phyi nyin dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi shar byang chos rje gnyis dang /las sna sogs rta pa mang po'i chibs bsu dang / thab 'dzin dkar spro sogs zhus/ rim gyis bgrang yas rgyal ba sras bcas 'du badhare bsnyi gnas dag pa'i snang ngor rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por lhun gyis grub cing / tha mal gyi snang ngor yang gtsang zhing dben la bag phebs pa rig pa dwangs shing nyams rtogs dang dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pas bdud kyi sde mtha' dag bcom nas zung 'jug lki go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas bod yul gyi rdo rje'i gdan 'brog ri bo che dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phyag phebs/ gdan sa chen po dang khad nye bar phebs pa na/ dgon pa'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' na sprin dkar po bla bres kyi dbyibs can 'ja' kha dog sna tshogs mtha' 'jags kyi tshul du bkra ba dang / ri klung phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'ja' tshon 'dres ma'i sprin dkar gyi dum bu gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang mchod lha sogs ci rigs pa'i dbyibs su chags pa rnams rje bla ma 'byon pa'i phyogs su dal gyis 'ongs te g.yas su bskor ba'i tshul gyis dkrig cing / rma chen gyi rten tho'i thad nas sprin dkar phra la ring ba zhig tshur dar yug brkyangs pa bzhin byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma mig gi bdud rtsir spungs pas/bdag cag zhabs 'brang ba rnams shin tu ya mtshan che bas 'di na de na zhes gcig si/sa gcig la smra ba'i ca co che ba la/ rje bla ma mchog nas ci 'dug gsung byung bar mchod dpon gyis ya mtshan can rnams zhus par/'ud ma sgrog par kha rog tu dmigs brtse ma thon ces phebs mtshams

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 409sprin gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu'i ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i ser sbrengs dang / gtsug lag khang dang spyil bu rnams su dar 'phyar dung 'bud so gas rten 'brel rmad du byung ba'i bkod bshams dang bcas khri thog khang du phebs/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab khri chen bsam gtan phun tshogs pas gzim khang gi phyi logs nas bsus te nang du phebs nas phyag 'bul bcas mjal rmā zhu ba mdzad/ phral du gser gdung chen mos gtso ba'i rten pyi/ gtso bo rnams la mchod mjal mdzad/ phyi nyin rnams su rim gyis 'du khang chen mo dang shar byang so so'i chos grwar gdan drangs nas dkar spro 'bul nod/ spyi sger gyi dge 'dun rnamakha5 kyis mjal kha zhus/ tshogs chen la lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas chos sgron gcig tsam dang / shar rtser mkhas grub chig brgyud kyi bla mazhi rnal 'byor/ byang rtser bla ma mchod pa'i khrid rnams bka' drin rma la/ khri rin po che shar byang gi chos rje gnyis sogs la 'bul nod dang dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed kyi/ gsol ras gya nom pa stsal/cha phu brag sob kyi ri khrod pa rnams kyig mjal kha dang chos 'brel zhus par/rje ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan yun ring bzhugs nas thugs dam nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i gnas yin gsungs thugs dgyes pa mdzad/ nyin gcig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs gcig tu bsdus pa'i za ma tog sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang mchod pa dang phyag bya ba'i gnas su gyur pa/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel ba thogs pa thams cad snyed pa las rnam par grol pa/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i skyu gdung yid bzhin

410 gangs can ljongs su chos 'alo/ ra rgya cher bskor tshul/nor bu snying por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rin po che'i drung du phebs / mchod pa'i khyad par bzang zhing rgya che ba bshams/ rje bla ma nyid gser gdung la zhal phyogs par bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon ci rigs par bdag cag zham 'brang ba rnams 'khod pas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med du bltas te dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rgyas pa/ rje bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i smon lam sogs nan tan du mdzad/de dus rje bla mas bdag la mchod rten gyi mdun du bzhugs pa'i yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan las ring bsrel 'byung bar grags pas khyod kyis ltos shig gsung ba bzhin bltas pas ma mthong ba la/ sku brnyan gang rung zhig gi dbu zhwa dal bus zhus gsungs/ mkhas grub rje'i dbu zhwa blangs pas ring bsrel kha shas mdun gyi ting phor gyi nang du ting sgra dang bcas lhung ba phyag tu phul bas gcig de phral zhal du gsol ba gnang / sang nyin nged rang gcig pu song nas ring bsrel thob tu re bas sku brnyan gsum ga'i dbu zhwa zhus kyang ring bsrel gcig kyang ma byon no/ /de nas mchod khang so so'i phyi nang gi rten rnams la zhib mjal gnang zhing / la dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan shin tu gnyan pa'i druja du phebs nas nyid sa/cig pus 'jam dpal bka' nyan ma dang 'chi bdag ma gsung bzhin dbu dang rwa gnyis bcas la phyag gis reg cing ljags nas 'then 'then lta bu gnang /'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos go khrab ya mtshan can zhipos/ 'bul rgyu bskyur gnang mdzad pa phul te 'phrin bcol zil che ba zhig mdzad/ sta

gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshul/ 411ma lha sa ma/sa la mo chos skyong chen pos gdan sa dga' ldan du 'bod pa btang na gsang lung 'ga' zhig smra rgyu yod cing / byad grol zhig kyang phul na dgos pa che zhes phebs yod pa bzhin/ 'di skabs sa/zim chung du sku phebs gnang / lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa chen pos gsang ba'i lung mang po zhig dang / chos skyong rang nas byad grol kyang 'bul bar mdzad/ nyin gcig gling skor du phebs pas rgyab ri'i g.yas zur gyi lam sne nas lung pa'i mthil du grong chung zhig na bsangs kyi dud pa chen po thon pa snyan du phul bas grong ba de'i ming la ci zer gsungs/ rgyunu/ yod pa gcig gis mtha' rgyas zer lags zhus pas rten 'brel bzang gsungs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ de ni rje bla ma nyid kyi bka' drin kyi mthu las dus kyi mtha' dang sa 'i mtha' thams cad du rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bsta—na pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel shin tu bzang bar sems de nas rim gyis phebs par skor lam gyi steng 'og kun tu rang byon gyi sku brnyan yig 'bru sna tshogs dang / rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes byon pa mang du 'dug pa rnams gsang sngags mkhar ba dge bshes zhig gis so so'i lo rgyus zhib tu gsol/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho phebs dus gsar du byung ba yin zer ba rdo zhig la 'bur dod kyis rje bla ma'i sku'i rnam pa gsal bar thon pa zhig kyang gzigs rtog phul/ sus yin mi shes pa'i zhabs rjes zhig mjal skabs rje bla mas kho bo la sku rtsed tshul gyis zhabs rjes 'di rnying ma ba nig gi yin 'dug pas/ khyed cag phur bu rtsog pa'i slob ma rnams kyis 'dzem pa legs gsungs byung bar/ rje bla ma'i gdan sar rnying mas (nabs rjes

— 412 gangs can sngongs su chos 'khor rgya cher bskor tshulaga'ajog thub na/ bde ba can gyi rin po che'i sa gzhi la nged nas kyang rkang rjes zheg 'be+ebar+sā lags zhuri shrī pas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba byung /phyis su rtsad bcad pari na zhabs rjes de 'khon ston gyi yin pa'i gtam brgyud yod zer bas/ de lta na rje bla mas sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung byon pa gor ma chag go /rma chen gyi lha tho'i thad du phebs nas rje bla ma yab sras kyisi/ 'jig rten pa'i lha srung bsten pa mi mdzad pas/ 'khrungs lha rma chen gyi lha tho yang skor lam nang du ma chud cing / snga ma dadwa/re lda na khri pa 'ga' 'i/ga gis dos rgyal bsten pas bkra mi shis pa byung ba khri chen rdo rje 'chang ginu / kho'i lha rten sogs bshigs nas dgon pa nas bskrad pa'i lo rgyus sogs zhib tu gsung / lam bar dang lha sar phebs nas kyang da res dga' ldan du sdod ring gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung zhe'i/ yang yang gsungs pas/ de la dpags na dga' ldan du dag pa'i rnam rol khyad par can mang du byung ba 'dra yang dngos su sa/sungs pa ma thos so de nas gdan sa chen po dga' ldan nas chibs bskyod mdzad de gas nga sngags ma/bar du bzhugs zhag mdzad/ rje bla mas chos 'khor bskor ci nga sngags grwa thog mar btsugs pa'i gnas yin gsungs thugs shin tu spro ba mdzad/yer pa lha rir phebs nas gnas dang rten rnamaṭa5 la zhib mjal gnang / de kalī dge 'dun rnams kyis zhus pa bzhin bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang rgyas par stsal/ yer pa 'dir thig le'i sgrub pa zhig byed rgyu byung na bsam pa snga ma nas yod kyang byed rgyu ma byung / da lan dbang 'di bskur rgyu byung ba shin tu legs byung zhes dgyes tshor shin tu che ba mdzad /

gengs can tsāngs su chos 'khor rgya chir bskor tshul/ 413der bzhugs ring thugs nyams shin tu spro bas gsung mgur mang bo 'then pa gnang zhing / bdag cag zham 'brang ba rnams la jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar dang bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros mang po zhig gsung gleng tshul gyis 'doms pa mdzad/ nyin gcig byams khang du mjal bar phebs pa'i lam du shing sdong gi rtse mor skya ka zhig skad sna tshogs sgyur ba ched du gsan nas zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad de gser yig zhig sleb rgyu yin pa 'dra dzegasung / de nub gong ma'i bka'i gser yig zhig 'byor byung bas thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de nas phebs lam du bla ma gnyan lo ts+tsha ba dang rwa lo gnyis mthu 'gran par grags pa'i gnyan mgon phug par phebs/ dpal mgon zhal gyi gtor chog bskang gso rgyas pa zhig mdzad/gzhu —t+na yi/sa thab bsu sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus te lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs bsam 'grub khang gsar du phyag phebs so//rgyaskya bag mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan cing / /rgyaskya byā rgya mtshos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /rgyaskya byā gnyis pa'i gdan sa dga' ldan du/ /rgyalda ba'i gdung 'tshob 'di yis zhabs pad bkod/ /de tshe dkar phyogs skyong bah+pho lha spoms kyis/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis phyogs mtshams kun bkang zhing / /rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sdes/ /nabs rdul spyi bos blangs te gus pas btud/ /der ni rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i/ /gzugs sku za ma tog gi snying po can/ /mchod sdong sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyis kyang / /phyag mchod yul du gyur pa de yi drung / /rgyal ba rgya mardo mchod sprin rgya mtshos ma nyes byas te/ /sems can
