da thudzanya zhangs/ can+d+ra/sngong ga su chos 'tsho/ ra rgya cher bskor tshul/swo mardo+ori sdug bsngal rgya ༷man+d+ra skem rma dang / /zhing khams rgya ༷mardo phan bde s+t+waṃ mardosan ragengs pa yi/ /smon lam swo mardo gsung dbyaras rgya ༷mardzus 'dengs/ par mjad/ /gtong ba swo mdz+wa'i rlabs g.yo bas/ (/'dus pa rgya ca/tsho rab tshims shing / /legs bshad rgya mtshos gzur gnas kyi/ /jed r+sha rgyaX patsho 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dge lda/na —bsta0na sride gur kum me tog tshal/ /bka' drin drod kyis skyo nga ba'i nyin byed de/ /mar gad spungs 'dra'i 'brog/ ri'i rtse mo nas/ /dal gyis lha ri snying po'i mgul du 'phags//sngon tshe jo 'brom nyi zla zung 'brel gyis/ /bod yul bka' drin snang bas khyab mdzad pa'i/ /rnam thar ma lus dus 'dir khyod gcig pus/ /gzur gnas rnams la mngon sum nyid du bstan/ /de tshe mi pham chos kyi mdun sa na/ /'jam dpal snying po nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rab dgyes rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor dbus su/ /khyod la bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ / ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ —/khyab bdag rdo rje sem sa dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpaXl bza5 poX rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brdzod ༷pa daṅga ldarno baṅgen shā'i mdzes rgyan las/ gangs can gyi ljongs su zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod de chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //

4tshad—rlutu braco lnga bra/ thod gulka daduspe su zhezhas puzhi dgos puzhi gamyo bro gangaspe can nagon po rgyalka dbrang budun puzhi ldad sprid zhid dazhin nor 'u zhakhyilka ne+ed dzas zhardin nan-id puzhi tshulu/sa stag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nang paṇa chen thams cad masten par mjal 'dzom ched bkra shis lhun por phebs rgyur/ gzhung nas bka' blon gung paṇ+ḍi ta/ rtse'i sku mdun mkhan po/ mchod dpon mkhan po/ mgron gnyer bcas dang / bkas mngags pa'i tā zhin ha ching nga / car go chi/ mi chi ge chi/ ta'i phu sogs rgya mi mang ba bcas lha sa nas phyag bteg tā zhin ha ching nga na gzhon pa dang / gong ma'i bdag rkyen che gras yin pas nga rgyal che zhing / dkon mchog la mi dad cing ngang tshul gtum pa zhig yin pas rje bla ma marngo+og la mi gus pa'i rnam pas gong mar snyan phra zhu 'dun sogs byed kyang / wa skad la seng ge'i ba spu tsam yang mi g.yo ba bzhin rje bla ma mchog nas thugs snang ci yangaci mi mdzad 'dug gnam gyi mdar bzhus/sa zhag mdzad thog rje bla ma glo bur du thugs 'tshub pa'i rnam pas mgon po'i gtor chen zhig phral du 'phen pa gnang / de nub ha ching nga kha sna nas khrag gi rgyun zag ste shi la khad pa byung 'dug cing / mi ring bar kho rang gi bya spyod mi legs pagyigong nas gsan pas dgongs phog gis khrin du

416 bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/phur khrims mun du bcug gtor chen de khong la dmigs nas mjad dam zhes 'ga' zhig gis gleng ba kho bos snyan du gsol bas/ bstan pa'i rim kror dmigs pa las rang don chung ngu de tsam gyi ched du byas pa ga la yin/thon kyang kho ba bstan pa la mi dga' ba'i rigs su 'dug pas zur tsam phog pa yin kyang srid ces gsung / 'brug dang ra lung gi gnas gzigs dang mchod mjal gnang / sangs rgyas sgom pa'i sgrub phug rtsad gcod gnang ba sus kyang mi shes pa la/ rje bla ma nyid nas ngos 'dzin mdzad ces thos/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po nas mgron gnyer sogs rta ba lnga bcu skor/ grwa tshang zur bzhi'i bla ma dang / spyi so/ dge bskos dang mi tshan so so'i rgan pa/ rje drung dpon chos mdzad sogs rta pa brgya phrag du ma'i chibs bsu dang / thab bsu sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus shing / cho+o/ sde'i nub zur nas dge 'dun bla gos gyon pa rnams kyi ser sbrengs dar 'phyar dung 'bud sogs bkur gzos dpe bral lta bu dang bcas chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por phyag phebs/— gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil du snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa paṇa chen tham sa cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po snyo bzang dpūl ldan ye sheg dabhang po dang zhal mjal/ thog mar paṇa chen rmichog rnos sdugobaṃ ma bdaṅge po r+bhan po'i sku'i 'tshams 'dri gnang zhing / de rjes rje bla mas 7paṇa chen rin po cher gyug 'bul mdzad nas khri la bzhugs/ bla brang nas gsol ston rgya che ba'i ja gral thog bstan srid spyi sgos ci rigs pa'i gnas tshul las brtsams pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ tshes grangs bzang po'i nyin rje bla ma mchog nas

n+ded yul dbus su h+phabs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngosa'adzinamadzadatshul/ 411 wa gyipaṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chu+ogs dbur spya na drangs te brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul bar mdza de cing / rje bla ma nyid kyis maṇ+ḍal phyag tu thogs nas mchog gsurwa/ la bstod cing shis pa brjod pa'i bden tshig sngon du btang ste/ paṇa chen mchog gi che ba'i yon tan las brtsams pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad pa ni/ 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyis bsams bzhin du srid par skye ba blangs nas 'gro ba'i don la me tog gi tshal du bung ba dang / ngang pa dwangs pa'i rdzing bu la 'jug pa dang chos mtshungs par ngan song gi gnas kyang mtho ris kyi dga' tshal ltad spro ba lhur lenarnyacing / gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal gyi dbang las mkhas pa dang grub pa dang brtul zhugs spyod pa/ 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po/ blon po/ bya ri dwags/ gru dang zam pa/ zas gos gnas mal sogs sprul pa sna tshogasdo4 bstan nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul ni spyan dang mngon par shes pa mnga' ba la sogs pa ma gtogs/ bdag cag so skye tha mal gyi spyod yul las 'das shing / sku'i skye ba mkhas btsun dam pa rasas rim dang mthun par bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul tsam zhu ba'i dbang du byas na/ sdon bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'dri zhing lan ldon pa'i nyan thos chen po 'phags pa rab 'phyor nas ba thung / byang shasnya lar rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i li+o ba dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed/paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas/ bod kyi yul 'dir gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor rgyas mdzad 'gos lo chen po/ dpal sa skya pa'i gdung ruri na

418 dzad yul dbus su bas te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul /su gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub thob chen po g.yung ston/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i sras byi thu bo bstan pa 'dzin pa la smon lam gyirna mthu grub pa'i mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje bsod nams phyogs glang / grub pa'i dbang rgyug blo bzang don grub/ paṇa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bdag gi mkhan rin po che rje btsun blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po'i bar du rim par phebs te/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i mdzad pa bstan nas rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen po bskrun pa las/ slar yang rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nyid rgyal dang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan 'gro'i dpal du legs par phebs te/ sngon gnas rjes su dran pas mdo sngags kyi gzheng lugs gang la yang mkhas tshul bzhes pa bka' drin che zhing / da dung mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum mthar phyin rdzogs par mdzad de chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin par bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhabs zung rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med bskal brgya'i bar du brtan pa dang / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku zhing 'dir myur du phebs nas dam pa nyid kyi sras su gyur te/ jo 'brom yab sras kyi mdzad pa bzhin yab sras gnyis kyis chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor nas/ bod khams yongs la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa stsol ba/ gong ma bdag po chen po yang dkon mchog bla mar 'dzin cing / bstan pa rin po che la gus pa 'phel ba la brten nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan bde bla lhag tu spel ba'i phyir zhabs pad dgung lo //phri phrag

—bod sdi' dbu— ri nu phediri — skre rgyas dab ra ba na pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 41nyakhri phrag yi/ k+ṣiṃr+sha9 nāri du rngorta byu she cing chab sre da dar zhing rgyas pa dang / bdag nyid kyang yabaXsras gnyis kyiṭa/ rjes su bzung nas gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyod rteri ra dge ngaridun gyi sde dang lha/na cig gso la ba snying thang/ pa nas 'debs rnga/ las/sa/ pas ji ltar d+mo sdusne pa'i re ba 'bras ldan du smin pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po stsol ba rmā /pyen ma/phyen/ ces zhu ba gnang bar/ paṇa chen mchog nas bdag tshur mthong byis pa'i blo can skye 'chi la rang dbang dang nus mthu chung bas khas len byed dka' na yang / rje lcang skya rin po che dang ‘ n-i ge 'dun rnams thugs rtse chir/ drikhapre gyisdo/ mchog gsum la gsol 'debs dang bden tshis/ brjo da nga gnang ba'i mthu la brten byin rlabs 'ong ba gzhir bcas// dalko/na ma chog la gsol ba btab ste 'dun ro byed tshul gyi lan gsung ba gnang / ja sdoshrī ga bla 5/ sogre/sa zhabs phyi ne māṃ sa khyo /sri kyang dadzas 'bul bteg de ḍo/r+sha / rimyori/ bzhin rje bla myo4 rnga4 chos/ du /sdo smu paṇa tshen rin po cher 'jigs pye da ho nga /tsa 5/su 3/ ma ri dbang / 'jigs byed rim gnyis kyi khrid/ cilcags mkhar gyi khrid dang / lung rgyun po/nga yod/ 'khrul 'khor gyi rnam bshad khams gsum rnam rgya1pre dang bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa gnyis kyi lung / rje rin po che nas rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la gnang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i li/ khro sbrags sgrub/'jigs byed ser po la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/ rong ston blo bzang grags pas mdzad pa'i 'khor chen gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi lung / phyag rdo ra 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / chos rgyal nang sgrub dang mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / rgyal dbang ma cho+og gi ljags

da 420 bodayul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pagli yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/rtsom 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i bstod pa/ paṇa chen ma cho go/ nas bka' rtsom mdzad rme'i rje bla ma nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / thugs rje chen po'i gsol 'debs/rī khyung nag gi byabs khrus dang 'jigs byed kyi dug bcoṭashrī rtso/ gas kyi lung bcas gas na pa mdzad/ nyin gcig rje bla ma mchog nas mdzod btags/ gser srang lnga bcu bcas paṇa chen rin po cher 'bul ba mdzad de/ sngas/sa khang du sngon chad 'jigs gas nga gnyis las bde rna/chog gi sgrub mchod tshugs pa zhig mi 'dug pas/ skyabs/ mngetswa/na mchog nas thugs khur che bzhes ngos 'dzugs par spo dzad na n+da gas grwa 'di nyid gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin gshis/ rje rin po che'i bstan pa'i zhabs tog bla na med par 'gyur bas/ ba/zhi rten so gas rjes nas phul chog pa zhu zhes zhu ba mdzad par/ bka' las bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po nyid nas 'di ltar gsung ba bstan pa thugs la bcags pa'i lhag bsam kho nar snang bas dbang khrid so gas bgyis te gang gsung ltar 'dzugs pa'i 'dun pa zhu zhes gsungs par thugs shin tu dgyes/ zhag nyi shu'i ring bkra shis lhun por bzhugs pa'i nyi ma re gnyis ma gtogs sku mdun du gdan drangs nas lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel bar mdzad cing / khyad par du mdo sngags kyi dri ba sgo du ma nas zhus pa rnams la paṇa chen mchog nas lan thogs med 'debs pa gnang bas thugs shin tu dgyes pa byung /de dus skyid grong nas bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan yang de khar phebs 'dug pa dang mjal phrad mdzad cing / dge ldan bka' brgyud phyag rgya che na pori zab khrid shin tu smin rgyas su gsan/ bla ma 'di nyid kyis phyis su phyag rgya

bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'gyi yod tshul / 42sdod chen po'i nyams khrid lan grangs shin tu mang ba gnang nas phyo7gas tham/sa cad du dar bar mdzad 'dug na'ang / sngags dang 'brel ba'i zab ba/nad zhal shes mthar thug rnams rje bla ma 'di nyid la rgya cher 'doms par mdzad pa las gzhan la cher ma gsungs pa ra snang / dus phyis zhig gsang ba'i tshul gyis kho bo la/ rang re'i bka' brgyud kyi glegs bam deng sang gar yod mi shes pa de yang bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu yod pa 'dra phebs pas/ kho bos glegs bam de mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes phyin chad la ji ltar phebs pa'i lo rgyus mthong thos ma byung bas/ ji ltar brgyud nas khong gi phyag tu phebs pa 'dug zhus par/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes nas/paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / de nas re zhig gi bar gar yod mi shes pa la paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes sku mtshams zhig gi skabs/ ri khrod pa hrul po lta bu zhig mjal du byung ba gzims 'gag pas nang du ma btang ba la/ paṇa chen rin po ches mkhyen nas cis kyang nang du thong gsungs pa bzhin sku drung du mjal/ zhag shas lha/na du bzhugs nas nyin mtshan med par gsung gleng 'ba' zhig gnang ba'i mthar ri khrod pa gar song med pa byung / de nyid sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin 'dug cing /paṇa chen gong mas sprul pa'i glegs bam khong 'a/ gtad pa de res rjecibatsun blo bzang ye r+shas la phul ba yin par snang / rje de nyid kyis grub dbang blo bzang rnam rgyal dang / de nas khong la byud ba yin 'dug su dang su'i phyag tu 'gro ba'irī bya ra chos bdag dam can chos kyi rgya/k+ṣapre po sa byed pa yin pas rgyun chad nga/ mi yong ba yin 'dug ces sa/sungs/ de lta na bla ma

422 sdon+d+ra —yuladabusasu phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ye shes rgya'ari myo/tshan dang mjal skabs rje nyid nas/ kyang gzigs yod dam zhus par ci ze re nged rang mig mi / gsal bas gzugs rags pa yang mi mthong na sprul pa'i glegs bam ji ltar mthong / glegs bam de skabs su ma babs pa su yin gyi mdun du yod kyang mi mthong ba nig yin skad ma thos sam zhes gsungs nas zhal gyis bzhes pa mi mdzad 'dug gleka/sa bam gzigs ma gzigs gang ltar yang de'i brjod bya phal cher de res gsan yod nges su 'dug ste/ 'di phyin chad nas skabs 'gar skal lda dzo/ re sa/nyis la snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa gnang skabs sprul pa'i glegs bam na 'di ltar gsung bya ba nyag nyug thon pa zhig 'dug cing / rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya ma'i khrod du yi ger bkod pa gnar ba'ang re gnyis yo da tshod 'dug go /'di dag las 'phros te ya mtshan pa'i gtam mang po zhig thos na'ang / bka' rgya shin tu dam pas 'dir 'bri bar ma nus so/ /nyin gcig snar thang la phebs nas/ mchod mjal zhib cho/ mdzad/ de nas dbus phyogs su chibs bskyod nye ba na paṇa chen mchog nas rje bla ma ston 'khor tshang mar phebs rdzongs gya nom pa mdzad cing / phebs khar gzim chung du bsnyen bkur rgyas pa'i thog7paṇa chen mchog ma/nu/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan sogs byin rten mang po phyag gis gnang ste/ rgyal dbang thangunod+ngharicad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi yang srid skor la thugs khur che bzhes sogs bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos tshul sa/sungs pa'i nga ko' lan rtswa/ rje bla ma mchog nas bka' phebs bzhin nga4 sgrung pa'i 'dun pa zhu zhing / skyabs mgon mchog nyid nas kyang mdo sngags kyi thugs gnyer mthar

tram̐dapaskyabadabus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yangasridangosa'adzinamadzadatshuX/ 423phyin pa gnang dgos lugs dang / slar yang zhal dkyil myur du mjal chog pa'i skyabs 'ju ga kyang gnang dgos zhes zhu ba mdzad/ de nas bkra shis lhun po nas chibs bskyod gnang bar bla brang gis rta thab sogs kyi phebs skyel sngar rgyun bzhin zhus te rim/ gyiṭa/ chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar phyag phebs so/ / rīspangs rtogs yon tan cha shas yongs gang ba/ /thub pa'i zhal skyin smra ba'i zla ba de/ /phyogs kun chos dkar 'od kyis snang ba'i slad/ /bapri shidze+e rdul brtsegs lhun po'i spo la 'dzegs/ /der ni bde ldacha/ zhing margon 'od mtha' yas/ /k+tar smrig 'dzin pa'i srol la brten pa de'i/ /mtshan dpe me tog phreng ba mgon 'di yi/ /spyan ras bung ba rtsen pa'i yul du gyur/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan bang mdzod 'dzin pa des/ /thugs gsang chos kyi sgo 'phar yongs phye nas/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi gzi 'od dang 'grogs pa'i/ /gdams pa'i no ra bu bgrang yas khyod la gtad/ /de tshe bkra shis lhun sdug ba gam nas/ /'jig rten sgron ma 'od po che zung gis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i gdong bar 'phrin las kyi/ /ngo mtshar 'od ris gsar pa bkod pa na/ /gangs can ljongs 'di 'chi med mdun sa bzhin/ /chos srid dga' ston rdzogs ldan yo —lang bzhin//bde skyid lang rme sos ka'i pad+ma bzhin/ /skye bo 'di dag sprin bral zlo ba bzhin// /rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid 'khrul med nges pa rnyed pa nyid bod du phebs pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo yin cing / lo snga ma zhig nas

424 bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/yang srid dwogs gnas shar na gcig lho na gcig nub na sa/cig bcas gsum byung ba la bod kyi gzugs can gzugs me da thams cad kyis chu dkrog pa las mar 'byung res 'dod khyer gyi gtam sna tshogs bye'u 'jol mo bzhin du sgrog par byed kyang / rje bla ma nyid thugs shin tu sgam pas btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngang la re zhig bzhugs pa mdzad/ skabs shig rgyal dbang mchog gi na bza' zhig dbu sngas su gdan drangs nas gsol 'debs shugs drag dang dpal ldan lha mor dmod bor ba'i 'phrin bcol nan tan mdzad nas mtshan brtag sgug pa gnang bar/ gzugs med pa'i sgra zheg gis rgyal ba'i sprul sku 'di la shaṅka pā la gtso zer ba zhig byung /de nas sa mo yos kyi lo rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku thag gcod pa dang / gser gdung rin po che rab tu gnas pa sgrub pa dang / rje bla ma nyid nas dus 'khor gyi dbang chen gsan bzhed bcas dgos pa du ma zhig gi ched du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyenakyipa dbus su gdan drangs/ dbus kyi chibs bsu pa ser skya thams cad kyis sgar spug sogs dgun zhwa gyon nas bsu rtsis la/ paṇa chen rin po che dpon g.yog dbyar chas ma/dzad 'dug zer bas than /sa cad kyis zhwa mo brje5 shrī nas sgar zhwa sogs dbyar chas sprad/rje bla ma dpon g.yog dang am pan rnams kyis dbu zhwa sogs dgun chas rang gis bsu ba gnong ba la/ mi nyams can 'ga' zhig gis zhwa mo brjes pa 'di'i rten 'brel la dpags na da res rgyal ba'i sprul sku ba/tsang gi de la thag cho da nas rgya phyogs ma gtogs bod thams cad mtho/ gtsang par 'a tsha ra ba 'dra zhes gleng ba mi'i dbyad shes mi ma yin gyi mngon shes las thig pa

bam̐d yul dbus su phibs te rgyal dasgeng bdud pa'i yang srid ngos 'ardzin ma5da tshul/ 42byeyod srid pa 'dug paṇa chen rin po che phebs nas po ta lar gzim chungalhabade ba can du bzhugs gnas mdzad/ phyi nyin rje bla ma paṇa chen mchog gi sku drung du phebs nas gsol tshig thog gyi+os srid gnyis lda kyo/ gyi gsung gleng 'phel/ de nas bzung skabs skabs su gsol tshigs lhan du/ gnang zhing thugs dgyenu/ pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ zla ba dang po rting ma'i tshes / bdun nyi nyin/ re bla ma mchog nas paṇa chen rin po cher gsol ston dang / gsung chog pa rnam rgyal grwa tshang ras/sa bsdus dang bcas rnam rgyal ma'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul bar/ dngul maṇa sku gsung thugs rten na bza' nyer dpyad/ rgya dngul rdog po sum cu so gsum gos dar gyi rigs ches mang ba sogs 'bul ba'i rnam grangs spam mtho ba phul/ nyin gcig skyabs mgon gnyis lho/ bzhus/sa skabs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad rma 'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che yang phebs pas/ 7paṇa chen mchog na55 renge myo/ dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa 'i sku rin chotswa tsher lcang skya mchog la bapro gleng phul gsung ba bzhin/ sprul sku rin po ji t+ta nas rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu 'a sa brtsam sa te brgal brtag mang du mdzad cing / rje bla ma mchog nas lan tho rī /'i/ med du gnang bas7paṇa chen thams cad ma/sgyen pa rje bla ma'i mkhyecha/ dpyod la thugs ya mtshan cing bsngags brjod rgya cher stsal/ ring po ma lon pa na rje bla ma mchog gis paṇa chen thamyoca/ cad mkhyen par dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen zhu ba'i snyan gas na phul bas da bye ri smu bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/ de na sa ston pa phun su ༷ra nu+opyo+oX/sawī ༷ rigs prun 'jad+dha/ dbyangs/ grags pa nyid gangs ri'i khrod du du sa kyi 'a/spo ra

da ljo3 6—bod—luladabusasu rlu/bas rte rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshulanilo'i bstan pa tseru/ par bya ba'i ched du byon pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ gnas phu3 susdu tshoswās paX 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta la'i tshoms chen khams gaspresum rnam rgyal du/dus phun susda tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyis dang po'i sangs hūṃs ṭ+wāṃpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bzhengs te rgyal po zla ba bzang po la sogs pa skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa'i dus khyad par can nag pas nya ba'i dus chen dang bstun/ 'khor phu1 sus tshogs ༷ thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag rje bla ma nyid dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa rje byams pa'i mtshan can/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab de mo sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ dam pa'i skyeṭapre rabs kyi phreng bas sgeg pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / chos kyi khri la dbang bsgyur pa'i mkhan slob du ma/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i dge bshes mang ba bcas 'dus pa nyis stong tsam la/ chos phun sudze+e tshogs pa rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol cherno dar+shal ṭaṃs skyo 'khor lo'i dbang rgyas par bka' drin du stsal to/ /de yang thog mar rgyud sde las bshad pa ltar slo ba ma rjes/ gzung gi cho ga mdzad cing / de rjes sa chog gi skor rnams dang / sa'i lha mo lhag gnas sogs sta gon gyi rim pa rnams sdon du gnang ba'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyis sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs te bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid zhugs shing dbang bzhes/ te/ nyin ga sum gyi dang po'i nyin dkyil 'khor

dzid yul dbuṭa4 su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos/ 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 427 du 'jug pa'i skor dang byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ nyin gnyis par mchog dbang gong ma gsum gong chen ba/sum/ ga3/ṭāpu nga t+na sdo rje glo ba dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas/ pa mtha' dwas/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi dgongs pa/ rgya bod kyi mkhas nga so so'i 'grel pa'i srol mang du gnas pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo rang nyid kyis rgyal po zla ba bzang po ltar bsngags par mdzad pa khams gsum gyi+os kyi rgyal po tsor kha pa chen po'i bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa de nyid/ thugs kyi sras ba/cig pu mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas rgya cher gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel chen dang / sgrub thabs pad dkar zhal lung / dbang chog dgongs pa rab gsal rnams kyi dgongs don/ srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen pos phyag len du mdzad pa ji lta bu bzhin tshad ma gsum gyis rnam par dag pa'i bshad pa dang / sla chos su ma song ba'i phyag len shin tu zhib pas gzab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa stsol bar mdzad/ dbang gi mjug tu gtang rag gi dngos 'bul kyang shin tu gyo che zhing spam mtho ba phul te dpon slob thams cad kyis bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i thugs smon rgya chen po dang bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil bar mdzad do/ /sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang bstun nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas rgyal dbang mchog gi gser gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du rje bla ma'ang bzhugs nas nyin gsum gyi ring rab gnas zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gnang / 'di dus paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i thugs dgongs

428 bod yul dbus su 'ibs rte rgyal dbang rbadun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mthod tshulo/la rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid las zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan bzhed thun mong ma yin pa yod 'dug kyang / rgyal mtshan mthon po'i de skabs kyi phyag mdzod blo chung spub 'thum zhig yod pa de'i rgyud la lus med bdag po'i byin rlabs zhugs te7paṇa chen mchog gis rje bla ma 'di nyid las bka' chos gsan na bkra shis lhun po ba'i sbam la gnod cing / bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i sna thag gzhan la shor dwogs pa'i a ma 'drer mthong gi rnam rtog gis paṇa chen rin po cher de 'dra mi 'gab tshul gyi zhu rigs dang bkag cha nan tan byas pas kho ba de dus dbang che bar brten thugs bzhed bzhin ma grub par 'dug go /de nas phyag mdzod kyi ngag bkod yin nam 7paṇa chen mchog gi yongs 'dzin mnga' ris pa zhig 'dug pa de/nyin bzhin lha sa bsam 'grub khang gsar du 'ongs nas rje bla ma las khrid chen brgyad so glus nyan cing / po ta lar phyin nas nyin re nyin re'i khrid dmigs dang gsung bshad rnams phral phral du 7paṇa chen thun po cher 'bul ba'i lugs byed kyin 'dug kyang / yongs 'dzin de skad ha cang byang po zhig med 'dra pas rdo rje'i tshig gyong po rnams la lo ts+tsha ji bzhin 'byor yod tshod mi 'dug go /nyin gcig paṇa chen mchog nas rje bla mar rdzogs rim gyi dka' gnad mang po zhig gi dwogs dpyod dang rmi lam 'dzin tshul la bka' 'dri zhib tu gnang bar/ rje bla ma mchog nas so so'i dwogs lan dang rmi lam 'dun stobs dang rlung stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i khyad par gyi gnad zab mo mang po zhig zhu ba gnang bas/ paṇa chen rin po che thugs lhag par rangs te bzhugs khri las babs nas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs lha

bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 429ros dang bcas 'bul ba gnang zhing sngar ma thos pa'i zab gnad de 'dra gsung ba bka' drin che zhes shin tu guṭa/ pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ da res zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po zhig zhu 'dod kyang rang dbang 'du ba zhig ma byung bas/ slar rje bla ma mchog dang mjal nas chos kyi bka' drin nod par gser gyi rgyal khab chen por cis kyang yong rgyu yin zhes phebs/ yang nyin ga cig paṇa chen mchog dang rje bla ma rnam gnyis chos kyi gsung gleng mang po zhig mdzad skabs/ paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs phun tshogs gling gi par ma de la/ nyid kyi skye ba gong mas dgag pa mang du ma dzad 'dug pas/ de la lung rigs kyi sgrub byed yang dag ji ltar yod ces phebs pa la/ rje bla ma mchog nas dam pa 5ོ shrī+o so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yin 'dug pas rang rang la sgrub byed re yod mchi zhes pa tsamyo/ zhig las zhu ba ma mdzad/ mi ring bar rje bla rma mchog nas sde snod 'jin pa mang po zhig la rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo sa/cig pa'i dbang gnang skabs/ de nyin paṇa chen mchog nas de 'dra'i bka' phebs gnang byung / rje ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mjad pa'i 'khrul spor mkhas pa dga' skyed la 'khrul spong rang du'ang rje bla ma'i dngos slob rnams kyi gzhung gi khungs mang du drangs yod pa de bzhin dang / der ma zad kho bos de'i rgyab kye+or du 'gro ba'i grub chen gyi gzhung yang ma nga po zhig drangs nas lung rigs kyi sgrub byed 'god rgyu na/chis shing / gcig shos la sgrub byed 'god gyu drag shos da lta rgyud pa'e phyag len du de ltar mdzad pas so zer ba las gzhan ci yang mi rnyed mod/ 'on

430 bod yul dbus su 'ebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/kyang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yul gnyan pa'i dbang gis dgag bzhag gi spros pa de 'dra zhu ma phod pas/ dam pa so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yin 'dug pas rang rang la sgrub byed re yod mchi zer ba tsam zhus pa yin zhes gsungs/ 'khrul spong de nyid rmongs pa dang 'dun pas 'gro ba la ler mon spa gro ba'i rdor gcod kyi dpen byed srid na'ang / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dpyod ldan dag giru/ gzu bo'i blos zhib tu dpyad na nges pa brtan po rnyed par 'gyur te 'dir ni skabs su ma babs pas de tsam las mi smra'o//thugasdo/ gsung sku yi rin chen pho brang dbus/ /mda' lnga pa dang drag po'i gdan gyi steng / /zhabs sen nor bu 'od chags 'khor lo'i mgon// ka la tsakra daswāl lhan ༷ shes kyi/ /thugs rje 'jig rten kun la khyab pa'i sprin/ /mgon 'di'i gsol 'debs dbyar tsās bskul ba las/ /theg mchog dbang gi gru char 'jo ba yis/ /ris med skal bzang yid kyi dri ma bkrus/ /de tshe rigs ldan grags pa dus kyi mthar/ /ngur smrig zol gyis 'ongs te 'gro mang zhig /ma 'ongs drag po 'khor lo'i gdul bya ru/ /thabs kyis bkri bar byas zhes lha rnams gleng / /bde ldan pad tshal las 'ongs pa'i/ /snang ba mtha' yas bung ba'i rgyal/ /mgon 'di'i mkhyen dpyod ge sar gyi/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi la sred kyang / /lus med bdag po'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rnga yab g.yob pas bar bcad pas/ /dgongs bzhed shing rta stong pa ru/ /re ba'i lam las phyir log gyur/ /de lta na yang rkyen dang tshogs pa yi/ /sa lu las kyang myu gu

bam̐d yul dbus su baibs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 431smin mthong na/ /dam pa'i thugs dgongs a mra'i sa bon las/ /dge legs 'dod rgu'i dpag bsam cis mi 'khrungs/ /rgyal tshab de mo bas gtso ba'i sku mdun nang ma/ mgron gnyer gsol gzim phyag mdzod sogs rtse'i las tshan/ bka' blon/ mda' dpon/ sde pa'i rigs sogs gzhung gi mi drags drung 'khor thams cad/ dbus tsho chen dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu bskul ma zhus pa la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa dpag bsam rin po che'i snye ma zhes bya ba rgyal dbang de nyid kyi mdzad pa thun mong ba gtso bor byas te sgro skur dang bral ba'i rang bzhin brjod pas gsal bar bstan cing / tshig gi sbyor ba blo mchog dman thams cad kyis go bde zhing bar skabs rnams su dpyod ldan rna ba'i bcud len du gyur pa'i snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gzu bo'i blos zhib tu brtags na dam pa'i rnam par thar pa la rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i dad pa bcos min skye zhing / bstan pa la ji ltar slob pa'i rim pa'i tshul la nges pa 'dren thub pa'i legs bshad bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan mchog tu gyur pa zhi ga dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba mchog gi rnam par thar pa las brtsams te gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa thugs rje'i nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba'ang ljags rtsom mdzad/ rgyal dbang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la mo chos skyong nas nub kyi der thag bcad kyang / chos skyong gzhan rnams kyis 'dra min sna tshogs zhig lab pas gcig tu thag ma chod pas/ bka' blon rnams nas7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku drung du chos skyong

432 bod yul dbus su phibs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'ardzon mdzad tshul /rnam sa phyo 0/sa gcig tu sku 'bebs kyis zhal 'dzom thog thag chod pa yong res/ nyin gcig po ta la'i tshom/sa chen gyi rgya mthongasdo/ khar/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje bla ma nyid/ rgyal tshab/ am pan/ bka' blon rnams dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / tshoms chen gyi mthil du/ la mo/gnas chung / bsam yas/ dga' gdong / khra 'brug chos skyong rnams sku 'bebs byas par/ thog ma rang du bsam yas pa dang / de rjes chos skyong gzhan rnams sku/ phebs nas lhan du 'dzoms par bsam yas pa la mo'i bzhugs khrir hab thob kyis b.ri da nas gtum drag shin tu che tshul gyis tshab tshub sna tshogs byas pa5 shrī/ zhu ba po rnams kyis lung bstan go bsdur kyi dri rmed sogs byed pa'i rngo ma thog cing / khra 'brug pas snga ma nub kyi de yin zer gi yod kyang 'di res ba5 sa ma yas pa 'i lung dang mthun par ma lab na khos phral du ral gris bsnun dwogs pa yin nam snga ma'i tshig 'gyur nas shar gyi de yin zer bas mtshon lung bstan rnams phyogs gcig tu mthun pa ma byang ba la rje bla ma mchog nas/ —da ni rang cag thams cad kyis7paṇa chen ri na po cher gso la ba rtse gcig tu btab nas bka' gang phebs la cha bzhag byed pa las 'os mi 'dug gsungs par/ bod kyi las don shes mkhan thams cad kyis de bzhin legs par gsol ba bzhin/ rje bla mas gtso mdzad/ rkargyal tshab/ bka' blon sogs las don byed pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ paṇa chen mchog la rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po'i yang srid rin po che 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin gyi bka' lung gtsang thag chod pa bka' drin bskyang dgos tshul gyi zhu ba nan tan phul bas/ paṇa

bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 433chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen pos 'khrul bral ye shes la rjen par shar ba bzhin gtsang phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa de nyidagyirgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum mgon mchog gi sku'i yang srid 'khrul med du t+thag gcod pa'i bka' lung stsal/ sngar sor rje bla ma mchog gi thugs dam brtag par7rgyal ba'i yang srid la shakho pā la gtso zer ba byung ba'i shakho pā la ni dung skyong bya ba yin 'dug pas/ la mo chos skyo nga chen po ni tshangs pa dung ji/ thor tshugs can du grags pa dang / paṇa chen mchog dang la mo chos skyo nga rnam gnyis kyi phyag tham kyang dung gi ri mo can du yod pa bcas 'grig pa 'dug cing /khyad par du snga mo rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas paṇa chen mchog la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang skathās/ gtsang phyag mdzod kyi rmi lam du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa da lta'i sprul sku 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i khyim der phebs nas bzhugs yod pa zhig rmis pa/ phyi nyin rgyal dbang rin po cher zhus pas/ 'di yin gyi gsal kha ma gnang bar da res rmi lam de 'dra byung tshu la gyi yi ge tham ka can gnyis gyis la gcig phyag mdzod la sprod/ gcig gzhung gi yig tshang du 'jog pa gyis phebs pa bzhin/ drung yig skal bzang bde chen nas de bzhin bgyis 'dug pa bcas gang ci nas phyogs lhung dang bral ba rnams yid ches kyi nges pa brtan pos dga' spro dbyar duṭa4 kyi chu gter bzhin 'phel bar gyur to/ /de nas rje bla ma mchog gis po ta la'i gzim chung khams gsum rnam rgyal du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa dngos 'bul dang bcas phul zhing tshogs gral du

snyedaphya34 bodayul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/gsung myori gur gnang ba 'di lta ra ro/ /zhing bde ba chen po'i pho brang na//rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyi da blo bzang grags/ /nga mos gus drag pos sa/sol ba 'debs/ /mgon thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /drin 'khor med bskal cibazang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rje blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes zhabs/ /don gnyis med ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi bkra shis rtags rdzas mchod pa deng / /nang bdud rtsi lnga yi mchod pa dang / /ches gsang ba phyag rgya'i mchod pa gsum/ /blo bde stong ngang nas 'bul bar bgyi/ /ma mkha' 'gro kun 'dus wa ra nyi/ /gnas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor bzhugs/ /i ti la ka yi 'od zur gyis/ /drod bde chen 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs//dpal bla ma rnam par snang mdzad che/ /gnas spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs/ /haṃ zla ba dkar po'i chu rgyun gyis/ /mchog dab/'a bzhi 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon rje btsun chos kyi rdo rje'i zhabs/ /gnas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lor bzhugs/ /gdangs mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyi sgras/ /dpal mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma mi bskyod he ru ka /gnas snying kha chos 'khor lte bar bzhugs/ /rlung kun rtog rgyu ba rnyu tir bcad/ /dpe'i lhan skye sa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang du/ /lha bla ma sgyu 'phrul dra ba bzhengs/ /nyams sna tshogs rtse dga'i rol pa yis/ /ma/ 'gro don byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /don ma bcos spros braṭ+wāṃpre gnyug ma dang / /sems lhan skyes bde stong ro gcig pas/ /gegs nyon mongs sprin tshogs

bod yul dbus su phebs te rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/ 435dbyings su dwangs/ /dpal 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems lhan skyes bde stong dbyer med dang / /lus 'ja' tshon ltar bkra rdo rje'i sku/ /ro gcig tu mnyam por zhugs pa yis/ /mchog zung 'jug 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang / /pha bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mchog sprul dang / /mgon rje btsun dpal ldan ye shes po/ nyis/ /gdan lhan cig 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel 'grig /yul byang phyopa /sa maba' ru skyes pa yi/ /'bangs skal ldan rol pa'i rdo rje nga / /glu gre ba bde mo ma mchis kyang / /don zab mo'i glu dbyangs 'di phul bas/ /pha rje btsun 'dzum zhal bstan nas kyang / /deng 'dir tshogs dad ldan gdul bya rnams/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon /stod kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ /dad dam tshig gtsang ma'i rten 'brel las/ /dus ring por mi thogs khyod zhal mjal/ /gsung bdud rtsi ngoms med spyod pa'i mthus/ /mchog sku bzhi myur du 'thob gyur cig /ces zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo yongs su grol te nyams rtogs kyi klong brdol ba'i rang mdangs rdo rje glu'i mchod pa phul bas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa thugs shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /rmad byung snying stobs chen po'i ri dbang gis/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho srubs pa'i snying po skyes/ /gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor los srid pa kun/ /nyin mtshan bar med snang bar mdzad pa las/ /bskrul badz+wang rgyal ba dz+wa mardo'i thugs rje'i sprin/ /gcig tu 'khrigs las gdul bya'i zhing sa la/ /phan bde bdud rtsiri gru char

436bod yul dbus su phebs ) rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad tshul/'jo ba de/ /chos dbyings kun gsal klong du thim pa na/ /bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi bstan srid nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /rgud pa'i tsha zer 'bar bas skem gyur te/ /'di snang skom pas gdungs pa phal mo che/ /re dogs 'khrul ba'i smig rgyus bslus pas ngal/ /de tshe thugs rje'i 'od dkar rgyas pa'i mgon/ /'di yi 'phrin las ga bur zegs ma yis/ /bod yul skye bo'i snying gi gdung bcil te/ /dge mtshan kun+da'i dus ston rgyas par mdzad//thabs mkhas mdzad bzang skya rengs bya ma rtas/ /legs lam snang ba yangs por phye ba las/ /gru 'dzin bdag po'i yang srid 'od stong can//gangs can legs byas shar ri'i rtse mor drangs/ /'jig rten dag tu rtsod ldan mtshan mo yi/ /rgud mun ji lta ji ltar spro byed pa/ /de lta de ltar 'gro ba'i nyi ma 'dis/ /mdzad bzang 'od snang lhag par spro la ltos//thugs bskyed zla shel khang bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od dkar pho nyas yang dang yang / /bsil ldan kun+da'i ra bar bdud rtsi'i skyes/ /stsal pa'i drin la soms shig blo ldan dag /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ri /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye sheg bstan pa'i sron me dpal bzadwa pyo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod 0pa dege ldaXn brnyin the'i rmidzezlo rgyan las/ bod yul dbus su phebs pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo gangs can mgon po rgyal dbang bdun pa'i yang srid yid bzhin nor bu 'khrul med rdos 'dzin mdzad pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o//

43lharlutha but+yā+o dug pu da sgogaska bralngan puzhi smro na mre rje /sna ji sgyu / kyi / sgyu / 7 / ma snye / /bratshun dmā puzhi nachog stulka k+kin po chen rabu byud gi tshulka khrimās stsolka zhan naded puzhi tshulu/de nas mi ring bar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gtsang du chibs bskyod sa/nang zhing / gong ma chen pos rje bla ma nyid bod du byon pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo rnams legs par bsgrubs zin pas/ da ni ma 'gyangs par gser gyi rgyal khab chen por phyir phebs gnang na legs zhes bka'i gser yig phebs/ kho bo cag nas rje bla ma nyid rgyal khab chen por phebs rgyu yin gshis re zhig gi bar du zhal mjal ba e yong mi shes pas/ sngar rje bla ma nyid kyis ji ltar gdams pa'i don rnams la sgrub pa byed tshu/la gyi zhal gdams bslab bya sems la bcang rgyu zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos pa'i gso/la ba yang yang nan tan du btab par brten/ dam pa'i chos la sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i bslab bya snying gi thig le zhes bya ba 'di nyid bka' drin bskyang bar mdzad do//oṃ swasnyi/ chos kun gnas lugs ji bzhin legs gzigs nas/ /skal ldan 'gro la bla nga dor ma lus pa/ /tshul bzhin ston mdzad thub pa'i dbang po la/ /deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /deng dus chos mthun gtam gyi sbyor ba dag /bgyid dang de la nyan dang sems pa

43skye rje batshun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ gedang / /rangs par byed rnams 'phya ba'i gnas gyur pas/ /bdag kyang snying las lu nga ngur spro mod kyang / /tshe rabs du mar rgyal ba'i dam chos la/ /lhag par goms pa'i blo dang brtson ldan khyod/ /dam chos sgrub la das/'a ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /yang yang bskul phyir gtam 'di gsong bor smra/ /de yang ston pa thugs rje can gyi gsung rab thams cad dang /de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa la tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas grub mtha' yas pa'i legs par bshad pa ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad kyang grol pa don du gnyer ba rnams la blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par ston pa kho na yin pas/ kha phyir bltas su ma song bar gzu bo'i blos de dag legs par sbyangs na/ blang dor gyi gnas la blo gros shen tu rgyas par 'gyur zhing / chos byed lugs logs su btsal ga la dgos/ /khyad par du so thar byang serma sa gsang sngags kyi bcas pa'i mtshams rnams bshes gnyen mkhas pa las legs par mnyan te nyams 'og tu tshud par byas na nyen mtshan thams cad du sgo sa/sum don ldan du 'da' ba zhig nges par 'byung /de tsa na ci byas chos su 'gro ba las chos min gyi go skabs ye mi 'byung ba'i gnad che mod kyang / rtsa ba bor nas yal ga tshol ba mang bar snang / da ni nges par chos rnam dag cig byed na/ thog mar bame+es gnyem/ mtsham/ nyid dang ldan pa mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas te/ bshes gnyen bsten tshur nas/ lhag mthong gi bor la myong khridadu byas te tshig tsam du ma lus nga/ra rang rgyud0la ya nga dang yang du bsgom par bya/ de yang phar tshad dbu ñca/sum mngon pa godi 'og so gas la sbyangs pa zhig yin na de tha3/〈 riri cad la ma gyi rim

/ji ba0wadam sa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ 43nyepa'i nyams len la rang rang gi thad du legs par sbyar te/ dbya da sgom dang 'jog sgom ji ltar rigs paṭasmu myong ba la bskor te skyong ba zhig byung na jo bo bka' gdamyo/sa pa dang / rje yab srasdoshrī kyi dgongs pa ltar mkhas pa mgu ba'i nyams len rmad du byung ba yin cing / de 'dra la gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba zhes zer ba yin/ deng sang mi tshe hril gyis gzhung lugs de dag la sbyangs pa byas kyang / kho 'di zer na nga 'di zer gyi shag 'gyed pa tsam la mgo bo 'khor nas ga/zhung de dag las nyams len gyi rim pa ji lta bu zhirnguni ston pa la blo kha ye ma phyogs par don mene du btang rjes rgas pas gtugs tsa na khrid yipi / chung ngu re la 'bad lo byed par snang ste mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi rga/nas kho na yin/ de lta na yang blo'i mthu shin tu chung ba'i dus 'dir dam pa gong mas mdzad pa'i lam khrid che chung gang rigs zhig la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis gzhung bsrang ba'i nyamyo/sa len byed tshu9ra la sgro 'de gas gcod pa zhig gal che/ de yang khrid gnang mkhan dang nyan mkhan gnyis kas sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor byas pas rgyud dang chos/ 'dres pa zhig byed dgos kyi/ nad pa'i rim gror mdo klog pa lta bu'i ga/ nga mgyong / sa mapyogs kyis khrid rgyun thob po zhes pa'i sa/yam rgyug dang tab tob tu ma song ba zhig dgos par snang / chos ngaslab kyin rgyud je gyong dang ngag je rtsub dang spyod pa je rtsing du 'gro ba de bslabs pa'i chos dang rang gi rgyud gnyis ro khur ba ltar rgyab bsnol du so nga ba'i ltas yin/gzhan du na dag snang je che dang rgyud je dul dang daye/ sbyor la je brtson dang tshe 'di'i snang shas ji chung du 'a gro bar snang na lha dang bla ma'i byen lebs

440 je btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/'jug pa dang / rtodzo/sa pa je mthor 'gro ba'i mgo tshugs pa yin par 'dug de nas rdo rje lo+ob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las dbang rgyun rnam par dag pa sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges su mnos te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa srog dang bsdos te bsrung ba sa/zhir bzhag pa'i steng du mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dkar chag tho'i yig chung las 'byung ba ltar rgyud kyi mthar thug dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rka no/thor lo bde mchog gnyis kyi rgyud kyi 'chad nyan dang man ngag la bdar sha gre/cod tshul ji lta ba bzhin byed pa zhig byung na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad la mi 'phyugs pa'i gzer thebs pa ni ga 'ong bas/ snyiri nas sgru/ba pa lhur len pa rnams la med du mi rung ba zhig yi na par snang / 'di dag gi tshe yang chos 'di'i brgyud nga 'i bla ma dang chos dang gregs ṭ+wā+oṃro /gas thams cad la dam tshis/ gi se la ye ma zhugs pa 3ga gal che/ sngar gyi thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong bzhin rngu 'i ste2se ma/sa skabs su babs pa'i bskyed rem dang rdzogs ri d+ngha pe gnyis kyi khrid la myong ba 'don gyin bshar sgom byed pa dang / skabs skabs su gegs sel bogs 'do na gyi rim pa rnarngaris bla ma la zhus kyin byed pa sogs dgos pa zhig yin par 'duska gong du bshad pa'ilke rim pa 'di dag tshags su tshud pa na tshe 'di'i gnyen nye du grogs dga' d+dha/dza' nor longs spyod sogs kyi/ /spa 'dzin byed pa rgyang ring du spangs te/ sa sde sog/sa nas bshad pa ltar ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i dben pa'i gnas su lta spyod mtshungs pa'i gros/sa dam tshig gtsado ba bzhi yan chad dang —snan du phyi nang gi g.yeng ba spangs te mtshams dam par bcad/ thog mar

je btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byungabasgrubs tshul/ 441 wa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis gzhung bsrangs te/ phyag dang yig brgya maṇ+ḍal sogs bsag sbyang (rwa/ 'bad pa'i sgo nas sngar gyi khrid rnam twasmi myo parjed pa byed/ lam gyi ri5 pa'i dmigs sko/ ra snga ma rnams la myo re ba ma thon bar du rgyas pa dang phyi ma rnam sa mdor bsdus re'i sgo nas nyin re bzhin lam yongs rdzogs la bshar sgom byed/ myong ba thon rim gyis snga ma bsdus pa dang phyi ma ngasnon pa ṭ+wāṃ ༈/gas byed/ thun mtsham sa nams su dngos sa//zhi'i dmigs skor gyi dpe cha blta ba ma gtogs sgra rtsinu/ sman gsum lugs kyi bstan 'a①ོ sa sogs la mi blta/ thun gyi mgo mjug tu byang chub kyi sems dang lta bas zin pa dang / bango+o slon gyis rgyas 'debs pa la nan tan bya/khrus dang kha zas dang gnyid dang rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor sogs kyang rang rang gi skabs ltar bya/ spyir rgyud sde tshad ldan nanu/ bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la khyad par med kyang / rang re'i brka/'a brgyud 'di la bde gsang 'jirga/sa gsum ya ma bral bar nyams su len pa 'di gnad thi/na tu che bar yo da/ sgrub pa'i skabs su rang phyogs lta zhog gzhan phyogs kyi bla ma dang chos so /gas 'a 'ang skyon 'dogs dang smod tshig brjod pa dod log sogs ye mi bya zhing grub mtha'i dgag bzhag sogs kyi spros pa mi bya/ tshe 'di ba'i mi dang snang ba mi bstun cing mthon po'i ngo 'dzin sogs dug bzhin du spar / rang la skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung ya nga bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snya/ma pa ma gtogs re dogs kyi rnam rtog mang po mi bya/ dge sbyor 'di 'dra byed rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang snyam du spro shugs chen po bya/skabs sa/bas su dkyil 'khor skrub mchod dang bdag 'a ju ga len pa dang /

442 rje btsun dam pa'i mthu+og sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang / tshogs kyi 'a/lor lo sogs la brtson pa ra bya/chos do na du gnyer ba'i slob ma re gnyis byung tshe zang zing la ltos pa med par sngar rang gis ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa de ltar du 'khrid par bya zhing / sbyor ba 'jam pos dad pa dang bca/ yod la 'god par bya yi/zhe sun dang yid 'pham du 'gro ba'i rigs mi byed par nye ring ran pa'i sgo nas don du gang 'gyur bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis legs par 'bad na gtan gyi 'dun ma myur du 'grub pas nan tan snyire bor bya zhing zhib par dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa bsten pa las shes par bya'o//smras pa/ 'di snang phun tshogs snying po med mthong nas/ /gtan gyi bde ba sgrub phyir dam pa'i chos/ /dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig nyams len pa'i/ /skal ldan de 'dra sa 'dir shin tu dkon/ /khyad par blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /yongs su rdzogs pa'i ga/nad la nges rnyed nas/ /ma nor tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i blo ldan ni/ /sar gnas dpa' bo yis kyang smon pa'i gnas/ /tshig 'khri'i lbu bar dam bca'i stegs 'cha' zhing / /gzhan smod tshig mda'i sbyor ba lhur len dang / /go sa mthon por re bas duṭapre 'da' ba'i/ /bshes gnyen phal cher e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras/ /ca ka'i sog rum gnas gzhi'i 'dzin skyong sogs/ /mno bsam mang pos brel bzhin ri phug tu/ /mi tshe stong zad byed pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /rang mngo/ rang gis bskor ba'i phur rgan yin/ /'brong gi rwa co ga/nyis bzhin rgyud dang chos/ /nam yang thug dus med kyang 'gro ba gzhan/ /

rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ 443yar 'dren byed pa'i bstan 'dzin yin no skad/ /mdzo sbrel g.yang la lhung ltar 'gyur gyis dwogs/ /thob thob nyan nyan rnam grangs bso/ga bsog nas/ /rgyud la 'ase/la dus med pa'i slob ma rnams/ /dbul bos phyug po'i nor bgrar ngang tshul ltar/ /dgos dus rapal phan pa shin tu dka'/ /kho bo mtshar ldan bla ma'i zhabs la katugs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i gsung rab mu lus par/ /phyogs rer ma song thos bsam ngal ba byas/ /bstan pa'i gnad la go ba phyogs tsam mthong / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khar/ sa chu bzhin myul/ /mtho dman skyid sdug spyod tshul sna tshogs mthong / /spyari+o grung 'dam kha'i blang dor cung zad shes/ /'dun gros mi la ma shor gtso rgan yin/ /de phyir chos bzhin sgrub pa'i blang dor tshul/ /smra ba'i spobs pa gzhan las mi dman pas/ /yang dag gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di lta bu/ /spel ba'i 'os su gyur pa yin kyang srid/ /khyod ni tshe rabs du mar legs sbyangs pas/ /shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen rab rgyaru/ gyur kyang / /legs par bshad pas ngoms pa med gyur pa/ /'di la kho bo cag gis yid rab spro/ /tshe 'di mi rtag srid 'byor snying po med/ /thub pa'i bstan pa'ang snum zad mar me dang / /skye rgu'i bde skyid nyi rgas grib so 'dra/ /de phyir la 'ur dam chos sgrub la 'bungs/ /ji ltar gdams pa'i don rnams nyams blangs na/ /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyin dang / /'bral ba med par theg pa'i yang rtse la ci dgar spyod pa'i skal bzang myong bar nges/ /gtam 'di bsnya/da pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /dri med rgyal ba'i bstan la legs zhugs nas/ /

444 je btsun dam pa'i mchog sprulalarababyungabasgrubasatshul/ da watheg pa mchog gi lam gyis myur bgrod de/ /byang chub chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces dam pa'i chos la sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i bslab bya snying gi thig le zhes bya ba 'di ni bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thu'u bkwan pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyi sbrul pa'i sku mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas yang dang yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag sdo rje 'chang blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang / byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs shing rim gnyis tsu ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i zhal snga nas sogs dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs yongs su rdzogs pa la rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i dad pa brtan po thob pa'i rgyal khams pa lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa dge tshul dge legs nam mkhas bgyis pas thub grwa 'i bstan pa rin po che dus thams cad du rgyas par gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /zhal gdams 'di nyid snying nas sgrub pa lhur len pa rnams la nyer ma/lo med mi rung du snang bas 'dir bkod pa yin gyi/ rang nyid sgrog par 'dod pa dang / rnam thar gyi glegs bam chen po yong ched tsam du bsam sa nas bris pa ma yin no/ /de ltar rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid dbang phyug ces pa sa mo glang gi lo bod du phebs pa nas bzung /'brug lo'i badz+walo ngo bzhi bzhugs pas/ de'i ring la gzhung sa nas ston

sdi btsun dam pami mchog sprul la rab byung bskubs tshul/ 445 'khor tshang mar nar ma'i gsol phog zur gsos/ — bzan shing sogs rgyun ldan dang / dus dus su na bza'/ nyer mkho'i yo byad gang dgos/bzo grwa rnams nas sku gsung thugs rten/ phyag dpe/ mchod rdzas/ bca' lag sogs gsar bsgrub/ lo gsar dang 'khrungs skar gyis mtshon dmigs bsal gyi dus rnams su dga' ston dngos 'bul gya nom pa/ mgron gnyer gnyis/ bla sman gcig drung yig ga sum sogs phyag g.yog zhu mi gang dgos bcar sdod/ dbang chen sogs gnang skabs/ dkyil 'khor chas 'jug dbang rdzas sogs gang dgos rtse nas g.yar 'bul ngos mchod dpon mkhan po dang / mchod g.yog pa rnams kyis phyag phyi gang dgos zhus pas mtshon/ mdor na rtse sa/zhung tshang mas nus pa rtsal sprug lta bus bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ de mtshungs rgyal mtshan mthon po nas kyang skabs skabs su 'tshams zhu sogs 'bul mi gtong ba gnang zhing / ljags smin dang sku'i nyer dpyad sna tshogs 'bul ba mdzad / gzhung sa nas grwa sa gsum dang / rgyud stod smad sogs dgom/ sgrub sde thams cad du mang 'gyed 'phar ma'i thog rje bla ma mchog gi zhabs brtan sku rim kyang rgyun ldan du bsgrub pa gnang / gzhan yang bod kyi bla chen mi chen thams cad dang / phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i ser skya dregs zhan mtha' dag gis rje 'di'i zhabs kyi pad+ma spyi bor mchod cing / zang zing gi 'bul ba bsnyen bkur sogs dbyar dus kyi sprin la 'gran pa byung zhing / de dag la so so'i babs bstun gyis gnang cha gsol ras kyang tshem med gya nom pa stsol bar mdzad do/ /rang phyogs kyi mkhas grub yod do cog rnams slob

— 446 da shā btsun dmatram̐ri mtshag kul la rab byungatram̐sdib kol/ mar 'dus par r+yā zad/ rje bla ma 'a di nyid deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba ga(na na — snes/ b.li/na zer mchus bstan pa dkruganu/ pa mi mdzad par dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis ris med du khyab pa mdzad pa'i dbang gis// sa skya rnying ma bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bstan 'dzin du mas kyang zhabs la gtugs nas legs bshad kyi skyes len par byed nga/sa ma tshon / mdor na rje bla ma nyid kyi chos srid 'phrin las kyi 'od snang gangs can gyi ljo ngas thamyo/sa cad du khyab pa la brten nas/ bstan 'akro'i phan bde yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur to//bod du phebs nas chos srid kyi mdzad pa rlabs che bas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul 'di rnams phal cher kho bo'i mig dang yid kyi spyod yul du gyur pa rnarma ṭa/ mro skur dang bral bar brjod pa yin no/ /rab 'byad+dha/ru/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams bka' bgros nas/ /rmad byung 'a phrin las ldor bu'i cod pan mchog /gang gi snying stobs dbu la nyer bcings te/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon du mnga' gsol ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po rol pa 'i rdo rje zhes/ /rab dkar grags pa du kā la yi gos/ /ngo mtshar yon tan ri mo 'bum bkra ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bla na bres pa de'i/ /zhal gyi dbugs tsam rgyu ba'ang mkha' khyab kyi/ /'gro ba kun la phan bde'i rgyur 'gyur na/ /rgyal ku na gsang ba gsum dang ro gcig rme'i/ /rlabs chen mdzad pa gzhan dag smos ci 'tshal/ /gang gi ngo mtshar mdzad bzang dngul chu yis/ /reg pa tsam gyis 'gro rgyud lcags kyi khams/ /phan bde su war+ṇa yi dngos po ru/ /bsgrubs pas 'brel tshad

ji btsun dam pa'i ca/chog thul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ 447don dang ldan pa nyid/ /nyam thag 'drem/ la rings pa'i thugaṭaṭa rje'i phyag /dpag bsam yal ga bzhin du nyer brkyangs te/ /rtag tu dge ba'i chos nor 'dzad med du/ /stsol mdzad 'gro ba kun gyi ma / redris/ bshes/ /dkon mchog rin chen kun 'dus za ma tog /'di yi zhabs kyis reg pas shis byas pa'i/ /rdul phran de yang lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan tu bsten par 'os/ /bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshos brjod pas kyang / /phyogs gcig tsam yang mtshon par mi nus pa'i/ /yon tan gter ma ri' khyon la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar rje btsum/ bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyis bod dbus gtsang gi bsta/na srid mtha' dag zla 'od phog pa'i gangs ri ltar gsal bar mdzad nas/ slar yang shar phyogs 7gong ma chen po'i gser gyi rgyul khab tu bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad par chibs kyi kha lo mngon parno phyogs pa la nye ba na/ bod yul gyi che rgu thams cad kyis da dung re zhig bod yul du bzhugs chog pa'i gsol ba nan tan du btab na'ang / gong ma chen po'i bka' dbang btsan pas thabs ma rnyed pas/bka' drin rjes snyodran pas dngos 'bul gyi phebs rdzongs sogs rgya cher phul zhing / lha sa nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur pa na che phra bar ma mtha' dag gis phebs skyenywa ring thung du ma dang / rnam pa kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i ga/sol 'debaso dang / slar yang mi ring bar bod yul du dgyes zhal mngon par phyogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrigs/ de nas rim gyis phebs lam rnams su sa tshigs so so'i rgya bod kyi bla dpon rnams kyis

443 sde btsun dam parme —mchog spyol la rab byungab—sgrubs tshul/bsu spyel dang / nyin re bzhin dad 'dus kyi skye bo grangs las 'das par mjal kha phyag dbang gnang ba sogs mtha' yas kyang sa bon ma byung bas 'bri bar ma spobs la/ khams kyi sa cha zhig tu go bo dgon gyi mkhan po 'bras spungs blo gsal gling pa zhig sku mdun du byung ba la chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas/ kho ba ha cang nga rgyal che drags pas rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshu/na chad na kho dang 'gran bzod pa gceg kyang med skad dang / dus kyis ma chog pa ma gtogs mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang la mi sleb pa med zer ba sogs rlung gis bteg pa'i gtam chal chol sna tshogs 'dzem med rgyung rgyal du smras shing / stong nyid rtogs par khas 'che ba sogs tshul 'chos shin tu che ba zhig 'dug pa la thugs lhag par ma rangs pas/ phyis su yang de lta bu'i zob can zhes yang yang gsungs/ de dus khos phyarte chen gyi lta ba'i go ba dpe med yin khul gyi bshad bshad mang po byed pa la bla ḍosku mchog nas brgal brtag gnang bas/ thal 'gyur pa'i lugs la rang rig 'jog dgos byung bas mtshon khas len shor tshabs che bas dam bca' bye ma'i chang bu ltar gyur/ de la 'khon du bzung ste/ dus phyis kho ba bod du thon nas chos mang po 'chad pa'i khur 'dzin cing / rje bla ma'i dgongs bzhed kyi dbu ma'i lta ba la jo nang ba'i gsor mi rung gi lta ngan gyi bshad pa bsres te bdud rtsi dang khyi lud 'dres pa'i kha zas kyi ston mo 'gyed pa la/rnam dbye mi shes pa'i byis pa mang po dga' sto na du 'khrul nas 'dus pa'i dbus su rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi gsung 'aska' zhig la rigs pa ltar snang gi nur za brjod par byed ces thos so/ /kho ba zob can zhig yin pa rang

'i btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byungabakubs sngel/ 44)wa tshig ji/sa kyang gas la bar byas snang ste/ 'bras rmye ngas su rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i mdun du kho bas dam bca' bzhag pa la/ mtshan nyid zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis bgro gleng btang bsagakhas len ma zin par/thal 'gyur nga 'i lugs la theg chen gang zag yin na stong nyid rtogs pas khyab pa dang stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i so skye rang das/'a ba'i rgyud kyi ka ba dang bum pa 'dzin pa'i shes pa bden 'dzin dang tha snyad 'jog byed kyi tshad ma gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yi na par khas len dgos byung ba la/ da dung ngo tsha ba med par dam bca' de sngon med kyi legs bshad yin tshul yi ger bris te sgrub byed kyi lung rigs 'god rgyu ma rnyed par khas len de legs tshul paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs so/ /zhes rdzun chen pos rdzu/khā ta'i mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu sa gtsang la phyis pa'i dpe bdag gir byas 'dug pas/rigs smra nem7ri la ma grags shing go rgyu ci yang med la lung rigs kyi sgrub byed dang prasmyor pade gtam de 'dra sngon med legs bshad dang sdon med log bshad gang yin rigs smra gsar bus kyang shes sla bar 'dug pas so//kho ba'i slob ma'i khyu rgyan du grags pa 'ag/'a zhig dang bdag cag nyams len skor gyi gleng mo byung bar/ 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa thams cad khyad du bsad de sems ngo blta ba kho nas chog shes byed pa sha stag tu 'dug cing / de dag gi khrod kyi nyams rtogs mtho bar rlom pa 'ga' zhig ni bying ba phra cho/ bsags pa ting sprudzin du 'khrul nas chos sku sang thob gnangs thob kyi stong rlomyo/ byed par snang bas/ 'grig 'grig gi bshad pa dang kha bo ci tsam mri ṭasmu kyang 'dre glud shar nub kyi dpe bzhin don la rje btsun sa

450 rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprulalarababyungabasgrubasatshul/da 4paṇa dang rgyal ba tsong /spa pa yab sras kyi gsung gi phyogs snga kho nar song 'dug go /des na skyes bu zob can de ni g.yo sgyus 'jig rte+o/ bslu ning rje bla ma'i bltan pa la zhugs pa'i zol gyis bstan pa dri bcas su byed par ring nas log pa'i smon lam btab pa zhig tu gdon mi za'o//thub bstan gangs rir dbang bsgyur mgon 'di yis/ /stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro cher bsgrags pa/ /lta ngan gcong rong 'khyams pa'i pags sngon wa'i/ /snying la zug rngur gyur te ku co 'don/ /mkhas pa'i dam bca'i brag ri ltar snang gi /thal 'gyur sol ba'i mdung gis bshigs re dang / /'khor bsgyur dpung la dmus long glen pa yis/ /dbyug pas ral kha byed 'dod 'di gnyis mtshar/ /mkhas gzhung rus sbal lu sa la skyon gyi spu/ /'tshol ba'i ngal ba bsten las rigs smra 'ga'i/ /klan ka'i me yis rang gi khas blangs kyi/ ag tshom tshig pa'i rma 'di sos na mdzes/ /rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje twen po dang ldan pa nyid rgyal khab chen por phyag phebs te 'jam dbyangs mi rje'i rnam par rol pa dang mjal phrad skabs/ bdag po chen po nyid gzim khang gi ra sgo phyi ma'i bar du byon nas bsu ba mdzad cing / gzis/sa ma thag sog po'i lugs srol gyi mdza' gcugs shin tu che ba'i rnam pa bzhin/ rje bla ma'i sku la phyag gis 'khril ba'i 'tshams 'dri mdzad cing / dri bral srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas 'bul ba dang bcas sku don thams cad legs par grub cing lam bar du nye zho med par bde bar phyag phebs te nged dang mjal phrad byung ba la dga' ba tshad las 'das pa byung zhes phebs/ gzim khang du

rji btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ 431byon nas bzhugs /phri ga cig ljo/ myo/nyam por bzhus/sa te bod kyi/ gnas tshul sogaṭa/ gsung gleng zhipa tu myori/jad do/ /bod ma/sa phebs pa'i sku skyos lta bur sku brnya / dang thang 7ka cari nga po/ spo ṭa/ snam sogs gtos che ba phul ba rnams dgyes nga sa bzhes/ rgya nyu do/ga gi yul gru chen po'i bla dpon grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams kyirtswasri bod nas phebs pa'i legs 'bul phul ba dang / de dag la so so 'i go babs dang bstun pa'i lha rten spos snam sogs kyi gnang sbyi/na stsal pa so gaska mtha' yas kyang zhib tu 'god par dgos pa ma ma/chis pas ma bris so/ /'gro la thugs rje'i phyag gis dam 'khyud de/ /da lta nyid du bde bar gshegs pa'i sar/ /bde blag 'khrid pa'i thabs tshung gang 'i/ dra1/ ces/ /'di nyed kho na bas ma gtan myo/dzad pa des/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde kun+da'i chang / /chos srid 'phrin 'a sa zla ba'i 'od dkar gyis/ /kun nas bran pa'i rtse dgas rgod byas pa/ /sa skya /nga phu—/sa la bdud rtsi'i das/'a ston gyur/ /de tshe ris med dad ldan mtha' dag mi /sa/ /dad pa'i snyim pa bdog pa'i me to ga gis/ /yongs su bkang bas khyod la mchod byed cing / /de dag kun kyang bsod nams dpal gyis mdzes 'di phyin chad lo kha shari smu ring gi rnam par thar pa sa bon sogs ma byung bas zhib tu ma nges kyang thor bu 'ga' 'i/ga ni/ 7gong ma chen por dgongs len zhus te/ bod dang khams phyo gaṭa/ nas dad 'bul du byud ba'i gser gyis gdugs bzopo bkod phun sum tshogs pa rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis myo dze+es pa zhig gas ra bzo mdzad nas tsan dan jo bo'i dbu thog tu phul / de dang

4bye2 rngo btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bltas tshul/ dus mnyam du gong ma chen pos kyang jo bo la gser gyi dbu rgyan rin po che sna tshogs kyise su spras pa zhig 'bul gnang mdzad pas rten 'brel kyi sgo phun sum tshogs pa 'grig mi ring bar rje bla ma mchog nas dad ldan du mas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ zung ṭu zi'i lha khang du gas/nga bde 'jigs gsu/ma gyi dbang chen rgyas pa bka' drin stsal/ bod du rgya97 dbang mchog sprul rin po che yul dbus su gdan drangs te re zhig snye thang du bzhugs pa la legs skyes kyi zhu 'phrin dang dngos 'bul gya nom pa bskur gnang mdzad/de nas mi ring ba na rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po che pho brang chen po po ta la'i gser gye khri la mnga' ga ṭ+wā+oṃsmu+ol bar gong nas gser yig pa a kya zhabs drung / phu tā zhin bcas gtong ba gnang skabs rje bla ma mchog nas rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar rgya cher 'byed pa'i zhu 'phrin dang dngos po'i 'bul ba rgya che ba bskur gnang mdzad cing / rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas kyang 7gong mar 'tshams zhus kyi bang chen du dmigs bsal gyi mkhan po gtong ba gnang ba'i gdong rje bla ma mchog la gsung 'phrin dang gnang skyes gya nom pa stsal/ thugs dam gyi skabs shig mdun gyi nam mkha' na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes zhig bzhugs pas/ rje bla ma nyid zhal du drangs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mngal du phabs pas yum gyi mngal de gzhal yas khang zhig gi rnam par 'dug de nas phyir thon te rang gnas su bzhag pa'i lang ba byung bas dā—de nyams mi ba zo da pa lta bu 'khrungs shing nyin mang po'i bar du bde b.ri mdangs mi nyon sa si byung / 'di n-i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dngo ṭasmi/ kyis ma/ra dbang bsku ra te bde bar

myu btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bskubs tshul/ 453gshegs pa'i sras su bskru na pa dpag par dka' ba'i rnad+ngha smu par thar pa'o /ja sag bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel dus kyi cho sa nyid du shā ra par kho ba chung ngu nas zhabs phyir 'brang ste phyag g.yog thugs zin ngekha5 rtu ri ba ngacas rje bla ma mchog nas thugs shin tu brtse bas/ datho/ngas pa ched gtad kyis sgrib sbyong sogs mdzad par mdo khams su skyes pa'i k+ka tshan ma gsal ba byung ba bzhin phyis su rje bla ma mchog a mdor phebs skabs ngos 'dzin mdzad 'dug cing / ja sag de pa rje gong ma ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi dus gnyer pa tshul khrims dpal bzang yin zhes kho bo la dngos su ba/sungs/des mtshon nas phyis su sku mdun chos rje bstan pa rir/ chen pyi// skye rngi ) gsal bar gzigs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dang / btsun mu/nga dpal grub zer ba shi bas kho gzim khang gi nye 'dabs byi/ rgya mi khya /kro/ gi buspre no pyesdo/ 'dug pa gsal bar gzigs nas phyag g.yog rnams la gsungs shing / de nyin rgya mi des kyang bu chung sku drung du mjal khar khyer yong ba ngos 'a jin ma dzad pa dang / gnyer pa zhig shi nas ring po ma lon par shitsha/ tu/ rid cing nyam thag pa'i rnam pas sku drung du slebs byung bar thugs shin tu brtse bas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i bum chu nas ster na phan par dgongs te bum pa phyag tu blangs nas kho'i lag pa gzed pa la blug par brtsams kyang bumyo/ pa'i mchu 'gags nas chu cung zad kyang mi tho na pa byung bas mtshon/ gzhan gyi skye ba snga phye gas la bar gzigs nas gsang ba6 ) tshul gyis zhal nas dngos su gsung ba ma nga po zhig thos nasmyokrung 'ga' zhig dgag bya che ba 'dug pas ma bkod do/ /

454 rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bskubs tshul/phyag ca/dzod kyi go sar u cu mu chen smon rams pa bskal bzang lha dbang bsko bzhag gnang nas/ 7gong ma chen por snyan sgron zhus pas gyigong nas kyang kho ba la ja sag gi ngo/ ṭan khyo//nang / rje phonyid bod du bzhugs skabs rta tshag rje drung rin po che sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan par/gong nas khong gi tshab lta bur bla ma bzang ba zhig dgos tshul phebs pa la/rje bla ma mchoro/ nas/ khri dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sprul sku yon tan bzang zhing rgyud dul ba sogs bla mar 'os pa yod tshul zhus pa bzhin wo/ nga bgyigong ma'i bka/mi / pe'i cing du phebs pa sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis mi ring bar sku gshegs pa dang / 'di bi bas dga' ldan khri rin po che rang yul du ring tsam phebs chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus khrol byung ba bzhin a mdor phebs nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pas/ pho brang chen por rje bla ma gcig pu ma gtos/sa bla chen gzhan me da pa la/ gong nas bong ba gser gzigs lta bus kho bo cag pe'i cing du yong dngo/sa pa'i bka' phebs/bdag snga ma bod du yod skabs tshe 'dir dben pa'i gnas zhig tu sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed rgyu e yong gi re bas rgya phyogs co/gas la yong mi dgos pa'i mgo 'dren gnang da ges tshul rje bla ma mchog la yang yang gsol ba nan tan btab par de skabatra/ zhal bzhes bzang po gnang byung na'ang / sdon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa'i ma thu sangs rgya rig kyis kyang bzlog dka' bar gsungs pas kho bo cag mi 'dod bzhi na rgya napo/ tu 'gro da tshe/ sa pa byung / pho brang du slebs nyin rang khasga gsang stabs kyis skyabs ma pe2/na mchog la mjal bar phyin pas/ thugs shin tu di gyes pas 1the bo'i skye ba blo/nga ma rgyal po'i bla

rje btsun dam pa'i mdzu+o3ོga sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/ 455mchod mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / kho bosdo/ ldar bod du pho brang chen por yong mi dges pa'i mgo 'dren dgos pa zhus tshul dang / da res thabs med lta bu byung ba dang / sa myo/thar bstan pa'i khur bzung ba bsod nams che tshul sogs kyi bka' phebs stsal pas sems kyi skyo ba sang sa/ rnga/ ci/ga byung / 7gong ma ra mjal kha zhu ba sogs kyi mngo / 'dren yang dag pa gnang zhing / sku gsung thugs rten stan snye la 'bol ṣ+pe/3 9ba ga cha tshang dngul sogs gnang skyes kyang shin tu gzab pa stsal/ /bod yul rdzing chung sa/tsang zhing nyams dga' bar/ /rang 'dod bag yangs rgyu ba'i nye'u chung bdag /las kyi lcags kyus drangs te rgya thang gi /ga'/na dbang bye tshan nang du 'gre bar gyur/ /'on kyang mi rje gnam sa'i dbang phyug gi /bka' drin dpag bsam yal ga'i bsil gri ba dang / /mngo/na ‘krudi'i thugs rje nyal 'gros bskyangs pa las/ /tshe srog mtshun lha'i zas su ma gyur par/ /tshul gnyis gtsug lag rlabs kyi zhags pa yis/ /cho/ra 'dzin 'ching ba'i rgyal khab mtsho chen du/ /blon 'bangs sro ga chags bye ba 'khrigs pa'i nang / /lugs zung rnam dpyod 'khyug pas rtsen par byas/ /gyigong ma chen po'i bka' las 'di lo ha'apre ha rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku li thang nas gdan drangs te do lon nor du phebs nas lcang skya hu thog thu las rab byung gi tshul khrims mnos rjes hal har sku gong ma'i gdan sar 'khod pa byed rgyu/ yin pas/de'i rtsis kyi/sa hu thog thu dbyar gyi ring hai ho 'u dang do lon nor du bzhugs nas ston kha'i dupya rje btsun dam pa'i spru la sku mjal phrad ca/dzad na legs zhes phe bas pa bzhin/ zhi ho'u la byon nas re zhig bzhugs pa ོ(nar / der

456 rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshul/bzhugs skabs /khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi nem thar mkha' spyod grub pa'i gtam snyan lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas mtsho bdun gyi lha khang ser por phebs/ hor chin shong hor zhabs drung gis zhus pa bzhin dge 'dun mang po la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid smin rgyas su stsal/mtsho bdun gyi tham ka bla ca/ pi lig thu no min han gyis ga/co ba'i dgon shar nub gnyis kyi dge 'dun spyi nas gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ ga/zhir bzhugs dang phyogs 'dus kyi don gnyer ba nyis brgya lhag tsam la byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi nyams khrid zhag bco lnga'i bar du nyin re bzhin chos thun rgyas pa re mjug tu sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa bka' drin stsal/ 'di res kyi chos nyan pa'i khrod du dge bshes bzang po mang tsam bzhugs pas/ rje bla ma mchog nas khrid dmigs mder bsdus tsam ma yin par thog mtha' bar gsum du gsung bshad zab cing rgya che la 'dum bde ba/ byin rlabs kyi tshan khas yid dbang med du 'khul ba/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyis go bde bas don du 'gyur tshabs che ba dang / bar skabs 'ga' 'i/ga tu kha ras/ sgom chung bas/ mtshang nas brus nas ma bshad na/ /glen pa khyod la go ba med/ /gsungs pa bzhin skyon la 'big pa'i gsung rnon pos rgol ba sogs mdor na dge bshes ston pas/ theg chen gyi bla ma bya ba bshad pa na 'byams klas par go ba bskyed la/ lag tu len pa na bstan pa'i ba ma la sa/nga phan dang thad kar don du gang 'gyur ston pa zhig dgos/ zhes gang gsungs pa bzhin du 'doms par mdzad pas/ snod ldan thams cad kyi rgyud la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i

je btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byung bskubs tshul/ 451sa bon khyad par can bskrun cing / rje bla mas/ bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ /khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ /snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ /phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog /ces smon lam mdzad pa bzhin mtha' 'khob sa mtha'i yul du rje bla ma'i bstan pa'i snying po 'phel rgyas yun ring gnas pa'i 'chad nyan mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig mdzad snang ngo / /ba/zhan yang lam gyi ga tso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig si/ rjes gnang / 'jigs byed dpa' gcig rdor sems yab yum/bde mchog dkar po/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'od zer can bcas kyi rjes gnang dang / bsgrub bya sum cu tsam la dge slong gi sdom pa legs par stsal/ de nas byang phyogs bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rje btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul rin po che phebs pa la chibs bsu sogs gtong ba gnang zhing /rje nyid kyi kazid+ngha ra khang du mjal phrad skabs bkur gzos dang phebs ston so/gas sa//zab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ tshes grangs bzang po'i nyin sprul sku rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes te dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang bar ma'i chu'/ khrims stsal cing ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i mtshan gsol ba mdzad/ sprul pa'i sku rin po che phyag g.yog pa nyung shas bcas la 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang bo'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa bka' drin bskyangs/ sprul sku rin po che nas snga phyir brtan bzhugs dang 'brel b.ri 'bul nod gzab rgyas phul zhing / rje bla ma mchog nas kyang dkar spro so gas kyi dga' sto/na thog phebs rdzongs kyi dngos 'bul rgya che

45skye rje btsun dam ba'i mchog sprul la rab byung bsgrubs tshulo/spam mtho ba 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas rje btsun dam pa sprul pa'i sku rin bo che hal har phebs shing / rje bla ma nyid do lon nor nas ong nyod har chin brgyud zhi ho'u la phebs/ de skabs kho po har chin wang gi lha khang du yod pas/ lam bar du phebs bsu dang bzhugs zhag sar gaṭ+wāṃ ṭa la ston sogs phul bas thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ nai ho'u la phebs nas/7gong ma chen por mjal 'dzoms mdzad cing / rje btsun dam pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i babs rgyun zhu ba gnang bas7gong ma chen po yang thugs dgyes par gyur/ de nas rim gyis pe'i cing du bde bar phyag phebs si//'phags pa'i yul gyi grub chen nag po pa/ /gangs ri'i ljongs su 'akaum dbyan+d+ras chokha rjer gras/sa/ /de ༷nyilda byeng phyogs bstan 'gro'i dpal margen du/ /skye khrong0 rim byon dz+rī btsus dasdu pā zhes/ /mdzad bzang gser gyi thur ma brgya phrag gis/ /thub bstan gdugs dkar gyen du 'degs pa de'i/ /yang srid bsam 'phel nor bu skye rgu yi/dze /legs byas zla ba'i ma ma'i lto bar sbrum/ /de nyid tshangs spyod dpal la rjeca/ chags pas/ /bdag gi 'dren mchog 'di yi zhabs pad drung / /gus pas bsnyen te tshul khrims bdud rtsi yi sa/ /thugs rga /sa/nga rin chen yol go 'gengs par mdzad/ /de tshe dam pa'i rang rtags 'od dkar can/ /ma chog sprul zla spu/zhon 'di yis byang phyogs kyi/ /ba/dul bya'i ku mud nga zhad par byed do zhes/ /'phags yul gnyis skyes dag kyang thal mo sbyor//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dz+wa shesdu bsta0na patī sgrospu sdi

lja btsun dam pa'i mchog sprul la rab byungabasgrubs tshul/ 45nya/de dpyal bsdung dz+wa'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brdzo da pa dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ gangs can gyi ljongs nas rgyal khab chen por phebs te skal ldan rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / byang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me rje btsan dam pa'i mchog sprul rin po cher rab byang gi tshul ༄cukhrims stsol bar mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// // —tsho du

460 sluzhu bucu/ budun pu/ nado smrad nu sdongs su khyon nas gdan ska chen po brumās pu smrid gi chis nu khrin nangazha brasgyun te tshad mā rma/mā 'askrelka nu zhachad nyan gsar zhatsags naded puzhi tshulka/nub gcig rje bla ma'i mnal lam du gnas chung chos skyong khog zhugs byas/ pa 'e/ga gi rnam pas/ dgu dang bcu yi bar mtshams su/ /ye shes chen po rma do ru tso/sal/ /zhes sogs mang po zhig zer ba la mdo ni a mdo yin nam dar rtse mdo yin gsung bar a mdo yin zer ba zhig thugs rmis su byung ba bzhin/ chu lug lo 'di'i zla ba dgu pa'i mjug tsam na mdo smad du yab dus kyi chos sdod du gyur pa gsan ma thag zhag bdun gyi bar rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga mdzad cing / sgrib sbyong du gsere gyis bris pa'i thar mdo dang mdo sde pad dkar bzhengs na legs pa thugs dam brtag par byung ba bzhin phral du bzhengs pa mdzad/ gong ma chen por mdo khams su reb tsam phebs chog pa'i dgongs pa zhus par yab kyi don du phebs rgyu yin gshisagyigong nas kyang dgongs khrol byung / de nas sog yul brgyud de a mdor phebs pa na/ chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi mkhan po las thog pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin ngo/ ches sa //rī 0 ba'i dgon lung pa'i chibs bsu bas mtshon/ mdo snad

go da gdanasabyams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 461 tsong kha'i phyogs kyi/ bla ma che chung / dgon sgrub sde/ dpon che phra/ lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis chibs bsu sogs rgyas par byas/ thog myo/ra yab zhi bar gshegs pa'i sar byon nas sgrib pa sbyo nga ba'i thabs mang du mdzad cing /gong ma chen pos yab kyi gdung mchod thebs su dngul srang sum brgya dang rje bla mar 'tshams 'dri'i gser yig shangs ta shel dam gang bcaru/ rta zam thog nas gnang ba zi ling am pan gyis phul bas/ gsol ras la phyag 'tshal ba dang thugs rje gzigs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskyangs pa la bka' drin che ba'i zhu tshig 'bul ba gnang / de nas chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling du phyag phebs/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi gsol ras gya nom pa dang / spyi 'jog tu rgyal ba'i rnam thar dpag bas ma 'khri shing gi thang ka gras mtshungs lnga bcu 'jog pa mdzad/ dgon pas tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas brtan bzhugs rgyas par phul te dngos 'bul kyang spam mtho ba phul/ yun mi thung tsam bzhugs kyi ring la phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i hor 'brog gi phye bo dpag tu med pa la nyin re bzhin mjal kha phyag dbang dang / mtsho sngon gyi wang pe'i le pe'i ze gung ja sag sogs mi chen rmo mang po mjal bar 'ongs pa rnams kyis 'bul nod sogs phul zhing / so sor 'dod mos kyi bka' chos dang gnang sbyin sogs kyis tshim par ma dzad/cha gan no min han/ do nga po no min han/ kiti thogs med/ g.yer gshong sprul sku/ bya khyung mkhan po las thog pa zur ba rnams dang bcas mjal bar phebs shing so so nas brtan bzhugs sogs phul/ gzhan yang phyogs nye ring tha dad nas rang sa na che ba'i bla ma sku skye rigs riches mang po

462 gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/mjal khar byung 'dug pa mangs dwogs pas so so'i ming ma smos so/ /bya khyung ba rna mas mjal ba'i nub mo/ mi nag po gzi ngami/ da che ba zhig gis/khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi sprul sku theg chen yon tan dar rgyas gling du gdan drangs na rten 'brel bzang po 'grig rgyu yod zer ba la/ theg chen yon tan dar rgyas gling gang yin dris par bya khyung dgon yin zer ba thugs rmis la byung / phyi nyin mkhan po gdan zur sogs la mnal la ma byung tshul dang bod nas khri sprul sku bya khyung du gdan 'dren thub na legs tshul gyi phebs sgo stsal/ mnal lam gyi mi de bya khyungakaugi srung ma skyes mchos/ rdo rje legs pa'i rnam 'phrul du gdon mi za zhing / de nas bzung bya khyung chos sde'i mtshan yang de ngazhin 'jags pa byung 'dug sprel lo zla ba dang bo'i nang du datho/na lung gi phu na snga ma phebs dus zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas gre/sang sngags bde ba chen po'i pho brang gi gzim chung du sku mtshams dam par bcad de/ rten dang mchod gtor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad kyang rgyud nas bshad tshod dang mthun pa tshogs pa mdzad cing / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad/de skabs gzigs snang zhig khu3sgrub khang gi steng gi nam mkha' na sprin nag 'khrigs shing char 'bab la khad pa dang 'brug sgra sgro ga cing glog 'od 'khyug pa lta bu'i nyams dang / dngos su yang sha chen gyi dri dang / skabs 'ga' zhig tu ga nas 'ong mi shes pa'i gsur dri chen po can gyi du bas gzim khang gi nang thams cad khengs pa dang / rnga brdung ba lta bu'i 'ur sgra dang thug chom gyi sgra 'jigs su rung ba sna tshogs kyis nye gnasru so /gas skyi ga/ya' ba

/de gidan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs rte 'chad nyanabatsugs tshul/ 46sdod byung 'dug nang chod kyang dngos su khol te lbu ba 'khrigs shing dri bzang lo 'thul ba dang / nub re bzhin khyi nag po lus bong shin tu che zhing rngam brjid dang ldan pa 'i/ga sgrub khang gi steng 'og rnams su yang yang 'dur rgyug byed pa la phyag g.yog pa 'ga' zhig gis khyi rang dga' bar bsams nas ded pas gar song med pa byung / 'di skabs dgos pa khyad par can zhig la dgongs te nub mang por drag po'i sbyin sreg mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gnang zhing / de skabs sku shin tu 'jigs zil che khas mchod g.yog so sa/sa kyis zhal blta mi bzod pa byung 'dug nub gcig mnal lam du/ bud med nag mo shin tu 'jigs su rung ba dre'u la zhon cing gdugs phub pa zhig sku drung du 'ongs nas cung zad ma rangs pa'i tshul gyis/ rje bla ma mcho ga la/khyed rang rgya yul du gtan bzhugs mdzad nas rang yul gyi dgon sde blos gtong ba zhes 'khang ba'i rnam pa byed pa la/ rje bla ma nyid nas/ nged rang rgya yul du bsdad nas gong ma chen po thugaṭa/ chos la 'dun par byas te rang yul gyi dgon pa tsam du ma zad/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin thams cad la phan thogs byas pa las/ rgya yul du rang dgar ma bsdad pa khyod kyis ma shes sam zhes bka' bkyon lta bu mjad pas/ kho dre'u las babs nas phyag gcig btsal ba thu'e tre5 dri ri shrī snyekru byung /'di dgon lung gi srung ma dpal ldan lha mo'i 'phrul yin pa 'dug ces kho bo la dngos su gsungs/ nyin gcig thugs dam la bzhugs khar sku gnyer la ting phor zhig khyer shog sa/sungs pa la/ cili ting zhig phyag tu phul bas dbu la kha sbub tu bkab nas thugs dam la cung zad bzhugs/

da 464 — gdan sa byams pa gling gi tshas khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ de nas ting phor zhabs phyi pa phyag rdor zer ba la gnang byung bar/ ting phor shin tu tsha ba me'i nang nas blang ma thag lta bu lag pa sa rīg mi bzod pa byung / zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas 'di nga'i grub rtags yin no gsungs zhes nga thos/ thun mtshams zhig dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam rim pa gnyi sa dang sbyar ba'i gsung mgur ya mtshan can gnang ba ni 'di ltar ro /na h+phe gu ru badz+ra hai ra wa ya/ dpal 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sgyu ma'i gar/ /rje ga/sum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i mchog /drin 'khor med ngag dbang ma cho ga ldan gyi/ /zhabs bdag snying pad+mo'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs//dus/ ba/nas skabs mthar thug legs tshos/sa kun/ /mgon khyod drin kho nar rag las pas/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpar legs bltas nas/ /sgo rkyagye rme/ kyisasgyu khyod myo/nyes bgyid par smon/ /rten dal 'byor don che rnyed dasnad//0 /ci/nga / /dgra 'a'u bdag nam 'ong nges med pas/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la yid gtad nas/ /las dkar nag blang dor tshul bzhin bya/ /bh+ya tho srid pa'i rtse mo'i phun tshogs kyang / ci/las nyon mongs rang bzhin sdug ngasngal dngos/ /don de phyir srid las grol pa'i phyir/ /lam bslab gsu ma rgyal mtshan 'dzin par smon/ /'gro ri sa/sa drug drin can mar shes nas/ /byams snying rje lhag bsam gyis drangs pa'i/ /thabs byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /yid dam bca' brtan pos bskyed par bya/ /yu la yul can snang pa'i spros pa kun/ /nang rtog pas btags pa tsam zhig las/ /don rang steng grub pa med pa'i tshul/ /sems rgyud
