gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 465la bskor te gtan la phebs/ /dbang rnam dag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis//rmongs dri ma rnam bzhi bkrus pa las/ /dpal sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges pa'i/ /rgyud skal ba bzang por bsgrub par bya/ /zab rgya che lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /yid tha mal snang zhen kun sbyangs nas/ /gzhi srid pa skye 'chi bar do'i rgyun/ /lam sku gsum ngo bor khyer la brtson/ /lus rdo rje'i bkod pa gsal dwangs dbus/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i pho brang lte ba ru/ /pha 'jigs mdzad rdo rje yab yum mchog /dbyings bde stong sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /thugs 'dod chags chen po'i shel gyi mdangs/ /brtan g.yo ba'i dngos kun khyab pa las/ /ro gcig tu zhu ba kun 'dus pa/ /yum 'od gsal nam mkha'i ngang du zhug sa/ /slar sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i skur bzhengs te/ /rtsa gnyis spangs sbru gu'i lam po cher/ /khams blo nyi'i bgrod pa 'bab 'dzegs kyis/ /lam dga' ba bcu drug ngo mtshar rgyas/ /dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i pho bra/nga dbus/ /rlung ga'u kha sbyor mi shigs sems/ /thugs rdo rje'i rnam par brtan pa yis/ /dgra gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rgyu ba gzhom/ /rtsa mchog gi pi wang khog pa ru/ /rlung sna lnga'i rgyud mang bskul ba las/ /gdangs gsang ba gsum gyi rab snyan sgra/ /lan grangs med bsgrags pas dga' ston ngoms/ /las ye shes the ki'i phyag kyā dang / /lhan cig tu skyil krung rnam bzhi'i stabs/ /yang yang du bsgyuro nga'i sim pa la/ /rtag rol pa'i bde skyid ci yang rgyas/ /gzhi 'khor ba'i rgya mdud ma lus pa/ /dus cig char grol pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /mdog rnam gsum snang ba zad par bskyal/ /ma gnyug

466 gdanari/rti—mad /paglingagi chos khrir bzhugs/ te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ma'i sems dang mngon sum mjal/ /dpe bcu gnyis ldan pa'i sgyu ma'i lus/ /snad bcud kyi dkyil 'khor khyab cing bsdu/ /don de las kun nyon mthar byed pa'i/ /yum phyag rgya chen mo'i rig sngags bsgrubs/ /yid bde sto nga sa/nyis med shel gyi khams/ /lus dbeng po'i gzhu dang dbyer med pa'i/ /don gsang gsum ngo bo ga/cig gyur pa/ /dpal zung 'jug bde ba'i dga' ston myong / /dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par/ /rgyud rnam lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dpal mi gnas myang 'das la 'god pa'i/ /don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /'bangs lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje nga / /tshe 'di snang bya bas rtag g.yengs pas/ /chos sgrub pa'i skal ba phra mod kyang / /sems mos pa brtan pos glu 'di blangs/ /pha bla ma 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dang / /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo thugs rjes gzigs/ /lam 'di nyid 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal mkha' spyod bde ba'i grong khyer du/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i pho nyas myur drangs nas/ /myo/gon bla ma lha yi zhal dkyil dang / /yid spro ba chen pos mjal gyur cig /ces 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i 'a /ma kyi rim pa yongs su dzogs pa dang sbyar ba'i glu dbyangs mkha' spyod grub pa'i dga' ston ces bya ba 'di ni/ rig 'dzin rdo rje theg pa la mo sa pa bsgrortan po dang ldan pa'i lcang smyon rol pa 'i rdo rjes/ chos sde chen po dgon lunge byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs da be ñca / tshi/nas gsang sngags bde ba chen po'i pho brang du yid la gang shar thol byung du glur blangs pa'i yi ge pa no dbyod ldan dge slong dge legs nam mkhas bgyis pa 'dis

da dgadanasabyams pa sgrung gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 467kyang gaṭa/nga chen rdo rje theg pa'i bsta na pa rgyas par gyur cig /ces pa ste gsung 'di la dpags na mtshams nang der rdzog/sa/ rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'as/'a ji/dzo/ thugs la 'khrungs par mngon no/ /sku mtshams grol nas chu bzang sprul sku/ sum pa mkhan chen/ ridagon lung rgyud pa bla ma blo nga zang dge legs sogs snod ldan nyung 'dus la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi lus dkyil gyi dbang yongs su rdzog5 / pa bka' drin du stsal/ de dus dbang bshad sogs rgya che zhing zab pa —//nang bas chos nyan mkhan blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sngo hrang nge dngos su byon kyang 'di las lhag pa ston rgyu med ces sgrog par byed do/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gru sa/zings la zhon nas/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mcho yi/ /pha mthar phyin khyod dben pa'i ri sul du/ /sgrub la rga/zhol ba'i ngal ba 'dis ci bya/ /'on kyang rtog ge phal cher ne tso bzhin/ /'di snang gzeb tu chud pas sgrub pa'i mkhar/ /'phur ba'i skabs bral tshig zlos tsam zhig gis/ /lang tsho yol bar bye da la co 'dri nyid/ /'di na dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu/ /rang nyid snyems shing gzhan gyis sgrogs pa dag /phal cher cho ga 'ba' zhig la la ni//gar thig dbyangs rol tsam gyis khengs pa nyid/ /rdo rje'i sa/sang tshig stoshā ri gi rlabs 'khrugs pas/ /zab don rin chen rnyed dka' gsang chen gyi/ /rgyud sde rgya na /tshor 'dod rgur dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /gdengs can daḥ sgang po khyod nyid gcig pur bas/ /kla klo'i skad dang mkha' 'gro'i brda' la sos/sa/ /rdo rje'i tshig mdud dam pos nyer bcings pa'i/ /

6 468 gdan sa byamasapa glingagichosakhrirabasngigasate'achad nyan btsusas tshul/sbas rgyud gsang tshig bkrol te snying po'i don/ /skal bzang 'ga' la khyod kyis rjen par bstan/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro 'khren la mi dgongs par//gsang chen chos mdzod sgo brgya cig char du/ /phye ste zab don thang mar brdal ba khyod/ /ha cang thugs rje'i gzhan dbang gyur par zad/ /bden gnyis e waṃ dngos po gcig gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje'i zab gnad ji bzhin ston pa la/ /byang chub rdo rje can dang dbyer med pa/ /zla med bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du dgon lung du phebs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gtso ba'i chos grwa chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi 'dus sde spyi nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'jam dpal —zhal lung gi bka' khrid thugs rje gzigs dgos tshul gyi gso la ba btab par dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gtso mdzad/ chos sde rang gi sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / zhabs drung sku skye chos rje rnams dang /sde snod la sbyangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos mtshon pa'i gzhir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun dang / gser dgon/ sku 'bum/ bya khyung / bde chen/ ror po dgon/ bkra shis 'khyil sogs dgon chen rnams dang /gzhi dgon/ sgrub sde ci rigs nas don gnyer gyis 'dus pari bla ma che chung dge bshes ka rams sogs khyon gsan mkhan nyis stong lnga brgya tsam la/ tshogs chen gyi 'du khang chen mo'i nang du byang chub 'a ma lhi rim pa nyams su len tshul rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen lo 'i legs bshad thams

giden sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs rte 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 46nya cad kyi nang na phul du gyur pa khrid yig 'jam dpal zhal lung gi steng nas nyin bco lnga 'i bar gsung bshad shin tu zab rgyas dang bcas bka' drin stsol pa mdzad/ 'di dus chos gsan mkhan gyi khrod du dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa ches mang ba la/ rje bla ma ma chog nas kyang po ti lnga ka'i dka' ba'i gnad du ma bkrol zhing / khyad par du dbu phar rnam 'grel bcas lam gyi rirma par bsgrigs pa'i gsung bshad shin tu zab pa sna re tsam go bas kyang lam gyi gnad du ma zhig la nges pa bde blag tu ster bar 'gyur pa lung rigs kyis mtha' chod pa stsal cing / de yang bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros dang brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal lung gis brgyan te bshad yam tsam ma yin pa'i rgyud tho ga tu bkal nas sems 'dul ba'i rim pa dang sbyar te/ mdor na rgyal ba tsong kha pa dngos byon kyang de las lhag pa ston rgyu med pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston nyin bzhin spel bar mdzad/ der chos gsan mkhan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams yid lhag par tshim pas/zhal lung las/ ma dag snod kyi skyon spangs gzur ba/nas kyi/ /rna bar dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs snyan po/ /yongs 'dzin zhal gyi sgo nas nyer thos pa/ /bskal par bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams zong gis rnyed/ /ces sa/sungasdoshaṃ pa ltar/ bdaka cag 'di lta bu'i skal ba bzang po nyams su myong ba la dpags na tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs che ba zhig bsags pa'i rigs su gdon mi za'o zhes dga' ba'i ca co rgyud mar sgro ga par byed cing / 'di lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i 'chad nyan cha/do khams kyi ljongs 'dir u duslu ra'i me tog dang mtshungs pa'i dbang gis

4k+ṇi0 gdan ga girda / —/ pa —ldita 3 sho—rji—ldo ba0gas te 'chad 7na—rdatsugs ༄ la/ da sangs rgyas kyi zhal k+ka thori ba'i lha klu na mas kyang shin tu ya — tshan cing dga' ba'i bsngags ngarjod sri —di rtse'i bar du bsgrags pa rnga //domyo/ 5 mi/ ro ‘ra / dus kyi mthar yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bsta na pa'i snying po mi nub cing ring du sa/nas pa'i mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams kyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog par byed pa'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung ba'o/ /pe'i cing du kho bo caka r+ṣa/sa khari ma rim gyi ngaka' chos gnang ba thugs rje che tshul zhus skabs zhal nas dbuṭashrī /tsang gi 'og tu mdo khams 'di bstan pa dar rgyas che li+o /nga rnam dge+o‘ོ/da dang lda na pa mang ba'i gnas yin pas/ da res lam rim gyi khrid gzab ngashad bgyis pa'i lugre/kusmu yin/ dgon lung gi ba/zho bdag de nag phyo gas pa zhi rka// yin 'dug pas chos nyan gyi skabs kha ba nyin mtshan med par babs/ byung yang / snying rus bskyed nas chos thun rgyun ma chad par btang ba yin zhes bhe ga/sungs//'di na pad dkar gzhon nu'i dri bsung gis/ /bung ba'i tshogs rnams ring nas 'gugs pa bzhin/ /gang ba/sungs legs bshad gsar ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /ris med skal bzang sa/dul bya mgron du bos/ /de tshe smra ba'i seng ge du ma yis/ /gus pa'i rga/tsug gis nyer bteg 'chad pa'i khrir/ /khams zla /sum chos kyi rgyal po khyod nga zhugs te/ /'jigs med spobs pas/ chos kyi rnga chem/ brdungs/ /gang ge r+ṣa/grin pa longs spyod 'khor ro yi/ /mdud pa dbyangs kyi rgyal mos bkropa ba ras/ /blo ldan rna bar bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ba'i/ /snyan rgu'i dbyangs kyi ro' mo mi 'byung med/ /dman pa rnams ni ma/ngon mtho'i phun tsho gas dang / /bar

da gdan sa byams pa glingagoḥ khrir batram̐0/wa/ ta spyo—da—tshi btsugs tshul/ 471ma'i 'gro ba nges legaṭatrī/ thar pa'i ngade/ /dbang bo/ ma chog rnams tham sa cad mkhyen pa'i sar/ /bgrod rnga/'i lam gyi rim pa rgyas par bstan/ /gsang ba zab mo'i dbyangs ba du na rdzornga sna/sa pa'i glu/ /'di ni rgyal gsung 'dus pa'i rol mo ste/ / smiske/trīnan du cho/sa pa mi 'dra sna tshogs pa'i/ /gdul bya'i yid rjes 'jug pa 'di mi sre da/ /bstan pa thams cad gru bzhir 'khyer shes nga'i bla ma/ /ma gtosgyu—/sa med ces 'brom rje gsungs par mi 'tshal te/ /k+to/sung rab don kun skyes bu gsum dang sngags kyi lam/ /bzhi ru sdud shes bya/khas pa ga/cig cig 'di na'ang snang / /mtha' dbus kun na rang rang smra ba yi/ /kha sgo sa/sal ba'i 'od ldan mang mchis kyang / /yongs rdzogs thub bstan sa chen gsari/la byed pa'i/ /chos kyi nyi ma 'di 'dra gzhan byung su/ /rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas dgon lung gi khri khur 'jog pa banang ste/ da res rje ngatsun bla ma dam pa nyid cho sa sde chen po'i khri la mnga' gso la na rten 'brel gyi 0/nad che'am snya/ma pas ci 'dra 'dug ce sa khri zur rnams dang kros dbang ba dge 'du na mang bcas la bka' 'dri ji /nang bas/ thams cad kyis legs so phul ba bzhin khri gdan zur rnams kyi sa gtso ba'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis ma/grin gcig gis gdan sa chen po'i chos kyi khri la bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab pa la/rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos sde 'di nyid rang gi rtsa ba'i gdan sa yin pas khyed rnams nas khri pa byed dgoṭaṭa k+to/sungs pa dang / nged rang khri la 'dug pa gnyis ka babs 'os med pa min na'ang / nged rang gong ma'i bkas

da wa4ṭ+wāṃ2 gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/phral du pho brang du 'gro dgos shing / chos sde chen po 'di nyid a mdo'i phyogs 'dir 'chad nyan gyi chos sde byung ba'i thog ma bstan 'dzi ri ghi skyes bu mang du byon pa'i bshad grwa chen po yin pas/ nged rang khri pa'i go sar bsdad nas chos 'chad nyan sogs mi byed par yul thag ring bor song nas 'dug pa bstan pa la phan pa las gnod pa che bas/ de bas na go sa che chung la ma ltos pa'i sku yon che zhing thugs rgyud bzang ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan zhig khrir gad na drangs nas bzhus/sdo/ na/ bstan pa'i bya ba 'phel bar 'gyur bas lekas zhes phebs nas zhal bzhes ma mdzad pa la/slar yang tshang mas phyag dang bcas gsol ba nan tan du btab ste/ rje bla ma nyid rten 'brel gyi khyad kyis khri la bzhugs nas 'chad nyan thun gcig tsam gyi mgo 'dzugs pa nga/ nang rjes sku tshab lta bu bsko bzhag mdzad pas 'thus tshul zhus par dka' dka' zhig la mthar zhal gyis bzhes pa mdzad/deng sang mad smad kyi phyogs 'di dag tu dgon sde ma nga po'i khri 'a dzin bdag byed rgyu e yong gi re bas 'bad pa dung dung byed cing / khri la 'aspo/ da rgyu byung ba dang (ragrig lam chos 'chad nyan sogs srang kha'i rdo bzhim/ yal bar dor te/ dge 'dun gyi zhal gyi 'du sgo tshun chad bcom nas rnyed bkur 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba dang / chos mthun thos bas ma la gzhol ba rnams la mthong skre yang mi byed par mthun 'jug la res pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams ba /zengs ngastod pa sogs bstan pa nyams pa'i las la bstan pa'i bya bar ming btags te rang nyid bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du rlom sems byed cing / dgon sde che chung mang po'i mkhan khrir bsdud pa'i grags stong

gdan sa byams pa gling ṅge chos khrir bzhugasge/ te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 473tsam thob bya mthar thug tu sems pa'i che phra mang po zhig snang re' / nge bla ma mchog gis de 'dra la dgongs nas phral du zhal bzhetshori ska ma sa/nang bar zad do/ /yangari zhal nas/ nged rang tshad ma rnam 'grel/7 'di la shin tu mos ba zhig yod ci nga / chos sde zhig tu rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan cig 'dzugs rgyu byu/nga na bsam pa snga ma zhig nas yo da kyang 'jurga/ṭasdo tre bas ma 'grig da res nged rang chos sdi 'a sni nyid kyi khri la sdod pa dang stangs cig tu rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyak+ta/ cidzo/ btsugs na legs sa ma snyam zhes bka' phebs pa la/ thams cad kyis shin tu dga' spro dang bcas pas de 'dra mdzad na bka' drin shi na tu che chul zhus/ de nas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku re na po che nas khur bzheri smu kyis 'dzin grwa gong 'og nas rigs pa smra ba mang cam bsdus te/ rnam 'grel gyi 'dzin grwa zur du phye zhing rtsi bzhag sos/sa 'dzin du ba/cug de nas ba/za' tshes phun sum tshogabu/ pa'i nyin bka' sa/dmas glegs bam sogs kyi lung gis zin cing / dam pa'i skye sa bu ba rarngu 5 ཿ da du byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i da ge 'dun 'du ba'i bste sa/nas/ legs bshad cho sa kyi dbyangs snyan rgyun mi 'chad du sgro gas pa'i das/'a tshal/ mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung khungs cho sa sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gli nga zhes grags pa'i gtsug la ba/ khang che na por/ dge 'dun nyi sa stong lhag tsam 'du ba'i tshogs kyi dbus su spyan drangs te/ mi 'jigs seng ges bteg pa'i 'od 'bar nod bu'i /phri la zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod de dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid bdag gir bzhes pa la/ spyi so dang bla brang che kha so so nas /phri 'bul sri+o gas ji/zab

da 474 gdan sa byams pa gling gi ‘sa khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyanabatsugs tshul/—da wargyas phul zhir dge 'dun nerma sa kyis myo/jal phya/sa/ zhus/ de nas chos/ grwar phebs 'dzin grwa bcu bzhi tsam la rtsi bzhas/ 0/nang zhing / rnam 'grel tso/sar 'dzugs kyi 'dzin grwa la sgo mang yig cha rnga/ two/sri ra ba'i rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i mgo nas rtsi kyāzhag rgyas pa gnang / sku mdun rang du dam bca' btsugs te bla ma 'ag/'a zhig dang dge bshes che gras bgro gleng gtong ba la gzigs rtog mdzad/ phyis su dgon lung du rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan btsugs par yis/ cha gang btang na les/ de 5 zhe ri sa 7paṇa chen chos pyi/ rgyal por zhu ba gnang bas/ se ra rje btsun pa'i yis/ cha btang na legs gsungs shing dpe rgyun dkon pa la/ paṇa ḍirichin mchog nas phyag dpe yang khaskur ba sa/nang / pe'i cing du yig cha'i par sa/sar brko gnang ba dgon lung du 'dzag pa mdzad cing rnam 'grel gyi ja tshul theb0shaṃ su dngul dkar srang stong phrag gcig gsol rasdo/ stsal/ dngul rname sa phyis su lcang skya bla brang gi mdzod pa zhwa dmar dka' bcu mchoka ldan zer ba'i kha che la mgrin pa yangs pa 'jig rten pha rol blos btang ba zheg gis khyur mid byas 'dug cing /rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan ni deng sang bar du ma nyams par gnas so / / thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis rang gi ston pa dang / de'i pa ltan pa la snying thag pa nas dad pa gting chugs pa zhipo/ ma skyes par skyabs 'gro rnam dag tsam yang 'byung dka' la/ dad pa yang rigs pa yang dag la brten nas ma skyes na rkyen thes/ dka' zhing / ris/sa/ pa'i lamyoshaṃ nas drangs pa'i dad pa gaṭīng tshugs/ 5/ bcos ma ma yin pa skye ba 'a / tshad ma rnam 'grel las rang gi ston pa grol pa don 4 /sprer la me da ma yin chu9pu dang /

gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 475des bstan pa'i bden bzhi'i blang dor rnams rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba yin tshul gtan la phab pa rnams shes pa la rag las pas/ rje bla ma nyid kyis rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan bstan pa'i rtsa bar dgongs nas nan tan chen po mdzad pa 'di la chos kyi gnad shes pa rnams kyis brtagaṭasmu na bstan pa'i bya ba chen po zhis/ yin pa shes te/ bla ma dam pa'i rma dzad pa 'di lta bu la chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa dang yid rangs pa dbang med du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di na thar ba don gnyer gyi/ /skyes bus las su bya ba ni/ /'khor ba chu bo rabs med las/ /thocin pa'i zam pa 'tshol ba ste/ /tshul 'di nam yang mi sems par/ /lto 'grang tsam gyis chog shes pa/ /de ni sha tshugs mir snang yang / phyugs kyi grangs su bgrang bya nyid/ /bden bzhi'i blang dor ma gtogs pa/ /srid las grol thabs gzhan med la/ /tshul de thub pa'i bstan pa las/ /phyi rol gyur la ma mchis so/ /de lta bas na rig pa yang dag gis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa grol pa don gnyer la/ /bstan bya'i don la mi bslu'i 'jug ngogs su/ /nges pa rnyed pa 'dun ma'i dang po ste/ /de yi ma thu las blang dor ston pa po/ /bklu med tshad ma'i skyabs su yid ches nas/ /bstan dang ston pa gzhan du mi 'tshol ba/ /de la nang ba sangs rgyas pa zhes zer/ /tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bder gshegs skyob don mi shes par/ /'dun sdang gti mug 'jigs pas 'gro ba yis/ /ngur smrig bgos kyang khyim pa mgo reg yin/ /yid ches nges pa bral ba'i khog stong shing / /dad gus bcos

476 gdan sa byams ba sgrung gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ma'i pags pas g.yogs pa las/ /tshig gi skyabs 'gro'i rgyud mang sgra 'byin pa/ /dmus long kha zas 'tshol ba'i thabs su zad/ /de phyir bstan dang ston pa bslu med du/ /sgrub pa'i yang dag rig tshul gi'u wa/ /phyogs kyi glang po'i rnam dpyod lus po las/ /thon 'di thar 'dod bsten bya'i bdud rtsi mchog /tshu la de dgongs nas rgyal rnga bdun pa'i gzhung / /blo gsal yongs kyis thos bsam dbyu gu yis/ /srid mtha'i bar du chad med rdungs shig ces/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'di yis bka' lung bsgra7/ sa/ /de nas slar yang chu bzang gzhis dgon du phebs/ yab kyi gdung rus kyi mchod rten lha khang bcas bzhengs rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang ljags bkod gnang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po'i dbang chen bka' drin stsal/ gser khog dga' ldan dam chos gling bas gdan drangs pas der phebs nas zhag gcig bzhugs/ tshogs chen du lam rim chos thun gcig gnang zhing mang 'gyed sogs kyi gsol ras kyang stsal/ khong tshos tshogs dbur spyan drangs te brtan bzhugs kyi dngos 'bul phul zhing dge 'dun rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ no min han dang zhwa lu pa'i bla brang gnyis nas gsol ston rgyas pa phul/ de nas gong ma'i bkas lcags rmog dpon po dmag zor mgon po dang / khams kyi dpon po dbang 'dus sogs byi ched dus+t+waṃ ze ling du phebs/ bkas mngags pa'i zi khron tsong du dang zi ling mam pan lhan rgyas thog dpon po de gnyis kyi don skor rnams legs lam che ba mdzad/ chos sde chen po sku 'bum nas gdan 'dren zhus

gidan sa byams pa gling gi sa khrir bzhugs dha 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 47 7pa bzhin phebs/ 'du khang chen mor dge 'dun gyi tsho gas dbur gdan drangs nas brtan bzhugs kyi dngos 'bul bteg lam rim chos thun gcig gnang nas lhag mthong gi skor la gsung bshad khyad thon stsal pas dge bshes rnams yid tshim pa'i dad gus lhag par 'phel/ rje'i mchod sdong gi mdun du mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te bstan pa rgyas pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam sogs nan tan du mdzad/ mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs kyi gsol ras rgya cher stsal nas slar yang chos sde chen po dgon lung du phebs/ de nas rgyar khab chen por chibs bskyod nye ba na/ sku tshab tu 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon byed par gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po ja sag bla ma bskal bzang lha dbang bsko bzhag mdzad/ khong gis zhus ngor bslab bya bdud rtsi'i yang zhun zhes bya ba 'di sa/nang ste/ na mo gu ru badz+ra snya ra ya/ mchog gsum kun 'dus drin can bla ma la/ /rtse gcig yid kyis gus pas btud byas te/ /dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi snying po'i don/ /gzhen bskul bslab bya mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /rgyal ba'i sa/sung rab dgongs 'grel bcas pa kun/ /gdul bya'i sems rgyud 'chos pa'i thabs yin pas/ de dag las lhag gdams ngag bslab bya ni/ /blo dang ldan pa su yis sa/nga nas rnyed/ /khyad par snying nas chos bzhin bya 'dod na// bka' sa/dmas gong rma 'i ga/sung las byung ba bzhin/ /tshe 'di blos btang bud snyegs thob gsum sogs/ /nges par da gos mod de tsam ma byung yang / 'di dang phyi ma gnyis las phyi ma gtso/ /chos dang 'jis/ rten gnyis las dam chos rga/tso/ /bshad dang sgrub pa gnyis las sgrub pa gtso//

da 413 da dgadan sa byams pa gleng gi chos khrir bzhugs rte 'chad nyan btsugs tshusku/snya/ma pa'i blo gdengs 'cha' ba sa/nad du che/ /ming dang snyan grags 'khor da nga dpal 'byor sospre /3sa/ /lta ci dam choṭashaṃ thos ngasam gi+o/ma pa yang / /niri tshe 'di'i ched du byed pa'i blos bslad na/ /phal cher ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru no 'gyur bar ba/suris/ /de phyir tshe 'di ji ltar byas kyang phyid/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags/ tshags ku/ ma tshud na/ /de ring tsam yang gar 'gro cha med pa/ /yang yang bsams nas blo sna skyungakushrī pa gces/ /las dbang btsan po sus kyang bzlog tu med/ /'di snang mno bsam tho ga tu khel bar dka'//skyabs la blo gtad las/ byis gar phrad pa/ /bdag gir bya zhing chos su 'khyer ba gces/ /khe nyen skyid sdu ga 'dam ga'i dbang yod dus/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub la mi 'bad na/ /'chi bdag pho nyas zin par gyur pa'i tshe/ /rang gis rang la zhe khrel 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ /chos kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i dam chig yin/ /chos kyi bskul ma 'chi ba rjes dran yin/ /chos kyi snying po nges 'byung byang sems yin/ /chos kyi ma thar thug nges don dbu ma yi na/ /sa lam rtogs pa mchog dman ma lus pa/ /gzhan phan bsam pa rgya che rgya chung dang / /gnas lugs rtogs pa phul che phul chung ba'i/ /sgo nas 'jog phyir don de sems pa gces/ /bla ma grogs dang chos la dag snang sbyongs/ /nga rgyal khong khro los/ lta sku—/nyen pos gzhom//dman sa gtsor bzung 'di snang 'dun ma skyungs/ /rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba chos pa'i mchog /rkyen dang phra da dus chos kyis ma phan na/ /'grangs skyid cho sa pa'i gzugs brnyan ya ma brla/ /de phyir rkyen ngan phra mo nas bzung ste/ /rim gyis lam du slong ba'i stobs bskyed bya4 /

gdan sa byam / pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/ 479bsta ma/ dang 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba ni/ /shin tu chung yang srog dang bsdos te sgrubs/ /rang don tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mnog che ltar/ /snang yang mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du spongs/ /rang nyid rtogs pa mtho yang rlom sems spo ngas/ /gzhan gyi yon tan phra yang yi rang bskyed/ /mtho mnyam dma' la gus das/'a brtse ba yis/ /rtag tu gshis bzang bsten pa gnad du che/ /rang khyo ma/ /bab rtse tsam yang 'bad pas gzhom/ /gzhan skyon ri lta ra che yang byams brtses skyo ngas/ /kun tu rang rgyud 'dul bar 'bad byas na/ /chos/ kyi rtogaṭa/ pa skye ba mi ring nye/ /khe rgyal bde dge ma/tha'asgodag/ khu /zhan la 'bul/ /pham gyong sdig sdug mtha' dag rang la len/ /sa/zhan don kho na'i ched du rdzogs byang sgrubs/ /sems5 de skye phyir bsag sbyang nga/nyis la 'bad/ /sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje theg /dngos grub gnyis kyi gter gyur gang de la/ /ci yo da rtsal gyis bag chags (rajo ga pa'i phyir/ /sgo ba/sum 'bad pa drag po bsten pa gces/ /spyi bor bla ma snying /༄ra lha bsgoms nas/ /sno/da bcud ma lus ye shes rol par blta/ /las rlung skyu tir 'gog pa'i phyi nang thabs/ /bsre ba rnam dgu'i gnad dang sbyar nas skyongs/ /mdor na blo bzang rgyal ba'i legs bshad kun/ /rgyud la bskor te yang yang semasace byas na/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma lag rtser thob dang 'dra/ /de bas rnam pa kun tu 'di la 'bad//sngo na byon ris med dam pa'i gsung rab kyang / /phyogs su ma lhung yid kyiṭa/ mang bltas na/ /rang re'i lugs la bogs 'don mchog yin pas//legs cha ma lus bsdus la nyams su longs/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub

480 gdan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /'dzin par nus phyir lha dang bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol 'debs sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i/ / chos shig bsgrubs na skyes bu'i yang rab yin/ /de ltar kho bos gdams pa'i legs bshad 'di/ /snying gi za ma tog tu bsrel byas nas/ /thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /rang gzhan don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /de ltar gtam 'di bsnyad pa'i dge ba yis/ /rgyal bstan dri med yun ring gnas pa dang / /'gro ba kun kyang 'khrul med lam bzang jis/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig /ces bslab bya bdud rtsi'i yang zhun zhes bya ba 'di yang rang gi slob ma gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po ja sag bla ma bskal bzang lha dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor/ lcang skya ro' pa 'i rdo rjes dbe+en gnas gsang sngags bde chen pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan dge slong dge legs nam mkhas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/zhes pa'o/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po mi yi gar/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa sku bltams shing / /'jam mgon sa paṇa sogs kyis byin brlabs pa/ /mkhas grub du ma rim byon mdo smad ljongs/ /me tog tshon gyi ri mo rnam bkra ba'i/ /spang ljongs lha yi dar dang kha ba'i rdul/ /rab dkar ka shi ka yi gos zung gile/ /cir yang klubs pa'i sa 'dzin tshar du dngar/ /mar gad byugs pa'i thang dang ri sul na/ /nyi 'od chang gis myos pa'i me tog tshogs/ /'dab ma'i kha nas ge sa ra rdul skyugs bzhin/ /bung ba'i mdza' bo 'bod pa'i mgo spyogs ldem/ /ri dwags ma ma nu zhos rgyags pa

girdudz+wa sa byams pa ming gi chos khrir bzhugs te 'a da nyan btsugs tshul/ 757(yi/ /phrug gur bcas pa g.yu yi ne'u gsing na / /'ga' zhig ma chong rgyug gang dang la la ni/ /bde bar nyal bas myo grin pa kyogs te blta/ /rba rlabs rtse dga'i gar dang lbu phreng gi /mu tig do shal gyidri sgeg dal 'gro ma/ /chu bya'i mgrin brgya bsdebs pa'i glu len pas/ /gya gyu'i 'gros kyis yul ljongs kun tu myul/ /la lar nags tshal stug po mun pa'i gos/ /rab btibs gcan gzan ngar sgras skyi g.ya' ba/ srin po khros 'dra'i brag ri rab mtho'i rtses/ /sngo bsangs bu mo'i lto ba 'bigs pa bzhin/ /'phrog byed ral ba gsig mtshungs drag po'i rba/ /ri bo'i zom nas gyen du 'phyur ba'i shugs/ /'ur 'ur khyab 'jug khros pa'i rnga sgra can/ /du ma dpung du tshogs pa'i klung chen 'bab/ /las kyi bzo bo bi shwa karma yi/ /rnam smin pir gyis 'byor rgud bde sdug sogs/ /tshon ris snang ba'i rtsigs nges la bris pa'i/ /grong dang grong khyer rgyu skar grangs dang mnyam/ /mtshams sprin g.yo 'dra'i bla gos 'dab ma can/ /sdom 4brtson zhi zhing dul ba ngur ba'i khyus/ /chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i gtsug lag khang / /pad+ma'i rdzing ltar gtsang zhing nyams dga' mang / /der ni skye rgu'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtser/ /mgon 'di'i zhabs sen nor bu bkod pa na/ /phan bde rin chen char ba phyogs kun tu/ /snyoms par phabs pas rdzogs ldan khengs pa 'phrog /ceri / bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dang 'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ༷ twes bkaun paḍi sgron sdi dbal bzang sdo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dge ldan bstan pa'i —

482 gedan sa byams pa gling gi chos khrir bzhugs rte 'chad nyan btsugs tshul/—mdzes rgyan las mdo smad kyiljongs su byon nas gdan sa chen po byams snatsho ripa gling gi chos kyi khriramanga' bsgyur te tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi'achad hwan 3ri 4 phre wasar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pawa/ / / /ru — —

—tre———— —— ———da — —— —— —— ——da ——da wa—— ——da wa—da wa — 48/ hūṃ 'e'u buco burgyad blo / zhaphugs pu zhadamā dpulka spyi pya 3 dazhi gnas na chog ram̐ bro rtse lngan smyabra puzhi rgyalka mādun busprengs pun na2da puzhi tshuzha/ de nas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin chos sde chen po dgon lu nga nas chibs kha bsgyur sog yul brgyud nas phebs/ snga phyi thams cad du lam bar gyi dpon khag rnams dang lha ga par o 8 du su 'di dad pa shin tu che bas bsnyen bkur yang dag pa zhus shing / a lag rizha'i lha btsun rna min han 'u/ na grub dar rgyas rje bla ma nyid la dad pa kha zhe med pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo yi na pas/ 'di res kyang nuk+to/ pa rtsal sprugs kyis bsnyen ngakur dang a mdor phyag g.yog tu'ang phebs pa sogs thugs zin nges phi nga 'dug rma chu'i char khrom chen paṃ (/gag la che dbang zhig gnang skabaru / spre5 1 / byi sa bzos pa'i tshe bum thams cad kyi mgor bzhag nas bka' bsgo gnang ba la glo bur du tshe bum zhig nas mi bcu skor zhig gi mgor 'jog rgyu ma byung / bka' chos grol nas mi du ma zhig chu'i pha rol tu gru mang po la bsdad nas thon pas/ gru gcig chur nub ste mi bcu skor zhig chus khyer ba phyiṭa/ su rtsad bcad pas tshe bum mgor 'jog rgyu ma byung ba rnams yin 'dug cing / gru de'i nang du dang po bug dab nga thob pa'i skyes dman zhig kyang bsdad yod pa la gyu sa/tong khar kho'i skyes pa slebs nas dedo sdod du ma bcug par gru —

4skye4 gnas mtshog ri bo ci lngar sgrub pa.oṃ rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ gzhan ma zhig la lhan du bsdad nas thon pas kho la skyon ma byung bas thams cad shin tu ya mtshan cing bla ma dam pa'i thugase rje dang byin rlabs la dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes 'dug rje bla ma mchog nas gsan ma thag chur shi ba de rnams rkab dgongs pa ched gtad kyis gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bka' drin bskyangs 'dug pas/ shi po de dag kyang skabs der shi ba 'khor ba rngari thaspru can du 'gro ba'i rkyen du gyur 'dug pas 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i skyes chen myo/chog gi gzhan phan gyi spyod pa ni de lta bu'o/ /do lon nor brgyud nas phebs skabs/ kho bo cag gis ong nyod kyi sa mtshams su chibs bsu dang ston mo zhus par thugs shin tu dgyes pa 'i bka' mchid mang du gnang / gong ma chen po zhi hor du bzhugs pa dang myori/jal 'phrad mdzad pas dgyes pa shin tu che zhing zhag shas bzhugs nas/ gong ma ri dwags kyi sa char byon n+dhes rje bla ma nyid pho brang chen por phebs so/ /snga ma bod du rgyal ba'i spru'/ sku'i dwogs gzhi can gzhan gnyis byung ba las/ lho kha ngos su byung ba de dbus kyi skyed tshangs ri khrod na sdod pa'i pra sti dge bshes kyis ri khrod du blangs te/ rgyal ba'i yang srid 'khrul med ni 'di ka yin no zhes lkog tu mi myo/nga por bsgrags pas/ skye bo klad med mang pos 'ur shog che tsam byas pa lha sar sdod pa'i am pan gyis gong ma chen por zhus pas/7gong ma dgongs pa shin tu tshom pas rtsad gcod ma mdzad na rgyal dbang sprul sku rin po che'i 'phrin las la gnod pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bar dgongs nas sprul sku dang dge bshes gnyis pe'i cing du bos nas khrims khasga sbyar rgyu'i gesung ris phebs pa la/ rje bla ma mtsha ga nas de ltar cha dzad na bsta ma/ pa la

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan basprengs tshul/ 48byomi mdzes pas sprul sku de bkra shis lhun por gyipaṇa chen rin po che'i phyag g.yog tu bcug na mig sngar mdzes shing / don la chu mig rang skam du song nas gyirgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po che'i 'phrin las kye gebs byed pa mi yong tshu'/ zhus pa gong ma'i dgongs par 'byor te/ bod kyi am pan sogs la de bzhin bka' phebs pas kho ba gnyis srog gi 'jigs pa las thar par gyur/ yang hal ha'i phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gis rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku dngos min tshul dang / dngos gzhi kho rang gi tsha bo zhig yod pa de ka yin tshul bsgrags par/ hal ha 'ga' zhig gis stong 'ur gyis brdab shog byas pa wang sangs rgyas rdo rjes gong mar zhus pa la/ dgongs gtad snga ma bzhin yod pa yang rje 'dis thabs mkhas kyis bshol nas sku skye de zho hor du sdod bcug pas mtshon/ pho skyes rgod tshod ma zin pa rnams phye ma leb mar me la rtse ba bzhin sdod ma tshugs pa'i byed pa mang pos phung gyod rin gyis nyos pa la/ rje 'dis mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ches mang du mchis so/ /shing bya lo'i dbyar kha mtsho bdun gyi dgon par phebs/ slob ma nyung 'dus zhig la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar khrid dben sa snyan brgyud kyi zhakhapre shes man ngag gis/ brgyan pa zhag bdun gyi bar du chos thun rgyas pa re gnang / gzhan yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha ngargya ma'i khrid/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig steng nas tshem bu lukro/sa kyi spya na ras ga phrigs kyi dmar khrid bcas bka' drin stsal/ zla ba tha/ci go/ tsam gyi ring la sku myo/tsham sa dam par bcad de las gshin gyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad cing mjug tu tshogs ga/tor rgyas pa gnang / de dus gzim

486 gan—shaṃ mchorji/ sditsho+o—ོ—byeswā—ka —༅rdzo—༷༷spu/ preng —tshu'//khang gi yang thog tu bya rog/ gi/ khyu/ chem/ po 'du ba so sa/sa srung ma dgyes nga 'i rtags ma tshan du ma dngos su byung 'dug nai hor du gong ma'i skyed tshal gyi mdun ngos kyi ri rtser lispyu/'i dbyibs can gyi brag rngu —ngon mchan cacan zhi ga yod pa/ rje gong ma ngag dbang blo bzang cho sa ldan byi ṭarga braka de dadzot+na phyug chen po'i rten shin tu gnyan pa zhig yin pas/ de'i gnyen por gnas der dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor zhig kyang bzhugs pa yin ba/sungs pa'i lo rgyus gong ma chen po'i snyan du lhong bar brten/ rje bla ma rma chog la brag de'i thad kar bde mchog gi blos bslang gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs rgyu'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gis lja sa/sa bkod ca dzad de bde mchog gi lha tshogs sku tshad byis pa lo bco lnga lon pa 'i bong tshod tsam bzhugs pa'i blos bslang shin tu che ba lha khang dang bcas ngaskrun pa mdzad/ rje bla ma gtso mdzad/ kho bo cag dase/ 'dun mang po dang bcas pas rab tu gnas pa tshad ldan bsgrub cing / gong ma chen po nyid kyi+orga/sa dbur bzhuka/sa te 'khor lo bde mchog si/ tshogs 'khor shin tu rgyas si lhan du mdzad/ de mtshungs pe'i cing ji/ nub ri'i lha zhol du 'jam dbyangs seng cibs/ sku tshad shin tu che ba gtsug lag /bang ngacari shrī bzhengs ri 'i bkod pa dang rab gnas si gas kyang rje bla ma myo/chog nas gnang nga ra si/phyore ma chen po phebs te ma chod 'bul so gas mdzad/ a lag sha nas tho mo na ḍido mi na han lhun grub dar rgyas phebs/ khong sku/ khu/ dpal gari+o ba 'du sa pa'i reya lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung zhus par thugs brel gyi skabs dang thug pas long skabs ma byung bas/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 487 wabasha da luje rgyaṭa/ pa nge / tsho min han dang bdag cag don gnyer ba kha shas bcas la dgyes pa chen shā༈sa bka' drin du stsal/ a mdo nas rje nyid kyi gcung chu bzang sprul sku phebasdo4 pa la mjal 'phrad thog ston mo sogs gzab rgyas dang gsur preng 'phepa / khong gis zhuṭaṭa nga/ bzhin/ lam rim byang chub bde lam gyi khrid/ rje rang nyid kyis rna dzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas bde ma chog lus dkyil gyi khrid dang / zab lam gtum mo'i dmar khrid/ gsang 'dus sko+o gas rim gyi khrid bcas gnang / gong ma chen po lo re bzhin zla ba bcu go/nyis pa'i nang du rje bla ma'i sa/ zim khang du phebs srol gyi rgyun snga ma nas yod thog lo rje sa ma me khyi lo rje bla ma dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i das/'a ston sdun bsu lta bur/ bya lo 'di'i mjug tu gnam gyi lha gong ma chen po rje bla ma'i bzhugs ga/nas zung ṭu zir phebs te/ sku brnyan sogs kyi gnar phyes bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas mi ring bar 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston byed rgyu'i bka' phebs dang / rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung gi phebs sgo mang du stsal/ de nas me khyi lo gsar tshes kyi zla ba dang po'i tshes bcuri/ 'khrungs skar gyi nyin mdzod nas ston mo'i gsol ras dang / gyigong ma rang si/ sku mdun gyi gar mkhan rnams gtor ba gnang nas blos gar gyi rtsed mo sogs kyang byed 'jug pa gnang / snga phyi ci rigs par 'dan ma hu po ga thus gtso ba'i phyag g.yog pa rnams dang zung ṭu zi'i grwa mang nas nyin gcig yung he gung gi mkhan po shar rtse no min han ngag dbang tshul khrims/ phu yi na bla cag rngus kya zhabs drung / dpal 'byor hu thog thu sogs ja sag bzhi/ gzhan yang lha khang so so'i bla ma che chung grwa pa

488 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/rnams dang bcas pas nyin gcig har chin wang rat+na sirnyi sogs tsho chen zhe dgu/ hal ha/ cha har/ or du su/ a lag sha sogs nas 'ongs pa'i wang pe'i le pe'i ze gung ja sag tha'i ji tha bu nang thams cad spyi thog dang so so'i nyin gcig sa/zhan yang chu bzang sprul sku/ hal ha dbang chen no min han sogs dang 'dus kyi bla dpon dngos dang el chi ci rigs pas rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa sgo du ma nas bsgrigs/ de dag gi zhib cha rnams sa bon med pas 'god par ma nus so/ /kho bo cag gis sger du nyin gcig gi ring gsol ston sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing /'khor lo bde mchog dkar po'i bdag mdun gyi cho ga sngon du 'gro bas rje bla myo/ bkur sti chen pos gdan drangs te/ seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gshigs dang bral bar bzhugs su gsol/ dpal 'khor lo bde rma chog tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor mos nas phyi nang gsangari ba'i mchod pa rgyas par phul/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems srung ma rnams dadu nga gi ra mdar spyan drangs pa la bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa'i gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos bgyis te/ sku'i rten rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo/ tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal ma/ thub phyopa me ru shi ṣa/ bde mchog dkar bo bcas kyi snang brnyan li ma/ gsung rten tshe mdo gser bris/ thus/sa rten rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa dang / na babe+e' paṇa chaṭ+wāṃ sro dang / phu thung ma'i skor cha tshang re/ dngul gyi spyi klugs bzed zhal zhal dkar stegs bcas/ tshem grub kyi bzhugs

ginas marmog ri n+de rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ 4skyenyastan rgyab yol/ gos chen dang snam bu yug mang tsam/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang brgya bcas spyan lam du bstar zhing / dngul dkar srang lnga bcu las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can lag tu thogs nas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i mgon gcig pur/ rgyal ba tshe mthaspru yas pa'i rang bzhin du zhabs pad g.yo ba med par brtan par bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol 'debs rang gi gang shes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas zhus par dgyes pa chen pos zhal bzhes bzang po spyi bor phebs/ phyi dro dngul srang brgya tsam gyis rgyu sbyar te tshogs 'khor rgyas pa phul ba'i tshogs gral du nged rang nas mgur dbyangs kyi mchod pa phur ba la/ rje bla ma nyid nas lan gyi tshul du rdo rje'i mgur zab mo thol byung du gnang ba tshogs 'khor krol rjes rje nyid nas zhal spod kū ri dzod pa bzhin yi ge pa kho bos bgyis te glegs bur bkod pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /rje dus sa/sum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ /skyabs bslu ba med pa'i bka' drin can/ /mgon blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mi bdag snying pad+mo'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ /dzon las smon bzang pos 'brel ba yi/ /rje sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam gnyis sogs/ /khyed dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mi kho bo'i glu la snyan gtod rnga5 dzod/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dang gcig /mchog sangs rgyas bsta na dang mjal dang gnyis/ /mgon dge ba'i bshes kyis zin dang gsumyo// /don 'di ba/sum rnyed dka' sems par mdzod/ /tshe mi rtag ri gzar 'bab chu

da 770 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/'dra/ /gnas nga na song 4/sum po ya re nga / /dus da lta rang dashā pu nga yod dus 'dir/ /chos rnam dag sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /srid 'khor ba'i phun tshogs snying po med/ /yid brtan du med cing ngoms mi shes/ /las nyon mongs draka/ po'i gzhan dbang can/ /'di bsatrī / mas nas skyo ba bskyed par ma dzod/ /rigs drug gi 'ahre ba ma lus pa/ /thog med nas bskyangs pa'i drin can ma/ /don de phyir byams brtse shugs drag gis/ /thabs byang chub sems la 'bad par mdzod/ /ston nam mkha'i chu 'dzin lang long de/ /dgung mkha' las byung zhing mkha' la thim/ /dpe de nyid rgyud la bskor byas nas// /phyi gzung ba bden med dran par mdzod/ /mdang gnyid kyis nen pa'i rmi lam du/ /skyid sdug gi snang ba gang myong de/ /dus da nang gang song cha med ltar/ /sems bden med sgyu mar shes par mdzod/ /sems sa/nyug ma lhan cig skyes pa de/ /chos 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po yin/ /thabs zab lam gnad du bsnun pa las/ /lam sku gsum rgyud la bskyed par mdzod/ /mi kho bo'i kha bo ma lags te/ /pha ngag dbang mchog ldan bka' drin gyis/ /sems skye med 'di la blo kha phyogs/ /dus de ring dga' bas glu ru blangs/ /khyed dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams ku/na/ /tshe 'di snang 'khri ba rgyab tu skyur/ /snying thag pas lha chos sgrub pa yis/ rten dal 'byor thob pa don ldan mdzod/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /khyed dam tshig gtsang ba'i bu slob dang / pha nged rang 'bral med dam chos kyis/ /dpal byang chub bsgrub pa'i smon lam ba gyid/ ces pa 'di yang brnya/na 'gro'i dpal

gnasdi—'chog ri—bo rtse lngari kha pa 'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ 491ca/ཿ 1 na dam k+ṣiṃ4 thu'u bkwan sprul pa 'i sku blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas nged rang ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel baspri gas nas/ tshogs 'khor gyi bsnyen bkur mdzad skabari ri/ mgur marngo+od phu0/ ba'i lan thol byung du smras pa'i byed pa po ni lcang skya ro la pa'i rdo rje lags so/ /zhes pa'o/ /bsta tshu/ 'a gro'i phan bde kun+da'i gnyen gcig pu/ /gang gi mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams shar ri'i phrag pa na/ /ngo ma tshar bye ba'i 'dzum dkar 'phro bzhin du/ /legs byas rdzogs ldan sa/sar ba'i dpal ngom pa'i/ /'byung 'gyur dus kyi cha shas rin chen snod/ /phan dang bde ba'i bdud rtsis yongs 'gengs pa'i/ /phun tshogs/ thog mar dge ba'i rten 'byung sgo/ /brgya phrag cig char phye ste skye rgu kun/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dge mtshan ji snyed par/ /phral dang yun du spyod pa'i dga' ston mchog /dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du rgya cher gtibs/ /de che bdag yid 'o ma'i chu gter ni/ /shugs drag dad pa'i rlung gis nyer bskyodaskyi tshopas/ /rten 'byung bdog pa'i rlabs phreng 'phyur ba dang / /chabs cig gsol 'debs ngang pa'i mgrin glu bsgrags/ /tshul des mgon po mchog gi thugs kyi mkhar/ /dgyes pa'i chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pa las/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las myur slong ba'i/ /rdo rje glu yi dbyar rnga dal gyis bzhad/ /deng nas byang chub bar gyi lha yi lam/ /mgon po nyin byed dbang pos mi gtong ba'i/ /bslu med zhal bzhes bdud rtsi'i bsang gtor gyis/ /bran pas snying gi sa/dung ba lhag med bcil/ /snga ma nas kho bo cag gis bka' chos 'ga' zhig gnang rgyu'i ri

4sri2 gnas mtshog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pagli rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ gsol ba nan tan du btab yod pa dang / 'di res chu bzang sprul skus kyang gsol 'debs zhus pas nged gnyis dang phyis su bod du dga' ldan khri la thon cing bod kyi srid skyong dang gong sa'i yongs 'dzin rnams chabs cig tu mdzad pa co ne mkhan po ngag dbang tshul khrims/ phu yin bla ma dpal 'byor hu thog thu/ sku tsha 'dan ma hu thog thu/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas sogs pho brang nang gi bla ma kha shas/ yung he gung gi grwa pa mang tsam dang / har chin smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas sogs phyogs nas byon pa kha shas/ har chin wang rat+na sirta/ mkha' 'gro mar grags pa ong nyod ha thun gzungs skyid bcas ser skya brgya phrag lhag tsam la 'phags yu la paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyi9 pre snakhor gyi cho ga du ma phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa phreng ba skorami gsum du grags pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis dang / de'i steng du grub mchog dachuṇa zhabs kyi kṛ ya samuts+tsha nas bshad pa'i dge legaṭa/ su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum bsnan pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lnga ri dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa rgyud dang grub chen gyi gzhung lugs rnam par dag pa dang sbyar te rgyud sde so so'i bshad pa/ dbang rnams kyi thad ka thad ka'i dmigs rnam brda' spod dbang don lam gyi rim par bsgrig tshul sogs kyi zhib cha dang phyag len phan tshun rgyas 'gebs dang gcig go gcig gis chod par byed pa'i sla chos ma yin par rang rang gi lugs srol ma 'dres pa brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag len mthong 0rgyud bzhin shin tu smin rgyas bka' drin du stsal/ de yang dus 'khor lha grwangs

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ 493mang zhing cho ga ha cang rgyas pas phreng rkyang gi phyag len bzhin mdzad pa las/dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la phreng ba'iri thog kṛ ya'i sgoṭa/ chos med mi rung 'ga' zhig kyang snon pa gnang zhing / blda mchog 'khor lo bsgyur drug la kṛ ya sa mu ts+tsha'i sgos chos phra mo rnams kyang bsna/na nar+sā phyag len shin tu rgyas pa bka' drin stsal/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi dbang gi skabs kho bo cag dbang stegs la rus rgyan sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chas 'jug dang bcas bkod/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang bcaji shrī/ rje bla ma 'khor lo'i bdag por bzhengs pas dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ rnam rgyal chen po'i bum pa la sogs pa'i chu'i dbang bskur cing shis brjod kyi me tog char du phab ste/ chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur ba gnang bas 'di lta bu'i skal ba bzang po nyams su myong ba snyam du dga' spro dar dad gus 'gran zhing 'phel ba byung / rdor phreng gi bka' dbang grub nas bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/dpal mo lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang rnams kyang mu 'thud de gnang / de ltar nyin mang po'i bar khor mo yug tu gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ bdag cag skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams gsang chen bla na med pa'i 'jug sgo na /chog tu zhugs pa la brten nas rig/sa kyi nus rma—yo/ngas su sad cing / sku bzhi'i sa bon rnam par dag pa thebs pas skye ba don yod par gyur/ deng sang gtsang ba ye dpal sogs chos la dbang za ba 'ga' zhig gis rdor riphring mi tra sogs kyi dbang la dkyil 'khor mang po lhan cig tu bsgrubs nas dbang gi skabs dkyil

— 494 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan basprengs tshul/'khor du 'jug pa'i skor dang / mjug gi cho ga rnarna sa thun mong du gcig gis chog pa byas nas nyin re la dbang mang po sdebs su 0 nyu ra ba dang / gtor ma dang bca' gzhi gcig mgon chen bcu gsum du bskyed nas rjes gnar bar chad kun sel tsam la mgon po gaḍā/na rnarma sa/ kyi sngags kyi rjes zloṭag 5 〉4 h+yed du bcug pas mgon chen bcu sa/sum gyi rjes gnang gi go chod par byed n+t+ra / da thos pas/ bstan pa dri bcas su byed pa'i lag len de 'dra la lto sdo / tshe/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi phyag bzher/ ka(ke na lta zhog me tog bkye bsdu tsam dzi4 na chod la'ang sla chos cung zad kyang mi mdzad pa ni nges pa /lo nar bstan se thugs khaske bcangs pa'i rnam thar du da gzod nges pa skyes so/ /chu bzang sprul skuṭa/ zhus pa bzhin nged car+shaka nyung ngu tsa ma 7 ge sngags rams pa dge/ lke )dun bkra shis kyi yig cha ltar gyi jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrokha/ ma nyer gcig gi hras sa/nang dang / bde mchog gi sngags btu'i rjes gnang rgyas pa gnang ba'i rma rtsa r+sha/ tu da po na slob lha—/ cig tu rngo+ogs 'khor kyang mdzad/ yang kho bo cag dang / chu rkazar spru' sku/ ma tshan spro gas myo/khan rin po che blo bzang dar rgyas bcas mi gsum kho na la rgyal dbang lnga pa che na po'i gsang ba rgya can las 'byung ba'i dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo la las bzhi'i lha mos bskor b.ri rjes/ gnang dbang bzhi dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa bka' drin stsal/ /bla ma'i zhal nas/ nged kyis cho sa skyong gi rjes gnang mi gzhan la gtan nas bskur gi med kyang / da res khyed 9/ sum dad pa dam tshig shin tu gtsang ba la bsams nas bskur ba yin zhes gsungs shing /rjeṭasdo dzo/nang gi bshad pa dang sbrags te sa/sang ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig kyang

da gnasomatshag ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 495lhug par stsal pa byang chub snying po'i bar du gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin gyis rjes su bskya/ngas par mdzad/ /rnaswā kun mchog ldan ye shes dwangs shel khamasag /rnasdu mang rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor tshon mdangs su/ /rnam bkra 'ja' tshon ri mo ltar 'char ba/ /rnasdu 'dren thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul 'edi rmad byung / /zung 'jug rdo rje'i gar gyi stangs sta bas gcig /lha sngags ye shes rnam 'gyur du ma ru/ /bsgyur pa'i rdo— rje3 dkyil 'khor bheng ba bzhin/ /tshar du dngar ba'i mgon du mngo na bzhengs nas/ /rging thugs bde stong ye shes chu 'dzin las/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i 'ubrug sgra ldir ba yis/ /skal bzang sdo rje'i slob ma rma bya'i tshogs/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon ma ngal gyis sgeg par gyur/ /cho ga nor 'khrul lag len gang byung gis/ /smin byed gzugs brnyan blun po dad ldan la/ /nor dang brje tshong byed pa'i dus ngan gyi/ /'chad nyan bstan pa nyams ltas mang mthong tshe/ /mkhyen darngu da dung chos khog par bzung ba yi/ /rgyud dang grub chen dgongs pa 'khrul med chab/ /phyag len ku sha'i 'dab rtse ma 'khrugs pas/ /nyer 'thor bdud rtsi'i baṭa/nga gtor 'di yid 'ong / /lo 'di'i dbyar mtsho bdum/ lha khang du phebs/ dbyar khya/— bzhes kyi dge 'dun rnams la 'dusnye — 3 ma tsho'i snying po'i lung dang spratra/sa te bslab bya lag len sogs kyi zhal rī / ka jirmi sa rgyas par stsal/ de khar rnying ma'i khur 'dzin pa'i sku skye nig gis spre'u'i zlos gar la 'gran pa'i bya byed sna tshogs kyis blun po mang po bslu ba la/ thugs brtse bas tshogs gtam btsan brjid can gtong ba gnang bas/ bsod nams

496 gnas ma chog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings hūṃl/ ldan pa'i tshig tsam yang / /nyam chung rnams kyis bzod par dka'/ /gau ṭa li rgyal po'i tshig tsam gyis/ /rgya ca/tsho'i rgyal po bcings zhes grags/ /zhes pa'i dpe ltar gyur/ 'di lo than pa che bas phyogs thams cad du char 'bebs byed mkhan mang pos nus pa rtsal sprug gis 'bad kyang char thigs pa sa/ cig kyang 'bebs ma nus pas/ rje bla ma mchog la zhus par/ rten la khrus gsol/ bsangs dang klu gtor sogs mang du gtong rgyu'i zhal ta phebs pa bzhin bsgrubs pas/ sprin 'dus kyang rlung drag pos gtor nas char 'bebs su ma ster/ der rje bla ma mchog nas klu gtor gyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa phan bde'i rgya mtsho chen po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar grub chen gyi gzhung dang rje bla na/'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i legs bshad dam pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i klu gtor gyi cho ga rnams las khyad chos du mas khyad par du 'phags pa de ljags rtsom mdzad pas/ dbu tshugs pa dang dus mnyam du char zim bu bab cing / ljags rtsom grub nas slob ma 'ga' zhig la klag lung gnang skabs kyang char cung zad bab/ de nas rje bla ma nyid mtsho bdun kyi rdzing bu'i 'gram du phebs nas bum gter 'jug pa mdzad cing / cho ga gsar rtsom ltar gyi mtsho rab tu gnas pa dang / klu gtor gtong ba gnang bas char gyi rgyun chen po 'jam zhing dal ba nyin gsum gyi ring babs te skye 'gro thams cad dga' bde la 'god pa ma dzad/ phyis su klu gtor gyi cho ga de'i ljags lung bdag cag slob ma kha shas la bka' drin bskyangs skabs lo rgyus de rnams dngos su gsungs shing / snga mo char 'bebs dgos pa'i skabs 'as/'a zhig tu bde mchog gi rgyud nas gsungs

gnasamacho3/ribortselngarasgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 497pa'i nam mkha' lding gi bris sku la brten pa'i gdams pa des rngo ra bzang po yang yang phab pa yin kyang cung zad rtsub pa zhig 'dug da res klu chog gsar ba de brtsams pa la rten 'brel mang po rang 'grig tu byung bas 'dis slad gzhan la phan thogs pa zhig yong ba 'dra/ deng sang mi 'ga' 'i/ga gis char rdo bzhag pa'i 'bebs thabs byed kyin 'dug kyang / de kla klo'i chos lugs yin pas dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byed mkhan tshos lag len byed mi rung / rang re dkon mchog la blo bkal nas mdo rgyud man ngag las byung ba'i gdams pa gang shes de lag tu blangs na char babs yong /gal te ma babs na semasdo can spyi mthun gyi las yin pas bya thabs ci yod/sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus su yang lo mang por char ma babs pa'i gtam brgyud yod pa de yin/ char phabs pa'i ming tsam gyi ched du kla klo'i lag len yan chad byed pa dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid ches med pa'i rtags yin/ zhes 'doms par mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzod kyi blos bslang chen po cha tshad dang ldan pa/ lha thams cad dngul gar blugs 'ba' zhig dang /gzhal yas khang sogs gser zangs las grub pa zhig snga ma nas bzhengs pa gnang yod pa/ 'di res dgon pa'i thugs dam rten du spyi 'jog mdzad/zhal nas/ nged kyis sbyin bdag sog po 'di rnams kyi lag nas dad rdzas ri rab tsam zhig blangs yod pas/ de dag ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i ched dang / rang gi dkor sgrib sbyong thabs su dkyil 'khor 'di brazhings pa yin/ de yang sog po mang pos 'brel thogs pa'i sa cha zhig tu

498 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshanabasgrongs tshul/ da wa bzhag na dgos pa che ba 'dug pas mtsho bdun dgon par bzhag pa yitho/ zhes gsungs pa thos pas/ dkyil 'khor de la phyag rna chod sogs kyi 'brel ba thogs chad ngan 'gro las grol pa'i mthong grol zhig yi/ na pa/ gdon mi za'o/ /theg pa chen por blo sbyong ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba yang 'di res ljags rtsom mdzad/ a mdo nas btsan po no min han gyi sprul sku phebs pas rje bla ma mchog la zhabs brtan gyi 'bul ba gzab rgyas phul zhing / bla ma dam pas kyang gzhis len ba//nang cha sogs sparma mtho ba dang khong rang gi thugs bzhed bzhin gyigong ma chen por 'tshamarnga smu zhu dang pe'i cing du gtan bzhugs kyi sne sbyor mgo 'dren sogs gang gzab thugs khashā btags so/ /kho bo cag dang mtshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che sogs kyis rje bla myo/ nyid la dgung lo nga pi/sum thog tu chags che ba'i lung bstan dang bzlog thabs su lo mtshams sogs gnang dgos tshul stag phu rdo rje 'chang gis bka' lung gnang yod pa bzhin da cha khyo/bas brtan rim gro'i rigs dang / khyad par du rje bla ma rang nyid nas sku keg sel ba'i thugs dam sogs cis kyang g.yel chung mi mdzad pa d+dha khyen ces yang ya/nga snyan bskul zhus pa bzhin dbus gtsang dang mdo smad so gas kyi dgon sgrub sde ji 4nga por zhabs brtan ci rigs sgrub thebs bskur sa/nang mdzad cing / rje bla ma nyid me phag lo 'di'i dbyar ka 'pha gas se 'jam dpal gyi gnas ri bo rtse lngar phebs nas zla ba kha shas kyi ring sku bcad rgya shin tu dam po'i ngos rdo rje'i rnal 'apyor zab mo la thugs kro/zhong ba sadzad/ pe'i cing du phe ngas nas / ro bos da res sa/nas khyad parino casgru/ delke 5 sku bcad rgya yun

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgringaru/ tshul/ 499ring gnang rgyu byung bas sku chags sogs bablog pa'i mtshan ltas 'dra byung yod las che zheru/ zhus par/ ngas ni tshe'i bar chad bzlog pa 'i ched du bsams nas dmi/ sbyor gyi rigs sna gcig kyang ma byas/ bla myo/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas rgyun gyi dge sbyor rnams bskyangs pas gnas kyi byin rlabs yin nam nyams dga' la bag phebs pa dge sbyor la brod pa che ba zhig byung / da dung re zhig sdod rgyu byung na legs pa yin te/ gong ma'i bkas tshur yong dgos pa byung song gsungs/ de ni paṇa chen blo 0zang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ srog 'tsho 'chi 'amyo+or rgud bde sdug dang / /yang bstod smad snyan dang mi snyan so gas/ /gang byung kyang bla ma'i byin rlabs yin/ /a la la ci byas glo ba das/'a/ /re dogs kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chos brgyad skya5 go snyi mas pas re dogs kyi mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /de lta na yang lo 'di dang phyi ma rnams su lam rim pa gnyis kyi nal 'byor la thugs dam rtsal 'don rma dzod pa nyid kyi stobs kyis shwa 'od chen pos rtswa sbur zhar la 'ded pa bzhin sku 'phrang kyang sel bar sna nga ste/ mnal lam zhig tu khang pa thog rim mang po yod pa zhig gi rtse thog na dpon po chen po btsun mo dang bcaṭasmu yod pa la rje nyid mjal phrad byed dgos pa lta bu'i bar thospu/ tsam du phebar pa na/ bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig rtse thog nas mar 'ongs te snaka pā la lde gu lta bu'i zas kyis bkare ba nig gtad nas 'di dpon po kya4ba yum gyis khyed la gsol ras su gnang ba yin/ re zhig nged dang mjal ba ru phebs mi dgos gsung byung zer/ lde gu de zhal du ga sol

500 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/bas sngar gsol ma myong ba dri ro phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dug cing / de nas phyir log phebs pa zhig thugs rmis su byung zhes gsungs pa dpyad na 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyis re zhig dag pa mkha' spyod du phebs rgyu bshol ba'i ched du/ mkha' 'gro ma'i pho nya zhig tshe bcud kyi bdud rtsi 'bul du btang bar sems la/ yang phyis su bka' chos zhig gi skabs gas nga bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dmigs rnam 'di dag yag po skyong byu byung na/ 'bru don du gnyer na phub ma zhar la 'byung ba'i dpe bzhin rkyen sel rim gro sogs kyang zur du mi dgos si ra des chog pa yin/ nged rang na phra dus chos skyong khag mang po'i lung bsta na phal cher mthun par lo sum cu las ring ba mi thub zer ba yod kyang / yongs 'dzin rnams kyi gsung ltar zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'di dag la 'bad 'bungs byas pas/ keg las thar te tshe ring tsam byung ba 'di ltar yin zhes gsungs pas kyang shes par snang —ngo / /rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas rje bla ma mchog la stsal pa'i zhal gdams su/ yid tha mal nyon mongs rnam rtog dang / /phyogs lhan cig mi gnas dben pa der/ /rje brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /dus rtag tu dga' mgur spyod pas na/ /las dang po ba yi gang zag bzhin/ /don bya ba nyung ba lhur bzhes pa/ /spyir dam pas bsngags 'os mchog yin kyang / /khyer semyo༈sa dpa' che la mdzes ma yin/ /zhes 'doms par mdzad pa bzhin/ rje bla ma dam pa 'di nyid ni ring mo zhispu/ nas rang don yid byed kyis dben pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dben pa dang /

genos mchog mi bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 561 tha mal snang zhen gyis dben pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dben pa la rtag tu rol pas na/ phyi rol gyi 'du 'dzi sogs kyis dben pa'i gnas dben pa la ltos dgos pa ma mchis kyang / rjes 'jug rnams la slob pa'i ched du 'du 'dzi la thugs gting nas sun pa dang / dben pa la mngon par dgyes pa'i tshul ston pa zhig yod pas/ sku tshe'i mjug tu dben dgon zhig tu chos kyi dga' bde la dgyes rgur rol pa'i thugs dgongs dang / rgyun du de lta bu'i gsung gi phebs sgo gnang zhing / mdo smad dgon lung gi phur gsang sngags bde chen pho brang gi gabrim khang sogs bskrun pa'ang dgongs gtad de lta bu yin pas/ bar skabs 'di 'dra zhig nas gong ma chen por dgongs pa gtsang zhus kyis mdo smad du phebs 'dun mdzad kyang / po ta 4 la gsar bzhengs dang / bka' 'gyur myo/na ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs las don sna tshogs gcig rting gcig gnon tshul dang / lo kha shas kyi bar du lho phyogs kyi dus zir ma zhi bas gong ma thugs bag phebs pa'i gseng bar ma byung ba bcas sa thaganyaring por phebs pa'i dgongs pa zhu gnang gi re ba dang bral bar gyur/ de nas ri bo rtse lnga 'di nyid phal po che dang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs su bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gnas su lung bstan cing / sangs rgyas byang sems dang rgya gar dang rgya nag gi skyesasnyi bu dam pa grangs las 'das pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin pa dang / sa chu sogs kyang sku la 'phrod cing pho brang chen po dang ha cang mi ring ba'i stabs kyis der bzhugs pa la gong nas kyang mi bzhed pa med pa bcas lo re bzhin dbyar gyi ring gnas

bye02 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrung pa—'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/chen 'di nyid du bzhugaṭa/ rgyuratshothugs thag chod pas/ thok+to/ chari ci /ri lo 'ga' zhig la byang chu ṇ+ḍaṃ —/ me 'i sa dpa' sa/zhon nu nor bzang rje dzosto'o/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ma jal ji preri gan sa zhen tsha'i dung zhes nor nga/za nga phug tu grags pa dang / slob dpo na sangs rgyas bskyangs byon nas sa/tsug to ra nem rgyal gyi gzungs gdan drangs pa'i gnas jing ging cikhi'u zhes rdo je'i phug tu grags pa dang / gnas kyi lte ba'i gtsug lag khang phu sa ting zheṭari khyang chub sems dpa 'i spor grags pa rnams su bzhugs nas/ spong ba bas ma gtan gyi 'alo/ ra lo la thugs gzhol bar mdzad/ mi ring bar sdo rje'i pug dang 'dab sugs nga /'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu dben dgon gsar 'debs mdzad cing / paṇa chen sku na rim gyis thugs dam rte ོ/ ma dzad pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi li sku bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa rje nyid kyis rnga/rurnar bzhengs dngul sa/ra blugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga dang /ga'/na ya nga dus gsum sa ngas rgyas/ rje yab sras/ khri chen rno rje 'chang /phyag rdo ra/ mi g.yo ba/ rta mgrin sogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi /snyu brnyan bris 'bu(re phyoci/nga po gsar bzhengs dang / mchod rdzachi+opre kyi bye brag mtha' yas pa bcas bskrun par mdzad/ dben dgon de la gong skyasdo chen pokuki phu'u lu yon zhes bod skad du ku/ na tu bde ba'i tshakru zhes pa'i me+eng gnar ba la/ khyo/la nas sgrub gnas rnying pa la rdo je 'i phug cekuṭa grags pa dang / da res gong nas sa/nang ba'i ming zur du'ang bde ba'i sgra 〈 ma/ pa bcatra5 bde ba chen po'i nyams len 'phek+ṣ-ir rwa / 'i ten 'brel bzang po 'gri ga byung sa/sung phug/sa mnyes pa mdzad cing / sgrub khang rang la rje nyid nas/ skye na

gnas mchog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 503waṃ dga' 'khyil zhes 'dogs pa gnang / de nas bzung lo ltar gyis pho brang nas zla ba bzhi ba'i nang du der phebs nas brgyad pa'i bar bcad rgya dam pa mdzad pa'i rgyun 'dzug pa gnang nas/ thun dang thun mtshams kyi rim pas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu zab gsang sdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ zhal nas nged ri bo rtse lngar mtshams la 'dug skabs thun mtshams cher med pa byas nas thun gyi ngo bo 'ba' zhika/ ji/sa dus 'da' bar byas pa yin zhes bdag la dngos su gsungs so/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i sprul pa'i gnas/ /dwangs bsil rin chen lhun po rtse lnga zhes/ /stug po bkod pa'i ngo mtshar yon tan kun/ /gcig tu spungs pa rgyal kun 'du ba'i zhing / /bder gshegs sras bcas byitsha/ rlabs g.yang chags pas/ /mthong ba'i mod la snang ba sgyur byed cing / /mtho ris tshal bzhin gtsang la rig pa dwangs/ /nyams dga' bag phebs dge sbyor rang gis 'phel/ /sgrib pa'i mun pa srasdo pa'i skal ldan gyi/ /dad pa'i me long log lta'i g.ya' bral bar /'jam pa'i dbyangs/ kyi byin rlabs ngo ma tshar sa/zugs/ /sgyu ma'i rol pa bzhin du cir yang 'char/ /nyon mongs dug gi khyad par zos pa yis/ /yon tan spu mdog lhag par nam bkra ba/ /blo ldan rigs su skyes pa'i rma bya'i tshogs/ /kun bzang spyod pa'i sgro gdugs ngom pa der/ /bdag nyid che 'dis rgyal ba'i yab gcig dang / /rang gi spangs rtogs yon tan gar bu'i lcid/ /gsang gsu/ma srang la bcal nas 'gran bzhed pas/ /ngang pa'i rgyal bo pad ma rngo+or 'angug bzhin spu/ /she0/sa/ /de tshe ri rab rdur snyed las sprudas/

5spu4 gnas mchog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal ma‘na bsgrongasaphulo/pa'i/ /rgyal pa'i zhing nas rgyal sras grangs med pa/ /mchod rdzas thogs pa'i lha klu'i zhabs 'brang bcas/ /mthu chen rgyal ba'i sras po mchog zung gi /gsang gsum ngo mtshar dpag yas gzigs pa dang / /zab rgyas chos kyi bgro ba gsan pa'i ched/ /'phur lding rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gshegs pa yis/ /gnas de bya rgod phung po bzhin du byas/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du li tsa byi/ /dri med grags dang 'jam dpal gdan 'dzoms nas/ /rten 'byung gtam gyi chos rnga cher brdungs pa'i/ /ya mtshan dus 'dir 'phags chen zung zhig gis/ /gsal bar byas zhes sangs rgyas zhing kun na/ /grags pa'i ba dan g.yo bas rgyal ba kun/ /rab dgyes bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor mdzad cing / /mchod pa'i las kyis lha rnams brel bar gyur/ /kho bo cag ri bo rtse lngar mjal bar song skabs gnas kyi dkar chag rnying pa rtse lnga pa dpal ldan grags pas mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa cung zad bsdus shing / rgya'i yig tshang nas bsgyur pa zhig snang ba bsgyur nyes pas go dka' ba bcas dkar chag rgyas pa zhig gnang rgyu'i bskul ma zhus pa bzhin ljags rtsom mdzad pa phal cher cha tshang yang mjug 'phro can du 'jog pa gnang ba rten 'brel zhig la dgongs sam snyam/ nye gnas dge slong dge legs nam mkhas bskul ba bzhin/ gnas bstod dang 'brel ba'i gsung mgur gnang ba ni 'di ltar ro/ /na mo gu ru/ yongs shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /mngon sum du ma/khyen pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /stobs bcu ldan kun gyi bathe/sa gnyen mchog /dpal mkhyen pa'i rka/ter de snying dbus bzhugasdoṭa/ /ngo+o na rgyal

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pari rgyal cha/tshan bape ngas tshul/ 505bas sdong pos brgyan pa sogs/ /mdo du mar gsal bar lung bstan cing / /ris med pa'i paṇa grub du ma yis/ /mgri na gcig tu bsngags pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /lha rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid/ /sku zur phud lnga pa'i gzhon nu'i tshul/ /rgyud skal ldan 'gro la mngon sum bstan/ /zhing 'di nyid bdag gir bzung zhes grags/ /phyi gnas kyi 'og gzhi dkyil 'khor kun/ /phyogs gzhan las rgyang grag du mas mtho/ /de srid par 'khyams pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /zag med kyi thar par 'dren pa'i brda/ /ri rin chen mtshar sdug lhun po lnga/ lke /dgung mkha' la bsnyegs 'dra gzi byin 'bar/ /de ye shes lnga yi 'phrin las kyis/ /mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba skyob pa'i brda/ /g.yu'i spang ljongs ne'u gsing bkra ba la/ /tshon sna brgyas phye ba ri me tog rgod/ /mngon mtho dang nges legs yon tan gyis/ /yid can kurlo/ spro ba bskyed pa'i brda/ /rkang drug ldan tshogs rnams 'jo sgeg gis/ /glu dar dir sgrogs shing 'phur lding rol/ /ma brtags na nyams dga'i rten 'brek+ṣiṃ la/ /rgyu 'bras kyi 'char sgo ngo mtshar ston/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan du ma zhig /dal 'bab cing lhung lhung sgra snyan sgrogs/ /byams snying rje tshad med rnam bzhi yis/ /ma 'gro kun skyob par byed pa'i brda/ /rlung bser bus bskul ba'i ljon pa'i tshogs/ /mdangs sngo ljang lo 'dab bskyod cing g.yob/ /rigs sad pa'i skal ldan skye bo rnams/ /lam theg pa chen por 'bod pa'i brda/ /ro brgya phrag mngar ba'i 'bras bu'i kyi+os/sa/ /smin legs pa'i lcid kyis stod cing spa/ /rnam grol gyi 'bras bu rmad byung ba/ /ting 'dzin pyi bde

bhe— 5 06 gnasaca/chog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan basprengs tshul/das/ṭa/ rga/nga ba'i brda/ /lus spu sdug skad snyan 'dab chags rngo+o'i/sa/ /dbyangs rgyud ca/ngas 'khrol bzhin phyogs bcur lding / /chos bden pa bzhi yi blang dor rnams/ /don lhug par 'doms pas dbugs 'byin brda/ /mig dkyus ring mdzes sdug ri dwags tshogs/ /bag phebs bzhin ri klung kun tu rgyu/ /lam bde bas rdzogs byang bgrod pa la/ /blo das/'a bde ci yang rgyas pa'i brda/ /brag rin chen ba gam mtho brtsegs pa/ /'od sna tshogs 'khyug pa'i mdzes sdug 'dzin/ /sku bzhi yi go 'phang mthon po dū// /mtha' yas pa'i yon tan ngom pa'i brda/ /nad nyes brgya sel ba'i sman gyi tshogs/ /yid tshim byed dri bsung kun tu 'thul/ /thabs shes rab rlabs chen mdzad pa yis/ /sri da zhi yi rgud pa sel ba'i brda/ /steng rna kha' la lhun sdug chu 'dzin tshogs/ /dbyibs bkod pa rma tha' yas cig char ston/ /mgon smra ba'i seṅge'i gsang gsum gyi/ /'phrul sgyu ma 'i rol rtsed mtshon pa'i brda/ /gnas 'di na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /rten ngo mtshar bkod pa bgrang yas —pa'i/ /dri gtsang khang mchod rten khri phrag tshogs/ /dad ldan gyi bsod nams zhing du dngar/ /de kun kyang ya mtshan 'od zer tshogs/ /phan tshun du 'khyug pa'i rtse dga' 'dzin/ /las dag pa'i skal ldan du ma la/ /nyams snang ba rmad byung brgyari phrag stsol/ /da gra bcom pa ma ṭaṃ ki pa dang / /bha ra na mahā paṇ+ḍi ta—sa/ /ga /gnas sgo phye rje btsun ma chog nyid kyi/ /sku'i rnam pa ji bzhin gsal bar bzhengs/ /rgyal sras kyi khyu mchog bi ma la/ /ma snya ta'i gnas brtan brgya phrag tshogs/ /yul 'phags pa'i sa/nas nas

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ thu07'dir byon te/ /kha cigahani ye shes sku ru gyur/ /sar gnas kyi dpa' po sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /'jam dpal gyi bka' bsgrubs gnas 'di yi/ /rdo rje yi phug tu bzhugs nas kyang / /rig 'dzin gyi ma kha' spyod brnyes zhes bshad/ /shar tsi na'i yul gyi sems dpa' che/ /mgon mi pham pa dang gnyis med pa/ /mtshan ching l+yang kau shrir grags pa dang / /lam chos nyid mngon gyur te'u shun sogs/ /rim byon gyi mkhas grub grangs med kyis/ /skyabs rje btsun chen po dngos su mjal/ /gsung bdud rtsi'i bgo skal spyad nas kyang / byang grol gyi go 'phang mngon du byas/ /yang rgyal blon khyim bdag rab byung sogs/ /rgyud dad pa'i nor bugregang rnams kyis/ /sku gsung gi snang ba mthong thos 8ོske+ogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i gtam brgyud grangs las 'das/ /tshul de dag kun gyi thun mong du/ sneblo tshad mas grub pa'i yon tan yin/ /da mthu chen rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi/ /nang gsang ba'i rnam thar mdo tsam brjod/ /sngon mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de/ /'khor gaṅgā'i rdul snyed sras dang bcas/ /dpal mkhyen pa'i gter gyis gdan drangs te/ /gnas 'di ru theg chen sgo brgya phye/ /phyogs bcu yi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor/ /khong mthu chen rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshogs/ /chos zab gsang bgro ba mdzad pa'i slad/ /dus da dung yang yang sprin bzhin 'du/ /sgrib nyon mongs 'ching ba kun bcad pa'i/ /'phags gnas brtan dgra bcom tsho gas rnams kyang / /nang ting 'dzin bde la rol bzhin du/ /dpal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sgos gsang chen rgyud sde'i yi dam lha/ /

da 50 8— gnasamachog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bye ba brgya/ /ri lhun stug rtse lnga'i b.remo/da pa'i nang / /rigs lnga yi dbye bas kun nas dkrigs/ /gnas nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /gar nyams dgu'i 'asdo sges/ sna tshogs kyis/ /chu skyes kyi mtsho la ngang pa bzhin/ /legs 'dus nas dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs/ /gtsado ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu yang / /rang rang gi 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/ /dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' nyan cing / gnas bcu nga ba'i tshul gyis phu dud byed/ /ma/thu stobs kyi mnga' bdag gshin rje'i rgyal/ /yum re ma ti dang rgan byad ma/ /'khor 'jigs rung dregs pa sde brgya da bcas/ /gnas bsrung zhing rnal 'byor skyong bzhin bzhugs/ /ya nga nā ga dzu na yab sras lnga/ /'phags yul gyi grub chen du ma dang / /dpal a ti sha dang sa paṇa sogs/ /'ja' lus kyi rol pas yang yang 'byon/ /pha bka' drin can gyi tsong kha pa/ /rje mkhyen pa'i gter dang lhan cig tu/ /khong sar gnas sems dpa' du ma la/ /gsang sngags dang dbu ma'i chos 'khor bskor/ /dad dam tshig ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /de kun kyang la lar drar srong tshul/ /skabs gzhan du byis pa pho mo dang / rgya'i btsun pa smug chas 'dzin pa dang / /nyam thag pa'i slong mo'i tshul gyis rgyu/ /bya ri dwags la sogs sems yod dang / /sman me tog rtsi shing nags tshul sogs/ /brtan g.yo ba'i dngos po cir yang brdzu/ /las sgrib pa mthug pa'i log lta can/ /blo yilda ga nyis can gyi rtog ge pa/ /rang mthon po'i dreg ju/ pas myos nams kyis/ /mngon sum du gyur kyang ngo mi shes/ /de lta bu'i gnas

ginas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ 50nyakyi che ba rnams/ /mi bdag 'dras ji bzhin brjod dka' yang / /sngon byon gyi rgya bod dam pa yi/ /gsung tshad mar brten nas cung zhig snra sa/ /las dkar nag 'dres ma'i gzhan dbang can/ /sprang ban rgan rol pa'i rdo rje bdag /'di snang gi 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba yis/ /chos rnam dag bsgrub pa'i skal dman yang / /gnas dben pa 'di ru lan 'ga'i bar/ /rje blo bzang rgyal ba'i snyan brgyud kyi/ /lam rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len la/ /bshar bsgom gyi bag chags cung zad bzhag /nyams rtogs pa skye bar dka' mod kyang / /rje 'jam dpal snying po'i legs byāshad dang / /drin 'khor med ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs/ pha bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /sngar sbyangs pa'i chos kyi tshig don rnams/ /rang rgyud thog 'gel ba'i 'gros shig the/'a / /tshe hril gyis 'dir 'dug snyam pa yi/ /slon 'dun dang gsol 'debs yang yang byas/ /dus da dung deng nas byang chub bar/ /lam zab mo 'di dang mi 'bral zhing / /don gegs med tshul bzhin bsgrub nus par/ /lha bla mas thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed snying nas dam chos bsgrub 'dod rnams/ /chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba rgyab bskyur nas/ /gnas 'di 'drar nyams len gting tshugs pas/ /dus gtan bde bsgrub pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /srog mi rtag ri gzar 'bab chu 'dra/ /nor longs spyod rtswa rtse'i zil ba ngazhi na/ /grogs mja' bcugs 'tshong 'du'i mgron po 'dra/ /blo sna mang las la zin pa med/ /pho bsam shes rang mgo ma bskor bar/ /dgra 'chi bdag bsun/ ma ma sleb gong / /phrad dka' ba dam pa'i lha chos kyisag / /rari btsan sa

510 gnas mchog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/zin pa mi legs sam/ /khyed dad ldan sbyin bdag pho mo tsho/ /skyabs dkon ma cho ga gsum la brten dus 'dir/ /lha sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs pa yi/ /gnas 'di 'drar phyag mchod smon lam thob/ /khong rgyal ba rgyal sras mthu chen gyi/ /thugs bskyed dang smon lam rlabs chen mthus/ /lam 5na 'gro'i sgo 'gegs thar ba yi/ /rgyu sa bon thebs la the tshom med/ /sems drang pos gros 'debs 'di byas par/ /slob rgyuni dang sbyin bdag dad ldan rnams/ /yid phyogs lhung dri mas ma sbags par/ /don lag tu blangs na phan par nges/ /gtam 'di las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /bdag 'gro drug pha mar bcas pa rnams/ /dus deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dpal 'jam dbyangs bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me phag lor 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga'i dben gnas kun tu bde ba'i tshal du zla ba ngo drug mtshams dam por bcad skabs/ nye gnas dge slong dge legs nam mkhas gnas bstod dang 'brel ba'i mgur ma zhig then rogs gyis zer bar brten/ dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes thun mtshams su kha nas gang thon smras pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /yang thun mtshams kyi skabs shig ja sas bla mas zhus ngor shin tu gsang ba'i mgur mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying gi thig le bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang gdams ngag bka' rgya ma 'ga' zhig gnang 'dug cing / lo snga ma mtshan lam du mi shin tu che zhing 'jigs

gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan badze+e/ngas tshul/ 511pa ral pa dung ltar dkar ba zhig gis/ khyod kyis dam can chos rgyal gyi bsnyen sgrub las sa/sum gyi yig cha zhig rtsoms shig nga ya mān+ta ka'i bka' srung yin no zer ba byung / zhal nas/ ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bdag lha zhig yin klu zhig yin zer ba mang po 'dug ste/ kho bos brtags na dam can chos kyi rgyal po yin pa 'dug ri lnga la 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pas bka' sdod las gshin kyang gnas srung gi tshul du yod pa yin 'dra/ nged la rmi ltas de 'dra byung bar ral pa dkar po yin pa de ci zhig yin nam zhes bdag la dngos su sa/sungs/ lo rjes mar yang mi de ji lta ba byung nas khyod kyis chos rgyal gyi yig cha mi rtsom pa e yin zer cur ma rangs pa'i rnam pa byed pa zhig byung / de nas nges par rtsom dgos pa yin 'dug snyam na/ṭashaṃ yi zlo/ snru 'di bris pa yin zhes gsungs shing / bsnyen sgrub gsar tsom gyi shog dril kyang ston pa gnang ba kho bos mjal/ yang nub gcig mnar lam du/ bla ma sku brjid bag can paṇa zhwa rne ring gsol zhing khri chen po la bzhugs pa zhig gis ral gri zhig gnang ba rmis gsungs/ 'di ni rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can du gor ma chag go /rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po don dngos gnas la rje btsun 'jam ba'i dbyangs dang —gnyis su med na'ang / drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams rnams su dben pa la bzhugs nas lha dang bla ma dbyer med la —gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bsag sbyang stobs che ba la 'bad pa/ gzhung chen mo rnams la zhib tu dpyod pa gsum dril du mdzad pa'i nyer len la ga

512 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/brten nas dbu ma'i lta ba gsar du rnyed pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ thub pa'i dbar po la rten 'byung gsung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa legs bshad snying po rtsomyo/ par mjad pa dang rjes su mthun par/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis kyang rgyu ritshos/sa tshang ba'i nyams len la thugs 'grus par mdzad pa'i mthus/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba khyad par can sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas thugs rgyud la gsar du 'khrungs pa de nyid rtogs zin goms par byas pas sgom byung gi myong ba thon pa na/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang klu sgrub yab sras/ rje bla ma rnams la rang gi nyams myong tshig gis mtshon par byas pa'i mgur dbyangs mchod par 'bul ba gnang ba ni 'di ltar ro/ /zab mo rten 'byung gi de nyid ngo mtshar/ /ji bzhin rjen pa ru ston pa'i bla ma/ /bka' drin 'khor med de snying dbus bzhugs shig /gar dran thol byung gi tshig gsum smra'o/ /a ma rgan mo de yun ring stor ba'i/ /bu chur spyon pa nga ji zhig ltar te/ /a ma drin can dang lhan cig 'dug pa/ /ngo ma shes pa de shes la khad snang ngo / /jo jo rten 'byung des lkog tu bsnyad pas/ /yin yin min min de e yin snyam mo/ /gzung 'dzin sna tshogs 'di a ma'i 'dzum bag /skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur 'di a ma'i brdzun tshig /bslu med a ma yis kho bo bslus so/ /jo jo rten 'byung des skyob par re'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na a ma rgan mo/ /kho na'i drin gyis ni grol par re ste/ /gzung 'dzin 'di nyid ko 'di ltar yin rin/ /dus gsum rgyal bas kyang skyob thabs mi 'dug /'gyur ba sna tshogs 'di 'gyur med a ma'i/ /rnam 'gyur yin pas na grol spyor 'dug go /cir yang ma

na wa ginas mchog ri bo ci lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bkings tshul/ 513 0grub pa'i bango da med a ma'i/ /cir yang brdzu ba yi phar brten tshur brten/ /'di ga tsam zhig la go rgyu 'dug go /pha rgan btsal bas ni ma rnyed pa de/ /ma rgan rnyed pa kho yin par 'dug pas/ /a ma'i pang nas ni pha rgan rnyed pas/ /pha ma drin can gyis bu nga skyob skad/ /gcig min gzhan min gyi a ma'i bzhin ras/ /jo jo rten 'byung gi me long nang na/ /zin pa med tshul gyis yod yod 'dra ste/ /yod pa nga 'dras ni rtog dpyo da ma zhurga/sa/ /klu sgrub zla grags kyis zhal chems rlung bskur/ /'jam dpal snying po yis bya cig btang bas/ /thag ring 'tshol ba yi dka' las bshol nas/ /lhan cig gnas pa yi ma rgan mthong re da lta rang re yi blo sa/sal 'ga' zhig /tshugs thub bden grub sogs brda' la zhen pas/ /snang ba ling ling 'di rang sor bzhag nas/ /dgag rgyu rwa can zhig 'tshol bar snang ste/ /sgrib bral a ma yi bzhin ras de na/ /lang lang ling lid 'di yod skad mi 'dug /gnad 'gag ma phigs pa'i bshad bshad mang kyang / /a ma rgan mo de bros dwogs 'dug go /yod zhig yod 'o da kyang da lta'i 'di 'dra'i/ /rong rong 'gal 'du can yi na tshod mi snang / /pha ma mdza' gcugs kyi 'bral med bag phebs/ /'jam 'jam skyid skyid zhig yin par sda/nga ngo / /phye mdo rnam rig dang shar gsum ya /span pos/ / a ma glang chen gyi thal dkar sa/zugs la/ bem po 'dzum ris kyi rgya stag khra bo/ /'dzin pa glad med pyi// spre'u snyon pa/ /gnyis med tshugs thub kyi dom bu ngar mari/ /tha snyad sna tshogs zhig 'dogs par byed kyang / /a ma ṭo/—/ dusku 3/ de stor nas 'dug pobhe/ /se rting

lha14 byunas mchog ri tha lngarngo ba'i rgyal ma‘na bsgrings tshul /kar 'brug gi snakhad+ku grub mang pos/ /gsal stong 'dzin med kyi rang gi rig pa/ /ka ཿdang / lhun grub kyi kun bzang rabhāzhalan /ma bcos lhan skyes kyi phyag rgya chen po/ /yod min med min gyi khas chosang bral sogs/ /sna tshogs tha snyad kyi zhal pho sgrogs kyang / /gshis lugs pigs po zhig yin na legs te/ /mdzub mo 'dzugs sa de ci zhig yin ang /tsa /phyi don ma bshigs pas blo 'tshubs mi dgos/ /don smra sde gnyis rnams dgyes dgyes mdzod cig /rang rig ma yin kyang tshad gzhal 'thad pas/ /rnam rig smra ba kun dgyes dgyes mdzod cig /rang mtshan ma grub kyang rten 'brel bkra bas5 /shar gsum mkhan po kun dgyes dgyes mdzod cig /gsal stong mi 'gal bas bzung kyang chog gi /slob bshad rgyud 'dzin rnams thugs chung mi dgos/ /ka nas dag na yang bzang ngan 'thad pas/ /rishā 'dzin zhig po/ rnams bzang zhen mi dngo/sa/ /bcos nas bsgoms na yang lhan skyes 'char bas/ /rtogs ldan rgan po nems u tshugs mi dngo/sa / /yod med spros bral de khas blang chog pas/ /rtog ge mgo mkhri gas rnams tshab chub ma byed/ 9glen kyang 4/zhung lu8 kaṭa rkapre sbyangs pa chu nga rnams/ /tha snyad myo ra tshul zhig oṃmakhyen yin srid/ /khyikho bo /khyed cas/ la mi gus ma las/sa/ /phog phug byung ma/ che / bzod par mdzod ci na /kho bo kun shes kyi shar po mim/ pa/nga / /pha bes kashir lugs kyi rta pho bzang po/ /rtag spyor khus spyor gyis pa zhon tshul mkhas pas5 gcig rdugs 'phyang las ni thar parone+e'o/ /'tshol dalhas mi 'dug ste 'tshol ma/ban rang yen/ /0danaripar r+shazhen te brdzun pa nyid yin1 /badzu na pa mi

genas mtshog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal ma na bsgrongs tshul/ 51byed 'gog ste bden pa rang yin/ /chad min rtag min la ngal gsos chog bo/ /a ma ma mthong yang ming tsam zhig gis/ /pha ma drin can de yun ring sto/ra ba/ /gan na 'dug pa bzhin 'phrad par snang gi /klu sgrub yab sras de bka' drin che'o/ /blo bzang grags pa de bka/ 'a drin che'o/ /drin ca na bla ma de bka' drin che'o/ /bka' drin gzo thabs su a ma mchod do/ /skye mred nga/rjod bral gyi a ma rgan mo/ /rig pa'i bu chung dang lhan cig 'dzoms nas/ /kun bzang spyod pa yi dga' ṣ+ṭhon tshen pos/ /ma rgan 'gro ba kun gtan bder 'khrid do/ /e ma la rol pa'i rdo rje/ /rngu / 'o la skyid pa'i rkang bro/ /'o na la 'di ru brdungs natwa// /a ho ya dkon mchog mchod do/ /zhes a ma ngo shes kyi brdzun tshipo/ bras/ cha'i sgra dbyangs 'di yang dbu ma chen po la lhag par mos pa'i 7ci/nga skya rol pa'i rdo rjes sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar smra sdo/ pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slo —— noge legs nam myo/kha'o/ /zhes pa ste gsung mgur khyad 'phags 'dirtsonyid kyi don legs par go na zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba myong ba la bskor nas nyams su līn pa'i gdams pa khyad par can lta khrid du mi ra gis btags pa gzhan rnashums su ma thon pa mang po zhig yo da tshod du gad 'o/ /'on kyang gtsang pa ye dpal sogs phyogs lhung can 'ga' zhig la 'dir phyogs snga rwakag pa garnod du phog nas ku co 'don par byed mod/ las kyis nongs pa'i gang zacig la/ /sman byin pa yang dug tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i dper zad do/ /skacabs shig zhal naṭa4/ ngas da res mtshams nang du rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chenacipo la skye ba phyi mar ngan song du mi ltung ba kho na'i ched du gsol ba sko
