516 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ phur tshub/ku/ su katab pas/ rmi lam du a mdo ba lta bu'i dge slore zhig gis gtun khung zhig tu gtun gyis brdungs bzhin dad zas gshin zas zer so khrigs khrigs byed pa zhig mis/ dad zas gshin zas la spyad na phyi mar gtun du 'tshod par 'gyur zer ba'i brda' yin pa 'dug ces thugs 'jigs pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ 'dul bar dge slong tshul /3mas rnam par dag pa bsrungs pas dkor sbyong nus par gsungs/ shing / rgyud sde rnams su sngakas pas bza' btung nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyad na dkor gyi phung po ri rab tsam yang byang bar gsungs pas/ /tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu las kyang ches gces par bsrung ba mdzad cing / gang snang bde stong gi rol pa 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba'i bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu la de lta bu'i dwogs pa'i gnas tsam yang ma mchis mod/ de ltar gsungs pa ni bdag lta bu blo gdengs ci yang med bzhin du dad ldan rnams kyis sen mo dkar nag gi steng nas bcad nas byin pa'i dad rdzas dang / shi bo'i yar 'dren du re nas byin pa'i gshin rdzas za ba la khyis khrag mthong ba ltar rngam — rku/ pa rnams la thugs brtse bas brda' gtong ba'i gsung yin pa gdon mi ) za'o/ /yang rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i / rnam thar du/ rje bla ma sku skye ba phyi mar ri bo rtse lngar paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshul gyis snga / dro 'khor sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la mdo phyogs kyi chos dang / phyi dro do rje 'dzin pa mang po la spra /sang sngags kyi chos gsungs shing bzhugs par bshad pa bzhin gacha/sa 'dir rje bla mari sprul pa'i rnam rol zhig nges par bzhugs pa yin 'dug snga ma zhig gnas 'dir sdod pa'i sta ga lung gi ri khrod pa

da wa gnas mchoka ri po rtse lngar skub pa'i rgyal cha na bsgrings tshu'// 511zhig chu len du phyin pas/ bod kyi btsun chung zhwa mo rne ring gyon pa zhig gis dmigs brtse ma gdangs dang bcas 'don bzhin 'ongs nas chu blang 'gro ba mthong / 'di phyogs su cha lugs de 'dra zhig yong don med bsam the tshom du gyur 'o/ ma de 6/ thaka rjes bsnyegs kyang sa/ra song cha med du song 'dug nged la yang rmi lam du dga' ldan khri rin po che rgya nag pa khong dbu zhwa rne ring dang chos gos ser po zhabs lham kyang ser po gsol ba zhig yang yang 'ong gi 'dug pa rje bla ma'i byin rlabs yin pa 'dra/ da lta rje'i sku brnyan nga 'dra ma yi na zer ba mang po zhig 'dug ste/ khri sprul sku de nyi da zhal nyams dang sku'i dbyibs rje bla ma ji lta ba bzhin yin 'dug ces gsu ngaku// rje bla ma gnas 'di'i bye brag ci 'dra zhig tu bzhugs pa yin nam zhus par/ 'dir bzhugs nges pa cher ma mchis kyang da lta ching lang cho'u zer ba'i hwa shang gi dgon der bzhugs pa yin 'dra zhes gsungs/gsung ris 'di la dpags na bla ma dam pa nyid rje bla ma'i rnam 'phrul de la nyams dang be+e khasgam du ma zad dngosatshosu yang mjal yod par the mi tshom mo/ /yang lan sa/cig ri bo rtse lngar bsnyen mtshams mdzad pa'i thun mtshams kyi skabs shig tu cung zad mnal du song ba'i rmi lam du/ dge slong zhwa ser po na bza' zhabs lham kyang ser po gsol ba zhig gis phyag bzed cig gsung byung ba bzhin bzed pas bdud rtsi yin nam snyam pa zhi ga blub/sa nas lan gsumyo/ du 'thung dgos zer bar/ 'khyor ba gang bo de lan gsum du myang dgos pa yin nam dgongs pa la/ de rdzogs par 'thungs dang ngas yang byug gi zer nas lan tro/sum gyi bar 'khyor ba gang re blugs pa zhal du

518 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul /gsol/ sku drung na dge legs nam mkha' dang gzhan ngo mi shes pa'i btsun chung gcig bcas 'dug pa la'ang bdud rtsi nas gnang bas kho gnyis kyis yang 'thung ba drisari// mnal sad pas na bza' dang bzhugs stan gyi steng du dngos su yang bdud rtsi cung zad bo 'dug pa/ phyag sor gyis blangs nas zhal du sa/sol bar mdog dmar ser la ro sbrang rtsi dang 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces gsungs/ 'di bdag la dngos su gsungs shing gzhan 'ga' la'ang gsungs 'dug 'di ni rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar du/'jam dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs khar zhugs pa dang / 'khor nyung shas zhig gi khar mang po dang 'ga' zhig gi khar cung zad re/ 'ga' zhig gi khar gtan nas mi 'gro ba gzigs pa'i tshul dang rnam pa chu thun pa'i gsang ba ngo mtshar ba nyid do/ /snga phyi ci rigs par gong du smosdosmu pa'i rnam pa de lta bu can gyi bla ma zhis/ gis spyi sger gyi 'byung 'gyur mang po lung bstan pa 'ga' zhig ji lta ba bzhin byung zi na cing / 'byung 'gyur kyang 'ga' zhig mchis pa kho boṭa/ rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal nasathe stusu/ mod kyang gsal bar bshad mi rung ba 'dug pas 'dir ma bris so/ / sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa'i yal ga yi/ /ral pa gsig pas 'jigs bskyed 'khor ba'i nags/ /thal bar rlog byed yang dag lta ba'i me/ /mgon 'dis lung rig gtsub shing brdar te sbar/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i rga/tam gyi rdzing / /log rtog dri mas sbags pa kun/ /dgag skub ke ta kas sbyangs te/ /gnas rmyegs ji bzhin gsal bar mdza da/ /

gnas mtshog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/ 519rtog se/'i dbugs kyis 'bud dka' ba/ /don rgyud sa/yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /lto ba ma rnyongs zab po'i sgra/ /'khor ba'i rims/ nad gnyen por bsgrags/ /shes rab zab mo'i mkha' klong du/ /chos rnams ma lus byari chub pa'i/ /rang zhal 'char ba phyag rgya che'i/ /ye shes a dār+sha yang bstan/ /mkhas rlom bung ba yar ma 'khrul lam du/ /'khor ba'i mu cor rna ba gtse ba'i glu/ /phyogs lhung ljan ljin khrod na 'byin pa ni/ /mi gtsang chad lta'i dri la zhen pas lan/ /gzhan du ma rig mun pas bris pa yi/ /'khrul ba'i ri mo srid na myo/chis so cog /sgrib pa'i cha kun spangs pa'i nyi ma 'dis/ /legs 'doms 'od kyi sor mos ma bsub med/ /gang gis rten 'byung sgyu ma'i rig sngags kyis/ /dngos 'dzin gdon tshogs bskrad pa'i legs skyes su/ /'jam mgon bla mas byin rlabs a mṛ ta'i/ /mchod yon 'khyor chu'i tshul gyis lan gsum sbrengs/ /chu mig zhig rdzing bur 'khyil ba pa'i lung khri zhes klu dkar mtshor 'bod pa gzim chung gi sgo drung na yod pa la/ 'di klu dkar phyogs la dga' ba sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong zhing mthu stobs kyang che ba 'dug ces gsungs shing / bzhugs gnas de'i sger gyi gzhi bdab/ la rdo rje dpal brtsegs zhes pa'i ming 'dogs gnang 'dug pa la dpags na/ mi ma yin de dag gis kyang rang gi gzugs bstan nas dam tshig khas blangs pa yin tshod 'dug kyang dngos su gsungs pa ma thos so/ /yang der sku bcad rgya la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig zhag kha shas kyi bar du snga dro'i cha la bzhus/sa gnas kyi thad kyi nam mkhar cub sil pi wang dung sogs rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs pa dang / sgrub

520 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs tshul/khang gi steng du 'ja' kha dog sna lnga pa mdung tshugs su zug pa phyag g.yog pa rnams dngaskeganas rdzokyi gsham du yod pa'i rgya'i grong pa'i mi 'ga' zhig gis kyang mthong zhing /4 rje bla ma nyid la de 'dra 'dug tshu la zhus par/ dkar phyo gas la dga' ba'i lha rnams dgyes pa'i brda' yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs nas thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad ces thos/ bla ma mchog nas de tsam la sa myo/ gsungs kyang de 'dra la rgyud dang 'grel pa rnams su phyi nang gi rna kha' spyod 'grub pa'i ltas khyad par can du gsungs 'duka ḍapres ngo mtshar chen por snang ngo / /yang zhal nas/ snga mo zhig nged ra nga ri bo rtse lngar lan gcig yong skabs bsag sbyang la 'bad pas/ lus las dud khu ljan ljin sbal lcong sdig sbrul sogs thon 'gro ba'i rmi lam 'ga' zhig byung / da cha sha chen sogs mi gtsang ba za ba dang sbrul dang sbal ba sogs khyur mid byed pa rmi ba zhig 'dug dkor mang po zos pas snga ma las lod du song ba yi na nam zhes gsungs/ rje nyid de ltarir khengs skyungs pa'i ba/sung gnang na'ar / dam pa gong ma tshad ldan gyi rnam thar mang por sha chen za ba dngos grub chen po 'grub pa dang / sbrul sdig sogs mid pa rlur thim pa'i rtags su bshad 'dug pas rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa'i mtshan ma yin pa gdon mi za'o/ /sngar gsang sngags bde chen du bcad rgya'i skabs nang mchod dngos su khol ba dang / do lon nor du yang de 'dra lan sa/cig byung zhing / 'dir yang sku mtshams skabs shig thod pa'i nang mchod phrom phrom khol ning lha ba 'khrigs pa byung 'dug pa/ lho brag mar pas rje mi lar gnang spyo'i nang

ginas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/ byi21mcho da cher sa/tad kyis byin rlabs mdzad pas 'od zer kha dro ga lnga ldan du khol ba kun gyis mthong ba dang tshul mtshungs pa'i kyub pa'i rtags mtshan rmad du byung ba'o/ /nang mchod de nyid ril bur dril ba slob ma 'ga' zhig la gnang zhing / kho bo la'ang phon che tsam stsal pa byin rlabs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba mngon sum du ni/nga ngo / /dam rdzas 'di 'dra'i byin rlabs dang nus pa la ltos na bkras lhun dang sa skya nas thon— pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu ma gtogs pa'i/ deng sang mchog dman mang po zhig gis bdud rtsi ril bu yin zer nas zong du 'grem pa rnams ni/ rin spungs 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pas/ bag phye btsag gis dril ba'i ril bu dang / /a ru gser mdog brdungs pa'i phye ma gnyis/ /sa phyogs 'di la brin sgo mi 'dug pas/ /mon dang kong pozhi yul du gshegs par zhu/ /zhes sde pa snang rtse ba'i dam rdzas la zur za byermi pa dang mtshungs pa kho nar 'dug go /skabs shig tshogs 'khor mang zhig mdzad skabs zhal nas/ nged kyis tshogs 'khor mang po bgyis pa 'di sha za chang 'thung snyam pa min te/ 'di 'dra ma byas na mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis re 'khang byed pa 'dug ces tshogs gral rang du gsu ngas 'dug pas/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin bzhin du 'dus pa dang lhan cig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan du spyod pa'i rgya gar gyi grub thob chen po rnams dang tshul mtshungs pa'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /da res kyi gsung 'di dang mkha' 'gro ma rna mas kyi snying gi thig le bskul ba'i mgur dbyangs kyi brjod don dang / rgyal dbang

byelha2 gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar thab pa rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshul/thams cad mkhyen pas bla ma dam pa nyid kyi nyams bzhes gsal 'debs su gnang ba'i gsung mgur du/ yid brtan pa 'awo rtsa/ byed phyag rgya'i ba/ra/ /rga/nas phyogs 'o5 hrūrma sa kun tu bun long nges/ /nang bde stong zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam/ /rgyun chu bo'i 'gros ba/zhin bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis rje bla ma mchog la sa/nang b.ri chab shog tu/ nyid kyang phyi nang rkyen gnyis thabs mkhas la/ /brten pa'i ral gri rnon pos kun rtog mgo /cig char bregs pa'i dhu tī rar rol pa'i/ /ting 'dzin nam yang lhod pa med pa nas/ /zhes 'a doms par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang bla ma nyid kyi/ gsung sgros 'ga' zhig rnams gung bsgrigs nas brtags na skabs 'di dag tu zhing sngags lhan skyes kyi pho nya mo khyad par can rnams kyidrotrī gro sa/sa/ mdzad pa'i mthu las/ rlung thim pa las byung ba'i 'od gsal lha/ma/ cig skyes pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor pa'i krub pa'i go 'phang mthon po mngon du mdzad pa gor ma chag kyang / dgag bya'i dbang gis gsal bar 'god ma nus pas rgyud sde'i don mkhyen pa rnams kyis brtags na shes nus par yod do/ /nyin gcig spyan nam mkha' la yun ring du gzigs nas phyag g.yog pa rnams la mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings 'dir ci 'dug ces phebs pa la/khong tshos bltas pas sprin dkar po dumyo/ tsam zhig chags pa mthong nas zhus pas dga' mo red gsungs zhal 'dzum pa mdzad 'dug pa/ rgyu mtshan zhu ba ma byung bas 'di yin ma gsungs 'dug kyang / yi dam gyi lha zhig zhal gzigs pa yin 'dra/ yang skabs shig phu sa ting gi 'jam dbyangs kyi

gam/sa mchoka ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa'irgyal mtshanabasnrengadzo tshul/ —sgochodrung du phebs nas yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal bsngo smo na ṭ+wā+oṃne+o nga/ sa rgyas pa mdzad cing / phyag dang sbrags te rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa lan bdun gsungs nas/ sku brtan la dbu gtugs te ting nge radzin gyi dbang bzhi byi na rlabs kyi tshul du len pa sa/nang ste sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs dgyes tshor che ba mdzad 'dug pa dang / yang zhal nas/ nged la ma)ོnga rmi lam du rje rinapobai la nye ba'i sras chen brgyadakyis bskoraba'isgrub thabs nig rtsom rngo sto zer ba byung ste/ de 'dra'i srol mi 'dug pas rmi lam de chul le chol le yin pa 'dra gsungs/ de dag la yang dgos pa khyad par can zhig yod pa ni gor ma chag go /ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs kyi rnam thar ya mtshan can 'di dag la lo snga phyi ci rigs yod srid na'ang / sa bon gyi zin tho kho bos ma mthong bas go rim gyi nges pa byed ma nus par dkyus gcig la mthar chags su bkod pa yin no/ /7 'dwam dpūl rdo rje rnon po ni/ /dgyes rgur rol pa'i sgrub gnas su/ /hūṃdz+wam dz+wasdil mi yi gar mkhan khyod/ ༷ /dgyermo rgurwa chos kyi dga' cibodes rtsen/ /sdopag med bskal pa'i snga rol nas/ ༷ /ṅgengs rtogs ma lus mthar phyin kyang / /gdul bya bkri ba'i thabs mkhas su/ /lamā la slob pa'i tshul mdzad de/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor g.yo ba glog gi gar/ /'di snang phun sdogs sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ltar/ /gzigs pa'i nges 'byung dpung ba brtan po yis/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan srid las 'das par bsgrongs/ /byams dang snying rje'i skya bas nyer bskyod pa'i/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi gru zhon nas/ ju/rgyal sras spyod rnga/ rgya mtsho'i

524 gnas mchog ri bo rtsi lngar sgrub pa' rgyal mtshan bsgrings tshulo/'jings brgal te/ /don gnyis yid bzhin nor bu bzhed rgur blangs/ /chos nyid ngo bor brdar ba'i shes rab mtshon/ /'gro kun bzod dka'i duḥkha la sbyor ba'i/ /lhan skyes dgra bo'i snying la bsnun pa yis/ /chos kun skrag ste stong pa'i dbyings su bros/ /bde stong lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje yis/ /kun rtog sa 'dzin bgrod pa kun bcom ste/ /zag med 'byor pa'i longs spyod mtha' klas pa'i/ /zung 'jug lha dbang khri la rnam par 'gyings/ /bya dka'i spyod mang gom pa 'degs 'jog gis/ /grangs med bskal par bgrod la mi ltos par/ /thabs mkhas gom stabs gcig gis sa lam kun/ /snyigs ma'i tshe gcig yun la rdzogs par gzhal/ /khyod kyi kun bzang spyo da pa'i me long du/ /dpag yas ngo mtshar 'phrul snang 'char ba 'dir/ /mi 'phrog mos pa'i pad+ma 'dzum khrol na/ /thugs rje nyi mas rtag tu skyong bar gsol/ /zhes bya ba ni —ra skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sen sa dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sdo shes balhan pasdi sgronaspre me dpaskya babyāng phya'i rnam par thar pa ya do tsam brjed ṅge daṅge ldarno bstaṅge the'i mdzes rgyan las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri ṣ+pertse lngar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad rngo pa'o

rjo ///rga/rdo/rte///)'ezhu bradhu dgu bu/ thugasdo/ sra/sa skyes chen dmā pu zhatha/'a ṭa/ k+kabu rgyaska nga/ spya tsheska zhakhor busmron da sro tha/rga nu tshu/9//sa 4ོ byi ba'i lo kho bos gsol ba btab nas thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi/ zur bka'i dbang chen bka' drin stsa la cing / dpon mo gzungs skyid kyiṭa5 shus pa bzhin slob 'khor nang ma kha shas la/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyo da ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa smin rgyas phu ru (la/ lo rjes ma 'di dgung keg che ba'i lung bstan yod pas gegasdo/ sel la dmigs nas dbus gtsang gi dgon khag rnams dang / mdo smad dgom/ lung du zhabs brtan rim gro rgya chen sgrub rgyu'i thebs sogs bskur dz+ra/nang spodzad/ kho bo cag pe'i cir du nad gzhi babs rtsi ba zhig gis yun ring na ba la/ lung—bstan dang phyo / phywa mkhan sogs kyi sa srog gi bar chad du 'gyur tshul lab cing / rgya bod kyi sman pa mkhas pa du mas kyang nad 'ayi+o dka' bar thag bcad na'ang / rje bla ma mchog nas nad gzhi 'di slar skabs 5/hūṃbs su yang yang 'phar ldang byed pa zhig yong shas che ba las/ tshe'e bar chad du 'gro ba sogs mi yong zhes gnang ba de kho na ltar gyur/ rje bla ma nyid rang gis sman bcos dang lhag par me btsa' sobs kyi dpyad sku dngos kyis mdzad pa dang / phral phral du rim gro rga/nga dgos rnams bka' lung brtse bas paskyangs shing / khyad par du nad gzhi'i

526 thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyazlo kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ r+sha rkyen pyi se gyigong ma chen por rang yul du phyir log chog pa'i gnang ba zhu nga ri mgo 'dren mdzad pa bcas/ nam yang gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs par mdzad/ kho bo rang yul du yong khar thugs dam rten bde ma thog dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan lo rgyus can gyis gtso ba'i bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan mang po/ dngul gos dar sogs kyi gnang sbyin bsam gyiṭasmu mi khyab pa stsal cing / nged kyang 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis yid k+to/ting nas sun pas// gong ma chen por dgongs pa zhus te dben pa'i gnas zhig tu 'gro 'dod sko ma pas chu rga/dung lta bu mchis kyang / rgyal srid kyi lugs sro la shin tu phra zhing zhib drags pas dgongs pa zhu 'os kyi bar skabs gtan nas ma rnyed/ khyed rang rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba lta bus gathugs gzhi ma bde ba'i rkyen gyis dgongs pa zhus pa la/ gong nas mi mnyes pa'i rnam pa med par dgongs khrol byung ba 'di 'dra lha dang bla ma'i drin yin pa shes par gyis la/ mdo smad du slebs nas rang rgyud chos ngazhin 'dul ba'i nyams len la 'bad pa gal che zhing / ri rang re bla chen gyi go sar 'khod pa rnams phyi'i rnam 'gyur 'jig rten dang mi bstun ka med mang po yod na'ang / sems kyi gtad so dam pa'i chos kho na dang /lhag par lus ngag gi bya ba gang la'ang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa gnad kyi don po yin pas sems la bcang ba gyis/ nged kyang lo kha shas kyi mchams nas gyigong mar dgongs pa gtsang zhus kyis rang yul du yong e thub snyam pa yod pas/ thog tu khel ba byung na rang re zhal 'dzom zhing / lhan cig tu dbon phar chos kyi dga' bde la ci dgar longs spyod

zugs sras skyis chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi tshos 'khor bskor tshul/ byo21pa bgyid/ ces sogs thugs la btags pa'i bslab bya rgyas par stsal/dgung lo nga gsum pa sa glang lo'i dpyid ka dgung keg gi 'tshub lta bus sku bsnyung bzhes pa'i tshu la bstan par grwa slob rnams kyis zhabs brtan sogs la 'bad pas mi ring bar bskung gzhi lhag med du dwangs nas/ har chin dka' bcu brtson 'grus sogs la spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub kyi dbang bka' drin stsal/ lo 'di'i dbyar rje bla ma ri bo rtse lngar phe0/// kun tu bde ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa rab gnas mdzad rgyu'i thugs dgongs skabs/ mdo smad nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po che dang / a lag sha nas tho yon no min han bcas de khar phebs pas/ rje bla ma mchog dang 'jam dbyangs ba3da pa'i sprul sku rin po ches gtso mdzad/ tho yon no min han sogs dase/ 'dun mang po dang bcas pas dpal rno rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i phyag len ltar mdzad cing / bla ma rnams la 'bul ba dang dge 'dun thams cad la mang 'gyed sogs rgyas pa stsal/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po ches zhus pa bzhin slob rma mi nyung tsam la dben sa snyan brgyur+sha kyi lam khrid sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ gsol dpon dge legs nam mkhas zhus ngor rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa shī sprul sku rin po ches bla ma dam pā'i lta ba'i gsung mgur gyi 'grel pa ljags tso ma gnang ba gzigs rtog phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad/sprul sku rin po che'i zhal nas/ de dus 'grel pa de rtsom pa la ma/lo ba'i dpe cha sna gcig kyang ma rnyed pas / nyin banin mgur ma de tshar sa/su ya re

d+ngha༄1tram̐————— sum̐gasasras kyerte/maina'aga' la zab rgyas kyi ts+tshas 'aro/ ra bsgor tshulo/ bton k+shi bla mar gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas bsam blo btang ba na brjod don rnams sems la lam lam 'char ba zhig byung / de nas 'grel pa de brtsams pa yin/ bla ma'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi mthu zer ba de 'dra yin pa 'dug ces gsungs pa kho bos dngos su thos/ 'di ni yab sras gnyis ka'i rnam thar ngo mtshar can du 'dug go /dus phyis kho bos rje bla mar mjal skabs (ragrel pa de thugs la babs e byung zhus pas/ sa skya pas lta ba la gsal stong 'dzin me da kyi tha snyad byed pa sa paṇa gyi gsung na'ang yod kyang / 'grel pa 'anir tshar chen yab sras nas byung tshul gnang 'dug de tsam ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'chad lugs bzang bar snang / de dus dpe cha sa/nga yang ma rnyed 'dug pas phral du thugs thog nas de tsam thon pa gsung rab la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas rtags yin pa 'dug ces gsungs so/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po ches rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung gnang rgyu'i snyan gsan phul bar/ pe'i cing du phebs nas gnang chog pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa bzhin/ dgun kha pe'i cing du yab sras gnyis zhal 'dzoms/ zung ṭu zi'i bla brang du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po ches gtso mdzad/ smin grol no min han sprul sku/ shar rtse no min han ngag dbang tshul khrin sa/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas sogs bla ma rnams dang / dge bshes du ma bcas gsan mkhan brgyad cu lhag tsam la/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po mdo sde thams cad kyi za ma tog dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad phyogs mthun gyi rgyud nems kyi bangod bya'i yang snying dpal mgon 'phags pa klu

bugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi/ chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 529sgrub yab sras kyis bkral pa/ 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi thugs dam sdi mthil du mdzad cing / bod kyi ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos snga rabs pa rnams kyis ma bshad pa dang log par bshad pa'i skyon mtha' dag bsal te/ sgra bsgyur mkhas pa gnyis kyi bshad srol gtsang ma bzhin dpyis phyin par rgya cher gtan la phabs pa'i legs bshad kyi gter chen po rim lnga rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me zhes grags pa de nyid gzhan gyi zer zlos tsam bskyar ba dang tshig gi na yam tsamyog 'grel ba'i bshad yam gyis nyi ma 'phul thabs byed pa'i deng sang gi 'chad pa po lta bu ma yin par/ phal ba rnams kyi blo gros kyi spyod yul du gyur pa lta ci tshig gi rjes zlos tsam yang ji lta ba bzhin thon dka' ba'i rdo rje'i gsang tshig shin tu zab cing brling ba rnams kyi tshig donajithang mar brdal ba'i bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / snying po'i nyams len gyi man ngag rnams grub chen rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang ma dzod brus pa'i zab gnad mthar thug pa lhug par 'doms pa'i sgo nas gzab bshad nyin btso lnga'i bar du legs par stsal/phyag len kyang blo gsar ba la dge rgan gyis dpe khrid byed pa lta bu'i bcas bde sla chos ma yin par/ chos thun re re bzhin mgor dpon slob thun mong gis rdor sems sgom bzlas/ 'grel gtor/ brgyud 'debs/maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / mjug tu sa/sang 'dus smon lam gsung ba sogs dpal ldan smad rgyud pa'i phyag bak+ṣi/sa bzhin mdzad cing / lhag par sgyu lus mchod pari skabs slob ma rnams kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dasger med pa la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phul te/ gi

530 thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab 4rgyas kyi 0chos 'kho—ra bskor tshul/ shigs rdo re'i sku brnyes pa'i tshul gyis sprustod cing / gsol ba lan gsum gyi bar du 'debs pa ngo na du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sgyu lus kyi gdam sa pa 'bogs pad mdzad pa sogs rje yab sras kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i 'chad thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len mtha' dag ma nyams pa mdzad/ bka' chos rdzogs pa'i mjug tu rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po ches bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs stan rgyab yol/ sku 'i nyer dpyad cha tshang / gser srang sum cu/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang brgya/ gos chen yug nyi shu sogs 'bul ba gnang zhing /maṇ+ḍal sbyi/gad+nghatu thogs nas rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mtha' yas pa las brtsams pa'i che brjod dang / bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs pad spyo rnge'e rang bzhin du brtan par bzhugs nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'phrin 'a sa kyisi gdul bya'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos tshul gyi zhu 'bul zab cing rgya che ba snyan du gsol bar/ rje bla ma mchog kyang thugs dgyes pa chen pos gsung lan rgyas pa dang / zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po stsol ba mdzad/ de ltar rje bla ma rno rje 'chang chen pos gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba la brten nas chos gsan mkhan thams cad yid lhag par tshims shing / khyad par du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che gzhan dring mi 'joka pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyis rgyud sde mtha' dag gi tshig don la nang byan chud cing / rgyal sras chen po rnams kyis kyang dpag par dka' ba'i lam gyi mthar thug zung 'jug gi gnad la sgro 'dogs chod

thugs sras kyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor basmor tshul/ 531pas/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rno rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis ston pa sdo rje 'chang las gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bango/ skal len pa dang chos mtshungs par gyur to/ /deng sang gi dge ldan bstan 'dzin du rlom pa rnams rje bla ma'i thugs bcud rim lnga gsalnga sgron sogs la 'chad nyan tshad ldan byed pa lta ci dpe klog tsam yang byed pa dkon par snang bas/ yab sras gnyis kyi 'chad nyan lan gcig pu 'di yang ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa'i srog gi zungs su gyur par snang ngo / / sprul pa'i sku rin po che sku rkyang la 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo'i thun mong rma yin pa'i rjes gnang sogs gsang chos 'ga' 'i/ga dang / dril bu skor gsum kyi rgya sa/zhung gi lung rnams gnang zhing / dpon g.yog tshang mar tshe dbang rgyas pa sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid bcas stsal terkasprul sku rin po che re zhig thu med pe'i ze'i ho shor phebs so/ /dregs ldan bde 'byung gtsug na ngal bso zhing / /blo tha /sal ku mud dga' tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar bye bas bsgrun min pa/ /legs bshad 'od dkar stong 'gyed bdag gi mgon/ /gang thugs snying rje'i rang gdangs dam pa'i chos/ /gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs kyi tasbu ra/ /gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i sgra brnyan ni/ /lha yi rnga bzhin dus su 'doms pa las/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro ba ku la yi tshogs/ /'khrin pa'i 'dab ma rgod byed gsang chen gyi/ /zab mo'i gdams pa rked med 'gram pa'i chang / /mkhyen dpyod zhal nas lhug par 'dzag bzhin du/ /sdi skrub klu rīdabang rol mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /rispya chen rispya thang bral ba

sna 532 thugs sras skyes 3na 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/rim pa lnga / /gceXs nor gtwes pa'i bu la 'bogs pa bzhin/ /kyāl sras zhwal ba'i gdung 'tshob la gtad pas/ /gangs ri'i ljongs su nyan bshad srog chad nas/ /glegs bu'i bem por gyur pa rimyo/ lnga'i gzhung / /tsi na'i yul du yab sras zung 'di yis/ /'chad nyan shi gsos sman gyis bslangs so zhes/ /dus mtha' 'di dang rnam par mi 'tsham pa'i/ /grags pa srid pa gsum na ldir ba'i sgras/ /rgyal kun chos kyi dbyings las myur bzhengs te/ /dgyes 'dzum 'od kyis 'ji/ 5/ rten sad par mdzad/ /rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che pho brang chen po nas chibs bskyod de shar phyogs pa tshwa can gyi rgya mtsho dang thag mi ring ba'i sog po'i yul zhig tu bzhugs skabs rje bla ma mchog la snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu mchid cig 'bul bar mdzad pa la bka' lan tshig don zab cing barming ba ngo mtshar can zhig gnang ba 'dir bkod na ha cang mang bar bsams nas ma bris pa gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa ltar ro/ /snga ma phag gi lo nas rgyal khab chen po'i lho phyogs su yu'u nan du grags pa'i zhing sa chen po dang 'dabs 'brel ba'i rgyal khab 'ga' zhig dang rgya gnyis ma 'cham pa'i rkyen gyis gong ma chen pos dadu nga chen 'jug pa gnang ba/ mon dang kla klo'i yul 'ga' zhig dang 'jang yul sogs snang 'thab pa'i dus zir chen po lo kha shas kyi bar du byung ba la/ 'di dus gong ma chen pos rje bla ma mchog nas lha/ mo'e gtor chen gnang dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ pho brang gi dbus ri'i yung an zi nas zhag ti

zhas sras skyis chin 'ga' la zab rgyas myi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 533 shas kyi ring 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo'i drag gtor sgrub pa mdzad cing / gtor zor 'phen du nye ba na bla ma dam pas gser skyems dang bcas dmod bcol bzhes sgra gnang ba shin tu zil che zhing / mtshan nyid bla ma sogs 'ga' zhig la sa gzhi dmag gis khengs pa lta bu'i mthong snang yang byung zhes zer/ gtor ma 'phen pa'i nyin dmag gi sa char phan tshun g.yul bkye bas pha rol po rnams kyis glang chen ral gri'i 'khor lo can mang po rbad byung ba rnams/ glo bur du phar log nas kho rang tsho'i dmag la nyam nyes shin tu che ba byung ba/ khong tsho'i mchod gnas mngon shes dang ldan pa zhig yod pa la dris par/ rgya nag gi rgyal khab tu dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi da bang phyug chen po spyan mi gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad pa zhig gis srung ma mthu stobs can rbad pa 'dug ces smras zhes paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas kho bos dngos su thos so/ /mdo smad dgon lung du sa mo glang gi lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam gtong bar gnyer pa blo bzang can ched mngags kyis dngul srang stong phrag phyed gnyis rgyur 'gro'i cho 'phrul chen po'i duṭapre chen la dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ dge 'dun nyis stong lhag brgal bar ja thug sku 'gyed sogs shin tu rgyas pa mdzad cing / snga phan rje bla ma nyid cho sa sde chen po'i khri baṃ dngos dang gdan sa pa sku tshab byed pa yin pa la/ 'di res chos sde chenari po 'chad nyan gyi bla ma dngos gzhi zhig med par tshab ma bsko ba 'di 'dra rgyun ring na 'chad nyan 'grig lam sogs nyams pa'i rkyen du 'gro srid pas/ rje nyid nas khri'e dgongs pa gtsang zhus dang / slad mar sngon gyi srol rnying pa zhisne/ thamyo/sa

534 zugs sras skyes chon 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/cad 'dod bstun gyis khri pa bsko bzhag bgyis na legs rngari'i bka' rgya phebs/ dgon par spyi 'jog tu gser gyis bris pa'i bka' 'gyur khyad par du 'phags pa sbyor 'jags mdzad pa dpyad khra phebs pa 'di nang bzhin no/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mcho lta bu la dbang 'byor zhing rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che'i pha rol tu son pa khri rin po ches gtso mdzad/bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa dam pa bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyan drung du/ shākya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa dge slong rgan po lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes yid dad pa chen pos ched du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ skye rgu'i phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par du 'jam mgen chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid nam mkha' ji sri da gnas kyi bar du lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas su phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rgyal ba yab sra sa gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ rgya bod hor gsum gyis mtshon pa'i yul gru rnamyo/ sa gang na su bzhugs pa thams cad kyi sku tshe zhabs pad yun ring du brtan cing / mdzad pa 'phrin las zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel ba dang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i zhabs pad lo khri phrag gi bar brtan cing chos mthun dge ba'i mdzad pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams kyis mtshon mtha' dbus kyi skye shāgro ma/tha' dag mi cha/shu rwa/ nyer 'arngu hūṃ rgud pa thamyo/ṭa4 cad dang

dhe thunasasrasaskyesachena'aga'alazabargyazi kyichosa'akhor bskor tshul/ 535bral te mchog gsum bla mar 'dzin pa'i dad gus dang / dkar po dge bcu'i khrims la gnas pa sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshul lhur len pa'i sgo nas rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs spyod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bkra shis kyi dge mtshan rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i ring dge 'dun rnams la bsnye na bkur zhus pa dang / dgon gnas 'di nyid kyi rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs rgyur/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob se ra byams chen chos rje dang / rgya nag tā ming rgyal po mchod yon gyi thugs dam rten gras rgyal ba'i bka' nyagyur ro cog gi glegs bam po ti brgya dang lnga dkar chag dang bcas pa/ bai ḍūr+ya'i glegs bu dang mtshungs pa'i mthing shog bzang po la gser zhun mas bris pa nan mo'i glegs shing tshon rtsi gser ris kyis mdzes pa/ gos skud lhas ma'i glegs thag a long gser tshags mas spras pa/ gdong dar zhal khebs na bza' phyi nang sogs spus gtsang khyad du 'phags pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba phul yod pa 'di bzhin lags pas/ dge ba 'di9/ mtshon bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gong du zhus pa ltar gyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dang / khyad par bdag kyang deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar du rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa la 'gran zla med pa'i go 'phang thob ste/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' klas par zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos rnga chen po brdung ba la spobs pa dang rnam dpyod phul du byung ba rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs lta bu dang / sdug bsngal

bye36 sum̐gasasrasaskyedze+e—chena'aga'al zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshulo/gyis nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba sgrol ba la snying rje dang byams pa'i nus mthu co yongs su rdzogs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lta bu dang /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing bdud dang mu stegs dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod pa la rlabs po che'i mthu dang ldan pa dpal phyag na rdo rje lta bur gyur te skad cig re re la'ang rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams rgya mtshor phyin te/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung du kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin rgya spetsho lta bus dgyes pa bskyed de/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i 'gro ba sgrol pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal sras kun tu bzang po lta bu 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba dang / tshe 'dir yang chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' srol dri ma med pa thun mong dang thun rmeng ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams la/ sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam don thams cad lhun gyis 'grub pa dang / bdag la re zhing ltos pa'i grwa slopa sbyin bdag thams cad gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i nyer 'tshe'i rgud pa mtha' dag dang bral nas/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnam dkar gyi bya ba thams cad zla ba yar ngo bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po myur ba nyid du thob pa'i bsngo smosnga gyis mtshams sbyor rnam par dag pa cis kyang gnang ba zhu/ zhes rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa pho byi ba'i lo smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas phul/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /lcags stag lo shar rtse no min han/ sku tsha 'dan ma sprul sku sogs slob ma kha shas la dpal 'khor

thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 53ṭīlo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa stsal/ dbyar gyi ring ri bo rtse lngar sku bcad rgya'i ngos nang du yang dag zhujog la gzhol ba mdzad cing / zla ba bdun pa'i mjug tsam la pho brang cin por phyag phebs te/ 'jam dbyangs mi rje chen po dang mjal 'dzoms mdzad/ 'di lo gnam gyi lhagyigong ma bdag po chen po dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi dus yin pas/ci megong ma rang gi zhabs brtan du bzhengs pa gnang ba'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan khri phrag bzhugs pa'i lha khang wan phu zi zhes pa/ rje bla mas gtso ba'i pho brang nang gi bla grwa mang pos rab gnas mdzad/brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi sgron rje bla ma mchog nas 7gong ma bdag po chen po dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i dga' ston rten 'brel du/ tshe dpag med kyi sku li ma bzhugs khri rgyab yol rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis spras pa/bde mchog rtsa rgyud gser bris/ gser gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal rin po che du ma'i phra rgyan can dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs dang bcas pa/ dngul gyi rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags rdzas bcu drug tshe bum dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can/ dngul gyi 'khor lo rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ rdo rje dar sna lnga'i chun 'phyang can/ gos tshem grub kyi bzhugs stan rgyab yol bcas dang / gzhan yang tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan che ba/ yang tshe dpag med bzhugs khang dang bcas pa gcig tshe dpag med li sku bzhugs khri rgyab yol can dgu/ sgrol ljang li sku gcig thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa'i sku bzhugs khang can/ sdob pa'i rnam thar thang ka dgu/ dkyil thang sna tshogs dgyu/ tshe

538 bugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/mdo gser bris dgu/ dnguldogyi mchod rten gcig gser zangs kyi mchod rten brgyad/ gser gyi bcu shad can gyi phyag phreng mi 'dra ba dgu /spos rengs che ba sbag cha zhe lnga/ rta dkar po dgu/ zhu'u yir grags pa'i nor bu don yod lcags kyu rin po che'i phra can bcas phul te/ gong ma chen po zhabs pad bska la pa khri phrag khri phrag tu brtan pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag tu phye ba mdzad/ gong ma chen pos rje bla ma mchog la/byu ru'i rgyan phreng mu men gyi mig 'byed can/ mdzod gos ser po yug chen lnga/ krong don yug bzhi/ mdzod gos sna tshogs yug sum cu tham pa/mgo snam dmar ser dgu sogs kyi gnang sbyin rgya che ba dang bcas thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i bka' bzang po stsal/ mogong mas gsar du bzhengs pa'i bde ba can gyi lha khang du nyin lnga'i bar du rje bla mas gtso ba'i dge 'dun mang pos gyigong ma'i zhabs brtan gyi rim gro sgrub pa gnang / rje nyid kyi sku tsha 'dan ma sprul sku glo bur du gshegs pas gyigong ma chen por zhus nas/ de'i tshab tu mdo smad nas sku tsha ra kho zhabs drung 'bod pa gnang ste phyag g.yog tu 'jog pa mdzad/ lcags yos lo gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs mi'i dbang pos nai hor du bod yul dbus kyi pho brang chen po po ta la dang dpe mtshungs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos kye+ong srung ma rnams kyi sku brnyan grangs las 'das pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i blos bslang mang po dang / rin po che'i mchod rten shin tu che ba du ma/ mchod rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs dang bcas pas byur bur gtams pa/ 'khor 'das byi/ mig gi bdud rtsi thams cad

thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 539phyogs gcig tu spungs pa lta bu'i khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs nas 'grub tu nye ba na bka' las/ rje bla ma nyid do lon nor du phebs nas/der hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i sprul pa'i skus nged la zhus don bzhin dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa dang / 'dod chos gang dgos rnams gnang grub rjes bla ma dam pa gnyis ka nai hor du byon nas/ nged la mjal kha dang /gsar du bzhengs pa'i po ta la rab gnas dang smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad dgos zhes phebs pa bzhin/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid mtsho bdun gyi lha khang chen por chibs bskyod mdzad/ mi ringabar byang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me rje btsun dam pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che phyag phebs pa la rje bla ma nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa mdzad/ rje btsun dam pas dbang chen 'ga' zhig gnang dgos pa'i snyan gsan zhus par/ thog mar lam thun mong ba'i khrid cig ma gsan na mi yong gsungs nas lam khrid mdor bsdus zhig gnang / kho bo cag nai hor du gong ma'i 'tshams zhur phyin pa 'di skabs su rje bla ma mchog dang mjal bas thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung gleng zhib tu mdzad/ mi ring bar rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che yang phebs/ de nas rje btsun dam pa mchog gis zhus pa bzhin lha khang ser po'i gzim chung du bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rje btsun dam pa mchog sprul rin po ches gtso mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku/ mtsho bdun tham ka bla ma pi lig thu no min han/ hal ha 'jam dpal rdo rje no min han/gtsang pa no min han/ il kug tshan hu thog thā sogs bla chen mang po

540 bugs sras sa chen 'ga' la zab rgyasakyichosa'akhorabaskoratshul/da dgedang / dge 'dun bzhi bcu skor bcas la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa snu i pa'i lugs kyi dbang chen/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang / gdugs dkar lha so bdun ma'i dbang / bde mchog sngags btu'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal rnam gsum ma gtogs pa'i 'a jam dbyangs chos skor gyi lha tshang ma'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ khyung khra/ khyung nag srad rgyud lugs kyi lo ma gyon gtso 'khor gsum/'jam dbyangs nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang / rdo rje 'jis/ṭari byed byi reskye da rdzogs kyi khrid/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang 'jigs byed sbrags sgrub kyi khrid/ klag lung thor bu 'ga' zhig dang bcas bka' chos mang du gnang /gzhan slob ma 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor/ bla ma mchod pa'i khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid 'pho ba dang bcas pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas gtum mo'i dmar khrid/ gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid rnams stsal/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po ches zhus pa bzhin/ khrid yig yid ches gsum ldan gyi thog nas nā ro chos drug gi khrid rgyas pa lus sbyong dang rlung gi rnal 'byor sogs kyi phyag bzhes dang bcas smin rgyas su stsal/ skabs shig mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi nyin rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i skus rgyu sbyar te/ dpak+ṣa 'alor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa mdzad skabs tshogs gral du rje bla ma mchog gis gsung mgur 'di gnang ste/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥzhing rab 'byams rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /don gcig tu 'dus pa'i ye shes gar/ /pha drin ca na ngag dbang mchog ldan zhabs/ /snying chos 'khor 'dab brgyad

gis sus skyis chen 'ga' la dz+rab rgyas snye chos 'khor bskor tshul/ bye41lte bar bzhugs/ /lung rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya che zhing / /tshe du mar bstan la bya ba mdzad/ /gnas lnga rig mkhyen pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /rje sprul pa'i sku khyod bdag la gson/ /longs rang re 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /rmongs ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur kyang / /yid gdod ma'i sems kyi rdo rje de/ /'od gsal ba dri mas dben pa yin/ /don de phyir sems kyi rang bzhin de/ /tshul ji bzhin rang ngo 'phrod pa'i phyir/ /mgon klu sgrub yab sras gzhung lugs la/ /sgo du mas nyams len 'bad pa gces/ /ma drin can rigs drug 'gro ba rnams/ /gnas srid par duḥkhas mnar ba la/ /byams snying rje chen po rab bskyed de/ /thabs byang chub sems la 'bad kyang 'tshal/ /spyir dal 'byor rten 'di rnyed dka' zhing / /sgos blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / /lar phrad pa shin tu rnyed dka' bas/ /snyan brgyud kyi gnad la sgrub pa gces/ /rje bla ma'i gsang ba'i yi dam mchog /dpal bde gsang 'jigs gsum dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la/ /nyin mtshan du 'bad pa shin tu gces/ /lha bla ma rang sems rdo rje gsum/ /dbyer med pa'i zab lam rnal 'byor gyis/ /yul gang snang kun la rgyas btab ste/ /rkyen gang shar lam du slong bar mdzod/ /nyid da lta rang yul phebs nas kyang / /dus ring por mi thogs rang re rnams/ /zhal mjal ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pas na/ /chos zab rgyas de dus bgro bar bya/ /dpal rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen nas/ /rje bka' drin can gyi bla ma'i bar/ /chos dam tshig gtsang ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /dpal brgyud

byi42 zugs sraru kyi sa 3na sdega' 'a zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog /ma mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba'i dbus/ /nyams gas nga gsum gar dgus mngon par brjid/ /mgon yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa yin/ /dpal yi dam mchog gi bkra shis shog /yul 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyer bzhi yi/ /yongs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/ /yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor yin/ /ma mkha' 'gro bzang po'i bkra shis shog /skyabs thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa mchog /tshe 'di phyi bar do'i 'jis/sdo/ 'a rtswa skyo ba/ /las sgrub mdzad ye shes mgon po yin/ /dpal chos skyong bzang po'i bkra shis shog /mchog sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gcis/ pu/ /lam byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa 'di/ /mi nga yi nyamyo/sa len snying po yin/ /lam nyams len bzang po'i bkra shis shog /rje sprul pa'i sku khyod zhabs pad brtan/ /bshad sgrub pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas/ /ma 'gro kun bde skyid dpal la rol/ /dus rnam kun dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lca/gas yos zla ba brgyad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen la mtsho bdun dgon gsar chen yo/ri sgrub khang du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog gis/ tshogs 'khor gyi mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe tshogs gral du gyilcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes gang shar thol byung du smras pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud yongs su grol pas rdo rje'i glu thol byung du gnang bas der tshogs pa thams cad snang ba 'gyur zhing / khyad par du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che r+bhags lhag par 'khul nas spyan chab kyi rgyun bcad par dka' ba byung

thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 543'dug de nas sprul sku rin po ches dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul zhing /sgrub pa'i mchod par 'khor lo bde mchog yi dam du bzung nas de'i rnal 'byor la sgrub pa snyi nga por byed ces zhus pas bla ma dam pa thugs lhag par dgyes/ sprul sku rin po che mdo smad du phyir 'byon rgyur phebs rdzongs rgyas pa stsal/ yab sras gnyis sku skye phreng du mar 'brel ba'i dbang gis phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa lta bu mdzad cing / rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba phebs lam du bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin lhag par dran pas thugs shin tu gdung ste/ mgur dbyangs kyi zhu 'phrin phul ba 'di ltar ro/ /dpal ldan dang po yi mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /ngur smrig dgetsho slong gi tshul gyis rnam rol te/ /zab rgyas legs bshad byi char ba 'bebs mdzad pa/ /rol pa'i rdo rje yi zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /'du shes gsum ldan gyi 'jigs med dbang po bdag /sngon smon mtshams sbyar gyis khyod kyi 'bangs su gyur/ /zab rgyas man ngag gi bdud rtsi ci yang 'thung / /bsam gyin bka' drin rang che'o thugs rje can/ /da dung zab chos kyi bka' drin zhu 'dod kyang / /gnas dus yul dbang giyobaskal 'di yid re mug /zhal dkyil yang yang du mjal bar 'dod na yang / /da lta rgyang ring du song bas yid re skyo/ /rgya chen nam mkha' ltar yangs pa'i mkhyen dgongs dang / /mdo sngags legs bshad kun 'doms pa'i gsung dbyangs dang / /byin rlabs 'od 'bar gyi yid 'phrog gzugs sku de/ /ma brjed dran bzhin du gsol ba 'debs shing thal/ /'dod yon ku mud la rol pa'i zla shel bdag gling bzhi'i rgyal khams de

544 thugs sras skyes chen 'ga' la mab rgyas kyi tshos 'khor bskor tshul/blta zhing myul du 'gro/ /'od stong ldan pa khyod bde bar bzhus/sa shig dang / /mi ring myur mjal gyi smon lam 'debs 'a tshal lo/ /rnam g.yeng chu gter du 'khyams pa'i ngang mo bdag kaphyogs gzhan mtsho rdzing gi ngo mtshar blta ru 'gro/ /pad+mo'i mtsho chen khyod bde bar bzhugs shig dang / /mi ring myur mjal gyi smon lam 'debs 'tshal lo/ /smra brjod dar dir la dga' ba'i bung ba bdag /rang gnasi lhum ra ru bag yangs byed du 'gro/ /pad+ma dkar po khyod bde bar bzhugs shig dang / /mi ring myur mjal gyi smon lam 'debs 'tshal lo/ /rnam g.yeng chos brgyad kyi khol bo 'jigs med bdag /gzhan phan snyad btags kyis rgyal khams myul du 'gro/ /yab rje drin can khyod bde bar bzhugs shig dang / /mi ring myur mjal gyi smon lam 'debs 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong mtsho skyes / kyi ge sar bzhad mi bzhad/ /khri gdugs nyi ma yi rgyag lugs de la rag /gus ldan bka' 'bangs kyi skyid sdug legs nyes kun/ /rje btsun bla ma yi thugs rje nyid rang mkhyen/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /'khor ba ngan song gi 'jigs las sgrol bar mdzod/ /yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi yi char chen 'be+ebs par mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /ma yis bu bzhin du 'bral med skyong bar mdzod/ /chos skyong kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen bar chad kyi 'phrang las sgrol bar mdzod/ /bcu gnyis bdag po de nam mkhar gnas na yang / /'od zer phreng ba yis pad dkar bzhad par byed/ /

zugs sras skyis chon 'ga' la zadzo rgyas bye sa 'khor bskor tshul/ byo45bka' drin gsum ldan khyod rgyang ring bzhugs na yang / /gus ldan bka' 'bangs bdag thugs rjes 'dzin nam snyam/ /cal conya long gtam la dga' ba ma yin kyang / /bla ma'i bka' drin ni yang yang dran gyur te/ /gang shar thol byung du tshig gsum smras pa'i dges/ /bla ma'i zhal dkyil de yang yang mjal bar smon/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas rje bla ma dang rje btsun dam pa sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis nai hor du byon nas gyigong ma chen por mjal 'phrad gnang / mi ring bar po ta la'i rab gnas dang / dge 'dun stong lhag bsdus pa'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad pa la gong ma chen po yang smon lam gyi tshogs la lhan du bzhugs/ mchod yon rnam gnyis bka' bgros kyis gtsug lag khang der gnyug mar gnas nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'chad nyan byed pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde gtsugs par bla ma las sne rnams bsko bzhag mdzad cing /7gong ma'i mdzoji nas nar ma'i 'tsho thebs kyi phog sbyor 'jags gnang /kho bos gsang chos 'ga' zhig zhus pa thugs brel gyi gseng bar rnams su bka' drin du stsal cing / rje btsun dam pa'i yongs 'dzin no min han 'jam dpal rdo rje la yang 'dod chos /'ga' zhig bka' drin bskyangs/thor god kyi rgyal khag 'ga' gong ma chen por mgo 'dogs par 'ongs pa rnams kyis rje bla ma mchog la so sos 'bul nod dang bcas bka' chos zhus pa rnams 'dod pa bzhin stsal te de dag gi yid kyi re ba rdzogs par mdzad do/ /thor god kyi tha'i ji yar 'phel zer bas 7gong ma chen por snyan sgron phul te kho rang gi bu dang chung ma nor rdzas mnga' 'bangs thams cad —

346 zugs sras k+ṣis chon 'ga' la zab rgyas spyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/blos lings kyis bskyur nas/ je bla ma mchog las rab byung dge tshul bsnyen ri rdzogs kyi sdom pa'i bka' drin zhus shing rang yul du mi 'gro bar bla ma dam pa'i sku drung du bcar sdod bgyid pa la/ rje bla ma mchog nas/ yar 'phel gyis blos btang 'di 'dra deng sang gi bla ma tshos kyang yong dka' ba 'dug ces kho la thugs shin tu brtse ba mdzad/ kho bo cag lta bu'i deng sang gi bla gyi go sar bzhugs pa rnams ni/ 'brug pa kun legs kyi gsungs las/ slob ma rnams la chog shes dam chos gsungs/ /bla ma rang ni khab skud tshun chad bsog ces pa'i ngang tshul las ma 'das pa 'dug pas/yar 'phel gyi 'dun ma de bdag cag la co 'dri ba lta bur snang ngo / /de nas rje bla ma pe'i cing du phebs/ lo 'di'i dgun kha slob ma 'ga' zhig la bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid stsal cing / kho bos gsol ba btab pa bzhin rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rnam bzhag gsang chen bcud kyi thig le zhes bya ba yig cha snga ma rnams su ma thon pa'i zab gnad mang po can de ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs nas gsung shog dang bcas kho bo la bskur gnang mdzad pa bka' drin gzhal bya'i yul las 'das so/ /gdod ma nyid nas rnam par dag /spros pa'i mtshan ma kun dang bral/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin can khyod ni/ /dper bya kun las 'das pa ste/ /'akro ba'i ma rig mun sel bas/ /rta bdun can dang mtshungs mod kyang / /de yis tsha gdung skyed byed la/ /khyod kyis zug rngu ma lus 'joms/ /thub bstan ku mud rgyas mdzad phyir/ /'od dkar can dang

zhigluzisras skyesachena'aga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ 54 1 'dra snyam yang / /khyod kyi yon tan cha shas ni/ /nam yang 'grib pa ma dmigs so/ /nyi zla'i rgyu ba 'gog pa yis/ /sgra spu/can nyid dang mtshungs tsam lte / /yong ye gtong bar mi ma dzad phyir/ /kun nas mtshungs pa'ang ma lag sa so/ /sdig pa'i tshang tshi nga bsreg pa la/ /dus mtha'i me dang cha 'dra ste/ /de lta na yang khyod nyid ni/ /thugs rje'i rlan dang 'bral baḥmed/ /dge ba'i lo tog spel ba'i slad/ /char sprin bzang por mtshungs snyam yang / /srid pa'i chu bo skem mdzad phyir/ /de yang /khyod kyi dper ma 'os/ sgyu/sgrib pa'i mkha' glang bskrod pa la/ /rlung gi brtul zhugs 'dzin mod kyang / /de ni yang zhing rgyu ba ste/ /khyod ni dbyings las g.yo ba med/ /skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho'e rga/zhir gyur pas/ 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra sems kyang / /kun bye/ bla na 'phags pa'i phyir/ /'og gzhi nyid dang ji ltar mtshungs/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi dri ma kun/ /'khrud pas dag byed rgyun 'dra yang / /nyon mongs bud shing ma lus pa/ /bsreg 'dis de yang mtshungs pa med/ /dge ba'i me to ga 'dab rgyas slad/ /yongs 'du 'dra zhes brjod 'dod kyang / /mtshan ma'i rlung gis nam du yang / /g.yo ba med phyir de las lhag /dngos grub rin chen kun 'byung bas/ /chu gter nyid du rtog na yang / /sred pa'i rlan dang mi lda na pas/ /gsher ba'i mtshan nyid las 'das so/ /nyi khri chig stong rlung gi srog /gcod pa'i dpa' bo che yin kyang / /dgra zun kun la bu gcig bzhin/ /dgongs phyir de dang ga la mtshungs/ /srid pa'i 'dam du srid pa yi/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma ste/ /'on kyang nyes pa'i mtshan mo

tram̐48 bugs sras skyes na 'ga' la ba rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ yis/ /zum pa'i skyon de khyod la med/ /'akro ba'i mun sel sgron me dang / /mtshungs kyang khyod ni kun rtog gi /rlung gis mi g.yo mar me ni/ /tha mal rlung gis bskyod par byed/ /e ma 'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa ma rnyed pas/ /'gran pa'i zla bral mgon khyod ni/ /rang nyid rang gi dpe ru zad/ /yang na rgyalta rnams khyod kyi sprul pa ste/ /khyod kyang rgyaX ba kun gyi rnam 'phrul yin/ /de phyir rgyaX kun 'dus pa'i gong bu nyid/ /mtshungs bral rgyaX ba khyod kyi dper 'os snyam/ / zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sdo shes ba༈na pa'i sgron me dpyal bsdung swo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brdzed pa dige ldin r+shastarno pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ thugs sras skyes chen dam pa 'ga' la zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor ba sogs kyi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //

—549lkezhu haṃ shu bu/ rgyulka zhazhi brakazha zhagyur ro cog mān dhūzhi skad du busgyun pu srogaspe mādzhad pu thon 'u da zhagazha zhig sde tshan du zhanuska puzhi tshulu/gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs chen po nas rang gi rigs gtogs man —ju 'di sde rgya che zhing chos la dad pa thob pa yang mang na'ang / yi ge dang skad rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing snga ma man ju rang skad du chos bsgyur pa cher med pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa zhig byung na phyi rabs la phan par dgongs te/ rje bla ma mchog la bka' 'gyur rin po che man ju'i skad du bsgyur dgos pa'i bka' phebs/ de nas slob grwa'i mi bzang rnams dang pe'i cing gi bla ma'i khrod nas skad rigs dang yi ge la mkhas pa rnams dang / hwa shang yon tan bzang ba kha shas bcas kyis chos bsgyur pa'i mgo btsugs/ po ti re re tsam bsgyur zin pa dang rje bla ma mchog nas zhus chen gnad ste gyigong ma chen por gzigs rtog 'bul ba dang 7gong nas kyang 'gyur bcos gnang dgos pa 'ga' zhig 'chos pa gnang ste zhib gzigs grub nas bsgyur byang sogs mdzad dgos pa'i dbang gis/ tshang ma bsgyur grub pa la lo mang po zhig gi bar 'gor gzhi byung 'dug gong ma bdag po chen po nyid sa chen po la dbang bsgyur pa'i stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal yin pas srid skyong gi bya ba blos mi 'khyud

550 bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur ba ri 5gas/ rmepa zhig yod rngu gor ma chas/ cing / de dag mdzad bzhin par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal la gzigs rtog gnang ba dang / gzigs pa tsam du ma zad tshig don zhib dpyodadzikyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni tre 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba yin par snang zhing / bstan pa kho na 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa bar dgongs nas do gal chen po de tsam mdzad pa blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams snying nas rjeri shrī su yi rangs pa'i yul du gyur pa nyid do/ /'brug lo'i dbyar dus ri bo rtse lngar bcad rgya mdzad cing rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo tā sa cung zad kyang mi g.yel ba'e ngang nas/rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang phan tshun gsang gsum gyi rol pas dus 'da' ba mdzad cing / ston ka/'i dus 7gong ma chen por ri dwags bshor ba'i sa char mjal 'phrad thog brta/na srid kyi don cha 'gangs che ba 'ga' zhig bka' 'dri sa/nang ba la phral yun thams cad du dge ba'i 'dun rnga/ bzang ba zhu gsol mdzad/ zhi ho ra po ta lar phebs nas slob ma mang po nig la byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi dmar khrid nyin bco lnga'i bar du ba/zab rgyas kyi myorijug tu sems bskyed mchod pa rgyas pa gnang / shar rgyalnga/ mo rong gi khams pa'i sde rgya mi chung tsam la dbang byed pa'i sde dpon kho rang gi 'bangs rnams kyis rab brtan rgyal po zhes 'bod cing / sde rnams dpa' rtsal dang gtum drag che zhing yul phyogs rong shin tu dog cing hrob pa/ chu bo rab med kyis 'khyud pas bgrod shin tu dka' ba/ dge lugs pa ma gtogs pa'i grub mtha' thams cad dar zhing mchod gnaṭashrī sa/ tso bo bon la byed pa zhig yod pa de/ nye 'khor gyi rgya'i sa dpon 'ga' zhig gis za

bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 551'dod kyis snyad gtser la brten nas ngo log pa la/ gong nas dpung 'jug rim pas r+ṣa ri ngo 〉n-i kyang / sa brtsan pa sogs kyis lo re zhig gi bar du ma thub pa la/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid la mngon spyod kyi la sa mdzad dgos pa'i ba7/'a phebs pas/ rje bla ma nyid sgrub gros/sa dang bcas pas zhag kha shas kyi bar du 'dod khams dbang mo'i drag po'i rga/tor chen sgrub pa gnang ste/ 'phen nyin gtor zor rnams sgo'i phyi rirol tu thon nas rdo ring gi ca ra slebs pa nas 'ur sgra tsheg sgra chen po rgyud mar byung zhing /gtor chen brdab pa dang mnyam du me dpung chen po zhig dum bur chad nas dgra phyogs su so nga ba ku/na gyis mthong / de dus g.yul 'gyed pa'i sar me dpur chen po zhig babs pa ā jang jun gyis gong mar zhus pas gtor chen 'phangs pa dang dus tshod 'grig pa byung zhes thos/ skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu 7gong ma chen pos rje bla ma mchog la dgun gyi dus 'dir rgyu'i bul kan gyi bzhugs stan dang na bza' wa nag gi pags pa'i tā hu sos/sa gnang skyes 'ga' zhik+to/ stsal/ de nas lo 'ga'i bar du gong ma'i bkas yang yang gtor ma 'phen pa gnang dgos byung bas 'tshub cha yang che tsam byung zhing /lan gcig gtor zor 'phen pa gnang bas de nyin kho rang tshos snga mo nas gsol mchod byed pa'e ri shin tu mtho ba zhig ོ/da pa de'i rtse rmar bon po mang po 'tshos/sa nas rten dang mchod gtor bshams te bom/ ci sa/sa kyi cho ga zhig sa/tong gi yod pa la/ de dang ha cang mi ring ba'i sa cha zhig na rgya'i dmag mi mang po yod pa'i sgar chen zhig 'dug pa'i thad lto/ra sprin nag po 'jis/sa su rung ba 'khrigs pa las 'brug grags shing glog 'khyug pa mthong

552 bka' migyuraman ju'i skadadu bsgyurapasogs/ —da wad wanas/ bon po rnam/sa kyi bsam pa la kho rang tsho'i nus pas rta sgar gyi steng du thog ser drag po zhig 'bab pa 'dra snyam du yod pa la/ sko bur du gnam sa g.yo ba tsam gyi rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig gis kho rang tsho'i rten mchod bshams pa rnams phyogs phyorga/sa su khyer te ba/tor/ phan tshun sa/cig gis gcig mi mthong ba'i tshod kyi mun pa 'thib cing ser ba drag po dang rlung shugs chen pos bon po rnams sdod ma tshugs par ri sul brag skyibs ci rigs su bros shing 'jigs zil gyis shin tu skrag cing dngangs pasacici bya gtol med lta bur gyur/ de dag gi khrod kyi mo ma rno shos rnams kyis mo btab par lha mo khros pa'i gdug rtsub shin tu che bas kho rang tsho pham pa zhig babs pas thams cad sems khong du chud pa byung 'dug rje bla ma mchog gi mnal lam du ong nyod dpon mo gzungs skyid 'khor g.yog dmag mi mang po dang bcas rje nyid kyi sku drung du 'ongs ma/sa phyag dbang zhus shing 'dug pa la/ dpon mo gar 'gro rgyu yin gsungs par tsha /lo ngo log pa rnams dang g.yul 'gyed du 'gro ba yin zer/ rje'i thusas dgongs la dpon mo zhig dmag la 'gro ba ma thos pas da tshores gyigong nas bkas mngags pa yin nam snyam pa zhig thugs rmis la byung / de nas mi ring bar rgyal cho/ rong gi sde rnams g.yul pham ste btsan rdzong thams cad shor bas dpon blon mi dra gas than sa cad rgya lag tu chud cing yul khams thams cad stong cham gyis song 'dug dmag gi sa char mthu rtags byung ba rnams gyigong ma chen pos blon po mang po tshopo /sa pa'i dbus su bka' gnang ste/ dgra sde cham la phab pa 'di nged rang gi stobs shurwasri tsam gyis r+ṣa/ yin/ sangs

paka'e 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 353rgyas kyi bstan pa la gus mchod lhur len bgyis pas bstan srung rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrubru pa'i mthu yin zhes phebs 'dug os lod jun gar 'di ge sar dmag gi rgyal po zhes grags pa de yin pas dgra thabs la mkhas shing / o ru su/ ha sag ho thon sogs yul khams gzhan rnams kyis zon byed pa'i gnas yin la/ rgya yul dang sa thag shin tu ring zhing chu chen pos chod pa sogs kyis mnga' zhabs su bsdu dka' ba dang / rgyal mo rong 'di sa cha shin tu brtsan pas sngon gyi dus su hor dang rgya'i rgyal po 'ga' zhig gis dmag drangs kyang len ma thub pa zhig yin pa la/ phyogs gnyis ka 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i mnga' zhabs su bsdug pa dang / de mtshungs lho phyogs su dpung 'jug mdzad pa'i yul de 'ga' zhig gis sman tse'i yul dang / la las 'jang gi yul yin 'dra zer bas/ gang yin ma nges kyang rgya gar dang 'dab 'brel ba grub thob rdzu 'phrul can yang mang du yod pa'i rgyal khams chen po zhig yin 'dug cing / sa thag shin tu ring zhing lam bar du dug can gyi ri dang dug mtsho du mas chod pa dang / ri stong rnams kla klo mi bsrun pa mang pos gang bas yul gzhan gyi mis bgrod dka' ba'i yul zhig yin skad 'dug pa yang / gong ma chen por 'dud par gyur pas phan tshun 'khrug long med par bde 'jags su gyur pa 'di rnams/ gong ma chen po nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med par ma zad/ drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor yang stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa chen po yin pas na/ sku tshe snga ma rnams su rlabs po che'i bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags pa'i lag rjes las bzod

dzubye4 theka'i 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ —par dka' ba'i snyegazi brjid nyi ma stong gi 'od zer ltar 'bar zhing / mthu stobs nus pa gnam lcags thog chen dang mtshungs pas gzhan sde de dag sba bkong ste rang dbang med par gus 'dud lhur len par gyur pa yin mod kyang / gtso bor sngar gong ma rang gis bka' phebs pa ltar/ rje btsun bla ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos bstan srung khyad par can las la bskul te rbad pa'i mthu la brten pa lo rgyus 'di dag gis shes so/ /gzhan phyogs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du/ dgra bo nyam chung re re tsam la lo zla mang por mthu gtad kyi las la 'bad pas mthar rtags cung zad re thon pa la sngags 'changathothu stobs kyi dbang phyug tu sgrogs pa la ltos na/ gtor zor lan re tsam 'phangs pas sde rgya che zhing stobs dang ldan pa la mngon spyod ska rtags dngos su thon pa 'di la ba ni nges par sdong mo /shā ri ri rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bla ma rwa chen po dang mtshungs par snang / rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus rtse brgya'i mtshon/ /ngur smrig bla gos phag nas 'phangs pa yis/ /bdud sde rmeg med 'joms pa'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ /mi bsrun 'gro la lhag par brtse ba 'di/ /bstan las phyir phyogs lta log bon la dad/ /yun du gson na 'gro mang sdig la sbyor/ /g.yul 'khrug las kyis 'gro ba'i bde 'joms pa'i/ /'i/nga bcu'i dgra la snying rjes khros pa las/ /ji ltar sman pa mkhas pas gtar sreg sogs/ /rtsub mo'icodapyad kyis nad pa rjes 'dzin bzhin/ /zhi bas 'dul bar mi spyod de dag ni/ /mngon spyod las kyis gdul byar nyer dgongs nas/ /mu thong ba'i mod la bgrang yas khro bo'i tshogs/ /rdobs cig 'a ga cha r+sā la

berka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 55bye ltung 'gyur zhing / /'jigs rung gshin rje de yang snying 'dar ba/ /dpal chen dus dgra'i dbang po'i skur bzhengs te/ /rar gi gsang yu ma rdo rje ro langs ma/ /rab 'jigs srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /dmag deng zor gyi las la rab dgyes pas/ /rkyang ser dre'u zhon nas rgyug pa de/ /rma sa'i ri spungs ran+ta'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ /stong gsum khyon 'gengs dam rdzas gtor mas brngan/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyan pos rgyud bskul nas/ /dgra sde'i g.yul ngo 'joms la nyer rbad pas/ /sa bdag dpung gi sprin nag 'khrugs klong nas/ /srid gsum bdag mo'i 'phrin las drag po'i thog char du phabs pas dgra sde'i yul khams bcas/ /skad cig yud la rjes shul med par brlag /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa bzhu blugs su/ /khol ba'i mthu stobs rdo rje'i tsha tshe 'bum/ /'bar 'khrugs bskal b.ri me yis bdud sde kun/ /thal bar rlog pa'i brtul zhugs 'di re 'jigs/ /de nas lo kha shas kyi nam thar zhib cha ma thos kyang rags rim tsam ni/skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs ga ma log nas 'brug tshang ba chos grags dar rgyas bya ba'i dge bshes bzang ba zhig rje bla mar mjal du phebs pas/ khong las brgyad stong sogs sher phyogs kyi mdo rnams dang / skyes rabs so bzhi pa/ rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs sogs kyi klag lung gsan pa mdzad/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo zhes bya ba bod du ma 'gyur ba zhig rgya'i bka' 'gyur khrod na yod pa 7gong ma chen pos rje bla ma mchog la bod skad du bsgyur dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa

byibyi6 paka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ bzhin/ bla ma mchog nas ljags zhus ngos lo ts+tsha ba rnams kyis bsgyur te gong mar gzigs rtog phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes/ 'phags pa'i gnas brten chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan bal bod mtshams skyid grong gi gnas dben par bzhugs skabs rje bla ma nyid la don mthun gyi bsngags pa brjod pa'i zhu 'phrin rim par byung ba ga gsung lan tshigs su bcad pa'i chab shog snga phyi gnyis 'bul ba gnang zhing / 'phrin yig gi lam nas phyag chen dang sngags kyi dka' gnas kyi dwogs gcod gsum tsam gyi dri ba gnang ba la/ rin po che ye shes rgyal mtshan nas dris lan du zab don snang ba zhes bya ba zhig brtsams nas phul 'dug pa/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs ha cang tshim pa ma byung ba 'dra/ dris lan de—phyis su khong gi gsung 'bum khrod du yod 'dug pa kho bos kyang blo gros chung ngus bltas pas/ dngos gzhi legs bshad phul du byung ba yin pa gzhir bcas kyang / lam rim dang rim lnga gsal spron rnams su rgyas par gsungs shing thams cad la rlung ltar grags pa'i bshad pa skabs su ma babs pa mang po zhig bkod nas dri ba dngos gzhi la lan ha cang mi rgyas pa dang / rje bla ma mchog nas dri ba so so la'ang dwogs pa shin tu phra ba mang po re 'god pa gnang ba rnams kyi dri tshig dang lan gnyis ka ma thon pa zhig byung snang ngo / /me pho sprel gyi lo rje bla ma dgung lo drug cur phebs rgyu'i dga' ston gyi sngon bsu lta bur/ lug lo'i mjug tu gyi'ajam dbyangs gong ma chen po rje bla ma'i gzim chung du phebs nas/ zhabs pad yun ring brtan par bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel rwa/zang po'i bka' phebs dang bcas tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan bzhugs khang dang

bka' 'gyur man ju'i skud du bsgyur pa sogs/ 551bcas pa/ tshe mdo spu/ser bris/ gu gu shel las grub pa'i mchod rten/mchod rdzaṭa/ kyi skor 'ga' zhig g.yu'i phyag phring rgyan ldan shel gyi me dam che ba dgu/ dngul rta rmig ma dgu/ gos chen dgu/ bzhugs stan rgyab yol sogs kyi gnang skyes gya nom pa dang / rgya'i lugs kyi khrang zhi'i zer ba'i zlos gar gyi gzigs mo bcas bka' drinacistsal/ sprel lo gsar tshes nas dga' ston dngos gzhi tshugs pas/ tshes gsum nas brgyad kyi bar du pho brang phyi nang gi dgon pa gang yod/ ri bo rtse lnga/ mtsho bdun/ ca/khar sngon sogs tsho chen zhe dgu/ hal ha/ os lod bcas sog yul gyi dgon sde che chung du ma'i bla ma dang 'dus spyi/ bod nas rgyal ba yab sras kyi bang chen/ mdo smad/ chab mdo/ brag g.yab sogs khams phyogs kyi dgon pa dang / bla 5/ che chung mang po'i mi sna/ pho brang dang sog yul gyi sbyin bdag dpon po che phra blon 'bangs ci rigs sogs mdor na phyogs tha dad nas ched gnyer gyis 'dus pa'i ser skya dregs zhan rang rang gi dad pas kun nas bslangs te dga' ston gyi mchod pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs 'bul myo/khan grangs las 'das pa byung snang / tshes brgyad kyi nyin bstan pa'i gas la byed smin grol no min han dang / sku tsha ra kho sprul sku sogs phyag g.yog pa che phra thun mong nas rje bla ma 'dus tshogs kyi mgon du spyan drangs te/ 'a/thor lo bde mchog dkar po'i cho ga'i sgo nas zhebs brtan rgyas pa phul 'i/nga / smin grol no min han sprul sku nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gso la 'debs kyi zhu 'bul mdzad pas/ rje bla ma thugs dgyes pa chen pos zhal bzhes kyi bka' lan gnang / dngos 'bul gyi rim pa yang smin

558 bka' 'gyur man jurme skad du bsgyur pa tso/ges/grol sprulnga pa'i skus dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can/gsang bde dgyes gsum / sgrol ma/ bde mchog dkar po/ tshe dpag med rnams khri rgyab yol bzhugs khang shel sgo can/ gser bris brgyad stong pa/ byang chub mchod rten/ tshe bum rin po che'i phra rgyan can/ ka bā la dngul gyi nang sha dang kha khebs stegs bcas/ khyung skyugs kyi phyag phreng gser gyi grangs 'dzin dang byi ru'i mig 'byed yod pa/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ na bza' cha tshang / gos btags grub kyi bzhugs stan rgyab yol/ /mdzod gos mang krong 'dres ma yug dgu /bzang spos chun po bco brgyad/ rnga rta dgu re/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang lnga bcu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dar snas brgyan pa rnams phul/ ra kho hu thog thus dngul ma/r+ṇa lha rdzas/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos yug dgu/ dngul rta rmig ma gsum// mtshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che blo bzang dar rgyas kyis/ dngul maṇa mjod btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/dngul srang stong phrag gcig ja sag bla rme dge legs nam mkhas/ tshe bum kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing la dngul gyi me tog drug cu re gcig re re'i steng du tshe dpag med re bzhugs pa'i khyad mtshar can/ glegs bam gasrer bris lnga/ rnam rgyal mchod rten khru bzhi pa/ gser srang bcu gcigadangul srang lnga ngacu/ mgron gnyer dem chi bstan pas/ tshe lha gsum gyi sku brnyan khru gangasneb bzhugs khri rgyab yol can/ dngul sra nga stong phrag sa/cigamagron gnyer rgya ma tshos/ tshe lha gsum gyi sku brnyan/ gser bris glegs bam/ dngul srang stong / em chi tā bla ma blo bzang rnam rgyal/ nang tsu/

2rka' 'gyur man ju'iskadadubasgyurapa tshugs/ —༄—sdo9wa gnyer pa blo bzang / dem chi dar rgyas/ gnyer pa ngag dbang ri+o/ cherte+o//mgron gnyer ye shes/ skal bzang / u cu mu chin zhabs drung / su la bla ma gsum/ gnyer pa bsam 'grub dang chos ldan rnams kyis mtshon phyag g.yog pa thun mong nas/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs stan sku snyel/gser dngul gos dar sogs dngos 'byor rgya che ba phul/ tshes dgu'i nyinazumatsho bdun dgon gyi tham ka bla ma pi lig thu no min han gtso ba'i/ dgon pa gnyis kyi bla ma las sne spyi pa bcas nas/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul srang chig stong dang / bla ma sogs rang rang gis sger 'bul/ mdo smad dgon lung spyi nas rgyud pa bla ma ngag dbang bsam 'grub ched mngags kyis dngul srang lnga brgya/ kho bos mi sna mar tshang nang so blo bzang bsod nams ched mngags kyis dngul srang sum brgya/ chu bzang sprul skus dngul srang lnga brgya/ na bza' cha tshang / gzhan yang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul sku rin po che sogs mdo smad kyi bla chen/ chos sde/ sbyin bdag rnams kyis 'byor 'khos kyi 'bul ba rnams phul nas zhabs brtan gyi gsol ba btab/tshes bcu 'khrungs skar dngos gzhi'i nyin/ shar rtse mkhan po co ne no min han/ phu yin bla ma dpal 'byor hu thog thu/ ja sag bla ma bzhi/ pho brang phyi nang gi dgon pa so so'i tā bla ma/ il ge bla ma/ su rka bla ma/ dem chi dge bskos rnams dang / yung he gung grwa mang bcas/ gyiri duno rtsu sbyar te rje bla ma tshogs dbur spyan drangs/ khrus gsol yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba sogs ma do lugs dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'irīthog so sos dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba rgya chen po btegs te zhabs brtan rgyas par phul/ bcu

d+ngha—— tram̐tsho — ba ka—྅tram̐gau ra man 'i skang khor pa sogs /kaci tha/ gi nyin sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i wang / pe'i le/ pe'i ze/ gung / nga sag tha'i ji/ tha bu nang sogs dpon po che chung du mas spyi bsdus kyi dngos 'bul rgya che ba phul zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab/ har chin wang rat+na sidzhais sger du cho ga dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs thog rten 'brel gyi dngos chas mang po dang / dngul srang dgu bacho bcas phul/ wang 'di nyid thugs rgyud dad pa'i nor gyis lhag par phyug pa zhi——/ yin 'dug pas/ rje bla ma mchog la snga phyir 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa lan grangs du mar phul 'dug cing / des mtshon nas skabs 'di dang gzhan du tsho chen zhe dgu/ hal ha/ cha har/ or/ du su/ os lod sogs kyi dad ldan sbyin bdag mang pos rang rang gi 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i dngoṭa/ 'byor gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba rnams sa bon ma mthong bas zhib tu ma bkod do/ /de dag gi snga phyir po brang nang gi 7gong ma chen po'i sku nye'i wang chen po rnams kyis gtso ba'i/ wang / pe'i le/ pe'i ze/ gung / he'u/ po/ e phu/am pan sogs mi drags du mas rgya'i lugs kyi rten 'brel gyi rdzas zhu'u yir grags pa cho/ra bu don yod lcags kyu rin po che sogs rgyu bzang po las byas pa/ gzhan yang rin po che'i spyad pa bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar can gyi rigs sogs zang zing gi bdog pa'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba 'bul mkhan grangs kyis mi lang ba lta bu byung / gong gsal de rnams la bla ma mchog nas kyang so so'i go babs dang bstun pa'i gnang cha dang ston mo sogs kyi gsol ras rgya cher stsol bar mdzad do/ /

bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 561srid pa'i phun tshogs chu bo ji snyed kun/ /gcig tu 'khyil ba'i dga' ston zla ba'e ma/ /dge ma tshan dbang gi rgyal po'i mngal sbrum pa'i/ /ngo mtshar blta la rgyu skar rnams kyang lhags/ /de tshe chu geter rnam bzhi'i 'og pag can/ /kun bzod sgeg 'chang ma yi bzhin ras la/ /bka' lung 'od kyi thig le rang dbang du/ /'god pa'i mi rje bcu gnyis bdag po yi/ /rnyog bral dad pa'i 'o mtsho 'phyur ba'i rlabs/ /shis brjod bstod bsngags tshig gi dbyangs sgrog cing / /skyes bzang zegs ma mu tig char ba bzhin/ /'grem pas mgon khyod thugs la dgyes pa bskrun/ /gzhan yang mig 'phrul lta bu'i zlos gar dang / /glu dang rgyud mang 'dres pa'i rol mo yis/ /'chi med gnas kyi ngo mtshar rdzogs byas te/ /'jig rten mya ngan med pa'i dus ston ngom/ /mtha' dang dbus kyi yul gru tha dad nas/ /dad pas 'dus pa'i skarīl ldan mang po yis/ /bdog pa'i me tog snatshogs 'thor bzhin du/ /gsol 'debs rol mo cir yang sgrog la brtson/ /dge legs dus ston sbrang chang gis/ /mchog dman skye bo bung ba kun/ /sim pa'i tshor bas cher myos te/ /kun dga'i glu dbyangs dar dir sgrogs/ /dga' ston zol gyis 'brel ba thogs pa yi/ /'gro ba mang zhig thar pa'i ba gam du/ /'dzegs pa'i bsod nams them skas 'dzugs pa la/ /sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul 'di e ma mtshar /skabs 'di 'dra tsam du gong myo/'i dpung shugs kyis rgyal mo rong ba'i mi bsrun pa rnams tshar bcad nas sa cha mi sde mtha' dag mnga' zhabs su brtswas pas/ yul de na snga ma grub mtha' gzhan phyogs kyi dngo/na sde re

562 bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/gnyis las dge lugs pa stobs chen med cing / bon shin tu dar+ha bar yod pa la/ gong ma chen pos deng phyin chad nas bon lugs byas mi chog pa'i bka' lung dril bsgrags shing / yul gyi lte bar g.yung drung lha sdings zer ba'i bon gyi sde dgon yod pa gtor nas lha khang sogs rang babs su bzhag pa la/ dge 'dun mang po bsdus te zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa'i chos sde chen po dga' ldan gling bya ba btsugs/ der 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon du bla ma bzang ba zhi ga gtong rgyu rje bla mar bka' phebs pa bzhin paṇ+ḍi ta mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer gtong ba gnang zhing / kho ba la phyogs de'i bsta na 'gror gang pham/ byed lugs kyi bslab— bya rgyas par gnang / de dus gong nas rje bla ma mchoka la bon lugs kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul rnams zhib tu bka' 'dri gnang bar/ gshen bon/ brdol bon/ bsgyur bon so so'i lo rgyus rnams dang / bon gyi ston pa gshen rab rgya'i lo'u kyun bya ba yin pas/ bon dang rgya'i do'u si gnyis khungs gcig tshul sogs zhib tu zhu ba mdzad/ de las 'phros te bod na grub mtha' mi 'dra ba ci tsam yod pa dang / de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin min dang / dge ldan pa grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags tshul ji 'dra yin rnams bka' 'dri phebs par/ bla ma mchog nas/ bod du grub mtha' rigs mi gcig pa mang po yod na'ang / dar rgyas che ba dge lugs pa/ sa skya pa/ bka' brgyud pa/ rnying ma ba bzhi dang / de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin par mchungs na'ang lta sgom spyod pa rang rang gi 'asdod tshul mi 'dra ba cung zad re yod tshul dang / grub mtha' gzhan dag kyang rang

bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 563rang gi tho0/ ma'i srol 'byed mkhan rnams kyis rgya gar paṇa grub la gtugs4 nas gzhung bshad man ngag dri ma med pa sha stag dar bar mdzad pa yin na'ang / phyis su rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig gis gsung sgros sogs ma zin par lta ba'i bzhed tshul sogs la nor 'khrul gyi bslad cung zad zhugs ba sko'aga' zhig yod tshul dang / rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag la brten nas/ bod kyis ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi dri mas sbags pa mtha' dag bsal nas/ mdo sngags lta sgom spyod pa gang la'ang 'khrul ba phra mo tsam yang med pa ri bo dgeskeldan pa'i bstan pa'i srole phye zhing / rje'i gsur rab rnams su bod snga rabs pa sus kyang ma thon pa'i legs bshad zab cing rgya che ba du mas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin par bkral nas yod tshul rnams zhib tu zhu ba dhe mdzad pas/ swong ma chen pos sngar nas dge lugs pa la thugs mogothun mong ma yin pa yod pa'i steng du 'di res rje bla ma mchog nas phyogs zhen tsam ma yin pa'i gnas tshul drang po snyan du gsol ba la brten nas/gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyis dge ldan ring lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i nges/ pa brtan po rnyed par gyur te/ mi ring bar dbus gtsang mdo khams sog yul thams cad rtsadage ldan pa'i che —brjod dang bcas de'i lugs srol gtso bor byed dgos tshul gyi gser gyi bka' lung kyang bsgrags par mdzad do/ /gnad ci yang mi shes nga ra ri bong cal 'gro/gas kyi jes su zhugs pa'i deng sang gi dge lugs pa'i bstan 'jin du khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig la gong mas bka' 'dri de lta bu gnang

— 564 bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ ba yin na/ dge lugs pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad chos log yin pas de thams cad ro med mdzad na legs tshul gyi zhu ba u tshugs zhig byed tshod du 'dug kyad / rje bla ma dam pa 'di nyid ni byang chub lam gyi rim par gsungs pa bzhin bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du gzigs/ de la brten nas gsung rab ma lus pa gdams ngag tu shar/ de'i mthus rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed nas/ nyesri sbyod chen po chos spong ba'i las la nam yang mi 'jug pa'i dbang gis/ grub mtha' rang rang gi gnas lugs babs rgyun drang por zhu ba las chags sdang phyogs zhen gyi rdzun zhu ma mdzad par brten/ gzhan phyogs pa rnams kyang sngar rgyun rang babs saganas thub pa 'di byung bas/ dge lugs pa gcig pur ma zad ris su lochad pa'i chos lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gis mgon 'di'i bka' drin gyi —phung po gzhal dka' bar snang ngo / /ji ltar rdza mkhan rnams kyis 'jim pa'i snod/ /ci dga'i dbyibayosu 'chos bzhin gangs can 'dir/ /mkhas blun du mas rang rango 'dod rgyal du/ /bcos pa'i chos lugs tshong 'dus zong ltar mang / /mkhas pas lung rigs srang la bcal ba na/ /phal cher snying po'i lcid dang mi ldan la/ /'ga' zhig gser chu byugs pa'i ra gan bzhin/ /rdzun gyi rang mdog ston pa'ang yod ces grags/ /de lta na yang tshul 'di chos rnams la/ /chos mig rdul bral thob pa'i spyod yul las/ /long bas glang chen gzugs la rtog pa bzhin/ /phal bas kha tshon gcod pa'i gnas ma yin/ /bdag ni mgon po 'di yi bka' drin las/ /'jam dpal

da da wad bka'a'agyur man ju'i skad du bsgyulda ba sogs/ 5tshadabyangs dngoṭa rgyal ba tsong ba/ pa'i/ /bshad sgrub zung 'brel bka' brgyud ma/ gtogs pa/ /grub mtha' gzhan la yid smon shwe/ra ma gyur/ /'on kyang chos spong nyes pa gsungs thos pas/ /deng dus sa/nad 'gag ci yang ma rtogs par/ /chags sdang dbang gis chos dang gang zag gzhan/ /smod pa'i mkhas rlom rjes su ga la 'brang / /bdag gi 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'dis/ /dag snang spyan gyis grub mtha' gzhan dag gi /legs cha'i ri mo ji snyed gzigs pa kun/ /rang gi lugs la bogs 'byin gdams pa ra shar/ /de phyir kla klo bon dang jo nang ba'i/ /gsor mi rung gi lta ngan ma gtogs pa/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin yongs la ris med du/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad/ /de lta bas na bdag gi bla ma 'di'i/ /rnam par thar pa'i cha shas 'di tsam yang / /chags sdang bstan pa'i bya bar rlom pa yi/ /bstan 'dzin gzugs brnyan dag gis bskrun du med/ /gang gi zhabs sen nor bu ni/ /ris med bstan 'dzin gtsug rgyan te/ /'phrin las gdugs dkar grib bsil kyang / /skye rgu'i gdung ba sel ba'i mchog /thor god nas yong ba'i dbu mdzad bla ma ye shes chos 'phel gyis zhus ngor/ lam rim gyi khrid dang grub chen dril bu zhabs lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dbang bskyed rdzos/sa kyi khrid dang bcas pa stsal/ dbyar dus ri bo rtse lngar phebs nas bcad rgya yun ring tsam gnang / sku mtshams grol nas nye gnas ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' dang / u cu mu chin smon rams pa bstan 'dzin grags pa'i sku skye dkon mchog bkra shis gnyis la rje bla ma'i legs bshad thun/ mong ma yin

byo66 bka'azhe'agyur man ju'i skad du baḥr pa sogs/pa dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel sbas don kun sa/sal gye steng nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad phyogs mthun gyi rgyud rnachasku sa gung bsgrigs/ pa'i gzab bshad nyin bco lnga'i bar dang / rje blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas bde ma chog dril bu lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzob/sa/ dmar khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa nyin gsum gyi ring gnang / de dag gi skabs su rgyud mchod snga phyi gnyis tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dang /phyi ma'i ska bas su 'grel dbang bskur ba sogs dam pa bar ma chad pa'i phya ga len bzhin rgyas pa mdzad/ zhal nas/ nged kyis rgyud bshad 'di khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi drung du mnos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du ba/zhan la 'chad rgyu ma byung ba da res khyed tsho la mthar phyin pa bshad pa yin zhes thupa/sa / dgyes pa'i gsung phebs 'dug bla ma mchog nas bde mchog gi gyad kyi bshad pa sku tshe 'dir lan gcig pu 'di las ma gnang 'dug pas/ zhu ba po 'di gnyis ni thugs la btags pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma mchog tu gyur pa yin par snang / bshad pa rdzogre/sa pa'i mjug tu bka' drin sa/tang rag gi yo na du ja sag bla mas rgyu sbyar te tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa dang / dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba'ang gya nom pa phul/ snga phyir tshogs 'khor gyi thebs 'bul mkhan mang du byung zhing / der tshogs pa thams cad kyang dam tshig gtsang ba'i slob ma sha stag yin pa bcas/ nyin bzhin dpon slob rnamyo/sa tshogs kyi dga' ston la tshim pa drug ldan du longs spyo da cing / rdo rje'i glu gar gyis dus 'da' bas au ṭi ya na'i gnas la co 'dri ba lta bur gyur/gsu/nga chos sa/zhan yang mang tsam zhig gnang 'dus/ kyang zhib tu ma nges/ de
