boka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ lha61 rdzo ltar yun ring po'i bar du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis ci las dang skal bar ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma rnams tshim par mdzad pa'i mjug tu/ slob ma thun mong nas dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba rgya cher bteg ste zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par thugs dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / lo re bzhin ri bo rtse lngar sku mtshams gnang ba'i mjus/ tu gtor rgyag re mdzad kyin yod pa bzhin/ 'di res chos rgyal gyi gtor zor 'phen pa gnang zhing / de skabs lo dus dang mi 'dra bar rus rgyan sos/sa gsol zhing / sku'i gzi brjid dang gsung gi gdangs sos/nu/ shun tu 'jigs rngams che bas phyag g.yog pa tham sa cad kyang 'jigs zhum zhum byed pa zhig byung zhes thos/ me bya lo rgyal yum hwang tha'i hu gnam la gshegs pas/ gong ma'i bkas rje bla ma gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs kyi 'don pa zhag bdun gyi bar du gsungs/ rje bla ma dgung lo re gcig la phebs pa'i dgung keg lta bus bsnyun gzhi lci tsam bzhes pa'i tshul bstan par/ gong ma chen pos am pan sogs btang nas bsnyun 'dri yang yang mdzad cing / rgya'i sman pa mkhas pa zhig kyang gtong bgyiganang / zhabs phyi pa rnams nas lha khang so so'i dge 'dun pa rnams la mang 'gyed sogs btang thog zhabs brtan rim gro rgya cher bsgrubs pas/ mi ring bar sku khams mi bde ba lhag med du dwangs par gyur/ de dus bod du de mo hu thog thu zhi bar gshegs pas/ gong ma chen pos khong gi tshab tu bod kyi las don byed mkhan gyi bla ma zhig gtong dgos 'dug pas su btang na legs zhes bka' phebs

56skye bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad rdu bsgyur pa sogs /par/ bla ma mchog nas smin grol sprul pa'i sku btang na zhus pa gong ma'i dgongs par ma son pas/ rje bla ma rang nyid sku na smin na'ang 7gong ma'i sku don yin gshis song chog ces zhus par/ bka' las bod sa thag ring ba dang lo yang mang tsam 'gor 'gro bas hu thog thu nyid gtong mi phod/shar rtse mkhan po no min han btang chog pa 'dra zhes phebs par bla ma mchog nas de kas 'thus tshul zhus/ de nas rgyal yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa dang bod kyi las don byed pa thun mong du co ne no min han ngag dbang tshul khrims gtong ba gnang / khong la bod kyi bstan srid las don sgrub tshul gyi bslab bya rgyas pa gnang zhing dad rten du phyag phreng zhig da nga rdzongs pa 'i gnang skyes gya nom pa stsal/ lo 'di dang phyi ma gnyis rnarma sa su dbyar gyi ring ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs nas/ ji skad du chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog 'jis/sa med dbang pos rje bla ma mchog la phul ba'i chab shog tu/ thos bsam sgom pa'i gru gzings la brten mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son bzhin du/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhing mchog grub pa'i gonas su rnal 'byor zab mor gzhol ba'i dka' thub 'dis ci bya/ /'on kyang rgya chen gzhung lus/nu/ mang du thos par rlom yang 'du 'dzi'i phreng ba stug pos non gyur te/ /de don sgrub pa'i skabs bral snyoms las khol bo bdag cag kun la co 'dri byed pa ma yin nam/ /zhes dang / zab mo'i rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol ba dang / /skabs 'gar legs bshad phreng ba spel ba dang / /gzhan tshe zab rgyas chos kyi char 'bebs pa/ /'di sa/sum phan tshun 'gran bzhin bzhugs lags som/ /

bka' 'artser man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ 569stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyis yal bor ba'i/ /dmu rgod gdul dka'i 'gro rnamar+sha/ sgrol ba'i phyir/ /sna tshogs khams dang dbang po dang 'tsham pa'i/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa ston bzhin bzhugs lags grang / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las g.yo ba med pa'i ngang nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba la sman yon du che ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che bsam las 'das pa zhig mdzad pa gor ma chag na'ang zhib tu ma nges pas 'bri bar ma sprobs so/ /mkhas grub stong gi rnam dpyod 'od zer gyis/ /ma phyed rgyud don ba ku la'i me tog /gang gi zhal lung lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang / /btab pa'i mod la tshig don 'dab brgya grol/ /mkha' 'gro'i brda' yi rlabs 'khrigs rtsa rgyud mtshor/ /sbas pa'i zab rgyas gsang don ma ṇi ka /bshad rgyud don yod 'phrul zhags kyis bkug ste/ /thar 'dod dbul ba bsal 'di shin tu rmad/ /rgyal bka' 'gyur ro tsog gi mu snyi ka /man ju zhes grags rgya nag shar phyogs pa'i/ /skad kyi srad bur bstar ba'i do shal phreng / /mi yi bdag po'i dgongs bzhed rgyan tu bskrun/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i 'phrin las nyin byed dbang / /chos srid mkha' la 'dren pa'i kha lo bar/ /shar rtse'i khri la ngal bso'i khyung sngon skyes/ /dge legs snang ba'i lam yangs 'cha' bar mngags/ /sems can khams la phan pa ro gcig pa'i/ /rnam thar bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng phyogs kun tu/ /'phyur 'di bde chen mi rtog snying rje'i mtsho/ /lhag par 'phel bha'i lang tsho ngom par zad/ /'di na bde sdug sgro mdangs sna tshogs pa/ / ma nges

570 bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs/ cir yang ston pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /srid pa rma bya'i bslu brid gzigs mo la/ /rtag tu yengs pa'i bla chen mang rme chis kyang / /'brel ba thogs tshad zag pa med pa'i chos/ /snying po bde bar gshegs pa'i 'bras ba sto 1la/ /za ba'i longs spyod ster ba'i dpag bsam shing / /khyod mtshungs srid pa gsum na yod re skan/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye sheg bsnan pa3 sgron sdo dpal bsdung ༷'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brdzid pa darge ldarno bstani pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog man ju'i skad du bsgyur pa sogs mdzad pa thor bu ba 'ga' zhig sde tshan du bgyis pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //

— ——571 nazhu nyer gartsag pu/ nachod ldon gud zhadrelka gyi thugs buskyed smron lkamā nu nathus puṇa chen jinas cad nakhyen pu tha/ger nyu rgyalka khabu tu gdan drangs te rdogs ldan gaskan zhazhi dga' ston spelka dan mān-id puzhi tshulu/dzom bod du phebs skabs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/slar nged rang pe'i cing du yong rgyu yin pas de dus nyid la bka' chos 'ga' zhig kyang zhu dgos zhes phebs pa la/ rje bla ma mchog nas lo gang gi nang du 4bas rgyu yin zhus par yong rgyu yin kyang da lta dus la ma babs zhes phyis 'byung gi lung bstan gnang ba'i dus la slebs pas/ 7 gong ma rngen po'i gdan 'dren bzhed dang paṇa chen mchog nas phebs bzhed pa'i bar gyi mtshams sbyor rje bla ma mchog nas mdzad de/ bdag po chen po dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi skabs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal khab chen por phebs rgyur phan tshun gnyis ka nas thugs thag bcad/ de nas gong ma chen pos nai hor du poṇa sten rin po che phebs nas bzhugs gnas kyi ched bkra shis lhun po la dpe blangs pa'i bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim khang gser gdung lha khang gnyis mchod khang grwa gshag dang bcas pa rten gsum mchod rdzas kyis byur bur gtams pa'i ngo mtshar can dang / pe'i cingo du lha khang ser po nub mar bzhugs

572 mchod yon zung gi bugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/ gnas kyi khang pa shin tu rgya che ba gsar bskrun mdzad/ phag gi lo gser gyi bka' lung gis paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bod nas chibari na bskyod mdzad skabs rje blam mchog nas zhu 'phrin gyi gsung shog bcas phebs bsur phyag g.yog pa kha shas mtsho sngon gyi bar du gtong ba gnang / me paṇa chen rin po che mdo smad sku 'bum gyi chos sde chen por dgun bzhugs mdzad cing / lcags pho byi ba'i lo mdo smad nas phyag bteg sog yul brgyud nas rim gyis phebs skabs rje bla ma gong ma'i bka' bzhin phebs bsur mtsho bdun gyi dgon par phebs/ der paṇa chen rin po che phebs sgugs kyis zhag mang tsam bzhugs ring la phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i ser skya dregs zhan mang por mjal kha phyag dbang dang 'dod chos thor bu bka' drin stsal/ paṇa chen rin po cher sku'i 'tshams zhur ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' ched mngags mdzod pa/ cha har gyi sa'i cha u su thur mjal bas/ paṇa chen rin po che thugs shin tu dgyes pas tshur yang 'tshams zhu 'bul bar/ mgron gnyer dang gsol dpon gangs can mkhan po snga phyir gtong ba gnang / mtsho bdun nas rim gyis chibs bskyod mdzad nas shan du zhes par bzhugs zhag kha shas gnang ba'i nub gcig mnal lam du sog gur zhig gi nang du rje bla ma nyid dang sku drung na har chin smon lam bla ma bcas bzhugs 'dug pa'i gzim gur gyi phyi rol tu mi mang pos bskor ba byed pa'i khrod du gdangs snyan pos yig drug 'don mkhan zhig 'dug pa la khyod su yin zhes 'dri ba gnang bar nged rang ma chos rje yin no zer/ rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs la grub chen na kha pa rje bla ma'i yum gyi sne ba yin pas

metshod yam̐n zung sgo budas bskyid cis baṇa jin gdan drangs tshul sogs1 byi73ma chos rjer grags pas kho grub chen de nyid yin rgyu red dgongs nas khyed ga nas 'dir byon pa yin gsungs pa la/ nged rang ri bo po ta la nas 'ongs so zer/ khyed rang rje rin po che'i yum gyi skye ba yin pa la sku gshegs rjes rje bla ma'i drung du mi 'byone par po ta lar phebs pa ci yin gsungs pa la/khong gis de ltar yin kyang nged rang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang 'brel che bas po ta lar skyes pa yin zer/ 'o na po ta lar 'phags pa'i drung du skye ba la rgyu tshogs ci lta bu sgrub na myur zhes dris pa la/ tshem bu dmar khrid kyi sgo nas rigs drug gnas 'dren gyi dmigs pa dang bcas ma ṇi dung phyur gcig bton na po ta lar skyes nas 'phags pa'i zhal mjal bar the tshom med do zhes zer ba la smon lam bla ma dad nas tshem bu dmar khrid cig phral du gnang dgos tshul zhu bar rje bla ma nyid nas dmar khrid cha tshang zhig gsungs pa thugs rmis su gsal bar byung / phyi nyin dge ba'i bshes gnyen har chin smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas sku drung du byung ba la mnal lam gyi lo rgyus gsungs pas/ khong dad pa chen po 'khrungs te de ma thag rje bla ma'i drung nas tshem sum̐ dmar khrid gsan cing de nas bzung yig drug la 'bad pas sa ya bdun tsam song skabs nub gcig rmi lam du po ta la nas ma chos rjes btang ba yin zer ba'i grwa pa zhig gis gding ba zhig gtad nas 'di ma chos rjes khyed la bskur ba yin mi ring bar po ta lar shog ces 'phrin bskur byung zer ba la/ nged kyis ma ṇi dung phyur ma thon pas thon tshar nas yong chog pa zhu byas par dung phyur thon mi yong zer nas song ba rmis/ mi ring bar khong ba sku gshegs pas rje bla ma'i mnal

582 mchod yon zung gi bugs bskyed kyis paṇa rmyen gdan drangs tshul sogs /gyi zlos gar rtsed mo gzigs par paṇa chen mchog phebs pa rnams su rje bla ma nyid kyang lhan du phebs pa mdzad/ nyer drug gi nyin paṇa chen rin po che po ta lar gnas gzigs la phebs—skabs/ rje bla ma mchog kyang der byon nas tshogs pa la paṇa chen rin po ches dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung stsal pa'ang gsan pa gnang / nyer dgu'i nyin tā phu zi'i dgu gtor la gong ma chen po dang paṇa chen rin po che lhan rgyas thog rje bla ma mchog nas rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de drug cu pa'i zor 'phen pa gnang / tshes gsum gyi nyin pyegong nas paṇa chen mchog la rgya skad du po'u pa'i zhes pa nor bu po'i tham ka gnang skabs/ rje bla ma nyid byon nas paṇa chen mchog gi tham ka bzhes skabs lhan bzhugs mdzad cing pa yar gyi kha btags 'bul ba gnang / tshes drug gi nyin bkra shis lhun por smon lam tshogs pa'i mgon du ma chod yon gnyis dang rje bla ma mchog phebs nas/ paṇa chen rin po ches bde smon bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs shing shis borjod mdzad/ dgon sde bkra shis lhun po 'di khar mdo sngags kyi cho ga phyag len sogs gtsang gi bkra shis lhun po nang ltar 'dzugs rgyur/ paṇa chen rin po che'i grwa khrod nas bla ma bzang ba zhig dang byang 'dren dge bskos sogs dgos tshul/ rje bla ma mchog la gong nas bka' phebs pa bzhin paṇa sten rin po cher snyan 'bul mdzad de bla ma sogs bsko bzhag gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bdun la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen po dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i bkra shis khri sdog khri rdzag gi pa yar chen po dang bsnan zhabs brtan 'bul rgyur/ je bla

mchod yon zung gi bugs bskyed kyis paṇa 3na gdan drangs tshul sogs/ 583ma mchog kyang paṇa chen rin po che dang lhan du gyigong ma'i bzhugs gnas su byon/ snga phyir paṇa chen mchog gyigong mar mjal phrad skabs thams cad du rje bla ma nyid lhan du phebs pa gnang zhing / de dag gi skabs gyigong ma'i bkas paṇa chen rin po che gzim khang nang ma'i bar du 'do li la bzhugs nas dang / rje bla ma gzim chung phyi ma'i 'gag bar du phebs byams la bzhugs nas 'byon chog pa'i bdag rkyen bla na med pa stsal/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nas gyi'ajam dbyangs rtso/nga ma chen po'i rgyal srid kyi/ mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sku che ba'i bsngags brjod las brtsams te gsung bshad 'byams klas pa'i sgo nas zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig phul ba dang / gong ma chen pos bka' lan zab cing rgya che ba nor bu'i do shal bzhin lhug par stsal pa rnams/ rje bla ma mchog nayomachod yon so so la bsgyur nas snyan du 'bul ba gnang / tshes brgyad kyi nyin po ta lar smon lam gyi tshogs dbur mchod yon gdan 'dzom par rje bla ma mchog kyang phebs/ tshes bcu gsum gyi 'khrungs skar dngos gzhi'i nyin/rje bla mas gong ma chen por rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba phul 'dug na'ang zhib cha ma nges shing / paṇa chen mchog dang lhan du 7gong ma chen por mjal phrad dang / pho brang nang mar tshe chog sogs zhabs brtan zhal 'don gyi rim pa gnang / tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin 7gong nas paṇa chen rin po cher bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang gsan bzhes mdzad skabs gsung bshad dang cho ga'i dmigs rim rnams rje bla ma mchog nas sog skad du bsgyur te gong chu'i snyan du 'bul ba gnang / de nas paṇa

584 mchod yon zung gi bugs bskyed kyis paṇa gin gdan drangs tshul sogs/chen mchog rgyal khab chen po pe'i cingadu chibs bsgyur nye ba na/ rje bla ma zhag shas kyi sngon la pe'i cing du phyag phebs nas paṇa chen rin po che'i phebs bsur mgron gnyer bstan pa dem chi gtong ba gnang / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin paṇa chen mchog pho brang chen po'i nye 'dabs shi ra su mer phebs pa la rje bla ma mchog nas mjal 'dzoms thog chos srid kyi gsung gleng rgyas pa gnang / tshes gsum gyi nyin paṇa chen mchog dang rje bla ma man ju'i lha khang du phebs par/ gong nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par stso la rgyu'i 'ja' sa gser yig gi 'char gzhi lha sras drug pa brgyud nas paṇa chen mchog la spyan star zhu rgyu gnang ba/ rje bla ma mchog nas bod skad kyis bkrol te paṇa chen rin po cher snyan 'bul mdzad/de nas yo mi yan gyi skyed tshal lha'i yul gyi ya mtshan thams cad ma tshang ba med pa der paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gzigs mor phebs pas rje bla ma mchog kyang lhan du byon/ rje bla ma mchog nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par/ rgyal po chen po 'di sngon gyi thugs bskyed gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis bstan pa bstan 'dzin spyi dang / lhag par rje nyid la mi 'phrog pa'i dang ba dang ldan pa'i rtags su skyed mo'i tshal gyi phyi nang kun tu spyan drangs te shis brjod dang byin rlabs zhu ba gnang ba ma gtogs/ skyed tshal nang mar gzhan ma blon po rnams kyang yong mi chog /'di la dpags na mchod yon rnam gnyis sngon dus zhig nas thugs bskyed kyi 'brel ba zab mo yod pa da lam mngon du gyur pa ngo mtshar che tshul sogs zhu ba mdzad/skyed tshal nas tshur phebs pa'i lam du hwa shang gi dgon pa jo zheng zi bya bar

mi5da yon zung gi bugs ba:da kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/ tram̐8byiphebs pas/ dgon de'i khri zur tā hwa shang mdo sde la shin du mkhas pa zhig yod pa la/ paṇa chen mchog nas lta ba dang 'dul ba'i skor sogs mdo phyogs kyi dka' gnad mang po'i bka' 'dri gnang ba dang / hwa shang gis de dag la lan thogasashaṃ med du zhus pa rnams rje bla ma mchog nas lots+tsha mdzad pas/ paṇa chen shin tu dgyes nas hwa shang la bsngags brjod mdzad/de ga'i rgyu mtshan rje bla ma dang lha sras drug pas 7gong ma'i snyan du gsol bas/ gong ma thugs dgyes pas hwa shang de la chan zhi zhes bsam gtan slob dpon gyi cho lo bka' drin stsal/ de nas paṇa chen rin po che bzhugs gnas su phebs par rje bla ma mchog nas zur gsos kyi bsnyen bkur rgya che ba 'bul ba mdzad/ tshes dgu'i nyin shar ka'i skyed tshal du paṇa chen mchog dang gong ma mjal 'dzom mdzad rgyu'i phyag phyir rje bla ma mchog kyang phebs/ bcu gnyis nas nyin kha shas kyi bar paṇa chen mchog pho brang chen po'i nang gi 7gong ma'i bzhugs gnas rnams dang tsan+dan jo bo'i lha khang sogs lha khang mang po rnams su phebs pa dang / de nas wan shu'u shan du mtsho chen po la gru chen ngo mtshar can la bzhugs nas phebs pa dang / shang shan gyi lha khang rnams su phebs pa bcas la rje bla ma mchog kyang lhan du phebs nas/ lha khang rnams kyi lo rgyus dang skyed tshal gyi ya mtshan pa'i bkod pa rnams snyan du gsol ba gnang zhing / lta ba'i skor gyi dri ba 'ga' zhig zhus par 7paṇa chen mchog nas lan mtha' chod pa stsal pas rje bla ma mchog gi thugs tshim pa byung snang / nyer gcig gi nyin lha khang ser por paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa las gcod kyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs/

5skye6 masnad yam̐n thung gi bugs bskyed spyos baṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/rlung dza bir ma'i lung khrid bcas gsan pa mdzad/ dus mtshams ma nges kyang skabs shig rje bla ma mchog nas paṇa chen rin po cher spyan snga chos drug gi lung gsan pa'i dbu tshugs 'dug kyang 'phro can du lus pa rten 'brel gyi gnad cig yod par sems/ de nas 'char can gyi chab tshan 'phrod bzhes la phebs nas nyer dgu'i nyin phyir phebs te paṇa chen mchog la mjal 'dzoms mdzad/ bcu pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin po'u he'i ten bya ba rgyal po na rim gyis khri 'don gnang ba'i pho brang du/ gong ma chen po dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i ston mo chen po la rje bla ma mchog kyang phebs/ gong ma'i bkas paṇa chen mchog pho brang 'di'i them skas gsum pa'i bar dang / rje bla ma them skas gnyis pa'i bar du 'do li lo bzhugs nas phebs/ po'u he'i ten 'di rgyal po na rim khri 'don ma dzad pa'i pho brang yin pas/ gnam 'og gi mi dregs zhan su yang 'do li la 'dug pa lta zhog bka'i gnang ba med par ra skor du 'jug pa yang mi rung ba la/ /'di res bla ma dam pa rnam gnyis la sngar dpe med pa'i dmigs bsal 'di 'dra gnang ba/ gong ma chen po bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la gus pa lhur bzhes pa'i rang rtags bzo med du bstan pa nyid do/ /paṇa chen bzhugs gnas su phebs nas rje bla ma mchog la sku brnyan snam spos sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dngos po'i bdog pa dang / phyag g.yog pa rnams la'ang go babs dang bstun pa 'i gnang cha rgya che ba stsal/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin tsan+dan jo bo'i mdun du gong ma chen po dang paṇa chen rin po che rje bla ma bcas lhan rgyas ngos spyan 'dren khrus gsol sogs rgyas pa mdzad

mtshod yon zung gi buṅges bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/ 5skye1cing / de mtshungs nyer gnyis la yung he gung du smon lam rgyas pa mdzad/nyer drug gi nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje bla ma rang gi bzhugs gnas zung ṭā zir gdan drangs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rje rga/nang dang / gdugs dkar/ byams pa'i dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ —sgrol ma/rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs bcas kyi ljags lung zhu ba mdzad/ lha rdzas nang mdzod/ dngul dkar las grub pa'i zhing khams rgya ma tsho'i bkod pa dang tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can/ sku gsung thugs rten/ lha sna tshogs kyi sku thang bris legs bdun/ gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe bum kha rgyan gyi dbus rnam rgyal ma'i sku brnyan la tshe lhas bsko ra ba/ dngul srang nyis brgya/mdzod gos yug chen lnga sogs 'bul ba mdzad cing / phyag mdzod gsol dpon sogs zhabs 'brang ba rnams la'ang dngul dang gos dar gyi gsol ras rgya che stsol ba gnang / byams chen chos rje'i gzim chung sogs lha khang khag dang / rje bla ma'i mchod khang steng shod mgon khang rnams su zhabs kyis bcags te mchod 'bul thugs smon shis brjod sogs mdzad/ paṇa chen mchog nas rje bla mar lha rdzas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi snang brnyan/na bza' cha tshang / dri bzang chun po drug cu/ snam bub nyi shu'i skor/gzhan yang seng ge'i pags pa sogs dngos po khyad mtshar 'ga' zhig dang / phyag g.yog pa rnams la'ang go babs dang bstun pa'i sa/nang skyes stsal/ paṇa chen rin po che nas rje bla ma mchog la ni gu chos drug gi zab khrid gsan pa mdzad cing zung ṭā zir zhag gcig bzhugs/ phyi nyin rje bla ma mchog nas kha btags dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal/ g.yang ṭi las grub

byoskyeskye mtshud h+phan zung gi bugs bskyid 'is paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul soges/ pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi snang brnyan sogs dngos 'bul rgya che ba 'bul ba gnang / paṇa chen mchog nas rgya gar gyi ral gri dang me mda' sogs gnang byung ba dgos pa khyad par can la dgongs par mngon/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mi rje chen por bka' chos 'bul bar pho brang yang shu'u gung du paṇa chen mchog dang rje bla ma lhan cige par phyag phebs/ gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen por myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gzab bshad dang bcas phul ba/ rje bla ma mchog nas sog skad du bsgyur te zhu bar mdzad/ gong nas chos yon rgya cher gzab cing / paṇa chen mchog nas kyang lha rdzas/ mgon chos lha mo gsum gyi snang brnyan/ rgya gar gyi me mda' gnyis/ ral gri bcas 'bul ba mdzad/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos gong ma mchod yon la dngos skyes sna tshogs rim par bstar ba gnang ba'i mjug tu/ mtshon cha'i rigs 'bul bar mdzad pa 'di/ dus phyis kla klo gor+ṣas bkra shis lhun po sorges la log sgrub byas pa la/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa '-ijam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i dpung gis dgra sde de dag tshar gcod par mdzad pa 'di dang / de tsam du ma zad ma 'ongs pami na shasnya lar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can du sku'i skye ba bzhes skabs/ rje bla ma lcang skya sdo rje 'chang mchod yon kyang sku'i rnam pa ci rigs pas lhan cig tu 'dzoms nas/ yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gis kla klo'i sde thams cad bcom ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar yang nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyis 'byung gi dgos pa khyad par can la dgongs pa gdon mi za

mchod yon zung gi thugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/ 589ste/ phyis su 'brug gi lo kho bos rje bla mar mjal skabs lo rgyus 'di rnams gsungs nas paṇa chen mchog gis gong mar 'bul nod rim phul gyi mjug rang du mtshon cha sna tshogs phul ba dang / nged la yang de ltar gnang byung ba khyed rang gis bsams na dgos pa ci yin pa 'dug ces phebs par/ ma 'ongs pa na kla klo 'joms pa'i rten 'brel bshad ma thag pa ltar zhus nas phran bu'i bsam tshod la de 'dra 'dug ces zhus pas/ rje bla ma zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas de 'dra zhig gi rten 'brel la dgongs pa yin las che/ nyin gcig paṇa chen rin po ches nga la drag po 'khor lo can gyi dmag dpon ga nyis las gcig rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yin cing /gcig khyed rang yin pas kla klo dang g.yul sprad dgos rgyu yin 'dug ces gsung zhing bzhad mo gnang byung / de'i lan du nged kyis rtsed mo'i tshul gyis ngas ni rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa khyed rnam gnyis la gsol ba 'debs kyin yod pas/ rab tu na mkha' spyod bde ba can dga' ldan mngon dag 'a lta bu'i zhing zhig tu 'khrid pa mdzod/ gal te de ltar ma byung na 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba ci yang med par dbe+en pa'i gnas su sgrub pa snying por byed pa zhig tu skye ba'i thugs rje gzigs/ da res kyi tshe 'di la gong ma'i srid skyong dang 'brel ba'i bya bzhag sna tshogs 'dis gting nas yid sun yod pa la/ slar yang shasnya la'i 'thab rtsod 'khrug long gi mgo khyer byed mkhan zhig tu mi bsko rogs thugs rje gzigs zhes zhus pas 7paṇa chen kyang bzhad mo mdzad byung zhes gsungs so/ / tsho — — ne hūṃ— rwa —— — — ———

590 mchod yon zung gi thugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/bden don bcu gnyis rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /de nyid bcu phrug mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /zung 'jug dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo'i/ /mkha' khyab gsang chen rdo rje'i rol gar las/ /kai la shas mdzeṭa/ dpal ldan shasnya la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa rgya che'i gnas/ /rdo rje'i dbyings zab pho brang ka lnga par/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan byon dang 'byon 'gyur mang / /de las dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /rtsa rgyud sdud mdzad 'jam dbyangs grags pa ni/ /'di na bloX badz+wang dpaXl ldan sngi shes te/ /ma 'ongs drag po 'khor lo can du grags/ /de yis kla klo'i mun sprul drungs phyung ste/ /chos kyi sgron ma lo grangs du ma'i bar/ /spar bas 'akro la yang dag ye shes lam/ /snang bar byed ces rgyal ba'i lung du bstan/ /de phyir mgon 'di 'brel thogs mchog dman 'gro/ /grangs las 'das pa dus der smin grol gyi/ /dga' ston mgron du 'gugs par bya ba'i ched/ /shar phyogs yul gru chen po rnams su byon/ /gnam sdo/'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma che/ /'gro mgon rigs kyi cod pan bcas pa la/ /phyag rtags rdo rje'i ru mtshon nyer gtad nas/ /kla kle 'joms pa'i dpung gi rogs su sbran/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa shar phyogs rgyal khab cher/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol gyis nyer byon nas/ /mu stegs 'joms pa'i sta gon mdzad do zhes/ /kla klo'i grong khyer thams cad ngud mos gang / /de yis chu srin rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i sde/ //'dar bas me tog cod pan sar lhung zhing / /rdo rje shugs sogs dkar phyogs srung ma rnams/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i ba dan 'a/du byed do/ /de ltar

mi5da tshon zung gi thugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul soges/ 59’rigs ldan bcu gnyis bdag po yis/ /'dzam gling khyon la dge legs sbyin pa na/ /bdag kyang cha bsags nor bu'i rwa ba ru/ /smon pa'i pad+ma dus der kha 'byed shog /paṇa chen rin po ches gong ma chen por rjes gnang phul grub nas bzhugs gnas su phebs skabs zhal nas/ da ni byed rgyu thams cad tshar ba yin gshis blo yang shin tu bde zhes pa'i bka' bzhad mo cung zad dang bcas phebs byung bar/ rje bla ma mchog gis skyabs mgon mchog nas de lta bu'i bka' gtan nas ma phebs pa zhig dgos/ mdzad pa phyag las rnams bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig yin pas 'khor ba ma stong gi bar la rdzogs pa'i mtha' yod rtswags med/ rgyal khab 'dir gong ma chen po'i bzhed pa rnams bskangs te/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su zhabs sor bkod nas kyang bstan 'gro'i don dpag tu med pa zhig gnang rgyu yod mod/ da lta'i bka' de lta bu sku rtsed kyi tshul du'ang gtan nas mi gnang ba mkhyen ces zhu ba mdzad/ bka' las/ rje lcang skya rin po che dbus khyed rnam pas gang gsungs pa de ltar yang nges par red de/ nged nas zhu rgyur/7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bzhed pa skong rgyu'i las don rtsa ba che rigs rnams tshar ba la bsams nas da res sku rtsed kyi tshul du zhus pa las/gzhan ma da lta ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin 'grub pa'i smon 'aṭa/na gsol 'debs gang drags zhu zhes phebs/ paṇa chen thams ca na k+ka khyen pa lha khang ser po'i bzhugs gnas su phebs nas sku ltems pa'i tshul bzhes pas/ rje bla ma mchog spya na drangs phyag g.yog rnams nas phyag rtsa la gzigs dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin gzigs nas/ phyag rtsa zhus pas de tsam ci shes rje

392 mtshad lon zung gi bugs bskyid kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogaso/rang gi thugs bskyed rang gtso che bas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i dpal du zhabs pad yun ring brtan dgos tshul gyi gsol ba nan tan 'debs pa gnang / phyi nyin 7gong ma chen po phebs nas gzigs rtog mdzad cing /rje bla ma mchog la sku drung du bcar bzhugs gnang dgos pa'i bka' phebs/7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad zin pa'i dbang gis nyin bzhin sku khams je lod du phebs/ skabs shig rje bla ma mchog nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i bka' bsgo 'bul dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin bka' bsgo'ang 'bul ba mdzad/ nyin gtsog zhal nas/pha dam pa rgya gar phebs 'dug pas/ sa du rbad 'dren pa mdzod gsungs nas/ rje bla ma dang ja sag nam mkha' bcas la sngags de 'dren 'jug pa gnang / snyun gzhi'i rgyu rkyen sogs gsang ba'i bka' lung ca/nga tsam phebs 'dug pa rnams rje bla ma'i zhal nas kho bos dngos su thos na'ang yi ger 'god mi rung bas ma bris so/ /de nas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig gi nyi rgas tsam na srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon gcig pu de nyid gzugs sku'i bkod pa rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ de dus phyag g.yog pa nang ma thams cad mya ngan gyis brgyal te sku drung na 'khod pa su yang med pas/ rje bla ma mchog la ja sag bla ma nam mkhas phyag g.yog zhus te/ sku gdung rin po cher phral du dgos pa'i sri zhu rnams mdzad cing / thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rim pa dang / sprul sku myur phebs kyi gsol 'debarme bcas rgyas pa gnang ste/ phyag mdzod dang gsol dponu sogs sku mdun nang ma rnams la sems

mchod yon zung gi bugs bskyed kyis paṇa chon gdan drangs tshul sogaX/ 593gso ba'i zhal ta'ang bka' drin stsal/ khong tshos zhus pa bzhin mchog sprul rin po che myur phebs kyi 'dod gsol dang / thugs dam brtag par babs pa'i rim gro sgrub rgyu rnams kyi bka' gsal bcas stsol ba mdzad/ phyag mdzod nas skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mchog sprul myur phebs kyi ched du rje bla mar gser sku bzhi/ thang ka bcu gcig rje'i gsung 'bum cha tshang / gser srang nyi shu/ dngul bre chen brgyad sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ bla ma mchog nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mi ring bar phebs pa'i ched du zhag bcu lhag gi bar sku mtshams dam po'i sgo nas yi dam srung ma'i bsnyen sgrub dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi tshogs mchod mang du mdzad/ sku mtshams grol nas bco lnga'i nyin rje bla ma mchog sku gdung gi drung du phebs nas bla mchod sogs gsung ba gnang zhing / gdung 'bul du dngul srang brgya'i maṇ+ḍal/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags rdzas cha tshang re/ dngul gyi mchod rkong gcig dngul gyi ting phor brgyad/ dngul gyi spos gzhong gcig dngul rdo tshad sum cu/ mdzod gos rgyan bzhis gtso ba'i gos chen tshos kha sna tshogs yug brgya/ man yug bcu/ mdzod btags che ba lnga bcu/ chung ba brgya/ rta sga 'khor cha tshang rigacig yang rta gcig mchod thebs su dngul srang sum cu/ spos ring spam stong phrag gcig chog grwa pa brgya lnga bcu nga bdun la dngul srang re/kha btags re/ — phyag mdzod gsol dpon sogs phyag phyi che chung thams

594 mchod yon zung gi thugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/cad la dngos skyes kyi gnang sbyin stsal/ lcags glang hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser gdung rin po che bod du spyan 'dren pa'i phebs skyel la ching ha'i phu bar du byon nas/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu snying por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la kha btags dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal bcas phul te yang srid myur phebs kyi thugs rje bskul ba gnang nas phyir phebs so paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas rang gi gsang ba'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig rje nyid kyi thugs sras lo chen sprul sku la gsungs pa de nyid kyis gsol 'debs su bsgrigs pa las/ 'gyur med rdo rje gdan du paṇ+ḍi ta/ /sangs rgyas 'byung gnas gtsug lag khang sbyong tshe/ /sa spyod sangs rgyas phyogs kyis mchod cing bkur/ /dus 'dir slar yang mngon mdzad gso la ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yul dbus rdo rje gdan du paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas 'byung gnas bya bar sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i dus su mi rje gong ma bdag po 'di nyid chos rgyal sangs rgyas phyogs zhes bya bar gyur nas paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid mchod gnas mdzad pas mtshon/ mchod yon rnam gnyis sku tshe du mar 'brel ba'i dbang gis da lta'i dus su gnam skyong gong ma chen pos paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkur sti chen pos gser gyi rgyal khab tu spyan drangs te/ zhal mjal tsam nyid nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste dpe srol bsam brjod las 'das pa'i bkur sti phu dud mdzad pa la brten nas dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa gzi brjid nyi ma ltar 'bar bar gyur pa dang / nub gangs

mtshod yon zung gi thugs bskyed kyis paṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/ 595 —can gyi ljongs nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram la thug gi bar gyi srog chags bye ba khrag khrig du ma sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang mtshungs pa'i skal ba bzang por longs spyod rgyu byung ba 'di thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma thar gtugs na rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i byed las las byung ba kho na yin pa gzu bo'i blos zhib tu brtags na shes par snang bas bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmadwa du byung ba'i spyod tshul la blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i ni da pa bsgom par byos shig / rgya gar pan+t+ra chen sangs rgyas 'byung gnas zhabs/ /gangs can paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes te/ /'phags yul chos rgyalda sangs rgyas phyoṅges 0de yang / /dbang phyogs rdos swol 'jam dbyangarme gong mar gyur/ /sdon tshe mchod yon zung du 'brel ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba cher mdzad cing / /ma 'ongs mtha' 'khob gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'i/ /thugs bskyed smon lam btab pa dus 'dir smin/ /ji ltar mkha' la nyi zla zung 'brel nyid/ /yang yang shar bas dus tshigs gsal byed ltar/ /sa la mchod yon zung du 'brel ba yis/ /yang ya nga thub bstan gas/la bar byed 'di mtshar/ /ma kha'i kla klo gdul la thugs brel bas/ /gzhan gyis lo mang 'grub dka'i bstan 'gro'i don/ /thung ngu'i yun la myur bar rdzogs mdzad nas/ /mgon po chos kyi dbyings su mnal tshul bstan/ /'on kyang 'di ni sgyu ma'i tshul tsam las/ /nges— pa'i don du 'chi 'pho mi mnga' ste/ /gang gi rang bzhin don dam chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur

596 mtshod yon zung gi thugs bskyid kyis ṇa chen gdan drangs tshul sogs/med g.yung drung snying po nyid phyir ro/ /gang zhig 'byung bya gar byed pa'i/ /mtshan mo'i mun pa zad pa na/ /skya rengs dkar pos mdun bdar nas/ /nyin byed 'char ba su yis khegs/ /de bzhin 'di na dpal yon la/ /sdang ba'i 'gal byed dang bral te/ /dkar po'i mthun rkyen bdo ba na/ /mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor slar yang ngom/ /bdag gi mgon 'di'i mtha' lkas mdzad 'phrin rta ljang gis/ /phan bde'i snang ba mtha' lkas 'gyedz+wa pa'o 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mi rje'i bsod nams mthanya ༷tsu mkharno la nyer drangs nas/ /phyogs kun dge mtshan mthaX' yas gled kyis bkang 'di rmad/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye sheg bstan —pa3 sgron bhe dpal bzang sdo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjed rmi dge n+derno bsta na pa'i mardzos rgyarno larmi/ mchod yon zung 'brel gyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gser gyi rgyal khab tu gdan drangs te rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston spel bar mdzad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //

— — rī /mi/shā//lha/rluzhu nyer gahaṃsu pu/ gnan braskos smuzhi ne+e sko zhadamā dbyidarga god na chen pos glu mā dmā pu dgung glu budun cun nabuska puzhi dgazha ston gyi gnad skyeska rgya chen cizha bu srogs gyi tshuzha/ lcags mo glang gi lo pho brang chen po'i nub kyi phyogs nyin lam kha shas kyi sa cha zhig na sngon gyi dus hwa shang gi grub thob cig gis bzhengs pa'i ṭing ting phu zer ba'i lha khang chen po'i nang du spyan ras gzigs phyag stong can gyi sku brnyan shin tu che ba byin rlabs can zhig yod pa/ gong ma chen pos nyams gsos mdzad par rje bla ma mchog dang gong ma chen po bcas byon nas gnas der zhag shas rkebazhugs shing / gong ma'i bkas rje bla ma mchog nas lha khang sku brnyan dang bcas pa snyerab tu gnas pa mdzad/ yul 'di byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi bzhugs gnas su grags skeng mtha' skor du 'obs rim pa bdun dang shing tā la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun sogs kyang cha 'dra zhig ston rgyu yod 'dug ces zhal nas dngos su thos/ skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu hwa shang zhig gis rgya'i lugs kyi byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i sku brnyan zhig phul ba la thugs gtsigs che ba mdzad cing dbu sngas su morgyun du mchod pa gnang / phyis su kho bos mjal skabs sku 'dra de ched du ston pa gnang nas rtag tu ngu'i sku brnyan 'di rgyun du mchod na sher phyin gyi

bye18 gong mas bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur rlubs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ don la blo gros rgyas par 'gyur zhes dngos su gsungs/ chos 'phags kyi bzhugs gnas su phebs pa dang de nas bzung rtag tu ngu'i sku brnyan mchod par mdzad pa 'di dag la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa chen po zhig yod par nges so/ /ṭing ting phu nas mchod yon lhan du ri bo rtse lngar chibs bskyod gnang / phu sa ting bi gtsug lag khang du smon lam gyi tshogs dbur rje bla ma dang g.yon phyogs su gong ma chen po bzhugs nas zhal 'don gyi rim pa dang bla ma mchog nas bsdo smon rgyas pa gnang / 'don pa'i mjug tu rje bla ma dpon g.yog kha shas kyis gong ma'i mdun du bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsungs shing / me tog 'thor ba dang kha btags re 'bul ba'i lugs srol yod pas de bzhin mdzad skabs/ gong ma chen pos hu thog thu nga'i khri khar lhan du bzhugs na bde mo 'ong ba 'dug gsungs nas rje bla ma'i phyag nas bsnams te bzhugs khri gcig la lhan bzhugs gnang ba sogs spyan bskyangs kyi bkur gzos bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ nyin gcig gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen po rje bla ma'i bzhugs gnas kun tu bde ba'i tshal du phebs/ dgyes pa'i bka' mang du phebs shing bla ma dam pa'i phyag nas bsnams te khyed nga'i bla ma yin gsungs dad gus kyi rnam pa mngon mtshan can gnang / bla ma mchog nas gsol ja zhunu/ shing sku brnyan dang bzang spos sogs kyi 'bul ba phran bu phul ba dgyes pas bzhes/ nyid kyi gzim khang 'di cung zad gu dog 'dug pas rgya bskyed pa mdzod gsungs nas dngul srang khri phrag gcig gi gnang sbyin dang / gzim khang gi g.yas su sa cha'i dpon po rnams kyis 7gong ma chen por gzim khang zhig bzos

gong mas blomadamapadagungalobadunatram̐—rabaibasapar dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 599yod pa de yang rje bla mar gtan 'jags su stsol ba mdzad/ de nas gong ma chen po pe'i cing du 'byon pa la phebs skyel sogs sngar lugs bzhin gnang / gong mas gnang ba'i dngul de las sum stong tsam ri bo rtse lnga'i grwa pa dang hwa shang gi dgon pa thams cad la gnang / sku tsha ra kho hu thog thu sogs la 'jigs byed rim gnyis kyi bka' khrid smin rgyas gnang zhing re zhig sku mtshams mdzad/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i sprul sku bod kyi gtsang phyogs su 'khrungs pa 'di lo do lon nong brgyud nas nai hor du gong ma chen por 'tshams zhu byed rgyur/gong nas rje bla ma do lon nor du phebs nas sprul pa'i sku rab byung mdzad dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ mtsho bdun lha khang du phebs nas re zhig bzhugs/ rje btsun dam pa'i sprul pa'i sku phebs pa la/ ra kho hu thog thu dang ja sag bla ma sogs chibs bsur gtong ba gnang / thog mar sprul pa'i sku rje bla ma'i gzim khang du phebs nas mjal 'dzoms mdzad par gsol ston rgyas pa bstar/ de nas rje bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i bzhugs sgar du phebs ma/sa sku gsung thugs rten gser dngul gos chen sogs kyi 'bul ba dang bcas sku tshe brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa sogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung bshad rgyas pa stsal/ mi ring bar sprul pa'i sku la bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims stsal/ gzhan yang bsgrub bya mang po zhig la bsnyen rdzogs/ dge tshul/ rab byung / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ci rigs 'bogs pa mdzad/ de nas rje bla ma dang rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku lhan cig par nai ho'u la phebs nas 7gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mjal

6khye0 5nga mas bla ma dam pa dgude bla bdun cur phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/'phrad mdzad/ bla ma mchog dang sprul pa'i sku tshogs dbur bzhugs nas gong ma'i zhabs brtan gyi tshe chog sogs gsung ba gnang zhing / gong nas gsol ras gnang sbyin sogs sngar rgyun bzhin stsal/ de nas rje bla ma pe'i cing du phebs/ ra kho hu thog thu/ ja sag bla ma sogs phyag g.yog nang ma rnams dang / dpon mo gzungs skyid/ har chin wang rat+na sirnyi sogs lnga bcu skor la/ bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang smin rgyas dang / mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer/ stag lung lha rams pa blo gros bsod nams sogs nyung ngu zhig la zhi khro sprags sgrub rdo rje tshig spram gyi khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang don gnyer ba 'ga' zhig la skyabs khrid/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / bde mchog dkar po/rdor sems yab yum/ 'jam dpal nag po/ gdugs dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang bka' drin stsal/ chu stag nas bzung shing sbrul bar gyi rnam thar zhib cha ma nges kyang rags pa tsam thos pa las/ bka' chos gnang ba'i skor ni/ smin grol no min han/ zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis/ ra kho hu thog thu/ ja sag nam mkha' sogs slob ma nyis brgya skor la/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis sogs nyung 'dus zhig la gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ har chin smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas/mchod rten dkar po'i zhabs drung dge legs rgyal mtshan/ pā rin e phu bde legs bzang po sogs la mi tra lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub

gong mas bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun curīr phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 601kyi dbang / ho'u chid chos rje karma 'byor ldan gyis zhus pa bzhin/ mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer/ zhabs drung dge rgyan/ e phu bde legs sogs mi bcu skor zhig la gsang bdag 'khor chen gyi dbang / zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis kyis gsol ba btab nas khong dang / rje nyid kyi phyag g.yog nang ma kha shas bcas la grub dbang nā ro pa nas sgra bsgyur mar pa yab sras la brgyud pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i smin lam yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang / zhabs drung dkon bkras la sger du/ 'bar lugs tshe khrid/phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po'i rdzogs rim gyi gegs sel drag po gsum 'dul ba'i man ngag zhal shes kyi khrid sogs gdams pa 'ga' zhig gnang / ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs/ u rad dus 'khor zhabs drung gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin khong dang mkhar sdon phyogs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig ri bo rtse lnga'i ja sag bla ma/ zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis/ ja sag nam mkha' sogs phyag g.yog nang ma bcas khyon nyis brgya lhag tsam la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa/ a pa ga lca/nga lung sku skyes kyi zhus ngor/ bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas/ zhabs drung dkon bkras/ta'i gu shri'i sku skyes sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun nyis brgya skor la rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs sta gon dang bcas pa/ cha har slob dpon zhabs drung gis zhus ngor khong dang spyan g.yas mkhan po sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun sum brgya lhag tsam la gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i dbang chen stsal pas mtshon zhu ba po rnams kyi mos pa dang bsnan pa'i chos bka' mang tsam zhig bka' drin bskyangs pa mdzad /

602 gong mas bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/u cu mu chin smon rams pa bstan 'dzin grags pa'i sku skye dkon mchog bkra shis 'di pa zhi dul bag yod sgrub pa la brtson— pa zhig yin pa dang / nye gnas ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' las smon bzang pos rje bla ma'i thugs zin pa'i grwa slob kyi gtso bo yin pa bcas/ khong gnyis rje bla ma mchog nas thugs rjes lhag par bzung ste gsang chos bka' rgya can 'ga' zhig dang / bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi gnad kyi zhal shes mang po lhug par 'doms pa ma/dzad ces thos so /mtha' 'khob mya ngam thang du 'khyams pa yi/ /chos 'dod skom pas gdudi sa rnams mgon po 'di'i/ /brtse chen sprin sdon klong nas gdams pa'i char/ /'dzad med lhug par phabs pas tshim par gyur/ /gzu lum g.yo can srin bya bder rgyu ba'i/ /rtsod ldan mtshan mo'i dus 'dir mgon khyod kyi/ /legs 'doms 'od dkar snang ba 'di kho na/ /tharapa'i lam bzang gsal ba'i sgron mer gyur/ /rin chen ri bo'i ngos la brten pa yi/ /gnyis skyeṭashrī dag kyang gser 'od 'dzin pa bzhin/ /khyod zhabs bsnyen pa'i skal bzang 'di dag rnams/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse mor son/ /rma chur grags pa'i chu klung chen po la chu gzhan mang po 'dres pa rgya nag lho phyogs su 'bab pa/ skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu lo re bzhin chu ha cang rgyas che bas/ yul de'i grong khyer dang zhing sa du ma khyer ba la/ gong ma 'i stobs shugs chen pos chu rags btsan po brtsig pa sogs thabs ci byas kyang ma phan pas/ gong nas rje bla ma mchog la phan thabs bka' 'dri phebs par/ chu 'di'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs tshwa chen myi

tsho/nga mas bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur phebs par dgaṭ+wāṃ ston mdzad tshul/ 603gangs ri'i phyogs yin 'dug pas/ gzhi bdag rma chen sbom ra gzab mchod mdzad na phan nam zhus pa bzhin 7gong mas ze ling a ma pan la bka' phebs te/ lo re bzhin mdzod nas gangs ri'i nye 'dabs su gsol mchod byed pa'i rgyun btsuspu/sa/ de nas bzung da lta'i bar du phyogs der chu'i gnod pa zhi ste srog chags grangs las 'das pa zhig 'jigs pa med par bag yangs su 'khod chog pa byung ngo / /pe'i cing gi bzhugs gnas zung cu zi'i g.yon ngos su hwa yān zi zer ba'i lha khang du sdon ming gur gyi dus su bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan rdo rje 'chang / bde dgyes/ 'jigs byed/mgon po phyag bzhi drug gur rnams yod pa lo mang song ba'i rnying skyon che bas 7gong ma chen por snyan zhu phul te/ sku brnyan de rnams cha tshad dang gzungs gzhug sogs tshad dang ldan pa rje bla ma nyid nas gsar bzhengs mdzad pa la gong nas lo rgyus rnams rdo ring gi ngos la 'bebs pa gnang /ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs shig tu dus tshod 'khor lo yod pa'i mkhar ba ya mtshan can cig khrom du 'tshong rgyu 'dug pa grwa pa zhig gis nyos nas rje bla mar phul bas gzigs ma thag rmakhar ba 'di nged na phra dus 7gong ma shi tsung rgyal pos pad tshal gyi kun dga' ra bar zhabs 'chag mdzad dus bsnams kyin yod pa'i phyag mkhar zhig yod pa de ngo ma yin pa 'dug gsungs mgon khang gi spyan gzigs su 'bul ba gnang / gong ma bdag po chen pos rang nyid dge sbyong gi rnam pa can gyi steng du bla ma yi dam du ma bzhugs pa'i 'dra thang zhig dang / yang dpal ldan lha mo'i sku brnyan btags grub 7gong ma rang gi ljags rtsom tshigs bcad kyi kha byang yod pa

da 604 gongams bla ma dam pa dkung lo bdun cur phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/bcas rim par gnang ba bkur sti chen pos bzhes pa mdzad/ gong ma'i lugs srol la gser gyi tog su yin gyis bzhag mi chog pa la/ skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu gong ma tshan pos rje bla mar phebs byam la gser tog 'dzugs rgyu bka' drin bskyangs pa/ mdo khams sogs kyi bla chung 'ga' zhig gis khrims med kyi lung stong phag phug rnams su rang gis rang gzengs bstod pa lta bu ma yin par/ chab srid chen po'i lugs kyi gzengs bstod rgyal khams yongs la ngom chog pa zhig yin pas/ pho brang nang gi bla chen mi chen thams cad kyis rje bla mar legs 'bul kyang rgya che ba phul 'dug /shing 'brug lo kho bo cag gong ma chen po'i gser zhal mjal bar 'gro skabs mkhar sdon nas rje bla ma ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs pa la/ 'tshams zhu 'bul mi'i gdong zhu yig phul ba'i bka' lan du gong mar mjal rgyu'i don skor sogs lanang sbyar gyi bslab bya dang / nai ho'u nas 7gong ma'i 'tshams zhu sogs grub rjes pe'i cing du zhal mjal chog pa bcas zhal ta zhib 'khod kyi gsung bris spyi bor stsol ba mdzad/ 'di lo sku mtshams kyi mjug tu glo bur las bcol gyi gtor ma 'phen pa gnang skabs zil shin tu che zhing / me lce'i dum bu 'tshub cing 'khyil ba chad de gtor ma 'phen phyogs su 'gro ba sogs zor pra shin tu bzang bas/ zhal nas/ da res kyi gtor rgyag 'di yag po byung / ngas lo re bzhin 'di 'dra re byed kyin yod pas da lta yan la lo nyer brgyad song ba yin/ zhesadagongs gzhi can gyi gsung phebs 'dug kho bo cag zho ho'u nas gyigong ma'i gser zhal mjal ba sogs kyi dgos pa rnams legs par grub nas pe'i cing du rje

5nga mas bla mi dam pa dgude lo bdun cur 'ibs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 605 bla ma mchog la mjal bar phyin/ zhag shas sgug sdod byas shing ri bo rtse lnga nas phebs phral du mjal kha zhus par thugs dgyes nyams shin tu che ba gnang / dga' ldan snyan brgyud kyi phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid thurges rje gakhrags dgos zhus par dgyes bzhin du nyin gsum gyi ring la smin rgyas su stsal/ mdo sngags gnyis ka dang khyad par du gsang sngags kyi phyag chen la deng sang gi phyag chen gyi khrid 'chad pa po dang khrid yig rtsom mkhan rnams la phyogs tsam yang ma grags pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i gnad du ma zhig rje bla ma rang gi myong thog nas 'doms par mdzad pas/ nyams len 'di sa/cig bus 'tshengs pa 'dug snyam pa'i brod pa dang dga' dad skyo gsum 'gran pa bzhin du byung / gzhan yang rje nyid gyi gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor 'ga' zhig bcas klag lung gi skor yang mang tsam zhig zhus/dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa rgya mi chung tsam dang bcas zhabs/ pad yun ring du bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol 'debs snying gi khong nas zhus pa la thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pa dang zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad/ rang ngos nas sa thag ring ba sogs kyis slar zhal marjal ba e yong mi shes bsam rang gi gyon pa'i ang dang zhig phul te tshe 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad dang / byang chub snying po'i bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus par dgyes bzhin du zhal bzhes bzang po gnang byung bas/ 'dun ma legs par 'grub snyam du yid la dga' ba rgyas pa byung /rje bla ma dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi dus dngos gzhi me rta'i lo yin na'ang / shing sbrul lo'i dgun dus nas dbus gtsang mdo

da 6yo rgongams bla ma dem pa dgung lo bduno cur 'ibs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ khams hal ha os lod sogs phyogs tha dad nas dga' ston ched du 'dus pa'i bla dpon el chi sogs mi 'tshogs shin tu mang bas/ nyin re bzhin mjal kha phyag dbang ja gral gsung gleng mdzad pa sogs kyis thugs brel shin tu che ba byung / rgya'i lugs la dga' ston snga snur byed pa'i srol bzhin dgun zla tha ma nas 'khrungs skar gyi ston mo'i mgo tshugs/ thog mar rigs rus phun sum tshogs shing bstan pa bstan 'dzin spyi dang khyad par du rje bla mar mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa pā rin a sa gan am pan pe'i ze e phu bde legs bzang pos/ tsan+dan dmar po 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i bzhuganu/ khri'og gzhi'i stegs rgya che ba'i mtha' skor du ra ba dra mig can dang / khre dngos kyi g.yardo4 g.yon rgyab rnams su ri mo sna tshogre/sa 'bur du dod pa 'i lan gan dang / tha /d+ngha5sa g.yom/ du stegs 'phrul ma'i khar rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i nyer dpyad du ma bsgrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar khyad par du 'phagar+sā pa/ gzhan yang bzhugs stan sku snyel/ byi ru'i sdong po/ g.yang she'i nor bu don yod lcags kyu dngul rta rmig ma sogs dngos 'bul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas/ tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan phul zhing / e phu rang nyid kyis dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas dang bcas pa btegs nas/ zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i zhu tshig gi gsol 'debs rgyas par zhus pas/ rje bla ma thugs shin tu dgyes pas bka' lan rin po che'i do shal lta bu stsol ba mdzad/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin gnam sa'i dbang phyug mi rje gong ma bdag po chen po nas dga' ston gyi gnang skyes su bzhwang kyo'u her tshun zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi yod pa'i r+pā na dang / tshe dpag

gong mas bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 607med kyi gser sku dgu/ dngul gyi mchod rten gcig mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa rgyu tsardon las grub cing / khang bu rnams su tshe dpag med kyi gser sku dgu bcu re bzhugs pa/ mtho dman thog tshad tsam re yod pa gnyis/ spos shel gyi mchod rkong lnga/ gu gu sha'i bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun/ gu gu sha'i me dam gnyis/ mar me'i stegs gnyis/ spos phor gcig bcas rgya'i lugs kyi bo'u gung du grags pa'i mchod rdzas lnga/ khrus gsol gyi chas cha tshang ba/ bho k+ṣe gyi bum pa gcig dung dkar rin po che'i rgyan can gnyis/ yu'u shi dang gser gyi 'khor lo gnyis/ kar yol gyi lhung gzed gcig gser gyi mdung mo gcig yu'u shi'i mchod zhal yu ring gcig dang bzhes phor gcig chos gos rnam gsum sogs rab byung gi chas kyi na bza' cha tshang / rus rgyan kha dog mi 'dra ba tshar lnga/ yu'u shi las grub pa'i rdor dril khyad mtshar ḍa ma ru dang bcas la/ gos gser 'brug mngags btags kyi phyi sha byas pa'i chin ta kan gyi sku slog byur dmar gyi rgyan phreng / khug ma che chung so thur gyi shubs bcas/ gu gu shi' shangs tha kha'i khu khur/ sna tha khas bkang ba'i shel dam dgu/ mang nog krong don nul ma yu cil ma yug chen re/mdzod gos nang ma dmar ser yug dgu/ mdzod gos phyi ma yug dgu/gser gyi rta rmi0/ gzugs dgu/ dngul rta rmig ma dgu/ mdzod nang ma'i rtser sonaḥkha btags dgu/ gos skud mngags btags kyi bzhugs stan dang sku snyel/ yu'u shi'i zhu'u yi gnyis dang bcas pa rnams bkas mngags pa'i nang blon chen po rnams kyis 'bul rgyu khyer yong ba/ lugs srol ltar

ge608 gongams bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur zebs paradaga'astonamadzadatshul/da wagyi bkur sti phu dud dang bcas bdag gir bzhes/ phyi nyin 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po sku dngos rje bla ma'i gzim khang du phebs nas mu tig gi phyag phreng rgyan ldan khyad par du 'phags pa zhig gong ma dngos kyi phyag gis gnang ste/ zhabs pad brtan pa'i bden tshig gi bka' lung gser gyi phreng ba'i do shal lta bu lhug par stsol ba mdzad/ rje bla ma mchog nas gsung lan phral yun kun tu bkra shis pa'i bden tshig dang bcas/ sku gsung thugs rten/ g.yang ṭi'i zhu'u yi sogs rten 'brel mtshon byed kyi dngos 'bul bteg gong nas gzim khang rnams su mchod mjal mdzad nas pho brang du phyir phebs/ bla ma mchog nas gyigong ma chen pos dga' ston du stsal pa'i zlos gar gyi gzigs mo yun mi thung tsam gzigs shing gar mkhan do dam pa dang bcas par gsol ras rgya cher stsal/ de'i phyi nyin nas gyigong ma chen po'i nang blon a li ha tā hai zhin sogs blon po mi drags mang pospa gser dngul gos dar rin po che'i spyad pa ngo mtshar ba sogs dngos chas sna tshogs 'bul mkhan nyin re bzhin zam mi chad pa lta bu byung / me pho rta'i lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po'i nyino tsan+dan jo bo'i drung du 7gong ma chen por lo gsar gyi kha btags 'bul ba dang / gzim khang du gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston sogs lo dus bzhin mdzad/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin sku tsha ra kho hu thog thu dang ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkhas gtso ba'i phyag g.yog pa thun mong dang / dga' ldan khri rin po che'i sprul pa'i sku dang /kho bos ched mngags kyi bang chen mdzod pa zhi dar nang so / dgon lung spyi nas rgyud pa bla ma lha rams pa blo bzang bkra shis/ mtsho bdun dang a mdo

gong mas bla ma rdum pa dgung lo bdun cur zibs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 609chu bzang gi el chi bcas phyogs gcig pas bde mchog dkar po dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs kyi thog sku gsung thub/sa rten/ na bza' nyer dpyad/ dngul spos snam sogs rang rang gi dngos 'bul gang yod phul te/ zhabs pad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ tshes bcu'i 'khrungs skar gyi nyin bstan pa'i gsal byed smin grol no min han gyis sku gsung thugs rten dang sku'i nyer dpyad cha tshang / dngul srang stong phrag gcig ja sag bla ma/ tā bla ma sogs pho brang phyi nang gi bla ma las sna rnams kyis rang rang gi dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul/ bcu gcig gi nyin sngon goms kyi bag chags bzang pos bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing zab mo'i nyams len la gzhol ba har chin chen wang rat+na sirnyi/ dpon mo ma ṇi dha ra bcas kyis dngos 'byor gyi mchod sprin rgya che ba dang / gzhan yaspro pā rin chen wang pa thus gtso ba'i tsho chen zhe dgu'i dpon po rnams dang / hal ha tsho ba brgyad dang cha har tsho brgyad or du su a lag sha mtsho sngon sogs kyi bla dpon ser skya du mas rang rang gi dngos 'bul dang bcas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ de dag gi snga phyi bar gsum ci rigs par bod nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bka' blon rnams kyis gtso ba'i mi chen rnams dang / chab mdo 'phags pa lha/ rta tshag rje drung / brag g.yab spul sku/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa sogs bla chen rnams dang / gzhan yang sgogs thag nye ring ci rigs kyi sbyin bdag dad ldan du mas mtshon mdor na

610 5nga mis ma rdum pa dasnyeji bo durna cur mibs sger dga'i ston modzad tshulo/gong ma'i mnga' zhabs su gtogs pa'i bod sog gi rigs yod do cog lta bu 'ga' zhig sku dngos dang / sa thag ring po na yod pa rnams kyis el chi dang zhu 'phrin ci rigs pas brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul nod dang legs skyes kyi dngos po bzang zhing gya nom pa 'bul ba dbyar dus kyi sprin phung bzhin 'du bar gyur te/ nyin mang po'i bar du dga' ston rdzogs ldan gyi dus la 'gran bzod pa'i phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /'gyur med snying stobs mkha' la 'phags pa'i ri/ /rab dkar lhag bsam kha ba'i gos klubs pa/ /mdzad bzang nam mkha'i mig gi lta zer gyis/ /dge legs chab tu bzhus pa'i rgyun mang babs/ /'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis sgo mang can/ /rnam thar rin chen khang bzang grwa gcig tu/ /rdzogs ldan ya mtshan mgron du 'bod pa yi/ /dus ston gsar ba'i 'du 'god ci yang spel/ /zhal gyi pad+ma mchu sgros 'dab mnyen can/ /ze'u 'bru dkar po'i tshems phreng rdzogs pa las/ /zab rgyas gsung gi sbrang rtsi mngar bo'i bcud/ /skal bzang blo gros bung bas ci dgar 'thung / /sgra spyi tsam gyi phrum rar mi skye ba'i/ /nges don phyag chen dkar po chig thub sman/ /nyams myong mthon po'i ri las thon pa 'di/ /srid pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi nyid/ /legs 'doms 'od kyi phreng bas bdag snying gi /gdung ba bcil ba'i bka' drin zla ba'i gzugs/ /rnyog bral dang ba'i mtsho—nang spros pa yi/ /rba rlabs lag pas bsub kyang mi 'grib 'char/ /gang gi rgya khyon tshad las 'das pa yi/ /kun gsal an+da rnyil gyi lding khang na/ /sna tshogs rgyu skar grangs kyis mi chod pa/ /

rga /nga moru/ bra ma dab pa dgung lo bdun cur phebs par dga' ston mdzad tshul/ 611rang rang 'od snang nyi tshes snyems na yang / /brgya phrag 'od zer rnon po'i pir thogs nas/ /rang 'gros gshegs stabs gser gyi khu ba yis/ /sa la dus tshigs ri mo 'dri byed pa/ /snang ba'i mdzod can de la 'gran bzod su/ /de bzhin 'di na phyogs re'i thos bsam gyi/ /nags sul rgyu ba'i bstan 'dzin ri skyes bu/ /mang yang yongs rdzogs thub bstan gangs ri la/ /dbang byed ri dwags rgyal po khyod gcig nyid/ /gang gi thugs bskyed sprin sngon las 'ongs pa'i/ /mdzad bzang char chen 'di yis ma bskyangs na/ /mtha' dbus ljongs kyi phan bde'i lo tog kun/ /rkyen ngan than pas ma rungs byed nges kyang / /kun tu bzang po'i 'phrin las nam langs pa'i/ /snang ba mkha' khyab 'bar 'dis srid pa'i mun/ /zos pas khyod kyi gdul bya'i zhing khams na/ /rgud pa'i mtshan mo ming yang med par gyur/ /snyigs ma'i tsha gdung 'bar bas mnarwa ba la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rdzi ngad las/ /gang gi 'o/la gyi dbugs tsam ches bsil ba/ /zla med 'gro ba'i mgon la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye sheg bstan pa3 snyon gī dpa la bzang sdo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam baljad rmi dge ldarno babyen shā'i marmes rgyarno lathe/ gnam bskos mi'i rje bo 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen pos bla ma dam pa dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi gnang skyes rgya cher stsal pa sogs kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /

4)12 —— cho———— 'ezhu nyen gsumā pu/ zhid zhadizhi gdulka byu sdogs naska naded pu tha mā zhasnyan puzhi tshuzha/ de ltar dga' ston gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/ khri sprul sku dpon g.yog la bde mchog snu i pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / dgon lung rgyud pa bla ma blo bzang bkra shis kyi zhus ngor 'bral med rjes 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs zhig ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs 'dug pa sku tshe 'dir bka' chos gnang ba dang gsung rtsom mdzad pa'i tha ma yin par snang / snga ma 'brug gi lo tsam nas zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung yang yang phebs 'dug ste/ kho bos mjal nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhus skabs kyang / zhal nas nged rang la lha dang bla ma mang bo zhig gi lung bstan du tshe ha cang ring ba mi yong tshul yod kyang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyis sku tshe ring tsam yong zhes gsungs pa bzhin da cha bdun cur nye bas deng sang gi dus kyi tshe mthar phyin pa'i tshad la slebs mod/ 'od kyang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab ste yun ring sdod pa'i 'phen pa gtong zhes phebs pa de dus zhal bzhes bzang snyam pa las rtog dpyod gzhan ma byung yang phyis su dpyad na dgung lo bdun cu'i thog gzhan don la dgongs pa gtad rgyu gsal bar gsungs pa yin 'dug der ma zad nyin gcig kho

zhing thadi'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad ba tha ma bstan tshul/ 613bo la/ khyed rang lo rjes ma'i nang rang yul du phyir 'gro rgyu e yin phebs pa la/ lo rjes ma 'dir mi thon pa 'dra zhus par/ 'o na de rag tu nged tshang la do gal zhig yong ba 'dra gsungs/ kho bo'i bsam par rgyal bo tshang la nged tshang zhes snga mo nas gsung gi yod pas chab srid kyi don skor zhig yin thag chod kyis/ de dus ho thon 'ga' zhig ngo log skad kyang thos pa bcas ho thon phyogs kyi gtam de rtsa ba che ru song ba 'dra gsan pa yin nam zhus par/ de 'dra ma yin ra skor 'di ka'i nang du brel ba che tsam yong ba 'dra zhes phebs/ da dunga'ang blun po gti mug pa kho bo'i sems la ra skor zhes pa rgyal po'i mkhar la gsungs pa yin 'dug bsam/ ra skor 'di nang du phral du brel ba slong thub mkhan zhig med dam zhus par/ bzhad mo zhig gnang nas sus shes mo phywa mkhan 'ga' zhig gis de skad lab 'dug gsungs/ phyis su bsams na mi ring bar zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs gtad gsal bar gsungs pa yin 'dug kyang / blun rmongs shin tu tha chad pa kho bos ni don min gyi phyogs zhig tu dpyad nas ji bzhin ma shes pa 'dug go /kho bo sog yul du yod skabs gsung shog yang yang phebs pa phal cher gyi brjod don snga rgyun dang mi 'dra bar thugs sna bstung ba'i phebs sgo mang du stsal 'dug cing / lhag par sbrul gyi lo gsung shog cig tu/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i ngang tshul spyi dang bye brag bla depon che ba 'ga' zhig gi bya spyod la gting nas thugs khrel ba dang rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas yul dus 'di lta bur thugs log pa lta bu'i gsung mang tsam bcas gnang 'dug cing / me rta'i lo dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga'

ci 614 zhinga'adi'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mjod pa tha ma bstan tshul/ston la dngos mjal du yong 'dun yod tshul zhus pa'i bka' lan du/ nged bdun cur slebs pa la ngo mtshar ci yang med cing brel 'dzings kyis bag phebs pa zhig nam yang yong ba dka' bas khyed rang phebs zhan 'dra zhes sogs dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung bris zhig gnang 'dug dbang thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams ni ci lta bu'i mdzad pa zhig mdzad kyang gnas dang dus dang gdul bya dang dgos pa la ma gzigs par mi mdzad pas/bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyang / sku tshe 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa rlabs che ba mdzad dgos pa rnams ni 'phro can du lus pa gcig kyang med par mdzad zin cing / sku dngos kyis 'dul bar bya ba'i gdul bya rnams kyang rdzogs pas gdul bya'i lhag ma rtag 'dzin can le lo'i dbang du gyur pa rnams myur du chos la bskul ba dang / sku gdung dang ring bsrel tsam gyis 'dul bar 'os pa yang mang du mchis pas na re zhig de dag gi don la gzhol ba skabs su babs par dgongs te/ gang du sku'i bkod pa bsdu bar bya ba'i gnas ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i gnas mchog lhun po dwangs bsil nyid phun sum tshogs par gzigs shing / dus kyang bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen sa ga zla ba la sku'i bkod pa bsdu bar dgongs pa na/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi thugs kyi baned pa rnams 'bad rtsol la cher ma ltos par rang shugs kyis 'grub pa zhig yod pa'i dbang gis/ lo ltar bzhi pa'i mjug tsam la ri bo rtse lngar phebs bzhin yin kyang / 'di lormo zla ba gsum pa'i nang du gyigong ma chen po ri bo rtse lngar

da wa zhinga'adi'igadul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 615phebs rgyu dang rje bla ma nyid kyang de dang dus mtshungs su phebs dgos pa'i gong ma'i bka' babs/ pe'i cing nas phebs kha lo dus dang mi 'dra bar mchod khang rnams su byon nas mchod 'bul smon lam sogs rgya cher gnang zhing / mgon khang du 'phrin bcol sogs kyang nan tan mdzad ces thos la/ phebs lam du phyag g.yog pa zhig gis rgya mi 'ga' zhig la brdungs pa'i ku co gsan pas/ khyed cag da lta nga'i shed khur nas gzhan la brdeg 'tshog byed pa 'dug ste/ slar pe'i cing du yong skabs mis tshur brdungs kyang babs khur dgos pa yong shas che zhes phebs pa la/ ma gzhi nas phyag g.yog pa tshos gzhan la brdeg 'tshog rigs byas tshe thugs mi mnyes pa zhig yod pas/ 'di res kyang thugs ma dgyes pa'i bka' bkyon yin bsam pa las dwogs pa gzhan ma byung 'dug de nas ri bo rtse lngar phebs rjes gong ma chen po yang der byon/ lha khang chen mo'i 'jam dbyangs byin can gyi drung du rje bla ma tshogs dbur bzhugs shing / gong ma chen po yang phebs nas lhan cig tu smon lam gyi phyag srol bzhin zhal 'don gyi rim pa dang bsngo smon sogs rgyas par mdzad do/ /rje bla ma mchog gi sku tshe 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa rdzogs par nye ba na mchod yon gnyis ka gnas khyad par can du gdan 'dzom ste/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du bsdo smon rlabs che ba bya ba'i mjug sdud pa lta bu mdzad pa 'di ni/ rje bla ma dam pa nyid dang gyigong ma bdag po chen po rnam gnyis mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel du gyur te/ chos srid kyi mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i 'od snang gis bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i lam bzang gsal bar byed pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam rlabs

616 zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/po che ring 7 zhig nas mdzad pa'i 'bras bu da lta mngon du gyur pa mtshon byed dang / slad mar yang mdzad 'phrin de lta bu'i sgo nas mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzad pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yangs ngo/ra phye ba ste/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa sgyu ma'i rol pa lta bu 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar zhing dpag par dka' ba'i gnas su gyur pa nyid do/ /smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs pa'i skabs nas sku 'khrugs cung zad bzhes na'ang gzhan la mi mngon pa ltar mdzad nas/ gong ma chen po gser gyi rgyal khab tu phyir phebs pa'i chibs skyel so gas sngar rgyun ltar gnang / de nas rim gyis sku khams zhan du song bas phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis phral du gong ma chen por snyan 'bul zhu rtsis byas pa la/ rje bla ma mchog nas re zhig 'then tsam byas te gong ma chen po rgyal khab tu phebs grub mtshams su zhus na 'grig pa yong zhes phebs/ de nas mtshams 'di 'dra zhig tu sku snyun babs lci tsam yod tshul snyan 'bul zhus pas/ gong nar+sā phral du rgya bod kyi sman pa myo/khas pa gnyis am pan gcis/ bcas mgyogs shad kyis gtong ba gnang / bod pa sman pa des phyag rtsa mjal bas sku snyun 'di dwangs skyed yong mi yong rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs rje 'ba' zhig la rag las pa las tha mal gyi sman dpyad kyi gnas min pa 'dug zer zhing yid shin tu pham pa lta bu byed cing / rgya'i sman pas gsol sman sogs phul na skyon med pa'i tshul lab 'dug rje bla ma nyid nas gsol sman thun re gnyis las ma bzhes shing / zhabs brtan rimyo/ kro sogs kyi spros pa cung zad kyang mi gnang

5nga 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad ba tha ma brtarna tshul/ 611bar/ rgyun gyi thugs dam rnams 'chag med mdzad cing thugaru/ bag phebs pa'i rnam pas lhod 'bol gyis bzhugs pa gnang / de lta na'ang sku gcopaba'i rnam pa nyin bzhin je lod du gyur pa la phyag g.yog pa rnams sems shin tu 'tshab pas gnas de ka'i dgon che chung thams cad dang / pho brang phyi nang gi dgon pa rnams su zhabs brtan gyi rim gro nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu sgrub/ bla ma dam pas gong ma'i drung 'khor khri ya gcig dang dngos su thug byungan gong mar zhu rgyu 'ga' zhig yod ces gsungs pa gyigong ma chen po'i snyan du son pas/ pā cung am pan phral du gtong ba gnang zhing gyigong ma rang gi 'bral spangs kyi sku brnyan byin can zhig kyang 'bul rgyu bskur ba gnang / ri bo rtse lnga sa mtho zhing chu bsil bas pho brang du gdan drangs na legs pa'i bka' phebs/ bla ma mchog nas sku'i babs rgyun gyi gnas tshul dang / skye 'chi rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i tshigs bcad/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul byas pa'i gdung rus rnams zangs kyi mchod rten du bcug nas ṭing has zir bzhag chog pa bcas kyi zhu yig thugs dam rten gyi sku brnyan phyag ḍam rdor dril dang bcas pā cung la sprad nas 'bul rgyu bskur ba gnang bas kho ba mgyogs shad kyis phyir loganyin gcig phyag g.yog pa 'ga' zhig la/ zhal nas/ nga'i lus bro 'tshal kyang sems bde ba chen po nyams su myong gi 'dug da lta rang dang gzhan zer ba dang phyi dang nang zer ba 'di thams cad ro gcig tu song ba bzhin —'dug ces bka' stsal/ 'di ni theg chen thun mong ba'i dbang du byas na ji bla ma 'di nyid theg chen blo sbyong la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa zhigar+sha

618 ning 'de'i gdul 5gas nas mdzad ba ma bltan tshul/yin pas bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga bas/ shwa bo sgang ba la khyod blo sbyong ba la rkyen ngan grogs su shar/ sdug bsngal bde bar myong ba ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas yin cing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ blo sbyong bsgom pa'i lus 'dom gang gru bzhi po 'di nyid bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyang de la zer te/ phyi nang gi rkyen ngan pa gang gis kyang sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba'i rkyen du mi 'gyur bar bde ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khaca/sa kyang de la zer te/ lus sems kyi sdug bsngal me tshogs spungs pa lta bus kyang g.yo zhing 'khrugs par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyang de la zer/chos thams cad la bde bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yang de la zer gsungs pa dang / bslab btus las/ de la sdug bsngal chud ngu la goms pa sngon du btang na dka' ba dang shin tu dka' ba la'ang goms pa 'grub ste/ dper na goms pa'i dbang gis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal la bde bar 'du shes pa bzhin du sdug bsngal byung ba thams cad la bde bar 'du shes nyid du nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu chos thams cad bde bas non pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar blo sbyong gi nyams bzhes la brten nas snying rje chen po'i stobs ches cher rgyas pas/ nad la sogs pa sa/zhan la sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu byed pa rnams kyang bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i chos thams cad la bde bas non pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes

ning 'de'i gdul bya rjogs nas mdzod pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 61nyapa'i 'bras rtags su gsal la/ ting nge 'dzin 'di ni bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i mthong lam nas thob par gsungs pas go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i rnam thar du 'dug go /rdo rje theg pa'i dbang du byas na bdag nyid chen po 'di gsang ba bla na med pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo la nyin ma tshan khor yug tu thugs gzhol bar mdzad pas dben gsum man chad kyi spangs rtogs mngon du mdzad zin nas/ skabs 'dir ni bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis/ bde dang sdug bsngal ro mnyam na/ /chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bde stong gi ye shes nus pa mchog tu brtas pas kun rtog g.yo byed kyi rlung thams cad gnyis spang gi lam du mnal te 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad pa la nye bar phyogs pa ste gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su snang ngo / /nyi shu lnga'i nyin de ring skar ma yag po yin nged kyi rna lam du sgra snyan mang po zhig thos gi 'dug khyed tshos thos gi e 'dug ces gsungorīs/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis kyi snga dro yab de 'dra yang yang gsungs shing / pe'i cing nas gnyer pa chos ldan sku drung du 'byor pa la/ thu'u bkwan sprul pa'i sku da skabs sa cha gang du bzhugs yod pa red ces bka' 'dri phebs pa la gnyer pas thu med pe'i ze'i ho sho na yod tshul zhus/ yang u cu mu chin smon rams pa'i sku skye 'di khar yong rgyu yin pa slebs e byung phebs par da dung ma slebs zhes zhus/ 'di gsung gi tha ma yin zhes zer/ de nas zil gnon ces pa me pho rta lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes gnyis kyi phyi dro bya'i dus tshod tsam la slebs pa na zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs/ sku drang por bsrangs phyag res 'ga'

620 ging 'ari'i gdul bya rjogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/mnyam bzhag res 'ga' phyag phreng 'dren tshul mdzad cing / nyams rgyus can gyis brtags na rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhig mdzad pa'i rnam pas bzhugs te/srod 'khor gyi dus tshod tsam na zhal dbugs kyi rgyu ba mi mngon par gyur te 'od gsal chos kyi skur mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de'i tshe sku'i gzi mdangs lhag par rgyas shing zhal ras zla ba ltar dkar ba la khur tshos mngon par gsal ba dang / gnyer ma dang kham khum sogs med pa'i gzhon sha chags pa zhig tu gyur cing / skabs la lar dri ngad phun sum tshogs pas gzim khang gi nang khengs pa byung / pho brang nas chibs bsgyur gnang skabs nas bzung 'di reg la nyin re bzhin rlung 'tshub mi zad pa ldang ba dang bu yug gi 'tshub ma dang bcas sngar ma grags pa'i grang ngad shin tu che ba sogs ltas mi legs pa mang po byung ba ni/mgon po 'di nyid zhing gzhan du phebs pa la dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu rnams ma bzod pa'i mya ngan gyi rnam pa mtshon par nges la 'di nyin nas bzung rje btsun bla ma mchog gi mngon du mdzad pa'i 'od gsal ni 'di lta bu'o zhes mtshon pa'i phyir du nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing rlung gi rgyu ba phra mo yang med par gyur to/ /zhag gsum gyi bar du thugs dam la bzhugs nas tshes lnga'i nyin srod 'khor tsam gyi dus hika gsung ba lta bu'i sgra zhig gnang ba sku gdung gi rim gro pas thos te/ slar sos pa lta bu'i tshul mdzad dam snyam ste rtab rtab pos phyag g.yog pa rnams la sbran pas thams cad sku gdung rin po che'i drung du slebs nas mjal ba na thugs dam grol pa'i rtags gsal bar byon 'dug ces thos so/ /

zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mthod ba tha ma bstan tshul/ 621de ltar 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rgyud sde las bshad pa'i 'da' ga'i gdams pa zab mos mtshams sbyar te rnam par smin pa'i phung po rnying ba'i za ma tog skal ldan rnams kyi mchod pa'i gnas su bzhag ste/ sar gnas dpa' bo rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi lus tsam la brten nas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'asnyor ma ri rab kyi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa nam mkha' khyab pa rnams kyis lha rdzas kyi me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim/ rin po che'i khri stan la sogs pa bkur sti dang rim gro dpag tu sted pa dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa du mas mdun nas bdar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas sngon nas bsus/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs kyi pad+mo nas btegs te/ 'ja' dang 'od kyi lam nas mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gshegs par gyur to/ /de nyin nas nam mkhaspru rgya mthing gis byugs pa ltar sngo zhing dwangs pa la phyogs dang mtshamyo/sa rnams su sprin dkar gsar ba bla re dang gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan lta bu dang / 'ja' 'od sna tshogs pas kun tu dkrigs pa sogs lha rnams kyis sku gdung yid bzhin—gyi nor bu rin po che mngon par mchod pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung / de ltar 'gro ba thams cad phan bde'i snang bas rtag tu skyong ba'i nyi na byed ni nub/ thar lam 'tshol ba rnams la blang dor ma ner bar ston pa'i sa mkhan ni stor/ sa'i 'byer 'jigs po'i chab srid kyi srog datshosdong ni 'gag rgyal ba gnyis

622 zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan ni 'gyel bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs te smre sngags kyi ca co 'don par gyur/ khyad par du zhabs 'brang na 'khod pa mtha' dag ni rgya mtsho'i klong du ded dpon dang bral ba'i tshong phrug gi tshogs 'khyams pa ji lta bar ci bya gtol med par gyur cing / sa thag ring po na 'khod pa'i slob ma grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnas tshul de lta bu thos ma thag tu chomya ngan dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas snying dum bur 'gas pa lta bur gyur to//kye ma nyi zla'i sgron ma stong sbar nas/ /sa gsum kun tu bskal pa bye ba ru/ /'bad pas btsal kyang rnyed dka'i rin po che/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen gcig pu der/ /thub bstan gling kun skyong ba'i nyi ma khyod/ /gzugs sku'i snang ba brtul ba'i dus babs zhes/ /lus med bdag pos 'gro 'di'i las ngan gyi/ /rgongs thun grib so'i phag nas gsol btab cing / /zhing 'di'i dngos kyi gdul bya'i mtha' rdzogs pas/ /da ni rang gnas mkha' spyod zhing khams su/ /gshegs par 'os zhes phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams/ /dgongs pa sa/cika tu bgros pa'i bka' lung gi /gser yig sug par thogs pa'i bya ma rta/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ri rab rdul gyi grangs/ /mthon mthing kun gsal khang pa'i khyams chen po/ /yongs su gang ba mgrin gcig bsdebs pa yis/ /spyan 'dren bskul tshig klu dang gadha rba'i/ /rgyud mang rab bsres dbyangs kyi rol mo'i sgra/ /mu cor sgrogs pa gang thugs gnyis 'thung la/ /rang dbang bral ba'i lcags kyu bzhin gyur pas/ /mkha' spyod rdo rje'i pho brang

zheng 'deshā gdul bya 5gas nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 623zag med kyi/ /yon tan bsung zhim ci yang 'thul ba der/ /gcig tu dgyes pas bdag cag dman rnams la/ /thugs rje'i 'ching rgya cig char grol pa ltar/ /chu bur mig la snang rung gzugs kyi sku/ /mkha' las sprin byung mkha' la thim pa bzhin/ /gang nas byon pa zag med chos dbyings su/ /longs su sdud pa'i dgongs pa gtad pa na/ /lang tsho gsar ba'i 'jo sgeg yid 'phrog pa/ /nor bu'i thod bcing dar gyi lhab lhub dang / /rin chen rgyan phreng gser gdub sil sgra can/ /rig 'dzin lha dang mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma rnams/ /rdo rje'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /zhim po'i dri 'thul snyan pa'i rol mo 'khrol/ /'ja' tshon gur phub me tog char ba 'bebs/ /seng ge'i khri bshams 'od kyi lam 'then nas/ /rgyal mtshan mchog dang rab dkar lha yi gdugs/ /ston zla 'bum phrag tshar du dngar ba bzhin/ /rnga yab bser bu 'khrugs pa ba dan gyi/ /lce brgya g.yo ba rgyu skar 'dzum rlabs bzhin/spre /pi wang gling bu sil snyan rol mo'i sgra/ /dri za'i 'jigarten skyengs par byed pa bzhin/ /dpag yas mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa/ /sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa bzhin bshams nas/ /nor bus myus pa'i gser gyi khri chen po/ /'jam mnyen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan brtsegs par/ /zhabs sen bkod pa lha dang lha mo yis/ /bar snang gdugs bzhin btegs nas nam mkha'i dbyings/ /rab sngo in+d+ra nī la bstar ba'i sa/ /rgyu skar me tog tshogs kyis bkra ba'i gzhir/ /dgu tshigs chu bo'i rlabs kyang bder brgal nas/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du yud kyis gshegs/ /kyi hud 'gro ba'i phan

624 'ing 'di'i gdul bya gas nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul /bde'i rtsa ba chad/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'degs pa'i yu ba chag /thar 'dod pad tshal skyong ba'i nyi ma nub/ /'di 'dra'i skal ngan khrod du bdag cag lus/ ri /blo bzang rgyal ba'i legs bshad dka' gnad kun/ /ji bzhin 'doms mdzad gcig pu zhing gzhan gshegs /da ni yab rje'i mdo sngags gzhung rnams kyang / /rgyud chad pi wang bzhin du 'gyur bar nges/ /blo gros ldan pas dka' gnad gzhung gi don/ /dpyod tshe sgro 'dogs the tshom mdud rgya yi/ /bcings rnams gsung dbyangs gcig gis bde blag tu/ /'grol mdzed mkhas pa'i mgon dang bral 'dis skyo/ /dbe+en par sgrub la gzhol rnam sa nyams rtogs kyi/ /brdar sha gcod dang gegs sel bogs 'byin sogs/ /kha bshad tsam min rang gi myongs pa bzhin/ /ston mdzad grub pa'i mgon dang bral 'dis skyo / /las ngan 'bras bu nad gdon dgra bgegs kyi/ /'tshe bas mnar te ci bya gtol med du/ /gyur rnams stabs 'grig tsam min byin rlabs mthus/ /dbugs 'byin nyam thag mgon dang bral 'dis skyo/ /brtse med 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar chud cing / /'ijigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /nyam thag 'chi kha'i sems can mang po yang / /lamangon 'dren pa'i mgon dang bral 'dis skyo/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gangs can gyi/ /bstan srid gdugs dkar 'gyel la phyogs pa yang / /gang gi thugs rje dpung bas da bar bteg /da nas rlung nang mar me lta bur sems/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba'i dbang / /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las phyogs kun tu/ /gegs med rgyas pa'ang mgon 'di kho

zhing 'di'i gdul bya rjogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 625na'i mthu/ /da ni co ltar 'gyur snyam 'phyang mo nyug /mtha' dbus 'khod pa'i thub pa'i rjes 'jug kun/ /gang gi drin las 'tshe med bag yangs su/ /'khod mod deng nas lung stong 'brog khyim bzhin/ /'jigs shing ya ngar 'gyur snyam blo ma bde/ /bstan la sdang ba'i skye bo mi bsrun pa/ /stobs ldan mang po'i bsam sbyor ngan pa kun/ mgon 'di'i drin gyis re ba 'bras med gyur/ /da ni de lta'i mthu ldan gzhan su mchis/ /khyad par nyon mongs gcong nad ces btab pas/ /sdug bsngal zug rngus mnar ba'i nyam thag bdag /dam chos sman mchog stsol ba'i mgen gyis bor/ /skal ngan kho bo da ni su la re/ /las ngan chom rkun dgra bos lam bsgugs pa'i/ /srid pa 'brog dgon 'jigs su rung ba 'dir/ /dam pa'i mgon gyi skyel mas bdag cag dor/ /da ni bdag la mgon skyabs gzhan su mchis/ /blang dor blta ba'i 'drin byed dang bral zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis dbul ba'i dmus long bdag /brtse ldan dge ba'i bshes kyi dmigs bu stor/ /kyi hud da ni thar lam ci ltar 'tshol/ /chos srid gang nas re ba 'cha' ba'i gnas/ /drin can yab rje bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs/ /snyigs dus ma rungs dmu rgod skye bo'i khrod/ /nyam chung kho bo gcig pur lus 'dis skyo/ rī /de ltar sngon byung bka' drin dran pa dang / /'byung 'gyur gnas tshul sems pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /snying la sdug bsngel dmyal me 'bar ba dang / /'dren byed mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i 'gal 'du bsten/ /lo 'dab brul ba'i nags kyi gtsug phud can/ /dbyar mtha'i chu 'dzin gzhon nur mig gtad kyang / /sprin sngon nam

626 zhing 'gi'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/mkha'i dbyings su yal ba na/ /bltas kyang rang gi mjug sgro —tsam du zad/ /de phyir lhag bsam dag pa'i lus kyi phyid/ /snying stobs brtan pa'i 'khar ba la 'khril nas/ /blang dor gom pa mgon khyod gshegs pa yi/ /shul lam drang por dal gyis 'god pa 'dir/ /mkha' spyod zhing nas rdul bral ye shes spyan/ /mthing gi ut+pal zung 'dras nyer gzigs te/ /brtse ba'i phyag ring glang chen sna zhags ltar/ /rkyong bas dbugs dbyung mdzod cig drin can rje / /de nas byin rlabs kyi phung po gzhal du med pa'i sku gdung rin po che nyid sman dang dri bzang dang gos dar bzang pos legs par dril nas za ma tog gi nang du spyan drangs pa gdung sgrom gyi khrir mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa'i dbus su bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du nyin re bzhin slob ma rnams kyis bla ma mchod pa dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum kye rdor 'khor chen kun rig mi 'khrugs pa sogs yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor du ma'i zhal phye ste bdag 'jug blang ba sogs la 'bad par byas shing / ri bo rtse lnga'i dgon pa rnams dang / rgyal khab pe'i cing gi phyi nang gi dgon che chung thams cad/ mtsho bdun gyi dgon pa gnyis sogs mdor na phyogs de'i dge 'dun bzhi sde long ba yan chad thams cad la dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam dker gyi dge ba rgya chen po bsgrub par bgyis so/ /sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan phral du 7gong ma chen por gnas tshul phul bas gsan ma thag thugs mya ngan gyis brgyal ba lta bu la/ mi ring bar bla ma mchog gis gdams par mdzad pa'i chos thams cad rten 'byung gzugs
