zhing 'di'i gdul bya rjogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 621brnyan ltar 'char ba'i gdams pas thugs gso bar mdzad de/ nga'i bla ma drang don du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang nges pa'i don du 'chi 'pho dang bral ba yin cing mi ring bar thugs rje'i dbang gis rang cag gi mgon du slar yang 'byon par nges pa yin zhes pa'i bka' phebs/ gser srang lnga bcu las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ nang mdzod brgya/ spos reng chun po brgya bcas 'bul mi gtong ba gnang zhing / bod du rgyal ba'i dbang por gnas tshul dang sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs zhu rgyu/ dgongs rdzogs thebs su dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya bcas rta zam thog nas phral du gtong ba ga/nang / kho bo de dus ri bo rtse lnga dang khad shin tu ring ba'i thu med kyi sa char yod pa la/ rje bla ma sku khams bsnyel ba'i gtam thos pas sku drung du 'gro bar chas pa na sa ga zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nub rmi lam du lam bar gyi rgya mi'i mgron khang lta bu zhig na rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang nged cag lhan du 'dug pa la/ rje bla ma glo bur du byon nas nged thag ring po zhig tu 'gro rgyu yin khyed rnam gnyis sku khams bde ba mdzod gsungs kha btags ring po re gnang byung ba la/ nged nas kha btags zhig 'bul rtsis kyis btsal ba'i bar der rje bla ma rgyang ring por byon song ba rmis pas da lan ri bo rtse lngar song yang zhabs mi zin pa 'dra snyam 'gro rgyu bshol/ phyis su rtsad bcad pas de dus mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan zin 'dug pas rang la dad pa ngo da phyin bla ma'i byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi 'dug snyam du yid ches kyi dad pa skyes pa byung / rje bla ma mchog gi zhal chems su ngas pā cung brgyud nas 7gong mar zhus yod pas khyed tshos nga'i phywang po 'di ril bor

628 zhing 'di'i gdul bya rjogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bltan tshul/'jog pa skad dang / gser dngul gyi mchod rten bzhengs pa skad ma byed par zhugs la sbyangs nas rus pu rnams kyis sats+tsha dang sku brnyan mang du thob la zangs kyi mchod rten ha cang mi che ba zhig tu bcug nas gnas 'di nyid kyi snyeng has zi'i lha khang der skyol zhig ces gnang 'dug de ni deng sang sbyin bdag daje 'khor g.yog 'dzom zhing 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma phal cher gyis rje rin po che dang rgyal ba yab sras la 'gran pas gdung ril bor 'jog pa dang / gser dngul gyi mchod rten chen po byed pa'i srol mtha' dbus thams cad du dar 'dug pa la thugs ma dgyes pa snga ma nas mdzad kyin yod pas/ dmigs ltos de 'dra nyams smad pa'i ched du dgongs pa yin par snang / rje rin po che dang rgyal ba yab sras lta bu'i rtsod med kyi skyes chen dam pa 'ga' zhig gi sku gdung ma nyams par bzhugs su gsol ba la bstan 'gro la phan pa'i phral phugs kyi dgos pa chen po re yo da 'dug pas/ gang zag rang dga' bas de la 'gran na/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ ma thob pa ni thob smra zhing / /shi ba mya ngan 'das brjod nas/ /dad pas mchod rten byed bcug na/ /de dag ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shi bo de la dumyal ba'i sgo 'byed thabs su 'gyur pa las dgos pa gzhan yod pa ma mthong ngo / /pā cung am pan pe'i cing du slebs nas gyigong ma chen por rje bla mas 'bul ba gnang ba'i zhu yig sogs phul bas/ nged bla ma'i bka' las gcig kyang 'das pa med na'ang / da res kyi gsung 'di las cis kyang 'da' bar byed dgos pa 'dug bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu'i sku gdung

zhing 'arimi gdul bya gas nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 62mi la sres/ chog 'bul ba'i rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa yang yul phyogs 'dir med la/ sa gsum gyi rin po che gcig pu lta bu'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu 'di zhugs la zhen pa sems kyis ji ltar phod/ lha dang bcas pa'i bhegro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing khyad par du 'phags pa 'di lta bu gser dngul gyi mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol kyang bsnyen bkur che bar mi 'gyur na dngos po phal ba'i mchod rten du bzhag pa ga la 'os/ bla ma dam pas de skad gsungs pa paṇa chen rin po che dang 'gran pa lta bur 'gro dwogs pa'i thugs dgongs yin par nges pas/ gal te de lta na mchod rten rgyu gser gyis bzhengs kyang mtho dman paṇa chen rin po che'i gser gdung las tshon kha shas kyis dma' ba bgyis pas 'thus pa 'dug des na gser gdung bzhengs pa dang de nyid ṭing has zir gdan drangs nas 'jog pa sogs kyi bkod pa 'di nas byed pa yin zhes pa'i bka' babs/ de nas 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen pos gser bzang po srang stong phrag bdun tsam las grub pa'i mchod rten chen po rin po che dpag tu med pa'i phra tshoms kyis spras pa phral du bzhengs pa mdzad de/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin shu am pan ched mngags mdzad nas/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i bar mtshams rnams ring bsrel rnam bzhi dang rin po che sna tshogs dri bzang sna tshogs kyis byur bur gtams par byas/ de nas gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs dgongs la mchod sdong bzhugs yul gtsug lag khang dkyus ma lta bu byas na/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur sogs kyi dbang gis sdig can kyi skye bo ma

630 'ing 'de'i gdul bya 5gas nas mdzed pa tha ma bstan tshul/rungs pa'i rigs kyis sbyor ba ngan pa rtsom pa sogs 'byung srid pas/ de 'dras glags mi khel bar bskal pa ji srid kyi bar du lha mi'i mchod yul du bzhugs pa zhig mdzad par dgongs pa dang / khyad par du de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gi sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bskal pa mtha' yas pa 'das pa'i 'og tu bdag cag gi ston pas zhal phye bar sku shin tu skam pas gsung byon par snying rje pad dkar las gsungs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos chen po 'od srung gi sku gdung ma nyams pa ri bya rkang can du ri brag kha sbyar ba'i nang du bzhugs pa ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams pas lung ston par gsungs pa dang / mgon po klu sgrub dang rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku gdung gis kyang phyi ma'i dus su bstan tso'agro'i don rgya chen po mdzad par bshad pa dang chos mtshungs par 'byung 'gyur gyi dgos pa khyad par can la dgongs nas/ rje bla ma nyid kyi bka' gnang ba'i gnas der sa'i 'og shin tu gting ring por brkos pa na brag thon byung bas brag de la khang bu gru bzhi pa shin tu yangs pa bzoṭashaṃ te/ de'i dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i khri'i steng du mchod sdong bzhugs su gsol ba'i mtha' skor du mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bkang / de'i steng du mchog dman thams cad kyi mig la snang du rung pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / rdo'i mchod rten chen po sku gdung gi pur tshwa sogs byin rlabs rton gyis byur bur gtams pa bzhengs par mdzad/lo 'di ka'i nang du rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal bkod bzhin rigs kyi tsha bo ra kho su thog thus bod du phyin te rgyal ba yab sras la 'bul chen dang / lha ldan

lha zhing 'demi gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/ 631smon lam/ ser 'bras dge sa/sum/ rgyud stod smad/ bkra shis lhun pos mtshon pa'i gtsang dbus kyi dgon pa che chung thams cad dang / chos sde chen po dgon lung sogs mdo smad kyi dgon sde thams cad la mang 'gyed/ skyes chen dam pa rnams la 'bul ba sogs kyis mtshon dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i rnam dkar dge sgrub rgya che ba bgyis snang ste zhib par sa bon ma byung bas 'bri bar ma spobs so/ / zhing 'di'i gdul bya pad+ma gzhon dzu'i tshogs/ /'phrin las 'od kyi nu zhos skyong ba'i ma/ /mgon po nyin byed chos dbyings nub ri'i phag /mnyam bzhag zag med gzim khrir mnal ba na/ /rin chen phreng ba bstar pa'i mdud 'dzin bzhin/ /gang gi zhabs 'brang rnams kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /duge leswās yon tan rgyu skar grangs med kyis/ /zab yangs rnam dpyod nam mkhu' mdzis pa des/ /skyabs gnas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying po 'di'i/ ༷/zarge med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i slad/ /pho brang 'khor gyi lha yang skrag bskyed pa'i/ /gtong ba chen po'i sgo 'phar yongs phye ste/ /gser dngul rin chen dar zab la sogs pa/ /nor gyi phung po ri ltar spungs pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mgon po mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid can/ /ris med spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs/ /byin rlabs sprang rtsi'i dpal la sred nga/ yi sa/ /ring bsrel pad+ma spungs pa'i mchod rten drung / /nyin bzhin 'dus pa rig 'dzin rkang drug can/ /rnam dag cho ga dar dir sgrogs rnams kyis/ /rnam bzhi'i rgyud sde'i nges gsang nam mkha'i khams/ /dkyil 'khor snang brnyan 'ja' tshon dra ba'i gur/ /sdo rje'i rig sngags

632 zhing 'di'i gdul bya dzags nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan tshul/sprin sgra'i sil snya na can/ /bsgrub cing mchod pa dbyar gyi phun tshogs bzhin/ /dbus gtsang mdo khams hor dang rgya yul gyi/ /dge 'dun 'dus pari rol mtsho ji snyed pa/ /gtong ba'i char gyis bkang ste lud pa'i sgra/ /gsol 'debs smon lam bden tshig dbyangs su sgrogs/ /bsod nams zhing du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba las/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig tsam legs bsngags na/ /ril po'i sku sa/dung smos ci dgos so zhes/ /sa yi bdag po'i thugs la de dgongs nas/ /sgrib bral ye shes nor bu ngal bso'i snod/ /mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba'i za ma tog /snying por bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong 'dzam gling rgyan/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du bskrun par mdzad/ /ji ltar rnam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong bzhin/ /mgon po mya ngan 'das kyang thugs bskyed mthus/ /sku gdung yid bzhin nor bus khams sa/sum gyi/ /'gro ba kun la phan bde'i 'dod pa 'jo/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyabra bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i nge bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye sheg bkaun pa3 sgron sngi dpaXl bsdung sdo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjid rmi daṅge ldar+ghaṃ bsta na pa'i mdzes rgyan las/ zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas mdzad pa tha ma bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //

633rluzhunyan buzhi bu/ nanalka zhamā thod gaskalka gyi snad dan rte butsun zhadamā dpy-ings skas tshad na zhi lwamā nimā gaskan puzhi tshulu/de ltar 'a kro ba thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nyid re zhig gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdus te zag med chos kyi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan kyang / rnam 'grel las/ sgrub byed thugs rje goms las de/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs nas sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa la brtse ba lta bu'i snying rje chen po rgyun mi 'chad du goms pa'i dbang gis/srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas mnar zhing mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang bral ba rnams la shin tu brtse ba'i thugs rje chen pos rang dbang med par bskul te/ dper na nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin la sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pa gsar du 'byung ba'i mtha' la zad pa med pa ltar/ chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du slar yang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sems can zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / smin grol la 'god pa sogs kyi ched du gang la gang 'dul gyi spru la pa'i rol pa mtha' yas pa nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du ston par mjad pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab rtswa smin dang lung ston rgyu yi rga/zus/sa/ /rga/nga yin de yang

634 mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/'dir ni rtag gnas te/ /nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ slar yang mi g.yo'i sku mnga' khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul rnams kyis/ /gshegs par ni bltams dang byang chub zhi ba'i 'khor lo'ang ston par mdzad/ /ces sogs mdo dang bstan bcos rnams su rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /da ni rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis na'ang drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor mnal lam 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi sprul pa'i rang gzugs dang mjal te/ de nyid kyis zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston stsol par mdzad pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyis shog dril du bkod nas bka' rgya mdzad pa 'di nyid skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la theg pa mchog gi rigs kyi nus pa yongs su brtas par bya ba'i ched du/ rdo rje'i gsung dri ma med pa tshig ris ma nyams par kyu ru lugs su 'god par bya ste 'di ltar ro/ /gnyid mo che'i rmi lam gyi rol mtshor shar ba'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar zla ba'i snang brnyan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab zag med ye shes li khri'i rdul brtsegs gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs pa/ /nyin byed bye bas 'khyud pa'i 'od kyis rnam phye zhabs brten mtshar sdug chu skyes rab rgyas par/ /gdong bzhi mchod sbyin brgya ba'i do ger gyis mchod gang de/ra phyogs bcu'i rnam par 'dren pas kyang / /bsti bstang lan

mnal lam gyi snang bar je btsun 'jam dbyaras las lam rim gsan tshul/ 635brgyar bgyis mdzad gang des da dung bdag la dge legs snang ba mngon par stsol/ /gsal dwangs rang rig shel dkar sna tshogs snang ba'i tshon dang 'grogs pa las/ /sgyu ma'i ltad mo cir yang 'echar ba brjod pa'i yul las 'gongs mod kyang / /bde ba'i mchog ster zlos gar snang brnyan 'bras bus stongs pa ma yin pas/ /gcig pur dga' ba'i ca co bsgrags 'dir blo ldan rnams kyis gshung mi ris/sa/ /ngo mtshar rten 'brel tshogs pa'i sa bon la/ /skyabs mchog byin rla jos sprang char gyis gsher las//don 'bras sbrum pa'i snyan tshig myu gu brtas/ /la lar 'ga' yi don du 'gyur yang srid/ /stong pa'i gshis dang snang ba'i nyams/ /khyo shug mdza' bar 'tham pa las/ /sgyu ma'i khyi'u chung bzhin legs skyes/ /sna tshogs gar gyis 'khyugs 'dir ltos/ /kho bo rol pa'i rdo rjes rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing sbrul lor 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul ba'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar phyin te/ zla shas mtshams kyi bcad rgya bgyis shing mchog gsum la gsol ba btab par/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi mtshan mo drag char shin tu che ba babs shing shwa 'od kyi nyen kyang che bas gnyid kyi go skabs 'phrog par/ glo bur du dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i tshig don rnams gzhan zhig gis bshad pa lta bur gsal bar shar bas phyi nyin yi ger 'god pa byas/ mtshams kyi skabs nyams dang mi lam 'dres pa'i za zi mang zhing / phal cher lhong tshar 'dres pa'i nyams su snang bas bzang ngan phyed dka' bar 'dug mod/ 'ga' zhig ni lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs yin nam snyam pa'ang ci rigs byung / mtshams

636 mnal lam gyi stsang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/grol nas tshur yong skabs hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin po'u ting phu'u zhes pa'i rgya mkhar chen po'i nye 'dabs su zhag skabs nyi ma nub rjes/ nye gnas ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' dang lhan du gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sa/zhung le'u lnga tsam bton pas yid la bde nyams mi 'dra ba zhig byung /de nas nyal bas gnyid du 'gro khar 'jam dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs zhig 'don bzhin gnyid du song bas/ skabs shig gnyide sad pa /lta bu'i nyams la mi zhig glo bur du byung bar khyod su yin dris pas/ nga 'jam dbyangs yin zer/ nged kyi grwa pa 'jam dbyangs zer ba zhig sgo'i phyi logs na nyal yod pa de yin 'gro snyam bltas/ pas/ nged rang gi mig mi gsalabs mi'i byad dang cha lugs mthong gin med pa la/ de res btsun chung gzhon nu gos ser gyi phu dung gsar ba gyon pa zhig 'dug par da nam tshod gang la slebs 'dug snya ri'i 'khor lo la ltos shig byas pas/ khos de la blta ba'i lugs byas nas phag gi dus tshod kyi phyed la slebs 'dug zer/'o na da dung snga bar 'dug pas khyod rang phar song la nyol zhes smras pas/kho rang de gar 'grings nas phar mi 'gro bar 'dug detsāskabs rang gi sems la glo bur du/ rgya gar skad du/ pra mā ṇa bar ti kā kā ri ka /bod skad du/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi chig le 'ur byas pa zhes bya ba zhes pa dang / rtog pa'i dra ba zhes sogs dang / skye bo phal cher phal la chasas shing zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dran byung / de mur btsun chung de de kar 'dug cing / des brjod pa zhig/ sa/sa 'o4 bar ma byung yang rna bar sgra zhig gis/ tshad ma neca4 'grel 'di ngasta na ngacos phu ba du snyuji re ba zhig

rnal lam gyi sna nga bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 631yin/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba la rang re'i ston pa dang bstan pa la snying nas dad pa gting tshugs pa zhig phye dgos/ de yang dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams la rigs pa rnam dag gis drangs pa'i nges shes ma skyes kyang yid ches kyi dad pa skye ba yod mod kyang rkyen theg pa dka'/ rigs pa yang dag la brten nas nges shes skyes na rkyen gyi ldog tu med cing bag chags brtan po 'jog rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par/tshad ma kun btus kyi mchod brjod/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis rang gi ston pa grol pa don gnyer la tshad ma yin tshul rgyas par bshad pa 'dis phyi rol pa rnams kyi thar pa dang der bgrod pa'i lam mang du smras pa rnams byis pa brdol thabs smra ba dang 'dra bar khong du chud par 'gyur bas/ rang gi ston pa dang bstan panil rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i dad pa gting tshugs pa bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes yong / de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi bden bzhi'i blang dor thabs dang bcas pa gsungs pa 'di rnams la rigs pas legs par dpyad tshe/ 'gal ba dang / ma grub pa dang / ma nges pa'i skyon cung zad kyang med par ma zad rgyu mtshan gang gsungs pa thams cad thos bsam gyis dpyad kyin don gyi ngo bo la shin tu 'dzugs par yod cing / de yang da lta'i nyams dang bsres kyin bsam dgos te/ da lta rang la 'phral du bde sdug sna tshogs 'byung ba 'di res 'ga' 'byung zhing / de yang bde sdug che chung ma nges pa 'di rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'byung ba myong bas grub pa 'di la dpags nas/ nyer len gyi phung po yang rgyu la nges par ltos shing / rgyu de

—da sngosdo—skye—tram̐nalalamagyisnang bar rji btsun 'tham dbyangs lal lam rim gsan tshul/yang rtag pa dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung bar ston pas gsungs pa rnams nges par 'thad par 'dug snyam pa dang / rgyu'i rirtswa ba yang ma rig pa dang sred pa yin —par gsungs pa 'di la nges shes brtan po skyes pa zhig cis kyang dgos/ de'i yan lag tu gzhan sde rnams kyis 'khor ba'i rang ribazhin la log par rtog pa dang / de'i rgyu dbang phyug rtag pas byas pa sogs bshad pa rnams rigs pas 'gog pa yin/ de nas 'khor ba'i rgyu'i rtsa ba ma rig pa dang sred pa yang sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs par yul la log par zhugs pa'i 'dzin stangs can yin pas de dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i rigs pa rnam dag gis 'gog nus shing / de khegs pa na de las sdug bsngal 'byung ba yang 'gog nus pas thar pa 'thob nus su tshad mas nges/ de'i yan lag tu gzhan sdes thar pa ma yin pa la thar par sgro btags pa dang / grol byed kyi lam dbang phyug gi dbang bskur dang skra 'bal ba sogs kyi dka' thub dang / de nyid nyer lnga bsgom par bshadapa rnams rigs pas 'gog pa yin/ rang lugs kyi thar pa de yang sems kyi rang bzhin dri mas bslad pa dag par byed pa la rag las shing / de yang thog ma med pa naṭa/ semaṭa/ phyin ci log tu zhugs tshabs che bas rim gyis dag par byed daswos pas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo shi ba sgron pa bzhin du thog mar mi rtas/ pa dang sdug bsngal baṃ sogs kyi gtam la brten nas rgyud sbyong ba'i smin lam la slo ba dgos/ de nas snod rung du song ba na rang dbang ba'am rang skya pa'i gang zag gi bdag med pa'i tshul shes par byas nas nga/sgom pa'i grol lam gyis thar pa thob pa yin la/ de yang mi —

mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 639rtag sogs bcu drug log rtog bcu drug gi gnyen por 'gyur tshul sogs legs par shes nas rang rgyud la bskor te sgom par byed dgos/ de lta bu'i bden ngazhi'i rnam bzhag bshad pa 'di rnams rang gig ma shes par gzhan la storne mi nus pas/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang bden bzhi'i blang dor thabs dang bcas pa legs par mkhyen pa dang / mkhyen pa de yang yun ring po'i bar du goms par mdzad pas mkhyen pa brtan pa dang /di yang 'khor ba las grol pa'i thabs ma tshang ba med par yongs su rdzogs pas ma lus par mkhyen pa ste rtogs pa'i yon tan gsum dang / de'i mi mthun phyogs sgrib pa rnams kyang spangs pa dang / spangs ba de phyir mi ldog pas brtan pa dang / ma lus par spangs pa'i yon tan gsum dang ldan pas/ bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa de ni rang 'jigs pa thams cad la sa grosmu/ ga'an 'jigs pa las grol pa'i thabs la mkhas par rigs pa yang dag gis grub/ rang nyid de ltar yin kyang gzhan sgrol bar mdzad dam snyam na/ de ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis bskal ba grangs med pa du mar gzhan la phan par byed pa'i thugs rje chen po yun ring du goms par mdzad pas 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas skabs na yang / sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba las grol pa'i thabs su 'bad rtsol med par ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byung ba yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni thar lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i mdzad pa 'di nyid yin/ des na bcom ldan 'das ni kun la thugs rje chen po nye ring med par 'jug cing / phan

640 mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/btags pa dang ma btags pa thams cad kyi don mdzad pa yin pas/ nges par grol pa don gnyer gyi skyabs tshad ma yin par 'dug snya ma du nges shes shugs drag cig skyes pa gal che ba yin/ de tsa na chos dang dge 'dun la yang mi ldog pa'i dad pa rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa shugs drag po skye ba yin/ de ltar le'u gnyis pa nas bshad pa 'de rnarma sa legs par bsgom shes na skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam gyi rim pa rnams la myong ba bcos ma ma yin pa thon pa'i thabs mcho ga tu gyur pa yin/ gtso bor phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la skyo ba bskyed dgos pa yin mod kyang /de yang rags rim nas ma sbyangs na mi skye bas lam rim nas bshad pa ltar tshe 'dir yun du mi gnas pa'i 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang / ngan 'akro'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa sogs la yid 'khul ba'i myong ba 'don dgos/skyabs 'gro'i chos skor ni sngar bshad pa der 'dus la/ las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag ni dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad pa'i yid ches shugs drag byung phyin/ ston pas bshad pa ltar gyi las 'bras la blang dor byed tshul go ma log pa des drangs nas bde blag tu skye ba'o/ /rang gis myong ba thon nas gzhan 'khrid pa la rigs lam la sbyangs pa yod pa rnams la gzhung dang sbyar nas 'khrid na don du 'gyur tshabs che mod/ /'on kyang da lta rigs lam la sbyangs par rlom pa rnams kyis kyang nyams len du 'khyer shes pa srid mthar snang bas rigs lam la sbyangs ma sbyangs gang yin kyang slob ma'i blo tshod dang bstun nas dpyod tshul sngar gyi de dag ji/ phyogs nas 'khrid cing /go sla ba'i yan lag dpe dang / yid ches pa'i yan lag tu lung dang

menal/lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 641sbyor ba sogs blo tshod dang bstun na sa/nad du 'gro dzi+orngu+obs chen+tu 'o na le'u dang po 'chad pa'i dgos pa ci yin zhe na/ le'u gnyis par lam 'bras kyi rnam bzhag bshad pa de dag rigs pas sgrub da rnge 3/sa pa sha stag yin la/rigs pa yang rgyu mtshan ltar snang dang yang dag ji ltar yin ngos ma zin na rigs pas dpyod khul byas kyang lam du mi 'gro bsakyi rgyu mtshan ltar snang dang yang dag gi khyad par dang ngo bo grangs nges rnams shes dgos/ de la rgyu mtshan nam gtan tshigs yang dag ni/ ngo bo tshul gsum tshang ba dang / 'bras rang ma dmigs pa gsum du grangs nges pa dang / de dag gi nang gses kyi dbye ba dang / gzhan sde'i gtan tshigs ltar snang bshad pa rnams 'gog tshul shes dgos la/ le'u dang por bshad pa'i 'bras ba'i gtan tshigs ni/ le'u gnyis pa'i skabs su nyer len gyi phung po la ༄spyir rgyu yod pa tsam sgrub pa la rgyu sngon song tsam gyi 'bras rtags dang /'khor ba'i rgyu mi rtag pa sogs su sgrub pa la rgyu'i khyadadzu par sgrub pa'i 'bras tags dang / rgyu'i chos rjes su dpog pa'i khyad par sgrub pa rnams so sor sbyor shes dgos/ rang bzhin gyi rtags ni/ nyer len gyi phung po 'jig pa'i chos can yin pas mi rtag pa dang / kun tu sdug bsnga la ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa dang / phung po tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas bdag rang dbang can ma yin pa sogs la sbyor dgos/ ma dmigs pa'i rtags ni/ gtso bor rdzas yod kyi bdag 'gog pa dang / de'i yan lag tu gzhan sdes btags pa'i bdag khyad chos gsum ldan 'gog pa sogs kyi skobs rgyu r+sā dmigs pa dang / 'brel rda ma dmigs pa dang / khyab byed

642 marnal lam snye snang bar sde btsan mujam debyangs los lam rim gsan tshul/ma dmigs pa sogs skabs dang bstun nas sbyor dgos pas/ le'u dang por bshad pa'i gtan tshigs kyi rnam bzhag de dag kyang le'u gnyis pa'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bsgom pa la thabs mchog tu 'gyur tshul shes dgos/da ni le'u gsum pa'i don ni/ le'u gnyis pa'i skabs su theg pa thun mong gi dbang du mdzad nas gang zag gi bdag med pa sgom tshul gtso bor bstan pa tsam las chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam bzhag ma gsungs la/ der bshad pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas snod rung du song ba na chos kyi bdag med ston pa yin pas de'i ched du le'u sa/sum pa 'di gsungs pa yin/ de yang le'u 'dir bshad pa'i tshad ma'i grangs dang / ngo bo dang 'bras bu la log par rtog pa bsal ba'i rnam bzhag legs par shes par byas nas sgom rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ 'bras rtogs gsum gyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung rnams yin/ de yang sngar rjes su dpag pa'i sgo nas nges shes drangs pa de rnams kyang mthar mngon sum la gtugs dgos pa dang / mngon sum gyi yul 'dzin pa yang phyi gzung ba yul gyi rnam bzhag dang / nang 'dzin pa sems kyi rnam bzhag dang / des de ji ltar 'dzin pa'i tshul rigs pas legs par dpyad nas gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas 'bras rtogs gsum gyi gzhung la so sor sbyor ba shes dgos/ bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags dang / mngon par brjod pa'i bag chags dang / rigs mthun gyi bag chags gsum gyi phyi mas dbang shes lnga la gzung ba phyi rol tu snang ba bskyed pa dang / bar bas gang la gang snang ba de la 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni sdon po'o zhes pa lta bu nang gi brjod pa dang / de la brten

9mini la lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam debyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 643nas sgra'i brjod pas sgro 'dos/sa par byed cing / snga mas de ltar du btags pa ltar gyi 'dogs pa'i gzhir rang gi sdod lugs kyi dbang gis grub par 'dzin pa yin la/ de lta bu'i 'dzin lugs de la rigs pas legs par dpyad mthar lhan cig dmigs nges kyi gtan tshigs sogs la brte— —/ nas chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pas sgro 'dogs pa ltar gyi grub tshul med par nges par byas nas phyi'i yul snang rnams nang sems kyi bdag nyid dang / rang rig pa'i sems kyang gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis stong pa'i ngo bor legs par thag bcad nas bsgom pa gnad du che/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du byung ba'i grub thob phal mo che zhig thog mar lta ba 'di'i sgo nas zhugs te/ sngags bla med kyi rdzogs rim gyi lam sna zin pa nas dbu ma chen por gyur pa mang du yod pas grub chen 'ga' zhig gis do ha rdo rje glu dang / phyag chen gyi rnam bzhag gsungs pa 'ga' re yang lta ba 'di dang sbyar ba myori nga bar yod/ bod kyi bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis phyag chen gyi khrid bsta na pa du ma zhig kyang sems tsam pa'i lta ba 'di'i sgo nas dbu mar 'khrid pa'i lugs yin/ 'on kyang grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi phyagasgyu chen mar mi sogs la brgyud pa ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin kyang 'di dag grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa yin pas/ rang rang gi nyams rtogs la gang shar dang gdul bya nye ba'i slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang bstun nas gegs sel dang bogs 'don gyi ngo sprod mdzad pas sa/zhung chen mo'i sgra 'gros dang rmethun mi mthun sna tshogs yod kyang / blo phugs sa/tod sa dbu sems kyi gzhung chen mo la thug pa yin/ lhan cig dmigs nges kyi

644 mnal lam gyi snang bar rji btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul /rtags kyi don da lta ṭīka/ byed rnams kyis bshad pa yang gzhung gi 'bru ga non dang rtsod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ — don gyi ngo bo ni bum pa lta bu mthong ba na 'di mthong ngo snyam pa dang / 'di skye'o snyam du shes pa'i tshe shes bya dang shes byed gnyis ya bral du ma song bar shes byed rig pa rang yang myong ba'i cha rang rgyud la brtags na gsal bar yod la/ de ni 'brel med rdzas tha dad la mi rung bas rdzas gcig pa'i sgrub byed du nges par 'gyur ba 'di yin/ des na ngo bo dang khyad par gyi tha snyad de dag gi gzhir nang rtog pa la gtan ma ltos par yul kho rang gi sdod lugs kyis grub pa ltar zhen pa la brten nas phyi rol don du grub par 'dzin pa 'byung ba yin pas/ lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags la brten nas grub tshul de 'gog pa 'di pa'i lugs yin zhing / 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ ming gi snga rol blo med phyir/ /zhes pa sogs kyang dgag bya de nyid 'gog pa'i rigs pa'i rnam grangs yin no/ /de dag gi don bsgom pa'i tshe rang gi myong ba la brten nas gzugs la sos/sa pa ngo bo dang khyad par gyi tha snyad kyi gzhir 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa la ma ltos par ye mi 'char bas tshul 'di la dpags nas phyi rol gyi snang ba nang shes pa'i rdzas su thag gcod pa dang / shes pa rang nyid gsal rig myong tsam gyi ngo bo yan gar bar 'char la/ rigs pas dgag pa'i nges shes kyi 'dzin stangs dgag bya bkag pa'i med dgag la zhugs pa yin kyang / las dang po pas gsal rig gi snang cha 'gog mi nus pas de ka la mnyam par 'jog dgos/ tshul de la bsams nas phyag chen pa gong ma

mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 645rnams kyis snang ba sems su thag bcad/ sems nyid stong par thag bcad/snang stong dbyer med du thag bcad ces sogs dang / rtse gcig dang sgom med sogs rnal 'byor bzhi'i tha snyad byas pa dang / yang 'as/'a zhig gis gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin zer ba'i tha snyad byed pa rnams nyams myong brdas ston pa'i lugs yin pas gzhung dang 'gal skyon ye med/ rang nyid nyams myong can yin na thal phyir sogs kyi tha snyad ma sbyar kyang gzhung las 'byung ba'i rigs pa'i 'gros sems la bzhag nas rgyu mtshan dang dpe gang 'tsham gyis slob ma'i rgyud la nges shes skyes pa la gzo bar byas na lta ba rtogs par byed du yod/ bka' gdams pa dang bka' brgyud gong ma phal cher gyis tha snyad rags pas 'khrid pa yang de 'dra ba zhig yin/ gzhung la legs par sbyangs pa zhig yin na bstan bcos nas 'byung ba'i rigs pa de dag yang yang sems par byas/ de yang rgyud thog tu myong ba la bkar nas bsam dgos/ dpyod pa'i skabs su rigs pa ha cang tshig la yam nas 'chal grab byung na 'phro rgod kyi skyon 'byung nyen yod pas gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi rigs pa'i gnad la sems dril nas dpyad cing dpyad mthar 'jog pa spel mar byed dgos/ dpyad sgom skabs kyi glan te 'jog pa dang / nye bar 'jog pa'i sems gnas kyang de 'dra zhig la zer/ de ltar rnam rig pa'i lta ba 'di sgom tshul sharnyi pa'i sher phyin man ngag sogs la brten nas legs par bsgom shes na/de nyid bde chen dang sbyor ba sogs la 'dris par byas pas sngags bla med kyi rdzogs rim sna zin tsam la sleb thub/ de nas dbu ma chen por 'gyur

646 mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/pa yang sla ba zhig yod/ rang rgyud pa lugs gnyis kyi lta ba la 'khrid na yang myur tshabs che ste/ rnam rig pa dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang thal 'gyur ba rnams dgag bya'i ngos 'dzin rim gyis phra ru 'gro ba yin pas/sems de kho na nyid kyi gting la 'jus/ pa yang rim gyis 'khrid na phan sleb che/ 'on kyang da ltar gyi las dang po pa rnams la yang tshe sngon ma'i sbyangs 'phro sad pa'am bsod nams kyi bsags rgyab che ba dang / tshe 'dir yang lha dang bla ma la dad pa brtan pos bsag sbyang la 'bad de byin rlabs zhugs pa nams la dang po nas thal 'gyur pa'i lta ba bstan na rtogs sla ba'i rigs kyang yod pas/ bag chags 'jog lugs rgyud tshod dang bstun pa shes dgos/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon por song ba'i skabs su yang sems bden grub dang chos nyid bden grub sogs rtsa ba nas med mod spyang / nang sems kyi 'khyer so 'ga' zhig la sems tsam pa'i rigs pa 'di dag bogs 'don du 'gro ba zhig yod pas/ dben sa bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gtam de yang don che bar yod/ le'u gsum pa 'dir chos kyi bdag med rgyas par gtan la phabs pa dang / sngar le'u gnyis par snying rje chen po'i skor bshad pa rnams snying rje chen po des drangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang zung du 'brel te nyams su blangs na skyes bu chen po'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ le'u bzhi pa ni/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag tu mkho ba yin nga/sa/ sngar le'u gnyis pa dang gsum par theg pa che chung gi lam gtan la phabs nas rang gis/ ji ltar rtogs pa'i don de dag tshig lhag chad nor gsum dang bral ba'i sgo nas

mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 641gzhan la 'doms par byed pa de/ rang gis mthong don rab gsal byed/ /ces pa'i don yang de yin la/ gdul bya la 'chad pa/'i tshe gzhung lugs gdaspe sa par shar ba'i mkhas pa zhig yin phyin/ pha rol po'i blo tshod dang bstun nas lung rigs dang mi 'gal zhing blo la 'char sla ba yid ches kyi nges pa bskyed pa ha cang bshad pa dang / ma bshad pa dang / log par bshad pa'i skyon gsum dang bral ba'i sgo nas rgyud la phan thogs pa'i nyams len byed tshul la bkri ba gal che zhing / de yang le'u 'di nas bshad pa dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyi mngon pa kun btus kyi 'bel gtam rnam par nges pa'i le'u sogs la brten nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa byed tshul gnad du 'gro ba shes na mkhas pa'i grangs su 'gro zhing bstan pa la phan pa 'ong ba yin/ don las ring du gol ba'i n+dig 'khri dang / kho 'di zer na nga 'di zer gyi gshag 'gyed pa la rno ba kho na rang gis slob cing /gzhan la'ang tshul de kho na 'khrid pa ni rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i dgos pa gzhi nas stor ba yin cing / tshul de la gos rgas su brtson par byed pa ni rang gzhan gang la yang phan pa med pas snying po dang bral ba kho na'o/ /de ltar rnam 'grel gyi gzhung 'di byang chub lam gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la shin tu mkho zhing / gdams ngag la nang byan tshud pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin tshul shes par gyis/ don bsdu na/ thar pa'i khang bzang mchog la 'jug pa'i sgo 'byed pa la sgo de'i sgo lcags dam po 'byed pa'i lde mig 'phrul can zhig dgos pas/ le'u dang por rigs pa yang dag dang ltar snang gi khyad par zhib tu shes par byed pa

648 mnal lam gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ni rigs pa'i 'phrul gyi lde mig bzo ba yin/ de nas ma rtogs 'o/ga rtog the tshom gyi dbang du mi 'gro zhing gzhan gyis log par bstan pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar thar pa'i sgo lcags 'byed pa ni/ le'u dang po'i rigs pa'i lde mig de nyid kyis sgo lcags legs par bkrol nas sgo 'byed pa ni le'u gnyis pasazubastan pa'i rnam bzhag de kas 'byed pa yin/ de nas thar ba 'i khang bzang de nyid kyi nang gi mdzes pa dang sdug pa dang zhi ba yid du 'ong ba'i khyad par rnams legs par mthong bas yid gzhan du mi ldog pa'i bsam pa brtan po thob pa ni/ le'u gsum pa nas bshad pa'i chos kyi bdag med de kho na nyid snying rje chen po dang 'brel nas nyams su len shes pa la byed pa yin/ de nas blo dang ldan pa'i skal ba bzang po can gyi gdul bya rnams rang gis ji ltar mthong ba'i thar pa'i khang bzang chen po der 'khrid par byed pa ni le'u bzhi bar bshad pa de rnams yin zer ba'i mur ha ha zhes pa lta bu'i sgra chen po zhig bsgrags nas btsun chung de yang mi snang bar gyur/ rang gi sngas mgo la bltas pas mal yol gyi phyi der me chen po 'dom gang lhag tsam 'bar ba zhig mthong byung / da khang ba la me 'jigs yong e 'gro snyam du ha cang 'jigs sngangs med pa'i sems tshab tshub ngang nas spos phor nas 'bar ba yin shas che snyam du lag pa gnyis brkyangs te spos phor yin tshe go sa spor dgos snyam du nom nyug byas pas/ gzhi lcags lta bu la nyagaser gyi pad ris mdzes pa 'bur tshugs su yod pa'i snod chen po zhig gi khar pad+ma'i lo ma'i thal ba yin nam snyam pa'i mdog dkar ba'i phye ma zhig gis bkang bar bdal ba la/ sol ba dang shing bu sogs ci yang

menal 5ma spyo snang bar rje btsu na'ajam dbyanges las walagi sdim/— thasan tshu lha/ 641med par me lce gyen du 'bar ba 'dom sa/nga lhag tsam 'ur sgra dang tshegs sgra che ba me'i tsha tsha du ma 'phro ba mdog sa/ser lta bu la dmar sharu ju cung zad yod pa zhig 'bar gyin 'dug snod de che ba zhig snang bas shugs kyis 'degs snyam tsa na shin du yang zhing 'jam pa zhig 'dug me de lus la phog pa kyi| tsha sreg gi reg bya med par dro zhing 'jam la bde ba zhig snang / da me 'di mched na khang pa la skyon yong dwogs che bas phyir 'don dgos pa 'dra snyam skad chen pos grwa pa rnams bos pas// dar ceg na btsun chung mgo che ba gzugs sbom zhing thung ba gos ser po gyon pa zhis/ sleb byung bar khyod su yin dris pas nga rgyal mtshan yin zer bas/ nged kyi grwa khrod na su nyid rgyal mtshan zer ba zhig yod pas de yin snyam nas me 'di phar 'don grogs gyis byas pas/ pre+o/ 'dzum tsam byas nas me 'dis gang la'ang gnod mi 'gro/khyod sems ba de mo gyis/ zer ba'i mur btsun chung de dang me snod dang bcas pa yang mi 'dug nga'i mig kyang sngar rgyun ltar mi gas la ba'i bab de kar 'dug de nas skad phyung ste/ khos zhes bos pas 'jam dbyangs zhes pa'i grwa pa ngo ma des slebs byung / khyod kyis spo sa phor gar bzhag me chen po 'bar gyin 'dug pa byas pa sa kho ha thang ba lta bus ci zer 'di na me ye med pa zer gyin 'dug da gzod rgyal mtshan gyis me khyer tshod yin byas pas/ kho na re/ rgyal ca/tshan zer ba 'di na su yang med zer/ de nas nang du bsam mno cig btang bas sngar gyi de rnams nyams 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin par gzod go / bzang ngan ci yin ni ma shes/ gzhung lugs/ kyi gtam 'di rnams ni gnad che zhing legs pa 'dra ba zhig snang / semasadzo ḍi

650 mnal lam spyo snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las lam ram̐m gsan tshul/ spro dga' zhig kyang skyes/ de nas nam langs pa na drung du yod pa rnams la rang nyid spro nyams kyi rmi lam 'di 'dra zhig rmis zhes zur tsam smras pas/nye gnas ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' dang /gi os lod dge slong ngag dbang chos 'phel sogs kyis phyag 'tshal nas cis kyang yi ger 'khod pa zhu zer gyin 'dug nged kyang nyams 'ur bas yong 'gro zhes khas len thal song bar brten slar tshig rnams sems la ma brjed par bkra lam me 'dug pas ji ltar smras pa bzhin shog dril du 'bebs pa po ni chos rje thub bstan dar rgyas kyis bgyis pa'o/ /sngar gyi tshig de dag kyang rmi lam du ji ltar byung ba bzo bcos med par kyu ru lugs su bris pa yin pas/gzhung dang yig cha gzhan sogs dang bsdur nas lta ba ma byas pas gzhanagyi dang mthun mi mthun gang yin kyang / 'di la sus kyang bcos slad med pa zhu zhing / deng dus kyi mi rnams yid ches dka' bas mang po la mi ston pa'i gsang rgya byas na legs so/ /smras pa/ sna tshogs srid dang zhi ba'i 'khrul 'khir 'di ni rang rig mes pos sprul pa las gzhan gang du ci zhig yod/ /rdzun pa las kyang rdzun pa'i chos la bden par zhen pa blo ldan blo la rnam pa kun tu cher mi 'tsham//de lta mod kyi rdzun pa yis kyang bden pa'i dngos po rnam par mthong ba rten 'byung zab mo'i ngo mtshar gshis/ /kye ma gtam 'di dag kyang la la'i snying la bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur bar srid dam snyam du kho bo sems/ /rigs smras gdengs can stong gis rol pa'i phul byung gzhung bzang chu gter che//gzhon nu'i lus mdzes ye shes lhun pos rnam par 'phrul pas bsrubs pa — bhe

minal lam gyi snang bar sde btsan 'jam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshul/ 631las/ / snying po'i don mchog bde 'byung gtsug rgyan bdag blo'i rgyan du shar ba 'dis/ /skal ldan ku mud tshal la legs pa'i shas kyis kun tu dge ba ci yang bgyis/ /gang gi thugs rje'i spyan ras rto+oṅge+od kyi cha shas snying la reg pas kyang / /dri med gzhung mang don za(— ma lus ri mor bris ltar legs ston pa/ /mkhyen pa'i gterade'i bka' drin byang chub bar du gzhal bar mi sprobs pas/ /byang chen thob kyang khyod zhabs spyi bor bsten no thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ /las nyon rba rlabs drag tu 'khrugs pa'i gting zab srid pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /brnag dka' sdurga/ bsngal gsum gyi 'dzin khris bar mtshams med par gtses pa yi/ /'gro ba 'di kun sgrol la mthu chen dpa' bo chen por bdag gyur te/ /sgrib bral ye shes bdud rtsi'i dga' bas rtag tu dbugs 'byin byed gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rnam 'dren sras bcas rnams kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du//rten 'byung gtam gyi chos sgra sgrogs la nam yang mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i//rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i khur chen khyer la gzhan dring mi 'jog pas / /stobs bcu'i mnga' ba kun la phul byung dgyes pa bskyed par bdag gyur cig /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen dkrigs pa'i thub bstan rgya mtsho chen po 'di/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i mkhas grub gdengs can bye bas yongs su bzung ba las / /skye rgu mtha' dag log par lta ba'i lam du nam yang mi phyogs pa'i/ /bkra shis rab dkar lbu ba srid rtser 'phyur ba'i dpal mo nyams pa med gyur cig /gnas skabs su yang gang zhig bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam dang sgo gsum skad

0652 zuganar lam gyi snangabaX che ḍitsuna'ajam dbyangs las lam rim gsan tshu/la/ cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing / /byang chub sems gnyis spyod dang bcas la brtan pa'i blo gros mthu thob ste/ /gtan du bde ba'i 'byor pa ma/chog gis rnam pa ku/na tu rol gyur cig /ces gnyid mo che'i rmi lam gyi rol mtshor shar ba'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar zla ba'i snang brnyan ces bya ba 'di yang chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi snying po'i don phyogaso tsam mthong ba mang du thos pa'i rgyal khams pa dz+nyā na shā sa na su bhā paṃ khā li ta badz+ra zhes bya bas smras pa'i dge bas skye rgu thams cad rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /ces pa'o/ /chos kyi mnga' thang chen por dbang bsgyur cing / /chos kyi stobs kyis sa garmem ༷zil gyis gnon/ /chos kyi grags pa phyogs r+shacurno lhang nge ba//chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bla ma khyoshaṃ/ ༷ /chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbus na chos kyi dar+shazlo gyis mngon mtho chos kyi gzi 'od 'ashār pri'i ༷choḍā kyi rin chen lhuXn po dang / j-i /chos kyi blo spozlo mkha' las chos kyi tsha zerno spo khris chos kyi pad tshal rgyas byed chormi skyo nyin byed dbang po steX/ ༷ /chos kyi cha r+shas ༷yongs rdzogs chos kyi 'osgrod hūṃng dkar bos rtos kyi 'gal zla'i muni tsul chokha kyi zla ba gsal ༷ba ༷dang / /chos kyi rin ts+tshan skun 'byung chos kyi chu bo ku na shādus chos kyi gting mtha' datheg dika'i sdos sdi rgya mtsho che rnong r+yan/ /chos kyi garngodzu ri dge ba'i sar gnas shing / /chos kyi rtsal rdzogs spobasaX pah+pho g.yu ral gsig / choXs sdi nga ros log smra'i glasdo bo ༷'dar/ /rdos sngi seng chen dpal ldan bla ma khyod/ /chos sdi gru gzings brtan pos chos kyi sa ——

mnal lam gye snangabararjebatsuna'abamadatram̐ngaṭa/lasalamarizi gsanatshul/ 653phongaṭasmu pa'i sems can chos kyi rin che na gling skyeka chos/ kyi ded dpon chen po dang / /chodze+e/ kyi gte0ra 0mdzod phye ste chos kyi noram̐ gyiṅgi dbul rnams chokha sdi sbyin pas tshim mardzod chosu sri dā na pa ti r+ghaṃ/0 /chodze+e kyi spya 1/ racasdo yang sa rdzes rdos sdi sa/nas lugs ḍā/zi gas nas/ chog sngi lam bzeng 0ston 'e jad rdos sdi sa mkhan bzang po dang / /choXs sdi lang tsho dar bab dz+was sdi/ rgyan gos bzang ldan choXs sdi glu dbyangs snya/na sgro sa/sa chosdu sdi gar ma khan ma chog kyang yin/ /cho sa kyi spros pa rgya chen kun ma khyen cing / /chospreṭage bhe gnas lugs gzigs la sdob ༷rib bral/ /rdos sngi da migs pus mabyu rirge sdo+ongs rnams 'khrid/ /chodze+e kyi spyan mnga' dpal ldan bla ma khyod/ /chodze+e k+shi dbang phyug lhun chags 6sda0 sdi dga' bde'i ri sul chos sdi drang srong rgos shāstan chos kyi sa 'dzin nyarmoṅge dga' dang / /dzhas kyi khrims ldan 'du gnas ts+tshas skye yo byad kun tshang chog k+shi sgo mo mang phye cho/pre skyo kun dga' ra ba ste/ /chozlo skye khang bzang mdzes byed chos kyi spyod bzarngo rnyib lhub chokha sdi 'bras buh+pho rtog mdzes choṭa/ kyi rgyal marmon nyidam pa dang / /cho—sa skyi shās la nyer bskul chos kyi sgra ldabyasdos zab mo chos sdi mkha' las sgrog shā'iX choXs sdi rnga bo che yang rmin/༷ /chog kyi sku mnga' k+ṣiṃd cho phyag 'tshal zhing / /chothe bzhin sgrub pa'i myog chod pa dartsa/ pa 'bul/ /choXs dang 'gal bar bgyis rnams 'gyod pas bshagaṭa// /ོ༷ rnga 5 mthun rnam thar bzang por rjeru/ yi rangs /chos 'khor zab cing rgya che bskor bar bskul/ /chokha kyi don du brtan par bahūṃgs gsol 'debs/ /chosdu ldan dge ba dudu/ gsum ci bas gas kun//chos gzugs sku gnyis thob pa'i rgyu ru bsdo/ /

zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes bsnan pa3 sgronu me dpaXl bsdung sdo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjishaṃ pa dasge ldarno bstane the'i mdzes rgyan las/ mnal lam 'od gsal gyi snang bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sa tshad ma'i lam rim gsan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //

6tsabyiṭ+wāṃ lketu nyen lnga bra/ rnan ldan gyi don brasdus puzhi tshulka/cho da ni sa bcad gnyis pa rnam thar gyi don bsdu ba la 'jug par bya ste/de yang mnyam med tsong kha pa chen pos byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mor mdzad pa po'i che ba 'chad skabs/ lha gcig dri paṃ ka ra'i rnam par thar pa gsungs pa'i sa bcad ji lta ba bzhin 'god par 'dod pas/ 'di la gsum/ rigs ci lta bur skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul/ rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ brnyes nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta la sku 'khrungs nas lo grangs nyis stong drug brgya dang sum cu so gnyis 'das pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me mo bya'i lo la/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid mdo smad byang phyogs gyi sa'i thig ler bstan 'gro'i dpal du sku 'khrungs par gyur to/ /de yang skyes bu dam pa 'gro ba'i don du bsams bzhin du skye ba 'dzin pa rnams ni rigs rus dang stobs 'byor sogs la mi gzigs par rgyu mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa'i yab yum gyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i tshul ston par byed pas na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi yab yum du gyur pa'i las can de gnyis ni/ spyir rgyal po zas gtsang dang / sgyu 'phrul ma chen mo'i sdon gyi 'byung ba dang mthun par ring mo zhig nas rgyal ba'i sras po 'di nyid skyed par byed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba

656 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsags shing smṛ na lam rlabs po che mang du btab pa zhig yin pa ba /zhir bcas kyang / 'phral snang la rirga/sa rus stobs 'byor sogs shin tu zhan cing / rje gong ma grwa slob dang bcas ba la 'brel ba cung zad kyang med par ma zad ming tsam yang thos ma myong bas/ sprul sku 'khrungs rgyu'i dwogs pa tsam yang med pa zhig ste/ bla ma dam pa bsams bzhin du 'di lta bu'i khyim du skye srid 'dzin pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga'i bstan pa la rigs dang rus mi gtso chos gtso ba yin no zhes gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa shā ri'i bus/ ha cang phyug pa'i khyim dang ni/ /dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i khyim du skyes nas kyang / /rab tu 'byung bar byed par shog /ces smon pa mdzad pa dang rjes su myori/thun par sgrub pa'i ched dang / yab rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal nas// 'byor ldan grwa pa bcu lhag yod phyin chad/ /shi nas 'dzam bu gling du skye nges shing / /de yang sdon gyi nye rigs sbyin bdag la/ /cis kyang rang dbang med par skye dgos pa'i/ /deng dus sku skye rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang stobs 'byor 'khor g.yog sbyin bdag sogs 'dzom zhing / bla ma'am mkhan po'am chos rje zhes 'bo7 sni pa'i ming can zhig yin phyin mi tshe hril gyis mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga sogs mi dge ba'i lasdo/ la bag med du spyo da kyang / shi ba'i 'og tu cis kyang mi'i nang du skyes te che ge mo'i sku skye ni 'di'o zhes ston rgyu zhig yod dgos par ma zad/ rab tu na rigs rus mi 'jing longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa zhig gi khyim dang / gal te de lta bu ma rnyed na rang gi nye

rnam thar gyi don bsdu sa pa'i tshul/ 657rigs sbyin bdag lta bu 'brel che ba zhig gi bur cis kyang skye ba len du re bas/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ la sa 'bras kyi rnam bzhag gsungs pa mngon sum du sun phyung nas bcom ldan 'das tshad ma'i skyes bu bzhugs gral nas bton te/ rdzun smra'i gang zag gi gral du 'dzud par nye ba'i mig ltos ngan pa mtha' dbus kyi yul gru kun tu dar che bas de dag la co 'dri zhing nyams smad par bya ba'i ched yin par kho bo cag sems so/ /bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku'i dbyibs dang gsung gi gdangs thugs kyi dkyel rnams la'ang khyad chos mthun snang du grub pa mang po zhig mchis teṭ+wāṃsku kho lag yangs shing chu zheng gab pa phyag dang zhabs rnam/sa tshod dang 'tsham pa la zhabs mthil snyoms shing phyag gi sor mo rnams mi dkyus ma'i sor mo las ring ba dang / dbu gdugs ltar rgyas shing spyi gtsug mngon par mtho ba zhig yod/ snyan g.yas kyi 'gram du nor bu'i dbyibs lta bu'i 'bur bo zhig mchis te/ rje gong ma ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan pa la yang snyan rgyan de lta bu zhig yod 'dug cing / sku snga phyi gnyis kas 'bral spangs su mdzad pa'i rje bla ma'i sku brnyan thugs gcigs shin tu che ba zhig yod pa la'ang zhal 'gram g.yas par rtags mtshan de 'dra zhig gsal bar snang ngo / / rje gong tso'i sku dus su sku brnyan gyi rtags mtshan de skabs 'ga' zhig tu chung ngu 'gro dus phyag rdzas sogs cung zad bri ba dang / che ru 'gro dus 'phel ba zhig pong gi yod ces bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas dngos su thos so/ / rtags na/tshan 'di 'dra ni rje bla ma skyu snga phyi rgyal ba tsong kha pa rnams ngo

658 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/bo gcig tu mtshon pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i re khā nyid do snyam du kho bo sems so /gsung shin tu mtho la gdangs snyan pas tshogs chen po dang lhan du zhal 'don sogs mdzad skabs rje bla ma'i gsung gzhan thams cad las lhang lhang gsal ba zhig yod cing / bstod dbyangs dang nyams mgur sogs kyi 'gyur khug sogs gnang ba la shin tu mnyen cing snyan cha che ba thos pas yid 'phrog pa dang / chos gsungs pa'i tshe tshogs ci tsam che yang mtha' dbus med pas gsal bar thos shing / yun ring po'i bar du 'chad par mdzad pa sogs kyis gre ba 'dzer ba dang gsung gdangs zhan du 'gro ba sogs gtan nas med do/ /thugs dkyel shin tu che ba zhig ste/bya ba gang la'ang gya tshom du 'jug pa mi mdzad par/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ gang zhig lus ngag yid kyi las/ /thams cad legs par yongs rtogs te/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan shes nas/ /rtag tu byed pa de mkhas pa/ /zhes dang / legs bshad las/ mi gang skye bo dam pa dang / / dman pa'i khyad par legs brtags nas/ /de yi bya ba sgrub shes pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi chen yin/ /zhes sa/sungs pa ltar/ phral phugs kyi khe nyen sogs la zhib tu dgongs nas 'dor len gang 'os mdzad 6 /chis shing / gong ma'i las don 'gangs che ba mang po dus gcig tu gtad pa na yang tshab tshub dang brel ba mi mdzad par lhod kyis gnang ba dang / rkyen bzang ngan ci la yang dga' sdug gi rnam par mngon pa cung zad kyadi mi mdzad la/ sne bo ngan pas sku la bsdo ba dang mi

rnam thar gyi don brnas pa'i tshul/ 659 snyan par sgrogs pa gsan kyang / sdud pa las/ gal te gzhan las ngan brjod tshig rtsub thos gyur na/ /bdag bde yin/ zhes byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgong rme nas/ zhal ras 'dzum 'bol le thugs nyams dga' yal le bzhugs pa las ma dgyes pa'i rnam pa ye mi ston/ phra ma zhu mkhan gyi rigs la phral du rdzun phug 'don pa'i gsung rnon po gnang bas sus kyang phra ma mi chud cing / kha gsag dang g.yo sgyu'i tshig rnams kyang de ma thag mkhyen nas dang du mi bzhes/ rkyen thog babs su byung ba la spyod 'jug las gsungs pa'i/ gal te bcos su yod na ni/ /de la mi dgar bya mi dgos/ /gal te bcos su med na ni/ / de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ /zhes pa dang / bye ma'i khang bu gib gyur na/ /byis pa rnams ni ga chad du/ /de bzhin bstod dang gragasanyams na/ /rang gi sems ni byis pa bzhin/ /zhes sogs gsungs shingalhod 'bol gyis bzhugs pa sogs mdor na/ rnga sgra'i tshigs bcad las/gshe dang gya tshom smra ba dang / /tshig ngan smra bar byed pa la/ /mkhas pa shin tu bzod byed pa/ /glang chen me tog char pa bzhin/ /khro ba dag ni rdzun dag dang / /tshig ngan smra bar byed pa la/ /mkhas pa shes rab ldanasagyur pa/ /gang yin des ni thams cad bzod/ /rdo ba sreg kyang 'ju mi 'gyur/ /char ba babs kyang 'jig pa med/ /de bzhin bde dang sdug bsngal gyis/ /mkhas pa nyams pa 'gyur ba med/ /de la mkhas pas bzod par byed/ /bden pa min pa yang bzod de/ /de las gzhan pa bstan du med/ /ces dang / sdeng po bkod pa'i mdo

660 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ las/ dgra dang gros/sa la ri bo 'dra ba ste/ /rgya mtsha bzhin du mi 'khrugs sems dang ldanachi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngeng tshul bdag gir bzhes pa mdzad do/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten gyi blo ngo dang bstun pa'i ya mtshan cha shas tsam gleng ba yin gyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ rgyal sras nyan rang dang bcas pas kyang brjod kyis mi lang na bdag lta bus phyogs tsam yang mtshon par ga la nus te/ rje bla mas/khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi/ /tshul 'di rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos kyis/ /ji tsa ma brtags kyang blo yi yul min na/ /tshangs dang dbang po sogs kyis smos ci 'tshal/ /mkha' lding dbang pos mkha2 la bgrod bgrod nas/ /nam zhig rang stobs bri bas ldog 'gyur gyi/ /nam mkha' zad pas ldog par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /khyod kyi yon tan brjod pa'ang de ltar lags/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gang sku gser zhun brtsegs pa'i lhun por 'gran/ /zhal dkyil gang ba'i zla bar co 'dri byed/ /spyan zung mthing gi ut+pal dpal la 'khu/ /mchu sgros pad+ma 'dzum pa'i ngo mtshar 'dzin/ /srid zhi'i ya mtshan kun 'dus sku mchog gi /ba spu gcig gi yon tan rin chen phreng / /bskal mang srad bur bsta/ra te 'gro 'di yis/ /'bad pas bgrangs kyang rdzogs pa'i ma tha' dang bral/ /'gro ba kuno gyi yid bzhin du/ /'artswag pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma yang / /'chi med go 'phang ster ‘ 4'i sman//spangs rtogs chu klung 'bum 'khyil ba'i/ /bde chen mi rtog thugs kyi mtsho / / bstan 'gror phan pa ro gcig pa'i/ /rnam thar bdud rtsi 'i

rnam thar gyi rdon bkus pa'i tshul/ 661rlabs mang g.yo/ /phral gyi mdzad spyod cha shas phra mo yang / /gzhan phan snying la mngar ba'i ro sngo bas/ /su zhig drung du bsnyen kyang4 bur shing gi /tshal du zhugs pa bzhin du dga' bhas tshim/ /e ma gang gi bka' drin gyi/ / sos ka'i dpal dang 'grogs pa yi/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi zhing sa kun/ / dge legs myu gus khyab par gyur/ /gnyis pa rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul la ga/nyis/ mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan brnyes/ pa'i tshul dang / tshul bzhin sgrub pa rtogs pa'i yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul 'o( dang po ni/ deng sang bstan 'gro'i don du bsams bzhin du skye ba bzung bar khas 'che ba'i sprul sku'am sku skyer grags pa chos kyi bya bar ming btags pa'i chos brgyad kyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig bskor/ bstan pa'i don yin pa skad kyis bstan pa rmang nas 'jig pa'i la sa/ byed/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yin zer nas sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa thams cad khyad du gsod/'jig rten 'dren par rloms kyang 'jig rten rgad po 'a sa lod pa 'di dag gi ngang tshul la chos mthun gyi rnam thar bzang po'i dri tsam yang mi bro bas ngan skyugs kyi phung po brdal ba bzhin du blo gros dang ldan pa rnams skyugs bro ba la sa bstan 'gro la phan par 'gyur ba til 'bru tsam yang ma mchis la/'phags bod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu grangs las 'das pa byon pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i sdom lta bu ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob darī+o/na dbyig gi gnyen pos/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhis dang / ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ — —/—

66kle rnam tharagyildanabasnusapa'itshul/ da —————lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi tshur+ṣari /m+bims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas thos bsam sgom gsushu— tsu gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba byed pa 'di kho na las ma mchis shing / der ma 'dus pa dang de las mchog tu gyur pa'i mdzad pa gzhan ston rgyu yang med do/ /don de la dgongs nas rje bla mas kyang rang nyid kyi rtogs brjod du/dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du pa sngo sa/ /zhes bka' stsal pa yin no/ /theṇa grub de dag gi khrod du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa gzhir bcas kyang / ngas ni chos thams cad thugs su chud zin pas gsar du thos pa sogs byed pa la ltos pa med do zhes mi gsung bar las dang po pa dang mthun par bstan pa la rim gyis slob pa'i tshul mdzad pa ni/ gdul bya thun mong la don du 'gyur zhing bstan pa spyi khyab la phan che ba'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /de bas na bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis kyang chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sogs sngon byon gyi mkhas grub tshad ldan de dag gi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun pa mdzad pa'i tshul zhib par gong du smori tha zin pa ltar la/ 'dir ni de dag gi don bsdus pa'i sdom lta bu 'god par bya ste/

nem thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 663mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims la thug par gzigs nas sdom khrims mnos te khas blangs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad sku srog las kyang gces par bsrung ba gzhir mdzod cing / de nas mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las kyang yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes dang / byang chub lam rim chen mo las/ sangs rgyas thob pa la thob byed kyi lam la slob dgos/ slob pa la shes dgos/ shes pa la thos dgos/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni sgom byung gi 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin la/ sgom byung gi shes rab sgom pa 'ba' zhig las 'byung zhing / sgom rnam dag byed pa la bsam pas nges shes 'dren pa sngon du 'gro dgo sa/ de la thos pa ma nor ba zhig byed dgos pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rgyu med rkyen med du mi 'byung bas de'i rgyu la bslab dgos shing / bslab tshul thos nas shes par bya dgos pas na dang po thos pa rgya chen po mdzad dgos par dgongs te/ cathos pa gang la bya ba'i gzhi ni/ bdag cag lta bu'i dbang po tha shal du gyur pa rnams ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbos pa rgya chen po dor te/bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ lam gyi gnad thams cad tshang ba'i man ngag

664 —/rnam tharagyidon bsdus pa'i tshul/ mdor bsduru/ pa tsam re thos na sa nyams su blangs pas kyang dgos pa 'grub par 'gyur mod kyang / gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ rje bla ma rang nyid kyi gsung las/ gzhan don byed la dpa' ba'i sems dpa' yis/ /rigs can gsum gyi sman pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ / mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad la/ /thos bsam sgom pas nges par slob dgos pa/ /rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /dgongs don snying por mi pham mgon gyis bshad/ /ces t+pā/sungs pa ltar gdul bya rigs can gsum ka rjes su 'dzin dgos pas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad la slob dgos pa rgyan gyi mchod brjod skabs nas gsungs shing / drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i dngos po lnga la ma bslabs na ni/ nam du yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mi nus so/ /de bas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir rig pa'i dngos po lnga la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du byang sa'i chos 'tshol gyi le'u las kyang gsungs shing / mdo sde rgyan las/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen brnyes mi 'gyur bas/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /padag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la des brtson bya/ /zhes pa dang / spyod 'jug las kyang / rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slo ba pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gdul bya mos pa sna tshogs pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du shes bya'i gnas thams cad

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 665la slob par gsungs pas na/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid skyes rig pa'i gnas thams cad bugs su chud par mdzod pa las katso bor gyur pa nang rig pa'i sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad tshul gong du bris zin pa ltar yin cing / de yang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ lta ba'i mthar thug dbu ma'ang de nyid don/ /bden 'dzin gnyen por bsgom phyir mi slob par/ /grangs 'dzin phyir dang gang shes tshogs nang du/ /smra phyir 'bad pa bdag 'dzin gsos 'debs yin/ / blang dor gnas dang lam gyi yan lag kun/ /tshad mas gtan la dbab phyir ma yin par/ /mang po'i dbus su 'gran zla zil mnan nas/ / gzhan ngor grub phyir 'bad pa'ang chos min yin/ /gzhung lugs don la cha tsam ma reg pa'i/ /rdzas ldog nas bzung chos can zol 'jog sogs/ /'bad nas slob pa kun slong skyon med na/ /lung ma bstan gyi las su 'gyur ba tsam/ /chags sdang phrag dog 'gran sems drag po dang / /mi gzugs tshol phyir thos bsam sgom gsum la/ /ji tsam 'bad kyang chos min du ma'i sbo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zer tshad kha phyir bltas su so/nga nas rang rgyud skam grog ge lus pa'i deng sang gi mtshan nyid pa g.yag rwa bzhin du gyong zhing 'khyogs pa zhig tu song na 'phung tshabs de las che ba med pas/ de la dgongs nas rdzo mi las kyang ras chung pa la/khyod sgom chen stan brdol zhig yong du re ba la/ /rtsod yig 'di yi mang lugs kyis/ /ston chen lham brdol zhig 'byung gis dwogs/ /zhes gsungasapa yin par 'dug bla ma dam pa 'dis kyang tshul de bugs la

666 rnam thar gyi dod ngasdus pa'i tshul/dgongs nas gzhung lugs chen mo rnams la thos bsam mdzad pa thams cad rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu 'khyer ba bka' gdams gzhung pa pa'i dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do//rig pa'i gnas gzhan yang gong du bshad pa ltar ka tsan dbyangs can sgra mdo dang bcas pa mtha' dag thugs su chud cing / sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug sogs bod kyi brda' sprod kyi gtsug lag rnams dang / sgra'i yan lag tu gyur pa brit+ta dza ti'i sdeb spyor kyang dpyis phyin pa mkhyen no/ /'jam sdud bzang gsum la sngon gyi 'gyur rnying zhig gi phyag dpe byung ba la bris nor rim brgyud kyis ma dag pa tshan che ba 'dug pa rnams rje bla ma nyid kyis 'gyur la zhus chen dang skad dod nyams pa rnams saskṛ ta'i skad kyis dag par bcos te/ lalca dang bod yig gis skad gnyis shan sbyar ba'i glegs bam gsar du bskrun pa gnang zhing / rje bla ma rang nyid sku na gzhon dus mdo phran 'ga' zhig saskṛ ta'i skad kyis zhal 'don mdzad ces kyang thos so//snyan dngags ni deng sang dpe don 'phrod tsam la ming gi mngon brjod re gnyis sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad dam dum byed shes pa la snyan dngags mkhan du rlom zhing sgrogs par byed pa ches mang du snang la/ mkhas par grags pa la las spel ba'i snyan dngags kyi phreng ba 'gran zla med pa'i lugs su byed pa 'ga' zhig kyang zhib tu dpyad na/ brjod bya la ngo mtshar ba ci yang med par tshig rna bar 'jebs pa 'ba' zhig gtso bor byas nas 'ja' tshon dang mtshungs par snying pos dben pa mthong cho/da/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis snyan dngags kyi tshig sbyor mdzad pa rnams ni don zab cing barming

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 667ba la tshig rna bar snya/na cing go bde ba dang / tshig gi nus pa 'don lugs gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa rgya gar mkhas pa'i snyan dngags lta bu zhig yod pa ni/ dge legs su byed pa'i gtam drang srong mngon par dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / theg pa chen por blo sbyong ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba sogs la bltas na shes par 'gyur ro//skar rtsis dang dbyangs 'char gyi skor yang ri mo 'gro ba tsam ma yin pa'i go ba dpyis phyin pa dang / nag rtsis kyi khungs rgya nag la thug pa'i dbang gis de skor la bod du sngar ma grags pa yang mang po zhig thugs su chud par snang ste/ dngos su zhal nas kyang rtsis kyi skor la deng sang nged dang zhabs drung blo bzang bstan rgyan gnyis kyis go ba rnyed pa tsam yang shes mkhan dkon pa 'dug bu ston gyi mkhas pa dga' bskyed 'di shes na rtsis kyi phugs skyel sa rnyed pa yod kyang / ji bzhin shes mkhan dkon pa snang zhes gsungs pa kho bos dngos su thos so/ /bzo rig la yang lus bzo lha sku'i phyag tshad dang dkyil 'khor gyi thig sogs zhib tu mkhyen pas spyan gyis mi gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad skabs su yang skabs shig dgos pa khyad par can zhig la dgongs nas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan shin tu che ba zhig gsar bskrun gnang bas/ de'i skabs su spra tshil gyi ma dpe bzhengs rgyu'i chag tshad rnams rje rang gis mdzad cing / sku'i dbyibs dang zhal nyams bying rnams phyag bzo gnang ba dang / do lon nor du bzhugs rgyu'i kun rig gi blos bslang gi thig kyang sku dngos kyis mdzad do//sku na phra dus phyag bris gnang ba'i gzab gshar gyi yi ge dang / lat+ta dang

da tsha8 rnam tharagyidon bsdus pa'i tshul/wartu la dang nā ga ra'i yi ge sogs kho bos kyang mjal bas shin tu ngos gtsang ba 'dug cing / rgya dang sog po'i yi ge sogs yig rigs mi 'dra ba gzhan yang mang po 'bri klog mkhyen par gda'o/ /ngag bzo mchog tu gyur pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ni smos mi dgos la/ gong du bshad zin pa ltar skad rigs sna tshogs dang / chos sde rnams su grags pa'i chos spyod kyi dbyangs dang / chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso'i gdangs dbyangs khungs ma ji snyed ci ga mchispu/ pa las 'di mi mkhyen bya ba med cing / de dag kyang grwa sa so so dang rgyud stod smad lta bu'i rang rang gi lugs kyi 'gyur khug 'degs 'jog yan chad ma 'dres pa'i zhib cha mkhyen pa zhig yod do/ / bzhi brgya pa las/ ji ltar kla klo skad gzhan gyis/ /bzung bar mi nus de bzhin du/ /'jig rten pa yis ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten bzung bar nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten rjes su bzung ba'i ched du 'jig rten pa'i skad kyi bye brag kyang rnam grangs du ma mkhyen pas/rgya dang sog po dang man ju rnams kyi skad rigs phal pa dang de dag gi skad kyis chos gsungs pa gang la yang tshig gi 'bru dang gdangs sogs gang ci nas so so'i nyams ji lta ba bzhin thon pa dang / bod skad la yang gtsang dbus lho kha 'phan po lta bu'i skad zur cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams dang /de bzhin du khams —pa dang a mdo sogs so so'i skad kyi bye brag thams cad rang skad ci 'dra ba sa/sung ba dang / a tsa ra'i 'phral skad kyang phal cher mkhyen pas dzo ska 'ga' zhig dang gsung gleng mdzad pa na khong tsho rang yul gyi mi dang gtam lab byed pa lta bu'i dga' pa bskyed pa zhig yod/ zhal

nem ra gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 669 nas/ nged bod du snga ma phyin skabs lha sar a tsa ra'i khrod du nang ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig yod 'dug pa skad ma go bas sus kyang paṇ+ḍi ta yin pa ma shes par snang tsho/ ngas kho dang gleng mo bgyis par shing gi ri na grub chen mi tra dzo ki bzhugs pa dang mjal bas sku bong da lta'i mi las nyis tshad kyis che ba rus rgyan dang stag sham gsol ba zhig 'dug shing gi ri'i mtha' dug chus bskor nas brgal mi thub 'dug pas chu'i tshur 'gram nas mthong ba yin tshul sogs rgya gar gyi gnas tshul mang po bshad byung / sgra'i dka' sa/nad mang tsam dris par bshad rgyu bzang po yod 'dug rung / nged saskṛ ta'i skad ma byang bas gting phyin pa mi shes zhes bdag cag la dngos su gsungs so/ /gsung 'phros phal ba'i rigs gnang ba na/ bzhad gad slong ba'i ched du gsungs pa rnams mi che chung thams cad kyis thos phral du bzhad gad 'phel zhing bsams na go ba chen po yo da pa dang / sdon gyi lo rgyus lta bu gsung ba yang ma 'dres pa dpyis phyin pa dang / bslab bya lta bu gnang na so so'i rgyud tshod dang 'tsham zhing sems la khrigs se 'bag pa dang / btsan brjid che ba'i brling po zhig gsungs na yang mchog dman su 'dra yin kyang bsams kyin 'jigs zhum zhum 'gro ba dang / nyam thag pa la dbugs 'byin pa'i gsung phebs pa na ci 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyis non kyang snying sang sang byed pa zhig yod/ gzhan gyi mtshang nas brjod pa sogs pha rol gyi sems la gnod pa'i tshig rtsub dregs zhan su la nam du'ang mi gsung ste/zhal nas / rma gzhan mkhas na 'tsho srid kyi/ /nyes pa'i tshig rma drubs pa thed/ /zer ba yin pas khyed cag phung krel kyi rgyu tshig rtswab nam yang ma smra

6lha0 /rnam thardahūṃdonabasdusapa'i tshul/zhig /ces yang yang 'doms par mdzad/ sku drung du byung ba'i mi la chos kyi gsung gleng gnang ba na kho rang gi blo dang 'tsham zhing thad kar don du gang 'gyur gsung ba zhig yod pas/ dad pa can la dkon mchog gi yon tan dad pa'i phan yon sogs gsungs nas gzengs bstod cing dga' bar byed/ de bzhin du gtong phod can la sbyin pa/ thos pa can la mkhas pa'i yon tan/ sdig pa las bzlog pa la tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / yang nyes spyod can gyi rigs la/ sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag sogs/ mdor na yul de nyes spyod las ldog pa'am/ rgyud kyi dge rtsa sngar yod gong 'phel du gtong ba'i phebs sgo stsol ba las/ khyod kyi des gang yang mi yong zer nas/ mi'i cung zad yong ba de med brlag la btang / rang gis de las lhag pa yong ba ci yang byed rgyu med pa'i deng sang gi dge bshes su hrornga5 pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyi bslab bya lta bu nam yang mi gsung ngo / /mdor na spu+od 'jug las/ smra na yid phebs 'brel ba dang / /don gas la yid du 'ong ba dang / /chags dang zhe sdang spangs pa dang / /'jam dang ran par smra bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rna bar snyan cing snying la 'bab pa'i gtam don dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig las/ mi dge ba bskyed pa'i rigs nam du yang mi gsungs so/ /yid bzo mchog tu gyur pa so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad pa dang nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs ni gong 'og tu smos pa bzhin yin la/yid bzo phal ba'i dbang du byas kyang / srog gcod pa'i khrims lta bus

rnam thar gyi don bkus pa'i tshul/ 671mtshon pa'i chos dang 'gal ba'i rigs ma gtogs pa'i srid skyong gi las don 'gangs che ba 'ga' zhig gong nas rje bla ma mchog la gsang stabs kyis gros 'dri ba gnang gi yod 'dug pas/ de rigs la blon po chen po 'jig rten gyi mes po lta bu rnams kyi blor ma shar ba'i dge legs su 'gyur ba'i 'dun ma bzang po srid skyong gi lugs dang mi 'gal zhing / chos dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig gsol bar mdzad pas/ rgyal blom/ thams cad kyis sus kyang ma dran pa 'di lta bu thugs la 'char ba zhes ngo mtshar du byed pa zhig yod par mchi'o/ /de'i dbang gis rgyal srid kyi bya ba rnams kyang /rin chen phreng ba las/ chos las rgyal srid bde ba dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu grags pa yi/ /bla re rgya chen 'byung 'gyur zhing / /blon po rnams kyang kun tu 'dud/ ci /ces gsungs pa ltar dge mtshan dang ldan pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang chos srid kyi bya ba gang la'ang thugs rab myur ba brjed nges chung ba brtan brling che ba gting khel ba sogs yid bzo'i gnas su bshad pa thams cad ma tshang ba med pa dang ldan no/ /gsung rab lta zhog rig byed kyi gtam rgyud 'ba' zhig kyang zad mi shes pa mkhyen cing / zhal nas ge sar sgrung 'di la deng sang mang po zhig shod gi 'dug pa phal che ba rtog btags kyi rdzun gtam kho nar 'dug nged la rdzun gtam ma 'dres ba'i khungs ma zhig bshad rgyu yod de zhes gsungs pa thos so/ /mkhyug dpyad dang mo phywa'i rigs kyang rnam grangs mang po zhig mkhyen kyang phyag len du mi mdzad la nyin gcig rgyal mo nong nas sdongs— pasdi sdon po rno mthong mo

672 gyu rnam thar gyi don bsus pa'i tshul/la shin tu mkhas par grags pa zhig la bcu thig gi rkyang bshad cig bka' 'dri zhib tu gnang bas kho shin tu dpa' zhum ste mgo phur phur byed pa kho bos kyang mthong / gzhan yang rten dang rol cha'i brtag pa/ mi rta'i dpyad pa/ gnam sa'i ltas kyi dpyad pa sogs mdor na shes bya'i gnas la mi mkhyen pa med do/ /gso ba rig pa la rtsa chu'i brtag pa dang / sman so so'i ngos 'dzin dang ro nus zhu rjes dang / nad kyi mtshan nyid dbye ba/so so'i zas sman spyod lam/ dpyad kyi sko ra dang bcas pa zhib tu mkhyen cing phyag len du'ang mdzad pas/ shin tu nyam thag pa'i nad pa 'ga' zhig dregs zhan la ma ltos par thugs shin tu brtse bas sku dngos kyis rtsa gzigs pa gnang zhing / phal cher dri bas ngos 'dzin pa mdzad de nad kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i sman gang yin pa stsol ba mdzad cing / thugs brebi ci tsam che yang sman zhu mkhan la le shor med par brtse bas bka' drin skyong bar mdzad pas/ shin tu 'chos dka' ba'i nad gzhi chen pos zin pas sman pa mkhas pa mang pos yal bar dor ba la rje 'dis thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ste sman dpyad mdzod pas srog rnyed pa yang grangs las 'das pa zhig byung ngo / /phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis sman sbyor ba'i tshe na yang gang byung byed mi 'jug par sbyor tshad sogs ma nor ba lag len mthong brgyud ji lta ba bzhin byed pa la nan tan mdzad cing / lo re'i sman sbyor ba yang 'tsho byed grags pa can gyis mi tsher sbyar ba tsam gyi tshod long ba snang ngo / /de ltar nang rig pa'i sde snod gsum dang / sgra tshad bzo gso ste rig gnas che ba lnga dang / snyan dngags sdeb sbyor ming gi mngon sbyor skar rtsis zlos

— rnam tharagyirdonabasasapa'itshulta/ sdo73 wagar te rig gnas chung ba lnga bcas/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shes lo thos lo tsam ma yin par sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad pas mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la mnga' brnyes so/ /thos pa'i sgron mes rmongs mun ma bsal na/ /rang nyid gar 'gro'i gtol med 'khyams 'gyur bas/ /blang dor gnas la 'thoms pari 'akro ba la/ /me khyer tsam gyi bya ba'ang nus ma yin/ /de lta na yang deng dus bsams bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i don du byon par zhal 'ches rnams/ /lha sku'i gsob bzhin mchod yul bzhugs pa las/ /mang du thos la khros pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin/ /mgon khyod thos bsam sgom pa'i pha rol tu/ /ring nas son kyang thar 'dod gdul bya la/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog gshegs pa'i lam 'di zhes/ /ston par bzhed nas dang por thos pa btsal/ /mkhas pa'i snying nor gnas lnga rig pa'i khur/ /cher rlom phur bu'i rna ba can dag gis/ /bor rnams brtson 'grus myos bum gzengs bstod nas//rnam dpyod spos kyi glang pos ci dgar bteg /de'i mthus dri mas yongs dag mkhyen rab khams/ /zla shel ltar dkar dngos po gcig nyid kyang / /rig byed tshen gyi kha dog sna tshogs par/ /'char ba'i go skabs mkha' bzhin yangs gyur te/ /kun rtog ri mo'i lam du mtshon min pa'i/ /gtsug lag 'phrul gyi sgeg mo'i bzhin mdzes la/ /'dris pa'i mkhyen dpyod spyan dkyus ring po'i tshad/ /rig byed bla ma yis kyang gzhal ma gyur/ /rig gnas 'chi ba med pa'i bcud bzang pos/ /ches cher myos pa'i nyams kyis sgeg pa khyod/ /dgyes pa'i glu ni mkhas pa'i rna ba la/ /rig

6lha4 rnam thar gyi don bkus pami tshul/ pa'i gsang tshig sgrog pa'i pho nyar gyur/ /tshangs pa'i yid la ma dran phur bu'i blos/ /dpyad par spobs min ngo mtshar 'dun ma'i gros/ /dpal gyi mgur las thon pas mi bdag srid/ /zla 'od kyis 'phyur mtsho ltar rgyas par mdzad/ /zhal gyi pad+ma gdams ngag sbrang rtsi'i gter/ /ljags kyi ral gri rgol ba 'joms pa'i mtshon/ /mgrin pa'i 'phang 'gro snyan dngags dbyangs kyi mdzod/ /ngo mtshar ma lus gcig tu khyod la rdzogs/ /gnyis pa tshul bzhin sgrub pa rtogs pa'i yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul la gnyis/ rtogs pa'i yon tan thus/sa rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i rgyu rngo+ogs bsten par mdzad pa'i tshul dang / de la brten nas yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de ltar bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid sku na gzhon nu'i dus nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgo ra rab tu byung / tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / rig pa'i gnas thams cad dang khyad par du nang rig pa'i sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan cing thugs su chud/ thos pa'i don rnams la dri ma med pa'i rigs par nges shes drangs te gzhung lugs thams cad gdams pa'i mchog tu gzigs te/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos/sngon bsags legs byas kyis 'phangs pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang / /rab 'bar me 'obs dang 'dra ba'i khyim gnas las phyung nas/ /mnyam

rtem thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 61byemed zas gtsang gi sras po'i bu rgyud du snyegs pa/ /bsams kyin blo bde'i nyams dbyangs shig len pa rang spro'o/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yi zhal nas sa/ dmas ngag gi nying khu/ /sde snod rin po che rnam gsum mdzub 'khrid du bstan nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gshegs bshul byang chub kyi sems la/ /yid ches gol sa las ldog pas zhe blo rang bde'o/ /zhes dang / 'khrul bral rgyud lung gi nges pas tshad ma ru grub cing / /chad med brgyud ldan gyi bla mar byin rlabs kyi bka' babs/ /ma dag dri ma kun sbyong nus dbang bzhi yi chu bo/ /snying gi zil dngar du thob pas zhe blo rang bde'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi thos bsam gnad du song ba'i gdengs tshad dang ldan par gyur pa na/ ji skad du/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ tshig 'khri'i lha bar dam bca'i stegs 'cha' zhing / /gzhan smod tshig mda'i sbyor ba lhur len dang / /go sa mthon por re bas dus 'das pa'i/ /bshes gnyen phal cher e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras/ /zhes dang / thob thob nyan nyan rnam grangs bsog bsog nas/ /rgyud la 'gel dus med pa'i slob ma rnams/ /dbul pos phyug po'i nor bgrang ngang tshul ltar/ /dgos dus rang la phan pa shin tu dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje dge 'dun grub kyis/ dgra nyon mongs 'dul thabs mi byed par/ /shag 'gyed pa tsam gyi 'chad nyan yang / /'dre shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ /glud nub sgor gtong bzhin don re chung / /zhes ga/sungs pa ltar/ deng sang gi dge ba'i bshes lha/nyen du rlom pa kha nas sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad

676 rnam ra gyi rdon bkus pa'i tshul/gtan la phabs kyang / rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len thun gcig tsam yang mi byed par shes tshad kha bshad du khyer nas tshe 'di 'ba' zhig la shi 'tham ro 'tham du song ste/ milha bdud du babs/ sman dug tu song / mtsho la me 'bar ba bzhin du chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'a gro dgos pa de'i grogs su song bas/ 'chi dus sde sdod gsum pa 'chi ba dang 'jig rten rgan po 'chi ba blo gdengs khyad par cung zad kyang med pa mang du snang bas/rje bla mas rang gi rjes 'jug rnams de lta bu'i skal ngan gyi ngang tshul tha chad pa las bzlog ste/ skyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /skye ba'i dzong las tshegs chung thar par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang shes rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len la 'bad nas / rab tu na phyin chad las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba len mi dgos pa dang / ma mtha' 'chi dus su 'gyod pa mi dgos pa zhig bya dgos par 'doms pa'i ched du/rje bla ma rang nyid kyang thun mong gi snang ngor sngar rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi don la thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu mdzad pa de rnams tshig tsam du ma bzhag par thugs nyams su bstar ba'i sgrub pa lhur bzhes pa la gzhol bar mdzad do// de yang mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / bslab btus las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nagag su gnas par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag la brtson par bya/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ de ltar 'dod la skyo byas te/ /dben pa la ni dga' ba bskyed/ /rtsod dang nyon mongs kyis stong pa/ /zhi ba'i nags kyi nang dag tu/ /skal ldan zla 'od tsan+dan

rnam thar gyi donabartsasapa'itshul/ 677 wagyis bsil ba'i/ /yangs pa'i rdo leb khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /sgra med zhi ba'i nags rlung g.yob pa yis/ /gzhan lartsophan don sems shing 'chag par bye sne / /ces sogs mdo dang bstan bcos las mang du gsungs shing / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / de phyir 'di snang chos brgyad spros pa'i rgya/ /shes rab ral gri rnon pos dral byas te/ /thub pas bsngags pa dben pa'i nags tshal der/ /sems khyod zhi ba'i bdud rtsi ci'i mi len/ /spang ljongs 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i lding khang du/ /zla ba nor bu'i rdo leb gcal du bkram/ /ga/yur gyisdog dud pa'i 'dab ma'i grib bsil la/ /nyin mo spyod pa'i rnal 'byor skyong bar spro/ /de bzhi na zla ba'i sgron me 'od 'bar zhing / /rgyu skar do shal rgod pa'i mtshan dus su/ /g.yeng med rnal 'byor brtson pa'i dañca/'a bde 'di'i/ /dpe yang srid pa gsum na ga la yod/ /pad+ma'i dra bas khebs pa'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /yongs mdzes chu bya'i tshogs rnams snyan sgrogs shing / /rma bya gzhon nu dga' ba'i gar byed pa'i/ /gnas der dal 'byor don ldan byas na snyam/ /me tog 'bras bus gang ba'i ljon shing gi /spu long mngon par rgyas pa'i sa 'dzin khrod/ /sngo ljang lo ma'i spyil chung nyams dga' bar/ /ting 'dzin dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par spro/ /gang du za zir g.yeng ba kun bor nas/ /ri skyibs nor bu'i phug yangs nyams dga' bar/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas dga' bde ba/nga / /de 'dra rgyal po rnams la'ang yod re skan/ /'chi med skyed tshal 'dra ba'i sman ljongs su/ /mi dge'i spyod tshul phra mo'ang rgyang bsrings te/ /sgo

678 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/gsum dam pa'i lam bzang skyon med par/ /ma bcos lhug par 'jog la snying nas spro/ /der ni thub gzhung bdud rtsi'i bcud len gyis/ /nyon mongs yid kyi rnag khrag kun sbyangs te/ /ting 'dzin sgo brgya phye nas yon tan gyi/ /ngo mtshar bgrang yas ltad mo blta bar smon/ /zhes sa/sungs pas mtshon mdor na rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis dben pa la bsngags pa mang du mdzad cing / 'phags bod kyi skyes/ bu dam pa phal mo ches dben pa bsten nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa dang dben pa'i yon tan gyis thugs drangs nas smon pa rgya cher gnang ba bzhin du/ rje btsun bla ma dayopa nyid kyang rtag tu dbe+en pa la gzhol ba'i thugs 'dun nar ma mdzad/ 'on kyang gyigong ma chen po'i mchod yul du bzhugs pa'i dbang gis dben pa'i gnas su gtan chags par bzhugs pa ma byung yang /dgung lo zhe brgyad thog mdo khams su dgon lung gi lung pa'i phu gsang sngags bde chen du dgun gyi ring bzhugs pa nas mgo brtsams te/ phyi lo nas bzung ji srid sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du lo ltar dbyar gyi ring ri bo rtse lngar byon nas 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba thams cad btsan chod mdzad de/bcad rgya shin tu dam po'i ngang nas mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa'i nyams bzhes la thugs gzhol bar mdzad do/ /deng sang 'ga' zhig skyo shas than thun skyes nas dben par 'gro 'dod kyang be+e'u rtod phur la btags pa bzhin/ 'di snang gi phun tshogs chung ngu re blos ma thong rbe dang bya ba phra mo re tsam grub ma zin pa la thogs te phyi bshol du lus pa mang du snang na/ bla ma dam pa 'dis 'khor bsgyur gyi dpal la 'than bzod pa'i yo lang dang /
