rnam thar gyi rdon bsdus pa'i tshul/ 679chos srid kyi bya bzhag gnad che zhing spong dka' ba du ma caca/ gyis bzhag nas dben pa bsten par mdzad pa 'di gcig pu yang bas ya gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa deng sang gi chen por rlom pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang tsam yang bya dka' ba'i gnas su snang ngo / /dus rgyun par yang snya ri'i 'khor lo la tshad 'dzin pa mdzad de sprel gyi dus tshod la slebs pa na ci lta bu'i thugs brel yod kyang mtshams 'jog pa gnang ste/ gzim phugs su phebs nas sang nyin nyi ma rdzogs par 'char gyi bar du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mdzad cing / de'i bar du 'osagyu med re gnyis ma gtogs dregs zhan su la yang mjal kha mi sa/nang zhing / gsol gzim ma gtogs phyag sa/yog pa gzhan su yang sku drung du 'gro sa med pas shin tu dben cing 'gol bar bzhugs pa dang / byes su phebs pa'i tshe yang phebs byang dang shing rta sogs la bzhugs pa nas tsha zhag gi sar ma phebs bar du do gal can re gnyis ma gtogs su la yang mjal kha mi gnang bar zhal 'don 'ba' zhig gsungs pa dang / zhag babs kyi sa yang mkhar chen po sogs mi tshogs che ba'i 'du long zar zir yod sar mi gnang bar de 'dra la khad ring ba'i gnas 'gol ba 'ba' zhig tu mdzad/ gyigong mar mjal phrad kyi ched du pho brang nang du byon nas cung zad sgug pa gnang dgos pa'i tshe rming gyigong ma'i nang 'khor gyi nyug rum pa sogs sku drung du 'ong ba rnams la gsung 'phros cher mi gnang bar thugs dam 'ba' zhig mdzad/ston mo dang ltad mo sogs kyi mi tshogs che ba'i nang du bzhugs dgos pa'i tshe yang de bzhin gnang zhing / de 'dra'i dus phal che ba la bzang spyod dang

680 rnam thar gyi don brtsas pa'i tshul/smon lam bdun cu ba sa/sungs pa kho bos yang yang thos pas mthong thos dran reg gi sems can de rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam rlabs po che mdzad pa yin par sems/ rgyun gyi thugs dam 'chag med kyi rim pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i skyes bu chung 'bring gi dmigs rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub sems sbyong la nan tan dang smon 'jug cho gas 'dzin pa dang bcas pa/ gsang ngade 'jigs gsum phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po rnams dang / khyad par du bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad cing / bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po yongs su grags pa rnams kyi gtor chog gcod stan thog gcig ma/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam/ bzang spyod/smon lam bdun cu pa sogs dang / mdo sdud pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u kha shas re bcas thugs dam gyi rim pa 'di rnams rgyun ldan du mdzad cid / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags kyi rigs kyang mang po zhig zhal 'don mdzad pa yin par snang ste/ nged kyis ma ṇi dung phyur gcig bton zin/ da cha bye ba kha shas song bas lo 'ab/'a ma shi na da dung dung phyur gcig 'gro ba 'dra zhes kho bo la dngos su gsungs/ de dus dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes skabs yin cing / de'i rjes su lo nyi shu zhugs pas dung phyur lhag kyang song ba'i tshod du 'dug de lta na ma ṇi gcig pu yang dung phyur gnyis gsum tsam gsungs yod pa snang / yang de dus ya ma rā dza dang mgon po'i sngags shā sa na gnyis kyang bye ba lhag re song / bde

n+despa thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 681mchog gi snying po yi ge nyer gnyis pa dung phyur 'gro ba nye/ phag mo'i phreng sngags kyang 'bum phrag dgu tsam 'gro ba yod ces 'akyil nas dngos su gsungs/ slob ma 'ga' zhig la yang deng sang gi dus su bde mchog da ra 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags nged las lhag pa bzlas pa yod re skan zhes zhal spyal gyi rnam pas gsungs 'dug pas ljags bzlas gcig pu yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa yin 'dug go /zla re bzhin mar ngo'i ring dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma bsngo ba dang / yar mar gyi tshes bcu gnyis la bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rigs re ma chag pa gnang zhing / khyad par du rje bdag nyid chen po'i dus mchod dgun zla ra ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin tshogs pa mang po dang lhan du bde mchog lha i pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor rgyas pa bcas mdzad cing / dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dang rje nyid kyiṭashrī mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying gi thig le bskul ba'i gsang ba'i mgur dbyangs/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam sogs gdangs snyan pos gsung ba dang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa'i snying po rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi bshad sgrub yun ring du gnas pa'i thugs smon gyi mtshams spyor nan tan du gnang / khri chen rdo rje 'chang dang rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyi dus mchod la yang de mtshungs mdzad kyin 'dug gzhan yang skabs 'ga' zhig tu gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / 'khor lo chen po sogs kyi sgrub mchod bdag 'jug kyang ci rigs mdzad/ sku na gzhon dus chos skyong gi rigs

6skyelha rnem thar gyi ldan bsdus pa'i tshul/kyi bsnyen sgrub cher gnang gi med pa la rta tshag rje drung rin po che nas chos skyong chen po rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub sogs mdzad na legs pa'i zhal ta gnang bar brten/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa sogs chos skyong phal che ba'i bsnyen pa mdzad cing / skabs de nas bzung ste mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor sgrub re yang lo re bzhin ma chad par mdzad do/ /nang du gzhol ba'i nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad kyang 'du byas kyi dge rtsa la khyad ga/sod mi mdzad par/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa 'bul ba dang / phyag dang bskor ba/ sats+tsha 'debs pa/ su rū pa dang chab gtor/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sogs chos spyod thor bu yang mang po zhig phyag len la 'debs par mdzad do/ /de ltar 7gong ma bdag pos mtshon che rgu thams cad kyis gtsug gi rgyan tu 'dzin pa sogs 'phrin las kyi 'od stong nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par spro bzhin du mdo sngags kyi lam gyi gnad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams bzhes la thugs rtse gcig pa'i spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo dang / shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i gzhung lugs chen po dag gi tshig don la tshul bzhin du dpyod pa/sngon med legs bshad gsar ba'i phreng ba spel ba/ nyi da kyis ji ltar gzigs pa ltar don gnyer can gyi gdul bya rnams la so so'i blo dang 'tsham par 'doms pa'i klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo chen po dag gis dus 'da' bar ma zad/ ris med pa'i yid can kun la mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas byang chub mchog gi sa bon bskrun pa/ gyi'ajam dbyangs gong ma chen po ri chos srid kyi dgongs bzhed mtha' yas pa skong ba/ dken mchos/

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 6skye3gsum gyi cen bzhengs shing mchod pa sogs kyis bsnyen bkur ba/ dge sbyong dang mgon med pa dang 'phongs pa rnams la sbyin pari sgo 'phar 'byed pa/ nad kyis nyen pa la sman dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa'i skyabs mdzad pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'ang mtha' klas pa 'grus par mdzad pas/rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi nyin gnyig gi mdzad pa yang chen por rlom pa dag gis mi tshe la 'grub dka' ba lta bur snang / tshul 'di ni 'phags chen dam pa'i mnyam rjes dbyer med du song ba'i rnam par thar pa tha mal gyi blor chud dka' ba'i ngo mtshar bla na med pa zhig tu blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis shes par bya'o/ /che rgu mtha' dag gis gtsug tu bkur yang khengs dregs cung zad kyang mi mdzad par nyam chung la thugs lhag par brtse zhing / nor rdzas la 'dzin chags gtan nas mi mdzad pas lo re bzhin phyag rdzas gang byung rnams las phral chas 'dang tsam ma gtogs lhag po gang yod dge phyogs su phral phral du gtong ba mdzad/ sku snga phyi gnyis kyi ring gi mi ser gyi rigs rnying ba dang gsar du byung ba mi nyung tsam yod kyang / de dag la rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral gyi rigs sna gcig kyang mi 'gel bar ma zad 'tsho chas sogs kyi gsol ras phangs med du gnang zhing / phyis su nged la mi ser sogs kyi dgos pa med gsungs nas phyogs gzhan nas 'ongs pa thams cad rang rang gi bdag po rnams la phyir slog gnang / gzhungs nas bod kyi chos sde dang gdan sa che ba 'ga' zhig gtsang 'bul byed rgyu'i snyan sgron phul ba dang / sog yul nas kyang de rigs mang du byung na yang / ngas ni ba/dag 'dzin gyi gzhir gyur pa'i dgon sde 'dzin bdag mi byed gsungs

684 rnam ra gyi don bcis pa'i tshul/nas gcig kyang bdag tu ma bzhes/ gyigong ma'i sku drung du phebs pa sogs gal che skabs ma gtogs na bza' gsar ba gtan nas mi bzhes par rgyun du skyi chags pa'i na bza' rnying ba 'ba' zhig gsol zhing / gsol spyad dngul sogs rin po che las byas pa gtan nas mi 'chang / tha na gsol zhal dngul gyi nang sha can tsam yang mi bsnams par sku tshe hril por rdzab ya'i phor ba che ba zhig kho na la mdzad/ zhal nas/ da lta bsod nams bsag pa'i dus yin gyi bsod nams spyod pa'i dus min zhes bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs pa bzhin du/ dngos po rin thang che ba'i rigs rnams sdon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu las byung ba yin/da lta gos dang gnas mal yo byad sogs rin thang che ba la rgyun par longs spyad na sngar bsags kyi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu myur du zad ༵ra 'gyur bas stabs gcig la zad par ma byas par yun du longs spyad na legs pas/ khyed cag gis rgyun du gos gzab 'chor dang / yo byad dngul phor dngul sder dngul ldir sogs rin po che'i rigs rin thang can la byed pa 'di phral snang la bsod nams che mdog kha yang phugs su mi legs zhes 'doms par mdzad/ mdzad spyod 'di dag ni 'di snang srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad snying po med par gzigs nas thugs nges par 'byung ba nyid kyis/ bdag cag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas gtsang bde rtag bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log par lta ba'i dbang du song ba rnams phyin ci log gi zhen pa las zlog par byas pa'i ched du dgongs pa'o/ /deng sang gi bla chen brgya byin stong 'gugs kyi mdzad 'phrul dang chos nor brje ba'i tshong gi

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 685khe spogs la shin tu mkhas shing / rnyed tshol du rta rmig lcags kyis btum nas rgyal khams chu bzhin myul ba la skyo ngal med pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ thabs 'phrul sna tshogs pas gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i sa zhing mi ser dgon sde sogs 'phrog pa la thugs stobs lhag par rgyas shing /yong gtong gi rtsis grangs bu lon gyi 'phel skyed so nam gyi bzang ngan nor phyugs kyi 'phel 'grib rnams la bshar sgom 'chag med du mdzad pa/ phor ba kha chag yan chad nor rdzas ka ca ga//nga rnyed phyi rabs kyi don du gter du sbas te/ kha byang dbu'i sngas kyi 'og dang lde mig sku rked du 'bral spangs su 'chang ba/ tshur ri tsam phul yang ngoms pa med cing phar 'u su'i 'dab ma tsam gnang ba la yang sku sha nas ster ba'i tshod kyi thugs 'phangs mdzad pa rnams dang / bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa sgo thams cad nas mi mthun par snang ngo / /yul kun myul kyang mig gis mi mthong ba'i/ /gzugs med sems kyi glang po yarī mcha na pa/ /dran shes rwa bar gsar du 'jug pa dag /rnam mang bya ba'i lam kun 'gog dgos khyi/ /zab rgyas dmigs pa sa/nga la mnyam bzhag kyang / /bskal pa'i rlung gis mi bsgul ting nge 'dzin/ /ri ltar brtan pa brnyeru / khyod 'du 'dzi dang / /bral ba'i lus kyi dben par ci zhig ltos/ /chos kyi 'khor lor 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi/ /rlung sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pa mthar phyin khyod/ /lce mchu so rkan sbyor bas sngags kyi grangs/ /mang du bsog pa'i ngal ba 'dis ci bya/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ji snyid kun/ /khyod 'ba' zhig gi ye shes 'phrul

686 rnam thar gyi don bsnyus pa'i tshul /yin phyir/ /de dag bsgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /rang nyid bsgrub cing mchod pa ma 'a gas sam/ /'dod la brkam pa'i dri ma bdag cag gis/ /ras la zhugs pa'i snum bzhin 'don dka' yang / /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pa khyod/ /skyon des dben la ha cang ngo mtshar ci//nang du yang dag 'jog las mi gakho bar/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba rgyun ldan du/ /mdzad pa'i mnyam rjes dbyer med rnam thar 'di/ /ngo mtshar gzhan las lhag snyam kho bo sems/ thub pa'i legs par bshad pa'i spang leb kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i dam chos gru sbyar te/ /'khor ba rabs med chu las 'gro ba kun/— /cig char sgrol bar mdzad 'di de bas mtshar/ /gsang gsum mdzad pa rnam par mi rtog kyang / /'os pa'i ri la 'bab pa'i nyi ma bzhin/ /gdul dbang cir yang 'char ba'i rnam 'phrul la/ /bsams kyin lag pa'i pad+ma snying khar zum / /gnyis pa de ltar rgyu sngon song la brten nas 'bras bu rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ deng dus grub thob tu zhal gyis 'ches ba 'ga' zhig gis rgyu cung zad kyang mi sgrub par 'bras bu rtogs pa'i yon tan spang la sha mo brdol ba bzhin rang 'khrungs su rgyud la skyes pa skad byed pa ni/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'du byas yin pa ma dgongs pa'i rtags su gsal la/ rgyu ma tshang ba med pa las 'bras bu 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas/ rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis ni bshad ma thag pa ltar rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i rgyu tshogs kyi nyams bzhes tshad dang ldan pa mdzad pa la brten nas/ nyams

rnam thar gyi donabasdusapa'itshul/ 681wa rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig chos nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin thugs la 'khrung sa par snang ste/ de yang tho tsa 'i spyod pa sna tshogs 'dzem med byung rgyal du spyod cing lha mthong 'dre mthong smra ba sogs la rtogs pa'i yon tan du gsung rab las ma bshad pas/ 'dir ni byang chub lam rim chen mo las/ spyir rgyal ba'i lung gi bstan pa thams cad sde snod rin po che gsum du 'du bas/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa yang bslab pa rin po che gsum du 'du dgos so/ /zhes rtogs pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi spyi sdom lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che gsum du gsungs pa ltar de gsum gyis thugs rgyud gtams pa'i tshul mdo tsam bsnyad par bya'o/ /de'i tshul la yang lam rim las/ de la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten du gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las lan du mar bsngags pas na/ thog mar tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bslab pa gzhan gnyis kyi rten du gyur pa lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mchog dang ldan pa'i tshul bshad na 'di la gsum las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas sdon goms bag chags bzang po'i mthu yongs su brtas pas/ ji skad du khyim bdag drag shul can gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdag kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas nas mngon par byung ste nam zhig na 'di lta bu spyod par 'gyur/ bdag kyang nam zhig na dge 'dun gyi las dang / gso sbyong gi las dang / dgag dbye'i las

——tram̐bye8 rnam thang gi tram̐n+d+ra—ṣartswas pa'itshul/ rīdang / 'dud pa'i las de la gnas par 'gyur snyam nas/ des 'di ltar rab tu byung ba'i sems la dga' bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las kyang / btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim la ni//nam yang bde bar ma sems shig /phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / /khyim na gnas pa nad du che/ /gcig ni bsrung bas nyon mongs la/ /gnyis pa 'tshol bas sha thang ngo / /zhes dang / gal te chos spyod khyim gyi so nam 'chor/ /khyim la phyogs na chos kyang ga la 'grub/ /chos kyi las ni rab tu zhi ba yin/ /khyim gyi don ni drag shul can gyis 'grub/ /de bas chos dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod phyir/ /bdag la phan 'dod su zhig khyim na gnas/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ rga ba mthong zhing nad kyi sdug bsngal dang / /sems dang bral ba'i shi ba mthong nas ni/ /brtan pa'i btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim spangs kyis/ /'jig rten phal bas 'dod spangs nus re skan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khyim na gnas pa ni bya ba ngan pa sna tshogs kyis brel nas dge ba'i bsam pa ma skyes pa mi skye zhing skyes pa rnams rim gyis 'grib par byed pa/ tshong dang zhing las sogs las ngan pa sna tshogs pa dang / de dag gi ched du phan tshun 'thab pa dang rtsod pa sogs bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal du mas lus sems bun nas gdung bar byed pa/ 'dod pa spyod pa ni dug sbrul nag po'i gdengs ka'i grib bsil ltar mnog chung zhing nyen che ba/ mdor na nyes pa du ma'i 'byung khungs su gyur la/ rab tu byung ba ni nyes pa thams cad las ldog cing yon tan thams cad skye ba'i rten sa gzhi lta bu/ rgyal ba sras bcas

rnam thar gyi don brdus pa'i tshul/ 689thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i gnas yin par dgongs nas bar ma'i tshul khrims dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa nod par mdzad cing / bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa 'dzin pa'i dge slong ni/ dge slong la rab tu gasnyes pa'i mdo las/ dge slong zhes bya chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje'i srog shing yin/ /dge slong zhes bya thar pa'i lam bgrod de/ /dge slong zhes bya rgyal ba'i sras po yin/ /dge slong zhes bya nyon mongs srog gcod de/ /dge slong zhes bya duḥkha spong ba yin/ /dge slong rang gi ngo bo bsdam pa ste/ /zhes sogs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags pa brjod pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang / /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa/ /gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring / /dge tshul zhes bya de dag las / /khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o zhes gsang sngags bla med la 'jug pa la'ang dge slong gi rten mchog tu gsungs pa rnams la thugs nges chen po 'khrungs nas/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyi drung nas bsnye na par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ de nas bzung ji srid sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du dge slong gi sdom pa'i bcas mtshams mtha' dag phra zhing zhib par bsrung ba mdzad cing / cung zad 'das na yang de ma thag phyir bcos pa'i thabs la brtson par mdzad gle / yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma bslab khrims la nyes ltung gi dri mas cung zad kyang ma gos pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen por bzhugs

690 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/so/ /zhal nas/ khyed cag bslab pa la gces spras byed pa gal che/skye dgu'i dbus na lhun po lta bur brjid/ /stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa yin pas ——/nas skabs su kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba zhig 'dod na yang tshul khrims legs par bsrung bas 'grub par 'gyur/ nged rang chung ngu nas dbang sdud kyi las la zhe 'dod med pas de rigs gtan nas byas pa med kyang / mtha' dbus kyi sdi thasdus cad dga' zhing 'dud par byed pa 'di tshul khrims kha ral sna ral du ma btang ba'i drin gyis yin zhes gsungs/ tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phun sum tshogs pas gzim khang gi nang dang nye 'khor thams cad du khyab cing / na bza' rnying ba gzhan gyi mchod gnas su khyer ba rnams lo ci tsam song yang tshul khrims kyi dri mi nyams pa dang / der ma zad gzim khang du yun ring bzhag pa'i kha btags dang dar tshun chad la dri ngad zhim po zhen pas phyir khyer yang re zhig gi bar mi yal ba zhig yod pa kun la mthun snang du grub po/ /dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ theg chen gyi bla ma bya ba bshad pa na 'byams klas par go ba bskyed la/ lag tu len pa na bstan pa'i tha ma la gang phan dang thad kar don du gang 'gyur ston pa zhig dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos ston pa dzo rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi khastan pa'i tha ma'am mjug tu phan par 'gyur ba gang yin legs par brtags nas de gtso bor ston dgos pa sa/la che bar snang ste/ shar phyogs kyi sa'i mtha' 'di rnams su dang por chos dar bar byed myo/khan 'gas thog ma nyid nas gsang sngags kyi skor khyab bdal du spel 'i/nga / grwab pa'i

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ rī 691brtul zhugs can 'ga' nig gis grub spyod sna tshogs mngon mtshan du mdzad par brten/ deng sang gi dus su mchog dman sus kyang 'dul ba'i lag len dang bslab khrims kyi phyogs la nan tan ci rming mi byed par lha'i sgrub thabs re kha ton du byed pa kho nas grol par re ba sha stag tu snang /yul dus gnas skabs 'di 'dra ba'i khrod du rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid mi gtsang ba'i 'dam khrod kyi pad+ma dkar po bzhin du tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dri bsung ching nge mdzad cing / gzhan dag kyang tshul de la 'god par mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni/ rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos/ ji ltar nod pa'i bslab pa phra mo yang / /nges 'byung bsam pas byang chub thob kyi bar//srog gi phyir yang gtong bar mi byed pa'i/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu 'dzin par shog /ces dang / rnadza dag bslab pa khrel med sems kyis dral/ /dam pas smad pa'i las la 'jigs mi byed/ /khrims 'chal dge sbyong sha tshugs can rnams kyang / /bdag gis skyon med khrims la sbyor bar shog /ces smon pa mdzad pa'i gnas yin 'dug pas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /de la kha cig 'di skad ces/ khyod kyis rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid gsang sngags bla med kyi lam la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i tshul mang du smra bzhin du/'dul ba'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod byed pa 'gal ba kho na ste/ gsang sngags bla med ni theg chen gyi yang rtse yin cing 'dul ba theg dman nyan thos kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas so zer na/ de ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i gnad ci yang ma mthong zhing dge slong gi sdom pa rme rta

692 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/theg pa che chung ga/nyis ka'i thun mong ba yin pa ma shes par kha padud kyis phye ba'i tshig smra ba ste/ /khyod rang gi blo ngo na dge slong yin phyin theg dman las ma 'das so snyam 'dug pas/ de lta na bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa yang dge slong rnam dag ma yin pa'am/ yang na theg dman par khas len dgos shing / klu sgrub yab sras/ thogs med sku mched sogs rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams dang / a ti sha/ sa paṇa/ bu ston/ rje tsong kha pa sogs bod kyi grub mtha' so so'i srol 'byed mkhan thams cad theg pa dman par 'dod dgos pas / de lta na sangs rgyas nas bzung rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thug gi bar gyi rgya bod kyi paṇa grub thams cad la theg dman pa'o zhes skur ba 'debs pa khyod las tha chad pa su zhig mchis/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis sngags la zhugs nas dge slong gi bcas mtshams yar ldan du bsrung dgos kyi/ sngags la bsnyad btags nas 'dul ba'i bcas pa khyad du bsad na/ sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa las/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba dang / /zhes sbom po'i ltung ba 'byung bar gsungs la/sngags lugs kyi sbom po'i ltung pa gcig byung na so thar gyi pham pa bzhi ka byung ba las kyang nyes dmigs rtsi bar gsungs so/ /der ma zad 'dul ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bkas bcas pa yin pas/ de bsams bzhin khyad du bsad na/ bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bder gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsa ltung yang 'byung ba gdon mi za'o/ /des na bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pas nang gsang sngags bla med kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo

ri rdom thar gyi don brnas pa.oṃ tshul/ 6sgre3las g.yo ba med kyang phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang cung zad kyang mi 'gal bas sdom gsum gcig gcig gi grogs su mdzad pa 'di ni rnam thar phul du byung ba yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod skyong zhing / /nang du 'dus pa la rab dga'/ /zhes dang / 'brom ston pas/ tshan gcig gi 'dul ba la brten nas sngags ca 'byid/ sngags la brten nas 'dul ba ca 'byid de/ 'dul ba sngags kyi grogs sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su song ba nga'i bla ma'i bka' rgyud min pa med/ ces gsungs/'di ni rje rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen po'i yang rnam thar gyi gtso bo zhig yin pas/ stag tshang lots+tsha ba shes rab rin chen kyang dang po rje rin po che la ma dad pas dgag pa sogs byas kyang / phyis su rnam thar 'di mthong nas chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa skyes te/ kha cig 'dul ba gtsor byas gsang sngags spong / /gzhan dag sngags la mos blos 'dul ba 'gog /gya la ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag 'gal med du/ /rdzogs par nyams su len mkhas khyod la 'dud/ /ces bstod pa mdzad par snang ngo / /deng dus bla gos 'chal tshul rma dkris su/ /'chang ba'i cher rlom bstan pa'i bdag por snyems/ /khyim gyi 'ching ba spel ba'i gtam gyi phreng / /rnam thar mchog tu gsang mthor sgrog par byed/ /rgyal bas dkar chos kun gyi gzhir bsngags pa'i/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rmang nas yal ba la/ /phal ba'i zhing sa chung ngu shwa 'od kyis/ /khyer ba'i sems las tsam yang byed pa su/ /nyon mongs tshang tshing 'khrigs pa las mched pa'i/ /sdug bsngal 'brog gi me la char rgyun bzhin/ /gya nom zhi ba ster

6sri4 ma thar gyi rdon bsnus pa'i tshul/ ba'i bag yod khrims/ /gces pa'i nor bzhin bsrung ba'i rnam par thar//'di nyid kho na bstan pa'i tha ma la/ /'chi gsos sman gyi mchog ste 'di med na/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i grags pa ci mchis kyang / /seng ge'i ro bzhin gzugs brnyan tsam du zad/ /srung ba med pa gzhwam brnyes kyang //skyon bral tshul khrims gasngam bsrung ba/ /mgon 'di bslab pa gzhwam ldan pa'i/ /dge 'dun 'phags tshogs sa/sum gyi mgon/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i tshul ni/ ༷ byang sems kyi sdom pa'i bslab bya thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang snying po lta bu ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che yin pas/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis sku na shin tu phra mo'i dus nas byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams pa gsan nas/ glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma la rgyun du thugs dam mdzad cing / dgung lo bco lnga'i skabs rang gi bshar sgom gyi ched du lam rim chen mo las gsungs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed tshul tshigs bcad du bsgrigs pa k+ṣi/ga kyang mdzad 'dug go /phyis su bla ma dam pa mang po las theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa gang yod rnams lan gcig ma yin par nan tan gyis gsan pa mdzad cing / nyams bzhes gsal 'debs su rin po che ye shes rgyal mtshan la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig snying por dril ba zhig rtsom pa mdzad pa'i bskul ma gnang ba ltar khrid yig bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba zhig kyang gnang 'dug cing /byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad nas rgyun du gtong len gyi dmigs pa la nan tan mdzad/ tha na gzim khang gi rtsigs ngos kyi ri mo tshun chad la rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras

rnam tharagyido n+d+rarwa sdus—pa'itshul/ 6nyabyegazigs kyis nyamyo/ thag pa'i sems can 'jigs pa las bskyab pa dang /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i 'od zer gyis rigs drug so so 'i sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba la bkod pa'i tshul rnams 'bri ba gnang / thugs dam gang gam/nga yang sems rin po che des zin pa dang / thugs dam du ma zad spyod lam rnam bzhi gang la yang byang chub kyi sems kyis cim zin pa med cing / dge ba bsdo ba thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems kyis gzhan don 'ba' zhig tu bsdo ba las rang don du bsdo ba skad cig tsam yang mi mdzad/bdag cag la bla mchod kyi geka' khrid cig gnang skabs zhal nas/ bla ma mchod pa 'di'i nyam sa len gyi gtso bo gcig gtong len gyi dmigs pa 'di yin pas/ byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam gsal bar bgyis te/ des na rje btsun bla ma thugs rje can/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lnga bo 'di yang yang 'don gyin gtong len gyi dmigs nam bskyang dgos/ 'di gal che bas 7paṇa chen blo bzang cho sa rgyan gyis bla mchod cho ga thog mar gnang skabs tshig rkang bzhi las med kyang / drung pa rgyal tshab dang gu ge snying stobs rgya ma gyi+o sogs kyi/sa rgyud 0rikhul ba'i ched du bla ma'i mtshan nas 'bod pa'i tshi ga gcig 'jug dgoṭasmi/ tshul zhus pa bzhin/ des na rje btsun bla ma thugs rje can/ /zhes pa gsar 'jug gnang ba yin 'dug gcod kyi gdams pa'i snying po yang 'di yin pas dkar dmar sna/ tshogs 'gyed kyi/ dmigs pa rkyang ba tsam ma yin par/ de tham sa cad byams snying rje'i mdangs ma yal ba'i ngang nas byed cing / 'gyed kyi mjug tu gtong le na rlung la bskyon pa'i dmigs pa yun ring du byed dgos 'e/sashrī gsu/ngas shing / yang zhal

696 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ nas/ spar shes kyi blo 'di rgyud la skye ba shin tu dka' ba zhig yin/ 'di byung na des sna drangs nas drin gzo sogs skye ba las sla bar 'dug 'di dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di la rigs pa'i sgrub byed 'char bde ba mang po ma gsungs/ rnam 'grel las skye ba'i ya mtha' thug med du sgrub pa'i rigs pa gsungs pa shin tu zab na'ang rigs pa skor thag ring pos sgrub dgos pas las dang po ba la 'char dka' ba zhig 'dug 'di la ltos te stong nyid kyi lta ba la dbu ma'i gzhung rnams su rigaṭa/ pa'i rnam grangs shin tu rno ba mang po yod pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa zhig gis rigs pa de rnams kyi sgo nas dpyad na rtogs myur ba zhig 'ong bar snang / mar shes 'di skye dka' bas bka' gdams kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyang 'di la thugs sbyong skabs phral du skye ma nyan par lung stong zhig tu song nas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas rang gi tshe 'di'i ma rgas shing khog pa'i rnam pa can zhig mdun du bsams nas/ rdza'i a ma zhes 'bod cing ngu ba'i rnam pa yan chad kyi thabs sna tshogs 0/nang bar gsungs 'dug rang re rnams dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong ba 'di gtso bor byed dgos/bka' gdams pa rnams thugs dam 'phel mi 'phel yang 'di'i sgo nas 'jog pa red/ 'di nga mi rgan gyi snying gtam yin no/ /zhes thugs brtse bas 'doms par mdzad de zhib tu brtags na rje bla ma rang nyid kyis byang chub kyi sems rim/ po che la thugs ji ltar spyangs pa dang kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar rakhruras pa'i nyams myongadagi steng nas gsungs pa yin pa shes par snang ngo / /de ltar byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs dam gyi mthil du

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 697mdzad cing / ga'/na dag la yang tshul de 'a/ nan tan dgoṭari/ tshul 'dom ri / par mdzad pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gnad shes pa zhig gis bltas na dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skye ba'i rnam thar yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal nas/ rgyal bas pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen po dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen po gnyis gsungs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po ni med do/ /de gnyis gang gi drepa/ ra 'jug kyang 'jug sgo ni byang chub kyi sems kho na yin te/ de rgyud la nam skyeṭashrī pa na gzhan gang yang ma skyes kyang theg chen par 'jog pa yin la/ de dang nam bral ba na stong pa nyid kyi rtogs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ci yod kyang nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltung zhing / theg chen las nyams pa yin par theg pa chen po pa 'i gzhung du ma/ las gsungs shing rigs pas kyang 'grub pa yin no/ /des na dang por theg chen par chud pa yang sems de bskyed pa tsam gyis 'jog la/ phyis theg chen pa'i nang nas 'thon pa yang de dang bral ba tsam gyis 'jog pas na/ theg chen pa ni sems de yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed do/ /zhes dang / de la 'bad nas bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye rgyu byung na des zin pa'i bya rog la zan nyung zad cig byin pa'ang byang sems kyi sbyo nga ba zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro yi/ de med na stong gsum rin po ches bkadā ste byin yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par mi chud do/ /de bzhin sdu tshul khrims nas shes rab kyi bar dang / lha hro/ ma pa dang rtsa rlung thig le 'o/gas sgom pa'ang byang chub sem sa dpa'i spyod par mi chu da do/ /zhes gsu ngas pa dang / 'bromā

698 rnam tharagyidonabasdutra/ngani tshul/ —rin po chesasmi// thud cho ba mar la rag las pa bzhin du/ sngas/sa kyi zab khyad byang chub kyi sems kyis 'a do na pa yin/ zheṭa/ so gas mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma las theg pa chen po 'i grangs su 'gro mi 'gro ni byang chub kyi sems nyid yod med kyi khyad kho nas byed par gsungs pas so/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs la 'khrungs rma ni rje nyid kyi gsuse sa/zhan gyis kyang shes par snang ste/ bod du phebs skabs nyin sa/cig stag phu rdo rje 'chang dang rje bla ma rnam gnyis kyis nyams rtogasashaṃ 'khrungs tshul gsung 'phros zhig gnang gi 'dug par/ rje 'di ba'i zhal nas/ bdag la rmi lam du gcan gzan 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas khyur mid byas te khog pa'i nang du slebs pa na gcan gzan de la khong khro cung zad kyang med par lhag par snying rje shugs drag po skyes te slon lam bdun cu ba yongs rdzogs 'don pa rmis pa dang / yang sa dang mi ma yin gyis glags blta ba rmis kyang de la gtong len gyi dmigs pa byed pa zhig rmi ba 'dug ceṭa/ 0/sungs pa la/stag phu rdo rje 'chang gis phyag thal mo sbyar nas byang chub kyi thugs shin tu 'byongs pa yin 'dug ces gsungs pa kho bo de dus sku drung na yod pas dngos su thos so/ /'di ni ga nod byed la khong khro ba rmi lam tsam du yang mi 'byung zhing byang chub kyi thugs rmi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad kyi dus nam du yang bagh+rid pa med pa shin tu ngo 'o/tshar chen po dang lda/na pa'i rnam thar du snang ngo / /khyad par byang sdom blangs nas bcas pa las mi 'da' bar mdzad tshul ni/ bod du rgyal dbang thams cad masbya/ na pa dang khri chen do rje 'chang gi drung nas/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen rma nas 'byung ba

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 699ltar smon sems cho ga'i sgo nas 'dzin par mdzad pa dang / dus rgyun du yang rten gyi drung nas smon 'jug cig char du 'dzin pa'i cho ga yang ya nga mdzad cing / sems bskyed mi nyams pa 'i rgyu nag chos bzhi spong ba dang /dkar po'i chos bzhi la slob pa rnams nan tan du mdzad cing / zhal nas/'jug sdom len pa'i cho ga byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad du rje bla mas gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin 'bogs pa'i rgyun rje bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos gsan 'dug kyang nged de dus na phra bas zhu rgyu ma byung / phyis su sdom rgyun de rtsad bcad kyang bla ma dam pa su la yang mi bzhugs 'dug pas rgyun chad pa yin pa 'dra/ hwa shang gi slob dpon bzang po rnams la sdom rgyun de yod 'dug pas/ snga ma rta tshag rje drung rin po ches nyid nas hwa shang mkhas pa zhig gi drung nas sdom rgyun de bzhes nas gzhan la 'bogs pa gnang na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa 'dug ces yang yang bskul ma gnang byung yang bod rnams kyis hwa shang gi sdom rgyun zhes ma dag pa'i grangs su 'dren pa las mos pa byed mkhan e yong mi shes bsam btang snyoms su bzhag pa yin gsungs/ rgyu mtshan mi shes pa'i bod re gnyis kyis bla chen brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun kyang ma dag par byed 'dug pas ji skad gsungs pa thugs mad par snang yang / skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la don du 'gyur ba yang mtha' ma bkag pas/ rje drung rin po ches bskul ma gnang ba bzhin sdom rgyun bzhes rgyu byung na legs pa 'dug na'ang snyigs ma'i mtha' la slobs pa'i gdul bya rnams bsod nams chung bas lan par snang ngo /

700 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/de ltar sdom rgyun de bzhes pa ma grub 'dug kyang sku na shin tu phra ba'i dus rje ngag dbang chos mirgya mtsho'i drung du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen thog mar gsan skabs sdom pa gnyis 'dzin par mdzad pa nas/slar bla ma dam pa du ma las rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi rigs mang du gsan pa thams cad kyi dus subyusdos pa de gnyis yar ldan gyi tshul gyis bzhes par mdzad cing / byang sems kyi rtsa ltung bco brgyad dang nyes byas bzhi bcu zhe drug la yang yang bsngo bgrang gnang nas nyes ltung gis ma goṭa5 pa la 'bad par mdzad de/ gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa'i byang sems kyi bslab bya de bskul ba po med kyang rang gi thugs la 'dris par bya ba'i ched du rje bla ma'i legs par bshad ba las btus te 'khyer bde bar mdzad pa yin tshul gsungs bas kyang shes par snang / rgya la nyes pas gos na yang 'phral 'phral du phyir bcos pas dag par mdzad cing / spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /phung po gsum pa 'don bya zhing / /rgyal dang byang chubasems bsten nas/ /ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ltung bshags kyi sgo nas sdig ltung sbyong ba la yang 'grus par mdzad do/ /de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed nas 'gro ba sgrol bar dam bcas te spyod pa la mi slob par gyi nar sdod mi rigs pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te de lta ra dam bcas nas/ /las kyis bsgrub par ma byas na/ /sems can de dag kun bslus pas/ /bdag gi 'gro ba ci 'drar 'gyur/ /dngos po phal ba cung zad la'ang / /yid kyis sbyin par bsam byas nasakau

rnam thar gyi ldan bkus pa'i tshul/ 101mi gang sbyin par mi byed pa/ /de yang yi dwags rgyur gsungs na/ /bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ /bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer nas/ /'gro ba thams cad bslus byas na/ /bde 'gror ci ga 'gro 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pas na don de nyid thugs la dgongs nas bla ma dam pa nyid kyis rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab pa'i tshul yang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i sdom ni rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug dang / gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yin par gsungs pas/ thog mar sbyin pa'i phar phyin lta bu la mtshon na/ rje bla ma nyid yo byad nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas nyin rer yang gtong ba'i sgo 'phar phye ste gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin mdzad pa brjod kyis mi lang zhing / rgyal khab chen po'i mu lto ba khri phrag tu nye ba la skabs skabs su bza' btung dang dngos po'i sbyin gtong mdzad pa dang / yas mas su phebs lam du slong mo ba zhig ga/zigs phyin ci nas kyang kar+sha pa ṇi sogs kyi gnang sbyin mi mdzad pa mi srid cing / de yang phal che ba la dngos kyi phyag gis ster bar mdzad nas smon lam gnang bas mtshon pa'i cizang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa yang don du gnyer ba rnams la 'dod chos ci rigs stsol ba dang rgyun par yang nam mkha' mtha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs nas mdo rgyud 'ga' zhig zhal 'don lhang lhang mdzad pa zhig yod/de dag gi tshe/ gang zhig sa/ser mchog rang bzhin ri rab la gnas marnyi ra dang lhar bcas gnod sbyin dang / /gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od kyis mun pa sel mdzad sa 'og gnas pa'i klu rnams gang yin dang/ /gangs can

702 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ rir ni dpal gyiṭashrī ro‘ra cing rab tu yid dga'i rig pa 'dzin pa sa/nga yin pa/ /de dag tham/sa cad tha—ra pa dam pa'i sgor gyur thung pa 'i gsung mnyan phyir ni 'dir panashes/sa shig /ces pa'i tshigaṭasmu su ngacad pa thog mar gsung ba zhig 'dug pa la dpags na/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la yang chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa gor ma chag go /mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa mdzad tshul yang / dngos dang brgyud pa ci rigs pa'i sgo nas rgyal po'i chad pa dang dmag 'khrug la sogs pa 'jigs pas nyen pa dang / nad dang gdon gyis gtses pa rnams skyob par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig gong du bris zin cing mtha' dag pa ni brjod kyis ga la la nga /des mtshon nas phar phyin phyi ma rnams dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la ji ltar slob par mdzad pa'i tshul yang shes par bya la/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo zhi gnas dang shes rab kyi ngo bo lhag mthong la slob par mdzad tshul phyogs tsam 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / thabs ma khas dang smon lam dang stobs / dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ṭosmu+ogs pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la ji ltar slob par mdzad pa'i tshu/la mtha' yas pa rnams ni bdag lta bu'i blo'i spyod yul du ma gyur pas/ blo kros dang ldan pa rnams kyis sdong po bkod pa'i mdo la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba'i theg pa chen po'i sde snod las shes par byas te/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par thar pa sgyu ma'i rol pa lta bu la ngo mtshar gyi dad pa bskyed cing / rang nyid theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi nus pa yongs su brtas pa'i thabs la brtson par gyis shig /

byung—/garatram̐ri+onabasdusapa'i tshul/ 703byamyo sa dang ba rtse ba'i skya ba zung g.yo ba'i/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi gru bo che/ /phyin drug ba dan dkar pos nyer mdzes pa/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar snyegs/ /byang chub sem sa dpa'i tshul khrirma sa rta zhon nas/ /'jug ldo ga ma nor lam du zhugs pa khyod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyarlom ba'i ba/dung 'tshob gcig pu ste/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen kyang yin/ /a ho byang chub sems mchog sra ba'i go /brtson 'grus dpung ba brtan pos bgos pa khyod/ /sgrib gnyis g.yul las rgyal ba'i grags snyan gyi/ /ba dan srid pa'iXmatha' las 'das par bsgrengs/ /sngo bsangs lha mo zla ba'i mngal sbrum pa/ /bdud rtsi'i zer gyis ku mud bzhad las dpog /khyod kyis sems mchog rgyud la sbas na yang / /dbugs kyang gzhan phan kho nar gyur 'dis shes/ /de phyir 'jig rten gsum gyi mtsho chen 'di'i/ /ral pa'i rlabs phreng gang gi zhabs bsil te/ /gang gi zhabs rdul reg pa'i rdul phran kyang / /khams sa/sum sems can kun gyi mchod pa'i rten/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun bla ma dayopa 'di nyid kyis gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi rim pa mtha' yas pa gsan pa las rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med kyi dbang gi skabs su rig pa ji 'dzin pa'i sdom pa len par mdzad cing / dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i rigs lnga so so'i dam tshis/ dang spyi'e dam tshig /byi ma la yang rtsa ba dang yan lag girmo dam tshig gnyis dang / rtsa ba'i dam tshig la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/sbom po brgyad/ rtsa ltung gi sder gtogs kyi sbom po shin tu mang po dang /

704 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/rtsa ltung bcu bzhi la yang yo ga nas bshad pa dang / bla med nas bshad pa'i tshul/ bla med la yang bla med spyi nas bshad pa dang dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba dang / yan lag gi dam tshig la yang spong ba'i dam tshig /bza' ba'i dam tshig /bsten pa'i dam tshig /spong ba'i dam tshig gzhan bstan pa dang / phyi ma la yang theg chen las ldog pa'i rgyu spong ba/ brnyas pa dang 'gom pa'i nyes pa spong ba rnams su yod pa dang /rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig la yang dam tshig bcu dgu yod pa rnams sku srog dang phasdos nas bsrung ba la thugs gzhol bar mdzad do/ /rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig rnams nyin mtshan dus drug tu bsdo bgrang mdzad cing / dam tshig mi nyams pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa rje rgyal ba sa/nyis pa'i man ngag zab chos thun mong ma yin pa thun drug gi rnal 'byor zhes grags pa de nyid nyin zhag re bzhin dus drug tu chag med du mdzad/ sngags kyi dam sdom la gces spras su mdzad pa bdag cag gi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yang mang po zhig mchis te/ kho bo cag dang mi gzhan zhig zhe 'khon du gyur pa la/ rje bla ma nyid nas bdag la 'khon 'dzin btang ste mthun par byed dgos pa'i zhal ta phebs par/ kho bos da dung 'khon du 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gsol ba la thugs shin tu ma rangs pa'i rnam pas/ de lta na/ sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa'i sngags kyi rtsa ltung dang / khros nas bshags kyang mi nyan pa/ /zhes pa'i byang sems kyi rtsa ltung khyod la 'byung ba 'dug /rtsa ltung la srog bsdos byed dgos na/ don chung ngu re'i

ma tharagyidonabakusapa'itshul/ — 105 wached ru ya nga mi 'dzem na snying rul bar zad do/ /zhes bka' bkyon par mdzad pas/ kho bo yang 'khon 'dzin zhi zhing ye bla ma mchog la mos/ pa che ru 'gro ba zhig byung / rdzibla ma nyid nas dgra gnyen ris su phye ba'i chags sdang dang / gzhan gyi mtshang la phog pa'i skyon brjod rigs gtan nas mi mdzad cing / zhal nas/ grub mtha'i phyogs lhung 'di 'phung tshabs shin tu che zhing / rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /zhes pa'i rtsa ltung gis kyang phog nyen che gsungs nas/ chos 'chad pa dang gsung 'phros sogs kyi skabs su yang grub mtha'i dgag bzhag gi sbos pa gtan nas mi na dzad/ dus phyis kho bos mjal skabs/rje bla ma mchog nas ri bo rtse lngar gnang ba'i lta ba'i nyams mgur du grub mtha' gzhan gyi lta ba la zur za'i gsung 'ga' zhig 'dug pa'i skor la dri ba 'ga' zhig zhus par dwogs lan mtha' chod pa gnang ba'i mjug tu/'di skor rnams dgag bzhag gi ched du byas pa ma yin/ rang lugs kyi lta ba la nges shes 'dren pa daja gol sa shes pa'i ched du gzhan gyi 'dod pa brjod pa tsam yin/ 'di 'dra'i skabs su kun dkris tshang na rtsa nyu/nga du 'gro nyen che zhes 'jigs 'jigs lta bu'i tshul mdzad/ de las 'phros nas sum pa mkhan pos chos log sun 'byin zhig brtsams/ khyod kyis de la lan btab pa red zer ba thos pas e bden zhes bka' 'dri gnang byung ba la/chos log sun 'byin gyi tha snyad cher mi 'dug ke ta ka zer ba zhig mdzad nas gzungs 'dus khrod kyi chos tshan 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas kyi gsung min sngol dang / gzhan yang mdos gto glud sogs la khungs med tshul sogs

106 sgru thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/thar thor gsungs pa zhig 'dug pa la/ bdag la mkhan chen rang gis khyod kyis 'di la zhib dpyod gyis la mi 'thad pa 'dug pa rnams la dwogs dpyod kyi yi ge bris la phul zhig ces lan kha yar gsung byung bas/ rang blo chung ngus dpyad de snyan sgron gyi yi ge zhig phul ba yin zhus par/ sum pa mkhan po ha cang rgas pa'i col gtam yin pa 'dug /'chi khar chos spong gi las bsags nas ci byed ces phebs pa la/ kho bo skyi nga/ya' bas spu zings byed pa byung / yang zhal nas/ gsang sngags zer ba la rgyu mtshan yod pas snod min la shin tu gas/nga dgos pa yin/ deng sang sngags kyi gdams pa zab mo thos tshad yi ger 'god pa dang / bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi yig cha thams cad par du brkos pa 'di sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar byed pa dang nyams par byed pa gang gi rgyur 'gro mi shes pa 'dug gsungs shing / rje bla ma rang gis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yig cha rnams bka' rgya shin tu dam pa dang par du rko ba sogs mi byed pa'i kha byang yang gnang / 'di ltar mdzad pa yang chos la ser sna dang dpe mkhyud mdzad pa ma yin par gsang sngags kyi gdams pa tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar bsre bslad du song na mi legs pa dang / khrom bsgrags bgyis na byin rlabs kyi ngad yal bar 'gyur ba dang / yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang sngags sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes pa'i rtsa ltung 'byung bar dgongs pa yin 'dug sngags kyi gdam/sa pa rnams snod la ma brtags par gya tshom du ye mi gnang zhing / lhag par /brom dbang bskur pa la thugs mi dgyes pas/ zhal nas/ nged kyis dbus gtsang du mi stong

da ————————— 'i ra kyi sa bsdus pa'i tshul/ ṭ+wāṃkhye1phrag mang snye+o ra dbang ngaskur byed datho/sdoshaṃ pa byung / gangs can chos/ kyi zhing khams de lta bu na ha cang gi snod min med 'gro ya nga snang med kyi gu yangs ma bya/sa par thog mar ming tho rgyag pa sogs zhib cha bgyisdo4 pa yin/ 'di phyogs su snga mo nged na gzhon dus sog yul zhig tu spyan ras gzigs kyi khrom dbang bskur myong ste/ phyis su de la 'gyod pa byung bas da lta khrom dbang gtan nas mi byed pa'i dam bca' lta bu byas yod ces gsungs/'di yang rgyud sde'i sa/nad shes pa zhig gis brtags na shin tu yi rangs pa'i gnas yin te/ dbang bskur yul gyi slob ma la gang yin gyis/ mi chog pa ra mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dgoṭatrī/ shing / mtshan nyid ji lta bu tshang dgos pa ni bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba 'a ri ga / slob ma yon tan gang ldan na/ /rnal 'ashi+or chen po'i snod du 'gyur/ /dad cing bla ma la yang gus / /rtag tu dge ba'i 'a ma la gnas/ /rtot+pā/ nga ngan pa rnam par spangs/ /lung ni mang du thos pa dang / /gsod pa dang ni 'tshe ba spangs/ /sems can rnams ni gdon pa'i blos/ /kun tu brtson dang yang dag ldan/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /dad pa chen po'i slob ma bzang / /zhes sa/sungs shing / de'i don na/khas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ mtshan nyid 'di rnams ni dang po nas rang 'khrungs su mi 'byung bas blo legs par sbyangs nas bskyed dgos la/ blo sbyong ba'i rim pa yang / dang por dge ba'i bshes gnyenatshubasten pa dang / de nas dal 'byor don che ba dang / rnyed dka' ba dang /ring du mi gnas pa dang / shi nas kyang las dbang gis ngan song du

lha08 rnam ra gyi don brtsas pami tshushā/ 'khyams tshul rnams rgyud la go ba rkyang bar ma lus pa'i myong ba re ma skyes bar du bsgoms nas/ de'i mthus drangs pa'i skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid tshang ba re legs par sbyangs/ de nas las 'bras la zhib tu sems pa la 'bad nas dge sdig la blang dor phra zhing phra ba nas bslabs/ de nas 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi nyes dmigs la legs par bsams nas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye bar bya/ de nas rang nyid srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul dang / de thams cad kyang drin can gyi ma sha stag yin tshul so gas zhib tu sems pa'i man ngag la blo ring du sbyangs nas/ 'gro ba thams cad gdon par 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa go yul du ma las pa zhig rgyud la ma kyes bar du 'bad dgos te/ 'di skyes na theg chen par 'gyur zhing des zin pa'i dge ba gang byas theg chen gyi lam du 'gyur/'di'i myong ba zhig rnal ma ma skyes na gang zag de theg chen par 'gyur ba'i skabs med cing / des ma zin na stong nyid kyi lta ba rnam par dag pas rgyas thebs pa'i rnyohū+oṃ nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / sngags bzla ba dang / rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa sogs la ji tsam 'bad kyang gsang sngags kyi lam khyad par can du 'gyur ba lta zhog /theg pa chen po'i lam tsam du ragyur bar bzhag shin tu dka' ste/ stong nyide mngon sum du rtogs pa ni nyan rang 'phags pa la yang yod pas/ lam de byang chub chen po'i lam du song ma song kun rdzob sems bskyed 'dis bzhag dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yin pa la sems 'di ni yun ring du blo sbyangs nas bskyed

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshu~X/ 709dgos kyi/ blo ma sbyangs par dbang bskur sogs kyi thog ོ/ra/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes sogs kyi tshis/ gi rjes zlo sa tsam gyis sems 'di skye na/ lam gzhan rnams kyang de dang 'dra bas nyi ma gcig la sangs rgyas kyi lam thams cad rgyud la bskye da nus par 'gyur ro//de bas na blo de myong ba ma skyes kyi bar du sbyangs nas/ de'i mthus drangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams la slob 'dod snyi nga thag pa nas skyes pa na byang sems kyi sdom pa cho gas tshul bzhin du bzung ste/ spyod pa phyin drug la legs par slob pa nyid rdo rje theg pa la thog mar 'jug pha'i rten du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de bas na sngags la 'jug par 'dod na thog mar lam thun mong ba la blo sbyong ba nyid man ngag gi mchog tu zungs shig /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten dgos la/ de lta bu ni shin tu dkon cing snod dang mi ldan ya la dbang la sogs pa'i gdams pa zab mo bshad na phan pa las gnod tshabs che bas/ ji ltar seng ge'i 'o ma ni/ /sa yi snod du bzhag mi bya/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud//snod min dag la sbyin mi bya/ /slob ma skad cig de la 'chi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gtsang pa ye shes dpar 'byor gyis/ 'bras spungs su ser skya rgan byis gang byung la khrom dbang bskur nyag gcig byas pa la/ blo gros dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig gisari / gsang sngags bon ltar gyer ba'i dus/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi dus la babs pa yin 'dug tshul gyis kha btang ba la/ gtsang pas de'i lan du/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyis lag tu spyo dril gtad nas/ bu yis slob ma bsdu bar

710 rnam thar gyi don bsduṭa/ pa'i tshul/gyis/ /zhes dbang bzhi dzogs par s+t+ra/na nga ba'i slob ma yin na rang gi skyag res ma lcogs na phar zhog /de min brgya phrag stong phrag du mar dbang bskur chog pa yin no/ /zheṭashrī kho rar ki lo rgyusmu kyi yi gejo bris pa mthong ste/ de lta na dbang gi dus su bla matra/ sheṭashaṃ rab ma gtad nas/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags//zhes sher dngang k+to//ོ/nga ba'i slob ma yin na rang gi skya ga res ma lcogs na phar zhog /de 3/ na brgya phrag stong phrag du mar rol chog pa yin no/ /zhes smos la 'dod loka 'jo la nyog tu spyod cig /rdo dril dngos su dang rig ma dmigs pas gtad pas mi+o mchungs/ so zer na/ slo ba ma bsdu bar gyis zhes pa'i slob ma yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la dgongs pas khrom dbang bskur chog pa'i sgrub byed du mi 'gro'o/ /des/ na gzhan phyogs dung ltar dkar yang nag por sprub/ rang phyogs sol ba ltar gnag kyang dkad por sgrub pa'i log pa'i gtan tshigs la slo ldan rnams yid che sa par mi bya'o/ /bza' ba'i dam tshig /bsten pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang tshul ngazhin phyag len la 'debs par mdzad de/ gsol tshigs lta bu'i dus su gsol ri zas rnams sku mdun du bzhag nas 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ e ma ho/ a yig rang bzhin las byung ba/ /ka ni lhan skyes bde ba che/ /pā la skyong bar byed pa ste/ /de nang sha dang bdud rtsi'i tshogs// /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sbyangs rtogs sbar/ /zag med ye shes rang bzhin mtsho/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /yi dam he ru ka dpal dang / /nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor sogs/ /dgyes pa bskyed

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i byu la/ 711phyir 'bul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ / kā ri/ la la ho/ a ra li ho/ zag med bde bas dgyes dgur rol mjad (sdo/ sa/ /lhan skyes bde chen bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zla nyi'i rgyu ba sgra gcan gyiṭashrī zodi shrī nas/ /tshangs pa'i me yis haṃ yig dbu mar zhus/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi'i tshogs rnams kun bsregs nas/ /bcu drug cha ldan bde bas rab myos te/ /khams gsum de yi ngo bor hub kyis drangs//mtshan 'dzin gdug pa'i sbrul gyi srog rtsa bcad/ /cir snang dbyings su thim pas ci yang mthong / /gnyis med gnyis su med min spros bral che/ /(mtshams 'dir tshig rkang gcig chad dam snyam)/ 'jug pa'i dga' ston myur bar stsal du gsol/ /ring nas srid par 'khor ba'i ngal gso'i gnas/ /bde chen thar pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' der/ /dpal bo dpa' mos brtse bas grogs mdzad nas/ /yid ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis drang du gsol/ /zhes pa rnams shub bus gsungs shing nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis longs spyo da par mdzad/ yi dam gyi bris thang / rgyud kyi glegs bam/ bgrang phreng / rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka thod pa/ bum pa/ rgyan drug sogs dam tshig gi rdzas rnams 'bral spangs su mdzad cing /thun mong min pa'i dam rdzas rnams gzhan la ye mi ston par gas nga zhing sba ba mdzad/ dam tshig gso phyir du bdag 'jug bzhes pa dang / yi dam dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gi gtor 'bul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/rdor sems dang dam tshig sdo rje'i bzlas pa/ za byed mkha' 'akro'i sbyin sreg so gas nyams chags skong ba'i thabs rnams la yang 'grus par mdzad/

112 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ deng sang gi dus su sngags kyi dbang don du gnyer mkhan mtshan mo'i skar tshogs las kyang ches mang ba snang yang / dbang gral du bsdad pa kho nas chog par sems pa las khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin srung mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon par snang zhing / phal cher dbang gi mtshan nyid dang dam sdom gyi phyogs la rtog dpyod tsam yang med par thob thob nyan nyan gyi rnam grangs bsog pa'i ched du/ gang na ḍa dril dkrol mkhan zhig yod tshad thams cad kyi drung du rgyug ste gral la 'tshang ci thub byed cing / dbang gral rang nas rdo rje'i spun la kha 'thab dang lag 'thab kyis rtsa ltung gis phog pa 'ba' zhig tu snang mod/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis ni/ gsang ba'i mdzod kyi rgyud sa ra has thod pa'i 'grel par brengs pa las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgom par yang dngos grub 'thong/ /gang la bsgom pa dang ldan zhing / /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma 'grub/ /skye ba gzhan du dngos grub 'thob/ /re zhig dam tshig nyams pa na/ /dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dku'/ /zhes ga/sungs pa dang / rje bla mas snga gas rim chen mo las/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa zhig gis dam tshig bsrung ba la 'bad nas ltung bas ma gos na/lam bsgom pa cher ma byung yang skye ba bdun la sogs pa tshun chad kyis mchog 'grub par gsungs shing / bsrung bya'i dam tshig bsrung ba yal bar bzhag nas gzhan la 'bad pa skad byas kyang ngan 'gror 'akro bas dngos grub lta

spre rdom thar gyi don bsus pa'i tshul/ k+ṇi13zhog bde 'gro ya nga rnyed par dka' ste/ zhes sems rgyud dang dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rmi nga ngo/ las lan gcig ma yin par sa/sungs pa la thugs nges chen pos gsang snga gas kyi dam tshig sdom pa rnam par dag pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de ltar so thar dang byang sems dang sngags kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i tshul 'di ni rnam thar gyi mchog tu bzung bar bya ste/ lam rir/ chen mo las/ de ltar sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnams khas len pa la dpa' ba tsam ma yin par ji ltar khas blangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' bar bsrung zhing / rgya la cung zad 'das na yang myur ba myur bar rang rang gi phyir bcos kyi cho gas dag nga ra byed pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni gsung rab kyi gnad shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i rnam par thar par shes par byos la dam pa rnams kyi rjes su bslab par bya'o/ /riskes gsungs pas so/ /deng dus sngags gzugs seng ge'i gsob can rnams/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i rtsal gsum mi ldan par/ /cho ga tsam gyi ral pa gsig pa yis/ /gsang sngags gangs ri skyong bar byed do lo/ /mgon 'dis dam sdom rmang gzhi med pa la/ /bskyed rdzogs rgya phibs rim pa gnyis kyi rtser/ /thung 'jug tog gis nyer mtshan gsang sngags kyi/ /khang bzang brtsig 'dod bzhad gad gnas su mdzad/ /gang gi chos bzhin spyod pa'i thugs stobs dang / /mkhas rlom chos la dbang za'i snying khams gnyis/ /che bar mtshungs kyang rno rje 'chang gi bka'i/ /gtan tshigs yi ge mgon

114 rnam ra gyi don bsdus pan+de tshul/ 'di'i bzhed pa/ra mthun/ /de phyir srung sdom dag pa'i lcags kyu yis/ /dngos grub dga' ston 'gugs pa'i rnam thar 'dir/ snyi /yi rangs bya yi sngags gzugs glang smyon dag /g.yang khar rgyug la blo ldan su rjes 'brang //sku gsum ral pa'i thor cog mthon po bcings/ /sdom gastom dri med ka shi'i jes kyis klubs/ /theg gastam 'phags pa'i gsang tshig khrig pa khyod//mchog gasngam 'dus pa'i drang sro nga chen po ste/ /rdi mdzad chos dang mthun pa'i rnam thar la/ /sbyi ltar bsams kyang dad pa 'phel pas bdag /lti la thug kyang skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ /ni gsungs bsgrub par nus pa'i byin rlabs stsol/ /lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang ldan pa ni/ thun mong (ba sems gnas dgu'i sgo nas lus sems shin sbyangs kyis drangs pa'i zhi gam/sa dang /thun mong ma yin pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin nā/na tu brtan pa mnga' zhing / de bzhin du lhag pa shes rab kyi bslarnga / 5'ang thun mong ba mtshan nyid so so rig pa yid byed kyi sgo nas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / thun rno nga ma yin pa stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lhag mthong dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes so / /de dag kyang rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung tshad ma las rjes su dpogs pa ste/ sku na phra mo'i dus bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bstar skabs snang ba thams cad 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i rnam par shar bas/ zhabs 'og tshun chad du rje btsun gyi sku'i rnam pa lam lam byung bas thugs la mi bde ba lta bu byung zhing / phyis su/ yang de 'dra'i snang ba

rnami thar gyi dan bsdus pa 'i tshul/ k+ṇi15 skabs skabs su 'ong gi 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / dus phyisasgo ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs skabs slob ma 'ga' zhig la/ da lta ngene kyis gzhan la gtam gleng mo byed bzhin par yang sngags bzla mi nus pa ma gtogs dkyi/lnga 'alo/ ra gyi cho ga 'don thub pa 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / yang sku na phra mo/ri dus 7dbu ma 'jug pa zhal 'don mdzad skabs snang ba 'di tham sa cad rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu las/ don la tshugs thub tu grub pa cung zad kyang mi 'dug snyam pa yang yang thugs la 'char ba byung gsungs pa dang / mya ngan las 'da' khar/ nga'i lus bro 'tshal yang sems bde ba chen po nyams su myong gi 'dug da lta rang dang gzhan zer ba dang phyi dang nang zer ba 'di thams cad ro gcig tu song ba bzhin 'dug /ces bka' stsal pa dang / gzhan yang gsung mgur du/ mi kho bo'i kha bo ma lags te/ /pha ngag dbang mchog ldan bka' drin gyis/ /sems skye med 'di la blo kha phyogs// / ’dus de ring dga' ba'i glu ru blangs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams la theg pa chen po'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung la ngal ba byas pa rnams kyis dpyad na nges pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas yi dam lha'i zhal sa/zigs pa dang / zag med kyi mngon shes mnga' ba dang / rdzu 'phrul khyad par du 'phags pa ston pa sogs sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ba la mnga' brnyes pa shes sla ste/ bdag cag la mngon du gyur pa 'ga' nig ni gong du skabs skabs su bris zin pa ltar ro/ /mnyam bzhag pad+mari rtsa ba la sdang ba'i/ /bying rgod glang po dran shes thag pa yis/ /

116 ldam thar gyi don brtsas ba'i tshul/ nyer bcings gang thugs zhi gnas rdzing bu'i nang / /lhag mthong rgyu skar khrus la zhugs bzhin gsal/ /myong snang spros pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /dbyingar+sā dang rig pa dbyer med me long nang / /chos kun rdzun pa'i bzhin ras ngom pa yi/ /snang stong zung 'jug ya mtshan gzigs mor yengs/ /ma rig gnyid bral theg gsum 'phags pa yi/ /blo gros 'chi med lang tsho sgrub byed pa'i/ /sgom byung bdud rtsi'i mchod yon ma lus pa/ /gang thugs shel gyi yol gor gcig tu 'khyil/ /gang shar lha yi 'khor lor bkra /sgra grag sngags kyi gdangs su snyan/ /dran rtog bde stong rnam rol pas/ /tha mal snang zhen khyod la med/ /snod bcud ye shes rol pa'i gzhal yas su/ /khyod thugs gzhon nu bde stong lang tsho can/ /ting 'dzin 'char sgo gu yangs rtsed 'jo yis/ /mtshar sdug phyag rgyar rol pa'i dga' ston rgyas/ /gsum pa yon tan brnyes nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i tshul la gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhyen brtse nus gsum dang / mdzad 'phrin phyag rjes kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po la yang gsum/ 'chad pa'i rnga chen brdungs pas skal ldan gti mug gi gnyid las bslangs pa/ rtsod pa'i gnam lcags phabs pas rgol ngan log rtog gi brag ri bshigs pa/ rtsom pa'i phred ba spel bas blo gsal rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa brgyan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi/ 'chad pa'i kun slong / bshad bya'i chos/ /ji ltar 'chad tshul/ bshad pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis gsung chos gang dang gang 'chad pa'i skabs su/ thog mar

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 717rtsa ba'i bla ma gtso bor bzhugs pa'i tshogs kyi zhing la bdun rnamyo/ dag dang maṇ+ḍal sogs phul te/ bshad pa'i chos kyis slob ma'i rgyud 'a phan thogs pa'i gsol 'debs shugs drag mdzad cing / 'chad pa dngos kyi tshe/mdzod las/ chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pas/ /mdo sogs yang dag ji bzhin ston/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten choṭashrī brgyad dang 'khor ba'i phun—tshogs don gnyer gyi blo dang rang don yid byed sogs nyon mongs can dang de dang 'brel ba'i kun slong ngan pa'i dri mas cung zad kyang ma gos par/ bka' gdams pa'i zhal nas/ li mo'i bu ci tsam pa'i chos bshad cig bgyis kyang legs so tsam yang bdag gir byed ma myong / 'gro ba nyam thag pa min pa med pa la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba la ma bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i snying rje chen po dang / mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad mi ga/nas pa'i myang 'das la 'god par bzhed pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i thugs dgongs 'ba' zhig gis kun nas bslangs te 'chad par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bshad bya'i chos ni/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid spyir na stag tshang lo ts+tsha bas/ khyod la gtsor byas ha cang mchog 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis thub bstan dkrugs pa yang / /dāg snang phyogs med thugs mnga' khyod nyid kyis/ /myur du bsal nas /stan 'dzin mthun gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar chags sdang gis bstan pa dkrugs pa mi mdzad par ris med kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad na'ang / chos 'chad pa na khungs dang

ṭī18 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/brgyud pa rnam par dag ma dag la mi dpyod pa'i gang byung mi mdzad par/sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ sdud pa pos bsdus/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis bshad nyan gyis gtan la phabs/ grub thob rna54 ṭa5 kyis nyams bzhes mdzad pas gyud grol/ lots+tsha ba tshad ldan rnams kyis legs par bsgyur pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag dang bcas pa dang / mdo sngags gang gi skabs su yang 'khrul ba'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med pa/ khams gsum chos cikyi rgyal po tsong kha pa yab sras kyi ga/sung rab rin po che rnams 'chad par mdzad pas/ bshad bya'i chos rnams khungs btsun pa'i rnam par dag pa yin no/ /gsum pa ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ dam chos dri ma can du byed pa'i skyon legs par mi 'chad par no ra 'khrul can dang the tshom gyis 'chad pa byis pa thang chen por 'khyams pa lta bu/ dka' ba'i gnas btang snyom sa su bzhag nas sla sar spros te 'chad pa rgan po so med kyi/ zas za ba lta bu/ gnad mi phig par don dang ma 'brel ba'i gtam gyis zing zing bor byed pa bya rog gi tshang 'cha' ba lta bu/ nyan pa po'i rgyud tshod dang mi bstun par shes tshad lhus/ par bshad pa glen mas bu chung gso ba lta bu sogs mdor na cho sa 'chad pa'i skyo na rnams dor nas/ mdo 'chad pa na phun sum tshoganu/ pa lngas gler bslangs te 'chad/ rgyud 'arngo da pa na mtha' drug tshul bzhi dang rgyan bdun la sogs pa'i skabs phye ste 'chad/ bstan bcos 'chad pa na bshad thabs kyi yan lag lnga'i sgo nas spruchad/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung krāchad pa na lung ris/sa kyi dgag bzhag spong gsum dang bcas te 'chad/ lam rim blo sbyong sogs 'chad pa na sems 'dul ba'i ri ma pa/ ga tso

rnam thar gyi rdon bsdus pa'i tshul/ 71nyabor byas te 'chad/ bskyed rdzogs sogaṭa/ 'chad rngu na rgyud don man ngag gi gnad dang ldan par 'chad pa mdzad ༷sa gdul bya'i rmongs pa'i mun pa sel zhing / blo gros kyi pad+ma rgyas par byed pa'i smra ba'i nyi ma chen por bzhugs pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pa'i skye bo'i dbus na nyi ma bzhin du lham/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa chos bshad pa'i 'bras bu slob ma ji ltar byung tshul ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pas/ dbus gtsang / rna do khams/ hor dang rgya yul kun tu skal ba dang ldan pa nams kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/mdo dang rgyud sde dang / dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung du ma'i bshad pa dang /lam rim blo sbyo —ri baphye da rdzogs sogs mdo sngags kyi gdams pa du ma'i nyams khrid/ gzhan yang spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang dang rjes gnang /mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma'i klag lung bcas/ mdor na gdul bya gang la gang 'tsham gyis dam pa'i chos dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing bzhin du stsol bar mdzad pa'i dbang gis gsung gi bdud rtsi myang ba'i slob ma nub dz+dza ti'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa nas/ shar rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram la thug gi bar du gnam gyi skar ma dang / sa'i dreg pa lta bur khyab par gyur pas de thams cad su zhig gis bgrang bar nus/ 'dir ni che long tsam zhig baljad na/ lhar bcaṭan skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen

lha20 rnam thar gyi don bsdub pa'i tshul/thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dbang pos rje 'di nyid las chos bka' rgya cher gsan bzhed yod kyang ma grub pas ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid gsan pa dang / mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad du ma'i legs par bshad pa skyes kyi tshul du bzhes tshul sngar bshad pa ltar dang / ga zhan yang rje 'di nyid kyi yongs 'dzin du gyur cing tshur bla ma dam pa nyid las kyang chos gsan pas phan tshun bla slob gnyis kar gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis shing snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor los thub bstan gling bzhi yongs la bzhed rgur dbang bsgyur pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bdag gi mkhan rin po che rje btsun ngag dbang byams pa'i zhal snga nas dang / rje bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa khri blo gros rgya mtsho'i sprul pa'i sku sngo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi skye phreng rim par —byon pa rta tshag rje drung blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ rje'i dngos slob stag phu gu shri dpal ldan don grub kyi skye brgyud grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po stag phu sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag kyāl ba sngags ramari shrī par grags pa rwa sgreng yang dgon pa blo bzang don grub/ lung rtogs yon tan gyi mnga' bdag bde 'byor mkhan po ngag dbang do na grub rnams so/ /gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma 'gro 'dren sprul sku che ba'i khrod du/ gzu bo'i blos brtags na lung rtos/sa kyi yon tan mdzad 'phrin sogs gang nas 7kyang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i thugs sras gcis/ pur gyur pa ni/ rdze'ajam

rnam thar gyi don bkus pa'i tshul/ 721dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po ye shenu / brtson 'grus grags pa'i sde nyid yin la/ gzhan yang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho/ rta tshag rje drung sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po/ bar khams bstan pa'i gsal byed brag g.yab sprul pa'i sku blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug /lho brag grub chen gyi skye brgyud 'ol dga' rje drung sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las lhun grub/ byang sems bde mo thang ba'i skye brgyud sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i skye phreng brgyud pa rgyal sraṭasmu sprul pa'i sku thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i skye brgyud mnga' ris sprul sku/ dga' ldan khri ba dwags po ba'i yang srid bskal bzang yon tan lhun grub/ 'bru la mkhan chen sprul sku ye shes bstan sgron/tre bo lha mgon sprul sku blo bzang rnam rgyal/ sgrub khang sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal/ mkhar rdo sprul sku blo bzang rin chen/ nyi ma thang zhabs drung ngag dbang chos ldan dpal bzang sogs gangs ljongs na bzhugs pa'i dam pa'i yang srid du ma dang / rje sher 'byung blo gros kyi skye brgyud chu bzang sprul sku ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug /spyan snga pa'i skye brgyud cha gan no min han gyi sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan dge legs rgyal mtshan/ khri rgya nag pa'i sprul sku ngag dbang thub bstan 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi skye ba smin grol no min han gyi sprul sku ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i skye ba rong po no min han gyi sprul sku dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyus/ rje'i dngos slob rong po lce nag pa'i skye

722 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ brgyud girti sprul sku /mi la'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa g.yer gshong sngags rams pa 'jam pa blo gros kyi sprul sku dge 'dun zla ba gragasta pa/ stong 'khor zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi skye brargyud stong 'khor sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ /gzhan yang / stag lung sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ri 'bri gung zhabs drung dkon mchog 'phrin las/ hor grub chen zhabs drung byams pa bstan 'dzin sogs mdo khams kyi sprul sku che chung na nga po/ byang phyo sa/sa bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i mchog spru la ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / de'i yang sprul dbang phyug 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ /'jam dpal rdo rje no min han/ i la gug san no min han/ gtsang pa no min han/ erte ni paṇ+ḍi ta no min han blo bzang dbang chen dpal 'bar/ dza ya paṇ+ḍi ta'i spru la sku blo bzang snyan grags dge legs rnam rgyal/ maspru shri no min han blo bzang 'jam dpal dang de'i sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan dbang phyug /mkhar sngon nes chi tho yon dang shi re ge thu gnyis/ kyi sprul sku/ tham ka bla ma chos skyabs sku skye/mtsho bdun gyi tham ka bla ma pi lig thu no min han gyi sprul sku blo bzang brta na pa rab rgyas/ ra kho hu thog thu ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal ma tshan dang de'i sprul sku/ bka' 'gyur pa blo bzang tshul khrims kyi sku skye/ cha har yo ga tsa ri blo bzang thubha bsta/na rgyal marngo+on dang slob dpon bla ma'i sku skye/ a lag sha'i dwags po sprukā5 sku kun grol no min han/ mong gil cin cha gan ti yan chi'i sku skye bskal bzang bsta na 2dzin phun chothe/sa sogs che na po hor gyi yāl gru'i 'gro 'dren sprul sku/'i rigs ches mang du mchis/ chos kyi gdan

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 723khri 'dzin pa'i bla chen yang / rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin du gyur pa khri chen bya khyung ba ngag dbang chos grags dang / co ne pa ngag dbang tshul khrims gnyis/ khri ba spom po ra ba blo bzang dri med/ phag mo chos sde pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ stod lung pa ngag dbang chos grags/khams tsha ba blo bzang bstan pa/ rgyal rong pa blo bzang smon lam rnams dang / gzhan yang / dga' ldan shar byang nyag rong rgyud stod smad kyi mkhan po'i khrod du'ang rje 'di'i slob mar gyur pa mang du rma chiṭa// bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen mchog gi yongs 'dzin mnga' ris pa blo bzang chos 'phel sogs dang / 'bras spungs sgo 0 /nga bla ma rigs pa'i dbang phyug cun gar ba blo bza nga chos grags/ gnas brtan chen po sog po sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dbus pa bstan pa yar 'phel/ bra nye ba ngag dbang dge legs/hor skal bzang dngos grub/ a mdo ka ring pa blo bzang chos dar/ blo gsal gling bla ma go bo 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs/ byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba mi nyag sbyin pa don grub/ nyag ri ngag dbang grags pa/ nyag ri pu to ba/ kre hor blo bzang dge legs/ bde yangs bla ma zhabs drung /sngags pa bla ma blo bzang shes rab/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ se ra byes pa bla ma e ba blo bzang pori/khas mchog /lha sa ba byams pa smon lam/ dbus stod pa rin chen skal bzang sogs dang / smad pa bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan/blo bzang rin chen/ grags pa 'phrin las/ sbyin pa chos bzang rnams dang / gzhan yang / rwa ba stod/ mnga' dwags rgyal gsum// dpal 'khor 4ོ ṭashrī sde/ zhwa lu/ gangs can/ snar thang / lha rtse so gas gtsang

724 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/dbus kyi chos sde du ma'i chos kyi khri la bzhugs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa ches shin tu mang / mdo smad dgon lung chos sde'i khri ba rig pa'i gnas thams cagathugs su chud nas gsung rtsom mang du spel ba 'bras yul skyed tshal mkhan zur sum pa zhabs drung ye shes dpa la 'byor/ byams brtse'i mnga' bdag bde rgu zhabs drung ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho/ lung rigs dbang phyug rgya ṇ+ḍig smon rams pa blo bzang don grub/ gzhung brgya smra ba bskal bzang lha dbang / mkhyen rab dbang phyug wang zhabs drung skal bzang ye shes dar rgyas/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa bde rgu dar rgyas rgya mtsho/chos sde chen po sku 'bum gyi mkhan po 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ra kho dpon slob shes rab chos 'byor/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan po dge 'dun don grub/ gser tog no min han blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/mkhas grub chen po mi nyag zhabs drung ngag dbang blo gros dar rgyas/ thub dbang stag mtsher zhabs drung ye shes skal bzang / gro tshang mkhan po blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs dang / bya khyung mkhan po lung rtogs kyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa rtswa ba blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ rgyal batshodagyes pa'i lam la rtse gcig tu sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa bde khang pa blo bzang rab brtan/chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri ba sde ba zhabs drung 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho/ nya༅༅ga rtogs kyi mnga' bdag bso/da nams grags pa/sde snod 'dzin pa bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis mtshom// mdor na bod chen mdo /bams kyi yu'4 ljongs lho byang na 'khod pa'i chos sde che chung / sngags grwa/ sgrub sde ci rigs kyi slob dpon mkhas btsun bzang gsum so/gas kyi

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pagli tshul/ 123 yon tan dang ldan pa ches mang po zhig mchis so/ /pho brang chen por phu yin bla ma dpal rabyor hu thog thu dang / sgo mang hu thog thu/ chos sde chen po yung he gu/nga gi mkhan po sde snod 'dzin ba paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas 'od zer/mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas/ zhabs drung bskal bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/zhe ho'i bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan po gtsang pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ mdung nag zhabs drung sogs snga phyir bod nas byon pa'i dge bshes chen po mang po dang / chen po hor gyi yul du a lag shar rdor dbyings sogs rnal 'byor rgyud gtso bor gyur ba'i rgyud sde du ma'i cho ga dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs lag len gtsang ma byed pa'i dgon sde btsugs shing / 'khrul 'khor lcags mkhar sbyin sreg gi skor sosas kyi yig cha mang du rtsom pa bo lha btsun no min han ngag dbang lhun grub dar rgyas sam ngag dbang rdo rje/ or du sur mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs shing brtsam chos mang du spel ba no yon bla ma blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ u cu mu chin du 'chad nyan gyi grwa tshang dang sgru ba sde btsugs shing rje bla mas brtse bas rjes su bzung ba zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis/ pad dkar chos gling 'debs mkhan dus 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ har chen du lam rim 'chad nyan gyi grwa tshang gnyis btsugs shing yul phyogs du mar gzhi gsus gyi phyag len nam skedag rgyas par mdzad pa dang mdo sngags kyi chos mang du spel ba sogs phyag rjes che ba mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha btsun bkra shis dar rgyas/ mtshan nyid kyi brtsam chos mang du spel ba thor god dge bshes snyan grags/ thu

— lha26 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/med mong gol cin dgon pa'i 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon slon rams pa bstan dar/ zhabs drung ngag dbang rgya mtsho so gas dang / byang phyogs hal ha dang thor ngo/da kyi yul du'ang rje bla ma 'i slob mar gyur pari dge bshes mang po zhig yod krādug kyang zhib tu ma nges so/ /gsung rab mang po hor gyi skad du bsgyur pa dang chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher spel bas mtha' 'khob kyi skal ldan du rna ra phan gdags pa dang / rang nyid mdo sngags kyi nyams len la rtse gcig tu ba/zhol ba phyo pha ga nar ta'i gu shri ngag dbang bstan 'phel dang / u cu mu chin bzod pa ku shri dang / lots+tsha ba ngag dbang chos dpal/ a ro hor chin meng ge thu gu shri/ ja rod bu/ shri so gas sa mthar bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i gang zag bzang po grangs las 'das pa zhig byung snang bas/ de tham sa cad kyi ming re re nas smo sa mi nus so / /dben pa'i gnas su chos brgyad kyi rlung gis g.yo ba med pa'i sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs par mdzad pa'ang se ra byesdon bla zur bra0/ ri 'a/la snga nas ngag dbang don bru/ ba/ chos 'phags kyi namyo4 'phrul du gra— /rtswa/ pa nyag re chos grags kyi skye ba sku tshe 'dir yang byang chub kyi sems thugs la 'khrungs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po klong brdol bla ya ngag dbang blo bzang / sras rin chen brag gi bla ma brag rgyab sngags rams pa blo ngazang 'o+o ri ri krāphel/sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhang zhung dge slong ye the/sa mtha' ya drosmi / byang rtse dpon slob brag so ba ri khrod du kun spa nga myodzad pa sangs rgyas choṭa/ spruphel/sgrub pa rnam dag gi ngang nas lam rim sogs kyi krāchad nyan ོ dzad pa bya bral dge bathe/rnga shrī snyan gras/sdo5 dang mnga' riṭasu rnga/ tho gaṭashaṃ ched/ dbem/ gnas

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 72k+ṇiphur bu lcog tu skru/ba pa yun ring mdzad cing da cha na do pye/da rma chu'i 'gram du dgon pa sa/sar radeb sa mdzad pa bya bral dge bshes 'otsārdo byer/ 'bras spungs dge 'phel ba re rno/da ri dzin pa dka' ba bu ne ngos grub/ dge 'phel bla ma mdo mi da staka lung pa kun spangs chen po ngag dbang rab brtan/ rin chen gling sogs su sgrub pa rnam dag 'a sto /zho' zhing da lta bkra shis sgo mang gi chos khrir 'khod pa lha btsun smon rams pa mthu stobs nyi ma/ ri bo rtse lnga'i dben gnas kun tu bde ba'i tshal du bzhugs pa mdo smad 'brug tshang ba chos grags dar rgyas sogs dang / gzhan yang / mngon mtshan chung la sa chod che ba'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'ang shin tu mang ste/ dper mtshon na/ri bo rtse lngar rje 'di'i slob ma kun spangs byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas myong ba thon nas dus rtas/ tu sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsams nas mchi ma 'ba' zhig 'don pa zhig yod pa des/ rang gi sor mo bcad nas rje bla ma la maṇ+ḍal du phul bar/ bla rma dam pas ri khrod pa bzang pa ldeg la gre/nang nas ka ka ni mang du bzlas te mer bsreg tu bcug paṭapre dri zhim po krāba' zhig byung zhing / 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du rang gi lus mar mer 'bul bar 'dod pa la rje bla masdon nga ka/'a ma khrol bas/lho phyogs po ta lar lhung ste/ sgro na lam chen po ma/nga du btab nas rang 'u sa ltos pa med par 'phags pa spyan ras gzis/sa la phul nas tshe'i 'du byed 'dor bar byas pa dang / yang ri khrod pa shes rab snying po kho na kha ton byed pa nig gis rje bla ma mchog la lta ba'i nyarma sa myo re phu' bar bla ma dam pa thutso/sa shin tu dgyes nas bsngags brjod 5ga dzad pas dutrī ngon de krādra'i rigs

bho28 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ mang tsam zhis/ bru+ong 'dug go /rje bla ma rang nyid kyi zhabs 'brar b.ri khrod du'ang / ja sa —// bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel/ sku mdun cho sa nge nga stan pa rin chen/ nye gnas dge legasaske nam d+dha / kha' rnams/ kyis 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam la nyams len snyir por byas pas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs tshul rje bla ma nyid kyi 'a/la nas thos so/ /tshul 'di ni bka' gdams pa gong ma'i rnam thar du/ slob dpon ston pas jo bo'i lots+tsha byas/a mes kyis phyag ga/yog la 'bad pas bsgom long cher med cing / dgon pa pas rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa yin kyang / nyams rtogs snga ma gnyis mtho bar byung ba bla ma'i byin rlabs su ba/sungs pa dang mthun par snang / gzhan yang chan zhi tā then hwa shang / yung hwa shang / lo hwa shang / she hwa shang rtso/gas rje bla ma mchog gi slo ba mar gyur pa'i hwa shang gi slob dpon che ba 'ga' zhig kyang yod la/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas hwa shang zhig sa thag ring po'i lam gyi ngal dub la mi blta bar/ rje bla ma ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs pa'i drung du chos nyan par 'ongs pa la bla ma mchog nas dbu ma'i lta ba sa/sungs pas khos ji bzhin blor ma chud pas/ hwa shang na re/ bla mas gsu ngas pa'i lta ba de shes pa la sngon du bsag sbyang stobs chen dgos pa yin 'dug pas re zhig phyir log nas gnas chen du mar bskor ba sogs bsag sbya nga la rabad rjes sku drung du yong chog pa zhus nas song / /lo spruga'i mtshams nas slebs byung bar lta ba skyo nga tshul gyi dmis/sa rnam 'bog/sa pa gnang bas ji bzhin nges thub pa byung ste gnas nges med du bsam gtan bsgom par song tshul zhal nas gsungs pa thos/ bde skyid rgyal po'i sras bcu gnyis pa dang /

da ldam tharagyidonabasdusaparam̐tshul/ ge—wak+ṇi29gong ma 'di nyid kyi sras lnga pa dang drug pa brgyad pa sogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i gdung brgyud du 'khrungs pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa mang po dang /blon po chen po 'ga' zhig dang / nang 'khor gyi nyug rum pa yan chad kyi khrod na'ang bla ma mchog las chos nyan nas nyams su len pa mang zhing /shing sā la ba lta bu'i rigs mthon por 'khrungs pa'i sog po'i dpon po che chung grangs las 'das pa rnams rje 'di'i slob mar ma gyur pa med la/ bod nas kyang sde snod rkyud sde rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen dpyod zla dang bral ba stag lung ga zi'i gdung brgyud zhabs drung mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal dang / dga' bzhi gung paṇ+ḍi ta/ thon mi'i gdung brgyud zhabs drung sri chod tshe brtan/ rgya ma khri khang pa ja sag dbang 'dus sogs mi chen mang po zhig rje 'di'i slob mar gyur to/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma / dam nga 'i skyes rabs kyi phring ba 'dzin pa'i sprul sku/ chos kyi sa/dan khri la bzhugs pa'i bla chen/ bka' pod mang por sbyangs pa'i dge bshes/ sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i spong ba pa/ skad gnyis smra ba'i gu shri/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde la mkhas pa'i hwa shang / dad pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i khyim bdag sogs kyis mtha' skubus nor 'dzin gyi khyon thams cad yongs su gang bas/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ khyod kyi slob ma bzang po'i shing / dge ba'i me tog cher rgyas pa/ /dpyid ka'i shing ni me tog gis/ /brgyan pa lta bur mdzes par gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyur to/ /gzhung bzang nya phyis khog pa las thon pa'i/ /zab rgyas tshig don mu thi la yi phring / /mi brjed gzungs kyi srad bur nyer
