130 — —sam ra gyi naḍisdis+t+ri pa'itshul/ da ———sdi bstar ba/ /rnam dpyod mgrin pa'i rgyan tu 'chang ba 'dis/ /'chad pa gangs kyi ri ngor dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /smra ba'i seng ger rlom pa mtha' dag gi /khengs pa 'i ku mud cig char zum byed pa'i/ /legs 'doms nyi ma 'i 'od zer grangs med spros/ /thub sa/sung dri bral mdo sngags chu klung rgyun/ /blo bzang dgongs bzhed 'khyogs med yur rba la/ /nyer drangs skal bzang zhing sar phabs pa yis/ /gtan 'dun lo tog bskyed bsring 'phel bar byas/ /rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i rkang drug tshogs/ /bsod nams kyis gtsang zhal gyi pad+ma las/ /'ongs pa'i gdams ngag sprang rtsi sa cher myos pas/ /lam bzang mkha' dbyings 'phur lding zlos gar 'jin/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi pad+ma zum pa'i kha/ /legs gsung 'od kyi sen mos bkrol mkhas pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma 'di ko 'jig rten gyi/ /rmongs pa'i mu na pa sekru ba'i sgron me mchog /gnyis pa rtso4sdo nga/'i gnamabyulcags phabs pas rgol ngan log rtog gi brag ri bshigs pa'i tshul ni/ rgya gar dang bod du'ang sngon gyi mkhas pa tshad ldan rnams kyis rigs pa'i rtsod pa byed pa na/ snga rgol ba dang / phyi rgol ba dang / dpang po gsum gyis bya ba rnams so sor nges par byas nas rigs pa'i lam nas mi 'da' bar rtsod cing / — rgol ba gnyis kyi rgyal pham dpang po mkhas pas gzhung lugs dang mthun par 'jog pa yin na'ang /de lta bu'i tsi+o da pa'i srol bzang po nub nas/ deng sang gi rtsod pa phal che ba ni/ bu ston thams cad ma khyen pas/ rang nyid grags 'dod pha rol dma' dbab 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i rtsod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems can/ /

— rnam tharagyidon bsdus pa'i tshul/ 731ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud bsreg /de lta'i rtso da pa de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / legs bshad gze ma ra ma go las/ phyogs snga bslu ba'i zol sbyor 'ba' zhig gis/ /tshig don ma sprubrel sbyor lugs log pa 'god/ /rgol ba'i shes dogs snying rtsa 'dar ba rnams/ /chom rkun sdar ma nor la 'jab pa 'dra/ /rgol ba mkhas pa'i lung rigs snang bar 'bros/ /mi mkhas blun po'i mdun sar skad 'phang mtho/ /dris 'phangs drug sgra'i lhu sgras rna ba 'gas/ /rigs pa smra ba de dag 'ug pa'i spun/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byol thabs dang g.yo thabs kyis/ phan tshun shag 'gyed pa tsam dang / rtsa ba'i tshig don gar song cha med par skabs ma yin pa'i rtsod pa kho nas kha rtsal 'gran pa lhur byed cing / dzig rtsub dang mtshang 'bru sogs kyis pha rol po dma' 'be+ebs thub na rtsod pa song bar brtsi ba las/ gzhung lugs dang mthun pa'i n+ḍid pa rnam dag byed mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang shin tu dkon par snang / rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyis mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs chen mo dag gi dka' ba'i gnas rnams la mkhas pa gzhan dang 'bel gtam gyi rtsod pa mdzad pa na/— paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la'i rtsod pa shan 'byed kyi bstan bcos las/ rang nyid rgyal bar sprudod pa'i chags pa dang / /gzhan dag pham par 'dod pa'i zhe sdang dang / /rang gzhan grub mtha'i gzhung la rmongs pa gsum/ /rtsod pa'i bsam pa dug can yin pas spongs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid rgyal ba dang gzhan pham par 'dod pa'i rtsod pa'i phasam pa ngan pa dor nas/ pha rol po'i rgyud kyi ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang the tshom

da 732 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/gyi dri ma rnams sel ba'i phyir/ 'brel zla sgrub pa/ 'gal zla 'gog pa/mtshungs zla bsgre ba sogs rtsod pa'i yan lag du ma dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/gti mug gi dra ba gcod pa ral gri'i 'khor lo lta bu dang / sun 'byin gyi rlung gis mi g.yo ba ri rgyal lhun po lta ba dang / tshig dang don la ma rmongs ༄pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sras ltar rtsod pa mdzad do/ /rgol ba bcom pa yang / dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus su gu shri bzod pa dang / bco brgyad pa'i dus su rigs pa'i dbang phyug tu grags pa sgo mang bla ma chos grags dang / karma si tu zhes rig gnas la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de yang /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang gnas sum cu so gnyis las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtas gyis mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pa dang / dus phyis rtog ge'i /— ngengs pas 'gying ba go bo mkhan zur rtsang pa ye dpal yang dbu ma'i rigs pa phra mo 'ga' zhig las brtsams pa'i rtsod pas kha la smra bcad kyi rgya byin pas mtshon mdor na rje 'di nyid kyi rtsod pa mdzad pa na rtog ge la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa ji lta bu zhig yin kyang lkug pa'i ngang tshul lhur len pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ khyod kyi gsung ni gcig tsam gyis/ /pha rol tshar gcod mdzad pa na/ /gzhan dag mi smra'i tshul gnas pa/ /dgun gyi khu byug lta bu lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /deng dus rtsod par grags pa kun/ /lung dang rigs pa'i lam btang ste/ /tshig ngan yug mo'i kha 'dzing gis/ /bstan la dgag 5ba byed do lo/ /la cilas chos kyi rtsod pa ni/ /'khrug long kha mchus mjug sud byed/ //na byung rnam dag rtsod pa'i srol/ /dgun gyi me

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 733tog lta bur gyur/ /'ga' zhig 'khyos/sarga po'i blo jo/sa rta nu dang / /sbyar ba'i ltar r+sha/nga thal 'gyur nyag phran gyis/ /bye myo/'i chang bu lta bu'i dam bca' 'ga'/ /bshigs la phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar rlom/ /yan lag bzhi yi dpung tshogs ma bshams shing / /sna tshogs ma tshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor gzeng min yang / /mgon 'di rtsod nga'i la/ yul la phyogs tsam gyis/ /snying dang byin pa mi 'dar rgol ba med/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin zlog par dka' ba'i mda'/ /dngos stobs rirgas pa'i rtsal gyis 'phangs pa yis/ /phas rgol sbyin skyes spobs pa'i grong bcom ste/ /thub bstan gangs ri 'dzin pa khyod gcig nyid/ /gsum pa rtsom pa'i phreng ba spel bas blo gsal rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa brgyan pa'i tshul ni/ deng sang mkha'i/ pa dang mi mkhas pa du mas brtsam chos kyi rigs sna tshogs pa 'gran bzhin du spel ba phal che ba ni/ legs bshad gze ma ra mgo las/skyes bas/ thob dang sbyangs stobs blo gros bral/ /'on kyang rtsom pa'i khur gyis dub pa rnams/ /tshig don tha snya/na don spyi mi the/sa bzhin/ /rtsom pa'i bya ba sa/shog chag bya dang mtshungs/ 'khor bar 'khor tshul thar lam bgrod tshul sogs/ /yang dag don gyis stong ba'i tshig sbyor rnams/ /ma ning gzugs mdzes rgyan gyis spras pa lta ra/ /mthong na mtshar kyang 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub/ /nang gi rang bzhin gsal bar ston byed pa'i/ /btsog gtam lhur len mngon brjod mdzes po rnams/ /mkhas rnams ngo tsha skyupo/ bro 'phel byed ba'i/ /mi gtsang bum pa rgyan gyis spus spu nyid/ /ha cang mngon brjod brda tshig dam po yis/ /kun nas

734 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/bcings pa'i glegaṭa/ bamyo5 grangs mang yang / / yi dwags phyug po'i nor gyi phung po ltar/ /su la'ang mi phan med pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /yi ge lci yang spel ba kho na'i phyir/ /skor tshogs mang po'i tshig tshogs rgya che yang / /don gyi mdo med sho dang mig mangs ltar/ /rnam rtog rgya bskyed mgo bo 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /rang gi blo gros rtsal las ma 'ongs pa'i/ /gzhan gyis byas pa'i tshig zur 'chos pa dang / /gzhan nas blangs te rga/'a/na du 'god byed pa/ /seng ge'i lhag ma za ba'i wa dang mtshungs/ /nang du don bzang no ra gyis phyug gyur kyang / /tshig sbyor ma dag chad lhag skyocha/ can rnams/ /rigs rus mtho yang mdog dang gos ngan na/ /rigs ngan gdol ba'ang bo 'dri byed dang mtshungs/zhes gang gsungs pa las ma 'das par snang zhing / rje bla ma 'di'i mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung dang / — tha na gsol 'debs sho lo ka yan chad kyi ljags rtsom ji 'dra zhig mdzad pa thams cad brjod bya rgya che la don zab pa/ tshig sbyor legs la snga phyi 'brel chags pa sogs mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog cing / bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan tu gyur pa 'ba' zhig tu yod do/ /rtsom pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myo /sa bzung ste dam pa bar ma chad pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba'am gsung gi gnang ba thob pa gsum yod cing / de dag re res kyang gzhung phun sum tshogs pa rtsom nus pa la/ rje 'di la ni de gsum ga tshang ba yi ོ/ no/ /des na legs bshad kyi rtsom pa mdzad pa'ang / rgyal dbang thams cad

ji da wa ——— — rnam tharagyidon bsdus pa'i tshul/ 135 mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dpag bsam rin po che'i snye ma/gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi sgo nas bstod pa thugs rje'i nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi rnam thar mkha' spyod grub pa'i gtam snyan lha'i rnga bo che/ grub mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan/ /dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad sems bskyed dang po rtsom 'phro can/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod/ bzang spyod smon lam gyi rnam bshad kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i rnam bshad mkhas pa dga' bskyed tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangs/byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i sa bcad/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul bshad pa theg chen 'jug sgo/ dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa'i sgron me/ lta khrid mdor bsdus gnyis/ theg pa chen por blo sbyong ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ da ge legs su pyed pa'i gtam drang srong mngon par dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor la brten nas lam gyi rim pa'i dge sbyor skyong tshul’/ bla ma mchog gsum spyi'i mchod chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ rje bdag nyid chen po gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs lhag pa'i lha sna tshogs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa/ thub dbang la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nasacabastod pa/ 'jigs byed/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can ma rnams kyi bstod pa/ spyan ras gzigs la sa/dung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa/ byang chub lam rim dang sbyar ba'i gsol 'debari smi/

d+ngha136 da wa rnamitharagyirdon bsdus pa'i tshul/bla ma mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang nges 'byung skyo shas kyi shugs glu/ gzhan yang bla ma mang po'i gsol 1debs brtan bzhugs kyi skor/ mgur ma dang zhal gdams bslab bya'i rim pa mang po dang / sngags kyi skor la/ bar do'i 'phrang grol gyi gsol 'debs rnam bshad gtan bde'i bsil ba ster byed zla zer/ gsang 'dus bsnyen yig dngos grub bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / 'khor lo sdom pa snu dril gnyis kyi bsnyen pa byed tshul mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdud rtsi'i bum bzang /blode mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi bum chog dang bdag 'jug ngag 'don/dril bu lha lnga'i smon lam shis brjod/ bde mchog gi zas mchod/ dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya tshul 'dod pa 'jo ba/ de'i sgo nas lho sgo'i cho ga bya tshul sdig sgrib sbyong byed zla ba'i 'od zer/ bde mchog snu i pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab dkar bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bstod pa dpa' bo dgyes pa skyed byed bde ba chen po'i sgra dbyangs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal snying po kye rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i rgya mtsho/ gsang bdag 'a/lor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje lhun po brtsegs pa/ 'khor chen lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba/ de'i mngon rtogs mdor bsdus/ 'khor lo chen po'e ras bris dang bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya tshul srid sa/sum bgegs dpung 'joms byed rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor chen gyi sbyin sreg bya tshul dngos grub sa/ter mdzod/ tshem bu dmar khrid kyi man

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 737ngag bdud rtsi yang zhun/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod/de'i shis brjod smon lam/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs smyur gnas cho ga dang bcas pa las sgrib dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog sbyin sreg shā/shin po rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa mngon dga'i zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas/ de'i smon lam shis brjod/ bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga dgos 'dod re ba kun skong / gza' yum gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga bkra shis rab rgyas/ bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs 'chi bdag 'jom sa pa'i mtshon cha/ de'i sgo nas tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/de'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshu/la gyi cho ga dgos 'dod re ba kun skong / bde mchog dkar po yab yum la tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i gsol 'debs bde chen bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / bde mchog dkar po dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs gter mdzod/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying bo/ de'i tshe khrid dngos grub bang mdzod/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med dga' ston/ de'i bstod pa tshe'i dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ 'chi ltas brtag pa dang tshe sgrub bya tshul/ rdor sems bla ched lugs kyi rjes gnang gi tho yigardor sems yab yum gyi bum sgrub bya tshul gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ gdugs dkar gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga bkra shis rab rgyas/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dkar po'i sgrub thabs/'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi lhab thabs che chung / mi g.yo ba 'i snab

738 rnam tharagyi donabasdusapa'itshul/ ——————da thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin sa/sang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs/ dzasta la nag po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun myo/ sgrol ma la rigaso la ba 'debs tshul 'dod dgurere mchog sbyin/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i bstod pa/ bla mgon dbyer med kyi ba/so la 'debs dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ rdo rje srung ma rnams la mchod gtor 'bul chul las bzhi lhun grub/ yang chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul tshul/ rnam sras kyi gtor chog /dam can gyi gtor chog dpa' bo'i sa/da rgyang/ 'phrin las drag po gnyer du gtad pa'i tshigs bcad/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog zhi ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ rgyal po sku lnga'i gso la mchod/ rma chen gyi gsol mchod/pho lha dung skyong dkar po'i gsol mchod/ bsangs chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ mahā nā se'i gsol mchod/ dgon lung gi gnas bdag 'od ldan rgya mtsho'i gsol kha sogs mdo sngags kyi gsung gi skor rnams dang /dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas/ sum rtags kyi don nyung ngur bshad pa blo ldan dga' bskyed/ tsan+dan jo bo'i lo rgyus dang skor tshad rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgyal khab chen po'i nub sgo'i mchod rten dkar po'i dkar chag dad pa rgyas byed/ ri bo rtse lnga'i dkar chag rgyas pa rtsom 'phro can rnams dang / dris lan dang chab shog skor mang po bcas bzhugs/bka' rgya ma'i skor yang / bde mchog lus dkyil gyi draskyed rim dmar khrid zhal shes bde chen gsal pa'i sgron me/ rje btsuk+ka rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen lhab kyi rnam bzhag gsang chen bcud kyi thig

—— rnam tharagyidonabasduṭagepa'itshul/ 739wa le/ gtum mo'i khrid yig bde ba chen po'i rgya mtsho/ shin tu gsang ba'i mgur dbyang4 mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying gi thig le bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs/ phag mo'i phreng sngags kyi mchan 'grel/ kyi rdor gyi rdo rje glu'i 'grel pa/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag dus 'khor gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag lam zab mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa las tshogs dang r+pācas pa 'jam dbyangs nang sgrub dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa bde chen rgyas pa'i dga' ston/ bde mchog lus dkyil dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor snyan brgyud ma/ bde mchog mkha' spyod mgon po gsum 'brel gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug tu bgrod pa'i them skas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim sgom tshul shin tu zab pa/mgon po snying zhugs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du chag med bya tshul klag chog dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'izusgo nas tshe sgrub bya tshul 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ lha gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i tshe sgrub rgyun 'khyer tshe srog brtan byed rdo rje'i go cha/ tshe bdag mgon po'i tshe sgrub bya tshul/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag /gtor sgrub kyi skabs su mkho ba'i gshin rje gshed dkar rtser dmar gsum gyi bstod pa 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa rnams yod do/ /dus kyi dbang gis chos don du gnyer ba nyung bas bskul ba po ma byung ba dang / rgyal khab chen por rtag par bzhugs pas 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis bar bcad pa'i sku

— 740 rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/dbang mi 'du bar brten/ gzhung chen po 'ga' zhig la bka' rtsom gyi’dgongs pa gtad kyang ma grub pa dang / 'jug pa'i rnam bshad sems bskyed dang po tsam dang / phar phyin lam sgrigs dang / legs bshad snying po'i dka' 'grel/ bde mchog chos 'byung rnams mgo tshugs tsam dang / 'jigs byed skyo lugs la legs bshad khyad thon mdzad pa'ang 'phro can du lus snang ngo/ /gsung rtsom/ snga phyi thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms na po ti dgu tsam yo da tshod 'dug kyang / gces smras byed mkhan ma byung bas 'ga' zhig dpe rgyun chad cing / dus phyis gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i gras su ma chud pa yang 'ga' re snang ngo / / gzhung lugs ma lus ri byi'i 'khyor chu bzhin/ mkhyen yangs mgrin par dog pa med bathung ba'i/ /blo che na khyod kyis 'jig rten rmongs pa'i mun/ /sel byed legs bshad sgron ma tshar du dngar/ /'thad ldan lung rigs skya ba zung g.yo bas/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i khyon kun gzhal bzod pa'i/ /sngon med gzhung lugs gser gyi gru bo che/ /blo gsal don mthun yongs kyi bsten byar bskrun/ /sdeb sbyor snyoms la lhod chags glang chen 'gros/ /don zab gting na gsal ba mtsho nang gzugs/ /tshig rgyan lang tshor 'os pa'i do shal ltar/ /bkod pa'i khyod gsung ngo mtshar mthong ba'i tshe/ /dpe don 'phang lo mthun par 'khor tsam gyis/ /mngon brjod nyung ma'i rnam grangs 'ga' 'dren par/ /rnam dpyod shing rtas snyan dngags nor bu'i dpya/ /drangs par rlom zhing sgrogs la khrel bgad shor/ /nyin byed nub pas zum par mi byed la/ /chab dang

— sgrum thar gyi don bkus pa'i tshul/ k+ṇi41 bral bas rnying bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /khyod gsung pad+ma mtshar 'di srid mtha'i bar/ /dus bzhi 'jig kyang mi/nyams gnas par nges/ /gnyis pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul la/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan thun mong ba 'jig rten gyi dar rgud sems can gyi bde sdug sogs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mngon shes khyad par can mnga' bas/ bstan srid la gegs chags 'byung 'gyur 'ga' zhig gzigs nas glo bur du las sbyor sogs kyis bzlog par mdzad pa dang /slob ma 'ga' zhig la'ang bar chad 'byung ba mkhyen nas bzlog thabs kyi rim gro sogs bka' stsal pa bzhin bsgrubs pas bgegs las grol ba'i lo rgyus sogs ches mang zhing / gsung 'phros kyi zhar la phyis 'byung 'ga' zhig gsungs pa deng sang de kho na bzhin thog tu babs na'ang dgag bya'i dbang gis 'dir gsal bar smra mi nus so/ /mkhyen pa'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams kyi dka' gnad dang /thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams tshig spyi tsam du ma lus par rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i nges shes brtan po brnyes pas thar 'dod rnams la blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par ston par badzod do/ /brtse ba'i yon tan kyang thun mong d+dha sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la lhag par brtse ba'i dbang gis nad kyis nyen pa dang / rgyal bo'i chad pa dang / gdon gyis gtses pa'i sems can mgon skyabs dang bral ba rnams gyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzad cing / brtse ba'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa mkha' khyab kyi sems

142 rnam tharagyirdonabasdus pa'itshul/ —da wacan thamasag cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral 'dod khur du 'khyer ba'i snying rje chen po bcos ma ma yin pa thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i dbang gis dgra gnyen ris su ma chad pa'i sems can thams cad la mas bu gcig pa ltar skyong bar mdzad pa ni/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu ba las/ khyod ni ma bcol legs mdzad pa/ /khyod ni rgyu med bzhin du byams/ /khyod ni ma 'dris mdza' bshes te/ /'brel ba med pa'i gnyen 'dun lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tha na zhal gyi dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba yan chad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ji snyed bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du mi 'gyur ba med pas/ mkhas grub rjes rje bla mar bstod pa las/ mgon po khyod kyi zhal gyi dbugs tsam yang mtha' dag 'gro la sman pa'i rgyur 'gyur na/ /tshogs gnyis spyod pa gzhan lta mo sa ci 'tshal/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skye rgu thams cad kyi mgon skyabs su bzhugs pa yin no/ /nus pa'i yon tan ni/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor brtan po la mnga' brnyes pas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel mtha' dag la dbang 'byor zhing / gdon drag po dang / 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad tshabs chen gyis zin pa'i nyam thag du ma bum chu dang / byin rlabs dang / ljags chab 'debs pa tsam gyis kyang gsos te bde ba la bkod pa ches mang la/ rje bla ma 'di nyid zhal bzhugs ring la bstan pa la mi dad pa'i sdig blon stobs che ba rnams kyis bsam sbyor log pa ji snyed brtsams kyang / dam pa 'di'i nus mthus nyi ma'i 'od kyis me khyer bzhin du zil gyis mnan pas mngon ——

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 743gyur du gnod pa bskyel nus pa gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /rje bla ma nyid la'ang phrag dog gi gdon kyis rgyud brlams pa'i skye bo ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig gis mthu byad mnan gtad sogs kyi sbyor ba mang du byas kyang brag la khu tshur bsnun pa bzhin du ci yang glags ma khel bar ma zad/ ra spu'i 'ur rdo ra bo'i mgo zer ba'i dpe ltar rang nyid gtan brlag gi rgyur song tshul sngar bshad pa de dag dang / gzhan yang 'ga' zhig yod kyang brjod pa'i dgos pa ma mchis so gsum nga/ mdzad 'phrin phyag rjes kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul ni/ 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin cing /bstan pa rin po che sdon dus 'phags yul sogs su dar zhing rgyas na'ang /dus kyi rim pas phyogs gzhan thams cad du nub pas/ deng sang gi dus su bstan pa dar rgyas che ba'i yul ni/ 'jam dbyangs mi rje gong ma chen pos bdag gir bzhes pa'i mnga' zhabs kyi yul phyogs 'di kho na tsam du zad pas/ bod dbus gtsang dang / mdo khams/ chen po hor gyi yul gru na 'khod pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa thams cad nag phyogs kyis gtse ba med par bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson du yod pa 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa 'di nyid gyigong ma chen po'i rigs kyi cod pan du bzhugs nas bdag po chen po'i thugs cho sa la 'dun par mdzod pa 'di kho na'i mthu yin pa kho bos zol bstod dang gcam bu'i bsngags brjod ma yin par blo gros dang ldan pa mtha' dag gis mngon sum tshad mas grub pa 'di ltar yin no//

744 rnam tharagyidonabasnusapa'itshul/ — da ge—des na 'jam mgon bla ma dkon mchog mtshan can gyis rje 'di la phul ba'i 'phrin yig las/ 'akro la phan bde'i mchod yon sbreng mkhas thub bstan ke la sha yi spor/ /sa gsum 'khor los bsgyur rgyal thi ba'i seng ge chen po khyod bzhugs pas/ /bgrang yas bstan 'dzin ri skyes mtha' dag nges par mgon dang bcas ba ge /nag phyogs las rgyal snyan pa'i ba dan da ni srid rtser bsgreng bar byed/ /gang gi legs mdzad sprin sngon gdengs ka can/ /stug por brtsegs pa'i char gyis ma bskyangs na/ /shar phyogs 'dzin mar blo bzang ring lugs kyi/ /nyal 'gro 'di dag chu thigs go 'phang 'dzin/ /ces gsungs pa rang bzhin brjod pa kho na'o/ / rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis deng sang gi bla chen 'ga' zhig ltar/ g.yo sna/ kha gsag gzhog slong / rnyed pasarnyed pa 'tshol ba sogs log 'tsho bsgrub pa'i thabs rmi lam tsam du'ang mi mdzod na'ang / phar phyin bsdus pa las/ rkang ba'i bkra shis gyur pa'i rdul dag kyang / /spyi gtsug dam pas blangs shing lha dang mis/ /phyag 'tshal mgos gtugs thob pa kun tu 'khyer/ /de phyir tshul khrims dpal ldan rigs mchog yin/ /zhes dang / /bstod pa brgya lnga bcu ba las/ mtho la phrag dog mi mdzad cing / /dma' la rngan chan mi mdzad la/ /mnyam la 'gran pa mi mnga' bas/ /khyod ni 'jig rtenagatso bor gyur//ces gsungs pa ltar/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i stobs kyis che rgu thams cad

stse—— — rnam tha ra gyi rdon bsus 3'i tshunya—/— 143kyis khengs dregs dor nas zhabs kyis reg pa'i rdul yan chad mchod pa'i gnas su byed pas/ zang zing gi dngos po bsarma gyis mi khyab pa dbyar dus kyi sprin bzhin du 'du bar gyur la/ de yang bla chen gzhano bzhin rdu rang gi nye du skyong ba dang / thab kha dang / sbyin bdag gi ngo 'dzin sogasadon med kyi phyogs su mi gtong bar/ bod du gyol ba yab sras kyis mtshodo pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams la 'thul ba/ jo 'o rnam gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i rten gsum khyad par can rnams dang / rgya gor— rno rje gdan/ bod kyi gnas chen mtha' dag ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogar+sā po ta la sogs gnas chen rnams la mchod 'bul/ mtha' dbus na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde ji snyed la mang 'gyed dang / phog dang ja tshul rgyun chags kyi thebs/ dbul po dang 'phongs pa rnams la zas gos gna.oṃmal sogs yar mchod mar sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzod cing / gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten rnying ba gso ba dang gsar du bzhengos pha sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang sa bon ma byung bas re re nas smos ma nuyoso/ /gzhan yang / bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa la zhib tu brtags na yum gyi mdo dang bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan sogs las gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa phacu'i yongs sbyong dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams kyang re re nas sbyar te bshed du yod aud kyang tshig gi sbos pa ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas ma bris so/ /'on tsung thod pha chen po'i gzhung la ngal ba byas pa rnams kyis sngar brjod zin pa de dag la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na shes par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na rigs

da khri 6 rnam tharagyi don bkus pa'i tshul/pa'i dbang phyug gis/ de phyir de yi bsgrub bya ru/ /gyur pa'i ye shes rnam dpyad bya'i/ /'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pū/ /nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho med/ /ces sa 'og gi gter dang srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa lta bu'i yon tan thun mong bas grol ba don gnyer la mi phan pas nyer mkho med cing / thun mong ma yin pa 'khor ba lugs 'byung ldog gi rim pa thabs dang bcas pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' mi mnga' dpyad nas mnga' ba zhig la bsten bya yongs 'dzin du bya dgos par gsungs pa dang /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos rje rin po che'i rnam thar zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rje'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rnam thar gyi gtso bo chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyis chos zab mo thams cad thugs su chud cing / dngos stobs kyi rigs pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad thugs su chud pa 'di yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid lha rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyarbe pa mnga' ba las gtso bor gyur pa ni gong du yang yang brjod pa bzhin theg pa chen po'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshul ma lus pa thugs su chud nas/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la thar lam phyin ci ma log pa ston par mdzad pa nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ /de bas na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni lung bstan gyi rnam grangs mang pos bzang bor sgrub dgos pa ma mchis na'ang / rnam grangs tsam du rje 'di'i lung bstan yin nges shes pa 'ga' zhig 'god pa la 'gal ba ma mthong zhing / de'ang dam pa la la sa sprul pa'i glegs bam dang / ma cig gi lung bstan dang —/—

— ——— ————da nomi thar gyi donabasdus pa'i tshul/ —14lha da rat+na'i spyi lung chen mo dang / gong sa lnga ba'i gsang ba rgya can sogs las rje 'di nyed lung bstan tshul mang du zer ba thos mod/ /'on kyang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che la sa byung ba nyid khungs btsun cing don la shin tu 'byor bar snang ngo / /de yang glang ri thang pa lung bstan pa'i skabs su'ang zur tsam 'byung na'ang / shin tu gsal ba ni pha chos kyi ma 'ongs pa lung bsta na pa'i le'u las/ da ni ruṭa/ mtshams nyid na mdo gsum gyi phugs gcig na/ ngas byin gyis rlabs pa'i bzang po bzang po 'ga' zhig 'ong / mi ring ba ni lcang ma can no/ /zhes pa'o/ /de yang 'ga' zhig 'ong zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas gcig kho na min pa shes pas na/ lung 'dis rgyal dbang bdun pa dang rje bla ma 'di nyid bcas yab sras gnyis ka dkyus gcig tu lung bstan par snang ste/ yab sras gnyis ka'i 'khrungs yul rus mi gcig pa rgya dang bod kyi sa mtshams zhig yin pas rus mtshams nyid na zhes dang / de yang a mdo/ chab mdo/ chu mdo ste gsum la mdo gsum du grags shing / mdo khams kyid+ngha sa'i lung pa bye brag zhig gi phugs yin pas mdo gsum gyi phugs na zhes pa dang 'byor ro//ngas byin gyis rlabanu/ pa zhes nga/ ya ba sra sa gnyis ka jo bo chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhye na pa sku phreng jo bo rje dang thugs rgyud gcig pa tshad ma'i lung gis 'grub pas / rje blo bzang ye shes pa de nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing / /brgyud nas byin gyis brlabasdo/ tshul gyi gsang ba thun mong ma yi na pa'ar mang du ma chis so bzad po bzang bo zhes pas rkyal dbang thams/ cad ma/kye na pa'i mtshan la blo bzang bskal

ṭī4bye rnam thar gyi don bkus pa'i tshul/ ——bzang zhes bzang sgra gnyis+t+ri 'ong ba dang / mi ring ba ni nye ba'i don yin pas rgyal dbang de nyid kyi nye ba'i sras su rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid dang / de'ang lcang ma can no zhes lcang skya'i mtshan can du bltan pa nyid do/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /yang sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las kyang / 'dzam gling shar phyogs rgya nag gi yul du rje bla ma 'di nyid dang / 'jam dbyangs gyigong ma mchod yon du 'gyur tshul dang / de'i mthus chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang /phyogs de'i las can mang po 'phags yul lta bu'i dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / phyogs tha dad nas skyes chen dam pa mang po der 'du ba dang / 7gong ma chen po chos tshul la mkhyen rab rgyas te bstan pa la bkur mchod byed pa dang / las can gyi 'bangs rnams kyang de'i rjes su 'brang pa dang / chos la mi dga' ba'i sdig blon dang bdud rigs thams cad stobs med par 'gyur tshul rnams bsngags brjod mang po dang bcas gsal bar bstan cing / ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa dang / / zhes rje 'di'i mtshan sgra yang dngos su thon par snang ste 'di ltar/'dzam bu brik+ṣas mtshan pa'i gling / /yul gyi dbus gyur ma gha ta/ /de yi byang shar phyogs ngos kyi/ /sa 'dzin mdzes pa'i grong khyer che/ /bcu phrag dge ba'i mtshan ma can/ /sa la gnas pa'i 'jam dpal zhing / /de na las can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol ba dang / /'jig rten mes po gnyis pa zhig /sa la 'phos ltar lhan du 'khod/ /de tshe lugs zung 'brel ba yi/ /dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'gyur/ /lha dbang

rnam tharagyidonabasdus pa'itshul/ 749lus kyi snang brnyan ni/ /skye rgu'i gtsug na zla ltar gsal/ /tong—khung dā ra dzā de yis/ /cod pan rtse mo nor bur mdzes/ /las can mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /rnam dkar sbrang char rgyun mi 'chad/ /bka' lung gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /snyan pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs bcur ldir/ /e ma de nas de dag gi /lugs bzang mngon du mthong ci 'tshal/ /sgra 'dzin lam du son tsam kyang / /bsod nams zhing sa dag pa la/ /rnam dkar sa bon bskrun brtson pa'i/ /sku gsum 'bras bu lhag par smin/ /de nas chos dang rgyal po'i srid/ /yun ring 'tsho zhing gnas par 'gyur/ /de tshe blo dang ldan pa yi/ /thub bstan spel byed mang du 'byung / /ded dpon brtson ldan du ca/ yang / /'phags yul rgya mtsho'i gling du 'jug /zab rgyas dam chos tshong zong gi /yul der ma rig dbul 'phongs sel/ /bsil ldan ljongs nas drang srong gi /rgyal mtshan thegs pa du ma yang / /las can mang po'i don phyir du/ /phyogs der bsod snyoms rgyu zhing lhags/ /ji ltar shel gyi me long nang / /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan gsal ba ltar/ /sa bdag yid kyi me long nang / /de ltar chos kun gsal bar 'gyur/ /ba glang khyu mchog rjes su 'jug /de bzhin mchis 'brangs 'gro kun kyang / chos bzhin rje ltar spyod byed pa'i/ /mchog gi bya bas dus rnams 'da'/ /de lta'i byurnam dkar dpung tshogs kyi/ /me tog mda' can sde dang bcas/ /ma lus pham par byas nas kyang / /bdud rnams mya ngan khang bur 'jug /dper na ma la ya yi rlung / /dri bsung ldan pa chos nyid de/ /de ltar

750 rnam thar gyi donabasdus pa'itshul/ da wa dam pa gnyis po dang / /'grogs pa de kun yon tan ldan/ /don te blon po ma rig can/ /mi dge'i dbang du gyur dag kyang / /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug gyur par du/ /rang gi gnas nas bskyod par byed/ /mdor na dus der phan bde ba/ /mtha' dag dga' mgur spyod byed pa'i/ /mi mthun dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /dge tshogs pad tshal ci yang rgyas/ /de las byung ba'i mtshan ma yang / /rmad du byung ba kho na yi/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i phreng ba yis/ /zhing de kun nas mdzes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /lung bstan 'di dag bu/ brjod don rnams skyes bu dam pa gzhan su la sbyar kyang ji bzhin 'grig dka' zhing / rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i tshul dang sgo thams cad nas shin tu mthun pa gzu bo'i blo can rnams kyis btas/sa na shes par snang ngo / /las nyon rlur gis dkrugs pa'i 'a/bor ba'i mtsho/ /zegs ma tsam yang sdurga/ ban+da la rma rlangasdo4 kyi/ /cho nge 'byin 'di rgya/la rnams zhi bde yi/ /mnal las bzhengs par bskul ba'i rol mor bzang /de phyir lto bar dug rga/sum mngal sbrum pa'i/ /'khor ba sri na cho/sa yan lag bcu ga/nyis kyis/ /'gro kun dbang med bzung nas mi rtag pa'i/ /kha sgor 'jug la snying rje chen po yis/ /ma bzod mgon 'dis rgyal dang rgyal sraṭapre kyi/ /snying stobs sra ba'i go cha ma luru/ bgos/ /bdud 'dul dab re po rnams kyi sto bas bcu'i mtshon/ /ma tshang mertsed pa thugs rje'i phyarga/ tu bsnams/ /bdud dang mu steri+o/sa chu+osas narmi se spa bkong ba'i/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi dam bca'i rnga chen brdungs / /tshad med rnam

rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i tshul/ 751bzhi'i dngu/nga gi tshogs bsdus te/ /snying rje'i gom stabs shugs drag myur bkod nar// /stong nyid ye shes thogs rdug bral ba'i skyogs/ /rgya chen thabs mkha sa shugs kyis nyer 'phangs pas/ /sgrib gnyis srog rtsa bcad nas 'khor ba'i krong / /bden med sgyu ma'i dur khrod nyid du byas/ /thugs rje'i dpyang thag brtan po brkyangs pa yis/ /sdug bsngal btson gyi dong nas bder bton te/ /thar pa phyir mi ldog pa'i grong khyer du/ /bcug pa'i sems can grangs tshad brjod las 'das/ /rdo rje zla ba dag pa'i snying po kun/ /'thungs pa'i zhal dkyil yid du 'ong ba yi/ /'dzum tsam bstan pas sgrol ba'i las bzang can/ /mang zhig mtho ris skas la 'dzegs te song / /sgrib pa'i cha kun spangs pa'i nyi ma zhig /srid pa'i ljongs 'dir de ring gsar 'ongs nas/ /gdod nas ma rig mun pas bris pa yi/ /las snang ri mo mang zhig bsub 'di ca/tshar/ /kwa ye mgon 'di'i bde chen mi rtog pa'i/ /spyan ras tshad med snying rjes brlan pa'i cha—/ /reg pa tsam yang bsil lo sdug bsngal meṭashrī/ /gdungs rnams 'dren pa 'di la /skyabs songs shig /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dzi shes bsnan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brdzedz+wa pa dasge lda rno bstaXn ༷pa'i maṣ+pes rgyarno ladṛ rnam thar gyi don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga ba'o// //

752rnan than myomā puzhi nadug bustu zha/de ltar rje btsun bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam yi ger bkod pa 'di'i gleng gzhi'i dbang du byas na/ bla ma dam pa nyid rang la snga phyir slob ma dang sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i dad ldan mang pos gsang ba dang thun mong gi rnam par thar pa yi ger bkod pa zhig thugs rje gzigs dgos tshul gyi gsol ba lan mang du btab 'dug kyang zhal bzhes gtan nas ma mdzad/der ma zad sku drung na rgyun du sdod pa'i slob 'khor nang ma 'ga' zhig la mdzad pa thun mong ba'i skor rnams 'phral 'phral du zin bris su btab na legs tshul kho bos lan du mar nan tan byas kyang / le lo dang snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pa yin nam/ gyi'ajam dbyangs gong ma'i dbu bla yin pa kho nas chog gi rnams grangs mang po mi dgos snyam pa yin nam/ bla ma'i bka' ma khrol bas yin nam/ gang ltar yang zin bris kyi rigs shog dril gcig tsam yang bkod mi 'dug de nas gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus par kho bos gdung mchod 'bul mi btang skabs/ ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' la bstan 'gro yongs kyi dpal mgon dam pa 'di lta bu la rnam thar gyi yi ge zhig med mi rung yin kyang snga ma sa bon zin tho sogs bkod mi 'dug pas/ da cha sku drung du bcar sdod byed mkhan khyed cag gi sems

da sdem tharartsom pa'i mjug bku ba/ 53la gang nges rnams zin bris sum bkod na slar brjed res kyi dbang du 'gro srid cing / lo kha shas song na rgyus yod kyi mi 'dri yul tsam yang mi rnyed pa zhig yong nges pas/ da lta rang zin bris su 'bebs gang thub cis kyang bgyid dgos zhes 'phrin yig springs par brten/ u cu mu chin zhabs drung dkon mchog bkra shis dang / ja sag bla ma nam mkha' gnyis kyis rang rang gi mthong thos rnams shog dril du phabs 'dug ces thos/ de nas 'dzam gling mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan 'di lta bu'i rnam par thar pa su yin zhig gis cha shas tsam yang ji lta ba bzhin brjod par mi nus pas/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che rje bla ma'i thugs sras gtso bo yin pa dang / mdo rgyud gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu byon cing /rig pa'i gnas thams cad thugs su chud pa'i nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ṭa chen po yin par ma zad/ ( ljags rtsom gang gnang thams cad tshig don rmad du byung ba mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa zhig yod pa bcas/ gang ci nas rnam thar ljags rtsom mdzad na bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan cig yong bar bsams nos kho bos bskul ma zhus par/ pha bla ma bka' drin can de'i rnam thar rtsom rgyu byung na rang yang skal ba bzang bas cis kyang rtsom 'dun bgyid/ 'on kyang sa bon gyi gzhi med na rtsom thabs dang bral bas zin bris yod pa rnams nged la 'phrod thabs gyis shig ces phebs/ kho bo cag gis rje bla ma mchog gi grwa slob rnams la rgyu mtshan de lugs kyi yi ge springs pas u cu sachin zhabs drung dang ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkha' sogs grwa slob rnams kyang shin tu spro bas/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin

lhatsa4 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bci ba /po cher rnam thar ljags rtsom gyi gsol 'debs nan tan du zhus 'dug de lta na'ang sa bon zin bris kyi shog dril rnams phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'khyer nas bla ma mchog la 'bul rgyu ma byung bas/ rnam thar ljags rtsom gyi spros pa rim 'gyangs kyis nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba lta bur gyur/ rje bla ma gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu skabs kho bo cag sog yul har chen du yod pas/ har chin chen wang rat+na sirnyis rje bla ma'i rnam thar khyed rang gis yi ger bkod ces bskul ma nan tan bgyis shing / de nas kho bo mdo smad du yong ba'i lam bar du rje bla ma mchog gi grwa slob sbyin bdag mchog dman mang po dang / mdo smad du slebs nas chos sde chen po dgon lung gi khri rin po che dang las sna thun mong nas kyang bskul ma bgyis na'ang /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku zhabs nas ljags rtsom mdzad rgyu yong re dang /rang ngos nas tshig dokro phun sum tshogs pa thon pa'i rnam dpyod kyis dbul bas rtsom rgyu'i khas len ma bgyis/ /skabs shig rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ rdo rje 'chang lcang skya rin po che'i rnam thar rtsom rgyu snga sor nged kyis khas blangs pa yin na'ang sa bon ma byung bas rngo mi thogs 'dugadeng sang bla ma ma chog gi rnam thar rgyus yod pa khyed rang las lhag pa gzhan su yang med pa 'dra bas/ des na khyed kyis rang la mthong thos gang yod la gzhir byas pa'i rnam thar gyi yi ge zhig brtsams na legs pa 'dug ces kho bo cag la bka' stsal cing mdo khams dang chen po hor kyi yul gru rnams nas che phra gzhan du mas kyang dngos dang 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskul ma yang yang byung ba la brten nas rnam par thar pa yi ger 'god pa'i rtsol ba

rdom thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ 15 bye'adi bzhin bgyis pa yin/ de yang rnam thar rtsom gzhir phan pa'i zin bris gzhan kho bos kyang ma mthong la/ dgung lo lnga yan chad kyi zin bris shog dril gnyis tsam bdag gi bla ma gong ma'i yig tshang nas rnyed cing / de phyin chad rnams rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang / khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan pa/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes gsum gyi rnam thar du thor tsam re 'dug pa rnams la gzhi byas/ gtso cher gong du brjod zin pa ltar thos bsam mdzad tshul sogs rje bla ma rang nyid nas zhal spod gnang ba dang / gzhan ya nga gsung 'phros sogs kyi gseb tu rnam thar thor bu gang gsungs rnams yid la ma brjed pa bgyis pa dang / dga' ston snga phyi'i skabs kyi 'bul nod sogs kyi skor dang bar skabs su bka' chos rim gnang rnams phyag g.yog nang ma kha shas kyi ngag nas thos shing /a mdor snga ma phebs pa dang / dbus gtsang du lan phyi ma phebs skabs dang / pe'i cing du snga phyir lo mang tsam la zhabs pad bsten skabs rang gis dngos su mthong thos gang yod rnams sgro skur dang bral bar brjod pa yin no/ /zhar byung du rtsod spongs kyi tshul du 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ci ste 'ga' zhig gis khyod kyis bla ma'i rnam thar gyi skabs su grub mtha'i rnam bzhag las 'byung ba'i bshad pa mang tsam bris 'dug pa skabs su ma babs so zer na/ de ni skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar gyi gtso bo ci yin ma shes pa'i gtam yin par 'dug pas kho bos cung zad bsnyad par bya ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par thar pa'i dbang du byas na/ dang po thugs be+e skyed pa/ bar du tshogs bsatrī 0sa pa/ myori thar sangs rgyaṭa/ pa rgya

k+ṇibyo6 nem thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsu 5/dang / sangs rgyas nas kyang mdzad pa bcu rnga /nyis bstan pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar dang yon tan yin na yang / chos bstan pa'i mdzad pa de thamasacad las mchog tu gyur pa'i mdzad pa yin pas/ rje bla mas/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin zhes gsungs/ de'i k+ṣiṃmatshan yang / sangs rgyas rnams kyis dang po thugs bskyed pa nas bzung slob pa dang mi slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi mdzad pa gang mdzad pa thams cad sems can smin grol la 'god pa kho na'i ched yin la/ sems can glin grol la 'god pa'i thabs kyang chos ston pa las mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med pas/ mdo las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrud cing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag ’sa mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la 'pho min te/ /chos snyed bden pa bstan pas grol par mdzad/ /ces gsungs/ der ma zad rdzu 'phrul ston pa sogs ni gnas skabs de'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la don du 'gyur ba yod mod kyang / dzi dngos kyi gdul byar ma gyur pa rnams la phan par mi 'gyur la/ chos bstan pa la brten nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'jig rten du yun ring du gnas nas sku dngos su mthong ba dang gsung dngos su thos pa'i skal ba dang ldan mi ldan thams cad la 'phral yun thams cad du phan bde 'byung ba yin pas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin/ de bzhin du 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub ji snyed cig byon pa thams cad la 'dra ste/ klu sgrub thogs med gnyis

rnam tharartsom pa sdimajug bkub/ 757nyi zla zung bzhin 'gran zla dang bral ba yang / dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol phye ba'i sgo nas yin cing / shing rta'i srol yang bstan bcos khyad par can brtsams nas phye ba yin gyi/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sogs kyis ma yin no/ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod la bka' drin che ba yang /byang chub lam sgron mdzad nas bka' gdams kyi lugs srol—gtsang ma btsugs pas yin la/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa gangs can gyi mkhas grub sus kyang 'gran mi bzod pa'ang mdo sngags gnyis ka la sngon med legs bshad kyi phreng ba spel bar mdzad pas yin gyi/ lha'i zhal gzigs pa lta bu'i rnam thar tsam ni gzhan dag dang thun mong ba yin pas rje bla ma'i khyad chos su mi rung ngo / /deng sang gi 'gro 'dren du rlom pa phal che ba la rnam thar gyi gtso bo de gzhi la ma grub pas/ rnyed bkur snyan grags dang / dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs las brtsams te brjod pa las 'os ma mchis na'ang / rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 'di lta bu la rang ‘ra mnga' ba'i khyad chos sngon med legs bshad kyi dga' ston spel tshul gyi gtam zad mi shes pa bsnyad par bya ba yod bzhin du de mi brjod par/ thun mong gi mdzad pa 'ba' zhig yi ger 'god pa la blun po min pa su zhig mgu bar 'gyur/ deng sang dus kyi dbang gis rnam thar yi ger bkod pa phal che ba yang ge sar gyi sgrung dang dbyibs mtshungs zhig 'byung gi 'dug pa las/sngon byon gyi mkhas grupa rnams/ kyi rnam thar du thos bsam sgom gsum dang /'chadaldod rtsom gsum ma gtogs dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang / brgya byin stong 'gugs kyi lo rgyus bris pa sna gcig spyang med do/ /mdor na rnamaci

758 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bci ba/ thar gyi brjod don/ blo gros dang ldan pas dpyad na dngos brgyud ci rigs nas chos dang mthun pa'i dad pa 'phel ba zhig dgos kyi/ de lta bu ma byung na dgos pa stor ba yin no/ /yang kha cig gi sa/ khyod kyis rnam thar 'dir mgur ma bslab bya 'ga' zhig dang / chab shog skor dang /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad mang po dang / bla ma mchog la bstod bsngags dang gzhan 'ga' la zur za ba'i gtam lhug pa yang mang du bris 'dug pa glegs bam chen po yong ba'i thabs tsam du zad pa las dgos pa gzhan ma mchis so/ /zhes zer na de la 'di skad ces bsnyad par bya ste/ sems can rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po tha dad pas/ rang gi sems 'dul ba la lhag par gzhol ba rnams la mgur ma dang bslab bya so gas don du 'gyur tshabs che bas/ mar mi sogs bka' brgyud pa'i dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar du mgur gyi rigs mang du bkod pa bzhin 'dir yang de 'dra la phan pa'i ched du bkod pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad gtan la phabs pa'i yon tan thams cad kha nas phyir lhug lhug skyugs pa las / mgrin pa man ṇ+ḍad du cung zad kyang mi 'gro ba'i deng sang gi dge bshes chos kyi mgul 'gag gi bsnyung gzhi can rnams kyi thugs la mi 'bab pa bden no/ /chab shog rnam grangs mang tsam bkod pa'ang skabs dang mi 'brel ba ma yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'phrin yig legs pa thos 'dra rin chen sgrom phye lta'i/ /chos ni 'dir bshad pa las dga' ba'i ma chog bskyed do/ /zhes chos 'phrin yig legs pa dang dpe sbyar bas na/spyir yang mkhas bas spel ba'i chab shog rnams don chen po dang ldan pa yin

ma thar ma pa'imajugabasdub/ da — — spudruzhe —la/ rnam thar gyi skabs su'ang rtogs brjod dpage bsam 'khri shing du bu mo mu tig 'khri shing sdis/ /sangs rgyas la 'phrin yig phul ba sogs bkod pa dang / de bzhin du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar dang /'brom rin po che jo bo rje'i phebs bsur byon pa'i lo rgyus dang / khro phu lots+tsha bas kha che paṇa chen spyan drangs pa'i shoṃ rgyus sogs sngon byung du ma dang /rgyal dbang sogs da ltar gyi skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar du'ang chab shog bkod pa mang du snang bas so/ /bar skabs rnams su tshigs bcad snyan dngags sog sa bkod pa ni/ rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/rgyal ba nyid kyis gsung rab bsngags pa na/ /don bzang ba dang tshig 'bru bzang po zhes/ /gsungs shing shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la'ang / /bsil zer bye ba'i 'od kyis byugs pa bzhin/ /don bzang ba la'ang yid 'phrog tshig sbyor gyis/ /spras par gyur na ches cher mdzes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mkhas pa 'jam gsar bas/'di na gtam gyi spyor ba gang byed kyang / yul gyi skad dang mthun na legs par smra/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i gnyer bya de min gyi/ /chen po'i kha la rgyu ba'i legs bshad tshol/ /zhes dang / tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis//blun rmongs grong pa'i mgal dum tshig phreng gis/ /dam pa'i yon tan brjod par ci zhig 'os/ /sdeb legs rmad byung rnam thar/ngo mtshar gtam/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len sbyin gyi longs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po'i bu grong khyer sos/sa su 'a gra ba na/ rang— gi che ba dang dpal phun sum tshogs pa ngom pa'i ched du gos

k+ṇi60 rnam thar ma pamimajusdo bsdu2/ —bzang pos klubs/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang bcas 'gro ba las/ mu lto ba'i cha byad kyis song na skye bo kun gyis 'phya zhing brnyas par yang byed do/ /de bzhin du srid zhi thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan tu gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu'i rnam par thar pa brjod pa na tshig gi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i lam nas drangs shing /yid du 'ong ba'i snyan dngags kyi rgyan du mas mdzes par byas te brjod par bya dgos kyi/ de lta bu ma yin par gdol gtam bzhin du grong tshig phal bas lhug par smras na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams dga' ba bskyed par mi nus shing / smra ba po rang gis rang nyid sun 'byin byed du 'gro bas/dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mtshungs med rgyal ba'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / mkhas mchog dbyug pa can gyis/ mkhas pa'i yang dag rab sbyar ba'i/ /ngag ni ngag gi 'dod 'jor bshad/ /de nyid nyes par sbyar na slar/ /sbyor bo ba lang nyid brjod byed/ /ces dang / zur mkhar ba legs bshad 'tshol gyis/ rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ rgya chen gzhung lugs dgongs don 'grel pa yi/ /yi ge'i rtsom pa mang du sbyar na yang / /grong tshig blun po'i tha snyad khyu 'khrigs pas/ /'jig rten long gtam bris pa'i rnam pa mtshon/ /sdeb legs tshig sbyor snyan dngags lus/ mdzes/ ma/ /rgyan mang mdangs kyis rnam par bkra na yang / /

rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ 761grong tshig gcig gis snyan dngags skal ngan byed/ /rgyan mang na chung sna bcad ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na 'dir chab shog snyan dngags kyi skor 'ga' zhig tshang ma bkod pa dang / bar skabs rnams su yang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal las thon pa'i snyan dngags kyi tshigs bcad gang 'os bris pa rnams ni/ snyan dngags kyi ngo mtshar ri mo'i khyad par phra zhib rnams gsal bar blta ba la/ blo gros kyi 'dren byed shin tu gsal ba 'ga' zhig gi snying la ngo mtshar dga' ba bskyed pa'i ched du bkod pa yin gyi/ rgya chen rig gnas kyi thang yangs por blo gros kyi gom pa bdeg 'cha' bas tshul 'chos kyi mkhar ba la skyabs su re ba'i bla dang ston chen rnams kyi rna lam du phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan dngags las phyugs rdzi'i gling bu snyan pa nyid do/ /bar skabs 'ga' zhig tu gzhan la zur za ba'i tshig 'ga' zhig smos pa ni/ blo gros dang ldan pas rnam thar bzang po'i ldog phyogs shes na bzang po la bzang por nges pa rnyed par 'gyur bas de'i ched tsam yin gyi chags sdang gi dbang gis smras pa ma yin no/ /de lta bu mi rung ba yang ma yin te/ sems can thams cad la thugs rje chen po nye ring med par snyoms par 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / mdo sde la lar bdud dang mu stegs dang sems can ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig la sgo du ma nas smo da pa'i rnam grangs mang du bka' stsal pas so/ /mdor bsdu na/ bdag gis rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa 'dir brjod bya sna gcig rkyang 'ded ma byas par rnam grwangs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas brjod pa ni/ mos pa mi 'dra ba so so la don

762 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bku ba/da du 'gyur ba'i ched du bsams pa yin gyi/ mang du smra ba la dga' ba dang /rang nyid sgrog par 'dod pa sogs nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa'i rjes su zhugs pa ma yin pas/ phyogs re tsam gyi thos pas dregs pa la las ci zer kyang kho bo bag tsha ba ci yang ma mchis so/ /da ni 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ rang cag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du 'khor ba 'dir skye ba grangs kyis mi chod pa zheg blang du zin kyang / spyir sgo gsum gyi bya ba gang bgyis pa thams cad don med 'ba' zhig tu songacizhing / bye brag tu ngag gi smra brjod ji snyed pa mtha' dag brag cha'i sgra bzhin snying po med pa kho nar gyur la/ da res rnyed par dka' ba'i chos ldan gyi lus rten bzang po thob pa 'di yang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin can gyi phyir yun ring du mi gnas pa dang / las kyi glags blta ba ma spangs pas 3phyi ma'i 'gro ba ji ltar 'gyur mi shes pa'i dwogs pa dang bcas pas na/ da lta rnam rig gsal zhing smra brjod nus pa'i gnas skabs su lce nyid kyis kyang dam pa'i yon tan brjod pa la 'bad pa'i sgo nas lus la snying po blang bar bya rigs te/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ rgya mtshor gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ /dam chos dga' sto na cher bcas pa'i/ /mi nyid bdag gis thob nas ni/ /mi rtag nyid dargarjes 'brel zhing / /las kyis glags la dwogs bcas pa/ /bdag gi lce 'di nyid kyis ko /snying po ci'i phyir blang mi bya/ /zhes/ rga/sungs/ de yang dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i chu bas pa ste zad par btung mi nus na'ang /cung zad btung bas kyang skom pa sel bar 'gyur ba bzhin du/ bdag

rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bku ba/ 763nyid chen po rnams kyi yon tan gyi phung po yongs su rdzos/sa pa brjod par ga la nus mod kyang / rang gi blos ci tsam dpog pa'i cha shas tsam brjod pas kyang don chen po 'grub par 'gyur bas na tshul de la spro bas 'jug par bya ste/ de nyid las/ mtsho chen chab ni bas par ma gyur kyang / /skye bo'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bgyid ltar/ /khyod kyi yon tan cha tsam bsgrags pas kyang / /bdag ni mchog tu glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ /zhes so//dam pa'i yon tan brjod pas don rjen ngo ci zhig 'grub par 'gyur snyam na/ de nyid las/ khyod kyi yon tan slad du bdag /bsod nams snyam nas spyi rtol skyes/ /zhes rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bsod nam sa rlabs po che bsdud par gsungs shing / bsod nams kyi mthu las mngon mtho nges legs kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyurardzo te/ mdo las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bso da nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po 'thob/ /ces dang / rgyal po mya ngan med kyis klu btul ba'i le'u las/ bsod nams kyis 'phags mi rnams ni/ /sa rnams gsum gyi steng du gnas/ /bsod nams mi rnams gnas yin te/ /bsod narma sa thar pa thob byed mchog /bsod nams 'jig rten grags byed yin/ /de phyir bla med bsod nams btsal/ /mtho ris thob byed ngan song spong / /mi yis rtag tu bsten bya ste/ /rma khas pasdo5 bsod namyo/sa bya ba yi na/ /zhes dang / phun sum tshogs

764 rnam ra rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/pa 'dod pa yis/ /bsod nams gang yin zhes bya ba/ /'di 'dra'i bye brag su mi sgrub/ /bsam du med par gang bsam pa/ /don de 'bad pa med pa ru/ /mi rnams la ni 'bras bu smin/ / /ces sogs bcom ldan 'das kyi bslu med tshad ma'i lung las rgya cher 'byung ba'i phyir ro smras pa/ rin chen bye ba'i gzi 'od rab 'khyug zag med rdul brtsegs mkha' spyod dag pa'i pho brang dbus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor mi shigs zab gsang rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs mngon sgrogs pa/ /mkha' khyab zhing du sgyu 'phrul dra ba spro dang sdud mdzad rigs brgya'i khyab bdag he ru ka /ngur smrig gar mdzad rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyi pad+mor slar yang gus pas phyag bgyid do/ /zhis baṃrlo dz+wa bzhin nyid dang ro mnyam lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje yis/ /kun rtog rlung gi rgyu ba mtha' dag gnyis spangs lam du bcom pa las/ /zag med 'khyor pa'i longs spyod mtha' klas thar pa chen po'i pho brang dbus/ /zung 'jug dang po'i mgon por bzhengs pa de ni bdag gi bla ma ste/ /gdul bya so so'i mos pa tha dad par/ /'bab stegs byed pa'i sgyu 'phrul chu klung 'bum/ /skad cig rer yang zhing kun 'jug pa las/ /'di na rol dzi'i rdor+sharje zhes su grags/ /mtshan dpe'i cha shas yojas rdzogs gzugarmo skuh+pho zlo shā gcig nyid lags kyang 'gro blo'i mos pa'i rdzing bu ji snyed rnams su de snyed 'char / /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan snyan pa'i gsung gi cha shas res kyang chos khyi rnam grangs dpag med sems can rang rang skad du

spre thar mabamimajug bku bo/ k+ṇi6tsa'adoms// /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab mkha' ltar zab yangs rithugs ni rtog pa bral yang 'gro 'dul 'phrin las dus las nagra yang yol ba med/ /'di lta'i ya mtshan gang la mnga' ba sgod ni rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid de bdag cag rnams kyang rgyal ba'i spos kyi khengs pa 'dzin/ /ma rig kho na'i rtsa ba las nyon gyi/ /yal ga stong du bres las smin pa yi/ /sdug bsngal 'bras bu shin tu kha ba'i ro/ /spyad pas zad mi shes pa srid pa'i nags/ /'di na deng dus bstan 'gro yi/ /phan bde 'i nyi zla za byed pa'i/ /mi bzad snyigs ma'i rgud pa ni/ /sgra gcan bzhin du nyer 'ongs pas/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i nor bu ni/ /rtsod pa'i thun mtshams gos dmar 'dzin/ /'jig rten bde skyid pad+ma'i tshal/ /rkyen ngan zla ba'i zer gyis zum/ /bstan 'dzin sgra ma ra yi tshogs/ /snying las chung ngu'i khung bur gzhol/ /mkhas rlom 'byung po'i 'dab chags dag /bstan la sdang ba'i than skad 'byin/ /cher rlom khyim pa gos ser can/ /thub pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por snyems/ /tshul 'chos g.yo can 'jig rten mkhan/ /sbyin bdag dad pa'i yon gnas byed/ /rab tu byung rnams bcas pa dang / /'khon pa bzhin du 'gal bar spyod/ /mkhas pa ngang pa'i rgyal po las/ /blun po khyim bya skad gsang mtho/ /sa bdag phal cher rang rang gi /mnga' ris til bzhin 'tshir bar byed/ /'jig rten ya rabs spyod pa kun/ /snyim par bzung ba'i chu bzhin bri/ /khrel 'dzem med pa'i ngan spyod ni/ /dbyar gyi shwa 'od bzhin du brdol/ /mi bzad sdig pa dug gi chu/ /bdud rtsi

d+dha166 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu baṃ/ bzhin du dga' bas 'thung / /kun tu phan pa'i dge/ ba la/ /skyugs nad can gyi zas bzhin blta/ /skye bo phal cher smyon pa bzhin/ /ngan song g.yang la bang rtsal 'gran/ /'di lta'i skyon brgya'i tsher ma can/ /snyigs ma'i tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i khrod/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyis kyang / /snying stobs gom pa 'god ma nus/ /de tshe ring nas thugs bskyed smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu grub ste/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i phyi nang mthun rkyen gang 'os pa/ /ma tshang med par yongs rdzogs kun mkhyen rol pa3 rdo rje zhes/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang srid pa'i gdung ba 'phrog dermi ṣ+peng zlodiX bzung / /phan bde rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thub bstan chu gter snyigs ma yi/ /rgud pa'i than chen gyis gdungs pas/ /chu thigs go 'phang 'dzin phyogs pa/ /rlabs chen smon pa'i sprin gyi mngal/ /thugs bskyed chu khur lci ldan pa/ /mgon 'di'i 'phrin las gru char gyis/ /bskyangs pas dbyar mtsho'i dpal la bkod/ /khyad par blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /rmad byung legs bshad bai ḍūr 'phang 'gro ni/ /bstan 'dzin chen por snyems pa phal mo che'i/ /blo gros phang bar sgra med gzims pa yang / /'di yi rnam dpyod 'phrul gyi sor mo yis/ /ngaka' gnad rgyud stong ci dgar bskul ba las/ /sngon chad ma thos snyan rgu'i rol mo yis/ /blo ldan rna ba brded rtsi'i yol gor byas/ /'di na mi bsrun sems can sna tshogs ji lta ji ltar sdug bsngal dngos dang de yi rgyu la spyod pa lhur len pa/ /de lta de ltar mgon po 'di yiṭashrī gang la gang 'tsham thabs mkhas mdzad pa ma tha' yas mu med bdag

da wa — rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ 767gir bzhes pa yis/ /snyigs ma lnga yi mun pa'i sbubs su zhugs pa'i 'jig rten 'di ya/nga sgro+o/ bahra// pre bzang po'i dpal yon 'ardzen pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /mtha' yasdo/ zhe nga gi rab 'byams rgyal ba rnams kyang dgyes 'dzum bzhad pas legs bsngags me to ga char du bsnyil bar mdzad snyam sems/ /thugs rje'i snang ba 'jig rten thams cad la/ /phyogs dang ris su ma chad mnyabe nyid du/ /'char ba'i khyab bdag bkra shis pad+mo'i gnyen/ /'di 'dra'i 'jig rten matse/na po gzhan su mchis/ /de ltar rmad byung dam pa'i yon tan bdud rtsi'i mngal gyis lci b.ri 'khun/ /snyan dngags nyamyo/sa 'gyur sgra brgyar sgrogs pa'i rtogs brjod sprin gyi bla re ni/ — da1 ldapyi nga3/ na paḍi lha la ma yangs pa ma ༷sa pa'i s+t+waṃn tu bres pa las/ srid pa'i sa/dung sel byin rlabs grib bsil phyogs kun babs pa'i ngo mtshar ltos/ /naga' kyi dpyil na khu byug ngag snyan 'byin/ /yid 'ong spang la rma bya zlos ba/ra rtse/ /rtogs brjod rin chen cod pan thod bcings nas/ /smra mkhan bdag kyang dga' ba'i dbyangs 'di sgrogs/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i 'i ra tsho'i dus ston sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyis kun dga'i bcud len rgyas par byed/ /mthing 'od nam mkha'i tā ma la dbus sgra brgya pa des dbyar rtsi+o/ phum/ tshas/sa phyogasdoshaṃ ku na gri+o gas/ /pad+ma'i rdzing bur ngang pa'i rgyal po ston gyi lha mo mgron du 'bod pa'i mgrin rnga brdungs/ /de bzhin 'di na rna ba'i dga' ston kun gyi phul byung rtogs brjod rol mo bdag gis 'a/krol/ /sa/nga yang 'di na blo gros lang tsho rgud pa'i mtha' la nyer bsten pas/ /rags pa'i brda' chad tsam la'ang blo mig mun pa'i ge 'phang

768 rnam ra rtsom pa'i mjud bku ba/'dzin bzhin du/ /spyi brtol mkhar ba la 'khril rtsom pa'i ri la nan gyis 'dzegs pa dag /yi ge'i bshul lam tsam du'ang bub pa'i lag rjes mang du bzhag pa mthong / /sa gsum kun tu btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba/ /rmad byung dam pa'i rnam thar nor bu'i phreng / /sdeb legs snyan dngags gser gyi nyag thag las/ /grong tshig phal pa'i srad bur brnya ra ci 'os/ /snyan dngags pad dkar phang phung bzhad pa dang / /gdol gtam gor ma gcal du bkram pa gnyis/ /dmus long blun por rnam dbye ma mchis kyang / /blo mig gsal ba'i mkhas la khyad par che/ /de phyir swa ra su sti'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bad+man pa'i lag pa 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu las/ /snyan tshig yid du 'ong ba'i dri bsung can/ /rtogs brjod yi ge'i ut+pal gsar ba 'khrungs/ /skyes bu blo gros shel gyi me long ltar/ /gsal rnams spro bsdo/ 'jug la snyan dngags kyi/ /'khri shing mdzes par dkrigs pa'i rtogs brjod nags/ /'di ko lha yi tshal bzhin yid du 'ong / /mgrin pa'i grong khyer gcig tu dri za yi/ /'jig rten yongs su rdzogs pa'i glu len pa/ /'di yis bdud rtsi'i khang bur ma bcug pa'i/ /sgra 'dzin de ni bem po'i dngos por zad/ /lus phra'i 'gram chang /tho nas ba ku la'i/ /'dab ma lhug par bkrol ba rgyu skar 'ga'i/ /snyem sa pa'i 'od dang me khyer ma nyam nyid du/ /bskru ba pa'i thabs zhes drang gtam 'di yang smra/ /gang gi gas nga sa/sum yon tan ma lus pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngatha/ ra changs pa'i sras mo nyer zhugs nas // / dzobi 'a brgyar badzo+od kyang rta ca myo/ ca tshen mi nus/ /'on spyang rang

— rnam tharartsomapa'imajugabasdub/ da 769gzhan dad pa 'phel ba dang / /rgyal ba dgyes/ pa'i 'a ma la nges rnyed phyir/ /ngo myoge tshar mdzad pa dpag yaṭa/ chu klo/ter la sa/ /bum gang tsam zhig rang gi skal bas blangs/ /bdag yid dad pa'i snyim par bzung ba mi/ /ngag tshig yid 'ong me tog sil ma 'di/ /mchod kanas bla ma mchog gi pho brang du/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gtibs te 'bul/ /de las 'ongs pa'i rab dkar dge ba yang / /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i chu bo rabs med las/ /'gro kun sku gsum rin chen gling mchog tu/ /sgrol ba'i gru gajings nyid du 'gyur bar bsngo/ /'di'i mthus blo bzang rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab gdengs can bu yi srub thag gis/ /mkhyen pa'i gter gyi zhal lung ri bo bka' bstan rgya mtshor bsgril ba las/ /sngon med mdo sngags chos tshul 'jig rten snang byed zung zhig shar ba 'di/ /lhun pas chu gter smad g.yogs bkrol min de srid mi nub sa/sa la gyur cig /dge ldan ring lugs gser gyi shing rta che/ /bshad sgrub 'phang lo'i 'phrul gyis drang po'i lam/ /'dren pa'i skyes chen mi yi khyu mchog ku/na/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i dpung ba dar drag shog /mi bzad snyigs ma'i 'dam rdzab khrod 'dir yang / /thugs bskyed sa bon dus su smin pa 'a/sa/ /'khrungs pa'i skyes mchog pad dkar bgrang yas kyis/ /mdzad 'phrin yid 'ong dri ngad 'thul bar shog /bslab gsum gser gyi bye mas lus bgos shing / /lung rigs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan sgrogs pa/ /rig grol 'khor lo'i lag ldan 'bum phrag gis/ /bshad sgrub chos sde'i mtsho kun gang gyur cig —/༈nga rtogs gaji 'od rab 'bar byub mi 'i ring lugs sgro la byed

770 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ bshes/ /mi shigs g.yung drung mkha' lam ring por 'dren pa'i kha lo par/ /gnam gyis bskos pa'i mi yi bdag po khyung sngon skyes de yi/ /dge legs snang ba dkar po 'gyed pa'i bzhed don kun 'grub shog /kla klo seng ge mo'i bu'i re ba'i mgrin/ /mchog gsum nus mthu zho 'thung rus mtshon gyis/ /nyer bcad thub bstan zla shel sgrib byed pa'i/ /lta ngan mun pa nam yang mi 'byung shog /mu mtha' bral ba'i 'jig rten kun gsal ngogs/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las go la 'i lam yangs las 'ongs pa'i dge mtshan rgyu skar tshom bu yis/ /phan bde'i 'od snang rtse dga' 'gran gyur cig /'a di ltar dad pa'i rol mtsho dpal ldan bla ma mchog de'i yon tan zla shel thigs pa 'thungs pas myos pa las/ /snyan dngags ngang pa'i mgrin glu dang 'grogs rba rlabs rtso/ra mos yi ge'i zegs ma 'bad pas 'thor bgyid kho bo yang / /tshe rabs phreng bar sgo gsum brtson pa'i chu klung cha shas tsam yang mi dge'i gcong rong gnas su mi gzhol bar/ /gcig tu dam pa'i chos lam drang por zhugs te rje btsun bla ma'i gsang gsum rgya mtshor ro gcig 'dres par shog /skye ba'i phreng rdog bar ma chad pa ru/ /dal 'byor gser gyi srad bur nyer bstar ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma nor bu'i mdud 'dzin gyis/ /skad cig tsam yang gtong bar ma gyur cig /ri dbang nyi zla'i rna char mngon sgeg cing / /chu gter me lce'i sham thabs 'dzin gyi bar/ /rtogs brjod nor bu'i do shal 'di yis kyang / /dge lda/na bstan pa'i mchod sdong mdzes byed shog /bla sa3 rnam thar 'bri dang klog pa dang / /bla ma'i yon tan brjod cing sems pa kun/ /bla

sgo6 rim thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/ 1110ma zhi byin rlabs snying lo nyer zhugs te/ /bla ma3 mdzad pa'i rjeca/ su slob paje shog /mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 0byin rlabs sprin phung stug por 'khrigs/ /lha dang drang srongatsā tshogs kyi bden tshig dbyar rnga dal gyis bzhad/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i 'phrin las glog phreng cir yang 'khyugs/ /bkra shis me tog char pa phyogs dus kun tu 'bab gyur cig /ces rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi bdag po khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gcig pu/ 'jam dbyangs mi'i rje bos ṣakwan ting phu'u shan bging rto tū rku shrī zhes byams brtses 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi ṣ+pe nas dibadza bskuri skre'i kuṅge ṅgelgen bla ma chen por mnga' gsol ba/ nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa yeX sheg bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa depye ldaXn brnyi3 ṅgesdi martosaX rgyarni cesaX bya ba 'di ni/ dang por dad pa dang gtong ba la sogs pa dam pas bsngags pa'i yon tan du mas— thugs rgyud legs par phyug pa'i mi'i dbang po har chin chen wang rat+na sidhis bdog pa'i dngos/ po gya nom pa'i me tog dang bcas nan cher bskul ba dang / bar du bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling ge chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa wang zhabs drung rin po che skal bzang ye thes dar rgyas gyis gtso mdzad chos sde'i las sna tshang mas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍashā/ lha rdzas bcas bskul ma mdzad cing / dus phyis rje bla ma'i sras gyi thu snga gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta tshen po 'a5che4 snye sniskyaXngs tsha ༷ sdo / ༷kyi spyal

— 1rnge 2 rnam thar rtsom pa'i jug ya ba/sdo ༷t+naX mtshasngo/ ca 5/ gyis bla ma mchog gi rnam par thar pa semyo5 sa la —nga nges pa rna du sa yi ger 'god par gyis shig ces dri bral srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas dang bcas gsung gi cod pan spyi bor bcings pa dang / gzhan yang cha har mur gu tsheg su me+e /'i bla ma tas chir hu thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhu/na grub dang / su nyid chos rje bska la bzang bsam 'grub sogs mdo khams dang chen po hor gyi yul gru ci rigs nas don gnyer ba mang bos gser dngul dar gos sna tshogs pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas yang dang yang du bskul zhing / rang gi mos pas kyang mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas/ bka' drin 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa'i 'dren mchog dam pa de nyidartakyis brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma'i tha shal ba7gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung gis jing zi'u chan zhi thu'u bkwan hu thog thu zhes rnam dag bslab ldan bsam gtan gyi slob dpon 'phags pa chen por bsngags pa'i btsun gzugs snyoms las pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang po ming gzhan ku sā li dharma badz+ra du 'bod pas/ /yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo dbyar gyi dga' ma lang tsho dar la babs pa'i dus su/ skyed mos tshal yid dga' chos 'phel du mgo brtsams pa bar skabs su 'du 'dzi'i brel ba sna tshogs kyis rim 'gyangs su gyur pa las nye char ku/ na dga' zhes pa shing pho lta ga gi lo/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs kyi dus tshigs kyi thog ma/ dri zhim ldan gyi zla ba'i nyi ma lug khyim du spyod pa'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ dbyangs a/ gsal byed ma/ 'byung ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ dbyangs 'char gyi dmar phyogs kyi

nem thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu n+de/ 113dga' ba dang po/ dbyangs a/ gsal byed dha/ 'byung ba sa/ 'a dod yon dri/ gnyis la// mthun pa'i dar rgud byis pa/ res gza' bkra shis/ skar ma dbyu gu/ sbyor chung stobs ldan/ 'phrod chen bdud rtsi/ rten 'brel ming gzutsā/sa/ nyi ma zhib par sa glang / rags par sa yos/ spar kha zhib rags mthun par gin/ sme ba zhib par dgu dmar/rags par brgyad dkar/ taskal ka ṭi rnyi sha/ gza' zla ba'i dbyu gu/ dus lha yang sa/ byed mas dbang bsgyur ba bkra shis tshangs pa'i dbyug gu thog pa'i 'grub sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin ca/khas grub kyi skyes bu zam ma chad par byon nas zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel zhing / blo gsal 'dus pa rgya mtshos legs bshad sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad du sgrog pa'i gnas phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar du rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig pa'i gnas la blo 'od 'phro zhing dad brtson rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i drung yig dge slong gu shri ngag dbang bstan 'phel gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /swa sti bi dza yarnyu/ rmad byung thugs bskyed rgya chen rab brling mu med 'gro la rjes brtse'i nor 'dzin gzhir/ /ma smad tshogs zung rin chen rnam bzhi'i kham sa kyi rdu9ra myo/nga phung po las 'khrungs shing / /theg gsum skye 'phags mdog bzang /gyen 'phyur bla na sku bzhi'i bang rim lham mer 'bar/ /lhun grub spangs rtogs nyi zla'i rgyan ldan kun mkhyen lhun po'i

714 5ma thar rtsom pa'imajug bsdub/ da dgezhabs pad la phyag 'tshal/ /gau chen dpal stug yongs kyi skyed byed cari phye/ na pa'i gter chen gzhon nu dang / /smra mkhas ngag gi dpa'ag 〉t+na ༷nga 'dod dgur stsol pa'i ne cho gyung yid 'ong mar/ /dbyer med thub dbang gnyis par graXs paḍi dpal 'bar mnyam med btsong kha pa/ /sras kyi khyu mchog rnam dag srol 'dzin tshogs la 'dud do rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon pos bho ṭa'i skye dgur rjes dgongs nas/ /blo bza nga bstan la bskas bsdung rnam 'dren stong gi mdzad pa'i khur/ /chabaX garmyeg legs bsnams mdo rgyud gtsug la ga rgyu marto'i dgongs zab gter/ /nyi ltar gsal mdzad rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor mchod/ /two ngasdung mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid stobs bcu'i dpūl ldan zhing / /snang ma/ rba3 ༷ shespya gsum ldan ngur smrig zol brten nas/ /ma lus 'gro kun thar par bkri ba'i sa mkhan mchog paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal bo lus can yongs kyi —/tsug na rgyal/ /dwag dbyāng 'jam dpal ni khro'i rnal 'byor risnye ḍi ga gi mkhar/ /rnam kun bde stong yī me+e/sa chen po'i lus 'degari+osmu kyis/ /dbang bsgyur mthu sdun yid su/bas rlung zas can 'joms pa'i/ /grub rna ji shā ga myo/kha' sding dbang po la na brgyar phyas/ se/ yul/ /rgyal kun ༷ shesdu 'od zer dra ba 'khyil ba'i snang ba'i gter/ /thub chen bshad nyu ba bsta na ༷paX puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i tshal chen po/ /kun nas bzhad mdzad thams/ cad mkhyen dngos sa gsum swon ḍi mchog /rje btsun bla ma byol paḍi sa rdi bdag sa/tsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /phul byung dh+wa gros ral gri mi shes dra ba sa/cod la rno / /dmashas tshul gsum gyi mdzad bzang phung bos phyogs kyi 'aro/ ra rke 'gengs/ /

ngage sgrumatharartsom pa'i mjug bsdu dzo/ 115 gzhan phan chos kyi ni masaX thub bstan sa chen ma lus gsal/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog rnam thar mkhan po khyod nyid bsngags pa'i yul/ /dpal ldan thub pa kun gyi gdung 'tshob che/ /srid zhi yongs kyi mgon po bla na med / /ma lus mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis mgos gtugs pa/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma dz+wal pa3 kau rte zhes/ /mgon khyod thog mtha' bar gyi rnam par thar/ /thun mong ma yin gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /'phags mchog sar gnas dpa' bo'i spyod yul las/ /tshur mthong sgra rtog smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /de lta mod kyi thun mong gdul bya'i ngor/ /de nyid grangs ldan sa rga'i don bzhin du/ /bsam bzhin sku 'khrungs 'khrul med sngon rjes dran/ /'gran gyi do med mtshan ldan bshes mang bsten/ /rgya chen mdo rgyud rig gnayogazhung kun sbyangs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i chos tshul ma lus bzhes/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams rtogs yang rtser son/ /sangs rgyas byang sems zhal gzigs bgro ba mdzad/ /thabs tshul du mas thub bstan phyogs brgyar gsal/ /skal bar ldan rnams smin grol lam la bkod/ /rgyal sras spyod pas 'gro kun bu bzhin bskyangs/ /sa chen skyong ba'i 'khor bsgyur gtsug nor gyur/ /bka' bstan mang bsgyur rnam dag chos sde btsugs/ /bod dang bod chen tsi nar chas 'khor skor/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa rlabs chen gyis/ /cher snyigs dus kyang rdzogs ldan bskal par byas/ /gzur gnas blo ldan slob 'khor mtha' klas par/ /sde snod bye ba'i dgongs bcud rgya mtsho che/ /ma 'dres gsal bar ston pa'i 'chad tshul gyis/ /thogs med sku mched slar yang byon pa bzhin/ /lung rigs glog

176 5ma thar rtsom pa'i mjug bku sge/'phreng dgag sgrub nam mkha'i mda'/ /'bebs la gzhol tshe 'dzam gling rgyan drug kun/ /bod ston gzugs kyis byang phyogs kha ba'i ljongs/ /deng 'dir gshegs snyam kun yid dpyang thag 'dzin/ /rig gnas grub mtha' sngon med legs bshad kyi/ /glegs bam greng ba thub bstan rgyan spel bas/ /mkhas mchog dpa' bo btsun pa zla ba rnams/ /skrag cing skyengs te zhing gzhanu bros sam snyam/ /'duX 'dzin bye ba'i mchog gyur u pa li/ /'dul ba 'bum sde'i mnga' bdag shes rab bzang / /'duX lung sde bzhi'i gnad don gsal slad du/ /'dulta 'dzin dz+nyā na dri paṃ khyod du sprul/ /yod med mtha' bral zab mo rten 'byung gnad/ /klu sgrub sras bcas man ngag blo bzang rje'i/ /rab gsal snang stong zung 'jug dbu ma'i lta/ /lag ma thil skyu ru ra bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /a dum wa ra ltar dkon rgyal ba las/ /rnyed dka'i gsang chen rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i don/ /yang snying bla med rim gnyis lam gyi gnad/ /phul byung nges rnyed rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang khyod/ /mdor na lta sgom spyod pa zung 'brel gyis/ /thub bstan spyi dang 'khrul bral zhwa ser bstan/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir nyi ltar gsal mdzad pas/ /blo bzang bstan la blo bzang rgyal ba dngos/ /de phyir khyod kyi don ldan grags pa'i dbyangs/ /bskul ba med par lha yi rnga bzhin du/ /lhang lhang ldir ba'i rab snyan gtam gyi glu/ /'og min bar du khyab 'di su yis 'gog /chu lha'i phyogs kyi skye ldan me tog tshul/ /rnam par 'khrigs nas dbang phyogs chu gter mthar/ /khyab pa'i skal bzang rkang drug phra rags kun/ /sgod zhabs pad+mor mi

rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bku ba/ 771'dud go skabs ci/ /gsang gsum bkod pa'i ngo mtshar rol rtsed la/ /grags pa'i mu khyud chayo/sa nas 'dren byed stong / /sprul te sa 'dzin rgyal bo'i rtse mo nas/ /lan brgyar bltas kyang ma tshims rtag tu bgrad/ /mkhas gsum bya bas thub dgongs rab gsal ba'i/ /dam chos dbyangase la gser mngal can gyis kyang / /sgra 'dzin brgyad kyis nyan kyang ngoms med par/ /chu klung gzugs gyis nyi bu'i phyogs su 'khyil/ /der ni smra mkhas ngag gi lha mo yis/ /ro 'dzin 'bum gyis bstod bsngags glu dbyangs dang / /chabs gcig rgyud mang 'gyur khugs stong gis kyang / /mngon mchod zlos gar lhur blangs gor ma chag /khyod kyi gsang mdzod yon tan rgya mtsho che'i/ /dpe zlar rgyal ba kun dang 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas grub kun gyi mdzad bzang kun bsdus na/ /mtshon par nus kyi zla gzhan gang gis rnyed/ /rab yangs lha yi lam dang chu gter bzhin/ /gting mtha' brul ba'i mdzod pa'i sa chen khyon/ /ma lus gsal byed ngo mtshar snyan ngag gi /rtogs brjod glegs bam legs bshad skyes spel mkhan/ /gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i gnyis 'thung steng na brjid/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen khyab byed stong phrag bgrad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rtse brgya rtag par gdengs/ /mkhas grub nye dbang tshogs kyis kun nas bskor/ /log smra'i bcud bral snying la 'jigs ster ba'i/ /snyo bzang chos sdi ñji n+d+ra sum rtsen bdag /sa steng bstan 'dzin rnam sad ts+tshagazlo kyi rmegorno/ /sa bla'i yul nas deng 'dir byon nam ci/ /don dam bla ma'i mkhyen brtse'i zla gzugs nyid/ /gdul bya'i blo mtshor sgas mchog

778 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsdu ba/zla snang tshul/ /ngo bo gcig kyang rnam pa tha dad kyis/ /rang gi yon tan brjod la sprul pa bzhin/ /e ma mkhyen bzang 'chi med rdzing ring ngos/ /gdul bya'i rnyog bral dad pa'i kun+da'i gnyen/ /mdzad bzang 'od dkar phreng ba 'bum sbo ba'i/ /sngon med rnam thar gnyis skyes rgyal po 'khrungs/ /'di ni gzhan phan chu shel khams las grub/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi ri dwags mtshan ma bkra/ /shar ba'i mod la rgud pa'i tsha gdung gzhil/ /ris med mkhas pa'i dpal mgrin gtsug gi rgyan/ /du ma'i rnam thar rgyu skar grangs mtshungs kyang / /phyogs re'i 'od snang phra mo 'byin pa las/ /yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan bcu gnyis gling gi khyon/ /mtha' dag gsal byed zla ba 'di gcig nyid/ /deng dus skye dgu'i bsod nams gdengs can grong / /khyod thugs brtson pa'i ri bo bsgril ba las/ /rgyal ba'i rnam thar tsha zer brgya ba'i zlar/ /'jig rten mun sel mtshan mgon 'di shar rmad/ /dam pa'i yon tan rab dkar 'o ma'i mtshor/ /mkhyen rab ngang mos rtogs brjod mgrin pa'i rnga/ /brdung dang lhan cig tshangs sras lus phra mas/ /'gran pa bzhin du rgyud mangs glu dang bsdebs/ /bstod bsngags tshul 'di gcam bu'i tshig sbyor gyi/ /sdeb legs me tog phreng ba 'thor min pa/ /gzur gnas rnam dpyod zhib mos legs gzigs dang / /lag pad spyi bor zum pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /'di na ltar snang bla mar zol ldan gyi/ /'khor rlom 'ga' yis zas nor tsam gyi ched/ /sgro btags bstod bsngags dbang gzhu lhar bkra ba'i/ /rnam thar yig phreng spel dang 'di mi 'dra/ /spyon

rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug brtsa ba/ 779bral gtsang ma'i yid kyi glegs bu'i ngos/ /dad gsum mtshon sbyar shes rab spyig gu yis/ /bla ma'i gsang gsum ngo mtshar cha shas gzugs/ /yang yang bris pas rlabs chen bsod nams sdud/ /sangag rgyasdu zhal skyin 'di lta'i bla ma la/ /sangag dz+was dngos mthong shes nas dad thob kyis/ /sangs rgyasdu bzhin du bstod bsngags lhur blangs na/ /sangag rgyas lag mthil 'byung bar gdon mi za/ /de phyir 'dzam gling sa yi thig le'i khyon / /kun khyab 'dzad med rnam thar chos sbyin che/ /spel slad dam pas rab bsngags dben gnas mchog /g.yer gshong bsam gtan gling nas par du bsgrubs/ /'dir 'bad las 'ongs rnam dkar 'od stong ldan/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i shes rgyud mkhar 'phags te/ thog med dus nas 'thib pa'i ma rig mun/ /gtan sangs chos gzugs sku mchog dpal thob shog /ris med grub mtha'i nags klung yid 'ong phreng / /rgyal bstan ri bo'i ngos su 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /zhwa ser bstan pa tsarngan sa mchog ljon/ /phan bde'i bsung zhim 'phro bzhin rgyas gyur cig ci/sde snod gadros mtsho chen 'khyil ba'i ngogs/ /lung rtogs gnyis ldan dza spu'i rkang 'thung che/ /ci mdzad 'bras smin dam chos su war+ṇar/ /gyur nas 'gro la rnam grol rgyan 'gyur shog /drang srong chen po'i rjes zhugs dge 'dun tshogs/ /rnam dag khrims kyi byi dor lhur len cing / /gtan bde'i ched du klog spong brtun bskyed pa/ /chos brgyad snang shas nongs pas dben gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas srid lam 'khyams dus kun/ /thub dbang gnyis pa dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs zung

—780 rnam thar rtsom pa'i mjug bsnu ba/nor bu gtsug rgyan 'bral med du/ /bsten cing mchod pa gsum gyis mnyes bgyid shog /de tshe dal 'byor kun tshang nya lcib khog /'phags nor thos bsam sgom pa'i mu tig gis/ /phyur bur gtams pa'i dga' ston chen po la/ /nam yang ngoms med 'dod dgur spyod gyur cig /bla ma mchog gi rnam thar glegs bam 'di/ /mtha' dbus nor 'dzin dkyi4/ 'khor kun khyab cing / /mchog dman sus mthong dad dang nges shes mchog /bde blag 'dren pa'i phun tshogs rgyur 'gyur shog 'dis mtshon rnam dkar rgya chen tshogs gnyis mthus / /mi 'jigs seng khrir 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /rnam 'dren yang sprul nyi gzhon lham me bar/ /srid mthar zhabs brtan mdzad 'phrin kun khyab shog /rje btsun bla ma'i nang gi thugs sras mchog /blo baṭang chospra kyi snang byed nyi ma che/ /dpag yas tshe yi dbang phyug ji bzhirno du / /zhabs brtar+ghaṃ blags bshad dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig /dbus gyur 'chang gi dbang ldan nor 'dzin gzhir/ /bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur pa/ /tong kun sa yi tshangs pa phan bde'i gsos/ /zhabs brtan chab srid rdo rje ltar brtan shog /'jig rten kun tu sdig 'bras rgud tshogs bral/ /gang 'dod dge legs mkha' la sprin stug bzhin/ /phun tshogs char chen kun gsal mtha' klas par/ /'dzad med 'bebs pa'i bkra shis kun khyab shog / //ces 'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye bra ga khams gsum chos kyi rgyul po

rna ra ma ba'i mjug bci ba/ 781mnyam med btsong kha pa chen po'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtse'i bar du bsgrongs pa la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral zhing / mkhas shing grub pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ gyi'ajam dbyangs gyigong ma chen po'i rigs kyi cod paṇa dam par gyur pa'i rje btsun bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i gter chen lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar pa rje bla ma marngo+og gi sras kyi thu bo gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje thu'u bkwan hu thog thu blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad 'di nyid bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i gsos su ljags rtsom grub 'phral khyod kyis par du bskrun la mjug tu par byang smon tshig sogs kyang gyis shig ces bka' yi me tog mardor ba spyi bor bstsal pa la brten nas/ rnam thar dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan gyi 'phrin las phyogs brgyar rab gsal nyi gzhon zhes bya ba 'di ni/ pyelcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi bka' lung gis er te ni paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thu zhes brtse gzigs dang / zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten cing / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i cha shas la longs spyad pa'i skal bzang / bka' 'at+pangs kun gyi tha chung bhu su ku ming gzhan g.yer gshong mer gan mkhan po ngag dbang dge 'dun zla ba grags pa'i ming can gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i sa rta lo'i gro bzhin zla ba gdong lnga'i dbang po 'dod pa'i tshims pa'i grwal tshes pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnyan chen se ku bya khyung gi lha zhol dben gnas dam pa/ g.yer gshong bsam gtan chos

da 782 5ma thar ma pa'i mjug bsdu ba/'thel gling gi bla brang legs tshogs kun 'grub kyi gzims khang phun tshogs sgo mang nas g.yar khral du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sdom brtson chos la 'dun ske zhing gsung rab 'bri 'don la byang chub pa'i dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas kyis bgyis pa'i dge bas thub bstan phyogs brgyar 'phel ba dang / dam pa'i rnam thar dri ma med pa bdag gzhan kun gyis tshul bzhin 'dzin nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig / //
